vulgate_text: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā naimiśāraṇyavāsinaḥ / citrā śrotuṃ kathāstatra parivrustapasvinaḥ
ce_text: tam āśramam anuprāptaṃ naimiṣāraṇyavāsinaḥ / citrāḥ śrotuṃ kathās tatra parivavrus tapasvinaḥ

vulgate_text: tasminsadasi vistīrṇe munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām / janamejayasya rājarṣeḥ sarpasatre mahātmanaḥ
ce_text: janamejayasya rājarṣeḥ sarpasatre mahātmanaḥ / samīpe pārthivendrasya samyak pārikṣitasya ca

vulgate_text: samīpe pārthivendrasya samyakpārikṣitasya ca kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaproktāḥ supuṇyā vividhāḥ kathāḥ
ce_text: kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaproktāḥ supuṇyā vividhāḥ kathāḥ / kathitāś cāpi vidhivad yā vaiśaṃpāyanena vai

vulgate_text: maharṣeḥ pūjitasyeha sarvalokairmahātmanaḥ / pravakṣyāmi mataṃ puṇyaṃ vyāsasyādbhutakarmaṇaḥ
ce_text: maharṣeḥ pūjitasyeha sarvaloke mahātmanaḥ / pravakṣyāmi mataṃ kṛtsnaṃ vyāsasyāmitatejasaḥ

vulgate_text: iha sarvamanukrāntamuktaṃ granthasya lakṣaṇam saṃkṣepeṇetihāsasya tato vakṣyati vistaram
ce_text: itihāsāḥ savaiyākhyā vividhāḥ śrutayo 'pi ca / iha sarvam anukrāntam uktaṃ granthasya lakṣaṇam

vulgate_text: aṣṭau ślokasahasrāṇi aṣṭau ślokaśatāni ca / ahaṃ vedmi śuko vetti saṃjayo vetti vā na vā
ce_text: adhyāyānāṃ śataṃ proktam adhyāyāḥ saptatis tathā / aṣṭau ślokasahasrāṇi tathā nava śatāni ca

vulgate_text: tato'nyebhyo'nurūpebhyaḥ śiṣyebhyaḥ pradadau prabhu ṣaṣṭiṃ śatasahasrāṇi cakārānyāṃ sa saṃhitām / triṃśacchatasahasraṃ ca devaloke pratiṣṭhitam
ce_text: idaṃ dvaipāyanaḥ pūrvaṃ putram adhyāpayac chukam / tato 'nyebhyo 'nurūpebhyaḥ śiṣyebhyaḥ pradadau prabhuḥ

vulgate_text: mātrorabhyupapattiśca dharmopaniṣadaṃ prati / dharmānilendrāṃstābhiḥ sā''juhāva sutavāñchayā
ce_text: mātror abhyupapattiś ca dharmopaniṣadaṃ prati / dharmasya vāyoḥ śakrasya devayoś ca tathāśvinoḥ

vulgate_text: taddattopaniṣanmādrī cāśvināvājuhāva ca jātāḥ pārthāstataḥ sarve kuntyā mādryāśca mantrataḥ / tāpasaiḥ saha saṃvṛddhā mātṛbhyāṃ parirakṣitāḥ
ce_text: tāpasaiḥ saha saṃvṛddhā mātṛbhyāṃ parirakṣitāḥ / medhyāraṇyeṣu puṇyeṣu mahatām āśrameṣu ca

ce_text: tāpasaiḥ saha saṃvṛddhā mātṛbhyāṃ parirakṣitāḥ / medhyāraṇyeṣu puṇyeṣu mahatām āśrameṣu ca

vulgate_text: yadā'śrauṣaṃ draupadīṃ raṅgamadhye lakṣyaṃ bhittvā nirjitāmarjunena / śūrānpañcālānpāṇḍaveyāṃśca yuktāṃstadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
ce_text: yadāśrauṣaṃ dvārakāyāṃ subhadrāṃ prasahyoḍhāṃ mādhavīm arjunena / indraprasthaṃ vṛṣṇivīrau ca yātau tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya

vulgate_text: yadā'śrauṣaṃ māgadhānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ jarāsandhaṃ kṣvamadhye jvalantam / dorbhyāṃ hataṃ bhīmasenena gatvā tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
ce_text: yadāśrauṣaṃ bhīmasenānuyātena aśvatthāmnā paramāstraṃ prayuktam / kruddhenaiṣīkam avadhīd yena garbhaṃ tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya

vulgate_text: yadā'śrauṣaṃ digjaye pāṇḍuputrairvaśīkṛtānbhūmipālānprasahya / mahākratuṃ rājasūyaṃ kṛtaṃ ca tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
ce_text: yadāśrauṣaṃ devarājaṃ pravṛṣṭaṃ śarair divyair vāritaṃ cārjunena / agniṃ tathā tarpitaṃ khāṇḍave ca tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya

vulgate_text: yadā'śrauṣaṃ vāsasāṃ tatra rāśiṃ samākṣipatkitavo mandabuddhiḥ / duḥśāsano gatavānnaivaṃ cāntaṃ tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
ce_text: yadāśrauṣaṃ droṇaputraṃ kṛpaṃ ca duḥśāsanaṃ kṛtavarmāṇam ugram / yudhiṣṭhiraṃ śūnyam adharṣayantaṃ tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya

vulgate_text: yadā'śrauṣamasurāṇāṃ vadhārthe kirīṭinaṃ yāntamamitrakarśanam / kṛtārthaṃ cāpyāgataṃ śakralokāttadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
ce_text: yadāśrauṣaṃ tridivasthaṃ dhanaṃjayaṃ śakrāt sākṣād divyam astraṃ yathāvat / adhīyānaṃ śaṃsitaṃ satyasaṃdhaṃ tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya

vulgate_text: yadā'śrauṣaṃ na vidurmāmakāstān pracchannarūpānvasataḥ pāṇḍaveyān / virāṭarāṣṭre saha kṛṣṇayā ca tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
ce_text: yadāśrauṣaṃ māmakānāṃ variṣṭhān dhanaṃjayenaikarathena bhagnān / virāṭarāṣṭre vasatā mahātmanā tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya

vulgate_text: yadā'śrauṣaṃ lokahitāya kṛṣṇaṃ śamārthinamupayātaṃ kurūṇām / śamaṃ kurvāṇamakṛtārthaṃ ca yātaṃ tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
ce_text: yadāśrauṣaṃ karṇaduryodhanābhyāṃ buddhiṃ kṛtāṃ nigrahe keśavasya / taṃ cātmānaṃ bahudhā darśayānaṃ tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya

vulgate_text: yadā'śrauṣaṃ bhīmasenena pītaṃ raktaṃ bhrāturyudhi duḥśāsanasya / nivāritaṃ nānyatamena bhīmaṃ tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
ce_text: yadābhimanyuṃ parivārya bālaṃ sarve hatvā hṛṣṭarūpā babhūvuḥ / mahārathāḥ pārtham aśaknuvantas tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya

vulgate_text: yadā'śrauṣaṃ droṇaputreṇa garbhe vairāṭyā vai pātyamāne mahāstraiḥ / saṃjīvayāmīti hareḥ pratijñāṃ tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
ce_text: yadāśrauṣaṃ droṇaputreṇa garbhe vairāṭyā vai pātyamāne mahāstre / dvaipāyanaḥ keśavo droṇaputraṃ paraspareṇābhiśāpaiḥ śaśāpa

vulgate_text: dvaipāyanaḥ keśavo droṇaputraṃ parasperaṇābhiśāpaiḥ śaśāpa / buddhvā cāhaṃ buddhihīno'dya sūta saṃtapye vai putrapautraiśca hīnaḥ
ce_text: yadāśrauṣaṃ droṇaputreṇa garbhe vairāṭyā vai pātyamāne mahāstre / dvaipāyanaḥ keśavo droṇaputraṃ paraspareṇābhiśāpaiḥ śaśāpa

ce_text: taṃ tathāvādinaṃ dīnaṃ vilapantaṃ mahīpatim / gāvalgaṇir idaṃ dhīmān mahārthaṃ vākyam abravīt

vulgate_text: kālaḥ supteṣu jāgarti kālo hi duratikramaḥ / kālaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu caratyavidhataḥ samaḥ
ce_text: kālo vikurute bhāvān sarvāṃl loke śubhāśubhān / kālaḥ saṃkṣipate sarvāḥ prajā visṛjate punaḥ / kālaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu caraty avidhṛtaḥ samaḥ

vulgate_text: lokānāṃ ca hitārthāya kāruṇyānmunisattamaḥ / atropaniṣadaṃ puṇyāṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyano'bravīt
ce_text: atropaniṣadaṃ puṇyāṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyano 'bravīt / bhāratādhyayanāt puṇyād api pādam adhīyataḥ / śraddadhānasya pūyante sarvapāpāny aśeṣataḥ

vulgate_text: vidvadbhiḥ kathyate loke purāṇe kavisattamaiḥ bhāratādhyayanaṃ puṇyamapi pādamadhīyataḥ / śraddadhānasya pūyante sarvapāpānyaśeṣataḥ
ce_text: atropaniṣadaṃ puṇyāṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyano 'bravīt / bhāratādhyayanāt puṇyād api pādam adhīyataḥ / śraddadhānasya pūyante sarvapāpāny aśeṣataḥ

vulgate_text: āraṇyakaṃ ca vedebhya oṣadhibhyo'mṛtaṃ yathā / hradānāmudadhiḥ śreṣṭho gaurvariṣṭhā catuṣpadām
ce_text: hradānām udadhiḥ śreṣṭho gaur variṣṭhā catuṣpadām / yathaitāni variṣṭhāni tathā bhāratam ucyate

vulgate_text: sa dīrghamāyuḥ kīrtiṃ ca svargatiṃ cāpnuyānnaraḥ / ekataścaturo vedā bhārataṃ caitadekataḥ
ce_text: yaś cemaṃ śṛṇuyān nityam ārṣaṃ śraddhāsamanvitaḥ / sa dīrgham āyuḥ kīrtiṃ ca svargatiṃ cāpnuyān naraḥ

vulgate_text: tadāprabhṛti loke'sminmahābhāratamucyate / mahattve ca gurutve ca dhriyamāṇaṃ yato'dhikam
ce_text: catvāra ekato vedā bhārataṃ caikam ekataḥ / samāgataiḥ surarṣibhis tulām āropitaṃ purā / mahattve ca gurutve ca dhriyamāṇaṃ tato 'dhikam

vulgate_text: atharcīkādayo'bhyetya pitaro rāmamabruvan / rāma rāma mahābhāga prītāḥ sma tava bhārgava
ce_text: atharcīkādayo 'bhyetya pitaro brāhmaṇarṣabham / taṃ kṣamasveti siṣidhus tataḥ sa virarāma ha

vulgate_text: evaṃ bhaviṣyatītyevaṃ pitarastamathābruvan / taṃ kṣamasveti niṣiṣidhustataḥ sa virarāma ha
ce_text: atharcīkādayo 'bhyetya pitaro brāhmaṇarṣabham / taṃ kṣamasveti siṣidhus tataḥ sa virarāma ha

vulgate_text: sametya taṃ dvijāstāśca tatraiva nidhaṃ gatāḥ / etannāmābhinirvṛttaṃ tasya deśasya vai dvijāḥ
ce_text: evaṃ nāmābhinirvṛttaṃ tasya deśasya vai dvijāḥ / puṇyaś ca ramaṇīyaś ca sa deśo vaḥ prakīrtitaḥ

vulgate_text: yattu śaunaka satre te bhāratākhyānamuttamam / janamejayasya tatsatre vyāsaśiṣyeṇa dhīmatā
ce_text: yat tu śaunakasatre te bhāratākhyānavistaram / ākhyāsye tatra paulomam ākhyānaṃ cāditaḥ param

vulgate_text: tadetadbhārataṃ nāma kavibhistūpajīvyate / udayatepsubhirbhṛtyairabhijāta iveśvaraḥ
ce_text: idaṃ sarvaiḥ kavivarair ākhyānam upajīvyate / udayaprepsubhir bhṛtyair abhijāta iveśvaraḥ

vulgate_text: pauṣyaṃ paulomamāstīkamādiraṃśāvatāraṇam / tataḥ saṃbhavaparvoktamadbhutaṃ romaharṣaṇam
ce_text: parvānukramaṇī pūrvaṃ dvitīyaṃ parvasaṃgrahaḥ / pauṣyaṃ paulomam āstīkam ādivaṃśāvatāraṇam

vulgate_text: nivātakavacairyuddhaṃ parva cājagaraṃ tataḥ / mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyā ca parvānantaramucyate
ce_text: mārkaṇḍeyasamasyā ca parvoktaṃ tadanantaram / saṃvādaś ca tataḥ parva draupadīsatyabhāmayoḥ

vulgate_text: saṃvādaśca tataḥ parva draupadīsatyabhāmayoḥ ghoṣayātrā tataḥ parva tataḥ prāyopaveśanem / mantrasya niścayaṃ caiva mṛgasvapnodbhavaṃ tataḥ
ce_text: ghoṣayātrā tataḥ parva mṛgasvapnabhayaṃ tataḥ / vrīhidrauṇikam ākhyānaṃ tato 'nantaram ucyate

vulgate_text: vrīhidrauṇikamākhyānamaindradyumnaṃ tathaiva ca / draupadīharaṇaṃ parva jayadrathavimokṣaṇam
ce_text: saṃdarśanaṃ ca kṛṣṇasya saṃvādaś caiva satyayā / vrīhidrauṇikam ākhyānam aindradyumnaṃ tathaiva ca

vulgate_text: rāmopākhyānamatraiva parva jñeyamataḥ param / pativratāyā māhātmyaṃ sāvitryāścaivamadbhutam
ce_text: ambopākhyānam api ca parva jñeyam ataḥ param / bhīṣmābhiṣecanaṃ parva jñeyam adbhutakāraṇam

vulgate_text: kuṇḍalāharaṇaṃ parva tataḥ paramihocyate / āraṇeyaṃ tataḥ parva vairāṭaṃ tadanantaram / pāṇḍavānāṃ praveśaśca samayasya ca pālanam
ce_text: draupadīharaṇaṃ parva saindhavena vanāt tataḥ / kuṇḍalāharaṇaṃ parva tataḥ param ihocyate

vulgate_text: yānasandhistataḥ parva bhagavadyānameva ca / mātalīyamupākhyānaṃ caritaṃ gālavasya ca
ce_text: parva sānatsujātaṃ ca guhyam adhyātmadarśanam / yānasaṃdhis tataḥ parva bhagavad yānam eva ca

vulgate_text: sāvitraṃ vāmadevyaṃ ca vainyopākhyānameva ca / jāmadagnyamupākhyānaṃ parva ṣoḍaśarājakam
ce_text: sāvitryauddālakīyaṃ ca vainyopākhyānam eva ca / rāmāyaṇam upākhyānam atraiva bahuvistaram

vulgate_text: jñeyaṃ vivādaparvātra karṇasyāpi mahātmanaḥ / mantrasya niścayaṃ kṛtvā kāryasya samanantaram

ce_text: harivaṃśas tataḥ parva purāṇaṃ khilasaṃjñitam / bhaviṣyatparva cāpy uktaṃ khileṣv evādbhutaṃ mahat

vulgate_text: saṃbhavo jatuveśmākhyaṃ hiḍimbabakayorvadhaḥ / tathā caitrarathaṃ devyāḥ pāñcālyāśca svayaṃvaraḥ
ce_text: tato bakavadhaḥ parva parva caitrarathaṃ tataḥ / tataḥ svayaṃvaraṃ devyāḥ pāñcālyāḥ parva cocyate

vulgate_text: vanavāso'rjunasyāpi subhadrāharaṇaṃ tataḥ / haraṇāharaṇaṃ caiva dahanaṃ khāṇḍavasya ca
ce_text: arjunasya vane vāsaḥ subhadrāharaṇaṃ tataḥ / subhadrāharaṇād ūrdhvaṃ jñeyaṃ haraṇahārikam

vulgate_text: khileṣu harivaṃśe ca saṃkhyātāni maharṣiṇā / etatsarvaṃ samākhyātaṃ bhārate parvasaṃgrahaḥ
ce_text: etad akhilam ākhyātaṃ bhārataṃ parvasaṃgrahāt / aṣṭādaśa samājagmur akṣauhiṇyo yuyutsayā / tan mahad dāruṇaṃ yuddham ahāny aṣṭādaśābhavat

vulgate_text: na kiṃciduktavantaste sā tānuvāca yasmādayamabhihato'napakārī tasmādadṛṣṭaṃ tvāṃ bhayamāgamiṣyatīti
ce_text: sa tayā kruddhayā tatroktaḥ / ayaṃ me putro na kiṃ cid aparādhyati / kimartham abhihata iti / yasmāc cāyam abhihato 'napakārī tasmād adṛṣṭaṃ tvāṃ bhayam āgamiṣyatīti

vulgate_text: sa taṃ purohitamupādāyopāvṛtto bhrātṛnuvāca mayā'yaṃ vṛta upādhyāyo yadayaṃ brūyāttatkāryamavicārayadbhirbhavadbhiriti tenaivamuktā bhrātarastasya tathā cakruḥ / sa tathā bhrātṝnsaṃdiśya takṣaśilāṃ pratyabhipratasthe taṃ ca deśaṃ vaśe sthāpayāmāsa
ce_text: tenaivam uktā bhrātaras tasya tathā cakruḥ / sa tathā bhrātṝn saṃdiśya takṣaśilāṃ pratyabhipratasthe / taṃ ca deśaṃ vaśe sthāpayām āsa

vulgate_text: tau taṃ pratyūcaturbhagavaṃstvayaiva preṣito gaccha kedārakhaṇḍaṃ badhāneti / sa evamuktastau śiṣyau pratyuvāca tasmāttatra sarve gacchāmo yatra sa gata iti
ce_text: te pratyūcuḥ / bhagavataiva preṣito gaccha kedārakhaṇḍaṃ badhāneti

vulgate_text: sa evamukta upādhyāyaḥ pratyuvāca yasmādbhavānkedārakhaṇḍaṃ vidāryotthitastasmāduddālaka evanāmnā bhavānbhaviṣyatītyupādhyāyenānugṛhītaḥ
ce_text: tam upādhyāyo 'bravīt / yasmād bhavān kedārakhaṇḍam avadāryotthitas tasmād bhavān uddālaka eva nāmnā bhaviṣyatīti

vulgate_text: mayyanivedya baikṣyaṃ nīpayoktavyamiti / sa tathetyukto bhaikṣyaṃ caritvoṇadhyāyanyavedayat
ce_text: tam upādhyāyaḥ pratyuvāca / mamānivedya bhaikṣaṃ nopayoktavyam iti

vulgate_text: sa tasmādupādhyāyaḥ sarvameva bhaikṣyamagṛhṇāt / sa tathetyuktaḥ punararakṣadgā ahani rakṣitvā niśāmukhe gurukulamāgamya guroragrataḥsthitvā namaścakre
ce_text: sa tathety uktvā punar arakṣad gāḥ / rakṣitvā cāgamya tathaivopādhyāyasyāgrataḥ sthitvā namaścakre

vulgate_text: naiṣā nyāyyā guruvṛttiranyeṣāmapi bhaikṣyopajīvināṃ vṛttyuparodhaṃ karoṣi ityevaṃ vartamāno lubdho'sīti
ce_text: tam upādhyāyaḥ pratyuvāca / naiṣā nyāyyā guruvṛttiḥ / anyeṣām api vṛttyuparodhaṃ karoṣy evaṃ vartamānaḥ / lubdho 'sīti

vulgate_text: tamupādhyāyaḥ pīvānameva dṛṣṭvovāca / vatsopamanyo bhaikṣyaṃ nāśnāsi na cānyaccarasi payo na pibasi pīvānasi bhṛśaṃ kenedānīṃ vṛttiṃ kalpayasīti
ce_text: tam upādhyāyas tathāpi pīvānam eva dṛṣṭvovāca / vatsopamanyo sarvam aśeṣatas te bhaikṣaṃ gṛhṇāmi / kenedānīṃ vṛttiṃ kalpayasīti

vulgate_text: tathā pratiṣiddho bhaikṣyaṃ nāśnāti nacānyaccarati payo na pibati phenaṃ nopayuhkte sa kadācidaraṇye kṣudhārto'rkapatrāṇyabhakṣayat
ce_text: sa tatheti pratijñāya nirāhāras tā gā arakṣat / tathā pratiṣiddho bhaikṣaṃ nāśnāti na cānyac carati / payo na pibati / phenaṃ nopayuṅkte

vulgate_text: atha tasminnanāgacchati sūrye cāstācalāvalambini upādhyāyaḥ śiṣyānavocat
ce_text: atha tasminn anāgacchaty upādhyāyaḥ śiṣyān avocat / mayopamanyuḥ sarvataḥ pratiṣiddhaḥ / sa niyataṃ kupitaḥ / tato nāgacchati ciragataś ceti

vulgate_text: sa upādhyāyasya āhvānavacanaṃ śrutvā pratyuvācoccairayamasminkūpe patito'hamiti / tamupādhyāyaḥ pratyuvāca kathaṃ tvamasminkūpe patita iti
ce_text: tam upādhyāyaḥ pratyuvāca / katham asi kūpe patita iti

vulgate_text: sa upādhyāyaṃ pratyuvāca arkapatrāṇi bhakṣayitvāndhībhūtosmyataścaṅkramyamāṇaḥ kūpe patita iti / tamupādhyāyaḥ pratyuvāca
ce_text: sa taṃ pratyuvāca / arkapatrāṇi bhakṣayitvāndhībhūto 'smi / ataḥ kūpe patita iti

vulgate_text: athāparaḥ śiṣyastasyaivāpodasya dhaumyasya baido nāma tamupādhyāyaḥ samādideśa vatsa baida ihāsyatāṃ tāvanmama gṛhe kaṃcitkālaṃ śuśrūṣuṇā ca bhavitavyaṃ śreyaste bhaviṣyatīti
ce_text: tam upādhyāyaḥ saṃdideśa / vatsa veda ihāsyatām / bhavatā madgṛhe kaṃ cit kālaṃ śuśrūṣamāṇena bhavitavyam / śreyas te bhaviṣyatīti

vulgate_text: sa upādhyāyenānujñātaḥ samāvṛttastasmādgurukulavāsādgṛhāśramaṃ pratyapadyata tasyāpi svagṛhe vasatastrayaḥ śiṣyā babhūvuḥ sa śiṣyānna kiṃciduvāca karma vā kriyatāṃ guruśuśrūṣā veti / duḥkhābhijño hi gurukulavāsasya śiṣyānparikleśena yojayituṃ neyeṣa
ce_text: sa śiṣyān na kiṃ cid uvāca / karma vā kriyatāṃ guruśuśrūṣā veti / duḥkhābhijño hi gurukulavāsasya śiṣyān parikleśena yojayituṃ neyeṣa

vulgate_text: bhoyatkiṃcidasmadgṛhe parihīyate tadicchāmyahamaparihīyamānaṃ bhavatā kriyamāṇamiti sa evaṃ pratisaṃdiśyottaṅkaṃ baidaḥ pravāsaṃ jagāma
ce_text: sa kadā cid yājyakāryeṇābhiprasthita uttaṅkaṃ nāma śiṣyaṃ niyojayām āsa / bho uttaṅka yat kiṃ cid asmadgṛhe parihīyate tad icchāmy aham aparihīṇaṃ bhavatā kriyamāṇam iti

vulgate_text: upādhyāyānī te ṛtumatī upādhyāyaśca proṣito'syā yathā'yamṛturvandhyo na bhavati tathā kriyatāmeṣā viṣīdatīti
ce_text: sa vasaṃs tatropādhyāyastrībhiḥ sahitābhir āhūyoktaḥ / upādhyāyinī te ṛtumatī / upādhyāyaś ca proṣitaḥ / asyā yathāyam ṛtur vandhyo na bhavati tathā kriyatām / etad viṣīdatīti

vulgate_text: ānayasvetaścaturthe'hani puṇyakarma bhavitā tābhyāmābaddhābhyāṃ śobhamānā brāhmaṇānpariveṣṭumicchāmi / tatsaṃpādayasva evaṃ hi kurvataḥ śreyo bhavitā'nyathā kutaḥ śreya iti
ce_text: saivam uktopādhyāyiny uttaṅkaṃ pratyuvāca / gaccha pauṣyaṃ rājānam / bhikṣasva tasya kṣatriyayā pinaddhe kuṇḍale / te ānayasva / itaś caturthe 'hani puṇyakaṃ bhavitā / tābhyām ābaddhābhyāṃ brāhmaṇān pariveṣṭum icchāmi / śobhamānā yathā tābhyāṃ kuṇḍalābhyāṃ tasminn ahani saṃpādayasva / śreyo hi te syāt kṣaṇaṃ kurvata iti

vulgate_text: bhouttaṅkaitatpurīṣamasya ṛṣabhasya bhakṣayasveti sa evamukto naicchat
ce_text: sa puruṣa uttaṅkam abhyabhāṣata / uttaṅkaitat purīṣam asya ṛṣabhasya bhakṣayasveti

vulgate_text: sa evamukto bāḍhamityuktvā tadā tadvṛpabhasya mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ ca bhakṣayitvottaṅkaḥ saṃbhramāḍhutthita evāpo'nuspṛśya pratasthe
ce_text: sa evam ukto bāḍham ity uktvā tadā tad ṛṣabhasya purīṣaṃ mūtraṃ ca bhakṣayitvottaṅkaḥ pratasthe yatra sa kṣatriyaḥ pauṣyaḥ

vulgate_text: yatra sa kṣatriyaḥ pauṣyastamupetyāsīnamapaśyaduttaṅkaḥ / sa uttaṅkastamupetyāśīrbhirabhinandyovāca
ce_text: tam upetyāpaśyad uttaṅka āsīnam / sa tam upetyāśīrbhir abhinandyovāca / arthī bhavantam upagato 'smīti

vulgate_text: athaivamukta uttaṅkaḥ smṛtvovācāsti khalu mayā tu bhakṣitaṃ nopaspṛṣṭamāgacchateti / taṃ pauṣyaḥ pratyuvāca eṣa te vyatikramo notthitenopaspṛṣṭaṃ bhavati śīghramāgacchateti
ce_text: athaivam ukta uttaṅkaḥ smṛtvovāca / asti khalu mayocchiṣṭenopaspṛṣṭaṃ śīghraṃ gacchatā ceti

vulgate_text: sa tāmuvācaite kuṇḍale gurvarthaṃ me bhikṣite dātumarhasīti / sā prītā tena tasya sadbhāvena pātramayamanatikramaṇīyaśceti matvā te kuṇḍale avamucyāsmai prāyacchadāha cainamete kuṇḍale takṣako nāgarājaḥ subhṛśaṃ prārthayatyapramatto netumarhasīti
ce_text: sā prītā tena tasya sadbhāvena pātram ayam anatikramaṇīyaś ceti matvā te kuṇḍale avamucyāsmai prāyacchat

vulgate_text: sa evamuktvā tāṃ kṣatriyāmāmantrya pauṣyasakāśamāgacchat / āha cainaṃ bhoḥ pauṣya prīto'smīti tamuttaṅkaṃ pauṣyaḥ pratyuvāca
ce_text: sa evam uktvā tāṃ kṣatriyām āmantrya pauṣyasakāśam āgacchat

vulgate_text: bhagavaṃścireṇa pātramāsādyate bhavāśca guṇavānatithistadicche śrāddhaṃ kartuṃ kriyatāṃ kṣaṇa iti
ce_text: taṃ pauṣyaḥ pratyuvāca / bhagavaṃś cirasya pātram āsādyate / bhavāṃś ca guṇavān atithiḥ / tat kariṣye śrāddham / kṣaṇaḥ kriyatām iti

vulgate_text: na yuktaṃ bhavatā'nnamaśuci dattvā pratiśāpaṃ dātuṃ tasmādannameva pratyakṣīkuru / tataḥ pauṣyastadannamaśuci dṛṣṭvā tasyāśucibhāvamaparokṣayāmāsa
ce_text: so 'tha pauṣyas tasyāśucibhāvam annasyāgamayām āsa

vulgate_text: tasya takṣako dṛḍhamāsannaḥ sataṃ jagrāha / gṛhītamātraḥ sa tadrūpaṃ vihāya takṣakasvarūpaṃ kṛtvā sahasā dharaṇyāṃ vivṛtaṃ mahābilaṃ praviveśa
ce_text: etasminn antare sa śramaṇas tvaramāṇa upasṛtya te kuṇḍale gṛhītvā prādravat / tam uttaṅko 'bhisṛtya jagrāha / sa tad rūpaṃ vihāya takṣakarūpaṃ kṛtvā sahasā dharaṇyāṃ vivṛtaṃ mahābilaṃ viveśa

vulgate_text: praviśya ca nāgalokaṃ svabhavanamagacchat / athottaṅkastasyāḥ kṣatriyāyā vacaḥ smṛtvā taṃ takṣakamanvagacchat
ce_text: praviśya ca nāgalokaṃ svabhavanam agacchat / tam uttaṅko 'nvāviveśa tenaiva bilena / praviśya ca nāgān astuvad ebhiḥ ślokaiḥ

vulgate_text: tamuttaṅko'nuviveśa tenaiva bilena praviśya ca taṃ nāgalokamaparyantamanekavidhaprāsādaharmyavalabhīniryūhaśatasaṃkulamuccāvacakrīḍāścaryasthānāvakīrṇamapaśyat
ce_text: praviśya ca nāgalokaṃ svabhavanam agacchat / tam uttaṅko 'nvāviveśa tenaiva bilena / praviśya ca nāgān astuvad ebhiḥ ślokaiḥ

vulgate_text: sa tatra nāgāṃstānastuvadebhiḥ ślokaiḥ ya airāvatarājānaḥ sarpāḥ samitiśobhāḥ / kṣaranta iva jīmūtāḥ savidyutpavaneritāḥ
ce_text: ya airāvatarājānaḥ sarpāḥ samitiśobhanāḥ / varṣanta iva jīmūtāḥ savidyutpavaneritāḥ

vulgate_text: bahūni nāgaveśmāni gaṅgāyāstīra uttare / tatrasthānapi saṃstaumi mahataḥ pannagānaham
ce_text: bahūni nāgavartmāni gaṅgāyās tīra uttare / icchet ko 'rkāṃśusenāyāṃ cartum airāvataṃ vinā

vulgate_text: evaṃ stuvannapi nāgānyadā te kuṇḍale nālabhattadā'paśyatstriyau tantre adhiropya suveme paṭaṃ vayantyau / tasmiṃstantre kṛṣṇāḥ sitāśca tantavaścakraṃ cāpaśyaddvādaśāraṃ ṣaḍbhiḥ kumāraiḥ parivartyamānaṃ puruṣaṃ cāpaśyadaśvaṃ ca darśanīyam
ce_text: tasmiṃś ca tantre kṛṣṇāḥ sitāś ca tantavaḥ / cakraṃ cāpaśyat ṣaḍbhiḥ kumāraiḥ parivartyamānam / puruṣaṃ cāpaśyad darśanīyam

vulgate_text: tābhirnāgaloka upadhūpite'tha saṃbhrāntastakṣako'gnestejobhayādviṣaṇṇaḥ kuṇḍale gṛhītvā sahasā bhavanānniṣkramyottaṅkamuvāca
ce_text: atha sasaṃbhramas takṣako 'gnitejobhayaviṣaṇṇas te kuṇḍale gṛhītvā sahasā svabhavanān niṣkramyottaṅkam uvāca / ete kuṇḍale pratigṛhṇātu bhavān iti

vulgate_text: adya tatpuṇyakamupādhyāyānyā dūraṃ cāhamabhyāgataḥ sa kathaṃ saṃbhāvayeyamiti
ce_text: sa te pratijagrāhottaṅkaḥ / kuṇḍale pratigṛhyācintayat / adya tat puṇyakam upādhyāyinyāḥ / dūraṃ cāham abhyāgataḥ / kathaṃ nu khalu saṃbhāvayeyam iti

vulgate_text: athaitasminnantare sa uttaṅkaḥ praviśya upādhyāyakulaṃ upādhyāyānīmabhyavādayatte cāsyai kuṇḍale prāyacchatsā cainaṃ pratyuvāca
ce_text: athottaṅkaḥ praviśya upādhyāyinīm abhyavādayat / te cāsyai kuṇḍale prāyacchat

vulgate_text: uttaṅka deśe kāle'bhyāgataḥ svāgataṃ te vatsa idānīṃ yadyanāgatosi kopitayā mayā śapto bhaviṣyasi śreyastavopasthitaṃ siddhimāpnuhīti
ce_text: sā cainaṃ pratyuvāca / uttaṅka deśe kāle 'bhyāgataḥ / svāgataṃ te vatsa / manāg asi mayā na śaptaḥ / śreyas tavopasthitam / siddhim āpnuhīti

vulgate_text: tatastasya vacanānmayā tadṛṣabhasya purīṣamupayuktaṃ sa cāpi kaḥ tadetadbhavatopadiṣṭamiccheyaṃ śrotuṃ kiṃ taditi / sa tenaivamukta upādhyāyaḥ pratyuvāca
ce_text: pathi gacchatā mayā ṛṣabho dṛṣṭaḥ / taṃ ca puruṣo 'dhirūḍhaḥ / tenāsmi sopacāram uktaḥ / uttaṅkāsya ṛṣabhasya purīṣaṃ bhakṣaya / upādhyāyenāpi te bhakṣitam iti / tatas tadvacanān mayā tadṛṣabhasya purīṣam upayuktam / tad icchāmi bhavatopadiṣṭaṃ kiṃ tad iti

vulgate_text: yaścainamadhirūḍhaḥ puruṣaḥ sa cendraḥ yadapi te bhakṣitaṃ tasya ṛṣabhasya purīṣaṃ tadamṛtaṃ tena khalvasi tasminnāgabhavane na vyāpannastvam
ce_text: ya ṛṣabhas tvayā pathi gacchatā dṛṣṭaḥ sa airāvato nāgarājaḥ / yaś cainam adhirūḍhaḥ sa indraḥ / yad api te purīṣaṃ bhakṣitaṃ tasya ṛṣabhasya tad amṛtam

vulgate_text: sa hi bhagavānindro mama sakhā tvadanukrośādimamanugrahaṃ kṛtavān / tasmātkuṇḍale gṛhītvā punarāgato'si
ce_text: tadanugrahāt kuṇḍale gṛhītvā punar abhyāgato 'si / tat saumya gamyatām / anujāne bhavantam / śreyo 'vāpsyasīti

vulgate_text: tatsaumya gamyatāmanujāne bhavantaṃ śreyo'vāpsyasīti / sa upādhyāyenānujñāto bhagavānuttaṅkaḥ kruddhastakṣakaṃ praticikīrṣamāṇo hāstinapuraṃ pratasthe
ce_text: sa upādhyāyenānujñāta uttaṅkaḥ kruddhas takṣakasya praticikīrṣamāṇo hāstinapuraṃ pratasthe

vulgate_text: anyasminkaraṇīye tu kārye pārthivasattama / arcayitvā yathānyāyaṃ pratyuvāca dvijottamam
ce_text: anyasmin karaṇīye tvaṃ kārye pārthivasattama / bālyād ivānyad eva tvaṃ kuruṣe nṛpasattama

vulgate_text: evamuktastu vipreṇa sa rājā janamejayaḥ / arcayitvā yathānyāyaṃ pratyuvāca dvijottamam
ce_text: evam uktas tu vipreṇa sa rājā pratyuvāca ha / janamejayaḥ prasannātmā samyak saṃpūjya taṃ munim

vulgate_text: āsāṃ prajānāṃ paripālanena svaṃ kṣatradharmaṃ paripālayāmi / pravrūhi me kiṃ karaṇīyamadya yenāsi kāryeṇa samāgatastvam
ce_text: āsāṃ prajānāṃ paripālanena svaṃ kṣatradharmaṃ paripālayāmi / prabrūhi vā kiṃ kriyatāṃ dvijendra śuśrūṣur asmy adya vacas tvadīyam

vulgate_text: paurāṇikaḥ purāṇe kṛtaśramaḥ sa kṛtāñjalistānuvāca mayottaṅkasya caritamaśeṣamuktaṃ janamejayasya sārpasatre nimittāntaramidamapi / kiṃ bhavantaḥ śrotumicchanti kimahaṃ bravāṇīti
ce_text: paurāṇikaḥ purāṇe kṛtaśramaḥ sa tān kṛtāñjalir uvāca / kiṃ bhavantaḥ śrotum icchanti / kim ahaṃ bruvāṇīti

vulgate_text: purāṇamakhilaṃ tāta pitā te'dhītavānpurā bhāratādhyayanaṃ sarvaṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanāttadā / kaccittvamapi tatsarvamadhīṣe raumaharṣaṇe
ce_text: purāṇam akhilaṃ tāta pitā te 'dhītavān purā / kaccit tvam api tat sarvam adhīṣe lomaharṣaṇe

vulgate_text: nigadāmi yathāyuktaṃ purāṇāśrayasaṃyutam / bhṛgurmaharṣirbhagavānbrahmaṇā vai svayaṃbhuvā
ce_text: imaṃ vaṃśam ahaṃ brahman bhārgavaṃ te mahāmune / nigadāmi kathāyuktaṃ purāṇāśrayasaṃyutam

vulgate_text: varuṇasya kratau jātaḥ pāvakāditi naḥ śrutam / bhṛgoḥ sudayitaḥ putraścyavano nāma bhārgavaḥ
ce_text: bhṛgoḥ sudayitaḥ putraś cyavano nāma bhārgavaḥ / cyavanasyāpi dāyādaḥ pramatir nāma dhārmikaḥ / pramater apy abhūt putro ghṛtācyāṃ rurur ity uta

vulgate_text: idamantaramityevaṃ hartuṃ cakre manastadā / athāgniśaraṇe'paśyajjvalantaṃ jātavedasam
ce_text: athāgniśaraṇe 'paśyaj jvalitaṃ jātavedasam / tam apṛcchat tato rakṣaḥ pāvakaṃ jvalitaṃ tadā

vulgate_text: mukhaṃ tvamasi devānāṃ vada pāvaka pṛcchate / mayā hīyaṃ vṛtā pūrvaṃ bhāryārthe varavarṇinī
ce_text: mayā hīyaṃ pūrvavṛtā bhāryārthe varavarṇinī / paścāt tv imāṃ pitā prādād bhṛgave 'nṛtakāriṇe

vulgate_text: matpūrvabhāryāṃ yadimāṃ bhṛgurāpa sumadhyamām / asaṃmatamidaṃ me'dya hariṣyāmyāśramādimām
ce_text: manyur hi hṛdayaṃ me 'dya pradahann iva tiṣṭhati / matpurvabhāryāṃ yad imāṃ bhṛguḥ prāpa sumadhyamām

vulgate_text: tasyaitadvacanaṃ śrutvā saptārcirduḥkhito'bhavat / satyaṃ vadāmi yadi me śāpaḥ syādbrahmavittamāt
ce_text: tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā saptārcir duḥkhito bhṛśam / bhīto 'nṛtāc ca śāpāc ca bhṛgor ity abravīc chanaiḥ

ce_text: athābravīc ca taṃ bhrātā supratīkaṃ vibhāvasuḥ / vibhāgaṃ bahavo mohāt kartum icchanti nityadā / tato vibhaktā anyonyaṃ nādriyante 'rthamohitāḥ

vulgate_text: evaṃ nirbadhyamānastu śaśāpainaṃ vibhāvasuḥ guruśāstre'nibaddhānāmanyonyenābhiśaṅkinām
ce_text: tasmāc caiva vibhāgārthaṃ na praśaṃsanti paṇḍitāḥ / guruśāstre nibaddhānām anyonyam abhiśaṅkinām

vulgate_text: apaśyannirmalajalaṃ nānāpakṣisamākulam / sa tatsmṛtvā piturvākyaṃ bhīmavego'ntarikṣagaḥ
ce_text: sa tac chrutvā pitur vākyaṃ bhīmavego 'ntarikṣagaḥ / nakhena gajam ekena kūrmam ekena cākṣipat

vulgate_text: tataḥ prasādayāmāsa kaśyapaḥ putrakāraṇāt / vālakhilyānmahābhāgāṃstapasā hatakalmaṣān
ce_text: prasādayām āsa sa tān kaśyapaḥ putrakāraṇāt / vālakhilyāṃs tapaḥsiddhān idam uddiśya kāraṇam

vulgate_text: tāvubhau bhakṣayitvā tu sa tārkṣyaḥ kūrmakuñjarau / tataḥ parvatakūṭāgrādutpapāta mahājavaḥ
ce_text: tataḥ parvatakūṭāgrād utpapāta manojavaḥ / prāvartantātha devānām utpātā bhayavedinaḥ

vulgate_text: rakṣadhvaṃ vibudhā vīrā yathā na sa haredbalāt / atulaṃ hi balaṃ tasya bṛhaspatiruvāca ha
ce_text: yuṣmān saṃbodhayāmy eṣa yathā sa na hared balāt / atulaṃ hi balaṃ tasya bṛhaspatir uvāca me

vulgate_text: carmāṇyapi ca gātreṣu bhānumanti dṛḍhāni ca / vividhāni ca śastrāṇi ghorarūpāṇyanekaśaḥ
ce_text: vividhāni ca śastrāṇi ghorarūpāṇy anekaśaḥ / śitatīkṣṇāgradhārāṇi samudyamya sahasraśaḥ

vulgate_text: athāpaśyadṛṣīnhrasvānaṅguṣṭhodaravarṣmaṇaḥ / palāśavartikāmekāṃ vahataḥ saṃhatānpathi
ce_text: athāpaśyad ṛṣīn hrasvān aṅguṣṭhodaraparvaṇaḥ / palāśavṛntikām ekāṃ sahitān vahataḥ pathi

vulgate_text: tatastasmādgirivarātsamudīrṇamahābalaḥ garuḍaḥ pakṣirāṭ tūrṇaṃ saṃprāpto vibudhānprati
ce_text: tatas tasmin dvijaśreṣṭha samudīrṇe tathāvidhe / garutmān pakṣirāṭ tūrṇaṃ saṃprāpto vibudhān prati

vulgate_text: nanādoccaiḥ sa balavānmahāmegha ivāmbare / vadhyamānaḥ suragaṇaiḥ sarvabhūtāni bhīṣayan
ce_text: nanāda coccair balavān mahāmegharavaḥ khagaḥ / vadhyamānaḥ suragaṇaiḥ sarvabhūtāni bhīṣayan / utpapāta mahāvīryaḥ pakṣirāṭ paravīrahā

vulgate_text: ulūkaśvasanābhyāṃ ca nimeṣeṇa ca pakṣirāṭ / prarujena ca saṃgrāmaṃ cakāra pulinena ca
ce_text: ulūkaśvasanābhyāṃ ca nimeṣeṇa ca pakṣiṇā / prarujena ca saṃyuddhaṃ cakāra pralihena ca

vulgate_text: iti saṃcintya garuḍastayostūrṇaṃ nirākaraḥ tayoścakṣūṃṣi rajasā suparṇaḥ sahasā''vṛṇot / tābhyāmadṛṣṭarūpo'sau sarvataḥ samatāḍayat
ce_text: tayoś cakṣūṃṣi rajasā suparṇas tūrṇam āvṛṇot / adṛṣṭarūpas tau cāpi sarvataḥ paryakālayat

vulgate_text: evamastviti taṃ viṣṇuruvāca vinatāsutam / pratigṛhya vanau tau ca garuḍo viṣṇumabravīt
ce_text: pratigṛhya varau tau ca garuḍo viṣṇum abravīt / bhavate 'pi varaṃ dadmi vṛṇītāṃ bhagavān api

vulgate_text: bhavatepi varaṃ dadyāṃ vṛṇotu bhagavānapi / taṃ vavre vāhanaṃ viṣṇurnarutmantaṃ mahābalam
ce_text: taṃ vavre vāhanaṃ kṛṣṇo garutmantaṃ mahābalam / dhvajaṃ ca cakre bhagavān upari sthāsyasīti tam

vulgate_text: dhvajaṃ ca cakre bhagavānupari sthāsyasīti tam / evamastviti taṃ devamuktvā nārāyaṇaṃ khagaḥ
ce_text: taṃ vavre vāhanaṃ kṛṣṇo garutmantaṃ mahābalam / dhvajaṃ ca cakre bhagavān upari sthāsyasīti tam

vulgate_text: harantamamṛtaṃ roṣādgaruḍaṃ pakṣiṇāṃ varam / tamuvācendramākrande garuḍaḥ patatāṃ varaḥ
ce_text: tam uvācendram ākrande garuḍaḥ patatāṃ varaḥ / prahasañ ślakṣṇayā vācā tathā vajrasamāhataḥ

vulgate_text: na ca vajranipātena rujā me'stīha kācana / evamuktvā tataḥ putramutsasarja sa pakṣirāṭ
ce_text: eṣa patraṃ tyajāmy ekaṃ yasyāntaṃ nopalapsyase / na hi vajranipātena rujā me 'sti kadā cana

vulgate_text: surūpaṃ patramālakṣya suparṇo'yaṃ bhavatviti taddṛṣṭvā mahadāścaryaṃ sahasrākṣaḥ puraṃdaraḥ / khago mahadidaṃ bhūtamiti matvā'bhyabhāṣata
ce_text: dṛṣṭvā tad adbhutaṃ cāpi sahasrākṣaḥ puraṃdaraḥ / khago mahad idaṃ bhūtam iti matvābhyabhāṣata

vulgate_text: kāmaṃ naitatpraśaṃsanti santaḥ svabalasaṃstavam / animittaṃ suraśreṣṭha sadyaḥ prāpnoti garhaṇām
ce_text: kāmaṃ naitat praśaṃsanti santaḥ svabalasaṃstavam / guṇasaṃkīrtanaṃ cāpi svayam eva śatakrato

vulgate_text: guṇasaṃkīrtanaṃ cāpi pṛṣṭenānyena gopate vaktavyaṃ na tu vaktavyaṃ svayameva śatakrato
ce_text: kāmaṃ naitat praśaṃsanti santaḥ svabalasaṃstavam / guṇasaṃkīrtanaṃ cāpi svayam eva śatakrato

vulgate_text: saparvatavanāmurvīṃ sasāgarajalāmimām / vahe pakṣeṇa vai śakra tvāmapyatrāvalambinam
ce_text: saparvatavanām urvīṃ sasāgaravanām imām / pakṣanāḍyaikayā śakra tvāṃ caivātrāvalambinam

vulgate_text: evameva yathāttha tvaṃ sarvaṃ saṃbhāvyate tvayi / saṃgṛhyatāmidānīṃ me sakhyamatyantamuttamam
ce_text: pratigṛhyatām idānīṃ me sakhyam ānantyam uttamam / na kāryaṃ tava somena mama somaḥ pradīyatām / asmāṃs te hi prabādheyur yebhyo dadyād bhavān imam

vulgate_text: tathetyuktvā'nvagacchattaṃ tato dānavasūdanaḥ / devadevaṃ mahātmānaṃ yogināmīśvaraṃ harim
ce_text: tathety uktvānvagacchat taṃ tato dānavasūdanaḥ / hariṣyāmi vinikṣiptaṃ somam ity anubhāṣya tam

vulgate_text: ajaraścābharaścaiva devānāṃ supriyo bhava / atha sarpānuvācedaṃ sarvānparamahṛṣṭavat / idamānītamamṛtaṃ nikṣepsyāmi kuśeṣu vaḥ
ce_text: ājagāma tatas tūrṇaṃ suparṇo mātur antikam / atha sarpān uvācedaṃ sarvān paramahṛṣṭavat

vulgate_text: snātā maṅgalasaṃyuktāstataḥ prāśnīta pannagāḥ / bhavadbhiridamāsīnairyaduktaṃ tadvacastadā
ce_text: idam ānītam amṛtaṃ nikṣepsyāmi kuśeṣu vaḥ / snātā maṅgalasaṃyuktās tataḥ prāśnīta pannagāḥ

vulgate_text: yatraitadamṛtaṃ cāpi sthāpitaṃ kuśasaṃstare / tadvijñāya hṛtaṃ sarpāḥ pratimāyākṛtaṃ ca tat
ce_text: tad vijñāya hṛtaṃ sarpāḥ pratimāyākṛtaṃ ca tat / somasthānam idaṃ ceti darbhāṃs te lilihus tadā

vulgate_text: abhavaṃścāmṛtasparśāddarbhāste'tha pavitriṇaḥ nāgāśca vañcitā bhūtvā visṛjya vinatāṃ tataḥ / viṣādamagamaṃstīvraṃ garuḍasya balātprabho
ce_text: tato dvaidhīkṛtā jihvā sarpāṇāṃ tena karmaṇā / abhavaṃś cāmṛtasparśād darbhās te 'tha pavitriṇaḥ

vulgate_text: kardamaśca mahānāgo nāgaśca bahumūlakaḥ / karkarākarkarau nāgau kuṇḍodaramahodarau
ce_text: kuñjaraḥ kuraraś caiva tathā nāgaḥ prabhākaraḥ / kumudaḥ kumudākṣaś ca tittirir halikas tathā / karkarākarkarau cobhau kuṇḍodaramahodarau

vulgate_text: tamevaṃ vādinaṃ śeṣaṃ pitāmaha uvāca ha / jānāmi śeṣa sarveṣāṃ bhrātṝṇāṃ te viceṣṭitam
ce_text: jānāmi śeṣa sarveṣāṃ bhrātṝṇāṃ te viceṣṭitam / mātuś cāpy aparādhād vai bhrātṝṇāṃ te mahad bhayam

vulgate_text: dāsyāmi hi varaṃ te'dya prītirme paramā tvayi diṣṭyā buddhiśca te dharme niviṣṭā pannagottama / bhūyo bhūyaśca te buddhirdharme bhavatu susthirā
ce_text: diṣṭyā ca buddhir dharme te niviṣṭā pannagottama / ato bhūyaś ca te buddhir dharme bhavatu susthirā

vulgate_text: nūnaṃ sarvavināśo'yamasmākaṃ samupāgataḥ śāpaḥ sṛṣṭo mahāghoro mātrā khalvavinītayā / na hyetāṃ so'vyayo devaḥ śapatnīṃ pratyaṣedhayat
ce_text: nūnaṃ sarvavināśo 'yam asmākaṃ samudāhṛtaḥ / na hy enāṃ so 'vyayo devaḥ śapantīṃ pratyaṣedhayat

vulgate_text: sarva eva hi nastāvadbuddhimanto vicakṣaṇāḥ / api mantrayamāṇā hi hetuṃ paśyāma mokṣaṇe
ce_text: api mantrayamāṇā hi hetuṃ paśyāma mokṣaṇe / yathā naṣṭaṃ purā devā gūḍham agniṃ guhāgatam

vulgate_text: yathā naṣṭaṃ purā devā gūḍhamagniṃ guhāgatam yathā sa yajño na bhavedyathā vā'pi parābhavaḥ / janamejayasya sarpāṇāṃ vināśakaraṇāya vai
ce_text: yathā sa yajño na bhaved yathā vāpi parābhavet / janamejayasya sarpāṇāṃ vināśakaraṇāya hi

vulgate_text: apare tvabruvannāgā dharmātmāno dayālavaḥ / abuddhireṣā bhavatāṃ brahmahatyā na śobhanam
ce_text: tatrāpare 'mantrayanta dharmātmāno bhujaṃgamāḥ / abuddhir eṣā yuṣmākaṃ brahmahatyā na śobhanā

vulgate_text: eṣā no naiṣṭhikī buddhiḥ sarveṣāmīkṣaṇaśravaḥ / atha yanmanyase rājandrutaṃ tatsaṃvidhīyatām
ce_text: eṣā vai naiṣṭhikī buddhiḥ sarveṣām eva saṃmatā / yathā vā manyase rājaṃs tat kṣipraṃ saṃvidhīyatām

vulgate_text: kiṃ tatra saṃvidhātavyaṃ bhavatāṃ syāddhitaṃ tu yat / śreyaḥ prasādanaṃ manye kaśyapaśya mahātmanaḥ
ce_text: kiṃ tv atra saṃvidhātavyaṃ bhavatāṃ yad bhaved dhitam / anenāhaṃ bhṛśaṃ tapye guṇadoṣau madāśrayau

vulgate_text: tasyāṃ janayitā putraṃ vedavedāṅgapāragam sanāmāyāṃ sanāmā sa kanyāyāṃ dvijasattamaḥ
ce_text: sanāmāyāṃ sanāmā sa kanyāyāṃ dvijasattamaḥ / apatyaṃ vīryavān devā vīryavaj janayiṣyati

vulgate_text: evamastviti taṃ devāḥ pitāmahamathābruvan / utkvaivaṃ vacanaṃ devānviriñcistridivaṃ yayau
ce_text: evam astv iti taṃ devāḥ pitāmaham athābruvan / uktvā caivaṃ gatā devāḥ sa ca devaḥ pitāmahaḥ

vulgate_text: etacchrutvā tu nāgendraḥ pitāmahavacastadā / saṃdiśya pannagānsarvānvāsukiḥ śāpamohitaḥ
ce_text: etac chrutvā sa nāgendraḥ pitāmahavacas tadā / sarpān bahūñ jaratkārau nityayuktān samādadhat

vulgate_text: svasāramudyamya tadā jaratkārumṛṣiṃ prati / sarpānbahūñjaratkārau nityayuktānsamādadhat
ce_text: etac chrutvā sa nāgendraḥ pitāmahavacas tadā / sarpān bahūñ jaratkārau nityayuktān samādadhat

vulgate_text: jaratkāruriti khyāto yastvayā sūtanandana / icchāmi tadahaṃ śrotuṃ ṛṣestasya mahātmanaḥ
ce_text: jaratkārur iti proktaṃ yat tvayā sūtanandana / icchāmy etad ahaṃ tasya ṛṣeḥ śrotuṃ mahātmanaḥ

vulgate_text: parikṣito narendrasya viddho yannaṣṭavānmṛgaḥ / dūraṃ cāpahṛtastena mṛgeṇa sa mahīpatiḥ
ce_text: dūraṃ cāpahṛtas tena mṛgeṇa sa mahīpatiḥ / pariśrāntaḥ pipāsārta āsasāda muniṃ vane

vulgate_text: saṃrambhātkopano'tīva viṣakalpo muneḥ sutaḥ uddiśya pitaraṃ tasya yacchrutvā roṣamāharat / ṛṣiputreṇa narmārthe kṛśena dvijasattama
ce_text: sakhyoktaḥ krīḍamānena sa tatra hasatā kila / saṃrambhī kopano 'tīva viṣakalpa ṛṣeḥ sutaḥ / ṛṣiputreṇa narmārthaṃ kṛśena dvijasattama

vulgate_text: sa ta kṛśamakṣiprekṣya sūnṛtāṃ vācamutsṛjan / apṛcchattaṃ kathaṃ tātaḥ sarvabhūtahite rataḥ
ce_text: sa taṃ kṛśam abhipreṣkya sūnṛtāṃ vācam utsṛjan / apṛcchata kathaṃ tātaḥ sa me 'dya mṛtadhārakaḥ

vulgate_text: teneha kṣudhitenaitya śrāntena mṛgalipsunā / ajānatā kṛtaṃ manye vratametadidaṃ mama
ce_text: teneha kṣudhitenādya śrāntena ca tapasvinā / ajānatā vratam idaṃ kṛtam etad asaṃśayam

vulgate_text: dhanārthī yāmyahaṃ tatra tanme dehi bhujaṃgama / tato'haṃ vinivartiṣye svāpateyaṃ pragṛhya vai
ce_text: dhanārthī yāmy ahaṃ tatra tan me ditsa bhujaṃgama / tato 'haṃ vinivartiṣye gṛhāyoragasattama

vulgate_text: tato bhakṣayatastasya phalātkṛmirabhūdaṇuḥ / hrasvakaḥ kṛṣṇanayanastāmravarṇo'tha śaunaka
ce_text: tato rājā sasacivaḥ phalāny ādātum aicchata / yad gṛhītaṃ phalaṃ rājñā tatra kṛmir abhūd aṇuḥ / hrasvakaḥ kṛṣṇanayanas tāmro varṇena śaunaka

vulgate_text: tasmātphalādviniṣkramya yattadrājñe niveditam veṣṭayitvā ca bhogena vinadya ca mahāsvanam / adaśatpṛthivīpālaṃ takṣakaḥ pannageśvaraḥ
ce_text: hasann eva ca bhogena takṣakeṇābhiveṣṭitaḥ / tasmāt phalād viniṣkramya yat tad rājñe niveditam

vulgate_text: santānaṃ hi paro dharmaṃ evamāha pitāmahaḥ / lambatāmiha nastāta na jñānaṃ pratibhāti vai
ce_text: lambatām iha nas tāta na jñānaṃ pratibhāti vai / yena tvāṃ nābhijānīmo loke vikhyātapauruṣam

vulgate_text: astitveko'dya nastantuḥ so'pi nāsti yathā tathā / mandabhāgyo'lpabhāgyānāṃ tapa ekaṃ samāsthitaḥ
ce_text: pranaṣṭaṃ nas tapaḥ puṇyaṃ na hi nas tantur asti vai / asti tv eko 'dya nas tantuḥ so 'pi nāsti yathā tathā

vulgate_text: adhaḥ praviṣṭānpaśyāsmānyathā duṣkṛtinastathā / asmāsu patiteṣvatra saha sarvaiḥ sabāndhavaiḥ
ce_text: na hi nas tat tapas tasya tārayiṣyati sattama / chinnamūlān paribhraṣṭān kālopahatacetasaḥ / narakapratiṣṭhān paśyāsmān yathā duṣkṛtinas tathā

vulgate_text: vā brahmaṃstvayā vācyaḥ so'smākaṃ nāthavattayā / bāndhavānāṃ hitasyeha yathā cātmakulaṃ tathā
ce_text: yathā dārān prakuryāt sa putrāṃś cotpādayed yathā / tathā brahmaṃs tvayā vācyaḥ so 'smākaṃ nāthavattayā

vulgate_text: na dārānvai kariṣye'hamiti me bhāvitaṃ manaḥ / evaṃ dṛṣṭvā tu bhavataḥ śakuntāniva lambataḥ
ce_text: evaṃ dṛṣṭvā tu bhavataḥ śakuntān iva lambataḥ / mayā nivartitā buddhir brahmacaryāt pitāmahāḥ

vulgate_text: lokasya caiva sarvasya priya āsīnmahāyaśāḥ / parikṣīṇeṣu kuruṣu sottarāyāmajījanat
ce_text: govindasya priyaś cāsīt pitā te janamejaya / lokasya caiva sarvasya priya āsīn mahāyaśāḥ

vulgate_text: prajā imāstava pitā ṣaṣṭivarṣāṇyapālayat / tato diṣṭāntamāpannaḥ sarveṣāṃ duḥkhamāvahan
ce_text: ṣaḍvargavin mahābuddhir nītidharmavid uttamaḥ / prajā imās tava pitā ṣaṣṭiṃ varṣāṇy apālayat / tato diṣṭāntam āpannaḥ sarpeṇānativartitam

vulgate_text: sa rājā pṛthivīpālaḥ sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ / babhūva mṛgayāśīlastava rājanpitā sadā
ce_text: babhūva mṛgayāśīlas tava rājan pitā sadā / yathā pāṇḍur mahābhāgo dhanurdharavaro yudhi / asmāsv āsajya sarvāṇi rājakāryāṇy aśeṣataḥ

vulgate_text: sakhyuḥ sakāśātpitaraṃ pitrā te dharṣitaṃ purā / mṛtaṃ sarpaṃ samāsaktaṃ sthāṇubhūtasya tasya tam
ce_text: brahmāṇaṃ so 'bhyupāgamya muniḥ pūjāṃ cakāra ha / anujñāto gatas tatra śṛṅgī śuśrāva taṃ tadā / sakhyuḥ sakāśāt pitaraṃ pitrā te dharṣitaṃ tathā

vulgate_text: āśīviṣastigmatejā madvākyabalacoditaḥ / saptarātrāditaḥ pāpaṃ paśya me tapaso balam
ce_text: anāgasi gurau yo me mṛtaṃ sarpam avāsṛjat / taṃ nāgas takṣakaḥ kruddhas tejasā sādayiṣyati / saptarātrād itaḥ pāpaṃ paśya me tapaso balam

vulgate_text: sa cāpi muniśārdūlaḥ prerayāmāsa te pituḥ / śiṣyaṃ gauramukhaṃ nāma śīlavantaṃ guṇānvitam
ce_text: sa cāpi muniśārdūlaḥ preṣayām āsa te pituḥ / śapto 'si mama putreṇa yatto bhava mahīpate / takṣakas tvāṃ mahārāja tejasā sādayiṣyati

vulgate_text: ācakhyauṃ sattva viśrānto rājñaḥ sarvamaśeṣataḥ / śapto'si mama putreṇa yatto bhava mahīpate
ce_text: sa cāpi muniśārdūlaḥ preṣayām āsa te pituḥ / śapto 'si mama putreṇa yatto bhava mahīpate / takṣakas tvāṃ mahārāja tejasā sādayiṣyati

vulgate_text: kimarthaṃ taṃ mayā daṣṭaṃ saṃjīvayitumicchasi / ahaṃ ta takṣako brahmanpaśya me vīryamadbhutam
ce_text: kimarthaṃ taṃ mayā daṣṭaṃ saṃjīvayitum icchasi / brūhi kāmam ahaṃ te 'dya dadmi svaṃ veśma gamyatām

vulgate_text: bhaviṣyati hyupāyena yasya dāsyāmi yātanām / ekaṃ tu śrotumicchāmi tadvṛttaṃ nirjane vane
ce_text: etat tu śrotum icchāmi aṭavyāṃ nirjane vane / saṃvādaṃ pannagendrasya kāśyapasya ca yat tadā

vulgate_text: saṃvādaṃ pannagendrasya kāśyapasya ca kastadā śrutavāndṛṣṭavāṃścāpi bhavatsu kathamāgatam / śrutvā tasya vidhāsye'haṃ pannagāntakarīṃ matim
ce_text: kena dṛṣṭaṃ śrutaṃ cāpi bhavatāṃ śrotram āgatam / śrutvā cātha vidhāsyāmi pannagāntakarīṃ matim

vulgate_text: na budhyetāmubhau tau ca nagasthaṃ pannagadvijau / saha tenaiva vṛkṣeṇa bhasmībhūto'bhavannṛpa
ce_text: sa tu tenaiva vṛkṣeṇa bhasmībhūto 'bhavat tadā / dvijaprabhāvād rājendra jīvitaḥ savanaspatiḥ

vulgate_text: dvijaprabhāvādrājendra vyajīvatsa vanaspatiḥ / tenāgamya dvijaśreṣṭha puṃsā'smāsu niveditam
ce_text: sa tu tenaiva vṛkṣeṇa bhasmībhūto 'bhavat tadā / dvijaprabhāvād rājendra jīvitaḥ savanaspatiḥ

vulgate_text: yathā vṛttaṃ tu tatsarvaṃ takṣakasya dvijasya ca etatte kathitaṃ rājanyathādṛṣṭaṃ śrutaṃ ca yat / śrutvā ca nṛpaśārdūla vidhatsva yadanantaram
ce_text: etat te kathitaṃ rājan yathāvṛttaṃ yathāśrutam / śrutvā tu nṛpaśārdūla prakuruṣva yathepsitam

vulgate_text: uvāca ca mahīpālo duḥkhaśokasamanvitaḥ / durdharaṃ bāṣpamutsṛjya spṛṣṭvā cāpo yathāvidhi
ce_text: niḥśvāsam uṣṇam asakṛd dīrghaṃ rājīvalocanaḥ / mumocāśrūṇi ca tadā netrābhyāṃ pratataṃ nṛpaḥ / uvāca ca mahīpālo duḥkhaśokasamanvitaḥ

vulgate_text: pratikartavyamityevaṃ yena me hiṃsitaḥ pitā / śṛṅgiṇaṃ hetumātraṃ yaḥ kṛtvā dagdhvā ca pārthivam
ce_text: anantaram ahaṃ manye takṣakāya durātmane / pratikartavyam ity eva yena me hiṃsitaḥ pitā

vulgate_text: yathāvadvedavidvāṃsaḥ sarve buddheḥ paraṃgatāḥ / ṛddhyā paramayā yuktamiṣṭaṃ dvijagaṇairyutam
ce_text: ṛddhyā paramayā yuktam iṣṭaṃ dvijagaṇāyutam / prabhūtadhanadhānyāḍhyam ṛtvigbhiḥ suniveśitam

vulgate_text: bālo'pi vipro mānya eveha rājñā yaścāvidvānyaśca vidvānyathāvat / prasādayainaṃ tvarito narendra dvijātivaryaṃ sakalārthasiddhaye sarvānkāmāṃstvatta evārhate'dya yathā ca nastakṣaka eti śīghram
ce_text: bālo 'pi vipro mānya eveha rājñāṃ yaś cāvidvān yaś ca vidvān yathāvat / sarvān kāmāṃs tvatta eṣo 'rhate 'dya yathā ca nas takṣaka eti śīghram

vulgate_text: etacchrutvā dīkṣitastapyamāna āste hotāraṃ codayankarma kāle / indreṇa sārdhaṃ takṣakaṃ pātayadhvaṃ vibhāvasau na vimucyeta nāgaḥ hotā ca yatto'syājuhāvātha mantrairatho mahendraḥ svayamājagāma
ce_text: etac chrutvā dīkṣitas tapyamāna āste hotāraṃ codayan karmakāle / hotā ca yattaḥ sa juhāva mantrair atho indraḥ svayam evājagāma

vulgate_text: ete vāsukijā nāgāḥ praviṣṭā havyavāhane anye ca bahavo vipra tathā vai kulasaṃbhavāḥ / pradīptāgnau hutāḥsarve ghorarūpā mahābalāḥ
ce_text: hiraṇyavāhaḥ śaraṇaḥ kakṣakaḥ kāladantakaḥ / ete vāsukijā nāgāḥ praviṣṭā havyavāhanam

vulgate_text: ucchikhaḥ śarabho bhaṅgo bilvatejā virohaṇaḥ / śilī śalakaro mūkaḥ sukumāraḥ pravepanaḥ
ce_text: ucchikhaḥ suraso draṅgo balaheḍo virohaṇaḥ / śilīśalakaro mūkaḥ sukumāraḥ pravepanaḥ

vulgate_text: pūrṇāṅgadaḥ pūrṇamukhaḥ prahāsaḥ śakunirdariḥ / amāhaṭhaḥ kāmaṭhakaḥ suṣeṇo mānaso'vyayaḥ
ce_text: śaṅkukarṇaḥ piṅgalakaḥ kuṭhāramukhamecakau / pūrṇāṅgadaḥ pūrṇamukhaḥ prahasaḥ śakunir hariḥ

vulgate_text: aṣṭāvakraḥ komalakaḥ śvasano maunavepagaḥ bhairavo muṇḍavedāṅgaḥ piśaṅgaścodapārakaḥ / ṛṣabho vegavānnāgaḥ piṇḍārakamahāhanū
ce_text: āmāhaṭhaḥ komaṭhakaḥ śvasano mānavo vaṭaḥ / bhairavo muṇḍavedāṅgaḥ piśaṅgaś codrapāragaḥ

vulgate_text: na śakyaṃ parisaṃkhyātuṃ ye dīptaṃ pāvakaṃ gatāḥ dviśīrṣāḥ pañcaśīrṣāśca saptaśīrṣāstathā'pare / daśaśīrṣāḥ śataśīrṣāstathānye bahuśīrṣakāḥ
ce_text: eteṣāṃ putrapautrās tu prasavasya ca saṃtatiḥ / na śakyāḥ parisaṃkhyātuṃ ye dīptaṃ pāvakaṃ gatāḥ

vulgate_text: vitasthe so'ntarikṣe ca hṛdayena vidūyatā / yathā tiṣṭhati vai kaścitkhaṃ ca gāṃ cāntarā naraḥ
ce_text: vitasthe so 'ntarikṣe 'tha hṛdayena vidūyatā / yathā tiṣṭheta vai kaś cid gocakrasyāntarā naraḥ

vulgate_text: nimittaṃ brāhmaṇa iti tasmai vittaṃ dadau bahu / dattvā dravyaṃ yathānyāyaṃ bhojanācchādanānvitam
ce_text: nimittaṃ brāhmaṇa iti tasmai vittaṃ dadau bahu / tataś cakārāvabhṛthaṃ vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā

vulgate_text: prītastasmai narapatiraprameyaparākramaḥ / tataścakārāvabhṛthaṃ vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā
ce_text: nimittaṃ brāhmaṇa iti tasmai vittaṃ dadau bahu / tataś cakārāvabhṛthaṃ vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā

vulgate_text: yadvākyaṃ śrutavāṃścāhaṃ tathā ca kathitaṃ mayā / āstīkasya kavervipra śrīmaccaritamāditaḥ
ce_text: śrutvā dharmiṣṭham ākhyānam āstīkaṃ puṇyavardhanam / āstīkasya kaver vipra śrīmaccaritam āditaḥ

vulgate_text: manaḥsāgarasaṃbhūtāṃ maharṣerbhāvitātmanaḥ / kathayasva satāṃ śreṣṭha sarvaratnamayīmimām
ce_text: manaḥsāgarasaṃbhūtāṃ maharṣeḥ puṇyakarmaṇaḥ / kathayasva satāṃ śreṣṭha na hi tṛpyāmi sūtaja

vulgate_text: śṛṇu sarvamaśeṣeṇa kathyamānaṃ mayā dvija / śaṃsituṃ tanmahānharṣo mamāpīha pravartate
ce_text: taj juṣasvottamamate kathyamānaṃ mayā dvija / śaṃsituṃ tan manoharṣo mamāpīha pravartate

vulgate_text: arjunaṃ puruṣavyāghraṃ sthirātmānaṃ guṇairyutam / sa vai saṃvatsaraṃ pūrṇaṃ māsaṃ caikaṃ vane vasan
ce_text: sa vai saṃvatsaraṃ pūrṇaṃ māsaṃ caikaṃ vane 'vasat / tato 'gacchad dhṛṣīkeśaṃ dvāravatyāṃ kadā cana

vulgate_text: rājyaṃ vihatabhūyiṣṭhaṃ pratyapadyanta pāṇḍavāḥ / iṣṭvā kratūṃśca vividhānaśvamedhādikānbahūn
ce_text: tatas te sarvam utsādya hatvā duryodhanaṃ nṛpam / rājyaṃ vidrutabhūyiṣṭhaṃ pratyapadyanta pāṇḍavāḥ

vulgate_text: kathaṃ vyasaninaṃ dyūte pārthau mādrīsutau tadā / anvayuste naravyāghrā bādhyamānā durātmabhiḥ
ce_text: kathaṃ vyatikraman dyūte pārthau mādrīsutau tathā / anuvrajan naravyāghraṃ vañcyamānaṃ durātmabhiḥ

vulgate_text: mucyate sarvapāpebhyo rāhuṇā candramā yathā / jayo nāmetihāso'yaṃ śrotavyo vijigīṣuṇā
ce_text: jayo nāmetihāso 'yaṃ śrotavyo vijigīṣuṇā / mahīṃ vijayate sarvāṃ śatrūṃś cāpi parājayet

vulgate_text: mahiṣīyuvarājābhyāṃ śrotavyaṃ bahuśastathā / vīraṃ janayate putraṃ kanyāṃ vā rājyabhāginīm
ce_text: idaṃ puṃsavanaṃ śreṣṭham idaṃ svastyayanaṃ mahat / mahiṣīyuvarājābhyāṃ śrotavyaṃ bahuśas tathā

vulgate_text: dharme cārthe ca kāme ca mokṣe ca bharatarṣabha yadihāsti tadanyatra yannehāsti na kutracit / idaṃ hi brāhmaṇairloke ākhyātaṃ brāhmaṇeṣviha
ce_text: dharme cārthe ca kāme ca mokṣe ca bharatarṣabha / yad ihāsti tad anyatra yan nehāsti na tat kva cit

vulgate_text: śrāvayedbrāhmaṇāñśrāddhe yaścemaṃ pādamantataḥ / akṣayyaṃ tasya tacchrāddhamupāvartetpitṝniha
ce_text: yaś cedaṃ śrāvayec chrāddhe brāhmaṇān pādam antataḥ / akṣayyaṃ tasya tac chrāddham upatiṣṭhet pitṝn api

vulgate_text: yathā samudro bhagavānyathā merurmahāgiriḥ / ubhau khyātau ratnanidhī tathā bhāratamucyate
ce_text: yathā samudro bhagavān yathā ca himavān giriḥ / khyātāv ubhau ratnanidhī tathā bhāratam ucyate

vulgate_text: idaṃ hi vedaiḥ samitaṃ pavitramaṣi cottamam / śrāvyaṃ śrutisukhaṃ caiva pāvanaṃ śīlavardhanam
ce_text: idaṃ hi vedaiḥ samitaṃ pavitram api cottamam / śrāvyāṇām uttamaṃ cedaṃ purāṇam ṛṣisaṃstutam

vulgate_text: adityāṃ kaśyapādvivasthān / vivasvato manurmanorilā
ce_text: dakṣasyāditiḥ / aditer vivasvān / vivasvato manuḥ / manor ilā / ilāyāḥ purūravāḥ / purūravasa āyuḥ / āyuṣo nahuṣaḥ / nahuṣasya yayātiḥ

vulgate_text: janamejayastu sunandāṃ nāmopayeme māgadhīṃ / tasyāmasya jajñe prācīnvān
ce_text: janamejayaḥ khalv anantāṃ nāmopayeme mādhavīm / tasyām asya jajñe prācinvān / yaḥ prācīṃ diśaṃ jigāya yāvat sūryodayāt / tatas tasya prācinvatvam

vulgate_text: arihaḥ khalvāṅgīmupeyeme / tasyāmasya jajñe mahābhaumaḥ
ce_text: arācīno 'pi vaidarbhīm evāparām upayeme maryādāṃ nāma / tasyām asya jajñe mahābhaumaḥ

vulgate_text: ṛcastu khalu vāmadevyāmaṅgarājakanyāyāmṛkṣaṃ putramajījanat
ce_text: ṛcaḥ khalv āṅgeyīm upayeme sudevāṃ nāma / tasyāṃ putram ajanayad ṛkṣam

vulgate_text: tatremau ślokau bhavataḥ mātā bhastrā pituḥ putro yasmājjātaḥ sa eva saḥ / bharasva putraṃ dauṣyantiṃ satyamāha śakuntalā
ce_text: mātā bhastrā pituḥ putro yena jātaḥ sa eva saḥ / bharasva putraṃ duḥṣanta māvamaṃsthāḥ śakuntalām

vulgate_text: suhotrastu khalvaikṣvākīmupayeme jayantīṃ nāma tasyāmasya jajñe hastī / ya idaṃ puraṃ nirmāpayāmāsa
ce_text: suhotraḥ khalv ikṣvākukanyām upayeme suvarṇāṃ nāma / tasyām asya jajñe hastī / ya idaṃ hāstinapuraṃ māpayām āsa / etad asya hāstinapuratvam

vulgate_text: pṛthagvaṃśakartāro nṛpatayaḥ / tatra ajamīḍhādṛkṣāyāṃ saṃvaraṇo jajñe sa vaṃśakaraḥ
ce_text: ajamīḍhasya caturviṃśaṃ putraśataṃ babhūva kaikeyyāṃ nāgāyāṃ gāndhāryāṃ vimalāyām ṛkṣāyāṃ ceti / pṛthak pṛthag vaṃśakarā nṛpatayaḥ / tatra vaṃśakaraḥ saṃvaraṇaḥ

vulgate_text: citrāṅgadastu prāptarājya eva gandharveṇa nihṛtaḥ / tato vicitravīryo rājā babhūva
ce_text: tayor aprāptayauvana eva citrāṅgado gandharveṇa hataḥ / vicitravīryas tu rājā samabhavat

vulgate_text: vicitravīryastu khalukāśirājasya sute ambikāmbālike udavahat / vicitravīryo'nutpannāpatya eva videhatvaṃ prāptaḥ
ce_text: vicitravīryas tv anapatya eva videhatvaṃ prāptaḥ

vulgate_text: sātha dvaipāyanaṃ cintayāmāsa so'grataḥ sthitaḥ kiṃ karavāṇīti / taṃ satyavatyuvāca bhrātā te'napatya eva svargataḥ tasyārthe'patyamutpādayeti
ce_text: sā tam uvāca / bhrātā tavānapatya eva svaryāto vicitravīryaḥ / sādhv apatyaṃ tasyotpādayeti

vulgate_text: dhṛtarāṣṭrātputraśataṃ babhūva gāndhāryāṃ varadānāddvaipāyanasya teṣāṃ ca dhārtarāṣṭrāṇāṃ catvāraḥ pradhānāḥ duryodhano duśśāsano vikarṇaścitrasenaśceti
ce_text: teṣāṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrasya putrāṇāṃ catvāraḥ pradhānā babhūvur duryodhano duḥśāsano vikarṇaś citrasena iti

vulgate_text: sa bāṇaviddha uvāca pāṇḍum / atra śloko bhavati
ce_text: sa bāṇaviddha uvāca pāṇḍum / caratā dharmam imaṃ yena tvayābhijñena kāmarasasyāham anavāptakāmaraso 'bhihatas tasmāt tvam apy etām avasthām āsādyānavāptakāmarasaḥ pañcatvam āpsyasi kṣipram eveti

vulgate_text: iti mṛgavratacāriṇā ṛṣiṇā śaptaḥ / sa viṣaṇṇarūpaḥ pāṇḍustaṃ śāpaṃ pariharannopasarpati bhārye
ce_text: sa vivarṇarūpaḥ pāṇḍuḥ śāpaṃ pariharamāṇo nopāsarpata bhārye

vulgate_text: kadācitsa āha svacāpalyādidaṃ prāptavānaham / purāṇeṣu paṭhyamānaṃ śṛṇomi nānapatyasya lokāḥ santīti
ce_text: vākyaṃ covāca / svacāpalyād idaṃ prāptavān aham / śṛṇomi ca nānapatyasya lokā santīti

vulgate_text: sā kuntī putrānutpādayāmāsa dharmādyudhiṣṭhiraṃ mārutādbhīmasenamindrādarjunamiti sa hṛṣṭarūpaḥ pāṇḍuruvāca / iyaṃ te sapatnī bhavati mādryanapatyā vrīḍitā sādhvī asyāmapatyamutpādyatāmiti
ce_text: sa tāṃ hṛṣṭarūpaḥ pāṇḍur uvāca / iyaṃ te sapatnyanapatyā / sādhv asyām apatyam utpādyatām iti

vulgate_text: sā kuntī tasyai mādryai tatheti vratamādideśa / tatastasyāṃ nakulasahadevau yamāvaśvibhyāṃ jajñāte
ce_text: tato mādryām aśvibhyāṃ nakulasahadevāv utpāditau

vulgate_text: tatastena saha citāmanvāruroha mādrī / kuntīṃ covāca yamayorāryayā'pramattayā bhavitavyamiti
ce_text: uvāca kuntīm / yamayor āryayāpramattayā bhavitavyam iti

vulgate_text: tatra bhīṣmāya dhṛtarāṣṭravidurayoḥ pāṇḍoḥ svargagamanaṃ yāthātathyaṃ nivedayantisma tapasvinaḥ
ce_text: tatas te pañca pāṇḍavāḥ kuntyā sahitā hāstinapuram ānīya tāpasair bhīṣmasya vidurasya ca niveditāḥ

vulgate_text: śaivyasya kanyāṃ devakīṃ nāmopayeme yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / tasyāṃ putraṃ janayāmāsa yaudheyaṃ nāma
ce_text: yudhiṣṭhiras tu govāsanasya śaibyasya devikāṃ nāma kanyāṃ svayaṃvare lebhe / tasyāṃ putraṃ janayām āsa yaudheyaṃ nāma

vulgate_text: bhīmasenastu vārāṇasyāṃ kāśirājakanyāṃ jalandharāṃ nāmopayeme svayaṃvarasthāṃ / tasyāmasya jajñe śarvatrātaḥ
ce_text: ahaṃpātis tu khalu kṛtavīryaduhitaram upayeme bhānumatīṃ nāma / tasyām asya jajñe sārvabhaumaḥ

vulgate_text: nakulastu khalu caidyāṃ reṇumatīṃ nāmodavahat / tasyāṃ putraṃ janayāmāsa niramitraṃ nāma
ce_text: nakulas tu caidyāṃ kareṇuvatīṃ nāma bhāryām udavahat / tasyāṃ putraṃ niramitraṃ nāmājanayat

vulgate_text: sahadevastu khalu mādrīmeva svayaṃvare vijayāṃ nāmodavahadbhāryām / tasyāṃ putraṃ janayāmāsa suhotraṃ nāma
ce_text: yudhiṣṭhiras tu govāsanasya śaibyasya devikāṃ nāma kanyāṃ svayaṃvare lebhe / tasyāṃ putraṃ janayām āsa yaudheyaṃ nāma

vulgate_text: bhīmasenaśca pūrvameva hiḍimbāyāṃ rākṣasyāṃ putramutpādayāmāsa ghaṭotkacaṃ nāma / arjunastu nāgakanyāyāmulūpyāmirāvantaṃ nāma putraṃ janayāmāsa
ce_text: bhīmasenas tu pūrvam eva hiḍimbāyāṃ rākṣasyāṃ ghaṭotkacaṃ nāma putraṃ janayām āsa

vulgate_text: janamejayāttu bhavataḥ khalu vapuṣṭamāyāṃ putrau dvau śatānīkaḥ śaṅkukarṇaśca
ce_text: janamejayāt tu vapuṣṭamāyāṃ dvau putrau śatānīkaḥ śaṅkuś ca

vulgate_text: rājoparicaro nāma dharmanityo mahīpatiḥ / babhūva mṛgayāśīlaḥ śaśvatsvādhyāyavāñchuciḥ
ce_text: rājoparicaro nāma dharmanityo mahīpatiḥ / babhūva mṛgayāṃ gantuṃ sa kadā cid dhṛtavrataḥ

vulgate_text: tamāśrame nyastaśastraṃ nivasantaṃ taponidhim / devāḥ śakrapurogā vai rājānamupatasthire
ce_text: tam āśrame nyastaśastraṃ nivasantaṃ taporatim / devaḥ sākṣāt svayaṃ vajrī samupāyān mahīpatim

vulgate_text: evaṃ saṃsāntvya nṛpatiṃ tapasaḥ saṃnyavartayat / prayayau daivataiḥ sārdhaṃ kṛtvā kāryaṃ divaukasām
ce_text: indratvam arho rājāyaṃ tapasety anucintya vai / taṃ sāntvena nṛpaṃ sākṣāt tapasaḥ saṃnyavartayat

vulgate_text: mārgaśīrṣe mahārāja pūrvapakṣe mahāmakham tataḥprabhṛti cādyāpi yaṣṭeḥ kṣitipasattamaiḥ
ce_text: tataḥ prabhṛti cādyāpi yaṣṭyāḥ kṣitipasattamaiḥ / praveśaḥ kriyate rājan yathā tena pravartitaḥ

vulgate_text: alaṅkṛtāyā piṭakairgandhamālyaiśca bhūṣaṇaiḥ / mālyadāmaparikṣiptāṃ dvātriṃśatkiṣkusaṃmitām
ce_text: aparedyus tathā cāsyāḥ kriyate ucchrayo nṛpaiḥ / alaṃkṛtāyāḥ piṭakair gandhair mālyaiś ca bhūṣaṇaiḥ / mālyadāmaparikṣiptā vidhivat kriyate 'pi ca

vulgate_text: śaṅkhabherīmṛdaṅgaiśca saṃnādaḥ kriyate tadā / bhagavānpūjyate cātra yaṣṭirūpeṇa vāsavaḥ
ce_text: bhagavān pūjyate cātra hāsyarūpeṇa śaṃkaraḥ / svayam eva gṛhītena vasoḥ prītyā mahātmanaḥ

vulgate_text: svayameva gṛhītena vasoḥ prītyā mahātmanaḥ / māṇibhadrādayo yakṣāḥ pūjyante daivataiḥ saha
ce_text: bhagavān pūjyate cātra hāsyarūpeṇa śaṃkaraḥ / svayam eva gṛhītena vasoḥ prītyā mahātmanaḥ

vulgate_text: etāṃ pūjāṃ mahendrastu dṛṣṭvā vasukṛtāṃ śubhām / haribhirvājibhiryuktamantarikṣagataṃ ratham
ce_text: etāṃ pūjāṃ mahendras tu dṛṣṭvā deva kṛtāṃ śubhām / vasunā rājamukhyena prītimān abravīd vibhuḥ

vulgate_text: vāyunā preryamāṇastu dhūmrāya mudamanvagāt bhāryāṃ cintayamānasya manmathāgniravardhata / tasya retaḥ pracaskanda carato gahane vane
ce_text: tasya retaḥ pracaskanda carato rucire vane / skannamātraṃ ca tad reto vṛkṣapatreṇa bhūmipaḥ

vulgate_text: idaṃ mithyā pariskannaṃ reto me na bhavediti / ṛtuśca tasyāḥ patnyā me na moghaḥ syāditi prabhuḥ

vulgate_text: dṛṣṭvaiva sa ca tāṃ dhīmāṃścakame cāruhāsinīm / divyāṃ tāṃ vāsavīṃ kanyāṃ rambhorūṃ munipuṅgavaḥ
ce_text: atīva rūpasaṃpannāṃ siddhānām api kāṅkṣitām / dṛṣṭvaiva ca sa tāṃ dhīmāṃś cakame cārudarśanām / vidvāṃs tāṃ vāsavīṃ kanyāṃ kāryavān munipuṃgavaḥ

vulgate_text: adriketyabhivikhyātā brahmaśāpādvarāpsarā / mīnabhāvamanuprāptā tvaṃ janitvā gatā divam
ce_text: tatrādriketi vikhyātā brahmaśāpād varāpsarāḥ / mīnabhāvam anuprāptā babhūva yamunācarī

vulgate_text: vismayāviṣṭasarvāṅgī jātismaraṇatāṃ gatā / sābravītpaśya bhagavanparapāre sthitānṛṣīn
ce_text: sābravīt paśya bhagavan pārāvāre ṛṣīn sthitān / āvayor dṛśyator ebhiḥ kathaṃ nu syāt samāgamaḥ

ce_text: viddhi māṃ bhagavan kanyāṃ sadā pitṛvaśānugām / tvatsaṃyogāc ca duṣyeta kanyābhāvo mamānagha

vulgate_text: na hyamī bhūtasatvaughāḥ pannagāḥ sanagāṃ mahīm / tadā dhārayituṃ śekurākrāntāṃ dānavairbalāt
ce_text: na hīmāṃ pavano rājan na nāgā na nagā mahīm / tadā dhārayituṃ śekur ākrāntāṃ dānavair balāt

vulgate_text: rudrasyānucaraḥ śrīmānmahākāleti yaṃ viduḥ / catvāriṃśaddanoḥ putrāḥ khyātāḥ sarvatra bhārata
ce_text: catvāriṃśad danoḥ putrāḥ khyātāḥ sarvatra bhārata / teṣāṃ prathamajo rājā vipracittir mahāyaśāḥ

vulgate_text: nicandraśca nikumbhaśca kupaṭaḥ kapaṭastathā śarabhaḥ śalabhaścaiva sūryācandramasau tathā / ete khyātā danorvaṃśe dānavāḥ parikīrtitāḥ
ce_text: śarabhaḥ śalabhaś caiva sūryācandramasau tathā / iti khyātā danor vaṃśe dānavāḥ parikīrtitāḥ / anyau tu khalu devānāṃ sūryācandramasau smṛtau

vulgate_text: atha prabhūtānyanyāni kīrtayiṣyāmi bhārata / anavadyāṃ manuṃ vaṃśāmasurāṃ mārgaṇapriyām
ce_text: atas tu bhūtāny anyāni kīrtayiṣyāmi bhārata / anavadyām anuvaśām anūnām aruṇāṃ priyām / anūpāṃ subhagāṃ bhāsīm iti prāvā vyajāyata

vulgate_text: aruṇā rakṣitā caiva rambā tadvanmanoramā / keśinī ca subāhuśca suratā surajā tathā
ce_text: alambusā miśrakeṣī vidyutparṇā tulānaghā / aruṇā rakṣitā caiva rambhā tadvan manoramā

vulgate_text: rākṣasāśca pulastyasya vānarāḥ kinnarāstathā / yakṣāśca manujavyāghra putrāstasya ca dhīmataḥ
ce_text: rākṣasās tu pulastyasya vānarāḥ kiṃnarās tathā / pulahasya mṛgāḥ siṃhā vyāghrāḥ kiṃpuruṣās tathā

vulgate_text: pulahasya sutā rājañśarabhāśca prakīrtitāḥ / siṃhāḥ kipuruṣā vyāghrā ṛkṣā īhāmṛgāstathā
ce_text: rākṣasās tu pulastyasya vānarāḥ kiṃnarās tathā / pulahasya mṛgāḥ siṃhā vyāghrāḥ kiṃpuruṣās tathā

ce_text: bṛhaspates tu bhaginī varastrī brahmacāriṇī / yogasiddhā jagat sarvam asaktaṃ vicaraty uta / prabhāsasya tu bhāryā sā vasūnām aṣṭamasya ha

vulgate_text: bhayo mahābhayaścaiva mṛtyurbhūtāntakastathā / na tasya bhāryā putro vā kaścidastyantako hi saḥ
ce_text: tasyāpi nirṛtir bhāryā nairṛtā yena rākṣasāḥ / ghorās tasyās trayaḥ putrāḥ pāpakarmaratāḥ sadā / bhayo mahābhayaś caiva mṛtyur bhūtāntakas tathā

vulgate_text: dhṛtarāṣṭrī tu haṃsāṃśca kalahaṃsāṃśca sarvaśaḥ / cakravākāṃśca bhadrā tu janayāmāsa saiva tu
ce_text: dhṛtarāṣṭrī tu haṃsāṃś ca kalahaṃsāṃś ca sarvaśaḥ / cakravākāṃś ca bhadraṃ te prajajñe sā tu bhāminī

vulgate_text: mātaṅgī tvatha śārdūlī śvetā surabhireva ca / sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannā surasā caiva bhāminī
ce_text: mātaṅgīm atha śārdūlīṃ śvetāṃ surabhim eva ca / sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannāṃ surasāṃ ca yaśasvinīm

vulgate_text: vimalāmapi bhadraṃ te analāmapi bhārata / rohiṇyāṃ jajñire gāvo gandharvyāṃ vājinaḥ sutāḥ
ce_text: tathā duhitarau rājan surabhir vai vyajāyata / rohiṇīṃ caiva bhadraṃ te gandharvīṃ ca yaśasvinīm / rohiṇyāṃ jajñire gāvo gandharvyāṃ vājinaḥ sutāḥ

vulgate_text: saṃpātiṃ janayāmāsa vīryavantaṃ jaṭāyuṣam / surasā'janayannāgānkadrūḥ putrāṃstu pannagān
ce_text: aruṇasya bhāryā śyenī tu vīryavantau mahābalau / saṃpātiṃ janayām āsa tathaiva ca jaṭāyuṣam / dvau putrau vinatāyās tu vikhyātau garuḍāruṇau

vulgate_text: devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca gandharvoragarakṣasām / siṃhavyāghramṛgāṇāṃ ca pannagānāṃ patattriṇām
ce_text: rākṣasās tu pulastyasya vānarāḥ kiṃnarās tathā / pulahasya mṛgāḥ siṃhā vyāghrāḥ kiṃpuruṣās tathā

vulgate_text: aśoko nāma rājā'bhūnmahāvīryo'parājitaḥ / tasmādavarajo yastu rājannaśvapatiḥ smṛtaḥ
ce_text: tasmād avarajo yas tu rājann aśvapatiḥ smṛtaḥ / daiteyaḥ so 'bhavad rājā hārdikyo manujarṣabhaḥ

vulgate_text: pauravo nāma rājarṣiḥ sa babhūva narottamaḥ / kupaṭastu mahāvīryaḥ śrīmānrājanmahāsuraḥ
ce_text: śarabho nāma yas teṣāṃ daiteyānāṃ mahāsuraḥ / pauravo nāma rājarṣiḥ sa babhūva nareṣv iha

vulgate_text: pārvateya iti khyātaḥ kāñcanācalasannibhaḥ / dvitīyaḥ śalabhasteṣāmasurāṇāṃ babhūva ha
ce_text: dvitīyaḥ śalabhas teṣām asurāṇāṃ babhūva yaḥ / prahrādo nāma bāhlīkaḥ sa babhūva narādhipaḥ

vulgate_text: kāśirājaḥ sa vikhyātaḥ pṛthivyāṃ pṛthivīpate grahaṃ tu suṣuve yaṃ tu siṃhikārkendumardanam / sa krātha iti vikhyāto babhūva manujādhipaḥ
ce_text: grahaṃ tu suṣuve yaṃ taṃ siṃhī candrārkamardanam / krātha ity abhivikhyātaḥ so 'bhavan manujādhipaḥ

vulgate_text: krathanaśca mahāvīryaḥ śrīmānrājā mahāsuraḥ / sūryākṣa iti vikhyātaḥ kṣitau jajñe mahīpatiḥ
ce_text: yas tv aśva iti vikhyātaḥ śrīmān āsīn mahāsuraḥ / aśoko nāma rājāsīn mahāvīryaparākramaḥ

vulgate_text: duryodhanasahāyāste paulastyā bharatarṣabha / vaiśyāputro yuyutsuśca dhārtarāṣṭraḥ śatādhikaḥ
ce_text: durmukho duḥsahaś caiva ye cānye nānuśabditāḥ / duryodhanasahāyās te paulastyā bharatarṣabha

vulgate_text: jayadrathāya pradadau saubalānumate tadā / dharmasyāṃśaṃ tu rājānaṃ viddhi rājanyudhiṣṭhiram
ce_text: dharmasyāṃśaṃ tu rājānaṃ viddhi rājan yudhiṣṭhiram / bhīmasenaṃ tu vātasya devarājasya cārjunam

vulgate_text: so'bhimanyurbṛhatkīrtirarjunasya suto'bhavat / yasyāvataraṇe rājansurānsomo'bravīdidam
ce_text: yaḥ suvarcā iti khyātaḥ somaputraḥ pratāpavān / abhimanyur bṛhatkīrtir arjunasya suto 'bhavat

vulgate_text: āmuktakavaco vīro yastu jajñe mahāyaśāḥ / sa karṇa iti vikhyātaḥ pṛthāyāḥ prathamaḥ sutaḥ
ce_text: āmuktakavacaḥ karṇo yas tu jajñe mahārathaḥ / divākarasya taṃ viddhi devasyāṃśam anuttamam

vulgate_text: duryodhanasya sacivaṃ mitraṃ śatruvināśanam / divākarasya taṃ viddhi rājannaṃśamanuttamam
ce_text: āmuktakavacaḥ karṇo yas tu jajñe mahārathaḥ / divākarasya taṃ viddhi devasyāṃśam anuttamam

vulgate_text: śriyastu bhāgaḥ saṃjajñe ratyarthaṃ pṛthivītale / [bhīṣmakasya kule sādhvī rukmiṇī nāma nāmataḥ
ce_text: śriyas tu bhāgaḥ saṃjajñe ratyarthaṃ pṛthivītale / drupadasya kule kanyā vedimadhyād aninditā

vulgate_text: brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyā mayā te parikīrtitāḥ / dhanyaṃ yaśasyaṃ putrīyamāyuṣyaṃ vijayāvaham
ce_text: dhanyaṃ yaśasyaṃ putrīyam āyuṣyaṃ vijayāvaham / idam aṃśāvataraṇaṃ śrotavyam anasūyatā

vulgate_text: mārtāṇḍasya yamī cāpi sutā rājannajāyata / mārtaṇḍasya manurdhīmānajāyata sutaḥ prabhuḥ
ce_text: mārtaṇḍasya manur dhīmān ajāyata sutaḥ prabhuḥ / manor vaṃśo mānavānāṃ tato 'yaṃ prathito 'bhavat / brahmakṣatrādayas tasmān manor jātās tu mānavāḥ

vulgate_text: dharmātmā sa manurdhīmānyatra vaṃśaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ / manorvaṃśo mānavānāṃ tato'yaṃ prathito'bhavat
ce_text: mārtaṇḍasya manur dhīmān ajāyata sutaḥ prabhuḥ / manor vaṃśo mānavānāṃ tato 'yaṃ prathito 'bhavat / brahmakṣatrādayas tasmān manor jātās tu mānavāḥ

vulgate_text: tejasā tapasā caiva vikrameṇaujasā tathā viśliṣṭo nahuṣaḥ śaptaḥ sadyo hyajagaro'bhavat / yatiṃ yayātiṃ saṃyātimāyātimayatiṃ dhruvam
ce_text: yatiṃ yayātiṃ saṃyātim āyātiṃ pāñcam uddhavam / nahuṣo janayām āsa ṣaṭ putrān priyavāsasi

vulgate_text: nahuṣo janayāmāsa ṣaṭ sutānpriyavādinaḥ / yatistu yogamāsthāya brahmībhūto'bhavanmuniḥ
ce_text: yatiṃ yayātiṃ saṃyātim āyātiṃ pāñcam uddhavam / nahuṣo janayām āsa ṣaṭ putrān priyavāsasi

vulgate_text: tato varṣasahasrāṇi yayātiraparājitaḥ / sthitaḥ sa nṛpaśārdūlaḥ śārdūlasamavikramaḥ
ce_text: tato varṣasahasrānte yayātir aparājitaḥ / atṛpta eva kāmānāṃ pūruṃ putram uvāca ha

ce_text: tataḥ sa nṛpaśārdūlaḥ pūruṃ rājye 'bhiṣicya ca / kālena mahatā paścāt kāladharmam upeyivān

vulgate_text: kālena mahatā paścātkāladharmamupeyivān / kārayitvā tvanaśanaṃ sadāraḥ svargamāptavān
ce_text: tataḥ sa nṛpaśārdūlaḥ pūruṃ rājye 'bhiṣicya ca / kālena mahatā paścāt kāladharmam upeyivān

vulgate_text: bhittvā bhittvā śarīrāṇi vṛkāṇāṃ sa vinirgataḥ / āhūtaḥ prādurabhavatkaco hṛṣṭo'tha vidyayā
ce_text: tataḥ saṃjīvanīṃ vidyāṃ prayujya kacam āhvayat / āhūtaḥ prādurabhavat kaco 'riṣṭo 'tha vidyayā / hato 'ham iti cācakhyau pṛṣṭo brāhmaṇakanyayā

vulgate_text: hato'hamiti cācakhyau pṛṣṭo brāhmaṇakanyayā / sa punardevayānyoktaḥ puṣpāṇyāhara me dvija
ce_text: tataḥ saṃjīvanīṃ vidyāṃ prayujya kacam āhvayat / āhūtaḥ prādurabhavat kaco 'riṣṭo 'tha vidyayā / hato 'ham iti cācakhyau pṛṣṭo brāhmaṇakanyayā

vulgate_text: vanaṃ yayau kaco vipro dadṛśurdānavāśca tam / punastaṃ peṣayitvā tu samudrāmbhasyamiśrayan
ce_text: sa punar devayānyoktaḥ puṣpāhāro yadṛcchayā / vanaṃ yayau tato vipro dadṛśur dānavāś ca tam

vulgate_text: maivaṃ śuco mā ruda devayāni na tvādṛśī martyamanupraśocate / yasyāstava brahma ca brāhmaṇāśca sendrā devā vasavo'thāśvinau ca
ce_text: maivaṃ śuco mā ruda devayāni na tvādṛśī martyam anupraśocet / surāś ca viśve ca jagac ca sarvam upasthitāṃ vaikṛtim ānamanti

ce_text: guror bhīto vidyayā copahūtaḥ śanair vācaṃ jaṭhare vyājahāra / tam abravīt kena pathopanīto mamodare tiṣṭhasi brūhi vipra

ce_text: guror bhīto vidyayā copahūtaḥ śanair vācaṃ jaṭhare vyājahāra / tam abravīt kena pathopanīto mamodare tiṣṭhasi brūhi vipra

vulgate_text: aniyojye niyoktuṃ māṃ devayāni na cārhasi / prasīda subhru tvaṃ mahyaṃ gurorgurutarā śubhe
ce_text: aniyojye niyoge māṃ niyunakṣi śubhavrate / prasīda subhru tvaṃ mahyaṃ guror gurutarī śubhe

ce_text: hateyam iti vijñāya śarmiṣṭhā pāpaniścayā / anavekṣya yayau veśma krodhavegaparāyaṇā

ce_text: uddhṛtya caināṃ tarasā tasmāt kūpān narādhipaḥ / āmantrayitvā suśroṇīṃ yayātiḥ svapuraṃ yayau

vulgate_text: preṣyaḥ śiṣyaḥ svavṛttiṃ hi visṛjya viphalaṃ gataḥ tasmātsaṃkīrṇavṛtteṣu vāso mama na rocate
ce_text: śiṣyasyāśiṣyavṛtter hi na kṣantavyaṃ bubhūṣatā / tasmāt saṃkīrṇavṛtteṣu vāso mama na rocate

vulgate_text: vāgduruktaṃ mahāghoraṃ duhiturvṛṣaparvaṇaḥ / mama mathnāti hṛdayamagnikāma ivāraṇim
ce_text: vāg duruktaṃ mahāghoraṃ duhitur vṛṣaparvaṇaḥ / na hy ato duṣkarataraṃ manye lokeṣv api triṣu / yaḥ sapatnaśriyaṃ dīptāṃ hīnaśrīḥ paryupāsate

vulgate_text: nādharmaścarito rājansadyaḥ phalati gauriva / śanairāvartyamāno hi karturmūlāni kṛntati
ce_text: nādharmaś carito rājan sadyaḥ phalati gaur iva / putreṣu vā naptṛṣu vā na ced ātmani paśyati / phalaty eva dhruvaṃ pāpaṃ gurubhuktam ivodare

vulgate_text: mā śoca vṛṣaparvaṃstvaṃ mā krudhyasva viśāṃpate sthātuṃ te viṣaye rājanna śakṣyāmi tayā vinā / asyā gatirgatirmahyaṃ priyamasyāḥ priyaṃ mama
ce_text: vadhād anarhatas tasya vadhāc ca duhitur mama / vṛṣaparvan nibodhedaṃ tyakṣyāmi tvāṃ sabāndhavam / sthātuṃ tvadviṣaye rājan na śakṣyāmi tvayā saha

vulgate_text: yaṃ sā kāmayate kāṃ karavāṇyahamadya tam yadyevamāhvayecchukro devayānīkṛte hi mām / maddoṣānmāgamacchukro devayānī ca matkṛte
ce_text: sā yaṃ kāmayate kāmaṃ karavāṇy aham adya tam / mā tv evāpagamac chukro devayānī ca matkṛte

vulgate_text: pibantīrlalamānāśca divyābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ āsanapravare divye sarvaratnavibhūṣite / upaviṣṭāṃ ca dadṛśe devayānīṃ śucismitām
ce_text: dadṛśe devayānīṃ ca śarmiṣṭhāṃ tāś ca yoṣitaḥ / pibantīr lalamānāś ca divyābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ

ce_text: tvayādya rājānvayayā mām anādṛtya yatkṛtaḥ / puṃsā saha samāyogo na sa dharmopaghātakaḥ

vulgate_text: puṃsā saha samāyogo na sa dharmopaghātakaḥ / na bhayaṃ vidyate bhadre mā śucaḥ sukṛtaṃ kṛtam
ce_text: tvayādya rājānvayayā mām anādṛtya yatkṛtaḥ / puṃsā saha samāyogo na sa dharmopaghātakaḥ

vulgate_text: sa ca sarvāṃ samudrāntāṃ kṛtsnāṃ bhokṣyati medinīm / paraṃ cābhiprayātasya cakraṃ tasya mahātmanaḥ
ce_text: mahātmā janitā loke putras tava mahābalaḥ / ya imāṃ sāgarāpāṅgāṃ kṛtsnāṃ bhokṣyati medinīm

vulgate_text: ṛtavo bahavaste vai gatā vyarthāḥ śucismite sārthakaṃ sāṃprataṃ hyetanna ca pāpmāsti te'naghe / gṛhāṇa ca varaṃ mattastatkṛte yadabhīpsitam
ce_text: prasanna eva tasyāhaṃ tvatkṛte varavarṇini / gṛhāṇa ca varaṃ mattas tatkṛte yad abhīpsitam

vulgate_text: ityevamuktvā manasā praṇidhāya manasvinī / tato dharmiṣṭhatāṃ vavre rājye cāskhalanaṃ tathā
ce_text: tato dharmiṣṭhatāṃ vavre rājyāc cāskhalanaṃ tathā / śakuntalā pauravāṇāṃ duḥṣantahitakāmyayā

vulgate_text: śakuntalāṃ pauravāṇāṃ duṣyantahitakāmyayā / evamastviti tāṃ prāha kaṇvo dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ
ce_text: tato dharmiṣṭhatāṃ vavre rājyāc cāskhalanaṃ tathā / śakuntalā pauravāṇāṃ duḥṣantahitakāmyayā

vulgate_text: patnīnāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā sādhu sādhvityacintayat garbhaṃ suṣāva vāmorūḥ kumāramamitaujasam
ce_text: pratijñāya tu duḥṣante pratiyāte śakuntalā / garbhaṃ suṣāva vāmoruḥ kumāram amitaujasam

vulgate_text: triṣu varṣeṣu pūrṇeṣu prājāyata śakuntalā / rūpaudāryaguṇopetaṃ dauṣyantiṃ janamejaya
ce_text: triṣu varṣeṣu pūrṇeṣu diptānalasamadyutim / rūpaudāryaguṇopetaṃ dauḥṣantiṃ janamejaya

vulgate_text: balaṃ tejaśca rūpaṃ ca na samaṃ bhuvi kenacit / āhartā vājimedhasya śatasaṅkhyasya pauravaḥ
ce_text: āhartā vājimedhasya śatasaṃkhyasya paurava / iti vāg antarikṣe māṃ sūtake 'bhyavadat purā

vulgate_text: yathāvidhi yathānyāyaṃ kriyāḥ sarvāstvakārayat / dantaiḥ śuklaiḥ śikharibhiḥsiṃhasaṃhanano'bhavat
ce_text: dantaiḥ śuklaiḥ śikharibhiḥ siṃhasaṃhanano yuvā / cakrāṅkitakaraḥ śrīmān mahāmūrdhā mahābalaḥ / kumāro devagarbhābhaḥ sa tatrāśu vyavardhata

vulgate_text: kumāro devagarbhābhaḥ sa tatrāśu vyavardhata / ṛṣerbhayāttu duṣyantaḥ smarannaivāhvayattadā
ce_text: dantaiḥ śuklaiḥ śikharibhiḥ siṃhasaṃhanano yuvā / cakrāṅkitakaraḥ śrīmān mahāmūrdhā mahābalaḥ / kumāro devagarbhābhaḥ sa tatrāśu vyavardhata

vulgate_text: vyāghrānsiṃhānvarāhāṃśca vṛkāṃśca mahiṣāṃstathā / ṛkṣāṃścābhyahanadvyālānpadbhyāmāśramapīḍakān
ce_text: ṣaḍvarṣa eva bālaḥ sa kaṇvāśramapadaṃ prati / vyāghrān siṃhān varāhāṃś ca gajāṃś ca mahiṣāṃs tathā

vulgate_text: balādbhujābhyāṃ saṃgṛhya balavānsaṃniyamya ca baddhvā vṛkṣeṣu dauṣyantirāśramasya samantataḥ
ce_text: baddhvā vṛkṣeṣu balavān āśramasya samantataḥ / ārohan damayaṃś caiva krīḍaṃś ca paridhāvati

vulgate_text: tato'sya nāma cakruste kaṇvāśramanivāsinaḥ / kaṇvena sahitāḥ sarve dṛṣṭvā karmātimānuṣam
ce_text: tato 'sya nāma cakrus te kaṇvāśramanivāsinaḥ / astv ayaṃ sarvadamanaḥ sarvaṃ hi damayaty ayam

vulgate_text: vikrameṇaujasā caiva balena ca samanvitaḥ / apreṣayati duṣyante mahiṣyāstanayasya ca
ce_text: sa sarvadamano nāma kumāraḥ samapadyata / vikrameṇaujasā caiva balena ca samanvitaḥ

vulgate_text: ityuktvā sarvadamanaṃ kaṇvaḥ śiṣyānathābravīt / śakuntalāmimāṃ śīgraṃ saputrāmāśramāditaḥ
ce_text: tasya tad balam ājñāya kaṇvaḥ śiṣyān uvāca ha / śakuntalām imāṃ śīghraṃ sahaputrām ito ''śramāt / bhartre prāpayatādyaiva sarvalakṣaṇapūjitām

vulgate_text: tathetyuktvā ca te sarve prātiṣṭhanta mahaujasaḥ / śakuntalāṃ puraskṛtya duṣyantasya puraṃ prati
ce_text: tathety uktvā tu te sarve prātiṣṭhantāmitaujasaḥ / śakuntalāṃ puraskṛtya saputrāṃ gajasāhvayam

vulgate_text: gṛhītvā cāmaraprakhyaṃ putraṃ kamalalocanam / ājagmuśca puraṃ ramyaṃ duṣyantādhyuṣitaṃ vanāt
ce_text: gṛhītvāmaragarbhābhaṃ putraṃ kamalalocanam / ājagāma tataḥ śubhrā duḥṣantaviditād vanāt

vulgate_text: saha tena kumāreṇa taruṇādityavarcasā / siṃhāsanasthaṃ rājānaṃ mahendrasadṛśadyutim
ce_text: abhisṛtya ca rājānaṃ viditā sā praveśitā / saha tenaiva putreṇa taruṇādityavarcasā

vulgate_text: śakuntalā nataśirāḥ paraṃ harṣamavāpya ca pūjayitvā yathānyāyamabravīttaṃ śakuntalā
ce_text: pūjayitvā yathānyāyam abravīt taṃ śakuntalā / ayaṃ putras tvayā rājan yauvarājye 'bhiṣicyatām

vulgate_text: prasīdasva mahārāja vakṣyāmi puruṣottama / eṣa putro hi te rājanmayyutpannaḥ paraṃtapa
ce_text: tvayā hy ayaṃ suto rājan mayy utpannaḥ suropamaḥ / yathāsamayam etasmin vartasva puruṣottama

vulgate_text: so'tha śrutvāpi tadvākyaṃ tasyā rājā smarannapi / abravīnna smarāmīti tvayā bhadre samāgamam
ce_text: so 'tha śrutvaiva tad vākyaṃ tasyā rājā smarann api / abravīn na smarāmīti kasya tvaṃ duṣṭatāpasi

vulgate_text: tasmādbhāryāṃ patiḥ paśyenmātṛvatputramātaram / antarātmaiva sarvasya putro nāmocyate sadā
ce_text: ātmātmanaiva janitaḥ putra ity ucyate budhaiḥ / tasmād bhāryāṃ naraḥ paśyen mātṛvat putramātaram

vulgate_text: janitā modate prekṣya svargaṃ prāpyeva puṇyakṛt / pativratārūpadharāḥ parabījasya saṃgrahāt
ce_text: bhāryāyāṃ janitaṃ putram ādarśe svam ivānanam / hlādate janitā preṣkya svargaṃ prāpyeva puṇyakṛt

vulgate_text: hlādante sveṣu dāreṣu gharmārtāḥ salileṣviva / vipravāsakṛśā dīnā narā malinavāsasaḥ
ce_text: dahyamānā manoduḥkhair vyādhibhiś cāturā narāḥ / hlādante sveṣu dāreṣu gharmārtāḥ salileṣv iva

vulgate_text: ratiṃ prītiṃ ca dharmaṃ ca tadāyattamavekṣya ca / ātmano'rdhamiti śrautaṃ sā rakṣati dhanaṃ prajāḥ
ce_text: susaṃrabdho 'pi rāmāṇāṃ na brūyād apriyaṃ budhaḥ / ratiṃ prītiṃ ca dharmaṃ ca tāsv āyattam avekṣya ca

vulgate_text: ṛṣīṇāmapi kā śaktiḥ sraṣṭuṃ rāmāmṛte prajā / devānāmapi kā śaktiḥ kartuṃ saṃbhavamātmanaḥ
ce_text: ātmano janmanaḥ kṣetraṃ puṇyaṃ rāmāḥ sanātanam / ṛṣīṇām api kā śaktiḥ sraṣṭuṃ rāmām ṛte prajāḥ

vulgate_text: aṇḍāni bibhrati svāni na tyajanti pipīlikāḥ / kiṃ punastvaṃ na manyethāḥ sarvathā putramīdṛśam
ce_text: aṇḍāni bibhrati svāni na bhindanti pipīlikāḥ / na bharethāḥ kathaṃ nu tvaṃ dharmajñaḥ san svam ātmajam

vulgate_text: na bharethāḥ kathaṃ nu tvaṃ mayi jātaṃ svamātmajam / mamāṇḍānīti vardhte kokilāṇḍāni vāyasāḥ
ce_text: aṇḍāni bibhrati svāni na bhindanti pipīlikāḥ / na bharethāḥ kathaṃ nu tvaṃ dharmajñaḥ san svam ātmajam

vulgate_text: śiśorāliṅganaṃ tasmāccandanādadhikaṃ bhavet na vāsasāṃ na rāmāṇāṃ nāpāṃ sparśastathāvidhaḥ
ce_text: na vāsasāṃ na rāmāṇāṃ nāpāṃ sparśas tathā sukhaḥ / śiśor āliṅgyamānasya sparśaḥ sūnor yathā sukhaḥ

vulgate_text: āhartā vājimedhasya śatasaṅkhyasya pauravaḥ / rājasūyādikānanyānkratūnamitadakṣiṇān
ce_text: āhartā vājimedhasya śatasaṃkhyasya paurava / iti vāg antarikṣe māṃ sūtake 'bhyavadat purā

vulgate_text: ātmā vai putranāmāsi sa jīva śaradaḥ śatam / upajighranti pitaro mantreṇānena mūrdhani
ce_text: aṅgād aṅgāt saṃbhavasi hṛdayād abhijāyase / ātmā vai putranāmāsi sa jīva śaradaḥ śatam

vulgate_text: eko bhūtvā dvidhā bhūta iti vādaḥ pravartate / tvadaṅgebhyaḥ prasūto'yaṃ puruṣātpuruṣaḥ paraḥ
ce_text: tvadaṅgebhyaḥ prasūto 'yaṃ puruṣāt puruṣo 'paraḥ / sarasīvāmale ''tmānaṃ dvitīyaṃ paśya me sutam

vulgate_text: sarasīvāmale''tmānaṃ dvitīyaṃ paśya te sutam / sarasīvāmale somaṃ prekṣātmānaṃ tvamātmani
ce_text: tvadaṅgebhyaḥ prasūto 'yaṃ puruṣāt puruṣo 'paraḥ / sarasīvāmale ''tmānaṃ dvitīyaṃ paśya me sutam

vulgate_text: parityajya ca māṃ yātā parātmajamivāsatī / pakṣiṇaḥ pumyavantaste sahitā dharmatastadā
ce_text: sā māṃ himavataḥ pṛṣṭhe suṣuve menakāpsarāḥ / avakīrya ca māṃ yātā parātmajam ivāsatī

vulgate_text: sarvameva parokṣaṃ me yattvaṃ vadasi tāpasi / sarvā vāmāḥ striyo loke sarvāḥ kāmaparāyaṇāḥ
ce_text: sarvam etat parokṣaṃ me yat tvaṃ vadasi tāpasi / nāhaṃ tvām abhijānāmi yatheṣṭaṃ gamyatāṃ tvayā

vulgate_text: menakā niranukrośā vardhakī jananī tava / yayā himavataḥ pāde nirmālyavadupekṣitā
ce_text: menakā niranukrośā bandhakī jananī tava / yayā himavataḥ pṛṣṭhe nirmālyeva praveritā

vulgate_text: yadā tu rūpamādarśe virūpaṃ so'bhivīkṣate / tadā hrīmāṃstu jānīyādantaraṃ netaraṃ janam
ce_text: yadā tu mukham ādarśe vikṛtaṃ so 'bhivīkṣate / tadetaraṃ vijānāti ātmānaṃ netaraṃ janam

vulgate_text: pāṃsupātena hṛṣyanti kuñjarā madaśālinaḥ / tathā parivadannanyānhṛṣṭo bhavati durmatiḥ
ce_text: anyān parivadan sādhur yathā hi paritapyate / tathā parivadann anyāṃs tuṣṭo bhavati durjanaḥ

vulgate_text: svayamutpādya putraṃ vai sadṛśaṃ yo'vamanyate / tasya devāḥ śriyaṃ ghnanti tatrainaṃ kalirāviśet
ce_text: svayam utpādya vai putraṃ sadṛśaṃ yo 'vamanyate / tasya devāḥ śriyaṃ ghnanti na ca lokān upāśnute

vulgate_text: krītānkanyāsu cotpannānputrānvai manurabravīt / te ca ṣaḍvandhudāyādāḥ ṣaḍadāyādabāndhavāḥ
ce_text: svapatnīprabhavān pañca labdhān krītān vivardhitān / kṛtān anyāsu cotpannān putrān vai manur abravīt

vulgate_text: sa tvaṃ nṛpatiśārdūla na putraṃ tyaktumarhasi / tasmātputraṃ ca satyaṃ ca pālayasva mahīpate
ce_text: sa tvaṃ nṛpatiśārdūla na putraṃ tyaktum arhasi / ātmānaṃ satyadharmau ca pālayāno mahīpate / narendrasiṃha kapaṭaṃ na voḍhuṃ tvam ihārhasi

vulgate_text: ubhayaṃ pālayasvaitannānṛtaṃ vaktumarhasi ātmānaṃ satyadharmau ca pālayethā mahīpate / narendrasiṃha kapaṭaṃ na hi voḍhuṃ tvamarhasi
ce_text: sa tvaṃ nṛpatiśārdūla na putraṃ tyaktum arhasi / ātmānaṃ satyadharmau ca pālayāno mahīpate / narendrasiṃha kapaṭaṃ na voḍhuṃ tvam ihārhasi

vulgate_text: sarvavedādhigamanaṃ sarvatīrthāvagāhanam / satyasyaiva ca rājendra kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīm
ce_text: sarvavedādhigamanaṃ sarvatīrthāvagāhanam / satyaṃ ca vadato rājan samaṃ vā syān na vā samam

vulgate_text: yasya te hṛdayaṃ veda satyasyaivānṛtasya ca / kalyāṇāvekṣaṇaṃ tasmātkartumarhasi dharmataḥ
ce_text: atra te hṛdayaṃ veda satyasyaivānṛtasya ca / kalyāṇa bata sākṣī tvaṃ mātmānam avamanyathāḥ

vulgate_text: ṛte ca gardabhīkṣīrātpayaḥ pāsyati me sutaḥ ṛtepi tvāṃ ca duṣyanta śailarājāvataṃsikām / caturantāmimāmurvīṃ putro me pālayiṣyati
ce_text: ṛte 'pi tvayi duḥṣanta śailarājāvataṃsakām / caturantām imām urvīṃ putro me pālayiṣyati

vulgate_text: etāvaduktvā vacanaṃ prātiṣṭhata śakuntalā / tasyāḥ krodhasamutthogniḥ sadhūmo mūrdhnyadṛśyata
ce_text: etāvad uktvā vacanaṃ prātiṣṭhata śakuntalā / athāntarikṣe duḥṣantaṃ vāg uvācāśarīriṇī / ṛtvikpurohitācāryair mantribhiś cāvṛtaṃ tadā

vulgate_text: mātā bhastrā pituḥ putro yasmājjātaḥ sa eva saḥ / bharasva putraṃ dauṣyantiṃ satyamāha śakuntalā
ce_text: bhastrā mātā pituḥ putro yena jātaḥ sa eva saḥ / bharasva putraṃ duḥṣanta māvamaṃsthāḥ śakuntalām

vulgate_text: subhūtireṣā na tyājyā jīvitaṃ jīvayātmajam / śākuntalaṃ mahātmānaṃ duṣyanta bhara pauravam
ce_text: abhūtir eṣā kas tyajyāj jīvañ jīvantam ātmajam / śākuntalaṃ mahātmānaṃ dauḥṣantiṃ bhara paurava

vulgate_text: śṛṇvantu devatānāṃ ca maharṣīṇāṃ ca bhāṣitam / ahamapyevamevainaṃ jānāmi sutamātmajam
ce_text: śṛṇvantv etad bhavanto 'sya devadūtasya bhāṣitam / aham apy evam evainaṃ jānāmi svayam ātmajam

vulgate_text: tatastasya tadā rājā pitṛkarmāṇi sarvaśaḥ kārayāmāsa muditaḥ prītimānātmajasya ha / mūrdhni cainaṃ samāghrāya sasnehaṃ pariṣasvaje
ce_text: mūrdhni cainam upāghrāya sasnehaṃ pariṣasvaje / sabhājyamāno vipraiś ca stūyamānaś ca bandibhiḥ / sa mudaṃ paramāṃ lebhe putrasaṃsparśajāṃ nṛpaḥ

vulgate_text: śaṅketa vā'yaṃ loko'tha strībhāvānmayi saṃgatam / tasmādetanmayā cāpi tacchuddhyarthaṃ vicāritam
ce_text: kṛto lokaparokṣo 'yaṃ saṃbandho vai tvayā saha / tasmād etan mayā devi tvacchuddhyarthaṃ vicāritam

vulgate_text: putraścāyaṃ vṛto rājye tvamagramahiṣī bhava
ce_text: manyate caiva lokas te strībhāvān mayi saṃgatam / putraś cāyaṃ vṛto rājye mayā tasmād vicāritam

vulgate_text: vāsobhirannapānaiśca pūjayitvā tu bhārata / sa mātaramupasthāya rathantaryāmabhāṣata
ce_text: tām evam uktvā rājarṣir duḥṣanto mahiṣīṃ priyām / vāsobhir annapānaiś ca pūjayām āsa bhārata

vulgate_text: brāhmaṇebhyo dhanaṃ dattvā sainikānāṃ ca bhūpatiḥ / dauṣyantiṃ ca tato rājā putraṃ śākuntalaṃ tadā
ce_text: duḥṣantaś ca tato rājā putraṃ śākuntalaṃ tadā / bharataṃ nāmataḥ kṛtvā yauvarājye 'bhyaṣecayat

vulgate_text: bharataṃ nāmataḥ kṛtvā yauvarājye'bhyaṣecayat / bharate bhāramāveśya kṛtakṛtyo'bhavannṛpaḥ
ce_text: duḥṣantaś ca tato rājā putraṃ śākuntalaṃ tadā / bharataṃ nāmataḥ kṛtvā yauvarājye 'bhyaṣecayat

vulgate_text: dauṣyantirbharato yajñairīje śākuntalo nṛpaḥ / tasmādbharatavaṃśasya vipratasthe mahadyaśaḥ
ce_text: duḥṣantād bharato jajñe vidvāñ śākuntalo nṛpaḥ / tasmād bharatavaṃśasya vipratasthe mahad yaśaḥ

vulgate_text: bharatasya varastrīṣu putrāḥ saṃjajñire pṛthak / nābhyanandattadā rājā nānurūpā mameti tān
ce_text: bharatas tisṛṣu strīṣu nava putrān ajījanat / nābhyanandanta tān rājā nānurūpā mamety uta

vulgate_text: viduḥ saṃvaraṇaṃ vīramṛkṣādrāthantarīsutam tatheme sarvapañcālā duṣyantaparameṣṭhinoḥ / anvayāḥ kuśikā rājañjanhoramitatejasaḥ
ce_text: tatheme sarvapāñcālā duḥṣantaparameṣṭhinoḥ / anvayāḥ kuśikā rājañ jahnor amitatejasaḥ

vulgate_text: te pratīcīṃ parābhūtāḥ prapannā bhāratā diśam sindhornadasya mahato nikuñje nyavasaṃstadā / nadīvipayaparyante parvatasya samīpataḥ
ce_text: sindhor nadasya mahato nikuñje nyavasat tadā / nadīviṣayaparyante parvatasya samīpataḥ / tatrāvasan bahūn kālān bhāratā durgamāśritāḥ

vulgate_text: tamāsane copaviṣṭaṃ rājā vavre svayaṃ tadā / purohito bhavānno'stu rājyāya prayatemahi
ce_text: taṃ samām aṣṭamīm uṣṭaṃ rājā vavre svayaṃ tadā / purohito bhavān no 'stu rājyāya prayatāmahe / om ity evaṃ vasiṣṭho 'pi bhāratān pratyapadyata

vulgate_text: rājatve taṃ prajāḥ sarvā dharmajña iti vavrire mahimnā tasya kuravo lebhire pratyayaṃ bhṛśam / tasya nāmnā'bhivikhyātaṃ pṛthivyāṃ kurujāṅgalaṃ
ce_text: tasya nāmnābhivikhyātaṃ pṛthivyāṃ kurujāṅgalam / kurukṣetraṃ sa tapasā puṇyaṃ cakre mahātapāḥ

vulgate_text: haviśravāstathendrābho bhumanyuścāparājitaḥ / dhṛtarāṣṭrasutānāṃ tu trīnetānprathitānbhuvi
ce_text: dhṛtarāṣṭro 'tha rājāsīt tasya putro 'tha kuṇḍikaḥ / hastī vitarkaḥ krāthaś ca kuṇḍalaś cāpi pañcamaḥ / haviḥśravās tathendrābhaḥ sumanyuś cāparājitaḥ

vulgate_text: evaṃvidhā mahābhāgā devarūpāḥ prahāriṇaḥ / anvavāye mahārāja ailavaṃśavivardhanāḥ
