vulgate_text: anapatyo'pi vindeyaṃ svargamugreṇa karmaṇā / asti vai tava dharmātmanvidma devopama śubham
ce_text: asti vai tava dharmātman vidma devopamaṃ śubham / apatyam anaghaṃ rājan vayaṃ divyena cakṣuṣā

vulgate_text: caturbhirṛṇavānitthaṃ jāyate manujo bhuvi / pitṛdevamanuṣyāṇāmṛṣīṇāmatha bhāmini
ce_text: ṛṇaiś caturbhiḥ saṃyuktā jāyante manujā bhuvi / pitṛdevarṣimanujadeyaiḥ śatasahasraśaḥ

vulgate_text: etebhyastu yathākālaṃ yo na mucyeta dharmavit / na tasya lokāḥ santīti tatā lokavido viduḥ
ce_text: etāni tu yathākālaṃ yo na budhyati mānavaḥ / na tasya lokāḥ santīti dharmavidbhiḥ pratiṣṭhitam

vulgate_text: ṛṣidevamanuṣyāṇāmṛṇānmukto'smi dharmataḥ / pitṝṇāṃ tu na mukto'smi tacca tebhyo viśiṣyate
ce_text: ṛṣidevamanuṣyāṇāṃ parimukto 'smi dharmataḥ / pitryād ṛṇād anirmuktas tena tapye tapodhanāḥ

vulgate_text: dehanāśe bhavennāśaḥ pitṝṇāmeṣa niścayaḥ / itareṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ tu nāśe hyātmā vinaśyati
ce_text: dehanāśe dhruvo nāśaḥ pitṝṇām eṣa niścayaḥ / iha tasmāt prajāhetoḥ prajāyante narottamāḥ

vulgate_text: iha tasmātprajālābhe prayatante dvijottamāḥ / yathaivāhaṃ pituḥ kṣetre sṛṣṭastena mahātmanā
ce_text: yathaivāhaṃ pituḥ kṣetre sṛṣṭas tena mahātmanā / tathaivāsmin mama kṣetre kathaṃ vai saṃbhavet prajā

vulgate_text: tathaivāsminmama kṣetre kathaṃ sṛjyeta vai prajā / sa samānīya kuntīṃ ca mādrīṃ ca bharatarṣabhaḥ
ce_text: yathaivāhaṃ pituḥ kṣetre sṛṣṭas tena mahātmanā / tathaivāsmin mama kṣetre kathaṃ vai saṃbhavet prajā

vulgate_text: ācaṣṭa putralābhasya vyuṣṭiṃ sarvakriyādhikām / uttamādavarāḥ puṃsaḥ kāṅkṣanto putramāpadi
ce_text: pūrvapūrvatamābhāve matvā lipseta vai sutam / uttamād avarāḥ puṃsaḥ kāṅkṣante putram āpadi

vulgate_text: anapatyo hi maraṇaṃ kāmaye naiva jīvitam mṛgābhiśāpaṃ jānāsi vijane mama kevalam / nṛśaṃsakarmaṇā kṛtsnaṃ yathā hyupahataṃ tathā
ce_text: mṛgābhiśāpān naṣṭaṃ me prajanaṃ hy akṛtātmanaḥ / nṛśaṃsakāriṇo bhīru yathaivopahataṃ tathā

vulgate_text: devā brahmarṣayaścaiva cakruḥ karma svayaṃ tadā / vyuṣitāśvastato rājannati martyānvyarocata
ce_text: vyuṣitāśvas tato rājann ati martyān vyarocata / sarvabhūtāny ati yathā tapanaḥ śiśirātyaye

vulgate_text: vyuṣitāśve yaśovṛddhe manuṣyendre kurūttama / vyuṣitāśvaḥ samudrāntāṃ vijityemāṃ vasundharām
ce_text: apy atra gāthāṃ gāyanti ye purāṇavido janāḥ / vyuṣitāśvaḥ samudrāntāṃ vijityemāṃ vasuṃdharām / apālayat sarvavarṇān pitā putrān ivaurasān

vulgate_text: abhāgyayā mayā nūnaṃ viyuktāḥ sahacāriṇaḥ / tena me viprayogo'yamupapannastvayā saha
ce_text: abhāgyayā mayā nūnaṃ viyuktāḥ sahacāriṇaḥ / saṃyogā viprayuktā vā pūrvadeheṣu pārthiva

vulgate_text: etatsvābhāvikaṃ strīṇāṃ na nimittakṛtaṃ śubhe asmiṃstu loke nacirānmaryādeyaṃ śucismite
ce_text: asmiṃs tu loke nacirān maryādeyaṃ śucismite / sthāpitā yena yasmāc ca tan me vistarataḥ śṛṇu

vulgate_text: mātaraṃ tāṃ tathā dṛṣṭvā nīyamānāṃ balādiva / tapasā dīptavīryo hi śvetaketurna cakṣame
ce_text: ṛṣiputras tataḥ kopaṃ cakārāmarṣitas tadā / mātaraṃ tāṃ tathā dṛṣṭvā nīyamānāṃ balād iva

vulgate_text: evamuktaḥ śvetaketurlajjayā krodhameyivān kruddhaṃ taṃ tu pitā dṛṣṭvā śvetaketumuvāca ha
ce_text: kruddhaṃ taṃ tu pitā dṛṣṭvā śvetaketum uvāca ha / mā tāta kopaṃ kārṣīs tvam eṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ

vulgate_text: yathā gāvaḥ sthitāḥ putra svesve varṇe tathā prajāḥ / tathaiva ca kuṭumbeṣu na pramādyanti karhicit
ce_text: anāvṛtā hi sarveṣāṃ varṇānām aṅganā bhuvi / yathā gāvaḥ sthitās tāta sve sve varṇe tathā prajāḥ

vulgate_text: ṛtukāle tu saṃprāpte bhartāraṃ na jahustadā ṛṣiputro'tha taṃ dharmaṃ śvetaketurna cakṣame
ce_text: ṛṣiputro 'tha taṃ dharmaṃ śvetaketur na cakṣame / cakāra caiva maryādām imāṃ strīpuṃsayor bhuvi

vulgate_text: niyuktā patinā bhāryā yadyapatyasya kāraṇāt na kuryāttattathā bhīru sainaḥ sumahadāpnuyāt / iti tena purā bhīru maryādā sthāpitā balāt
ce_text: iti tena purā bhīru maryādā sthāpitā balāt / uddālakasya putreṇa dharmyā vai śvetaketunā

vulgate_text: evaṃ kṛtavatī sāpi bhartuḥ priyacikīrṣayā / asmākamapi te janma viditaṃ kamalekṣaṇe
ce_text: asmākam api te janma viditaṃ kamalekṣaṇe / kṛṣṇadvaipāyanād bhīru kurūṇāṃ vaṃśavṛddhaye

vulgate_text: tasya tasya prasādātte rājñi putro bhaviṣyati / ityuktā'haṃ tadā tena pitṛveśmani bhārata
ce_text: ity uktāhaṃ tadā tena pitṛveśmani bhārata / brāhmaṇena vacas tathyaṃ tasya kālo 'yam āgataḥ

vulgate_text: saṃvatsare dvitīye tu gāndhāryā udaraṃ mahat / na ca prājāyata tadā tatastāṃ duḥkhamāviśat
ce_text: saṃvatsaradvayaṃ taṃ tu gāndhārī garbham āhitam / aprajā dhārayām āsa tatas tāṃ duḥkham āviśat

vulgate_text: kauravasyāparijñātaṃ yatnena mahatā svayam / udaraṃ ghātayāmāsa gāndhārī śokamūrchitā
ce_text: ajñātaṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrasya yatnena mahatā tataḥ / sodaraṃ pātayām āsa gāndhārī duḥkhamūrcchitā

vulgate_text: ghṛtapūrṇaṃ kuṇḍaśataṃ kṣiprameva vidhīyatām / sugupteṣu ca deśeṣu rakṣā caiva vidhīyatām
ce_text: ghṛtapūrṇaṃ kuṇḍaśataṃ kṣipram eva vidhīyatām / śītābhir adbhir aṣṭhīlām imāṃ ca pariṣiñcata

vulgate_text: ekādhikaśataṃ pūrṇaṃ yathāyogaṃ viśāṃpate / tataḥ kuṇḍaśataṃ tatra ānāyya tu mahānṛṣiḥ
ce_text: ekādhikaśataṃ pūrṇaṃ yathāyogaṃ viśāṃ pate / māṃsapeśyās tadā rājan kramaśaḥ kālaparyayāt

vulgate_text: svanugupteṣu deśeṣu rakṣāṃ caiṣāṃ vyadhāpayat / śaśāsa caiva kṛṣṇo vai garbhāṇāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ tathā
ce_text: tatas tāṃs teṣu kuṇḍeṣu garbhān avadadhe tadā / svanugupteṣu deśeṣu rakṣāṃ ca vyadadhāt tataḥ

vulgate_text: uvāca caināṃ bhagavānkālenaitāvatā punaḥ / sphuṭamāneṣu kuṇḍeṣu jātāñjānīhi śobhane
ce_text: śaśāsa caiva bhagavān kālenaitāvatā punaḥ / vighaṭṭanīyāny etāni kuṇḍānīti sma saubalīm

vulgate_text: jagāma tapase dhīmānhimavantaṃ śiloccayam / ahnottarāḥ kumāraste kuṇḍebhyastu samutthitāḥ
ce_text: ity uktvā bhagavān vyāsas tathā pratividhāya ca / jagāma tapase dhīmān himavantaṃ śiloccayam

vulgate_text: taṃ kharāḥ pratyabhāṣanta gṛdhragomāyuvāyasāḥ / kravyādāḥ prāṇadanghorāḥ śivāścāśivanisvanāḥ
ce_text: vākyasyaitasya nidhane dikṣu sarvāsu bhārata / kravyādāḥ prāṇadan ghorāḥ śivāś cāśivaśaṃsinaḥ

vulgate_text: samānīya bahūnviprānbhīṣmaṃ vidurameva ca / anyāṃśca suhṛdo rājankurūnsarvāṃstathaiva ca
ce_text: jātamātre sute tasmin dhṛtarāṣṭro 'bravīd idam / samānīya bahūn viprān bhīṣmaṃ viduram eva ca

vulgate_text: śatamekonamapyastu putrāṇāṃ te mahīpate / tyajainamekaṃ śāntiṃ cetkulasyecchasi bhārata
ce_text: śatam ekonam apy astu putrāṇāṃ te mahīpate / ekena kuru vai kṣemaṃ lokasya ca kulasya ca

vulgate_text: ekena kuru vai kṣemaṃ kulasya jagatastathā / tyajedekaṃ kulasyārthe grāmasyārthe kulaṃ tyajet
ce_text: tyajed ekaṃ kulasyārthe grāmasyārthe kulaṃ tyajet / grāmaṃ janapadasyārthe ātmārthe pṛthivīṃ tyajet

vulgate_text: mahārathānāṃ vīrāṇāṃ kanyā caikā śatādhikā / yuyutsuśca mahātejā vaiśyāputraḥ pratāpavān
ce_text: evaṃ putraśataṃ jajñe dhṛtarāṣṭrasya dhīmataḥ / mahārathānāṃ vīrāṇāṃ kanyā caikātha duḥśalā

vulgate_text: bhīmavego bhīmabalo balākī balavardhanaḥ / ugrāyudhaḥ suṣeṇaśca kuṇḍadhāro mahodaraḥ
ce_text: ayobāhur mahābāhuś citrāṅgaś citrakuṇḍalaḥ / bhīmavego bhīmabalo balākī balavardhanaḥ

vulgate_text: citrāyudho niṣaṅgī ca pāśī vṛndārakastathā / dṛḍhavarmā dṛḍhakṣatraḥ somakīrtiranūdaraḥ
ce_text: ugrāyudho bhīmakarmā kanakāyur dṛḍhāyudhaḥ / dṛḍhavarmā dṛḍhakṣatraḥ somakīrtir anūdaraḥ

vulgate_text: ādityaketurbahvāśī nāgadatto'grayāyyapi / kavacī krathanaḥ kuṇḍī kuṇḍadhāro dhanurdharaḥ
ce_text: ādityaketur bahvāśī nāgadantograyāyinau / kavacī niṣaṅgī pāśī ca daṇḍadhāro dhanurgrahaḥ

vulgate_text: anādhṛṣyaḥ kuṇḍabhedī virāvī citrakuṇḍalaḥ / pramathaśca pramāthī ca dīrgharomaśca vīryavān
ce_text: anādhṛṣyaḥ kuṇḍabhedī virāvī dīrghalocanaḥ / dīrghabāhur mahābāhur vyūḍhoruḥ kanakadhvajaḥ

vulgate_text: duḥśalāṃ cāpi samaye dhṛtarāṣṭro narādhipaḥ / jayadrathāya pradadau vidhinā bharatarṣabha
ce_text: duḥśalāṃ samaye rājā sindhurājāya bhārata / jayadrathāya pradadau saubalānumate tadā

vulgate_text: jāte balavatāṃ śreṣṭhe pāṇḍuścintāparo'bhavat / kathamanyo mama suto loke śreṣṭho bhavediti
ce_text: jāte vṛkodare pāṇḍur idaṃ bhūyo 'nvacintayat / kathaṃ nu me varaḥ putro lokaśreṣṭho bhaved iti

vulgate_text: amānuṣānmānuṣāṃśca saṃgrāme sa haniṣyati / karmaṇā manasā vācā tasmāttapsye mahattapaḥ
ce_text: taṃ toṣayitvā tapasā putraṃ lapsye mahābalam / yaṃ dāsyati sa me putraṃ sa varīyān bhaviṣyati / karmaṇā manasā vācā tasmāt tapsye mahat tapaḥ

vulgate_text: brāhmaṇānāṃ gavāṃ caiva suhṛdāṃ cārthasādhakam / durhṛdāṃ śokajananaṃ sarvabāndhavanandanam
ce_text: devānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca suhṛdāṃ cārthasādhakam / sutaṃ te 'gryaṃ pradāsyāmi sarvāmitravināśanam

vulgate_text: uvāca kuntīṃ dharmātmā devarājavacaḥ smaran / udarkastava kalyāṇi tuṣṭo devagaṇeśvaraḥ
ce_text: ity uktaḥ kauravo rājā vāsavena mahātmanā / uvāca kuntīṃ dharmātmā devarājavacaḥ smaran

vulgate_text: tathā maharṣayaścāpi jepustatra samantataḥ / gandharvaiḥ sahitaḥ śrīmānprāgāyata ca tumburuḥ
ce_text: divyamālyāmbaradharāḥ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitāḥ / upagāyanti bībhatsum upanṛtyanti cāpsarāḥ / gandharvaiḥ sahitaḥ śrīmān prāgāyata ca tumburuḥ

vulgate_text: indro vivasvānpūṣā ca parjanyo daśamaḥ smṛtaḥ / tatastvaṣṭā tato viṣṇurajaghanyo jaghanyajaḥ
ce_text: dhātāryamā ca mitraś ca varuṇo 'ṃśo bhagas tathā / indro vivasvān pūṣā ca tvaṣṭā ca savitā tathā

vulgate_text: tathaiva tāvapi yamau vāguvācāśarīriṇī / dharmato bhaktitaścaiva śīlato vinayaistathā
ce_text: nakulaṃ sahadevaṃ ca rūpeṇāpratimau bhuvi / tathaiva tāv api yamau vāg uvācāśarīriṇī

vulgate_text: satvarūpaguṇopetau bhavato'tyaśvināviti / māsate tejasā'tyarthaṃ rūpadraviṇasaṃpadā
ce_text: rūpasattvaguṇopetāv etāv anyāñ janān ati / bhāsatas tejasātyarthaṃ rūpadraviṇasaṃpadā

vulgate_text: anusaṃvatsaraṃ jātā api te kurusattamāḥ / pāṇḍuputrā vyarājanta pañcasaṃvatsarā iva
ce_text: pūrvajaṃ nakulety evaṃ sahadeveti cāparam / mādrīputrāv akathayaṃs te viprāḥ prītamānasāḥ / anusaṃvatsaraṃ jātā api te kurusattamāḥ

vulgate_text: mudaṃ paramikāṃ lebhe nananda ca narādhipaḥ / ṛṣīṇāmapi sarveṣāṃ śataśṛṅganivāsinām
ce_text: nāmāni cakrire teṣāṃ śataśṛṅganivāsinaḥ / bhaktyā ca karmaṇā caiva tathāśīrbhir viśāṃ pate

vulgate_text: priyā babhūvustāsāṃ ca tathaiva muniyoṣitām / kuntīmatha punaḥ pāṇḍurmādryarthe samacodayat
ce_text: kuntīm atha punaḥ pāṇḍur mādryarthe samacodayat / tam uvāca pṛthā rājan rahasy uktā satī sadā

vulgate_text: pāṇḍuḥ pañcamahātejāstānpaśyanparvate sutān / reme sa kāśyapayutaḥ patnībhyāṃ subhṛśaṃ tadā
ce_text: darśanīyāṃs tataḥ putrān pāṇḍuḥ pañca mahāvane / tān paśyan parvate reme svabāhubalapālitān

vulgate_text: jīvitāntāya kauravya manmathasya vaśaṃ gataḥ / śāpajaṃ bhayamutsṛjya vidhinā saṃpracoditaḥ
ce_text: jīvitāntāya kauravyo manmathasya vaśaṃ gataḥ / śāpajaṃ bhayam utsṛjya jagāmaiva balāt priyām

vulgate_text: avāpya putrāṃllabdhārthānvīrapatnītvamarthaye / madrarājasutā kuntīmidaṃ vacanamabravīt
ce_text: kuntīputreṣu jāteṣu dhṛtarāṣṭrātmajeṣu ca / madrarājasutā pāṇḍuṃ raho vacanam abravīt

vulgate_text: varteyaṃ na samāṃ vṛttiṃ jātvahaṃ na suteṣu te / tathāhi vartamānāṃ māmadharmaḥ saṃspṛśenmahān
ce_text: na cāpy ahaṃ vartayantī nirviśeṣaṃ suteṣu te / vṛttim ārye cariṣyāmi spṛśed enas tathā hi mām

vulgate_text: dagdhavyaṃ supraticchannaṃ tvetadārye priyaṃ kuru dārakeṣvapramattā tvaṃ bhaveścābhihitā mayā / ato'haṃ na prapaśyāmi saṃdeṣṭavyaṃ hitaṃ tava
ce_text: rājñaḥ śarīreṇa saha mamāpīdaṃ kalevaram / dagdhavyaṃ supraticchannam etad ārye priyaṃ kuru

vulgate_text: pāṇḍoruparamaṃ dṛṣṭvā devakalpā maharṣayaḥ / tato mantravidaḥ sarve mantrayāṃcakrire mithaḥ
ce_text: pāṇḍor avabhṛthaṃ kṛtvā devakalpā maharṣayaḥ / tato mantram akurvanta te sametya tapasvinaḥ

vulgate_text: te parasparamāmantrya devakalpā maharṣayaḥ / pāṇḍoḥ putrānpuraskṛtya nagaraṃ nāgasāhvayam
ce_text: te parasparam āmantrya sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ / pāṇḍoḥ putrān puraskṛtya nagaraṃ nāgasāhvayam

vulgate_text: tamakūjamabhijñāya janaughaṃ sarvaśastadā / pūjayitvā yathānyāyaṃ pādyenārghyeṇa ca prabho
ce_text: tam akūjam ivājñāya janaughaṃ sarvaśas tadā / bhīṣmo rājyaṃ ca rāṣṭraṃ ca maharṣibhyo nyavedayat

vulgate_text: bhīṣmo rājyaṃ ca rāṣṭraṃ ca maharṣibhyo nyavedayat teṣāmatho vṛddhatamaḥ pratyutthāya jaṭājinī / ṛṣīṇāṃ matamājñāya maharṣiridamabravīt
ce_text: teṣām atho vṛddhatamaḥ pratyutthāya jaṭājinī / maharṣimatam ājñāya maharṣir idam abravīt

vulgate_text: asmākaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā devānārādhayattadā brahmacaryavratasthasya tasya divyena hetunā
ce_text: brahmacaryavratasthasya tasya divyena hetunā / sākṣād dharmād ayaṃ putras tasya jāto yudhiṣṭhiraḥ

vulgate_text: ajeyānapi jetā'rīndevatādīnna saṃśayaḥ yasya kīrtirmaheṣvāsānsarvānabhibhaviṣyati
ce_text: puruhūtād ayaṃ jajñe kuntyāṃ satyaparākramaḥ / yasya kīritr maheṣvāsān sarvān abhibhaviṣyati

vulgate_text: aśvibhyāṃ puruṣavyāghrāvimau tāvapi tiṣṭhataḥ nakulaḥ sahadevaśca tāvapyamitatejasau
ce_text: yau tu mādrī maheṣvāsāv asūta kurusattamau / aśvibhyāṃ manujavyāghrāv imau tāv api tiṣṭhataḥ

vulgate_text: krośantaḥ pāṇḍavāḥ sarve bhīṣmo vidura eva ca / bāhlīkaḥ somadattaśca tathā bhūriśravā nṛpaḥ
ce_text: krośantaḥ pāṇḍavāḥ sarve bhīṣmo vidura eva ca / ramaṇīye vanoddeśe gaṅgātīre same śubhe

vulgate_text: anyonyaṃ vai samāśliṣya anujagmuḥ sahasraśaḥ ramaṇīye vanoddeśe gaṅgātīre same śubhe
ce_text: krośantaḥ pāṇḍavāḥ sarve bhīṣmo vidura eva ca / ramaṇīye vanoddeśe gaṅgātīre same śubhe

vulgate_text: tatastasya śarīraṃ tu sarvagandhādhivāsitam / śucikālīyakādigdhaṃ divyacandanarūṣitam
ce_text: tatas tasya śarīraṃ tat sarvagandhaniṣevitam / śucikālīyakādigdhaṃ mukhyasnānādhivāsitam / paryaṣiñcaj jalenāśu śātakumbhamayair ghaṭaiḥ

vulgate_text: tuṅgapadmakamiśreṇa candanena sugandhinā / saralaṃ devadāruṃ ca guggulaṃ lākṣayā saha
ce_text: tuṅgapadmakamiśreṇa candanena sugandhinā / anyaiś ca vividhair gandhair analpaiḥ samadāhayan

vulgate_text: haricandanakāṣṭhaiśca hariberairuśīrakaiḥ anyaiśca vividhairgandhairvidhinā samadāhayan
ce_text: tuṅgapadmakamiśreṇa candanena sugandhinā / anyaiś ca vividhair gandhair analpaiḥ samadāhayan

vulgate_text: kurūṇāmanayāccāpi pṛthivī na bhaviṣyati / gaccha tvaṃ yogamāsthāya yuktā vasa tapovane
ce_text: gaccha tvaṃ tyāgam āsthāya yuktā vasa tapovane / mā drakṣyasi kulasyāsya ghoraṃ saṃkṣayam ātmanaḥ

ce_text: kṣatriyābhyaś ca ye jātā brāhmaṇās te ca viśrutāḥ / ācāryaḥ kalaśāj jātaḥ śarastambād guruḥ kṛpaḥ / bhavatāṃ ca yathā janma tad apy āgamitaṃ nṛpaiḥ

vulgate_text: bhavatāṃ ca yathā janma tadapyāgamitaṃ mayā sakuṇḍalaṃ sakavacaṃ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitam / kathamādityasadṛśaṃ mṛgī vyāghraṃ janiṣyati
ce_text: sakuṇḍalaṃ sakavacaṃ divyalakṣaṇalakṣitam / katham ādityasaṃkāśaṃ mṛgī vyāghraṃ janiṣyati

vulgate_text: āyāntamarjunaṃ dṛṣṭvā kumārāḥ sahitāstadā / mamṛdustasya nagaraṃ drupadasya mahātmanaḥ
ce_text: tato 'bhijagmuḥ pāñcālān nighnantas te nararṣabhāḥ / mamṛdus tasya nagaraṃ drupadasya mahaujasaḥ

vulgate_text: dakṣiṇāṃścāpi pañcālānyāvaccarmaṇvatī nadī / droṇena caivaṃ drupadaḥ paribhūyātha pālitaḥ
ce_text: mākandīm atha gaṅgāyās tīre janapadāyutām / so 'dhyāvasad dīnamanāḥ kāmpilyaṃ ca purottamam / dakṣiṇāṃś caiva pāñcālān yāvac carmaṇvatī nadī

vulgate_text: putrajanma parīpsanvai pṛthivīmanvasaṃcarat / ahicchatraṃ ca viṣayaṃ droṇaḥ samabhipadyata
ce_text: hīnaṃ viditvā cātmānaṃ brāhmaṇena balena ca / putrajanma parīpsan vai sa rājā tad adhārayat / ahicchatraṃ ca viṣayaṃ droṇaḥ samabhipadyata

vulgate_text: hīnaṃ viditvā cātmānaṃ brāhmeṇāpi balena ca / drupado'marṣaṇādrājā karmasiddhāndvijottamān
ce_text: amarṣī drupado rājā karmasiddhān dvijarṣabhān / anvicchan paricakrāma brāhmaṇāvasathān bahūn

vulgate_text: anvicchanparicakrāma brāhmaṇāvasathānbahūn / nāsti śreṣṭhaṃ mamāpatyaṃ dhigbandhūniti ca bruvan
ce_text: amarṣī drupado rājā karmasiddhān dvijarṣabhān / anvicchan paricakrāma brāhmaṇāvasathān bahūn

ce_text: jātān putrān sa nirvedād dhig bandhūn iti cābravīt / niḥśvāsaparamaś cāsīd droṇaṃ praticikīrṣayā

ce_text: prabhāvaṃ vinayaṃ śikṣāṃ droṇasya caritāni ca / kṣātreṇa ca balenāsya cintayan nānvapadyata / pratikartuṃ nṛpaśreṣṭho yatamāno 'pi bhārata

vulgate_text: kartuṃ prayatamāno vai na śaśāka parājayam / abhitaḥ so'tha kalmāṣīṃ gaṅgātīre paribhraman
ce_text: abhitaḥ so 'tha kalmāṣīṃ gaṅgākūle paribhraman / brāhmaṇāvasathaṃ puṇyam āsasāda mahīpatiḥ

vulgate_text: pādyenāsanadānena tathā'rghyeṇa phalaiśca tam / arhayitvā yathānyāyamupayājo'bravīttataḥ
ce_text: pādaśuśrūṣaṇe yuktaḥ priyavāk sarvakāmadaḥ / arhayitvā yathānyāyam upayājam uvāca saḥ

vulgate_text: yena me karmaṇā brahmanputraḥ syāddroṇamṛtyeva / upayāja carasvaitatpradāsyāmi dhanaṃ tava
ce_text: yena me karmaṇā brahman putraḥ syād droṇamṛtyave / upayāja kṛte tasmin gavāṃ dātāsmi te 'rbudam

vulgate_text: upayājo'bravīdvākyaṃ kāle madhurayā girā / jyeṣṭho bhrātā na me'tyākṣīdvicaranvijane vane
ce_text: tataḥ saṃvatsarasyānte drupadaṃ sa dvijottamaḥ / upayājo 'bravīd rājan kāle madhurayā girā

vulgate_text: vimarśaṃ hi phalādāne nāyaṃ kuryātkathaṃcana / nāpaśyatphalaṃ dṛṣṭvā doṣāṃstasyā''nubandhikān
ce_text: tad apaśyam ahaṃ bhrātur asāṃpratam anuvrajan / vimarśaṃ saṃkarādāne nāyaṃ kuryāt kathaṃ cana

vulgate_text: vivinakti na śaucārthī so'nyatrāpi kathaṃ bhavet / saṃhitādhyayanasyānte pañcayajñānnirūpya ca
ce_text: dṛṣṭvā phalasya nāpaśyad doṣā ye 'syānubandhikāḥ / vivinakti na śaucaṃ yaḥ so 'nyatrāpi kathaṃ bhavet

vulgate_text: kīrtayanguṇamannānāmatha prīto muhurmuhuḥ / evaṃ phalārthinastsamānmanye'haṃ tarkacakṣuṣā
ce_text: tam ahaṃ phalārthinaṃ manye bhrātaraṃ tarkacakṣuṣā / taṃ vai gacchasva nṛpate sa tvāṃ saṃyājayiṣyati

vulgate_text: upayājavacaḥ śrutvā yājasyāśramamabhyagāt / jugupsamāno nṛpatirmanasedaṃ vicintayan
ce_text: jugupsamāno nṛpatir manasedaṃ vicintayan / upayājavacaḥ śrutvā nṛpatiḥ sarvadharmavit / abhisaṃpūjya pūjārham ṛṣiṃ yājam uvāca ha

vulgate_text: tasmāddroṇabhayārtaṃ māṃ bhavāṃstrātumihārhati / yena me karmaṇā brahmanputraḥ syāddroṇamṛtyave
ce_text: yena me karmaṇā brahman putraḥ syād droṇamṛtyave / upayāja kṛte tasmin gavāṃ dātāsmi te 'rbudam

vulgate_text: arjunasyāpi vai bhāryā bhavedyā varavarṇinī / sa hi brahmavidāṃ śreṣṭho brāhme kṣātre'pyanuttamaḥ
ce_text: sa hi brahmavidāṃ śreṣṭho brahmāstre cāpy anuttamaḥ / tasmād droṇaḥ parājaiṣīn māṃ vai sa sakhivigrahe

vulgate_text: tato droṇastu mā'jaiṣītsakhivigrahakāraṇāt / kṣatriyo nāsti tulyo'sya pṛthivyāṃ kaścidagraṇīḥ
ce_text: kṣatriyo nāsti tulyo 'sya pṛthivyāṃ kaś cid agraṇīḥ / kauravācāryamukhyasya bhāradvājasya dhīmataḥ

vulgate_text: ṣaḍaratni dhanuścāsya khaḍgamapratima tathā / sa hi brāhmaṇaveṣeṇa kṣātraṃ vegamasaṃśayam
ce_text: sa hi brāhmaṇavegena kṣātraṃ vegam asaṃśayam / pratihanti maheṣvāso bhāradvājo mahāmanāḥ

vulgate_text: pratihanti maheṣvāso bhāradvājo mahāmanāḥ / kārtavīryasamo hyeṣa khaṭvāṅgapratimo raṇe
ce_text: sa hi brāhmaṇavegena kṣātraṃ vegam asaṃśayam / pratihanti maheṣvāso bhāradvājo mahāmanāḥ

vulgate_text: sahitaṃ kṣatravegena brahmavegena sāṃpratam / upapannaṃ hi manye'haṃ bhāradvājaṃ yaśasvinam
ce_text: sa hi brāhmaṇavegena kṣātraṃ vegam asaṃśayam / pratihanti maheṣvāso bhāradvājo mahāmanāḥ

vulgate_text: tasya hyastrabalaṃ ghoramaprasahyaṃ parairbhuvi / śatrūnsametya jayati kṣatraṃ brahmapuraskṛtam
ce_text: kṣatrocchedāya vihito jāmadagnya ivāsthitaḥ / tasya hy astrabalaṃ ghoram aprasahyaṃ narair bhuvi

vulgate_text: droṇamṛtyuryathā me'dya putro jāyeta vīryavān / tatkarma kuru me yāja nirvapāmyarbuddhaṃ gavām
ce_text: droṇāntakam ahaṃ putraṃ labheyaṃ yudhi durjayam / tat karma kuru me yāja nirvapāmy arbudaṃ gavām

vulgate_text: gurvarthe'yojayatkarma yājasyāpi samīpataḥ / tatastasya narendrasya upayājo mahātapāḥ
ce_text: tatas tasya narendrasya upayājo mahātapāḥ / ācakhyau karma vaitānaṃ tadā putraphalāya vai

vulgate_text: ācavyau karma vaitānaṃ tathā putraphalāya vai iha putro mahāvīryo mahātejā mahābalaḥ / iṣyate yadvidho rājanbhavitā sa tathāvidhaḥ
ce_text: sa ca putro mahāvīryo mahātejā mahābalaḥ / iṣyate yadvidho rājan bhavitā te tathāvidhaḥ

vulgate_text: sautrāmaṇiṃ tathā patnīṃ tataḥ kāle'bhyayāttadā / yājastu savanasyānte devīmāhvāpayattadā
ce_text: yājas tu havanasyānte devīm āhvāpayat tadā / praihi māṃ rājñi pṛṣati mithunaṃ tvām upasthitam

vulgate_text: prehi māṃ rājñi pṛṣati mithunaṃ tvāmupasthitam / kumāraśca kumārī ca pitṛvaṃśavivṛddhaye
ce_text: yājas tu havanasyānte devīm āhvāpayat tadā / praihi māṃ rājñi pṛṣati mithunaṃ tvām upasthitam

vulgate_text: nāliptaṃ vai mama mukhaṃ puṇyāngandhānbibharmi ca / na patnī te'smi sūtyarthe tiṣṭha yāja mama priye
ce_text: avaliptaṃ me mukhaṃ brahman puṇyān gandhān bibharmi ca / sutārthenoparuddhāsmi tiṣṭha yāja mama priye

vulgate_text: jvālāvarṇo ghorarūpaḥ kirīṭī varma dhārayan / vīraḥ sakhaṅgaḥ saśaro dhanuṣmānsa nadanmuhuḥ
ce_text: jvālāvarṇo ghorarūpaḥ kirīṭī varma cottamam / bibhrat sakhaḍgaḥ saśaro dhanuṣmān vinadan muhuḥ

vulgate_text: so'bhyarohadrathavaraṃ tena ca prayayau tadā / jātamātre kumāre ca vākkilāntarhitābravīt
ce_text: so 'dhyārohad rathavaraṃ tena ca prayayau tadā / tataḥ praṇeduḥ pāñcālāḥ prahṛṣṭāḥ sādhu sādhv iti

vulgate_text: eṣa śiṣyaśca mṛtyuśca bhāradvājasya jāyate / bhayāpaho rājaputraḥ pāñcālānāṃ yaśaskaraḥ
ce_text: bhayāpaho rājaputraḥ pāñcālānāṃ yaśaskaraḥ / rājñaḥ śokāpaho jāta eṣa droṇavadhāya vai / ity uvāca mahad bhūtam adṛśyaṃ khecaraṃ tadā

vulgate_text: tataḥ praṇeduḥ pāñcālāḥ prahṛṣṭāḥ sādhusādhviti / dvitīyāyāṃ ca hotrāyāṃ hute haviṣi mantrite
ce_text: so 'dhyārohad rathavaraṃ tena ca prayayau tadā / tataḥ praṇeduḥ pāñcālāḥ prahṛṣṭāḥ sādhu sādhv iti

vulgate_text: kumārī cāpi pāñcālī vedimadhyātsamutthitā / pratyākhyāte pṛṣatyā ca yājake bharatarṣabha
ce_text: kumārī cāpi pāñcālī vedimadhyāt samutthitā / subhagā darśanīyāṅgī vedimadhyā manoramā

vulgate_text: punaḥ kumārī pāñcālī subhagā vedimadhyagā / antarvedyāṃ samudbhūtā kanyā sā sumanoharā
ce_text: kumārī cāpi pāñcālī vedimadhyāt samutthitā / subhagā darśanīyāṅgī vedimadhyā manoramā

vulgate_text: tāmratuṅganakhī subhrūścārupīnapayodharā / nīlotpalasamo gandho yasyāḥ krośātpradhāvati
ce_text: nīlotpalasamo gandho yasyāḥ krośāt pravāyati / yā bibharti paraṃ rūpaṃ yasyā nāsty upamā bhuvi

vulgate_text: yā bibharti paraṃ rūpaṃ yasyā nāstyupamā bhuvi / devadānavayakṣāṇāmīpsitā varavarṇinī
ce_text: nīlotpalasamo gandho yasyāḥ krośāt pravāyati / yā bibharti paraṃ rūpaṃ yasyā nāsty upamā bhuvi

ce_text: tau dṛṣṭvā pṛṣatī yājaṃ prapede vai sutārthinī / na vai mad anyāṃ jananīṃ jānīyātām imāv iti

ce_text: dhṛṣṭatvād atidhṛṣṇutvād dharmād dyutsaṃbhavād api / dhṛṣṭadyumnaḥ kumāro 'yaṃ drupadasya bhavatv iti

ce_text: guṇaiḥ samuditān dṛṣṭvā paurāḥ pāṇḍusutāṃs tadā / kathayanti sma saṃbhūya catvareṣu sabhāsu ca

ce_text: abhaviṣyaḥ sthiro rājye yadi hi tvaṃ purā nṛpa / dhruvaṃ prāpsyāma ca vayaṃ rājyam apy avaśe jane

ce_text: dharmanityaḥ sadā pāṇḍur mamāsīt priyakṛd dhitaḥ / sarveṣu jñātiṣu tathā mayi tv āsīd viśeṣataḥ

vulgate_text: nātra kiṃcana jānāti bhojanādi cikīrṣitam / nivedayati tatsarvaṃ mayi dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ
ce_text: nāsya kiṃ cin na jānāmi bhojanādi cikīrṣitam / nivedayati nityaṃ hi mama rājyaṃ dhṛtavrataḥ

vulgate_text: tasya putro yathā pāṇḍustathā dharmaparaḥ sadā / guṇāvām̐llokavikhyāto nagare ca pratiṣṭhitaḥ
ce_text: tasya putro yathā pāṇḍus tathā dharmaparāyaṇaḥ / guṇavāṃl lokavikhyātaḥ paurāṇāṃ ca susaṃmataḥ

vulgate_text: sa kathaṃ śakyate'smābhirapākraṣṭuṃ nararṣabhaḥ / rājyameṣa hi naḥ prāptaḥ sasahayo viśeṣataḥ
ce_text: sa kathaṃ śakyam asmābhir apakraṣṭuṃ balād itaḥ / pitṛpaitāmahād rājyāt sasahāyo viśeṣataḥ

vulgate_text: te tathā saṃstutāstāta viṣaye pāṇḍunā narāḥ / kathaṃ yudhiṣṭhirasyārthe na no hanyuḥ sabāndhavān
ce_text: te purā satkṛtās tāta pāṇḍunā pauravā janāḥ / kathaṃ yudhiṣṭhirasyārthe na no hanyuḥ sabāndhavān

vulgate_text: naite viṣayamiccheyurdharmatyāge viśeṣataḥ / te vayaṃ kauravendrāṇāmeteṣāṃ ca mahātmanām

ce_text: kṛpaḥ śāradvataś caiva yata ete trayas tataḥ / droṇaṃ ca bhāgineyaṃ ca na sa tyakṣyati karhi cit

ce_text: sa bhavān pāṇḍavān āśu vivāsayitum arhati / mṛdunaivābhyupāyena nagaraṃ vāraṇāvatam

vulgate_text: suvisrabdhaḥ pāṇḍuputrānsaha mātrā pravāsaya / vāraṇāvatamadyaiva yathā yānti yathā kuru
ce_text: sa viśrabdhaḥ pāṇḍuputrān saha mātrā vivāsaya / vāraṇāvatam adyaiva nātra doṣo bhaviṣyati

vulgate_text: purohitāṃśca pautrāṃśca gāndhārīṃ ca yaśasvinīm sarvā mātṝrupaspṛṣṭvā vidurasya ca yoṣitaḥ / yudhiṣṭhiraḥ śanairdīna uvācedaṃ vacastadā
ce_text: kṛpam ācāryaputraṃ ca gāndhārīṃ ca yaśasvinīm / yudhiṣṭhiraḥ śanair dīnam uvācedaṃ vacas tadā

ce_text: evam ukteṣu rājñā tu pāṇḍaveṣu mahātmasu / duryodhanaḥ paraṃ harṣam ājagāma durātmavān

vulgate_text: mameyaṃ vasusaṃpūrṇā purocana vasundharā / yathaiva bhavitā tāta tathā tvaṃ draṣṭumarhasi
ce_text: mameyaṃ vasusaṃpūrṇā purocana vasuṃdharā / yatheyaṃ mama tadvat te sa tāṃ rakṣitum arhasi

ce_text: śaṇān vaṃśaṃ ghṛtaṃ dāru yantrāṇi vividhāni ca / tasmin veśmani sarvāṇi nikṣipethāḥ samantataḥ

vulgate_text: dagdhānevaṃ svake gehe dāhitāḥ pāṇḍavā iti / na garhayeyurasmānvai pāṇḍavārthāya karhicit
ce_text: dagdhān evaṃ svake gehe dagdhā iti tato janāḥ / jñātayo vā vadiṣyanti pāṇḍavārthāya karhi cit

vulgate_text: tatra kecidbruvanti sma brāhmaṇā nirbhayāstadā / dīnāndṛṣṭvā pāṇḍusutānatīva bhṛśaduḥkhitāḥ
ce_text: tatra kec cid bruvanti sma brāhmaṇā nirbhayās tadā / śocamānāḥ pāṇḍuputrān atīva bharatarṣabha

vulgate_text: adharmyamidamatyantaṃ kathaṃ bhīṣmo'numanyate / vivāsyamānānasthāne nagare yo'bhimanyate
ce_text: tad rājyaṃ pitṛtaḥ prāptaṃ dhṛtarāṣṭro na mṛṣyate / adharmam akhilaṃ kiṃ nu bhīṣmo 'yam anumanyate / vivāsyamānān asthāne kaunteyān bharatarṣabhān

vulgate_text: evamuktāstadā paurāḥ kṛtvā cāpi pradakṣiṇam / āśīrbhiścābhinandyaitāñjagmurnagarameva hi

vulgate_text: kāmakrodhāvubhau yasya caraṇau samuvāhatuḥ / indriyāṇāṃ vaśakaro vaśiṣṭha iti cocyate
ce_text: tapasā nirjitau śaśvad ajeyāv amarair api / kāmakrodhāv ubhau yasya caraṇau saṃvavāhatuḥ

vulgate_text: mahīṃ jigīṣatā rājñā brahma kāryaṃ puraḥskṛtam tasmātpurohitaḥ kaścidguṇavānvijitendriyaḥ / vidvānbhavatu vo vipro dharmakāmārthatattvavit
ce_text: mahīṃ jigīṣatā rājñā brahma kāryaṃ puraḥsaram / tasmāt purohitaḥ kaś cid guṇavān astu vo dvijaḥ

vulgate_text: ratnāni ca mahārhāṇi vāsāṃsi vividhāni ca / taiḥ kāmaiḥ sarvasaṃpūrṇaiḥ pūjitaśca mahipatiḥ
ce_text: taiḥ kāmaiḥ sarvasaṃpūrṇaiḥ pūjitaḥ sa mahīpatiḥ / sāmātyaḥ sabalaś caiva tutoṣa sa bhṛśaṃ nṛpaḥ

vulgate_text: puṣṭāyataśirogrīvāṃ vismitaḥ so'bhivīkṣyatām / abhinandya sa tāṃ rājā nandinīṃ gādhinandanaḥ
ce_text: suvāladhiṃ śaṅkukarṇāṃ cāruśṛṅgāṃ manoramām / puṣṭāyataśirogrīvāṃ vismitaḥ so 'bhivīkṣya tām

vulgate_text: abravīcca bhṛśaṃ tuṣṭaḥ sa rājā tamṛṣiṃ tadā / arbudena gavāṃ brahmanmama rājyena vā punaḥ
ce_text: arbudena gavāṃ brahman mama rājyena vā punaḥ / nandinīṃ saṃprayacchasva bhuṅkṣva rājyaṃ mahāmune

vulgate_text: adeyā nandinīyaṃ vai rājyenāpi tavānagha / ratnaṃ hi bhagavannetadratnahārī ca pārthivaḥ / kṣatriyo'haṃ bhavānviprastapaḥsvādhyāyasādhanaḥ
ce_text: devatātithipitrartham ājyārthaṃ ca payasvinī / adeyā nandinīyaṃ me rājyenāpi tavānagha

vulgate_text: hriyase tvaṃ balādbhadre viśvāmitreṇa nandini kiṃ kartavyaṃ mayā tatra kṣamāvānbrāhmaṇo hyaham
ce_text: śṛṇomi te ravaṃ bhadre vinadantyāḥ punaḥ punaḥ / balād dhriyasi me nandi kṣamāvān brāhmaṇo hy aham

vulgate_text: asṛjatpahlavānpucchātprasravāddrāviḍāñchakān / yonideśācca yavānāñśakṛtaḥ śabarānbahūn
ce_text: asṛjat pahlavān pucchāc chakṛtaḥ śabarāñ śakān / mūtrataś cāsṛjac cāpi yavanān krodhamūrcchitā

vulgate_text: mūtrataścāsṛjatkāṃścicchabarāṃścaiva pārśvataḥ / pauṇḍrānkirātānyavanānsiṃhalānbarbarānkhasān
ce_text: puṇḍrān kirātān dramiḍān siṃhalān barbarāṃs tathā / tathaiva daradān mlecchān phenataḥ sā sasarja ha

vulgate_text: sā gaustatsakalaṃ sainyaṃ kālayāmāsa dūrataḥ / viśvāmitrasya tatsainyaṃ kālyamānaṃ triyojanam
ce_text: viśvāmitrasya sainyaṃ tu kālyamānaṃ triyojanam / krośamānaṃ bhayodvignaṃ trātāraṃ nādhyagacchata

vulgate_text: krośamānaṃ bhayodvignaṃ trātāraṃ nādhyagacchata / viśvāmitrastato dṛṣṭvā krodhāviṣṭaḥ sa rodasī
ce_text: viśvāmitrasya sainyaṃ tu kālyamānaṃ triyojanam / krośamānaṃ bhayodvignaṃ trātāraṃ nādhyagacchata

vulgate_text: akāmayattaṃ yājyārthe viśvāmitraḥ pratāpavān / sa tu rājā mahātmānaṃ vāsiṣṭhamṛṣisattamam
ce_text: sa tu rājā mahātmānaṃ vāsiṣṭham ṛṣisattamam / tṛṣārtaś ca kṣudhārtaś ca ekāyanagataḥ pathi

vulgate_text: dadarśātha dvijaḥ kaścidrājānaṃ prasthitaṃ vanam / ayācata kṣudhāpannaḥ samāṃsaṃ bhojanaṃ tadā
ce_text: dadarśa taṃ dvijaḥ kaś cid rājānaṃ prasthitaṃ punaḥ / yayāce kṣudhitaś cainaṃ samāṃsaṃ bhojanaṃ tadā

vulgate_text: śaktobhāryā mahābhāga tapoyuktā tapasvinam / ahamekākinī cāpi tvayā gacchāmi nāparaḥ
ce_text: anuvrajati ko nv eṣa mām ity eva ca so 'bravīt / ahaṃ tv adṛśyatī nāmnā taṃ snuṣā pratyabhāṣata / śakter bhāryā mahābhāga tapoyuktā tapasvinī

vulgate_text: pāhi māṃ bhagavanpāpādasmāddāruṇadarśanāt / rākṣaso'yamihāttuṃ vai nūnamāvāṃ samīhate
ce_text: trāhi māṃ bhagavan pāpād asmād dāruṇadarśanāt / rakṣo attum iha hy āvāṃ nūnam etac cikīrṣati

vulgate_text: mantrapūtena ca punaḥ sa tamabhyukṣya vāriṇā / mokṣayāmāsa vai śāpāttasmādyogānnarādhipam
ce_text: mantrapūtena ca punaḥ sa tam abhyukṣya vāriṇā / mokṣayām āsa vai ghorād rākṣasād rājasattamam

vulgate_text: tataḥ praviṣṭe rājarṣau tasmiṃstatpuramuttamam / rājñastasyājñayā devī vasiṣṭhamupacakrame
ce_text: tataḥ praviṣṭe rājendre tasmin rājani tāṃ purīm / tasya rājño ''jñayā devī vasiṣṭham upacakrame

vulgate_text: dīrghakālena sā garbhaṃ suṣuve na tu taṃ yadā / tadā devyaśmanā kukṣiṃ nirbibheda yaśasvinī
ce_text: dīrghakāladhṛtaṃ garbhaṃ suṣāva na tu taṃ yadā / sātha devy aśmanā kukṣiṃ nirbibheda tadā svakam

vulgate_text: tato dvādaśame varṣe sa jajñe puraṣarṣabhaḥ / aśmako nāma rājarṣiḥ paudanyaṃ yo nyaveśayat
ce_text: dvādaśe 'tha tato varṣe sa jajñe manujarṣabha / aśmako nāma rājarṣiḥ potanaṃ yo nyaveśayat

vulgate_text: mā tāta tātatāteti brūhyenaṃ pitaraṃ pituḥ / rakṣasā bhakṣitastāta tava tāto vanāntare
ce_text: mā tāta tāta tāteti na te tāto mahāmuniḥ / rakṣasā bhakṣitas tāta tava tāto vanāntare

vulgate_text: taṃ tathā niścitātmānaṃ sa mahātmā mahātapāḥ / ṛṣirbrahmavidāṃ śraṣṭho maitrāvaruṇirantyadhīḥ
ce_text: taṃ tathā niścitātmānaṃ mahātmānaṃ mahātapāḥ / vasiṣṭho vārayām āsa hetunā yena tac chṛṇu

vulgate_text: ūruṇaikena vābhorūrbhartuḥ kulavivṛddhaye / taṃ garbhamupalabhyāśu brāhmaṇyekā bhayārditā
ce_text: tāsām anyatamā garbhaṃ bhayād dādhāra taijasam / ūruṇaikena vāmorūr bhartuḥ kulavivṛddhaye / dadṛśur brāhmaṇīṃ tāṃ te dīpyamānāṃ svatejasā

vulgate_text: kiṃ hi vittena naḥ kāryaṃ svargepsūnāṃ dvijottama / yadasmākaṃ dhanādhyakṣaḥ prabhūtaṃ dhanamāharat
ce_text: nikhātaṃ tad dhi vai vittaṃ kena cid bhṛguveśmani / vairāyaiva tadā nyastaṃ kṣatriyān kopayiṣṇubhiḥ / kiṃ hi vittena naḥ kāryaṃ svargepsūnāṃ dvijarṣabha

vulgate_text: śama eva paro dharmastamācara parāśara / adharmiṣṭhaṃ variṣṭhaḥ sankuruṣe tvaṃ parāśara
ce_text: prajocchedam imaṃ mahyaṃ sarvaṃ somapasattama / adharmiṣṭhaṃ variṣṭhaḥ san kuruṣe tvaṃ parāśara / rājā kalmāṣapādaś ca divam āroḍhum icchati

vulgate_text: nimittabhūtastatrāsīdviśvāmitraḥ parāśara / rājā kalmāṣapādaśca divamāruhya modate
ce_text: prajocchedam imaṃ mahyaṃ sarvaṃ somapasattama / adharmiṣṭhaṃ variṣṭhaḥ san kuruṣe tvaṃ parāśara / rājā kalmāṣapādaś ca divam āroḍhum icchati

vulgate_text: adharmiṣṭhaṃ vasiṣṭhena kṛtaṃ cāpi purā sakhe / etanme saṃśayaṃ sarvaṃ chettumarhasi pṛcchataḥ
ce_text: jānatā ca paraṃ dharmaṃ lokyaṃ tena mahātmanā / agamyāgamanaṃ kasmād vasiṣṭhena mahātmanā / kṛtaṃ tena purā sarvaṃ vaktum arhasi pṛcchataḥ

vulgate_text: patnīmṛtāvanuprāpya sadyastyakṣyasi jīvitam tena prasādyamānā sā prasādamakarottadā / yasya carṣervasiṣṭhasya tvayā putrā vināśitāḥ
ce_text: tasmāt tvam api durbuddhe macchāpaparivikṣataḥ / patnīm ṛtāv anuprāpya sadyas tyakṣyasi jīvitam

vulgate_text: gṛhṇīṣva cākṣuṣīṃ vidyāmimāṃ bharatasattama / evamukto'rjunaḥ prīto vacanaṃ cedamabravīt
ce_text: tato 'rjuno 'stram āgneyaṃ pradadau tad yathāvidhi / gandharvāya tadā prīto vacanaṃ cedam abravīt

vulgate_text: sa hi vedārthatattvajñasteṣāṃ gururudāradhīḥ / vedaviccaiva vāgmī ca dhaumyaḥ śrīmāndvijottamaḥ
ce_text: sa hi vedārthatattvajñas teṣāṃ gurur udāradhīḥ / tena dharmavidā pārthā yājyāḥ sarvavidā kṛtāḥ

vulgate_text: sa cāpi viprastānmene svabhāvābhyadhikānbhuvi / tena dharmavidā pārthā yojyā sarvavidā vṛtāḥ
ce_text: sa hi vedārthatattvajñas teṣāṃ gurur udāradhīḥ / tena dharmavidā pārthā yājyāḥ sarvavidā kṛtāḥ

vulgate_text: menire sahitā vīrāḥ prāptaṃ rājyaṃ ca pāṇḍavāḥ / buddhivīryabalotsāhairyuktā devā ivāpare
ce_text: vīrāṃs tu sa hi tān mene prāptarājyān svadharmataḥ / buddhivīryabalotsāhair yuktān devān ivāparān

vulgate_text: tataste naraśārdūlā bhrātaraḥ pañca pāṇḍavāḥ taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ puraskṛtya pāñcālyāśca svayaṃvaram / prayayurdraupadīṃ draṣṭuṃ taṃ ca deśaṃ mahotsavam
ce_text: tatas te naraśārdūlā bhrātaraḥ pañca pāṇḍavāḥ / prayayur draupadīṃ draṣṭuṃ taṃ ca devamahotsavam

vulgate_text: kanyādānāttu śaraṇaṃ so'manyata mahīpatiḥ yajñasenasya kāmastu pāṇḍavāya kirīṭine
ce_text: yajñasenasya kāmas tu pāṇḍavāya kirīṭine / kṛṣṇāṃ dadyām iti sadā na caitad vivṛṇoti saḥ

vulgate_text: upopaviṣṭā mañceṣu draṣṭukāmāḥ svayaṃvaram / brāhmaṇāśca mahābhāgā deśebhyaḥ samupāgaman
ce_text: brāhmaṇāś ca mahābhāgā deśebhyaḥ samupāgaman / te 'bhyarcitā rājagaṇā drupadena mahātmanā

vulgate_text: brāhmaṇaireva sahitāḥ pāṇḍavāḥ samupāviśan / trayastriṃśatsurāḥ sarve vimānairvyomnyavasthitāḥ
ce_text: brāhmaṇais te ca sahitāḥ pāṇḍavāḥ samupāviśan / ṛddhiṃ pāñcālarājasya paśyantas tām anuttamām

vulgate_text: tasthau vyūhya mahānīkaṃ pālitaṃ dṛḍhadhanvibhiḥ āplutāṅgīṃ suvasanāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām
ce_text: vartamāne samāje tu ramaṇīye 'hni ṣoḍaśe / āplutāṅgī suvasanā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā

vulgate_text: mālāṃ ca samupādāya kāñcanīṃ samalaṅkṛtām āgatāṃ dadṛśuḥ sarve raṅgabhūmimalaṅkṛtām
ce_text: vīrakāṃsyam upādāya kāñcanaṃ samalaṃkṛtam / avatīrṇā tato raṅgaṃ draupadī bharatarṣabha

vulgate_text: niḥśabde tu kṛte tasmindhṛṣṭadyumno viśāṃpate / kṛṣṇāmādāya vidhivanmeghadundubhiniḥsvanaḥ
ce_text: niḥśabde tu kṛte tasmin dhṛṣṭadyumno viśāṃ pate / raṅgamadhyagatas tatra meghagambhīrayā girā / vākyam uccair jagādedaṃ ślakṣṇam arthavad uttamam

vulgate_text: idaṃ dhanurlakṣyamime ca bāṇāḥ śṛṇvantu me bhūpatayaḥ sametāḥ / chidreṇa yantrasya masarpayadhvaṃ śaraiḥ śitairvyomacarairdaśārdhaiḥ
ce_text: idaṃ dhanur lakṣyam ime ca bāṇāḥ śṛṇvantu me pārthivāḥ sarva eva / yantracchidreṇābhyatikramya lakṣyaṃ samarpayadhvaṃ khagamair daśārdhaiḥ

vulgate_text: sahadevajayatsenau meghasandhiśca pārthivaḥ / virāṭaḥ saha putrābhyāṃ śaṅkhenaivottareṇa ca
ce_text: virāṭaḥ saha putrābhyāṃ śaṅkhenaivottareṇa ca / vārdhakṣemiḥ suvarcāś ca senābinduś ca pārthivaḥ

vulgate_text: bṛhadbalaḥ suṣeṇaśca śibirauśīnastathā / paṭaccaranihantā ca kārūṣādhipatistathā
ce_text: sudakṣiṇaś ca kāmbojo dṛḍhadhanvā ca kauravaḥ / bṛhadbalaḥ suṣeṇaś ca śibir auśīnaras tathā

vulgate_text: śiśupālakhca vikrānto jarāsandhastathaiva ca / ete cānye ca bahavo nānājanapadeśvarāḥ
ce_text: ete cānye ca bahavo nānājanapadeśvarāḥ / tvadartham āgatā bhadre kṣatriyāḥ prathitā bhuvi

vulgate_text: tvadarthamāgatā bhadre kṣatriyāḥ prathitā bhuvi ete bhetsyanti vikrāntāstvadarthe lakṣyamuttamam / vidhyate ya idaṃ lakṣyaṃ varayethāḥ śubhe'dya tam
ce_text: ete vetsyanti vikrāntās tvadarthaṃ lakṣyam uttamam / vidhyeta ya imaṃ lakṣyaṃ varayethāḥ śubhe 'dya tam

vulgate_text: viceṣṭamānā dharaṇītalasthā yathābalaṃ śaikṣyaguṇakramāśca / gataujasaḥ snastakirīṭahārā viniḥśvasantaḥ śamayāṃbabhūvuḥ
ce_text: te vikramantaḥ sphuratā dṛḍhena niṣkṛṣyamāṇā dhanuṣā narendrāḥ / viceṣṭamānā dharaṇītalasthā dīnā adṛśyanta vibhagnacittāḥ

vulgate_text: dhanuṣo'bhyāśamāgatya tasthau giririvācalaḥ / dhanurāropyamāṇaṃ tu sarṣamātre'bhyatāḍayat
ce_text: evaṃ teṣāṃ vilapatāṃ viprāṇāṃ vividhā giraḥ / arjuno dhanuṣo 'bhyāśe tasthau girir ivācalaḥ

vulgate_text: siṃhakhelagatiḥ śrīmānmattanāgendravikramaḥ / saṃbhāvyamasminkarmedamutsāhāccānumīyate
ce_text: saṃbhāvyam asmin karmedam utsāhāc cānumīyate / śaktir asya mahotsāhā na hy aśaktaḥ svayaṃ vrajet

vulgate_text: durbalā api viprā hi balīyāṃsaḥ svetajasā / brāhmaṇo nāvamantavyaḥ sadasadvā samācaran
ce_text: brāhmaṇo nāvamantavyaḥ sad vāsad vā samācaran / sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ mahad dhrasvaṃ karma yat samupāgatam

vulgate_text: sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ mahaddhrasvaṃ karma yatsamupāgatam / jāmadagnyena rāmeṇa nirjitāḥ kṣatriyā yudhi
ce_text: brāhmaṇo nāvamantavyaḥ sad vāsad vā samācaran / sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ mahad dhrasvaṃ karma yat samupāgatam

vulgate_text: āropayatu śīghraṃ vai tathetyūcurdvijarṣabhāḥ / evaṃ teṣāṃ vilapatāṃ viprāṇāṃ vividhā giraḥ
ce_text: evaṃ teṣāṃ vilapatāṃ viprāṇāṃ vividhā giraḥ / arjuno dhanuṣo 'bhyāśe tasthau girir ivācalaḥ

vulgate_text: arjuno dhanuṣo'bhyāśe tasthau giririvācalaḥ / arjunaḥ pāṇḍavaśreṣṭho dhṛṣṭadyumnamathābravīt
ce_text: evaṃ teṣāṃ vilapatāṃ viprāṇāṃ vividhā giraḥ / arjuno dhanuṣo 'bhyāśe tasthau girir ivācalaḥ

vulgate_text: praṇamya śirasā devamīnaṃ varadaṃ prabhum / kṛṣṇaṃ ca manasā kṛtvā jagṛhe cārjuno dhanuḥ
ce_text: sa tad dhanuḥ parikramya pradakṣiṇam athākarot / praṇamya śirasā hṛṣṭo jagṛhe ca paraṃtapaḥ

vulgate_text: tadarjuno vīryavatāṃ sadarpastadaindririndrāvarajaprabhāvaḥ / sajyaṃ ca cakre nimiṣāntareṇa śarāṃśca jagrāha daśārdasaṅkhyān
ce_text: sajyaṃ ca cakre nimiṣāntareṇa śarāṃś ca jagrāha daśārdhasaṃkhyān / vivyādha lakṣyaṃ nipapāta tac ca chidreṇa bhūmau sahasātividdham

vulgate_text: viddhaṃ tu lakṣyaṃ prasamīkṣya kṛṣṇā pārthaṃ ca śakrapratimaṃ nirīkṣya / svabhyastarūpāpi naveva nityaṃ vināpi hāsaṃ hasatīva kanyā
ce_text: viddhaṃ tu lakṣyaṃ prasamīkṣya kṛṣṇā pārthaṃ ca śakrapratimaṃ nirīkṣya / ādāya śuklaṃ varamālyadāma jagāma kuntīsutam utsmayantī

vulgate_text: madādṛte'pi skhalatīva bhāvairvācā vinā vyāharatīva dṛṣṭyā / ādāya śuklaṃ varamālyadāma jagāma kuntīsutamutsmayantī
ce_text: viddhaṃ tu lakṣyaṃ prasamīkṣya kṛṣṇā pārthaṃ ca śakrapratimaṃ nirīkṣya / ādāya śuklaṃ varamālyadāma jagāma kuntīsutam utsmayantī

vulgate_text: avaropyeha vṛkṣastu phalakāle nipātyate / nihanmainaṃ durātmānaṃ yoyamasmānna manyate
ce_text: nihanmainaṃ durātmānaṃ yo 'yam asmān na manyate / na hy arhaty eṣa satkāraṃ nāpi vṛddhakramaṃ guṇaiḥ

vulgate_text: tatprekṣya karmātimanuṣyabuddhirjiṣṇuḥ sa hi bhrāturacintyakarmā / visiṣmiye cāpi bhayaṃ vihāya tasthau dhanurgṛhya mahendrakarmā
ce_text: tat prekṣya karmātimanuṣyabuddher jiṣṇoḥ sahabhrātur acintyakarmā / dāmodaro bhrātaram ugravīryaṃ halāyudhaṃ vākyam idaṃ babhāṣe

vulgate_text: yastveṣa vṛkṣaṃ tarasā'vabhajya rājñāṃ nikāre sahasā pravṛttaḥ / vṛkodarānnānya ihaitadadya kartuṃ samarthaḥ samare pṛthivyām
ce_text: ya eṣa vṛkṣaṃ tarasāvarujya rājñāṃ vikāre sahasā nivṛttaḥ / vṛkodaro nānya ihaitad adya kartuṃ samartho bhuvi martyadharmā

vulgate_text: tataḥ karṇamukhāndṛṣṭvā kṣatriyānyuddhadurmadān / saṃpetaturabhītau tau gajau pratigajāniva
ce_text: tataḥ karṇamukhān kruddhān kṣatriyāṃs tān ruṣotthitān / saṃpetatur abhītau tau gajau pratigajān iva

vulgate_text: sthito'smyadya raṇe jetuṃ tvāṃ vai vīra sthiro bhava / nirjito'smīti vā brūhi tato vraja yathāsukham
ce_text: brāhme pauraṃdare cāstre niṣṭhito guruśāsanāt / sthito 'smy adya raṇe jetuṃ tvāṃ vīrāvicalo bhava
