vulgate_text: tāṃ ca māyāṃ tadā dṛṣṭā ghorāṃ nāgena vañcitaḥ / dvidhā tridhā ca khagatānprāṇinaḥ pāṇḍavocchinat
ce_text: tāṃ ca māyāṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā ghorāṃ nāgena vañcitaḥ / dvidhā tridhā ca ciccheda khagatān eva bhārata

vulgate_text: devarājo'pi taṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃrabdhaṃ samare'rjunam / svamastramasṛjattīvraṃ chādayitvā'khilaṃ nabhaḥ
ce_text: devarāḍ api taṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃrabdham iva phalgunam / svam astram asṛjad dīptaṃ yat tatānākhilaṃ nabhaḥ

vulgate_text: tato'śanimuco ghorāṃstaḍitstanitaniḥsvanān / tadvighātārthamasṛjadarjuno'pyastramuttamam
ce_text: tadvighātārtham asṛjad arjuno 'py astram uttamam / vāyavyam evābhimantrya pratipattiviśāradaḥ

vulgate_text: sicyamāno vasaughaistaiḥ prāṇināṃ dehaniḥsṛtaiḥ / prajajvālātha so'rciṣmānsvanādaiḥ pūrayañjagat
ce_text: niṣpratīkārahṛṣṭaś ca hutabhug vividhākṛtiḥ / prajajvālātulārciṣmān svanādaiḥ pūrayañ jagat

vulgate_text: tāṃścakarta śaraiḥ pārthaḥ saroṣāgnisamukṣitaiḥ / viviśuścāpi taṃ dīptaṃ dehābhāvāya pāvakam
ce_text: tāṃś cakarta śaraiḥ pārthaḥ saroṣān dṛśya khecarān / vivaśāś cāpatan dīptaṃ dehābhāvāya pāvakam

vulgate_text: vegenāśanimādāya vajramastraṃ ca so'sṛjat / hatāvetāviti prāha surānasurasūdanaḥ
ce_text: aśaniṃ gṛhya tarasā vajram astram avāsṛjat / hatāv etāv iti prāha surān asurasūdanaḥ

vulgate_text: kāladaṇḍaṃ yamo rājan gadāṃ caiva dhaneśvaraḥ / pāśāṃśca tatra varuṇo vicitrāṃ ca tathā'śanim
ce_text: kāladaṇḍaṃ yamo rājā śibikāṃ ca dhaneśvaraḥ / pāśaṃ ca varuṇas tatra vicakraṃ ca tathā śivaḥ

vulgate_text: skandaḥ śaktiṃ samādāya tasthau merurivācalaḥ / oṣadhīrdīpyamānāśca jagṛhāte'svināvapi
ce_text: oṣadhīr dīpyamānāś ca jagṛhāte 'śvināv api / jagṛhe ca dhanur dhātā musalaṃ ca jayas tathā

vulgate_text: abhītau yudhi durdharṣau tasthatuḥ sajjakārmukau / āgacchatastato devānubhau yuddhaviśāradau
ce_text: tathā tu dṛṣṭvā saṃrabdhaṃ śakraṃ devaiḥ sahācyutau / abhītau yudhi durdharṣau tasthatuḥ sajjakārmukau

vulgate_text: utpātanādaśabdena trāsitā iva cābhavan / te vanaṃ prasamīkṣyātha dahyamānamanekadhā
ce_text: taṃ dāvaṃ samudīkṣantaḥ kṛṣṇau cābhyudyatāyudhau / utpātanādaśabdena saṃtrāsita ivābhavan

vulgate_text: cakraṃ vyasṛjadatyugraṃ teṣāṃ nāśāya keśavaḥ / tenārtā jātayaḥ kṣudrāḥ sadānavaniśācarāḥ
ce_text: svatejobhāsvaraṃ cakram utsasarja janārdanaḥ / tena tā jātayaḥ kṣudrāḥ sadānavaniśācarāḥ / nikṛttāḥ śataśaḥ sarvā nipetur analaṃ kṣaṇāt

vulgate_text: nikṛttāḥ śataśaḥ sarvā nipeturanalaṃ kṣaṇāt / tatrādṛśyanta te daityāḥ kṛṣṇacakravidāritāḥ
ce_text: svatejobhāsvaraṃ cakram utsasarja janārdanaḥ / tena tā jātayaḥ kṣudrāḥ sadānavaniśācarāḥ / nikṛttāḥ śataśaḥ sarvā nipetur analaṃ kṣaṇāt

vulgate_text: chittvānekāni satvāni pāṇimeti punaḥ punaḥ / tathā tu nighnatastasya piśācoragarākṣasān
ce_text: kṣiptaṃ kṣiptaṃ hi tac cakraṃ kṛṣṇasyāmitraghātinaḥ / hatvānekāni sattvāni pāṇim eti punaḥ punaḥ

vulgate_text: nāśaknuvañśamayituṃ tadā'bhūvanparāṅmukhāḥ / śatakratustu saṃprekṣya vimukhānamarāṃstathā
ce_text: tayor balāt paritrātuṃ taṃ dāvaṃ tu yadā surāḥ / nāśaknuvañ śamayituṃ tadābhūvan parāṅmukhāḥ

vulgate_text: babhūva mudito rājanpraśaṃsankeśavārjunau / nivṛtteṣvatha deveṣu vāguvācāśarīriṇī
ce_text: nivṛtteṣu tu deveṣu vāg uvācāśarīriṇī / śatakratum abhiprekṣya mahāgambhīraniḥsvanā

vulgate_text: dāhakāle khāṇḍavasya kurukṣetraṃ gato hyasau / na ca śakyau yudhā jetuṃ kathaṃcidapi vāsava
ce_text: na te sakhā saṃnihitas takṣakaḥ pannagottamaḥ / dāhakāle khāṇḍavasya kurukṣetraṃ gato hy asau

vulgate_text: vāsudevārjunāvetau nibodha vacanānmama / naranārāyaṇāvetau pūrvadevau divi śrutau
ce_text: naranārāyaṇau devau tāv etau viśrutau divi / bhavān apy abhijānāti yadvīryau yatparākramau

vulgate_text: sahitāḥ senayā rājannanujagmuḥ purandaram / devarājaṃ tadā yāntaṃ saha devairavekṣya tu
ce_text: taṃ prasthitaṃ mahātmānaṃ samavekṣya divaukasaḥ / tvaritāḥ sahitā rājann anujagmuḥ śatakratum

vulgate_text: nirīkṣitumamoghāstraṃ yoddhuṃ cāpi kuto raṇe / śataṃ caikena vivyādha śatenaikaṃ patatriṇām
ce_text: nāśakaṃs tatra bhūtāni mahānty api raṇe 'rjunam / nirīkṣitum amogheṣuṃ kariṣyanti kuto raṇam

vulgate_text: rurudurvāraṇāścaiva tathā mṛgatarakṣavaḥ / tena śabdena vitresurgaṅgodadhicarā jhaṣāḥ
ce_text: bhūtasaṃghasahasrāś ca dīnāś cakrur mahāsvanam / ruruvur vāraṇāś caiva tathaiva mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ / tena śabdena vitresur gaṅgodadhicarā jhaṣāḥ

vulgate_text: peturanye mahākāyāḥ pradīpte vasuretasi / samāṃsarudhiraudhaiśca vasābhiścāpi tarpitaḥ
ce_text: te vibhinnaśirodehāś cakravegād gatāsavaḥ / petur āsye mahākāyā dīptasya vasuretasaḥ

vulgate_text: uparyākāśago bhūtvā vidhūmaḥ samapadyata / dīptākṣo dīptajihvaśca saṃpradīptamahānanaḥ
ce_text: dīptākṣo dīptajihvaś ca dīptavyāttamahānanaḥ / dīptordhvakeśaḥ piṅgākṣaḥ piban prāṇabhṛtāṃ vasām

vulgate_text: abhidhāvārjunetyevaṃ mayastrāhīti cābravīt / tasya bhītasvanaṃ śrutvā mā bhairiti dhanaṃjayaḥ
ce_text: tasya bhītasvanaṃ śrutvā mā bhair iti dhanaṃjayaḥ / pratyuvāca mayaṃ pārtho jīvayann iva bhārata

vulgate_text: pratyuvāca mayaṃ pārtho jīvayanniva bhārata / taṃ na bhetavyamityāha mayaṃ pārtho dayāparaḥ
ce_text: tasya bhītasvanaṃ śrutvā mā bhair iti dhanaṃjayaḥ / pratyuvāca mayaṃ pārtho jīvayann iva bhārata

vulgate_text: yadarthaṃ śārṅgakānagnirna dadāha tathā gate / tatte sarvaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathā bhūtamarindama
ce_text: yadarthaṃ śārṅgakān agnir na dadāha tathāgate / tat te sarvaṃ yathāvṛttaṃ kathayiṣyāmi bhārata

vulgate_text: na jahau putraśokārtā jaritā khāṇḍave sutān / babhāra caitānsaṃjātānsvavṛttyā snehaviklavā
ce_text: tena tyaktān asaṃtyājyān ṛṣīn aṇḍagatān vane / nājahat putrakān ārtā jaritā khāṇḍave nṛpa / babhāra caitān saṃjātān svavṛttyā snehaviklavā

vulgate_text: tvayi havyaṃ ca kavyaṃ ca yathāvatsaṃpratiṣṭhitam / tvameva dahano deva tvaṃ dhātā tvaṃ bṛhaspatiḥ
ce_text: tvayāpo vihitāḥ pūrvaṃ tvayi sarvam idaṃ jagat / tvayi havyaṃ ca kavyaṃ ca yathāvat saṃpratiṣṭhitam

vulgate_text: trāsayaṃścāyamāyāti lelihāno mahīruhān / ajātapakṣāśca sutā na śaktāḥ saraṇe mama
ce_text: ime ca māṃ karṣayanti śiśavo mandacetasaḥ / abarhāś caraṇair hīnāḥ pūrveṣāṃ naḥ parāyaṇam / trāsayaṃś cāyam āyāti lelihāno mahīruhān

vulgate_text: ādāya ca na śaknomi putrāṃstaritumātmanā / na ca tyaktumahaṃ śaktā hṛdayaṃ dūyatīva me
ce_text: na ca tyaktum ahaṃ śaktā hṛdayaṃ dūyatīva me / kaṃ nu jahyām ahaṃ putraṃ kam ādāya vrajāmy aham

vulgate_text: asmādbilānniṣpatitamākhuṃ śyeno jahāra tam / kṣudraṃ padbhyāṃ gṛhītvā ca yāto nātra bhayaṃ hi vaḥ
ce_text: asmād bilān niṣpatitaṃ śyena ākhuṃ jahāra tam / kṣudraṃ gṛhītvā pādābhyāṃ bhayaṃ na bhavitā tataḥ

vulgate_text: ahaṃ vegena taṃ yāntamadrākṣaṃ patatāṃ varam / bilādākhuṃ samādāya śyenaṃ putrā mahābalam
ce_text: ahaṃ vai śyenam āyāntam adrākṣaṃ bilam antikāt / saṃcarantaṃ samādāya jahārākhuṃ bilād balī

vulgate_text: ahaṃ tamabhijānāmi hṛtaṃ śyenena mūṣikam / nāsti vo'tra bhayaṃ putrāḥ kriyatāṃ vacanaṃ mama
ce_text: ahaṃ hi taṃ prajānāmi hṛtaṃ śyenena mūṣakam / ata eva bhayaṃ nāsti kriyatāṃ vacanaṃ mama

vulgate_text: tatastaṃ jvalitaṃ dṛṣṭvā jvalanaṃ te vihaṅgamāḥ vyathitāḥ karuṇā vācaḥ śrāvayāmāsurantikāt / jaritāristato vākyaṃ śrāvayāmāsa pāvakam
ce_text: te śārṅgā jvalanaṃ dṛṣṭvā jvalitaṃ svena tejasā / jaritāris tato vācaṃ śrāvayām āsa pāvakam

vulgate_text: yastu kṛcchramanuprāptaṃ vicetā nāvabudhyate / sakṛcchrakāle vyathito na śreyo vindate mahat
ce_text: yas tu kṛcchram asaṃprāptaṃ vicetā nāvabudhyate / sa kṛcchrakāle vyathito na prajānāti kiṃ cana

vulgate_text: hiraṇyaretāstvarito jalannāyāti naḥ kṣayam / saptajihvānanaḥ krūro lihāno visarpati
ce_text: hiraṇyaretās tvarito jvalann āyāti naḥ kṣayam / saptajihvo 'nalaḥ kṣāmo lelihānopasarpati

vulgate_text: mātā praṇaṣṭā pitaraṃ na vidmaḥ pakṣā jātā nai no dhūmaketo / na nastrātā vidyate vai tvadanyastasmādasmāṃstrāhi bālāṃstvamagne
ce_text: mātā prapannā pitaraṃ na vidmaḥ pakṣāś ca no na prajātābjaketo / na nas trātā vidyate 'gne tvad anyas tasmād dhi naḥ parirakṣaikavīra

vulgate_text: mandapālo'ñapi kauravyaṃ cintayāmāsa putrakān / uktvā'pi ca sa tigmāṃśuṃ naiva śarmādhigacchati
ce_text: mandapālo 'pi kauravya cintayānaḥ sutāṃs tadā / uktavān apy aśītāṃśuṃ naiva sa sma na tapyate

vulgate_text: kathamuḍḍīyane'śaktānpatane ca mamātmajān / santapyamānā bahudhā vāśamānā pradhāvatī
ce_text: kathaṃ nu saraṇe 'śaktān patane ca mamātmajān / saṃtapyamānā abhito vāśamānābhidhāvatī

vulgate_text: palo na tāṃ vācamuktvā mithyā kariṣyati / ndhukṛtye na tena te svastha mānasam
ce_text: lokapālo 'nṛtāṃ vācaṃ na tu vaktā kathaṃ cana / samarthās te ca vaktāro na te teṣv asti mānasam

vulgate_text: eṣa hi prajvalannagnirlelihānī mahīruhān / āvigne hṛdi santāpaṃ janayatyaśivaṃ mama
ce_text: eṣa hi jvalamāno 'gnir lelihāno mahīruhān / dveṣyaṃ hi hṛdi saṃtāpaṃ janayaty aśivaṃ mama

vulgate_text: sā tānkuśalinaḥ sarvānvimuktāñjātavedasaḥ / rorūyamāṇāndadṛśe vane putrānnirāmayān
ce_text: sā tān kuśalinaḥ sarvān nirmuktāñ jātavedasaḥ / rorūyamāṇā kṛpaṇā sutān dṛṣṭavatī vane

vulgate_text: jyeṣṭhaḥ sutaste kata katamastasya cānujaḥ / madhyamaḥ katamaścaiva yānkatamaśca te
ce_text: jyeṣṭhaḥ sutas te katamaḥ katamas tadanantaraḥ / madhyamaḥ katamaḥ putraḥ kaniṣṭhaḥ katamaś ca te

vulgate_text: evaṃ bruvantaṃ duḥkhākaṃ mā na pratibhāṣase kṛtavānasmi havyānaiva śāntimito labhe / evamuktvā tu tāṃ mandapālastadā'spṛśat
ce_text: evaṃ bruvantaṃ duḥkhārtaṃ kiṃ māṃ na pratibhāṣase / kṛtavān asmi havyāśe naiva śāntim ito labhe

vulgate_text: kiṃ nu jyeṣṭhena te kimanantarajena te / kiṃ vā madhyamajātena kiṃ kaniṣṭhena vā punaḥ
ce_text: kiṃ te jyeṣṭhe sute kāryaṃ kim anantarajena vā / kiṃ ca te madhyame kāryaṃ kiṃ kaniṣṭhe tapasvini

vulgate_text: arundhatī mahātmānaṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ paryaśaṅkata / viśuddhabhāvamatyantaṃ sadā priyahite ratam
ce_text: viśuddhabhāvam atyantaṃ sadā priyahite ratam / saptarṣimadhyagaṃ vīram avamene ca taṃ munim

vulgate_text: yuṣmākamapavargārthaṃ tī jvalano mayā / agninā ca tathetyetijñātaṃ mahātmanā
ce_text: yuṣmākaṃ parirakṣārthaṃ vijñapto jvalano mayā / agninā ca tathety evaṃ pūrvam eva pratiśrutam

vulgate_text: evamāśvāsitānputrānbhāryāmādāya sa dvijaḥ / mandapālastato deśādanyaṃ deśaṃ jagāma ha
ce_text: evam āśvāsya putrān sa bhāryāṃ cādāya bhārata / mandapālas tato deśād anyaṃ deśaṃ jagāma ha

vulgate_text: tato'ñantarikṣādbhagavānavatīrya purandaraḥ / marudgaṇairvṛtaḥ pārthaṃ keśavaṃ cedamabravīt
ce_text: tato 'ntarikṣād bhagavān avatīrya sureśvaraḥ / marudgaṇavṛtaḥ pārthaṃ mādhavaṃ cābravīd idam

vulgate_text: pārthastu varayāmāsa śakrādastrāṇi sarvaśaḥ / pradātuṃ tacca śakrastu kālaṃ cakre mahādyutiḥ
ce_text: pārthas tu varayām āsa śakrād astrāṇi sarvaśaḥ / grahītuṃ tac ca śakro 'sya tadā kālaṃ cakāra ha

vulgate_text: vāsudevo'pi jagrāha prītiṃ pārthena śāśvatīm / dadau surapatiścaiva varaṃ kṛṣṇāya dhīmate
ce_text: vāsudevo 'pi jagrāha prītiṃ pārthena śāśvatīm / dadau ca tasmai devendras taṃ varaṃ prītimāṃs tadā

vulgate_text: pāvakaśca tadā dāvaṃ dagdhvasamṛgapakṣiṇam / ahobhirekaviṃśadbhirvirarāgsutarpitaḥ
ce_text: pāvakaś cāpi taṃ dāvaṃ dagdhvā samṛgapakṣiṇam / ahāni pañca caikaṃ ca virarāma sutarpitaḥ

vulgate_text: tato'bravīnmayaḥ pārthaṃ vāsudevasya sannidhau / pāṇḍavena paritrātastatkṛtaṃ pratyanusmaran
ce_text: tato 'bravīn mayaḥ pārthaṃ vāsudevasya saṃnidhau / prāñjaliḥ ślakṣṇayā vācā pūjayitvā punaḥ punaḥ

vulgate_text: tvayā trāto'smi kaunteya brūhi kiṃ karavāṇi te / ahaṃ hi viśvakarmā vai asurāṇāṃ parantapa
ce_text: asmāc ca kṛṣṇāt saṃkruddhāt pāvakāc ca didhakṣataḥ / tvayā trāto 'smi kaunteya brūhi kiṃ karavāṇi te

vulgate_text: propakārādarthaṃ hi nādāsyāmīti me vratam / yuktametattvayi vibho yadāttha puruṣarṣabha
ce_text: yuktam etat tvayi vibho yathāttha puruṣarṣabha / prītipūrvam ahaṃ kiṃ cit kartum icchāmi bhārata

vulgate_text: so'haṃ vai tvatkṛte kiñcitkartumicchāmi pāṇḍava / dānavānāṃ purā pārtha prāsādā hi mayā kṛtāḥ
ce_text: ahaṃ hi viśvakarmā vai dānavānāṃ mahākaviḥ / so 'haṃ vai tvatkṛte kiṃ cit kartum icchāmi pāṇḍava

vulgate_text: tato vicintya manasā lokanāthaḥ prajāpitaḥ / codayāmāsa taṃ kṛṣṇaḥ sabhā vai kriyatāmiti
ce_text: codayām āsa taṃ kṛṣṇaḥ sabhā vai kriyatām iti / dharmarājasya daiteya yādṛśīm iha manyase

vulgate_text: yadi tvaṃ kartukāmo'si priyaṃ śilpavatāṃ vara / dharmarājasya dayitāṃ yādṛśīmiha manyase
ce_text: codayām āsa taṃ kṛṣṇaḥ sabhā vai kriyatām iti / dharmarājasya daiteya yādṛśīm iha manyase

vulgate_text: sa kṛtvā sarvakāryāṇi pratasthe tasthupāṃ varaḥ / upetya sa yaduśreṣṭho bāhyakakṣādvinirgataḥ
ce_text: arcayām āsa devāṃś ca dvijāṃś ca yadupuṃgavaḥ / mālyajapyanamaskārair gandhair uccāvacair api / sa kṛtvā sarvakāryāṇi pratasthe tasthuṣāṃ varaḥ

vulgate_text: rukmadaṇḍaṃ bṛhadbāhurvidudhāva pradakṣiṇam / tathaiva bhīmaseno'pi rathamāruhya vīryavān
ce_text: upāruhyārjunaś cāpi cāmaravyajanaṃ sitam / rukmadaṇḍaṃ bṛhan mūrdhni dudhāvābhipradakṣiṇam

vulgate_text: anvīyamānaḥ śuśubhe śiṣyairiva guruḥ priyaiḥ / abhimanyuṃ ca saubhadraṃ vṛddhaiḥ parivṛtastathā
ce_text: sa tathā bhrātṛbhiḥ sārdhaṃ keśavaḥ paravīrahā / anugamyamānaḥ śuśubhe śiṣyair iva guruḥ priyaiḥ

vulgate_text: rathamāropya niryāto dhaumyo brāhmaṇapuṅgavaḥ indraprasthamatikramya krośamātraṃ mahādyutiḥ / pārthamāmantrya govindaḥ pariṣvajya supīḍitam
ce_text: pārtham āmantrya govindaḥ pariṣvajya ca pīḍitam / yudhiṣṭhiraṃ pūjayitvā bhīmasenaṃ yamau tathā

vulgate_text: tatastaiḥ saṃvidaṃ kṛtvā yathāvanmadhusūdanaḥ / nivartya ca tathā kṛcchrātpāṇḍavānsapadānugān
ce_text: pariṣvakto bhṛśaṃ tābhyāṃ yamābhyām abhivāditaḥ / tatas taiḥ saṃvidaṃ kṛtvā yathāvan madhusūdanaḥ

vulgate_text: svāṃ purīṃ prayayau hṛṣṭo yathā śakro'marāvatīm / locanairanujagmuste tamādṛṣṭipathāttadā
ce_text: locanair anujagmus te tam ā dṛṣṭipathāt tadā / manobhir anujagmus te kṛṣṇaṃ prītisamanvayāt

vulgate_text: uttareṇa tu kailāsaṃ mainākaṃ parvataṃ prati / yiyakṣamāṇeṣu purā dānaveṣu mayā kṛtam
ce_text: uttareṇa tu kailāsaṃ mainākaṃ parvataṃ prati / yakṣyamāṇeṣu sarveṣu dānaveṣu tadā mayā / kṛtaṃ maṇimayaṃ bhāṇḍaṃ ramyaṃ bindusaraḥ prati

vulgate_text: manaḥ prahlādinīṃ citrāṃ sarvaratnavibhūṣitām / asti bindusārasyugrā gadā ca kurunandana
ce_text: tataḥ sabhāṃ kariṣyāmi pāṇḍavāya yaśasvine / manaḥprahlādinīṃ citrāṃ sarvaratnavibhūṣitām

vulgate_text: tatra gatvā sa jagrāha gadāṃ śaṅkhaṃ ca bhārata tasmādgirerupādāya śilāḥ surucirāvahāḥ / sphāṭikaṃ ca sabhādravyaṃ yadāsīdvṛṣaparvaṇaḥ
ce_text: tatra gatvā sa jagrāha gadāṃ śaṅkhaṃ ca bhārata / sphāṭikaṃ ca sabhādravyaṃ yad āsīd vṛṣaparvaṇaḥ / kiṃkaraiḥ saha rakṣobhir agṛhṇāt sarvam eva tat

vulgate_text: kiṅkaraiḥ saha rakṣobhiryadarakṣanmahaddhanam / tadagṛhṇānmayastatra gatvā sarvaṃ mahā'suraḥ
ce_text: tatra gatvā sa jagrāha gadāṃ śaṅkhaṃ ca bhārata / sphāṭikaṃ ca sabhādravyaṃ yad āsīd vṛṣaparvaṇaḥ / kiṃkaraiḥ saha rakṣobhir agṛhṇāt sarvam eva tat

vulgate_text: sarvartuguṇasampannāṃ divyarūpāmalaṅkṛtām tarpayitvā dvijaśreṣṭhānpāyasena sahasraśaḥ / sabhā ca sā mahārāja śātakumbhamayadrumā
ce_text: sabhā tu sā mahārāja śātakumbhamayadrumā / daśa kiṣkusahasrāṇi samantād āyatābhavat

vulgate_text: bhrājamānā tathā'tyarthaṃ dadhāra paramaṃ vapuḥ / abhighnatīva prabhayā prabhāmarkasya bhāsvarām
ce_text: pratighnatīva prabhayā prabhām arkasya bhāsvarām / prababhau jvalamāneva divyā divyena varcasā

vulgate_text: prababhau jvalamāneva divyā divyena varcasā navameghapratīkāśā divamākṛtya viṣṭhitā / āyatā vipulā ramyā vipāpmā vigataklamā
ce_text: nagameghapratīkāśā divam āvṛtya viṣṭhitā / āyatā vipulā ślakṣṇā vipāpmā vigataklamā

vulgate_text: ahataiścaiva vāsobhirmālyairuccāvacairapi / tarpayāmāsa viprendrānnānādigbhyaḥ samāgatān
ce_text: ghṛtapāyasena madhunā bhakṣyair mūlaphalais tathā / ahataiś caiva vāsobhir mālyair uccāvacair api

vulgate_text: śrīmānmahātmā dharmātmā muñjaketurvivardhanaḥ saṅgrāmajiddurmukhaśca ugrasenaśca vīryavān
ce_text: tathaiva kṣatriyaśreṣṭhā dharmarājam upāsate / śrīmān mahātmā dharmātmā muñjaketur vivardhanaḥ

vulgate_text: aṅgo vaṅgaḥ sumitraśca śaibyaścāmitrakarśanaḥ / kirātarājaḥ sumanā yavanādhipatistathā
ce_text: kirātarājaḥ sumanā yavanādhipatis tathā / cāṇūro devarātaś ca bhojo bhīmarathaś ca yaḥ

vulgate_text: upāsate sabhāyāṃ sma kuntīputraṃ yudhiṣṭhiram / arjunaṃ ye va saṃśritya rājaputrā mahābalāḥ
ce_text: arjunaṃ cāpi saṃśritya rājaputrā mahābalāḥ / aśikṣanta dhanurvedaṃ rauravājinavāsasaḥ

vulgate_text: raukmiṇeyaśca sāmbaśca yuyudhānaśca sātyakiḥ / sudharmā cāniruddhaśca śaivyaśca narapuṅgavaḥ
ce_text: tatraiva śikṣitā rājan kumārā vṛṣṇinandanāḥ / raukmiṇeyaś ca sāmbaś ca yuyudhānaś ca sātyakiḥ

vulgate_text: upāsate mahātmānamāsīnaṃ saptaviṃśatiḥ / citrasenaḥ sahāmātyo gandharvāpsarasastathā
ce_text: citrasenaḥ sahāmātyo gandharvāpsarasas tathā / gītavāditrakuśalāḥ śamyātālaviśāradāḥ

vulgate_text: sabhāsthānpāṇḍavāndraṣṭuṃ prīyamāṇo manojavaḥ / jayāśīrbhistu taṃ vipro dharmarājānamārcayat
ce_text: pārijātena rājendra raivatena ca dhīmatā / sumukhena ca saumyena devarṣir amitadyutiḥ / sabhāsthān pāṇḍavān draṣṭuṃ prīyamāṇo manojavaḥ

vulgate_text: gāṃ caiva madhuparkaṃ ca sampradāyārghyameva ca / arcayāmāsa ratnaiśca sarvakāmaiśca dharmavit
ce_text: tadarham āsanaṃ tasmai saṃpradāya yathāvidhi / arcayām āsa ratnaiś ca sarvakāmaiś ca dharmavit

vulgate_text: mitrodāsīnaśatrūṇāṃ kaccidvetsi cikīrṣitam / kaccitsandhiṃ yathākālaṃ vigrahaṃ copasevase
ce_text: kaccit saṃdhiṃ yathākālaṃ vigrahaṃ copasevase / kaccid vṛttim udāsīne madhyame cānuvartase

vulgate_text: kaccidvṛttimudāsīne madhyame cānumanyase / kaccidātmasamā vṛddhāḥ śuddhāḥ sambodhanakṣamāḥ
ce_text: kaccit saṃdhiṃ yathākālaṃ vigrahaṃ copasevase / kaccid vṛttim udāsīne madhyame cānuvartase

vulgate_text: kaccitsaṃvṛtamantraiste amātyaiḥ śāstrakovidaiḥ / rāṣṭraṃ surakṣitaṃ tāta śatrubhirna vilupyate
ce_text: vijayo mantramūlo hi rājñāṃ bhavati bhārata / susaṃvṛto mantradhanair amātyaiḥ śāstrakovidaiḥ

vulgate_text: āptairalubdhaiḥ kramikaiste ca kaccidanuṣṭhitāḥ / kaccidrājankṛtānyeva kṛtaprāyāṇi vā punaḥ
ce_text: kaccid rājan kṛtāny eva kṛtaprāyāṇi vā punaḥ / vidus te vīra karmāṇi nānavāptāni kāni cit

vulgate_text: yātrāmārabhase diṣṭyā prāptakālamarindama / pārṣṇimūlaṃ ca vijñāya vyavasāyaṃ parājayam
ce_text: pārṣṇimūlaṃ ca vijñāya vyavasāyaṃ parājayam / balasya ca mahārāja dattvā vetanam agrataḥ

vulgate_text: tāṃśca vikramase jetuṃ jitvā ca parirakṣasi kaccidaṣṭāṅgasaṃyuktā caturvidhabalā camūḥ
ce_text: kaccin mūlaṃ dṛḍhaṃ kṛtvā yātrāṃ yāsi viśāṃ pate / tāṃś ca vikramase jetuṃ jitvā ca parirakṣasi

vulgate_text: avihāya mahārāja nihaṃsi samare ripūn kaccitsvapararāṣṭreṣu bahavo'dhikṛtāstava
ce_text: kaccil lavaṃ ca muṣṭiṃ ca pararāṣṭre paraṃtapa / avihāya mahārāja vihaṃsi samare ripūn

vulgate_text: kaccidātyayikaṃ śrutvā tadarthamanucintya ca / priyāṇyanubhavañśeṣe na tvamantaḥ pure nṛpa
ce_text: kaccic cārān niśi śrutvā tat kāryam anucintya ca / priyāṇy anubhavañ śeṣe viditvābhyantaraṃ janam

vulgate_text: niścitānāmanārambhaṃ mantrasyāparirakṣaṇam / maṅgalādyaprayogaṃ ca pratyutthānaṃ ca sarvataḥ
ce_text: ekacintanam arthānām anarthajñaiś ca cintanam / niścitānām anārambhaṃ mantrasyāparirakṣaṇam

vulgate_text: kaccittvaṃ varjayasyetānrājadoṣāṃścaturdaśa / prāyaśoyairvinaśyanti kṛtamūlāpi pārthivaḥ
ce_text: maṅgalyasyāprayogaṃ ca prasaṅgaṃ viṣayeṣu ca / kaccit tvaṃ varjayasy etān rājadoṣāṃś caturdaśa

vulgate_text: brahmaṇaśca sabhāṃ divyāṃ kathayiṣye gataklamām / divyādivyairabhiprāyairupetāṃ viśvarūpiṇīm
ce_text: brahmaṇaś ca sabhāṃ divyāṃ kathayiṣye gataklamām / yadi te śravaṇe buddhir vartate bharatarṣabha

vulgate_text: devaiḥ pitṛgaṇaiḥ sādhyairyajvabhirniyatātmabhiḥ / juṣṭāṃ munigaṇaiḥ śāntairvedayajñaiḥ sadakṣiṇaiḥ / yadi te śravaṇe buddhirvartate bharatarṣabha
ce_text: brahmaṇaś ca sabhāṃ divyāṃ kathayiṣye gataklamām / yadi te śravaṇe buddhir vartate bharatarṣabha

vulgate_text: siddhā devarṣayaścaiva sādhyā devagaṇāstathā / maruttvantaśca sahitā bhāsvanto hemamālinaḥ
ce_text: tasyām upāsate nityaṃ mahātmānaṃ śatakratum / marutaḥ sarvato rājan sarve ca gṛhamedhinaḥ / siddhā devarṣayaś caiva sādhyā devagaṇās tathā

vulgate_text: tejasvinaḥ somasuto viśokā vigatajvarāḥ / parāśaraḥ parvataśca tathā sāvarṇigālavau
ce_text: parāśaraḥ parvataś ca tathā sāvarṇigālavau / śaṅkhaś ca likhitaś caiva tathā gauraśirā muniḥ

vulgate_text: ekataśca dvitaścaiva tritaścaiva mahāmatiḥ śaṅkhaśca likhitaścaiva tathā gauraśirā muniḥ / durvāsāḥ krodhanaḥ śyenastathā dīrghatamā muniḥ
ce_text: parāśaraḥ parvataś ca tathā sāvarṇigālavau / śaṅkhaś ca likhitaś caiva tathā gauraśirā muniḥ

vulgate_text: pavitrapāṇiḥ sāvarṇiryājñavalkyo'tha bhālukiḥ / uddālakaḥ śvetaketustāṇḍo bhāṇḍāyanistathā
ce_text: durvāsāś ca dīrghatapā yājñavalkyo 'tha bhālukiḥ / uddālakaḥ śvetaketus tathā śāṭyāyanaḥ prabhuḥ

vulgate_text: vidyādharāśca rājendra gandharvāśca manoramāḥ / nṛtyavāditragītaiśca hāsyaiśca vividhairapi
ce_text: tathaivāpsaraso rājan gandharvāś ca manoramāḥ / nṛtyavāditragītaiś ca hāsyaiś ca vividhair api / ramayanti sma nṛpate devarājaṃ śatakratum

vulgate_text: bṛhaspatiśca śukraśca nityamāstāṃ hi tatra vai / ete cānye ca bahavo mahātmāno yatavratāḥ
ce_text: ete cānye ca bahavo yatātmāno yatavratāḥ / vimānaiś candrasaṃkāśaiḥ somavat priyadarśanāḥ / brahmaṇo vacanād rājan bhṛguḥ saptarṣayas tathā

vulgate_text: lehyaṃ copyaṃ ca peyaṃ ca hṛdyaṃ svādu manoharam / puṇyagandhāḥ srajastasya nityaṃ kāmaphalā drumāḥ
ce_text: puṇyagandhāḥ srajas tatra nityapuṣpaphaladrumāḥ / rasavanti ca toyāni śītāny uṣṇāni caiva ha

vulgate_text: trasadasyuśca rājarṣiḥ kṛtavīryaḥ śrutaśravāḥ / ariṣṭanemiḥ siddhaśca kṛtavegaḥ kṛtirnimiḥ
ce_text: yayātir nahuṣaḥ pūrur māndhātā somako nṛgaḥ / trasadasyuś ca turayaḥ kṛtavīryaḥ śrutaśravāḥ

vulgate_text: caturaścaḥ sadasyormiḥ kārtavīryaśca pārthivaḥ / bharataḥ surathaścaiva sunītho niśaṭho'nalaḥ
ce_text: aiḍo maruttaḥ kuśikaḥ sāṃkāśyaḥ sāṃkṛtir bhavaḥ / caturaśvaḥ sadaśvormiḥ kārtavīryaś ca pārthivaḥ

vulgate_text: pṛpadaśvo vasumanāḥ kṣupaśca sumahābalaḥ / ruṣadrurvṛṣasenaśca purukutso dhvajī rathī
ce_text: vyaśvaḥ sadaśvo vadhryaśvaḥ pañcahastaḥ pṛthuśravāḥ / ruṣadgur vṛṣasenaś ca kṣupaś ca sumahābalaḥ

vulgate_text: karandhamo bāhlikaśca sudyumno balavānmadhuḥ / ailo maruttaśca tathā balavānpṛthivīpatiḥ
ce_text: bhāṅgāsvariḥ sunīthaś ca niṣadho 'tha tviṣīrathaḥ / karaṃdhamo bāhlikaś ca sudyumno balavān madhuḥ

vulgate_text: kapotaromā tṛṇakaḥ sahadevārjunau tathā / vyaśvaḥ sāśvaḥ kṛśāśvaśca śaśabinduśca pārthivaḥ
ce_text: kapotaromā tṛṇakaḥ sahadevārjunau tathā / rāmo dāśarathiś caiva lakṣmaṇo 'tha pratardanaḥ

vulgate_text: ariṣṭanemiḥ sudyumnaḥ pṛthulāśvo'ṣṭakastathā / śataṃ matsyā nṛpatayaḥ śataṃ nīpāḥ śataṃ hayāḥ
ce_text: padmo 'tha mucukundaś ca bhūridyumnaḥ prasenajit / ariṣṭanemiḥ pradyumnaḥ pṛthagaśvo 'jakas tathā

vulgate_text: palāśānāṃ śataṃ jñeyaṃ śataṃ kāśakuśādayaḥ / śāntanuścaiva rājendra pāṇḍuścaiva pitā tava
ce_text: śataṃ ca brahmadattānām īriṇāṃ vairiṇāṃ śatam / śaṃtanuś caiva rājarṣiḥ pāṇḍuś caiva pitā tava

vulgate_text: sragviṇo divyagandhāśca divyagandhānulepanāḥ / ādityāstatra varuṇaṃ jaleśvaramupāsate
ce_text: sragviṇo bhūṣitāś cāpi divyamālyānukarṣiṇaḥ / ādityās tatra varuṇaṃ jaleśvaram upāsate

vulgate_text: pāṇimānkuṇḍadhāraśca balavānpṛthivīpate / prahrādo muṣikādaśca tathaiva janamejayaḥ
ce_text: prahlādo mūṣikādaś ca tathaiva janamejayaḥ / patākino maṇḍalinaḥ phaṇavantaś ca sarvaśaḥ

vulgate_text: patākino maṇḍalinaḥ phaṇavantaśca sarvaśaḥ / artho dharmaśca kāmaśca vasuḥ kapila eva ca
ce_text: prahlādo mūṣikādaś ca tathaiva janamejayaḥ / patākino maṇḍalinaḥ phaṇavantaś ca sarvaśaḥ

vulgate_text: godāvarī kṛṣṇaveṇī kāverī ca saridvarā / kimpunā ca viśalyā ca tathā vaitaraṇī nadī
ce_text: godāvarī kṛṣṇaveṇṇā kāverī ca saridvarā / etāś cānyāś ca saritas tīrthāni ca sarāṃsi ca

vulgate_text: saritaḥ sarvataścānyāstīrthāni ca sarāṃsi ca kūpāśca saprasravaṇā dehavanto yudhiṣṭhira
ce_text: kūpāś ca saprasravaṇā dehavanto yudhiṣṭhira / palvalāni taḍāgāni dehavanty atha bhārata

vulgate_text: putrapautraiḥ parivṛto gonāmnā puṣkareṇa ca / sarve vigrahavantaste tamīśvaramupāsate
ce_text: mahīdharā ratnavanto rasā yeṣu pratiṣṭhitāḥ / sarve vigrahavantas te tam īśvaram upāsate

vulgate_text: divyā hemamayai raṅgairvidyudbhiriva citritā / tasyāṃ vaiśravaṇo rājā vicitrābharaṇāmbaraḥ
ce_text: tasyāṃ vaiśravaṇo rājā vicitrābharaṇāmbaraḥ / strīsahasrāvṛtaḥ śrīmān āste jvalitakuṇḍalaḥ

vulgate_text: strīsahasrairvṛtaḥ śrīmānāste jvalitakuṇḍalaḥ saha patnyā mahārāja ṛddhyā saha virājate
ce_text: tasyāṃ vaiśravaṇo rājā vicitrābharaṇāmbaraḥ / strīsahasrāvṛtaḥ śrīmān āste jvalitakuṇḍalaḥ

vulgate_text: mandārāṇāmudārāṇāṃ vanāni pariloḍayan / saugandhīkavanānāṃ ca gandhaṃ gandhavaho vahan
ce_text: mandārāṇām udārāṇāṃ vanāni surabhīṇi ca / saugandhikānāṃ cādāya gandhān gandhavahaḥ śuciḥ

vulgate_text: tatra devāḥ sagandharvā gaṇairapsarasāṃ vṛtāḥ / divyatānairmahārāja gāyantisma sabhāgatāḥ
ce_text: tatra devāḥ sagandharvā gaṇair apsarasāṃ vṛtāḥ / divyatānena gītāni gānti divyāni bhārata

vulgate_text: brahmarṣayo bhavantyatra tathā devarṣayo'pare / kravyādāśca tathaivānye gandharvāśca mahābalāḥ
ce_text: ahaṃ ca bahuśas tasyāṃ bhavanty anye ca madvidhāḥ / ācāryāś cābhavaṃs tatra tathā devarṣayo 'pare

vulgate_text: upāsate mahātmānaṃ tasyāṃ dhanadamīśvaram / bhagavānbhūtasaṅghaiśca vṛtaḥ śatasahasraśaḥ
ce_text: bhagavān bhūtasaṃghaiś ca vṛtaḥ śatasahasraśaḥ / umāpatiḥ paśupatiḥ śūladhṛg bhaganetrahā

vulgate_text: vāmanairvikaṭaiḥ kubjaiḥ kṣatajākṣairmahāravaiḥ / medomāṃsāśanairugrairugradhanvā mahābalaḥ
ce_text: tryambako rājaśārdūla devī ca vigataklamā / vāmanair vikaṭaiḥ kubjaiḥ kṣatajākṣair manojavaiḥ

vulgate_text: pitāmahasabhāṃ tāta kathyamānāṃ nibodha me / śakyate yā na nirdeṣṭumevaṃrūpeti bhārata
ce_text: evaṃrūpeti sā śakyā na nirdeṣṭuṃ janādhipa / kṣaṇena hi bibharty anyad anirdeśyaṃ vapus tathā

vulgate_text: atharvāṅgirasaścaiva vālakhilyā sarīcipāḥ / mano'ntarikṣaṃ vidyāśca vāyustejo jalaṃ mahī
ce_text: bhṛgur atrir vasiṣṭhaś ca gautamaś ca tathāṅgirāḥ / mano 'ntarikṣaṃ vidyāś ca vāyus tejo jalaṃ mahī

vulgate_text: āyurvedastathā'ṣṭāṅgo dehavāṃstatra bhārata / candramāḥ saha nakṣatrairādityaśca gabhastimān
ce_text: candramāḥ saha nakṣatrair ādityaś ca gabhastimān / vāyavaḥ kratavaś caiva saṃkalpaḥ prāṇa eva ca

vulgate_text: vāyavaḥ kratavaścaiva saṅkalpaḥ prāṇa eva ca / mūrtimanto mahātmāno mahāvrataparāyaṇāḥ
ce_text: candramāḥ saha nakṣatrair ādityaś ca gabhastimān / vāyavaḥ kratavaś caiva saṃkalpaḥ prāṇa eva ca

vulgate_text: dharmacakraṃ tathā cāpi nityamāste yudhiṣṭhira / aditirditirdanuścaiva surasā vinatā irā
ce_text: aditir ditir danuś caiva surasā vinatā irā / kālakā surabhir devī saramā cātha gautamī

vulgate_text: upāsate ca saṃhṛṣṭā brahmāṇamamitaujasam / rākṣasāśca piśācāśca dānavā guhyakāstathā
ce_text: rākṣasāś ca piśācāś ca dānavā guhyakās tathā / suparṇanāgapaśavaḥ pitāmaham upāsate

vulgate_text: nāgāḥ suparṇāḥ paśavaḥ pitāmahamupāsate / sthāvarā jaṅgamāścaiva mahābhūtāstathā'pare
ce_text: rākṣasāś ca piśācāś ca dānavā guhyakās tathā / suparṇanāgapaśavaḥ pitāmaham upāsate

vulgate_text: mahāsenaśca rājendra sadopāste pitāmaham / devo nārāyaṇastasyāṃ tathā devarṣayaśca ye
ce_text: devo nārāyaṇas tasyāṃ tathā devarṣayaś ca ye / ṛṣayo vālakhilyāś ca yonijāyonijās tathā

vulgate_text: ṛṣayo vālakhilyāśca yonijāyonijāstathā yacca kiñcitriloke'smindṛśyate sthāṇu jaṅgamam / sarvaṃ tasyāṃ mayā dṛṣṭamiti viddhi narādhipa
ce_text: yac ca kiṃ cit triloke 'smin dṛśyate sthāṇujaṅgamam / sarvaṃ tasyāṃ mayā dṛṣṭaṃ tad viddhi manujādhipa

vulgate_text: kimuktavāṃśca bhagavaṃstanmamācakṣva suvrata / tvattaḥ śrotuṃ sarvamidaṃ paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me
ce_text: kim uktavāṃś ca bhagavann etad icchāmi veditum / tvattaḥ śrotum ahaṃ sarvaṃ paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me

vulgate_text: samāptayajño vidhivaddhariścandraḥ pratāpavān / abhiṣiktaśca śuśubhe sāmrājyena narādhipaḥ
ce_text: samāpya ca hariścandro mahāyajñaṃ pratāpavān / abhiṣiktaḥ sa śuśubhe sāmrājyena narādhipa

vulgate_text: samartho'si mahābāho sarve te vaśagā vayam / acirāttvaṃ mahārāja rājasūyamavāpsyasi
ce_text: samartho 'si mahābāho sarve te vaśagā vayam / avicārya mahārāja rājasūye manaḥ kuru

vulgate_text: śrutvā suhṛdvacastacca jānaṃścāpyātmanaḥ kṣamam / sa praśastakriyārambhaḥ parīkṣāmupacakrame
ce_text: śrutvā suhṛdvacas tac ca jānaṃś cāpy ātmanaḥ kṣamam / punaḥ punar mano dadhre rājasūyāya bhārata

vulgate_text: sa rājasūyaṃ rājendraḥ kurūṇāmṛṣabhaḥ kratum / jagāma manasā sadya āhariṣyanyudhiṣṭhiraḥ
ce_text: sa rājasūyaṃ rājendra kurūṇām ṛṣabhaḥ kratum / āhartuṃ pravaṇaṃ cakre manaḥ saṃcintya so 'sakṛt

vulgate_text: sa bhrātṛbhiḥ punardhīmānṛtvigniśca mahātmabhiḥ / mantribhiścāpi sahito dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
ce_text: sa bhrātṛbhiḥ punar dhīmān ṛtvigbhiś ca mahātmabhiḥ / dhaumyadvaipāyanādyaiś ca mantrayām āsa mantribhiḥ

vulgate_text: dhaumyadvaipāyanādyaiśca mantrayāmāsa mantravit / virāṭadrupadābhyāṃ ca sātyakena ca dhīmatā
ce_text: sa bhrātṛbhiḥ punar dhīmān ṛtvigbhiś ca mahātmabhiḥ / dhaumyadvaipāyanādyaiś ca mantrayām āsa mantribhiḥ

vulgate_text: dvārakāvāsinaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dvāravatyāṃ samāsadat / sa prabhuṃ prāñjalirbhūtvā vyajñāpayata mādhavam
ce_text: śīghragena rathenāśu sa dūtaḥ prāpya yādavān / dvārakāvāsinaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dvāravatyāṃ samāsadat

vulgate_text: indrasenavacaḥ śrutvā yādavapravaro balī / darśanākāṅkṣiṇaṃ pārthaṃ darśanākāṅkṣayācyutaḥ
ce_text: darśanākāṅkṣiṇaṃ pārthaṃ darśanākāṅkṣayācyutaḥ / indrasenena sahita indraprasthaṃ yayau tadā

vulgate_text: āmantrya rājansuhṛdo vasudevaṃ ca mādhavaḥ indrasenena sahita indraprasthamagāttadā / vyatītya vividhāndeśāṃstvarāvānkṣipravāhanavaḥ
ce_text: vyatītya vividhān deśāṃs tvarāvān kṣipravāhanaḥ / indraprasthagataṃ pārtham abhyagacchaj janārdanaḥ

vulgate_text: teṣāṃ tathaiva tāṃ lakṣmīṃ sarvakṣatramupāsate / idānīmeva vai rājañjarāsandho mahīpatiḥ
ce_text: teṣāṃ tathaiva tāṃ lakṣmīṃ sarvakṣatram upāsate / so 'vanīṃ madhyamāṃ bhuktvā mithobhedeṣv amanyata

vulgate_text: so'vanīṃ madhyamāṃ bhuktvā mitho bhedamamanyata / prabhuryastu paro rājā yasminnekavaśe jagat
ce_text: teṣāṃ tathaiva tāṃ lakṣmīṃ sarvakṣatram upāsate / so 'vanīṃ madhyamāṃ bhuktvā mithobhedeṣv amanyata

vulgate_text: sa sāmrājyaṃ mahārāja prāpto bhavati yogataḥ / taṃ sa rājā jarāsandhaṃ saṃśritya kila sarvaśaḥ
ce_text: taṃ sa rājā mahāprājña saṃśritya kila sarvaśaḥ / rājan senāpatir jātaḥ śiśupālaḥ pratāpavān

vulgate_text: jarāsandhaṃ mahāvīryaṃ tau hiṃsaḍimbikāvubhau vakradantaḥ karūṣasya karabho meghavāhanaḥ / mūrdhnā divyaṃ maṇiṃ bibhradyamadbhutamaṇiṃ viduḥ
ce_text: dantavakraḥ karūṣaś ca kalabho meghavāhanaḥ / mūrdhnā divyaṃ maṇiṃ bibhrad yaṃ taṃ bhūtamaṇiṃ viduḥ

vulgate_text: ugrasenasutaḥ kaṃsaḥ purā nirjitya bāndhavān / bārhadrathasute devyāvupāgacchadvṛthāmatiḥ
ce_text: kasya cit tv atha kālasya kaṃso nirmathya bāndhavān / bārhadrathasute devyāv upāgacchad vṛthāmatiḥ

vulgate_text: tasya hyamarasaṅkāśau balena balināṃ varau / nāmabhyāṃ haṃsaḍibikāvaśastranidhanāvubhau
ce_text: tasya hy amarasaṃkāśau balena balināṃ varau / nāmabhyāṃ haṃsaḍibhakāv ity āstāṃ yodhasattamau

vulgate_text: tasyāṃ vayamamitraghna nivasāmo'kutobhayāḥ / ālocya girimukhyaṃ taṃ māgadhaṃ tīrṇameva ca
ce_text: striyo 'pi yasyāṃ yudhyeyuḥ kiṃ punar vṛṣṇipuṃgavāḥ / tasyāṃ vayam amitraghna nivasāmo 'kutobhayāḥ

vulgate_text: niśaṭhaśca gadaścaiva sapta caite mahārathāḥ / vikamo jhillibabhrū ca uddhavo'tha vidūrathaḥ
ce_text: kahvaḥ śaṅkur nidāntaś ca saptaivaite mahārathāḥ / putrau cāndhakabhojasya vṛddho rājā ca te daśa

vulgate_text: syamantako maṇiryasya rukmaṃ nisruvate bahu / putrau cāndhakabhojasya vṛddho rājā ca te daśa
ce_text: kahvaḥ śaṅkur nidāntaś ca saptaivaite mahārathāḥ / putrau cāndhakabhojasya vṛddho rājā ca te daśa

vulgate_text: kṣatre samrājamātmānaṃ kartumarhasi bhārata / duryodhanaṃ śāntanavaṃ droṇaṃ drauṇāyaniṃ kṛpam
ce_text: sa tvaṃ samrāḍguṇair yuktaḥ sadā bharatasattama / kṣatre samrājam ātmānaṃ kartum arhasi bhārata

vulgate_text: ārādhya tapasogreṇa nirjitāstena pārthivāḥ / pratijñāyāśca pāraṃ sa gataḥ pārthivasattama
ce_text: so 'pi rājā jarāsaṃdho yiyakṣur vasudhādhipaiḥ / ārādhya hi mahādevaṃ nirjitās tena pārthivāḥ

vulgate_text: vayaṃ yaiva mahābhāga jarāsandhabhayāttadā / śaṅkitāḥ sma mahābhāga dvaurātmyāttasya cānagha
ce_text: vayaṃ caiva mahārāja jarāsaṃdhabhayāt tadā / mathurāṃ saṃparityajya gatā dvāravatīṃ purīm

vulgate_text: ṛddhyā maruttastānpaśca samrājastvanuśuśruma / sarvānvaṃśyānanumṛśannaite santi yuge yuge
ce_text: hitvā karān yauvanāśvaḥ pālanāc ca bhagīrathaḥ / kārtavīryas tapoyogād balāt tu bharato vibhuḥ / ṛddhyā maruttas tān pañca samrāja iti śuśrumaḥ

vulgate_text: sāmrājyamicchataste tu sarvākāraṃ yudhiṣṭhira / nigrāhyalakṣaṇaṃ prāptirdharmārthanayalakṣaṇaiḥ
ce_text: nigrāhyalakṣaṇaṃ prāpto dharmārthanayalakṣaṇaiḥ / bārhadratho jarāsaṃdhas tad viddhi bharatarṣabha

vulgate_text: bārhadratho narāsandhastadviddhi bharatarṣabha / na cainaṃ pratyatyuddhyanta kulānyekaśataṃ nṛpāḥ
ce_text: nigrāhyalakṣaṇaṃ prāpto dharmārthanayalakṣaṇaiḥ / bārhadratho jarāsaṃdhas tad viddhi bharatarṣabha

vulgate_text: taṇḍulaprasthake rājā kapardinamupāsate prokṣitānāṃ pramṛṣṭānāṃ rājñāṃ paśupatergṛhe / paśūnāmiva pramṛṣṭānāṃ rājñāṃ paśupatergṛhe
ce_text: prokṣitānāṃ pramṛṣṭānāṃ rājñāṃ paśupater gṛhe / paśūnām iva kā prītir jīvite bharatarṣabha

vulgate_text: jarāsandhabalaṃ prāpya duṣpāraṃ bhīmavikramam / yamopi na vijetā''jau tatra vaḥ kiṃ viceṣṭitam
ce_text: jarāsaṃdhabalaṃ prāpya duṣpāraṃ bhīmavikramam / śramo hi vaḥ parājayyāt kim u tatra viceṣṭitam

vulgate_text: asmiṃstvarthāntare yuktamanarthaḥ pratipadyate / tasmānna pratipattistu kāryā yuktā matā mama
ce_text: asminn arthāntare yuktam anarthaḥ pratipadyate / yathāhaṃ vimṛśāmy ekas tat tāvac chrūyatāṃ mama

vulgate_text: kṛtavīryakule jāto nirvīryaḥ kiṃ kariṣyati / nirvīrye tu kule jāto vīryavāṃstu viśiṣyate
ce_text: kṛtavīryakule jāto nirvīryaḥ kiṃ kariṣyati / kṣatriyaḥ sarvaśo rājan yasya vṛttiḥ parājaye

vulgate_text: vyūḍhānīkairatibalairna yudvyedaribhiḥ saha / iti buddhimatāṃ nītistanmamāpīha rocate
ce_text: vyūḍhānīkair anubalair nopeyād balavattaram / iti buddhimatāṃ nītis tan mamāpīha rocate

vulgate_text: nāsasāda nṛpaśreṣṭhaḥ putraṃ kulavivardhanam / sa bhāryābhyāṃ ca sahito nirvedamagamaddhṛśam
ce_text: maṅgalair bahubhir homaiḥ putrakāmābhir iṣṭibhiḥ / nāsasāda nṛpaśreṣṭhaḥ putraṃ kulavivardhanam

vulgate_text: muneśca bahumānena kālasya ca viparyayāt te tadāmraṃ dvidhā kṛtvā bhakṣayāmāsatuḥ śubhe
ce_text: te tad āmraṃ dvidhā kṛtvā bhakṣayām āsatuḥ śubhe / bhāvitvād api cārthasya satyavākyāt tathā muneḥ

vulgate_text: nārhāmi viṣaye rājño vasantī putragṛddhinaḥ / bālaṃ putramimaṃ hantuṃ dhārmikasya mahātmanaḥ
ce_text: nārhāmi viṣaye rājño vasantī putragṛddhinaḥ / bālaṃ putram upādātuṃ meghalekheva bhāskaram

vulgate_text: sā taṃ bālamupādāya meghalekhena bhāskaram / kṛtvā ca mānuṣaṃ rūpamuvāca vasudhādhipam
ce_text: sā kṛtvā mānuṣaṃ rūpam uvāca manujādhipam / bṛhadratha sutas te 'yaṃ maddattaḥ pratigṛhyatām

vulgate_text: mama nāmnā ca loke'sminkhyāta eva bhaviṣyati / evamuktvā tu sā rājaṃstatraivāntaradhīyata / sa saṅgṛhya kumāraṃ taṃ praviveśa gṛhaṃ nṛpaḥ
ce_text: evam uktvā tu sā rājaṃs tatraivāntaradhīyata / sa gṛhya ca kumāraṃ taṃ prāviśat svagṛhaṃ nṛpaḥ

vulgate_text: tasya nāmākaroccaiva pitāmahasamaḥ pitā / jarayā sandhito yasmājjarāsandho bhavatvayam
ce_text: tasya nāmākarot tatra prajāpatisamaḥ pitā / jarayā saṃdhito yasmāj jarāsaṃdhas tato 'bhavat

vulgate_text: prāpayiṣyati tatsarvaṃ vikrameṇa samanvitaḥ / asya vīryavato vīryaṃ nānuyāsyanti pārthivāḥ
ce_text: asya vīryavato vīryaṃ nānuyāsyanti pārthivāḥ / devair api visṛṣṭāni śastrāṇy asya mahīpate / na rujaṃ janayiṣyanti girer iva nadīrayāḥ

vulgate_text: avamānācca lobhācca bāhuvīryācca darpitaḥ / bhīmasenena yuddhāya dhruvamapyupayāsyati
ce_text: avamānāc ca lokasya vyāyatatvāc ca dharṣitaḥ / bhīmasenena yuddhāya dhruvam abhyupayāsyati

vulgate_text: yeṣāmabhimukhī lakṣmīsteṣāṃ kṛṣṇa tvamagrataḥ nihataśca jarāsandho mokṣitāśca mahīkṣitaḥ - -- c rājasūyaśca me labdho nideśe tva tiṣṭhataḥ
ce_text: nihataś ca jarāsaṃdho mokṣitāś ca mahīkṣitaḥ / rājasūyaś ca me labdho nideśe tava tiṣṭhataḥ

vulgate_text: kṣiprameva yathā tvetatkāryaṃ samupapadyate apramatto jagannātha tathā kuru samupapadyate
ce_text: kṣiprakārin yathā tv etat kāryaṃ samupapadyate / mama kāryaṃ jagatkāryaṃ tathā kuru narottama

vulgate_text: mādhavaḥ pāṇḍaveyau ca pratasthurvratadhāriṇaḥ amarṣādabhitaptānāṃ jñātyarthaṃ mukhyatejasām / ravisomāgnivapuṣāṃ dīptamāsīttadā vapuḥ
ce_text: amarṣād abhitaptānāṃ jñātyarthaṃ mukhyavāsasām / ravisomāgnivapuṣāṃ bhīmam āsīt tadā vapuḥ

vulgate_text: evaṃ prāpya puraṃ ramyaṃ durādharpaṃ samantataḥ / arthasiddhiṃ tvanupamāṃ jarāsandho'bhimanyate
ce_text: arthasiddhiṃ tv anapagāṃ jarāsaṃdho 'bhimanyate / vayam āsādane tasya darpam adya nihanma hi

vulgate_text: paryugnyakurvaṃśca nṛpaṃ dviradasthaṃ purohitāḥ tatastacchāntaye rājā jarāsandhaḥ pratāpavān / dīkṣito niyamastho'sāvupavāsaparo'bhavat
ce_text: etasminn eva kāle tu jarāsaṃdhaṃ samarcayan / paryagni kurvaṃś ca nṛpaṃ dviradasthaṃ purohitāḥ

vulgate_text: vyūḍhoraskānmāgadhānāṃ vismayaḥ samapadyata / advāreṇābhyavaskandya viviśurmāgadhālayam
ce_text: tān dṛṣṭvā dviradaprakhyāñ śālaskandhān ivodgatān / vyūḍhoraskān māgadhānāṃ vismayaḥ samajāyata

vulgate_text: uvāca caitānrājā'sau svāgataṃ vostviti prabhuḥ / maunamāsīttadā pārthabhīmayorjanamejaya
ce_text: uvāca caitān rājāsau svāgataṃ vo 'stv iti prabhuḥ / tasya hy etad vrataṃ rājan babhūva bhuvi viśrutam

vulgate_text: tato'rdharātre samprāpte yāto yatra sthitā dvijāḥ / tasya hyetadvrataṃ rājanbabhūva bhuvi viśrutam
ce_text: uvāca caitān rājāsau svāgataṃ vo 'stv iti prabhuḥ / tasya hy etad vrataṃ rājan babhūva bhuvi viśrutam

vulgate_text: kṣatriyā eva loke'sminviditā mama sarvaśaḥ / satyaṃ vadata ke yūyaṃ satyaṃ rājasu śobhate
ce_text: evaṃ virāgavasanā bahirmālyānulepanāḥ / satyaṃ vadata ke yūyaṃ satyaṃ rājasu śobhate

vulgate_text: snātakānbrāhmaṇānrājanviddhyasmāṃstvaṃ narādhipa / snātakavratino rājanbrāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā viśaḥ
ce_text: snātakavratino rājan brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā viśaḥ / viśeṣaniyamāś caiṣām aviśeṣāś ca santy uta

vulgate_text: advāreṇa rimporgehaṃ dvāreṇa suhṛdo gṛhān / praviśanti narā dhīrā dvārāṇyetāni dharmataḥ
ce_text: advāreṇa ripor gehaṃ dvāreṇa suhṛdo gṛham / praviśanti sadā santo dvāraṃ no varjitaṃ tataḥ

vulgate_text: trailokye kṣatradharmo hi śreyānvai sādhucāriṇām / nānyaṃ dharmaṃ praśaṃsanti ye ca dharmavido janāḥ
ce_text: trailokye kṣatradharmād dhi śreyāṃsaṃ sādhucāriṇām / anāgasaṃ prajānānāḥ pramādād iva jalpatha

vulgate_text: tasya me'dya sthitasyeha svadharme niyatātmanaḥ / anāgasaṃ prajānāṃ ca pramādādiva jalpatha
ce_text: trailokye kṣatradharmād dhi śreyāṃsaṃ sādhucāriṇām / anāgasaṃ prajānānāḥ pramādād iva jalpatha

vulgate_text: kulakāryaṃ mahābāho kaścidekaḥ kulodvahaḥ / vahate yastanniyogādvayamabhyudyatāstvayi
ce_text: kulakāryaṃ mahārāja kaś cid ekaḥ kulodvahaḥ / vahate tanniyogād vai vayam abhyutthitās trayaḥ

vulgate_text: yuyukṣamāṇāstvatto hi na vayaṃ brāhmaṇā dhruvam śaurirasmi hṛṣīkeśo nṛvīrau pāṇḍavāvimau / anayormātuleyaṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ māṃ viddhi te ripum
ce_text: mumukṣamāṇās tvattaś ca na vayaṃ brāhmaṇabruvāḥ / śaurir asmi hṛṣīkeśo nṛvīrau pāṇḍavāv imau

vulgate_text: prabhañjanabalāviṣṭo jarāsandhamarindamaḥ / utkṣipya bhrāmayāmāsa balavantaṃ mahābalaḥ
ce_text: evam uktas tadā bhīmo jarāsaṃdham ariṃdamaḥ / utkṣipya bhrāmayad rājan balavantaṃ mahābalaḥ

vulgate_text: kare gṛhītvā caraṇaṃ dvidhā cakre mahābalaḥ / tasya niṣpiṣyamāṇasya pāṇḍavasya ca garjataḥ
ce_text: tasya niṣpiṣyamāṇasya pāṇḍavasya ca garjataḥ / abhavat tumulo nādaḥ sarvaprāṇibhayaṃkaraḥ

vulgate_text: iti vai māgadhā jajñurbhīmasenasya nikhanāt / tatastu bhagavānkṛṣṇo jarāsandhajighāṃsayā
ce_text: kiṃ nu svid dhimavān bhinnaḥ kiṃ nu svid dīryate mahī / iti sma māgadhā jajñur bhīmasenasya nisvanāt

vulgate_text: kiṃ karmaḥ puruṣavyāghra śādhi naḥ praṇatisthitān / kṛtamityeva tadvidvi nṛpairyayadyapi duṣkaram
ce_text: kiṃ kurmaḥ puruṣavyāghra bravīhi puruṣarṣabha / kṛtam ity eva taj jñeyaṃ nṛpair yady api duṣkaram

vulgate_text: tataḥ suprītamanasaste nṛpā nṛpasattama / tathetyevābruvansarve pratigṛhyāsya tāṃ giram
ce_text: tataḥ pratītamanasas te nṛpā bharatarṣabha / tathety evābruvan sarve pratijajñuś ca tāṃ giram

vulgate_text: bhayārtāya tatastasmai kṛṣṇo dattvā'bhayaṃ tadā / ādade'sya mahārhāṇi ratnāni puruṣottamaḥ
ce_text: bhayārtāya tatas tasmai kṛṣṇo dattvābhayaṃ tadā / abhyaṣiñcata tatraiva jarāsaṃdhātmajaṃ tadā

vulgate_text: bhayārtāya tatastasmai kṛtvā kṛṣṇo'bhayaṃ tadā / abhyaṣiñcata rājānaṃ sahadevaṃ janārdanaḥ
ce_text: bhayārtāya tatas tasmai kṛṣṇo dattvābhayaṃ tadā / abhyaṣiñcata tatraiva jarāsaṃdhātmajaṃ tadā

vulgate_text: pārthābhāyaṃ sahitaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sarvaiśca vasudhādhipaiḥ / yathāvayaḥ samāgamya visasarja narādhipān
ce_text: yathāvayaḥ samāgamya rājabhis taiś ca pāṇḍavaḥ / satkṛtya pūjayitvā ca visasarja narādhipān

vulgate_text: khāṇḍavaprasthamadhyastho dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / āsītparamayā lakṣmyā suhṛdgaṇavṛtaḥ prabhuḥ
ce_text: pratīcīṃ nakulo rājan diśaṃ vyajayad astravit / khāṇḍavaprastham adhyāste dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ

vulgate_text: vikrameṇa vaśe kṛtvā kṛtavānanusainikam / etena sahito rājansavyasācī parantapaḥ
ce_text: sa tena sahito rājan savyasācī paraṃtapaḥ / vijigye sakalaṃ dvīpaṃ prativindhyaṃ ca pārthivam

vulgate_text: arjunasya ca sainyasthairvigrahastumulo'bhavat / tānsarvānajayatpārto dharmarājapriyepsayā
ce_text: sakaladvīpavāsāṃś ca saptadvīpe ca ye nṛpāḥ / arjunasya ca sainyānāṃ vigrahas tumulo 'bhavat

vulgate_text: kurūṇāmṛṣabho rājā dharmaputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / dharmajñaḥ satyasandhaśca yajvā vipuladakṣiṇaḥ
ce_text: kurūṇām ṛṣabho rājā dharmaputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / tasya pārthivatām īpse karas tasmai pradīyatām

vulgate_text: tatrasthaḥ puruṣaireva dharmarājasya śāsanāt / kirīṭī jitavānrājandeśānpañcagaṇāṃstataḥ
ce_text: tatrasthaḥ puruṣair eva dharmarājasya śāsanāt / vyajayad dhanaṃjayo rājan deśān pañca pramāṇataḥ

vulgate_text: mayūrasadṛśānanyānuttarānaparānapi / javanānāśugāṃścaiva karārthaṃ samupānayat
ce_text: sa vijitya tato rājann ṛṣikān raṇamūrdhani / śukodarasamaprakhyān hayān aṣṭau samānayat / mayūrasadṛśān anyān ubhayān eva cāparān

vulgate_text: tato ganvā mahārāja vāruṇīṃ pākaśāsaniḥ / gandhamādanamāsādya tatastānajayatprabhuḥ
ce_text: saro mānasam āsādya hāṭakān abhitaḥ prabhuḥ / gandharvarakṣitaṃ deśaṃ vyajayat pāṇḍavas tataḥ

vulgate_text: gandharvarakṣitaṃ deśamajayatsagaṇaṃ tadā / tatra ratnāni divyāni labdhvā rājannathārjunaḥ
ce_text: saro mānasam āsādya hāṭakān abhitaḥ prabhuḥ / gandharvarakṣitaṃ deśaṃ vyajayat pāṇḍavas tataḥ

vulgate_text: pañcālānvividhopāyaiḥ sāntvayāmāsa pāṇḍavaḥ / kiñcitkaraṃ samādāya videhānāṃ puraṃ yayau / tataḥ sa gaṇḍakāñśūro videhānbharatarṣabhaḥ
ce_text: sa gatvā rājaśārdūlaḥ pāñcālānāṃ puraṃ mahat / pāñcālān vividhopāyaiḥ sāntvayām āsa pāṇḍavaḥ

ce_text: tatra dāśārṇako rājā sudharmā lomaharṣaṇam / kṛtavān karma bhīmena mahad yuddhaṃ nirāyudham

vulgate_text: somadheyāṃśca nirjitya pratyayāvuttarāmukhaḥ / vatsabhūmiṃ ca kaunteyo vijigye balavānbalāt
ce_text: nivṛtya ca mahābāhur madarvīkaṃ mahīdharam / sopadeśaṃ vinirjitya prayayāv uttarāmukhaḥ / vatsabhūmiṃ ca kaunteyo vijigye balavān balāt

vulgate_text: śarmakānvarmakāṃścaiva vyajayatsāntvapūrvakam / vaidehakaṃ ca rājānaṃ janakaṃ jagatīpatim
ce_text: śarmakān varmakāṃś caiva sāntvenaivājayat prabhuḥ / vaidehakaṃ ca rājānaṃ janakaṃ jagatīpatim / vijigye puruṣavyāghro nātitīvreṇa karmaṇā

vulgate_text: vijigye puruṣavyāghro nātitīvreṇa karmaṇā / śakāṃśca barbarāścaiva ajayacchadmapūrvakam
ce_text: śarmakān varmakāṃś caiva sāntvenaivājayat prabhuḥ / vaidehakaṃ ca rājānaṃ janakaṃ jagatīpatim / vijigye puruṣavyāghro nātitīvreṇa karmaṇā

vulgate_text: tataḥ suhyānprasuhyāṃśca sapakṣānativīryavān / vijitya yudhi kaunteyo māgadhānabhyadhādbalī
ce_text: tataḥ suhmān prācyasuhmān samakṣāṃś caiva vīryavān / vijitya yudhi kaunteyo māgadhān upayād balī

ce_text: tataḥ pauṇḍrādhipaṃ vīraṃ vāsudevaṃ mahābalam / kauśikīkacchanilayaṃ rājānaṃ ca mahaujasam

vulgate_text: candanāguruvastrāṇi maṇimauktikakambalam / kāñcanaṃ rajataṃ caiva vidrumaṃ ca mahādhanam
ce_text: candanāguruvastrāṇi maṇimuktam anuttamam / kāñcanaṃ rajataṃ vajraṃ vidrumaṃ ca mahādhanam

vulgate_text: sekānaparasekāṃśca ratnāni vividhāni ca tatastenaiva sahito narmadāmabhito yayau - - abhagadattaṃ mahābāhuṃ kṣatriyaṃ narakātmajam arjunāya karaṃ dattaṃ śrutvā tatra nyavartata
ce_text: karāṃs tebhya upādāya ratnāni vividhāni ca / tatas tair eva sahito narmadām abhito yayau

vulgate_text: tāṃstānāṭavikānsarvānajayatpāṇḍunandanaḥ / nātādhipaṃ ca nṛpatiṃ vaśe cakre mahābalaḥ
ce_text: dvīpaṃ tāmrāhvayaṃ caiva parvataṃ rāmakaṃ tathā / timiṃgilaṃ ca nṛpatiṃ vaśe cakre mahāmatiḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ sa bhagavānagniścakame tāṃ sudarśanām / nīlasya rājñaḥ sarveṣāmupanītaśca so'bhavat
ce_text: nīlasya rājñaḥ pūrveṣām upanītaś ca so 'bhavat / tadā brāhmaṇarūpeṇa caramāṇo yadṛcchayā

vulgate_text: tato brahmaṇarūpeṇa ramamāṇo yadṛcchayā / cakame tāṃ varārohāṃ kanyāmutpalalocanām / taṃ tu rājā yathāśāstramaśāsaddhārmikastadā
ce_text: nīlasya rājñaḥ pūrveṣām upanītaś ca so 'bhavat / tadā brāhmaṇarūpeṇa caramāṇo yadṛcchayā

vulgate_text: pratigṛhya ca tāṃ subhruṃ nīlarājñaḥ sutāṃ tadā / cakre prasādaṃ bhagavāṃstasya rājño vibhāvasuḥ
ce_text: taṃ dṛṣṭvā vismito rājā jagāma śirasā kavim / cakre prasādaṃ ca tadā tasya rājño vibhāvasuḥ

vulgate_text: pāvake vinivṛtte tu nīlo rājā'bhyagāttadā / pāvakasyājñayā cainamarcayāmāsa pārthivaḥ
ce_text: pāvake vinivṛtte tu nīlo rājābhyayāt tadā / satkāreṇa naravyāghraṃ sahadevaṃ yudhāṃ patim

vulgate_text: tataḥ sa ratnānyādāya punaḥ prāyādyudhāṃ patiḥ / tataḥ śūrpārakaṃ caiva tālākaṭamathāpi ca
ce_text: prītipūrvaṃ mahābāhur vāsudevam avekṣya ca / tataḥ sa ratnāny ādāya punaḥ prāyād yudhāṃ patiḥ

vulgate_text: timiṅgilaṃ ca sa nṛpaṃ vaśe kṛtvā mahāmatiḥ / ekapādāṃśca puruṣānkeralānvanavāsinaḥ
ce_text: ekapādāṃś ca puruṣān kevalān vanavāsinaḥ / nagarīṃ saṃjayantīṃ ca picchaṇḍaṃ karahāṭakam / dūtair eva vaśe cakre karaṃ cainān adāpayat

vulgate_text: diśaṃ pratīcīṃ nakulaḥ karārthaṃ prayayau tathā / sahadevo diśaṃ yāmyāṃ jitvā sarvānmahīkṣitaḥ
ce_text: tathaiva sahadevo 'pi dharmarājena pūjitaḥ / mahatyā senayā sārdhaṃ prayayau dakṣiṇāṃ diśam

vulgate_text: tena tadbhāṣitaṃ śrutvā rākṣasendro bibhīṣaṇaḥ / śāsanaṃ pratijagrāha dharmātmā rākṣasaiḥ saha
ce_text: bhīṣmakāya sa dharmātmā sākṣād indrasakhāya vai / sa cāsya sasuto rājan pratijagrāha śāsanam

vulgate_text: tacca kṛṣṇakṛtaṃ dhīmānityamanyata sa prabhuḥ / tato dadau vicitrāṇi kambalāni kuthāni ca
ce_text: sa cāsya pratijagrāha śāsanaṃ prītipūrvakam / tac ca kālakṛtaṃ dhīmān anvamanyata sa prabhuḥ

vulgate_text: candanāni ca mukhyāni vāsāṃsi vividhāni ca / sa dadau sahadevāya tadā rājā vibhīṣaṇāḥ
ce_text: tataḥ saṃpreṣayām āsa ratnāni vividhāni ca / candanāgurumukhyāni divyāny ābharaṇāni ca

vulgate_text: visṛjya draviḍānsarvāngamanāyopacakrame / nyavartama tato dhīmānsahadevo narādhipaḥ
ce_text: vāsāṃsi ca mahārhāṇi maṇīṃś caiva mahādhanān / nyavartata tato dhīmān sahadevaḥ pratāpavān

vulgate_text: dharmarājāya tatsarvaṃ nivedya bharatarṣabha / koṭīsahasramadhikaṃ hiraṇyasya mahātmane
ce_text: dharmarājāya tat sarvaṃ nivedya bharatarṣabha / kṛtakarmā sukhaṃ rājann uvāsa janamejaya

vulgate_text: vividhāni ca ratnāni gojāvimahiṣāṃstathā / kṛtakarmā sukhaṃ rājannuvāsa janamejaya
ce_text: dharmarājāya tat sarvaṃ nivedya bharatarṣabha / kṛtakarmā sukhaṃ rājann uvāsa janamejaya

vulgate_text: śairīṣakaṃ mahetthaṃ ca vaśe cakre mahādyutiḥ / ākrośaṃ caiva rājarṣi tena yuddhamabhūnmahat
ce_text: śairīṣakaṃ mahecchaṃ ca vaśe cakre mahādyutiḥ / śibīṃs trigartān ambaṣṭhān mālavān pañcakarpaṭān

vulgate_text: tāndaśārṇānsa jitvā ca pratasthe pāṇḍunandanaḥ / śibīṃstrigartānambaṣṭhānmālavānpañca karpaṭān
ce_text: śairīṣakaṃ mahecchaṃ ca vaśe cakre mahādyutiḥ / śibīṃs trigartān ambaṣṭhān mālavān pañcakarpaṭān

vulgate_text: katsnaṃ pañcanandaṃ caiva tathaivāmaraparvatam / uttarajyotiṣaṃ caiva tathā divyakaṭaṃ puram
ce_text: kṛtsnaṃ pañcanadaṃ caiva tathaivāparaparyaṭam / uttarajyotikaṃ caiva tathā vṛndāṭakaṃ puram / dvārapālaṃ ca tarasā vaśe cakre mahādyutiḥ

vulgate_text: dūtāśca vāhanairjagbhū rāṣṭrāṇi subahūnyapi / tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā preṣayāmāsa pāṇḍavam
ce_text: tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā preṣayām āsa pāṇḍavam / nakulaṃ hāstinapuraṃ bhīṣmāya bharatarṣabha

vulgate_text: bahu vittaṃ samādāya vividhaṃ pārthivā yayuḥ / draṣṭukāmāḥ sabhāṃ caiva dharmarājaṃ ca pāṇḍavam
ce_text: anye ca śataśas tuṣṭair manobhir manujarṣabha / draṣṭukāmāḥ sabhāṃ caiva dharmarājaṃ ca pāṇḍavam

vulgate_text: prayataḥ prāñjalirbhūtvā bhāratānānayattadā / dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ ca bhīṣmaṃ ca viduraṃ ca mahāmatim

vulgate_text: bāhlikāścāpare śūrā rājānaḥ sarva eva te / virāṭaḥ saha putrābhyāṃ māvellaśca mahābalaḥ

vulgate_text: gadapradyumnasāmbāśca cārudeṣṇaśca vīryavān / ulmuko niśaṭhaścaiva vīraścāṅgāvahastathā

ce_text: dadus teṣām āvasathān dharmarājasya śāsanāt / bahukakṣyānvitān rājan dīrghikāvṛkṣaśobhitān

vulgate_text: vṛtaṃ sadasyairbahubhirdharmarājaṃ yudhiṣṭhiram tatsadaḥ pārthivaiḥ kīrṇaṃ brāhmaṇaiśca maharṣibhiḥ / bhrājate sma tadā rājannākapṛṣṭhaṃ yathā'maraiḥ
ce_text: tat sadaḥ pārthivaiḥ kīrṇaṃ brāhmaṇaiś ca mahātmabhiḥ / bhrājate sma tadā rājan nākapṛṣṭham ivāmaraiḥ

vulgate_text: caraṇakṣālane kṛṣṇo brāhmaṇānāṃ svayaṃ hyabhūt / sarvalokasamāvṛttaḥ piprīṣuḥ phalamuttamam
ce_text: sarvalokaḥ samāvṛttaḥ piprīṣuḥ phalam uttamam / draṣṭukāmaḥ sabhāṃ caiva dharmarājaṃ ca pāṇḍavam

vulgate_text: jñānavṛddhā mayā rājanbahavaḥ paryupāsitāḥ yasya rājanprabhāvajñāḥ purā sarve ca rakṣitāḥ / teṣāṃ kathayatāṃ śaurerahaṃ guṇavato guṇān

ce_text: vedavedāṅgavijñānaṃ balaṃ cāpy amitaṃ tathā / nṛṇāṃ hi loke kasyāsti viśiṣṭaṃ keśavād ṛte

vulgate_text: yudhiṣṭhirābhiṣekaṃ ca vāsudevasya cārhaṇam / na syādyathā tathā kāryamevaṃ sarve tadā'bruvan
ce_text: yudhiṣṭhirābhiṣekaṃ ca vāsudevasya cārhaṇam / abruvaṃs tatra rājāno nirvedād ātmaniścayāt

ce_text: yudhiṣṭhirābhiṣekaṃ ca vāsudevasya cārhaṇam / abruvaṃs tatra rājāno nirvedād ātmaniścayāt

vulgate_text: tataḥ sāgarasaṅkāśaṃ dṛṣṭvā nṛpatimaṇḍalam saṃvartavātābhihataṃ bhīmaṃ kṣubdhamivārṇavam
ce_text: tataḥ sāgarasaṃkāśaṃ dṛṣṭvā nṛpatisāgaram / roṣāt pracalitaṃ sarvam idam āha yudhiṣṭhiraḥ

ce_text: bhīṣmaṃ matimatāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vṛddhaṃ kurupitāmaham / bṛhaspatiṃ bṛhattejāḥ puruhūta ivārihā

ce_text: na hi saṃbudhyate tāvat suptaḥ siṃha ivācyutaḥ / tena siṃhīkaroty etān nṛsiṃhaś cedipuṃgavaḥ

vulgate_text: sa cānena hataḥ kaṃsa ityetattu mahādbhutam na te śrutamidaṃ bhīṣma nūnaṃ kathayatāṃ satām
ce_text: na te śrutam idaṃ bhīṣma nūnaṃ kathayatāṃ satām / yad vakṣye tvām adharmajña vākyaṃ kurukulādhama

ce_text: strīṣu goṣu na śastrāṇi pātayed brāhmaṇeṣu ca / yasya cānnāni bhuñjīta yaś ca syāc charaṇāgataḥ

ce_text: jñānavṛddhaṃ ca vṛddhaṃ ca bhūyāṃsaṃ keśavaṃ mama / ajānata ivākhyāsi saṃstuvan kurusattama / goghnaḥ strīghnaś ca san bhīṣma kathaṃ saṃstavam arhati

vulgate_text: kuryādyathā tvayā bhīṣama kṛtaṃ dharmamavekṣatā / cettvaṃ dharmaṃ vijānāsi yadi prājñā matistava
ce_text: ko hi dharmiṇam ātmānaṃ jānañ jñānavatāṃ varaḥ / kuryād yathā tvayā bhīṣma kṛtaṃ dharmam avekṣatā

vulgate_text: evaṃ dharmakathāṃ cakre sa haṃsaḥ pakṣiṇāṃ bhṛśam / pakṣiṇaḥ śuśruvurbhīṣma satataṃ dharmameva te
ce_text: dharmaṃ carata mādharmam iti tasya vacaḥ kila / pakṣiṇaḥ śuśruvur bhīṣma satataṃ dharmavādinaḥ

vulgate_text: yāthātathyena bhagavāndevo vā yadi vetaraḥ / śrotumicchāmi putrasya ko'sya mṛtyurbhaviṣyati
ce_text: śrotum icchāmi putrasya ko 'sya mṛtyur bhaviṣyati / antarhitaṃ tato bhūtam uvācedaṃ punar vacaḥ

vulgate_text: śiśuraṅke samārūḍho na tatprāya nidarśanam / etadeva tu saṃśrutya dvāravatyāṃ mahābalau
ce_text: evaṃ rājasahasrāṇāṃ pṛthaktvena yathākramam / śiśur aṅke samārūḍho na tat prāpa nidarśanam

vulgate_text: mā bhaistvaṃ devi dharmajñe na matto'sti bhayaṃ tava / dadāmi kaṃ varaṃ kiṃ ca karavāṇi pitṛṣvasaḥ
ce_text: dadāni kaṃ varaṃ kiṃ vā karavāṇi pitṛṣvasaḥ / śakyaṃ vā yadi vāśakyaṃ kariṣyāmi vacas tava

vulgate_text: śiśupālasyāparādhānkṣamethāstvaṃ mahābala / matkṛte yaduśārdūla viddhyenaṃ me varaṃ prabho
ce_text: evam uktā tataḥ kṛṣṇam abravīd yadunandanam / śiśupālasyāparādhān kṣamethās tvaṃ mahābala

vulgate_text: eṣa hyasya mahābāhusterjośaśca harerdhruvam / tameva punarādātuṃ kurute'tra matiṃ hariḥ
ce_text: eṣa hy asya mahābāho tejoṃśaś ca harer dhruvam / tam eva punar ādātum icchat pṛthuyaśā hariḥ

vulgate_text: ātmanindātmapūjā ca paranindā parastavaḥ / anācaritamāryāṇāmiti te bhīṣma na śrutam
ce_text: ātmanindātmapūjā ca paranindā parastavaḥ / anācaritam āryāṇāṃ vṛttam etac caturvidham

vulgate_text: evamādi tataḥ sarve sahitāste narādhipāḥ / garhaṇaṃ śiśupālasya vāsudevena viśrutaḥ
ce_text: evamādi tataḥ sarve sahitās te narādhipāḥ / vāsudevavacaḥ śrutvā cedirājaṃ vyagarhayan

vulgate_text: vāsudevavacaḥ śrutvā cedirājaṃ vyagarhayan / rathopasthe dhanuṣmantaṃ śarānsandadhataṃ ruṣā
ce_text: evamādi tataḥ sarve sahitās te narādhipāḥ / vāsudevavacaḥ śrutvā cedirājaṃ vyagarhayan

vulgate_text: prahṛṣṭāḥ keśavaṃ jagmuḥ saṃstuvanto maharṣayaḥ brāhmaṇāśca mahātmānaḥ pārthivāśca mahābalāḥ / śaśaṃsurnirvṛtāḥ sarve dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇasya vikramam
ce_text: prahṛṣṭāḥ keśavaṃ jagmuḥ saṃstuvanto maharṣayaḥ / brāhmaṇāś ca mahātmānaḥ pārthivāś ca mahābalāḥ

vulgate_text: kururājavacaḥ śrutvā bhrātaraste tvarānvitāḥ / tathā ca kṛtavantaste bhrāturvai śāsanaṃ tadā
ce_text: pāṇḍavas tv abravīd bhrātṝn satkāreṇa mahīpatim / damaghoṣātmajaṃ vīraṃ saṃsādhayata mā ciram / tathā ca kṛtavantas te bhrātur vai śāsanaṃ tadā

vulgate_text: cedīnāmādhipatye ca putraṃ tasyājñayā hareḥ / abhyaṣiñcata taṃ pārthaḥ sahitairvasudhādhipaiḥ
ce_text: cedīnām ādhipatye ca putram asya mahīpatim / abhyaṣiñcat tadā pārthaḥ saha tair vasudhādhipaiḥ

vulgate_text: tadyajñe nyavasanrājanbrāhmaṇā bhṛśamutsukāḥ / kathayantaḥ kathāḥ puṇyāḥ paśyanto naṭanartakān
ce_text: teṣu te nyavasan rājan brāhmaṇā bhṛśasatkṛtāḥ / kathayantaḥ kathā bahvīḥ paśyanto naṭanartakān

vulgate_text: bhuñjānānāṃ ca viprāṇāṃ svādubhojyaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ / aniśaṃ śrūyate tatra muditānāṃ mahātmanām
ce_text: bhuñjatāṃ caiva viprāṇāṃ vadatāṃ ca mahāsvanaḥ / aniśaṃ śrūyate smātra muditānāṃ mahātmanām

vulgate_text: tataḥ sa kururājasya sarvakarmasamṛddhimān / yajñaḥ prītikaro rājansaṃbabhau vipulotsavaḥ
ce_text: tataḥ sa kururājasya kratuḥ sarvasamṛddhimān / yūnāṃ prītikaro rājan saṃbabhau vipulaujasaḥ

vulgate_text: samāpayāmāsa ca taṃ rājasūyaṃ mahākratum / koṭisahasraṃ pradadau brāhmaṇānāṃ mahātmanām
ce_text: samāpayām āsa ca taṃ rājasūyaṃ mahākratum / taṃ tu yajñaṃ mahābāhur ā samāpter janārdanaḥ / rarakṣa bhagavāñ śauriḥ śārṅgacakragadādharaḥ

vulgate_text: kṣatraṃ samagramapi ca tvatprasādādvaśe sthitam / upādāya baliṃ mukhyaṃ māmeva samupasthitam
ce_text: samastaṃ pārthivaṃ kṣatraṃ tvatprasādād vaśānugam / upādāya baliṃ mukhyaṃ mām eva samupasthitam

vulgate_text: na hyahaṃ tvāmṛte vīraṃ ratiṃ prāpnomi karhacit / avaśyaṃ caiva gantavyā bhavatā dvārakā purī
ce_text: na vayaṃ tvām ṛte vīra raṃsyāmeha kathaṃ cana / avaśyaṃ cāpi gantavyā tvayā dvāravatī purī

vulgate_text: tato meghavapuḥ pragvyaṃ syandanaṃ ca sukalpitam / yojayitvā mahābāhurdārukaḥ samupasthitaḥ
ce_text: tato meghavaraprakhyaṃ syandanaṃ vai sukalpitam / yojayitvā mahārāja dārukaḥ pratyupasthitaḥ

vulgate_text: mahāduryodhano rājā śakuniścāpi saubalaḥ / sūtaputraśca gadheyaḥ saha duḥśāsanādibhiḥ
ce_text: gate dvāravatīṃ kṛṣṇe sātvatapravare nṛpa / eko duryodhano rājā śakuniś cāpi saubalaḥ / tasyāṃ sabhāyāṃ divyāyām ūṣatus tau nararṣabhau

vulgate_text: tataḥ sthale nipatito durmanā vrīḍito nṛpaḥ / niḥ śvasanvimukhaścāpi paricakrāma tāṃ sabhām
ce_text: svavastrotkarṣaṇaṃ rājā kṛtavān buddhimohitaḥ / durmanā vimukhaś caiva paricakrāma tāṃ sabhām

vulgate_text: jale nipatitaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhīmaseno mahābalaḥ / jahāsa jahasuścaiva kiṅkarāśca suyodhanam
ce_text: tathāgataṃ tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhīmaseno mahābalaḥ / arjunaś ca yamau cobhau sarve te prāhasaṃs tadā

vulgate_text: āruroha tataḥ sarve jahasuśca punarjanāḥ dvāraṃ tu pihitākāraṃ sphāṭikaṃ prekṣya bhūmipaḥ / praviśannāhato mūrdhni vyāghūrṇita iva sthitaḥ
ce_text: punar vasanam utkṣipya pratariṣyann iva sthalam / āruroha tataḥ sarve jahasus te punar janāḥ

vulgate_text: dvāraṃ tu vitatākāraṃ samāpede punaśca saḥ / tadvṛttaṃ ceti manvāno dvārasthānādupāramat
ce_text: dvāraṃ ca vivṛtākāraṃ lalāṭena samāhanat / saṃvṛtaṃ ceti manvāno dvāradeśād upāramat

vulgate_text: vidhānaṃ vividhākāraṃ paraṃ teṣāṃ vidhānataḥ / anekairabhyupāyaiśca tvayā na śakitāḥ purā
ce_text: anekair abhyupāyaiś ca tvayārabdhāḥ purāsakṛt / vimuktāś ca naravyāghrā bhāgadheyapuraskṛtāḥ

vulgate_text: ārabdhā hi mahārāja punaḥ punararindama vimuktāśca naravyāghrā bhagadheyapuraskṛtāḥ / utsāhavantaḥ puruṣā nāvasīdanti karmasu
ce_text: anekair abhyupāyaiś ca tvayārabdhāḥ purāsakṛt / vimuktāś ca naravyāghrā bhāgadheyapuraskṛtāḥ

vulgate_text: droṇastava maheṣvāsaḥ saha putreṇa vīryavān / mūtaputraśca rādheyo dṛḍhadhanvā mahārathaḥ
ce_text: droṇas tava maheṣvāsaḥ saha putreṇa dhīmatā / sūtaputraś ca rādheyo gautamaś ca mahārathaḥ

vulgate_text: anubhūya tu rājñastaṃ rājasūyaṃ sudurmatiḥ / yudhiṣṭhirasya śakunirduryodhasusaṃyutaḥ
ce_text: anubhūya tu rājñas taṃ rājasūyaṃ mahākratum / yudhiṣṭhirasya nṛpater gāndhārīputrasaṃyutaḥ

vulgate_text: mātrā pitrā ca putrasya yadvai kāryaṃ paraṃ smṛtam / prāptastvamasi tattāta nikhilāṃ naḥ kulaśriyam
ce_text: pitrā mātrā ca putrasya yad vai kāryaṃ paraṃ smṛtam / prāptas tvam asi tat tāta pitṛpaitāmahaṃ padam

vulgate_text: pṛthagjanairalabhyaṃ yadaśanācchādanaṃ bahu / prabhuḥ sanbhuñjase putra saṃstutaḥ sūtamāgadhaiḥ
ce_text: pṛthagjanair alabhyaṃ yad bhojanācchādanaṃ param / tat prāpto 'si mahābāho kasmāc chocasi putraka

vulgate_text: tasya te viditaprajña śokamūlamidaṃ katham / lokesmiñjyeṣṭhabhāganyastanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ
ce_text: tasya te viditaprajña śokamūlam idaṃ katham / samutthitaṃ duḥkhataraṃ tan me śaṃsitum arhasi

vulgate_text: triṃśaddāsīka ekaiko yānbibharti yudhiṣṭhiraḥ daśānyāni sahasrāṇi yatīnāmūrdhvaretasām / bhuñjate rukmapātrībhiryudhiṣṭhiraniveśane
ce_text: daśānyāni sahasrāṇi nityaṃ tatrānnam uttamam / bhuñjate rukmapātrībhir yudhiṣṭhiraniveśane

vulgate_text: triśataṃ coṣṭravāmīnāṃ śatāni vicarantyuta / rājanyā balimādāya sametā hi nṛpakṣaye
ce_text: rathayoṣidgavāśvasya śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ / triṃśataṃ coṣṭravāmīnāṃ śatāni vicaranty uta

vulgate_text: asatyaṃ cedidaṃ sarvaṃ sañjayaṃ praṣṭumarhasi aparyantaṃ dhanaughaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā śatrorahaṃ nṛpa / śarma naivābhigacchāmi cintayāno viśāmpate
ce_text: aparyantaṃ dhanaughaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā śatror ahaṃ nṛpa / śarma naivādhigacchāmi cintayāno 'niśaṃ vibho

vulgate_text: kamaṇḍalūnupādāya jātarūpamayāñśubhān / traikharvāḥ prativedyāsmai lebhire'tha praveśanam
ce_text: kamaṇḍalūn upādāya jātarūpamayāñ śubhān / evaṃ baliṃ samādāya praveśaṃ lebhire tataḥ

vulgate_text: śaṅkhapravaramādāya vāsudevo'bhiṣiktavān / śakyaṃ rukmasahasrasya bahuratnavibhūṣitam
ce_text: śaikyaṃ rukmasahasrasya bahuratnavibhūṣitam / dṛṣṭvā ca mama tat sarvaṃ jvararūpam ivābhavat

vulgate_text: tathaiva paścimaṃ yānti gṛhītvā bharatarṣabha uttaraṃ tu na gacchanti vinā tāta patatriṇaḥ / tatra gatvā'rjuno daṇḍamājahārāmitaṃ dhanam
ce_text: gṛhītvā tat tu gacchanti samudrau pūrvadakṣiṇau / tathaiva paścimaṃ yānti gṛhītvā bharatarṣabha

vulgate_text: pitrorarthe viśeṣeṇa prāvṛṇvaṃ tatra jīvitam / tatra tma yadi śaktaḥ syāṃ ghātayeyaṃ vṛkodaram
ce_text: tatra sma yadi śaktaḥ syāṃ pātayeyaṃ vṛkodaram / sapatnenāvahāso hi sa māṃ dahati bhārata

vulgate_text: pārthivairbahubhiḥ kīrṇamupasthānaṃ didṛkṣubhiḥ / aśobhata mahārāja nakṣatrairdyairivāmalā
ce_text: pārthivair bahubhiḥ kīrṇam upasthānaṃ didṛkṣubhiḥ / sarvaratnāny upādāya pārthivā vai janeśvara

vulgate_text: evamuktastato rājñā vyāsaśiṣyaḥ pratāpavān / ācacakṣe'tha yadvṛttaṃ tatsarvaṃ vedatattvavid
ce_text: evam uktas tadā rājñā vyāsaśiṣyaḥ pratāpavān / ācacakṣe yathāvṛttaṃ tat sarvaṃ sarvavedavit

vulgate_text: tatra sma yadi śaktaḥ syaṃ pātaye'haṃ vṛkodaram / yadi kuryāṃ samārambhaṃ bhīmaṃ hantuṃ narādhipa
ce_text: tatra sma yadi śaktaḥ syāṃ pātayeyaṃ vṛkodaram / sapatnenāvahāso hi sa māṃ dahati bhārata

vulgate_text: śiśupāla ivāsmākaṃ gatiḥ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ / sapatnenāvahāso me sa māṃ dahati bhārata
ce_text: tatra sma yadi śaktaḥ syāṃ pātayeyaṃ vṛkodaram / sapatnenāvahāso hi sa māṃ dahati bhārata

vulgate_text: madhyandinārkapratimāṃstejasā jvalitāniva / baliṃ ca kṛtsnamādāya pāṇḍavāya nyavedayat
ce_text: javasattvopapannānāṃ vayaḥsthānāṃ narādhipa / baliṃ ca kṛtsnam ādāya pāṇḍavebhyo nyavedayat

vulgate_text: daśārṇaścedirājaśca śūrasenaśca vīryavān vastrāṇi mukhyānyādāya ratnāni vividhāni ca / baliṃ ca kṛtsnamādāya pāṇḍavāya nyavedayat
ce_text: javasattvopapannānāṃ vayaḥsthānāṃ narādhipa / baliṃ ca kṛtsnam ādāya pāṇḍavebhyo nyavedayat

vulgate_text: hārānmukhyānparārdhyāṃśca vividhaṃ ca vibhūṣaṇam / śataṃ dāsīsahasrāṇi kārpāsikanivāsinām
ce_text: śataṃ dāsīsahasrāṇāṃ kārpāsikanivāsinām / śyāmās tanvyo dīrghakeśyo hemābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ / śūdrā viprottamārhāṇi rāṅkavāny ajināni ca

vulgate_text: upāyanaṃ yadā dadyustadā dvāramalabhyata / indrakṛṣṭairvardhayanti dhānyairnadamukhaistu ye
ce_text: indrakṛṣṭair vartayanti dhānyair nadīmukhaiś ca ye / samudraniṣkuṭe jātāḥ parisindhu ca mānavāḥ

vulgate_text: baliṃ ca kṛtsnamādāya dvāri tiṣṭhati vāritaḥ / aśvasāramayānbhāṇḍāñchubhāndantatsarūnasīn
ce_text: ājāneyān hayāñ śīghrān ādāyānilaraṃhasaḥ / baliṃ ca kṛtsnam ādāya dvāri tiṣṭhati vāritaḥ

vulgate_text: jātarūpamanarghyaṃ ca dadustasyaikapādakāḥ / siṃhalaśca tadā rājā parigṛhya dhanaṃ bahu
ce_text: anekavarṇān āraṇyān gṛhītvāśvān manojavān / jātarūpam anarghyaṃ ca dadus tasyaikapādakāḥ

vulgate_text: anyāṃśca vividhāndravyānparigṛhyopatasthire / ete sarve mahātmāno dvāri tiṣṭhanti vāritāḥ
ce_text: govāsanā brāhmaṇāś ca dāsamīyāś ca sarvaśaḥ / prītyarthaṃ te mahābhāgā dharmarājño mahātmanaḥ / trikharvaṃ balim ādāya dvāri tiṣṭhanti vāritāḥ

vulgate_text: śitāndīrghānasīnanyānyaṣṭiśaktiparaśvathān / ślakṣṇaṃ vastramakārpasamāvikaṃ mṛdu cājinam
ce_text: kuṭṭīkṛtaṃ tathaivānyat kamalābhaṃ sahasraśaḥ / ślakṣṇaṃ vastram akārpāsam āvikaṃ mṛdu cājinam

vulgate_text: hayairvinītaiḥ sampannānvaiyāghraparivāritān vicitrānsaparistomāṃścāpāni vividhāni ca
ce_text: rathāṃś ca vividhākārāñ jātarūpapariṣkṛtān / hayair vinītaiḥ saṃpannān vaiyāghraparivāraṇān

vulgate_text: praviṣṭo yajñasadanaṃ pāṇḍavasya mahātmanaḥ / jantucelāndvisāhasrāndukūlānyayutāni ca
ce_text: etad dattvā mahad dravyaṃ pūrvadeśādhipo nṛpaḥ / praviṣṭo yajñasadanaṃ pāṇḍavasya mahātmanaḥ

vulgate_text: imāṃśca dāyānvividhānnibodha mama pārthiva / yajñāpthe rājabhirdattānmahato dhanasañcayān
ce_text: dāyaṃ tu tasmai vividhaṃ śṛṇu me gadato 'nagha / yajñārthaṃ rājabhir dattaṃ mahāntaṃ dhanasaṃcayam

vulgate_text: tadvai pipīlikaṃ nāma uddhṛtaṃ yatpipīlikaiḥ / jātarūpaṃ droṇameyamahārṣuḥ kuñjaśo narāḥ
ce_text: te vai pipīlikaṃ nāma varadattaṃ pipīlikaiḥ / jātarūpaṃ droṇameyam ahārṣuḥ puñjaśo nṛpāḥ

vulgate_text: kṛṣṇavālāṃśca camarāñchuklavālāṃstathā parān / himavatpuṣpajaṃ caiva svādukṣaudrarasaṃ bahu
ce_text: kṛṣṇāṃl lalāmāṃś camarāñ śuklāṃś cānyāñ śaśiprabhān / himavatpuṣpajaṃ caiva svādu kṣaudraṃ tathā bahu

vulgate_text: ye parārghyā himavataḥ sūryodayagireranu / evaṃrūpāḥ samudrānte lauhityamabhitaśca ye
ce_text: ye parārdhe himavataḥ sūryodayagirau nṛpāḥ / vāriṣeṇasamudrānte lohityam abhitaś ca ye / phalamūlāśanā ye ca kirātāś carmavāsasaḥ

vulgate_text: cauṇḍikāścaudakāścaiva sālvāścaiva viśampate / aṅkavaṅkāśca yavanā anavadyā gayaiḥ saha
ce_text: śauṇḍikāḥ kukkurāś caiva śakāś caiva viśāṃ pate / aṅgā vaṅgāś ca puṇḍrāś ca śānavatyā gayās tathā

vulgate_text: kṣamāvataḥ kulīnāṃśca kuñjarānsaparicchadān / dattvaikaiko daśaśatāndvāreṇa praviśantviti
ce_text: dattvaikaiko daśaśatān kuñjarān kavacāvṛtān / kṣamāvataḥ kulīnāṃś ca dvāreṇa prāviśaṃs tataḥ

vulgate_text: samudrasāravaiḍūryānmuktāḥ śaṅkhāstathaiva ca / śubhāvartāñchubhāñchuktīḥ siṃhalāḥ samupāharan
ce_text: samudrasāraṃ vaiḍūryaṃ muktāḥ śaṅkhāṃs tathaiva ca / śataśaś ca kuthāṃs tatra siṃhalāḥ samupāharan

vulgate_text: nābhuktavantaṃ nāpītaṃ nālaṅkṛtamasatkṛtam / apaśyaṃ sarvavarṇānāṃ yudhiṣṭhiraniveśane
ce_text: nābhuktavantaṃ nāhṛṣṭaṃ nāsubhikṣaṃ kathaṃ cana / apaśyaṃ sarvavarṇānāṃ yudhiṣṭhiraniveśane

vulgate_text: sunīthaḥ prītimāṃścaiva hyanukarṣaṃ mahābalaḥ / dhvajaṃ cedipatiścaivamahārṣītsvayamudyatam
ce_text: sunītho 'pratimaṃ tasya anukarṣaṃ mahāyaśāḥ / dhvajaṃ cedipatiḥ kṣipram ahārṣīt svayam udyatam

vulgate_text: cāmare cāpi śuddhe dve yamau jagṛhatustathā / upāgṛhṇādyamindrāya purākalpe prajāpatiḥ
ce_text: upāgṛhṇād yam indrāya purākalpe prajāpatiḥ / tam asmai śaṅkham āhārṣīd vāruṇaṃ kalaśodadhiḥ

vulgate_text: prāṇadanta samādhmātāstato romāṇi me'hṛṣan / prāpatanbhūmipālāśca ye tu hīnāḥ svatejasā
ce_text: tatra sma dadhmuḥ śataśaḥ śaṅkhān maṅgalyakāraṇāt / prāṇadaṃs te samādhmātās tatra romāṇi me 'hṛṣan

vulgate_text: śaunakenaivamuktastu kuntīputro yudhiṣṭhiḥ praṇamya dvijaśārdūlaṃ pūjyavākyaṃ subhāṣitam / purohitamupāgamya bhrātṛmadhye'bravīṣidam
ce_text: śaunakenaivam uktas tu kuntīputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / purohitam upāgamya bhrātṛmadhye 'bravīd idam

vulgate_text: [vipratyāgasamādhisthaḥ saṃyatātmā dṛḍhavrataḥ dharmarājo viśuddhātmā tapa ātiṣṭhaduttamam ]
ce_text: evam uktas tu dhaumyena tat kālasadṛśaṃ vacaḥ / dharmarājo viśuddhātmā tapa ātiṣṭhad uttamam

vulgate_text: puṣpopahārairbalibhirarcayitvā divākaram / so'vagāhya jalaṃ rājā devasyābhimukho'bhavat
ce_text: puṣpopahārair balibhir arcayitvā divākaram / yogam āsthāya dharmātmā vāyubhakṣo jitendriyaḥ / gāṅgeyaṃ vāry upaspṛṣya prāṇāyāmena tasthivān

vulgate_text: gāṅgeyaṃ vāryupaspṛśya prāṇāyāmena tasthivān [śuciḥ prayatavāgbhūtvā stotramārabdhavāṃstataḥ
ce_text: puṣpopahārair balibhir arcayitvā divākaram / yogam āsthāya dharmātmā vāyubhakṣo jitendriyaḥ / gāṅgeyaṃ vāry upaspṛṣya prāṇāyāmena tasthivān

vulgate_text: kaṇṭhadaghne jale sthitvā mantraiḥ stotraiśca toṣitaḥ tato divākaraḥ prīto darśayāmāsa pāṇḍavam / dīpyamānaḥ svavapuṣā jvalanniva hutāśanaḥ
ce_text: tato divākaraḥ prīto darśayām āsa pāṇḍavam / dīpyamānaḥ svavapuṣā jvalann iva hutāśanaḥ

vulgate_text: phalamūlāmiṣaṃ śākaṃ saṃskṛtaṃ yanmahānase caturvidhaṃ tadannādyamakṣayyaṃ te bhaviṣyati / itaścaturdaśe varṣe bhūyo rājyamavāpsyasi
ce_text: phalamūlāmiṣaṃ śākaṃ saṃskṛtaṃ yan mahānase / caturvidhaṃ tadannādyam akṣayyaṃ te bhaviṣyati / dhanaṃ ca vividhaṃ tubhyam ity uktvāntaradhīyata

vulgate_text: bhūtāśrayo bhūtapatisarvabhūtaniṣevitaḥ maṇiḥ suvarṇo bhūtātmā kāmadaḥ sarvatomukhaḥ / [sraṣṭā saṃvartako vahniḥ sarvasyādiralolupaḥ
ce_text: bhūtāśrayo bhūtapatiḥ sarvabhūtaniṣevitaḥ / maṇiḥ suvarṇo bhūtādiḥ kāmadaḥ sarvatomukhaḥ

vulgate_text: anantaḥ kapilo bhānuḥ kāmadaḥ sarvatomukhaḥ ] jayo viśālo varadaḥ sarvadhātuniṣecitā
ce_text: bhūtāśrayo bhūtapatiḥ sarvabhūtaniṣevitaḥ / maṇiḥ suvarṇo bhūtādiḥ kāmadaḥ sarvatomukhaḥ

vulgate_text: [yaśo ne naśyejjñātibhedaśca na syāddharmo na syānnaiva caivaṃ kṛte tvām ] / etatkārye tava sarvapradhānaṃ teṣāṃ tuṣṭiḥ śakuneścāvamānaḥ
ce_text: etat kāryaṃ tava sarvapradhānaṃ teṣāṃ tuṣṭiḥ śakuneś cāvamānaḥ / evaṃ śeṣaṃ yadi putreṣu te syād etad rājaṃs tvaramāṇaḥ kuruṣva

vulgate_text: duryodhanaṃ tvahitaṃ vai nigṛhya pāṇḍoḥ putraṃ prakuruṣvādhipatye / dhruvaṃ vināśastava putreṇa dhīman sabandhuvargeṇa sahaiva rājabhiḥ
ce_text: yady etad evam anumantā sutas te saṃprīyamāṇaḥ pāṇḍavair ekarājyam / tāpo na te vai bhavitā prītiyogāt tvaṃ cen na gṛhṇāsi sutaṃ sahāyaiḥ / athāparo bhavati hi taṃ nigṛhya pāṇḍoḥ putraṃ prakuruṣvādhipatye

vulgate_text: yudhiṣṭhiramupāgamya pūjayāmāsa saṃjayaḥ / bhīmārjunayamāścāpi tadyuktaṃ pratipedire
ce_text: yudhiṣṭhiram athābhyetya pūjayām āsa saṃjayaḥ / bhīmārjunayamāṃś cāpi tadarhaṃ pratyapadyata

vulgate_text: priyaṃ sarve kariṣyāmo rājñaḥ kiṃ karavāmahe / na cāsya śaknumaḥ sthātuṃ priye sarve hyatandritāḥ
ce_text: priyaṃ sarve cikīrṣāmo rājñaḥ kiṃkarapāṇayaḥ / na cāsya śaknumaḥ sarve priye sthātum atandritāḥ

vulgate_text: pāṇḍavānprāpya tānrātrau kirmīro nāma rākṣasaḥ / avṛtya mārgaṃ raudrātmā tasthau girivācalaḥ
ce_text: itaḥ pracyavatāṃ rātrau yaḥ sa teṣāṃ mahātmanām / āvṛtya mārgaṃ raudrātmā tasthau girir ivācalaḥ

vulgate_text: ākramya ca kaṭīdeśe jānunā rākṣasādhamam / pīḍayāmāsa pāṇibhyāṃ tasya kaṇṭhaṃvṛkodaraḥ
ce_text: ākramya sa kaṭīdeśe jānunā rākṣasādhamam / apīḍayata bāhubhyāṃ kaṇṭhaṃ tasya vṛkodaraḥ

vulgate_text: ātiṣṭhastvamathaikena pādena niyamasthitaḥ / lokapravṛttihetostvamiti vyāso mamābravīt
ce_text: prabhāsaṃ cāpy athāsādya tīrthaṃ puṇyajanocitam / tathā kṛṣṇa mahātejā divyaṃ varṣasahasrakam / ātiṣṭhas tapa ekena pādena niyame sthitaḥ

vulgate_text: tathā parjanyaghoṣeṇa rathenādityavarcasā / ahārṣī rukmiṇīṃ bhaiṣmīṃ raṇe nirjitya rukmiṇe
ce_text: tathā parjanyaghoṣeṇa rathenādityavarcasā / avākṣīr mahiṣīṃ bhojyāṃ raṇe nirjitya rukmiṇam

vulgate_text: tathā nārāyaṇa purā kratubhirbhūridakṣiṇaiḥ / iṣṭavāṃstvaṃ mahāsatraṃ kṛṣṇa caitrarathe vane
ce_text: turāyaṇādibhir deva kratubhir bhūridakṣiṇaiḥ / ayajo bhūritejā vai kṛṣṇa caitrarathe vane

vulgate_text: evamukte tu vacane keśevena mahātmanā / tasminvīrasamāvāye saṃrabdheṣvatha rājasu
ce_text: tasmin vīrasamāvāye saṃrabdheṣv atha rājasu / dhṛṣṭadyumnamukhair vīrair bhrātṛbhiḥ parivāritā

vulgate_text: dyauśca te śirasā vyāptā padbhyāṃ ca pṛthivīprabho / jaṭhare khamime lokāḥ puruṣosi sanātanaḥ
ce_text: divaṃ te śirasā vyāptaṃ padbhyāṃ ca pṛthivī vibho / jaṭharaṃ te ime lokāḥ puruṣo 'si sanātanaḥ

vulgate_text: keśagrahamanuprāptā kā nu jīveta mādṛśī / pañcānāmindrakalpānāṃ prekṣatāṃ madhusūdana
ce_text: kacagraham anuprāptā sāsmi kṛṣṇa varā satī / pañcānām indrakalpānāṃ prekṣatāṃ madhusūdana

vulgate_text: putrāṇāṃ tava rājendra tvannimittamiti prabho / tatrācakṣamahaṃ doṣānyairbhavānvyatiropitaḥ
ce_text: vaicitravīryaṃ rājānam alaṃ dyūtena kaurava / putrāṇāṃ tava rājendra tvannimittam iti prabho

vulgate_text: athainamavinītena suhṛdo nāma durhṛdaḥ / sabhāsado'nuvarteraṃstāṃśca inyāṃ durodarān
ce_text: athainān abhinīyaivaṃ suhṛdo nāma durhṛdaḥ / sabhāsadaś ca tān sarvān bhedayeyaṃ durodarān

vulgate_text: atikhyātakulairvīrairdṛṣṭavīryaiśca saṃyuge madhyamena ca gulmena rakṣibhiḥ sā surakṣitā / utkṣiptagulmaiśca tathā hayaiśca sapatākibhiḥ
ce_text: madhyamena ca gulmena rakṣitā sārasaṃjñitā / utkṣiptagulmaiś ca tathā hayaiś caiva padātibhiḥ

vulgate_text: amṛṣyamāṇopasavyaṃ sālvaḥ samitidāruṇaḥ / yantāramasya sahasā tribhirbāṇaiḥ samārdayat
ce_text: amṛṣyamāṇo 'pasavyaṃ pradyumnena sa saubharāṭ / yantāram asya sahasā tribhir bāṇaiḥ samarpayat

vulgate_text: te hayāṃśca rathaṃ caiva dhvajaṃ dārukameva ca / chādayāmāsurasurāstairbāṇairmarmabhedibhiḥ
ce_text: te hayān me rathaṃ caiva tadā dārukam eva ca / chādayām āsur asurā bāṇair marmavibhedibhiḥ

vulgate_text: tato gadā halāḥ prāsāḥ śūlaśaktiparaścathāḥ asayaḥ śaktikuliśapāśarṣṭikanapāḥ śarāḥ / paṭṭasāśca bhuśuṇḍyaśca prapatantyaniśaṃ mayi
ce_text: tato huḍahuḍāḥ prāsāḥ śaktiśūlaparaśvadhāḥ / paṭṭiśāś ca bhuśuṇḍyaś ca prāpatann aniśaṃ mayi

vulgate_text: aṅgārapāṃsuvarṣaṃ ca śastravarṣaṃ ca bhārata / evaṃ māyāṃ prakurvāṇo yodhayāmāsa māṃ ripuḥ
ce_text: evaṃ māyāṃ vikurvāṇo yodhayām āsa māṃ ripuḥ / vijñāya tad ahaṃ sarvaṃ māyayaiva vyanāśayam / yathākālaṃ tu yuddhena vyadhamaṃ sarvataḥ śaraiḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ parvatabhārārtānmandaprāṇaviceṣṭitān / hayānsaṃdṛśya māṃ sūtaḥ prāha tātkālikaṃ vacaḥ
ce_text: tataḥ parvatabhārārtā mandaprāṇaviceṣṭitāḥ / hayā mama mahārāja vepamānā ivābhavan

vulgate_text: yā tvā'haṃ kauśikairvastraiḥ śubhrairācchāditaṃ purā / dṛṣṭavatyasmirājenadra sā'dya paśyāmi cīriṇam
ce_text: yā vai tvā kauśikair vastraiḥ śubhrair bahudhanaiḥ purā / dṛṣṭavaty asmi rājendra sā tvāṃ paśyāmi cīriṇam

vulgate_text: satkṛtāni sahasrāṇi sarvakāmaiḥ purā gṛhe sarvakāmaiḥ suvihitairyadapūjayathā dvijān / tacca rājannapaśyantyāḥ kā śāntirhṛdayasya me
ce_text: yad apaśyaṃ sabhāyāṃ tvāṃ rājabhiḥ parivāritam / tac ca rājann apaśyantyāḥ kā śāntir hṛdayasya me

vulgate_text: drupadasya kule jātāṃ snuṣāṃ pāṇḍormahātmanaḥ dhṛṣṭadyumnasya bhaginīṃ vīrapatnīmanuvratām / māṃ vai vanagatāṃ dṛṣṭvā kasmātkṣamasi pārthiva
ce_text: drupadasya kule jātāṃ snuṣāṃ pāṇḍor mahātmanaḥ / māṃ te vanagatāṃ dṛṣṭvā kasmān manyur na vardhate

vulgate_text: tasmānnātyutsṛjettejo na ca nityaṃ mṛdurbhavet / kālekāle tu saṃprāpte mṛdustīkṣṇopi vā bhavet
ce_text: yasmād udvijate lokaḥ kathaṃ tasya bhavo bhavet / antaraṃ hy asya dṛṣṭvaiva loko vikurute dhruvam / tasmān nātyutsṛjet tejo na ca nityaṃ mṛdur bhavet

vulgate_text: yo hi saṃharate krodhaṃ bhāvastasya suśobhane yo na saṃharate krodhaṃ tasyābhāvo bhavatyuta / abhāvakāraṇaṃ tasmātkrodho bhavati śobhane
ce_text: yo hi saṃharate krodhaṃ bhāvas tasya suśobhane / yaḥ punaḥ puruṣaḥ krodhaṃ nityaṃ na sahate śubhe / tasyābhāvāya bhavati krodhaḥ paramadāruṇaḥ

vulgate_text: satyaṃcānṛtataḥ śreyo nṛśaṃsāccānṛśaṃsatā tamevaṃ bahudoṣaṃ ta krodhaṃ sadbhirvivarjitam / mādṛśo visṛjettasmātsarvalokavināśanam
ce_text: satyaṃ cānṛtataḥ śreyo nṛśaṃsāc cānṛśaṃsatā / tam evaṃ bahudoṣaṃ tu krodhaṃ sādhuvivarjitam / mādṛśaḥ prasṛjet kasmāt suyodhanavadhād api

vulgate_text: pitāmahaḥ śāntanavaḥ raśamaṃ saṃpūjayiṣyati / kṛṣṇaśca devakīputraḥ śamaṃ saṃpūjayiṣyati
ce_text: pitāmahaḥ śāṃtanavaḥ śamaṃ saṃpūjayiṣyati / ācāryo viduraḥ kṣattā śamam eva vadiṣyataḥ / kṛpaś ca saṃjayaś caiva śamam eva vadiṣyataḥ

vulgate_text: bhuñjate rukmapātrībhiryatrāhaṃ paricārikā āraṇyakebhyo vanyāni bhojanāni prayacchasi / nādeyaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaste gṛhe kiṃcana vidyate
ce_text: āraṇyakebhyo lauhāni bhājanāni prayacchasi / nādeyaṃ brāhmaṇebhyas te gṛhe kiṃ cana vidyate

vulgate_text: aśvamedho rājasūyaḥ pauṇḍarīko'tha gosavaḥ / iṣṭāstvayā mahāyajñābahavo'nye sadakṣiṇāḥ
ce_text: aśvamedho rājasūyaḥ puṇḍarīko 'tha gosavaḥ / etair api mahāyajñair iṣṭaṃ te bhūridakṣiṇaiḥ

vulgate_text: rājanparītayā buddhyā viṣame'kṣaparājaye / pārtha mitrāṇi cāsmāṃśca vasūni ca parājitaḥ
ce_text: rājan parītayā buddhyā viṣame 'kṣaparājaye / rājyaṃ vasūny āyudhāni bhrātṝn māṃ cāsi nirjitaḥ

vulgate_text: atīva moha āyāti manaś paridūyate / niśāmya vyasanaṃ pārtha tavedamatiduḥsaham
ce_text: atīva moham āyāti manaś ca paridūyate / niśāmya te duḥkham idam imāṃ cāpadam īdṛśīm

vulgate_text: dharma eva manaḥ kṛṣṇe svabhāvāccaiva me dhṛtam [dharmavāṇijyako hīno jaghanyo dharmavādinām]
ce_text: dharmaṃ carāmi suśroṇi na dharmaphalakāraṇāt / āgamān anatikramya satāṃ vṛttam avekṣya ca / dharma eva manaḥ kṛṣṇe svabhāvāc caiva me dhṛtam

vulgate_text: unmattānmanyate bālaḥ sarvānāgataniścayān / dharmātiśaṅkī nānyasminpramāṇamadhigacchati
ce_text: dharmātiśaṅkī nānyasmin pramāṇam adhigacchati / ātmapramāṇa unnaddhaḥ śreyaso hy avamanyakaḥ

vulgate_text: naitāni veda yaḥ kaścinmuhyantyatra prajā imāḥ [api kalpasahasreṇa na ca śreyo'dhigacchati ]
ce_text: naitāni veda yaḥ kaś cin muhyanty atra prajā imāḥ / rakṣyāṇy etāni devānāṃ gūḍhamāyā hi devatāḥ

vulgate_text: sarvameva haṭhenaike daivenaike vadantyuta / puṃsaḥ prayatnajaṃ keciddaivametadviśiṣyate
ce_text: sarvam eva haṭhenaike diṣṭenaike vadanty uta / puruṣaprayatnajaṃ ke cit traidham etan nirucyate

vulgate_text: guṇābhāve phalaṃ nyūnaṃ bhavatyaphalameva ca / anārambhe hi na phalaṃ na guṇo dṛśyate kvacit
ce_text: bahūnāṃ samavāye hi bhāvānāṃ karma sidhyati / guṇābhāve phalaṃ nyūnaṃ bhavaty aphalam eva vā / anārambhe tu na phalaṃ na guṇo dṛśyate 'cyuta

vulgate_text: itiloke nirvacanaṃ puraścarati bhārata / api caitāḥ striyo bālāḥ svādhyāyamadhikurvate
ce_text: iti nirvacanaṃ loke ciraṃ carati bhārata / api caitat striyo bālāḥ svādhyāyam iva kurvate

vulgate_text: āśīviṣasamairvīrairmarudbhiriva vṛtrahā amitrāṃstejasā mṛdgannasurāniva vṛtrahā / śriyamādatsva kaunteya dhārtarāṣṭrānmahābala
ce_text: amitrāṃs tejasā mṛdnann asurebhya ivārihā / śriyam ādatsva kaunteya dhārtarāṣṭrān mahābala

vulgate_text: dhārtarāṣṭrānmahārāja kṣamase kiṃ durātmanaḥ / kartavye puruṣavyāghra kimāsse pīṭhasarpavat
ce_text: kartavye puruṣavyāghra kim āsse pīṭhasarpavat / buddhyā vīryeṇa saṃyuktaḥ śrutenābhijanena ca

vulgate_text: etadvacanamājñāya bhīmaseno'tyamarṣaṇaḥ / babhūva śāntisaṃyukto gurorvacanavāritaḥ
ce_text: etad vacanam ājñāya bhīmaseno 'tyamarṣaṇaḥ / babhūva vimanās trasto na caivovāca kiṃ cana

vulgate_text: bhīṣmāddroṇātkṛpātkarṇāddroṇaputrācca bhārata / duryodhanānnṛpasutāttathā duḥśāsanādapi
ce_text: bhīṣmād droṇāt kṛpāt karṇād droṇaputrāc ca bhārata / yat te bhayam amitraghna hṛdi saṃparivartate

vulgate_text: tacchrutvā dhṛtimāsthāya karmaṇā pratipādaya / pratipādya tu rājendra tataḥ kṣipraṃ jvaraṃ jahi
ce_text: tat te 'haṃ nāśayiṣyāmi vidhidṛṣṭena hetunā / tac chrutvā dhṛtim āsthāya karmaṇā pratipādaya

vulgate_text: ṛṣireṣa mehātejā nārāyaṇasahāyavān / purāṇaḥ śāsvato devastvajeyo jiṣṇuracyutaḥ
ce_text: ṛṣir eṣa mahātejā nārāyaṇasahāyavān / purāṇaḥ śāśvato devo viṣṇor aṃśaḥ sanātanaḥ

vulgate_text: ācāryā mānitāstuṣṭāḥ śāntiṃ vyavaharannyuta / śaktiṃ na hāpayiṣyanti te kāle pratipūjitāḥ
ce_text: sarvayodheṣu caivāsya sadā vṛttir anuttamā / śaktiṃ na hāpayiṣyanti te kāle pratipūjitāḥ

vulgate_text: adya ceyaṃ mahī kṛtsnā duryādhanavaśānugā sagrāmanagarā pārtha sasāgaravanākarā bhavāneva priyo'smākaṃ tvayi bhāraḥ samāhitaḥ
ce_text: adya ceyaṃ mahī kṛtsnā duryodhanavaśānugā / tvayi vyapāśrayo 'smākaṃ tvayi bhāraḥ samāhitaḥ / tatra kṛtyaṃ prapaśyāmi prāptakālam ariṃdama

vulgate_text: dhanuṣmānkavacī khaṅgī muniḥ sādhuvrate sthitaḥ / na kasyaciddadanmārgaṃ gaccha tātottarāṃ diśam
ce_text: dhanuṣmān kavacī khaḍgī muniḥ sārasamanvitaḥ / na kasya cid dadan mārgaṃ gaccha tātottarāṃ diśam / indre hy astrāṇi divyāni samastāni dhanaṃjaya

vulgate_text: tānyekasthāni sarvāṇi tatastvaṃ pratipatsyase anena brahmaṇā tāta sarvaṃ saṃpratipadyate
ce_text: vṛtrād bhītais tadā devair balam indre samarpitam / tāny ekasthāni sarvāṇi tatas tvaṃ pratipatsyase

vulgate_text: kṣipramāpnuhi kaunteya manasā yadyadicchasi / saṃsādhayasva kaunteya dhruvostu vijayastava
ce_text: taṃ dṛṣṭvā tatra kaunteyaṃ pragṛhītaśarāsanam / abruvan brāhmaṇāḥ siddhā bhūtāny antarhitāni ca / kṣipraṃ prāpnuhi kaunteya manasā yad yad icchasi

vulgate_text: abhivādya tu tau vīrāvūcatuḥ pākaśāsanim avāptavyāni sarvāṇi divyānyastrāṇi vāsavāt - - castrāṇyāpnuhi kaunteya manasā yadyadicchasi
ce_text: taṃ dṛṣṭvā tatra kaunteyaṃ pragṛhītaśarāsanam / abruvan brāhmaṇāḥ siddhā bhūtāny antarhitāni ca / kṣipraṃ prāpnuhi kaunteya manasā yad yad icchasi

vulgate_text: kartumarhasi kauravya maghavadvacanaṃ hitam / dīkṣitvā'dyaiva gaccha tvaṃ draṣṭā'si tvaṃ purandaram
ce_text: śakram eva prapadyasva sa te 'strāṇi pradāsyati / dīkṣito 'dyaiva gaccha tvaṃ draṣṭuṃ devaṃ puraṃdaram

vulgate_text: gṛhītvā cāśvahṛdayaṃ prīto bhāgasvarirnṛpa niṣadhādhipateścāpi dattā'kṣahṛdayaṃ nṛpaḥ / sūtamanyamupādāya yayau svapurameva ha

ce_text: ṛṣikulyāṃ naraḥ snātvā ṛṣilokaṃ prapadyate / yadi tatra vasen māsaṃ śākāhāro narādhipa
