vulgate_text: sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā somalokaṃ brajedbhuvam / tatra cihniṃ mahadrājannadyāpi sumahadbhṛśam
ce_text: tato gaccheta rājendra dhenukāṃ lokaviśrutām / ekarātroṣito rājan prayacchet tiladhenukām / sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā somalokaṃ vrajed dhruvam

vulgate_text: kapilāyāḥ savatsāyāścarantyāḥ parvate kṛtam / savatsāyāḥ padāni sma dṛśyante'dyāpi bhārata
ce_text: tatra cihnaṃ mahārāja adyāpi hi na saṃśayaḥ / kapilā saha vatsena parvate vicaraty uta / savatsāyāḥ padāni sma dṛśyante 'dyāpi bhārata

vulgate_text: taṃ praviśyāśramaṃ śrīmacchramaśokavināśanam / gavāmayanayajñasya phalaṃprāpnoti mānavaḥ
ce_text: kalaśyāṃ cāpy upaspṛśya śraddadhāno jitendriyaḥ / agniṣṭomasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ

vulgate_text: tato gaccheta rājendra brahmasthānamanuttamam tatrābhigamya rājendra brahmāṇaṃ puruṣarṣabha / rājasūyāśvamedhābhyāṃ phalaṃ vindati mānavaḥ
ce_text: gaṅgāhradaś ca tatraiva tīrthaṃ bharatasattama / tatra snātas tu dharmajña brahmacārī samāhitaḥ / rājasūyāśvamedhābhyāṃ phalaṃ vindati śāśvatam

vulgate_text: tairthikaṃ bhuñjate yastu maṇināgas bhārata / daṣṭasyāśīviṣeṇāpi na tasya kramate vipam
ce_text: daṣṭasyāśīviṣeṇāpi na tasya kramate viṣam / tatroṣya rajanīm ekāṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate

vulgate_text: ādityā vasavo rudrā janārdanamupāsate / śālagrāma iti khyāto viṣṇuradbhutakarmakaḥ
ce_text: tato gaccheta rājendra sthānaṃ nārāyaṇasya tu / sadā saṃnihito yatra harir vasati bhārata / śālagrāma iti khyāto viṣṇor adbhutakarmaṇaḥ

vulgate_text: abhigamya trilokeśaṃ varadaṃ viṣṇumavyayam / virājati yathāsomo meghairmukto narādhipa
ce_text: abhigamya trilokeśaṃ varadaṃ viṣṇum avyayam / aśvamedham avāpnoti viṣṇulokaṃ ca gacchati

vulgate_text: atha jeṣṭhilamāsādya tīrdhaṃ paramadurlabham / tatroṣya rajanīmekāṃ gosahasraphalaṃ labhet
ce_text: atha jyeṣṭhilam āsādya tīrthaṃ paramasaṃmatam / upoṣya rajanīm ekām agniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet

vulgate_text: ye tvindhanaṃ prayacchanti nirvīrāsaṃgame narāḥ / te yānti naraśārdūla śakralokamanāmayam
ce_text: ye tu dānaṃ prayacchanti niścīrāsaṃgame narāḥ / te yānti naraśārdūla brahmalokaṃ na saṃśayaḥ

vulgate_text: abhigamya mahādevaṃ varadaṃ viṣṇumavyayam pitāmahasaro gatvā śailarājasamīpataḥ / tatrābhiṣekaṃ kurvāṇo hyagniṣṭomamavāpnuyāt
ce_text: pitāmahasaro gatvā śailarājapratiṣṭhitam / tatrābhiṣekaṃ kurvāṇo agniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet

vulgate_text: samāruhya naraśreṣṭha stanakuṇḍeṣu saṃviśet / stanakuṇḍamupaspṛśya vājapeyaphalaṃ labhet
ce_text: śikharaṃ vai mahādevyā gauryās trailokyaviśrutam / samāruhya naraḥ śrāddhaḥ stanakuṇḍeṣu saṃviśet

vulgate_text: nandinyāṃ ca samāsādya kūpaṃ devaniṣevitam / naramedhas yatpuṇyaṃ tadāptoti narādhipa
ce_text: nandinyāṃ ca samāsādya kūpaṃ tridaśasevitam / naramedhasya yat puṇyaṃ tat prāpnoti kurūdvaha

vulgate_text: lapeṭikāṃ tato gacchetpuṇyāṃ puṇyopaśobhitām / vājapeyamavāpnoti devaiḥ sarvaiśca pūjyate
ce_text: laveḍikāṃ tato gacchet puṇyāṃ puṇyopasevitām / vājapeyam avāpnoti vimānasthaś ca pūjyate

vulgate_text: tato devahrade'raṇye kṛṣṇaveṇājalodbhave jātismarahrade snātvā bhavejjātismaro naraḥ / yatra kratuśatairiṣṭvā devarājo divaṃ gataḥ
ce_text: tato devahrade ramye kṛṣṇaveṇṇājalodbhave / jātimātrahrade caiva tathā kanyāśrame nṛpa

vulgate_text: tatra vedeṣu naṣṭeṣu muneraṅgirasaḥ sutaḥ / ṛṣīṇaāmuttarīyeṣu sūpaviṣṭo yathāsukham
ce_text: tatra vedān pranaṣṭāṃs tu muner aṅgirasaḥ sutaḥ / upaviṣṭo maharṣīṇām uttarīyeṣu bhārata

vulgate_text: ājyabhāgena tatrāgnīṃ tarpayitvā yathāvidhi / devāḥ svabhavanaṃ yātā ṛṣayaśca yathākramam
ce_text: ājyabhāgena vai tatra tarpitās tu yathāvidhi / devās tribhuvaṇaṃ yātā ṛṣayaś ca yathāsukham

vulgate_text: tatropaspṛśya rājendra pitṛdevārcane rataḥ / niyatātmā naraḥ pūto gaccheta paramāṃ gatim
ce_text: tatropaspṛśya rājendra kṛtvā cāpi pradakṣiṇam / niyatātmā naraḥ pūto gaccheta paramāṃ gatim

vulgate_text: rakatasmiṃstīrthe mahābāho snātvā pāpaiḥ pramucyate / gaṅgāyāṃ tu naraḥ snātvā brahmacārī samāhitaḥ
ce_text: gaṅgāyāṃ tu naraḥ snātvā brahmacārī samāhitaḥ / vidhūtapāpmā bhavati vājapeyaṃ ca vindati

vulgate_text: tasmiṃstīrthe tu jāhnavyāṃ snātvā pāpaiḥ pramucyate / tato gaccheta rājendra prayāgamṛṣisaṃstutam
ce_text: tato gaccheta rājendra prayāgam ṛṣisaṃstutam / yatra brahmādayo devā diśaś ca sadigīśvarāḥ

vulgate_text: kurukṣetrasamā gaṅgā yatratatrāvagāhitā / viśeṣo vai kanakhale prayāge paramaṃ mahat
ce_text: tatra haṃsaprapatanaṃ tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam / daśāśvamedhikaṃ caiva gaṅgāyāṃ kurunandana / kurukṣetrasamā gaṅgā yatratatrāvagāhitā

vulgate_text: bhāṣitaiḥ karaṇaiḥ pūrvamāstikyācchrutidarśanāt prāpyante tāni tīrtāni sadbhiḥ śāstrārthadarśibhiḥ / sadbhiḥ śāstrārthatatvajñairbrāhmaṇaiḥ saha gamyatām
ce_text: bhāvitaiḥ kāraṇaiḥ pūrvam āstikyāc chrutidarśanāt / prāpyante tāni tīrthāni sadbhiḥ śiṣṭānudarśibhiḥ

vulgate_text: tataścāṣṭaguṇaṃ pārtha prāpsyase dharmamuttamam / bhīṣmaḥ kurūṇāṃ pravaro yathā pūrvamavāptavān
ce_text: ataś cāṣṭaguṇaṃ pārtha prāpsyase dharmam uttamam / netā ca tvam ṛṣīn yasmāt tena te 'ṣṭaguṇaṃ phalam

vulgate_text: netā ca tvamṛṣīnyasmāttena te'ṣṭaguṇaṃ phalam rakṣogaṇabikīrṇāni tīrthānyetāni bhārata / agamyāni manuṣyendraistvāmṛte kurunandana
ce_text: rakṣogaṇāvakīrṇāni tīrthāny etāni bhārata / na gatir vidyate 'nyasya tvām ṛte kurunandana

vulgate_text: idaṃ devarṣicaritaṃ sarvatīrtābhisaṃvṛtam / yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvā'pisarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
ce_text: idaṃ devarṣicaritaṃ sarvatīrthārthasaṃśritam / yaḥ paṭhet kalyam utthāya sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate

vulgate_text: yathā ca vṛtrahā sarvānsapatnānnirdahanpurā / trailokyaṃ pālayāmāsa devarāḍvigatajvaraḥ
ce_text: yathā ca vṛtrahā sarvān sapatnān nirdahat purā / tathā śatrukṣayaṃ kṛtvā prajās tvaṃ pālayiṣyasi

vulgate_text: sarve vedavidaḥ śūrāḥ sarve'strakuśalāstathā sarve mahārathā mukhyāḥ sarve jitapariśramāḥ / yoddhukāmāśca pārthena satataṃ ye mahābalāḥ
ce_text: yoddhukāmaś ca pārthena satataṃ yo mahābalaḥ / sa ca divyāstravit karṇaḥ sūtaputro mahārathaḥ

vulgate_text: sa ca divyāstravitkarṇaḥ sūtaputro mahārathaḥ yo'stravegānilabalaḥ śarārcistalaniḥsvanaḥ / rajodhūmo'strasaṃpāto dhārtarāṣṭrāniloddhataḥ
ce_text: so 'śvavegānilabalaḥ śarārcis talanisvanaḥ / rajodhūmo 'strasaṃtāpo dhārtarāṣṭrāniloddhataḥ

vulgate_text: hiraṇyabinduḥ kathito girau kālañjare mahān / āgastyaparvatorabhyaḥ puṇyo girivaḥ śivaḥ
ce_text: agastyasya ca rājendra tatrāśramavaro mahān / hiraṇyabinduḥ kathito girau kālaṃjare nṛpa

vulgate_text: nṛgas yajamānasya pratyakṣamiti naḥ śrutam / marutaḥ pariveṣṭāraḥ sadasyāśca divaukasaḥ
ce_text: nṛgasya yajamānasya pratyakṣam iti naḥ śrutam / amādyad indraḥ somena dakṣiṇābhir dvijātayaḥ

vulgate_text: camasodbhedanaṃ viprāstatrāpi kathayantyuta / prabhāsaṃ codadhau tīrthaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam
ce_text: camasonmajjanaṃ viprās tatrāpi kathayanty uta / prabhāsaṃ codadhau tīrthaṃ tridaśānāṃ yudhiṣṭhira

vulgate_text: avyayātmā vyayātmā ca kṣetrajñaḥ parameśvaraḥ āste hariracintyātmā tatraiva madhusūdanaḥ
ce_text: trailokyaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣo devadevaḥ sanātanaḥ / āste harir acintyātmā tatraiva madhusūdanaḥ

vulgate_text: tasya śailasya śikhare saraḥ puṇyaṃ mahīpate / phullapadmaṃ mahārāja devagandharvasevitam
ce_text: tasya śailasya śikhare saras tatra ca dhīmataḥ / praphullanalinaṃ rājan devagandharvasevitam

vulgate_text: hradinī puṇyatīrthā ca rājarṣestatra vai sarit / viścāmitreṇa tapasā nirmitā sarvapāvanī
ce_text: hradinī puṇyatīrthā ca rājarṣes tatra vai sarit / viśvāmitranadī pārā puṇyā parapuraṃjaya

vulgate_text: tatrapuṇyo hradaḥ khyāto mainākaścaiva parvataḥ / bahumūlaphalopetastvamito nāma parvataḥ
ce_text: tatra puṇyahradas tāta mainākaś caiva parvataḥ / bahumūlaphalo vīra asito nāma parvataḥ

vulgate_text: kaunteyānantayaśasaḥ suvratasyāmitaujasaḥ / āśramaḥ khyāyate puṇyastriṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ
ce_text: tasyātiyaśasaḥ puṇyāṃ viśālāṃ badarīm anu / āśramaḥ khyāyate puṇyas triṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ

vulgate_text: etāvarṇāvavarṇau ca viśrutau manujādhipa / ījāte kratubhirmukhyaiḥ puṇyairbharatasattama
ce_text: dṛṣadvatī puṇyatamā tatra khyātā yudhiṣṭhira / tatra vaivarṇyavarṇau ca supuṇyau manujādhipa

vulgate_text: tatpuṇyaṃ paramaṃ brahma tattīrthaṃ ttapovanam / tatparaṃ paramaṃ devaṃ bhūtānāṃ parameśvaram
ce_text: tat puṇyaṃ tat paraṃ brahma tat tīrthaṃ tat tapovanam / tatra devarṣayaḥ siddhāḥ sarve caiva tapodhanāḥ

vulgate_text: ahaṃ ca karṇaṃ jānāmi yathāvadbharatarṣabha / satyasandhaṃ mahotsāhaṃ mahāvīryaṃ mahābalam
ce_text: ahaṃ ca karṇaṃ jānāmi yathāvad bharatarṣabha / na sa pārthasya saṃgrāme kalām arhati ṣoḍaśīm

vulgate_text: ye cāpyanugatāḥ paurā rājabhaktipuraḥsarāḥ dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ mahārājamabhigacchantu te ca vai / sa dāsyati yathākālamucitā yasya yā bhṛtiḥ
ce_text: dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ mahārājam abhigacchantu caiva te / sa dāsyati yathākālam ucitā yasya yā bhṛtiḥ

vulgate_text: tvayā saha mahīpāla draṣṭumicchāmahe vayam / bhavadbhiḥ pālitāḥ śūraistīrthānyāyatanāni ca
ce_text: prabhāsādīni tīrthāni mahendrādīṃś ca parvatān / gaṅgādyāḥ saritaś caiva plakṣādīṃś ca vanaspatīn / tvayā saha mahīpāla draṣṭum icchāmahe vayam

vulgate_text: niryaśaskāstathā daityāḥ kṛtsnaśo vilayaṃ gatāḥ / adharmarucayorājannalakṣmyā samadhiṣṭhitāḥ
ce_text: mānābhibhūtān acirād vināśaḥ pratyapadyata / niryaśasyās tato daityāḥ kṛtsnaśo vilayaṃ gatāḥ

vulgate_text: nago gayaśiro yatra puṇyā caiva mahānadī / vānīramālinī ramyā nadī pulinaśobhitā
ce_text: saro gayaśiro yatra puṇyā caiva mahānadī / ṛṣijuṣṭaṃ supuṇyaṃ tat tīrthaṃ brahmasarottamam

vulgate_text: divyaṃ pavitrakūṭaṃ ca pavitradharaṇīdharam / ṛṣijuṣṭaṃ supuṇyaṃ tattīrthaṃ brahmasarotulam
ce_text: saro gayaśiro yatra puṇyā caiva mahānadī / ṛṣijuṣṭaṃ supuṇyaṃ tat tīrthaṃ brahmasarottamam

vulgate_text: ye tu tatropavāsāṃstu cakrurniścitamānasāḥ / brāhmaṇāstatraśataśaḥ samājagmustapodhanāḥ
ce_text: brāhmaṇās tatra śataśaḥ samājagmus tapodhanāḥ / cāturmāsyenāyajanta ārṣeṇa vidhinā tadā

vulgate_text: cāturmāsyenāyajanta ārṣeṇa vidhinā tadā tatra vidyātapovṛddhā brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ / kathāṃ pracakrire puṇyāṃ sadasisthā mahātmanām
ce_text: tatra vidyātaponityā brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ / kathāḥ pracakrire puṇyāḥ sadasisthā mahātmanām

vulgate_text: so'pṛcchallambamānāṃstānbhagavantaśca kiṃparāḥ kiṃmarthaṃ veha lambadhve garte yūyamadhomukhāḥ / saṃtānahetoriti te pratyūcurbrahmavādinaḥ
ce_text: so 'pṛcchal lambamānāṃs tān bhavanta iha kiṃparāḥ / saṃtānahetor iti te tam ūcur brahmavādinaḥ

vulgate_text: tayorardhyaṃ ca pādyaṃ ca bradhnaśvaḥ pratyavedayat anujñāpyaca papraccha prayojanamupakrame / vada kāmaṃ muniśreṣṭha dhanyosmyāgamanena te
ce_text: tayor arghyaṃ ca pādyaṃ ca vadhryaśvaḥ pratyavedayat / anujñāpya ca papraccha prayojanam upakrame

vulgate_text: agastya eva kṛtsnaṃ tu vātāpiṃ bubhuje tataḥ / bahvannāśāpi te me'stītyavadadbhakṣayansvayam
ce_text: agastya eva kṛtsnaṃ tu vātāpiṃ bubhuje tataḥ / bhuktavaty asuro ''hvānam akarot tasya ilvalaḥ

vulgate_text: bhuktavatyasuro'hvānamakarottasya celvalaḥ vātāpe pratibudhyasva darśayanbalatejasī / tapasā durjayo yāvadeṣa tvāṃ nātivartate
ce_text: agastya eva kṛtsnaṃ tu vātāpiṃ bubhuje tataḥ / bhuktavaty asuro ''hvānam akarot tasya ilvalaḥ

vulgate_text: tato vāyuḥ prādurabhūdadhastasya mahātmanaḥ / śabdena mahatā tāta garjanniva yathā ghanaḥ
ce_text: tato vāyuḥ prādurabhūd agastyasya mahātmanaḥ / ilvalaś ca viṣaṇṇo 'bhūd dṛṣṭvā jīrṇaṃ mahāsuram

vulgate_text: na me vāganṛtā kāciduktapūrvā mahā'sura / vijñāyatāṃ rathaḥ sādhu vyaktamasti hiraṇmayaḥ
ce_text: mahyaṃ tato vai dviguṇaṃ rathaś caiva hiraṇmayaḥ / manojavau vājinau ca ditsitaṃ te mahāsura / jijñāsyatāṃ rathaḥ sadyo vyaktam eṣa hiraṇmayaḥ

vulgate_text: prāhlādirevaṃ vātāpirbrahmaghno duṣṭacetanaḥ evaṃ vināśito rājannagastyena mahātmanā / tasyāyamāśramo rājanramaṇīyairguṇairyutaḥ
ce_text: tasyāyam āśramo rājan ramaṇīyo guṇair yutaḥ / eṣā bhāgīrathī puṇyā yatheṣṭam avagāhyatām

vulgate_text: tato rāmaśarīre vai rāmaḥ paśyati bhārgavaḥ / ādityānsavasūnrudrānsādhyāṃśca samarudgaṇān
ce_text: tato 'paśyaṃ vasūn rudrān sādhyāṃś ca samarudgaṇān / ādityān aśvinau caiva tān sarvān pratyapūjayam

vulgate_text: taṃ śaktaṃ kaśmalāviṣṭaṃ dṛṣṭvā viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ / jagāma śaraṇaṃ śīghraṃ taṃ tu nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum
ce_text: taṃ śakraṃ kaśmalāviṣṭaṃ dṛṣṭvā viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ / svatejo vyadadhāc chakre balam asya vivardhayan

vulgate_text: sarve ca devā muditāḥ prahṛṣṭā maharṣayaścandramabhiṣṭuvantaḥ / vṛtraṃ hataṃ saṃdadṛśuḥ pṛthivyāṃ vajrāhataṃ śailamivāvadīrṇam
ce_text: sarve ca devā muditāḥ prahṛṣṭā maharṣayaś cendram abhiṣṭuvantaḥ / sarvāṃś ca daityāṃs tvaritāḥ sametya jaghnuḥ surā vṛtravadhābhitaptān

vulgate_text: evaṃ rātrau sma kurvanti viviśuścārṇavaṃ divā / kāleyāste durātmāno bhakṣayantastapodhanān
ce_text: evaṃ rātrau sma kurvanti viviśuś cārṇavaṃ divā / bharadvājāśrame caiva niyatā brahmacāriṇaḥ / vāyvāhārāmbubhakṣāś ca viṃśatiḥ saṃnipātitāḥ

vulgate_text: śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇamajaṃ vibhum te'bhigamya namaskṛtya vaikuṇṭhamaparājitam / tato devāḥ samastāste tadocurmadhusūdanam
ce_text: tato devāḥ sametās te tadocur madhusūdanam / tvaṃ naḥ sraṣṭā ca pātā ca bhartā ca jagataḥ prabho / tvayā sṛṣṭam idaṃ sarvaṃ yac ceṅgaṃ yac ca neṅgati

vulgate_text: tvaṃnaḥ sraṣṭā ca bhartā ca hartā ca jagataḥ prabho tvayā sṛṣṭamidaṃ viśvaṃ yacceṅgaṃ yacca neṅgati / tvayyeva puṇḍarīkākṣa punastatpravilīyate
ce_text: tato devāḥ sametās te tadocur madhusūdanam / tvaṃ naḥ sraṣṭā ca pātā ca bhartā ca jagataḥ prabho / tvayā sṛṣṭam idaṃ sarvaṃ yac ceṅgaṃ yac ca neṅgati

vulgate_text: etacchrutvā vaco devā viṣṇunā samudīritam / viṣṇumeva puraskṛtyabrahmāṇaṃ samupasthitāḥ
ce_text: etac chrutvā vaco devā viṣṇunā samudāhṛtam / parameṣṭhinam ājñāpya agastyasyāśramaṃ yayuḥ

vulgate_text: sa hi śakto mahātejāḥ kṣaṇātpātuṃ mahodadhim / agastyena vinā ko hi śakto'nyo'rṇavaśopaṇe
ce_text: na tu śakyāḥ kṣayaṃ netuṃ samudrāśrayagā hi te / samudrasya kṣaye buddhir bhavadbhiḥ saṃpradhāryatām / agastyena vinā ko hi śakto 'nyo 'rṇavaśoṣaṇe

vulgate_text: evaṃ śrutvā vaco devā brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ / parameṣṭhinamājñāpyaagastyasyāśramaṃ yayuḥ
ce_text: etac chrutvā vaco devā viṣṇunā samudāhṛtam / parameṣṭhinam ājñāpya agastyasyāśramaṃ yayuḥ

vulgate_text: vindhyo'pitadbhayādrājankuñcitāṅgo na vardhate / agastyasya prabhāveṇa yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi
ce_text: etat te sarvam ākhyātaṃ yathā vindhyo na vardhate / agastyasya prabhāvena yan māṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi

vulgate_text: evamuktāstatastena devatā munimabruvan / sarve prāñjalayo bhūtvā purandarapurogamāḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ sa lokamagamatsomakasya guruḥ param / anvakṣameva paścāttu somakopyagamatparam
ce_text: tataḥ sa lokam agamat somakasya guruḥ param / atha kāle vyatīte tu somako 'py agamat param

vulgate_text: matkṛte hi mahābhāgaḥ pacyate narakāgninā / sohamātmānamādhāsye narake mucyatāṃ guruḥ
ce_text: etac chrutvā sa rājarṣir dharmarājānam abravīt / aham atra pravekṣyāmi mucyatāṃ mama yājakaḥ / matkṛte hi mahābhāgaḥ pacyate narakāgninā

vulgate_text: sa cakāra tathā sarvaṃ rājā rājīvalocanaḥ / kṣīṇapāpaśca tasmātsa vimukto guruṇā saha
ce_text: sa cakāra tathā sarvaṃ rājā rājīvalocanaḥ / punaś ca lebhe lokān svān karmaṇā nirjitāñ śubhān / saha tenaiva vipreṇa guruṇā sa gurupriyaḥ

vulgate_text: yajñaiśca tapasā caiva parāṃ siddhimavāpa saḥ / deśaśca nāhuṣasyāyaṃ yajvanaḥ puṇyakarmaṇaḥ
ce_text: ambarīṣaś ca nābhāga iṣṭavān yamunām anu / yajñaiś ca tapasā caiva parāṃ siddhim avāpa saḥ

vulgate_text: atravai bharato rājā rājankratubhiriṣṭavān / hayamedhena yajñena medhyamaśvamavāsṛjat
ce_text: atraiva bharato rājā medhyam aśvam avāsṛjat / asakṛt kṛṣṇasāraṅgaṃ dharmeṇāvāpya medinīm

vulgate_text: asakṛtkṛṣṇasāraṅgaṃ dharmeṇāpya ca medinīm atraiva puruṣavyāghra maruttaḥ satramuttamam / prāpa caivarṣimukhyena saṃvartenābhipālitaḥ
ce_text: atraiva puruṣavyāghra maruttaḥ satram uttamam / āste devarṣimukhyena saṃvartenābhipālitaḥ

vulgate_text: evametanmahābāho paśyanti paramarṣayaḥ / iha snātvā tapoyuktāṃstrīllom̐kānsacarācarān
ce_text: evam etan mahābāho paśyanti paramarṣayaḥ / sarasvatīm imāṃ puṇyāṃ paśyaikaśaraṇāvṛtām

vulgate_text: rāṣṭraṃ śivīnāmṛddhaṃ vai śādhi pakṣibhirarcitaḥ / kṛtsnametanmayā dattaṃ rājavadvihagottama
ce_text: rājyaṃ śibīnām ṛddhaṃ vai śādhi pakṣigaṇārcita / yad vā kāmayase kiṃ cic chyena sarvaṃ dadāni te / vinemaṃ pakṣiṇaṃ śyena śaraṇārthinam āgatam

vulgate_text: asminyuge brahmakṛtāṃ variṣṭhāvāstāṃ munī mātulabhāgineyau / aṣṭāvakraścaiva kaholasūnurauddālakiḥ śvetaketuḥ pṛthivyām
ce_text: tasmin kāle brahmavidāṃ variṣṭhāv āstāṃ tadā mātulabhāgineyau / aṣṭāvakraś caiva kahoḍasūnur auddālakiḥ śvetaketuś ca rājan

vulgate_text: kathaṃprabhāvaḥ sa babhūva viprastathābhūtaṃ yo nijagrāha vandim / kiṃcādhikṛtyātha tayorvivādo videharājas samīpa āsīt
ce_text: kathaṃprabhāvaḥ sa babhūva vipras tathāyuktaṃ yo nijagrāha bandim / aṣṭāvakraḥ kena cāsau babhūva tat sarvaṃ me lomaśa śaṃsa tattvam

vulgate_text: draṣṭāsyadya vadato'smāndvārapāla manīṣibhiḥ / saha vāde vivṛddhe tu vandinaṃ cāpi nirjitam
ce_text: draṣṭāsy adya vadato dvārapāla manīṣibhiḥ saha vāde vivṛddhe / utāho vāpy uccatāṃ nīcatāṃ vā tūṣṇīṃ bhūteṣv atha sarveṣu cādya

vulgate_text: paśyantu viprāḥ paripūrṇavidyāḥ sahaiva rājñā sapurodhamukhyāḥ / utāho vā'pyuccatāṃ nīcatāṃ vā tūṣṇīṃbhūteṣveva sarveṣvathādya
ce_text: draṣṭāsy adya vadato dvārapāla manīṣibhiḥ saha vāde vivṛddhe / utāho vāpy uccatāṃ nīcatāṃ vā tūṣṇīṃ bhūteṣv atha sarveṣu cādya

vulgate_text: āśaṃsamānā vandinaṃ vai bijetumavijñātvā tu balaṃ vandino'sya / samāgatā brāhmaṇāstena pūrvaṃ na śobhante bhāskareṇeva tārāḥ
ce_text: āśaṃsase bandinaṃ tvaṃ vijetum avijñātvā vākyabalaṃ parasya / vijñātavīryaiḥ śakyam evaṃ pravaktuṃ dṛṣṭaś cāsau brāhmaṇair vādaśīlaiḥ

vulgate_text: na mokṣyase vai vadamāno nimajjan jalaṃ prapannaḥ saritāmivādhanaḥ / hutāśanasyeva samiddhatejasaḥ sthiro bhavasveha mamādya vandin
ce_text: na me 'dya vakṣyasy ativādimānin glahaṃ prapannaḥ saritām ivāgamaḥ / hutāśanasyeva samiddhatejasaḥ sthiro bhavasveha mamādya bandin

vulgate_text: yatheme parvatāḥ śaśvattiṣṭhanti surasattamāḥ / tāvajjīvenmam suto nirvāṇamuta me mataḥ
ce_text: yatheme parvatāḥ śaśvat tiṣṭhanti surasattamāḥ / akṣayās tan nimittaṃ me sutasyāyur bhaved iti

vulgate_text: nimittamasya maharṣirbhedayāmāsa parvatān / sa nimitte vinaṣṭe tu mamāra sahasā śiśuḥ
ce_text: sa nimitte vinaṣṭe tu mamāra sahasā śiśuḥ / taṃ mṛtaṃ putram ādāya vilalāpa tataḥ pitā

vulgate_text: lālapyamānaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā munayaḥ paramārtavat / ūcurvedavidaḥ sarvai gāthāṃ yāṃ tāṃ nibodha me
ce_text: lālapyamānaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā munayaḥ punar ārtavat / ūcur vedoktayā pūrvaṃ gāthayā tan nibodha me

vulgate_text: raibhyaṃ yāto nūnamayaṃ putraste mandacetanaḥ / tathāhi nihataḥ śete rākṣasena mahātmanā
ce_text: raibhyaṃ gato nūnam asau sutas te mandacetanaḥ / tathā hi nihataḥ śete rākṣasena balīyasā

vulgate_text: bharadvājasya cotthānaṃ yavakrītasya cobhayoḥ / pratiṣṭhāṃ cāpi vedasya saurasya dvijasattamaḥ
ce_text: anāgastvaṃ tathā bhrātuḥ pituś cāsmaraṇaṃ vadhe / bharadvājasya cotthānaṃ yavakrītasya cobhayoḥ

vulgate_text: evamastviti taṃ devāḥ procuścāpi varāndaduḥ / tataḥ prādurbabhūvuste sarva eva yudhiṣṭhira
ce_text: tataḥ prādurbabhūvus te sarva eva yudhiṣṭhira / athābravīd yavakrīto devān agnipurogamān

vulgate_text: etaddrakṣyasi devānāmākrīḍaṃ ca raṇāṅkitam / atikrāntosi kaunteya kālaśailaṃ ca parvatam
ce_text: uśīrabījaṃ mainākaṃ giriṃ śvetaṃ ca bhārata / samatīto 'si kaunteya kālaśailaṃ ca pārthiva

vulgate_text: dadasva śarma pravivikṣato'sya śailānimāñchailasute nṛpasya / śivapradā sarvasaritpradhāne sa bhrātṛkasyeha yudhiṣṭhirasya
ce_text: indrasya jāmbūnadaparvatāgre śṛṇomi ghoṣaṃ tava devi gaṅge / gopāyayemaṃ subhage giribhyaḥ sarvājamīḍhāpacitaṃ narendram / bhavasva śarma pravivikṣato 'sya śailān imāñ śailasute nṛpasya

vulgate_text: tavacāpyaratistīvrā vartate tamapaśyataḥ guḍākeśaṃ mahātmānaṃ saṃgrāmeṣvapalāyinam / kiṃ punaḥ sahadevaṃ ca māṃ ca kṛṣṇāṃ ca bhārata
ce_text: tava cāpy aratis tīvrā vardhate tam apaśyataḥ / kiṃ punaḥ sahadevaṃ ca māṃ ca kṛṣṇāṃ ca bhārata

vulgate_text: duḥkhena mahatā''viṣṭaścintayāmi divāniśam / ajeyamugradhanvānaṃ tena tapye vṛkodara
ce_text: duḥkhena mahatāviṣṭaḥ svakṛtenānivartinā / ajeyam ugradhanvānaṃ taṃ na paśyāmi phalgunam

vulgate_text: mandībhūte tu pavane tasminrajasi śāmyati / mahadbhirjaladhāraurgharvarṣamabhyājagāma ha
ce_text: mandībhūte ca pavane tasmin rajasi śāmyati / mahadbhiḥ pṛṣatais tūrṇaṃ varṣam abhyājagāma ha

vulgate_text: bhrāturvacanamājñāya bhīmaseno ghaṭotkacam / cintayāmāsa balavānmahābalaparākramam
ce_text: bhrātur vacanam ājñāya bhīmaseno ghaṭotkacam / ādideśa naravyāghras tanayaṃ śatrukarśanam

vulgate_text: tacchrutvā bhīmasenastu rākṣasaṃ pariṣasvaje / cintāyā samanaprāptamityuvāca vṛkodaraḥ
ce_text: smṛto 'smi bhavatā śīghraṃ śuśrūṣur aham āgataḥ / ājñāpaya mahābāho sarvaṃ kartāsmy asaṃśayam / tac chrutvā bhīmasenas tu rākṣasaṃ pariṣasvaje

vulgate_text: nadījālasamākīrṇānnānāpakṣiyutānbahūn nānāvidhamṛgairjuṣṭāṃścāraṇaiścopaśobhitān / samadaiścyaśi vihagaiḥ upairanvitāṃstathā
ce_text: nadījālasamākīrṇān nānāpakṣirutākulān / nānāvidhair mṛgair juṣṭān vānaraiś copaśobhitān

vulgate_text: mudā yuktā mahātmāno remire tatra te tadā ālokayanto mainākaṃ nānādvijagaṇāyutam / hiraṇyaśikharaṃ caiva madhye vindusaraḥ śivam
ce_text: ālokayanto mainākaṃ nānādvijagaṇāyutam / hiraṇyaśikharaṃ caiva tac ca bindusaraḥ śivam

vulgate_text: tatra te tarpayantaśca japantaśca kurūdvahāḥ / brāhmaṇaiḥ sahitā vīrā hyavasanpuruparṣabhāḥ
ce_text: tatra devān pitṝṃś caiva tarpayantaḥ punaḥ punaḥ / brāhmaṇaiḥ sahitā vīrā nyavasan puruṣarṣabhāḥ

vulgate_text: idaṃ ca dharmarājāya pradāsyāmi paraṃtapa gṛhyāparāṇi puṣpāṇi bahūni puruṣarṣabha / hareridaṃ me kāmāya kāmyake punarāśrame
ce_text: etat tu dharmarājāya pradāsyāmi paraṃtapa / harer idaṃ me kāmāya kāmyake punar āśrame

vulgate_text: vījyamānaḥ supuṇyena nānākusumagandhinā / pituḥ saṃsparśaśītena gandhamādanavāyunā
ce_text: hriyamāṇaśramaḥ pitrā saṃprahṛṣṭatanūruhaḥ / pituḥ saṃsparśaśītena gandhamādanavāyunā

vulgate_text: so'cintayattathā pārthe mayi tvativilambite / puṣpahetoḥ kathaṃ tvāryaḥ kariṣyati yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
ce_text: so 'cintayad gate svargam arjune mayi cāgate / puṣpahetoḥ kathaṃ nv āryaḥ kariṣyati yudhiṣṭhiraḥ

vulgate_text: jalāvalambo'tibhṛśaṃ savidyudiva toyadaḥ / vyanadatsa mahānādaṃ bhīmaseno mahābalaḥ
ce_text: latāvallīś ca vegena vikarṣan pāṇḍunandanaḥ / upary upari śailāgram ārurukṣur iva dvipaḥ / vinardamāno 'tibhṛśaṃ savidyud iva toyadaḥ

vulgate_text: tathā'nye darpitā nāgāḥ kareṇuśarapīḍitāḥ / siṃhavyāghrāśca saṃkruddhā bhīmasenamathādravan
ce_text: siṃhavyāghrāś ca saṃkruddhā bhīmasenam abhidravan / vyāditāsyā mahāraudrā vinadanto 'tibhīṣaṇāḥ

vulgate_text: śakṛnmūtraṃ ca muñcānā bhayavibhrāntamānasāḥ / vyāditāsyā mahāraudra vyanadanbhīṣaṇānravān
ce_text: siṃhavyāghrāś ca saṃkruddhā bhīmasenam abhidravan / vyāditāsyā mahāraudrā vinadanto 'tibhīṣaṇāḥ

vulgate_text: utpāṭya kadalīstambhānbahutālasamucchrayān cikṣepa tarasā bhīmaḥ samantādbalināṃ varaḥ / vimardansumahātejā nṛsiṃha iva darpitaḥ
ce_text: utpāṭya kadalīskandhān bahutālasamucchrayān / cikṣepa tarasā bhīmaḥ samantād balināṃ varaḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ saṃnyapataṃstatrasubahūni mahānti ca / ruruvāraṇayūthāni mahiṣāśca jalāśrayāḥ
ce_text: tataḥ sattvāny upākrāman bahūni ca mahānti ca / ruruvāraṇasaṃghāś ca mahiṣāś ca jalāśrayāḥ

vulgate_text: tasminanatha pravṛtte tu saṃkṣobhe mṛgapakṣiṇām / jalārdrapakṣā vihagāḥ samutpetuḥ sahasraśaḥ
ce_text: taṃ śabdaṃ sahasā śrutvā mṛgapakṣisamīritam / jalārdrapakṣā vihagāḥ samutpetuḥ sahasraśaḥ

vulgate_text: vikrīḍyatasminruciramuttatārāmitadyutiḥ / kṣobhayansalilaṃ bhīmaḥ prabhinna ivavāraṇaḥ
ce_text: tat saro 'thāvatīryāśu prabhūtakamalotpalam / mahāgaja ivoddāmaś cikrīḍa balavad balī / vikrīḍya tasmin suciram uttatārāmitadyutiḥ

vulgate_text: taṃ tu nādaṃ tataḥ śrutvā supto vānarapuṅgavaḥ / [bhrātaraṃ bhīmasenaṃ tu vijñāya hanumānkapiḥ
ce_text: taṃ tu nādaṃ tataḥ śrutvā supto vānarapuṃgavaḥ / prājṛmbhata mahākāyo hanūmān nāma vānaraḥ

vulgate_text: tena śabdena mahatā vyabudhyata mahākapiḥ jṛmbhamāṇaḥ suvipulaṃ śakradhvajamivocchritam / āsphoṭayaccalāṅgūlamindrāśanisamasvanam
ce_text: kadalīṣaṇḍamadhyastho nidrāvaśagatas tadā / jṛmbhamāṇaḥ suvipulaṃ śakradhvajam ivocchritam / āsphoṭayata lāṅgūlam indrāśanisamasvanam

vulgate_text: vidyutsaṃpātaduṣprekṣaṃ vidyutsaṃpātapiṅgalam / vidyutsaṃpātaninadaṃ vidyutsaṃpātacañcalam
ce_text: vidyutsaṃghātaduṣprekṣyaṃ vidyutsaṃghātapiṅgalam / vidyutsaṃghātasadṛśaṃ vidyutsaṃghātacañcalam

vulgate_text: taṃ vānaravaraṃ dhīmānatikāyaṃ mahābalam / svargapanthānamāvṛtya himavantamiva stitam
ce_text: nirīkṣantam avitrastaṃ locanair madhupiṅgalaiḥ / taṃ vānaravaraṃ vīram atikāyaṃ mahābalam

vulgate_text: dṛṣṭvā cainaṃ mahābāhurekaṃ tasminmahāvane / athopasṛtyatarasā bhīmo bhīmaparākramaḥ
ce_text: athopasṛtya tarasā bhīmo bhīmaparākramaḥ / siṃhanādaṃ samakarod bodhayiṣyan kapiṃ tadā

vulgate_text: siṃhanādaṃ cakārograṃ vajrāśanisamaṃ balī / tena śabdena bhīmasya vitresurmṛgapakṣiṇaḥ
ce_text: tena śabdena bhīmasya vitresur mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ / hanūmāṃś ca mahāsattva īṣad unmīlya locane / avaikṣad atha sāvajñaṃ locanair madhupiṅgalaiḥ

vulgate_text: kva ca tvayā'dyagantavyaṃ prabrūhi puruṣarṣabha / ataḥ paramagamyo'yaṃ parvataḥ sudurāruhaḥ
ce_text: ataḥ paramagamyo 'yaṃ parvataḥ sudurāruhaḥ / vinā siddhagatiṃ vīra gatir atra na vidyate

vulgate_text: vinā siddhagatiṃ vīra gatiratra na vidyate / [devalokasya mārgo'yamagamyo mānuṣaiḥ sadā]
ce_text: ataḥ paramagamyo 'yaṃ parvataḥ sudurāruhaḥ / vinā siddhagatiṃ vīra gatir atra na vidyate

vulgate_text: kāruṇyāttvāmahaṃ vīra vārayāmi nibodha me / nātaḥ paraṃ tvayā śakyaṃ gantumāśvasihi prabho
ce_text: kāruṇyāt sauhṛdāc caiva vāraye tvāṃ mahābala / nātaḥ paraṃ tvayā śakyaṃ gantum āśvasihi prabho

vulgate_text: svāgataṃ sarvathaiveha tavādya manujarṣabha / imānyamṛtakalpāni mūlāni ca phalāni ca
ce_text: imāny amṛtakalpāni mūlāni ca phalāni ca / bhakṣayitvā nivartasva grāhyaṃ yadi vaco mama

vulgate_text: bhakṣayitvā nivartasva mā vṛthā prāpsyase vadham grāhyaṃ yadi vaco mahyaṃ hitaṃ manujapuṅgava
ce_text: imāny amṛtakalpāni mūlāni ca phalāni ca / bhakṣayitvā nivartasva grāhyaṃ yadi vaco mama

vulgate_text: imaṃ deśamanuprāptaḥ kāraṇenāsmi kenacit uttiṣṭha dehi me mārgaṃ paśya me cādya pauruṣam / macchāsanamakurvāṇaṃ tvāṃ vā neṣye yamakṣayam
ce_text: uttiṣṭha dehi me mārgaṃ paśya vā me 'dya pauruṣam / macchāsanam akurvāṇaṃ mā tvā neṣye yamakṣayam

vulgate_text: tasya bhāryā janasthānācchalenāpahṛtā balāt / rākṣasendreṇa balinā rāvaṇena durātmanā
ce_text: tasya bhāryā janasthānād rāvaṇena hṛtā balāt / vañcayitvā mahābuddhiṃ mṛgarūpeṇa rāghavam

vulgate_text: sa rājyaṃ prāpya sugrīvaḥ sītāyāḥ parimārgaṇe / vānarānpreṣayāmāsa śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ
ce_text: tena tasyābhavat sakhyaṃ rāghavasya mahātmanaḥ / sa hatvā vālinaṃ rājye sugrīvaṃ pratyapādayat / sa harīn preṣayām āsa sītāyāḥ parimārgaṇe

vulgate_text: tataḥ pravṛttiḥ sītāyā gṛdhreṇa sumahātmanā / saṃpātinā samākhyātā rāvaṇasya niveśane
ce_text: tato vānarakoṭībhir yāṃ vayaṃ prasthitā diśam / tatra pravṛttiḥ sītāyā gṛdhreṇa pratipāditā

vulgate_text: dagdhvā laṅkāmaśeṣeṇa sādṛprākāratoraṇām / pratyāgataścāsya punarnāma tatraprakāśya vai
ce_text: dṛṣṭā sā ca mayā devī rāvaṇasya niveśane / pratyāgataś cāpi punar nāma tatra prakāśya vai

vulgate_text: tato rarāmeṇa vīryeṇa hatvā tānsarvarākṣasān / raṇe tu rākṣasagaṇaṃ rāvaṇaṃ lokarāvaṇam
ce_text: tato rāmeṇa vīreṇa hatvā tān sarvarākṣasān / punaḥ pratyāhṛtā bhāryā naṣṭā vedaśrutir yathā

vulgate_text: dhārmikaṃ bhaktimantaṃ ca bhaktānugatavatsalaḥ / pratyāhṛtya tataḥ sītāṃ naṣṭāṃ vedaśrutiṃ yathā
ce_text: tato rāmeṇa vīreṇa hatvā tān sarvarākṣasān / punaḥ pratyāhṛtā bhāryā naṣṭā vedaśrutir yathā

vulgate_text: tvāmanena pathā yāntaṃ yakṣo vā rākṣasopi vā / dharṣayedvā śapedvā'pi mā kaściditi bhārata
ce_text: ayaṃ ca mārgo martyānām agamyaḥ kurunandana / tato 'haṃ ruddhavān mārgaṃ tavemaṃ devasevitam / dharṣayed vā śaped vāpi mā kaś cid iti bhārata

vulgate_text: kālaṃkālaṃ samāsādya narāṇāṃ narapuṅgava / balavarṣmaprabhāvā hi prahīyantyudbhavanti ca
ce_text: bhūmir nadyo nagāḥ śailāḥ siddhā devā maharṣayaḥ / kālaṃ samanuvartante yathā bhāvā yuge yuge / balavarṣmaprabhāvā hi prahīyanty udbhavanti ca

vulgate_text: kāmaḥ kāmayamāneṣu brāhmaṇeṣu tirohitaḥ / etatkṛtayugaṃ nāma traiguṇyaparivarjitam
ce_text: etat kṛtayugaṃ nāma traiguṇyaparivarjitam / tretām api nibodha tvaṃ yasmin satraṃ pravartate

vulgate_text: bhrātuḥ priyamabhīpsanvai cakāra sumahadvapuḥ / tadrūpaṃ yatpurā tasya babhūvodadhilaṅghane
ce_text: bhrātuḥ priyam abhīpsan vai cakāra sumahad vapuḥ / dehas tasya tato 'tīva vardhaty āyāmavistaraiḥ

vulgate_text: rājñāmupāyaścāraśca buddhimantraparākramāḥ / nigrahapragrahau caiva dākṣyaṃ vai kāryasādhakam

vulgate_text: dvijaśuśrūṣayā śūdrā labhante gatimuttamām / kṣatraṃ yāti tathā svargaṃ bhuvi nigrahapālanaiḥ
ce_text: kṣatraṃ yāti tathā svargaṃ bhuvi nigrahapālanaiḥ / samyak praṇīya daṇḍaṃ hi kāmadveṣavivarjitāḥ / alubdhā vigatakrodhāḥ satāṃ yānti salokatām

vulgate_text: [balaṃ cātibalo mene na me'sti sadṛśo mahān ] tataḥ punarathovāca paryaśrunayano hariḥ
ce_text: tataḥ punar athovāca paryaśrunayano hariḥ / bhīmam ābhāṣya sauhārdād bāṣpagadgadayā girā

vulgate_text: [baddhvā duryodhanaṃ cādya ānayāmi tavāntikam ] yāvadetatkaromyadyakāmaṃ tava mahābala

vulgate_text: tadāhaṃ bṛṃhayiṣyāmi svaraveṇa ravaṃ tava / yaṃ śrutvaiva bhaviṣyanti vyasavaste'rayo raṇe
ce_text: camūṃ vigāhya śatrūṇāṃ śaraśaktisamākulām / yadā siṃharavaṃ vīra kariṣyasi mahābala / tadāhaṃ bṛṃhayiṣyāmi svaraveṇa ravaṃ tava

vulgate_text: vijayasya dhvajasthaśca nādānmokṣpāmi dāruṇān / śatrūṇāṃ ye prāṇaharāḥ sukhaṃ yena haniṣyatha
ce_text: vijayasya dhvajasthaś ca nādān mokṣyāmi dāruṇān / śatrūṇāṃ te prāṇaharān ity uktvāntaradhīyata

vulgate_text: phullapadmavicitrāṇi sarāṃsi saritastathā / nānākusumacitrāṇi puṣpitāni vanāni ca
ce_text: phullapadmavicitrāṇi puṣpitāni vanāni ca / mattavāraṇayūthāni paṅkaklinnāni bhārata / varṣatām iva meghānāṃ vṛndāni dadṛśe tadā

vulgate_text: haritāmbujasaṃchannāṃ divyāṃ kanakapuṣkarām / nānāpakṣijanākīrṇāṃ sūpatīrthāmakardamām

ce_text: haritāmbujasaṃchannāṃ divyāṃ kanakapuṣkarām / pavitrabhūtāṃ lokasya śubhām adbhutadarśanām

vulgate_text: gandharvāpsarasaścaiva viharantyatra pāṇḍava / yakṣādhipasyānumate kuberas mahātmanaḥ
ce_text: devarṣayas tathā yakṣā devāś cātra vṛkodara / āmantrya yakṣapravaraṃ pibanti viharanti ca / gandharvāpsarasaś caiva viharanty atra pāṇḍava

vulgate_text: ityuktvā rākṣasānsarvānbhīmaseno vyagāhata / tāṃ tu puṣkariṇīṃ vīraḥ prabhinna iva kuñjaraḥ
ce_text: ity uktvā rākṣasān sarvān bhīmaseno vyagāhata / tataḥ sa rākṣasair vācā pratiṣiddhaḥ pratāpavān / mā maivam iti sakrodhair bhartsayadbhiḥ samantataḥ

vulgate_text: te sarve tvaritā gatvā dadṛśustatra kānane / padmasaugandhikavatīṃnalinīṃ sumanoramām
ce_text: te gatvā sahitāḥ sarve dadṛśus tatra kānane / praphullapaṅkajavatīṃ nalinīṃ sumanoharām

vulgate_text: bhinnakāyākṣibāhūrunsaṃcūrṇitaśirodharān / taṃ ca bhīmaṃ mahātmānaṃ tasyāstīre vyavasthitam
ce_text: taṃ ca bhīmaṃ mahātmānaṃ tasyās tīre vyavasthitam / dadṛśur nihatāṃś caiva yakṣān suvipulekṣaṇān

vulgate_text: sakrodhaṃ stavdhanayanaṃ saṃdaṣṭadaśanacchadam / udyamya ca gadāṃ dorbhyāṃ nadītīre vyavasthitam
ce_text: udyamya ca gadāṃ dorbhyāṃ nadītīre vyavasthitam / prajāsaṃkṣepasamaye daṇḍahastam ivāntakam

vulgate_text: uvāca ślakṣṇayā vācā kaunteya kimidaṃ kṛtam sāhasaṃ vata bhadraṃ te devānāmapi cāpriyam / punarevaṃ na kartavyaṃ mama cedicchasi priyam
ce_text: sāhasaṃ bata bhadraṃ te devānām api cāpriyam / punar evaṃ na kartavyaṃ mama ced icchasi priyam

vulgate_text: viditāścakuberasya tatrate kurupuṅgavāḥ ūṣurnāticiraṃ kālaṃ ramamāṇāḥ kurūdvahāḥ / pratīkṣamāṇaā bībhatsuṃ gandhamādanasānuṣu
ce_text: sāntvitā dharmarājena praseduḥ kṣaṇadācarāḥ / viditāś ca kuberasya tatas te narapuṃgavāḥ / ūṣur nāticiraṃ kālaṃ ramamāṇāḥ kurūdvahāḥ

vulgate_text: tatastānpariviśvastānvasatastatra pāṇḍavān [parvatendre dvijaiḥ sārdhaṃ pārtāgamanakāṅkṣayā ]
ce_text: tatas tān pariviśvastān vasatas tatra pāṇḍavān / gateṣu teṣu rakṣaḥsu bhīmasenātmaje 'pi ca

vulgate_text: gateṣu teṣu rakṣaḥsu bhīmasenātmaje'pi ca rahitānmīmasenena kadācittānyadṛcchayā / jahāra dharmarājaṃ vai yamau kṛṣṇāṃ ca rākṣasaḥ
ce_text: rahitān bhīmasenena kadā cit tān yadṛcchayā / jahāra dharmarājānaṃ yamau kṛṣṇāṃ ca rākṣasaḥ

vulgate_text: brahmankathaṃ dharmarājaṃ yamau kṛṣṇāṃ ca rākṣasaḥ jahāra citraṃ bhīmaśca gato rākṣasakaṇṭakaḥ / vaktumarhasi viprāgrya vyaktametanmamā'nagha
ce_text: rahitān bhīmasenena kadā cit tān yadṛcchayā / jahāra dharmarājānaṃ yamau kṛṣṇāṃ ca rākṣasaḥ

vulgate_text: antaraṃ saṃpariprepsurdraupadyā haraṇaṃ prati / duṣṭātmā pāpabuddhiḥ sa nāmnā khyāto jaṭāsuraḥ
ce_text: parīkṣamāṇaḥ pārthānāṃ kalāpāni dhanūṃṣi ca / antaraṃ samabhiprepsur nāmnā khyāto jaṭāsuraḥ

vulgate_text: sa bhīmasene niṣkrānte mṛgayārthamariṃdame / [ghaṭotkacaṃ sānucaraṃ dṛṣṭvā vipradrutaṃ diśaḥ
ce_text: sa bhīmasene niṣkrānte mṛgayārtham ariṃdame / anyad rūpaṃ samāsthāya vikṛtaṃ bhairavaṃ mahat

vulgate_text: [vikramya kauśikaṃ khaṅgaṃ mokṣayitvā grahaṃ ripoḥ ] ākrandadbhīmasena vai yena yāto mahābalaḥ
ce_text: sahadevas tu yatnena tato 'pakramya pāṇḍavaḥ / ākrandad bhīmasenaṃ vai yena yāto mahābalaḥ

vulgate_text: ye'nye kvacinmanuṣyeṣu tiryagyonigatāśca ye / dharmaṃ te samavekṣante rakṣāṃsi ca viśeṣataḥ
ce_text: ye 'nye ke cin manuṣyeṣu tiryagyonigatā api / gandharvayakṣarakṣāṃsi vayāṃsi paśavas tathā / manuṣyān upajīvanti tatas tvam upajīvasi

vulgate_text: devāśca ṛṣayaḥ siddhāḥ pitaraścāpi rākṣasa / gandharvoragarakṣāṃsi vayāṃsi paśavastathā
ce_text: ye 'nye ke cin manuṣyeṣu tiryagyonigatā api / gandharvayakṣarakṣāṃsi vayāṃsi paśavas tathā / manuṣyān upajīvanti tatas tvam upajīvasi

vulgate_text: tiryagyonigatāścaiva api kīṭapipīlikāḥ / manuṣyānupajīvanti tatastvamapi jīvasi
ce_text: ye 'nye ke cin manuṣyeṣu tiryagyonigatā api / gandharvayakṣarakṣāṃsi vayāṃsi paśavas tathā / manuṣyān upajīvanti tatas tvam upajīvasi

vulgate_text: brahmarūpapraticchanno na no vadasi cāpriyam priyeṣu ramamāṇaṃ tvāṃ na caivāpriyakāriṇam / brahmarūpeṇa vihitaṃ naiva hanyāmanāgasam
ce_text: priyeṣu caramāṇaṃ tvāṃ na caivāpriyakāriṇam / atithiṃ brahmarūpaṃ ca kathaṃ hanyām anāgasam / rākṣasaṃ manyamāno 'pi yo hanyān narakaṃ vrajet

vulgate_text: bruvanvai tiṣṭhatiṣṭheti krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ / bāhusaṃrambhamevecchannabhidudrāva rākṣasam
ce_text: evam uktas tato bhīmaḥ sṛkkiṇī parisaṃlihan / smayamāna iva krodhāt sākṣāt kālāntakopamaḥ / bāhusaṃrambham evecchann abhidudrāva rākṣasam

vulgate_text: bhīmaseno'pyavaṣṭabdho niyuddhāyābhavatsthitaḥ / rākṣaso'pi ca visrabdho bāhuyuddhamakāṅkṣata
ce_text: rākṣaso 'pi tadā bhīmaṃ yuddhārthinam avasthitam / abhidudrāva saṃrabdho balo vajradharaṃ yathā

vulgate_text: prāpya parvatarājānaṃ śvetaṃ śikhariṇāṃvaram / [puṣpitairdrumaṣaṇḍaiśca mattakokilāṣaṭpadaiḥ
ce_text: prāpya parvatarājānaṃ śvetaṃ śikhariṇāṃ varam / tatrāpi ca kṛtoddeśaḥ samāgamadidṛkṣubhiḥ

ce_text: prāpya parvatarājānaṃ śvetaṃ śikhariṇāṃ varam / tatrāpi ca kṛtoddeśaḥ samāgamadidṛkṣubhiḥ

vulgate_text: pārijātānkovidārāndevadārudrumāṃstathā pārijātānkovidārāndevadārudrumāṃstathā / śālāṃstālāṃstamālāṃśca pippalānhiṅgukāṃstathā
ce_text: pārijātān kovidārān devadārutarūṃs tathā / śālāṃs tālāṃs tamālāṃś ca priyālān bakulāṃs tathā / śālmalīḥ kiṃśukāśokāñ śiṃśapāṃs taralāṃs tathā

vulgate_text: sarāṃsi ca manojñāni samantājjalacāribhiḥ kumudaiḥ puṇḍarīkaiśca tṛthā kokanadotpalaiḥ / kahāraiḥ kamalaiścaiva ācitāni samantataḥ
ce_text: sarāṃsi ca vicitrāṇi prasannasalilāni ca / kumudaiḥ puṇḍarīkaiś ca tathā kokanadotpalaiḥ / kahlāraiḥ kamalaiś caiva ācitāni samantataḥ

vulgate_text: apaśyaṃste naravyāghrā gandhamādanasānuṣu / tathaiva padmaṣaṇḍaiśca maṇḍitāṃśca samantataḥ
ce_text: tathaiva padmaṣaṇḍaiś ca maṇḍiteṣu samantataḥ / śikhaṇḍinībhiḥ sahitāṃl latāmaṇḍapakeṣu ca / meghatūryaravoddāmamadanākulitān bhṛśam

vulgate_text: mayūrāndadṛśurhṛṣṭānnṛtyato vanalālasān / kāṃścitpriyābhiḥ sahitānramamāṇānkalāpinaḥ
ce_text: kṛtvaiva kekāmadhuraṃ saṃgītamadhurasvaram / citrān kalāpān vistīrya savilāsān madālasān / mayūrān dadṛśuś citrān nṛtyato vanalāsakān

vulgate_text: na tāta capalairbhāvyamiha prāptaiḥ kathaṃcana / capalaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ dveṣyo bhavati mānavaḥ
ce_text: na tāta capalair bhāvyam iha prāptaiḥ kathaṃ cana / uṣitveha yathākāmaṃ yathāśraddhaṃ vihṛtya ca / tataḥ śastrabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭha pṛthivīṃ pālayiṣyasi

vulgate_text: ārṣṭiṣeṇāśrame tasminmama pūrvapitāmahāḥ / pāṇḍoḥ putrā mahātmāna sarve divyaparākramāḥ
ce_text: pāṇḍoḥ putrā mahātmānaḥ sarve divyaparākramāḥ / kiyantaṃ kālam avasan parvate gandhamādane

vulgate_text: kiyantaṃ kālamavasanparvate gandhamādane / kiṃca cakrurmahāvīryāḥ sarve'tibalapauruṣāḥ
ce_text: pāṇḍoḥ putrā mahātmānaḥ sarve divyaparākramāḥ / kiyantaṃ kālam avasan parvate gandhamādane

vulgate_text: na khalvāsītpunaryuddhaṃ tas yakṣairdvijottama / dhanadādhyuṣite nityaṃ vasatastatra parvate
ce_text: vistareṇa ca me śaṃsa bhīmasenaparākramam / yad yac cakre mahābāhus tasmin haimavate girau / na khalv āsīt punar yuddhaṃ tasya yakṣair dvijottama

vulgate_text: divyāvarṇāni divyāni divyagandhavahāni ca / madayantīva gandhena mano me bharatarṣabha
ce_text: tatra puṣpāṇi divyāni suhṛdbhiḥ saha pāṇḍavāḥ / dadṛśuḥ pañca varṇāni draupadī ca yaśasvinī

vulgate_text: vāsudevasahāyena vāsudevapriyeṇa ca / khāṇḍave satyasandhena bhrātrā tava mahātmanā
ce_text: khāṇḍave satyasaṃdhena bhrātrā tava nareśvara / gandharvoragarakṣāṃsi vāsavaś ca nivāritaḥ / hatā māyāvinaś cogrā dhanuḥ prāptaṃ ca gāṇḍivam

vulgate_text: śoṇitasya tataḥ peturghanānāmiva bhārata gātrebhyaḥ pracyutā dhārā rākṣasānāṃ samantataḥ / sa lohitamahāvaṣṭimabhyavarṣanmahābalaḥ
ce_text: sā lohitamahāvṛṣṭir abhyavarṣan mahābalam / kāyebhyaḥ pracyutā dhārā rākṣasānāṃ samantataḥ

vulgate_text: gadāparighapāṇīnāṃ rakṣasāṃ kāyasaṃbhavā / kāyebhyaḥ pracyutā dhārā rākṣasānāṃ samantataḥ
ce_text: sā lohitamahāvṛṣṭir abhyavarṣan mahābalam / kāyebhyaḥ pracyutā dhārā rākṣasānāṃ samantataḥ

vulgate_text: rukmapaṭṭapinaddhāṃ tāṃ śatrūṇāṃ bhayavardhinīm pragṛhyātha nadanbhīmaḥ śaikyāṃ sarvāyasīṃ gadām / tarasā cābhidudrāva maṇimantaṃ mahābalam
ce_text: tāṃ pragṛhyonnadan bhīmaḥ sarvaśaikyāyasīṃ gadām / tarasā so 'bhidudrāva maṇimantaṃ mahābalam

vulgate_text: evamuktvā sa dharmātmā bhrātā bhrātaramacyutam / bhīmasenaṃ mahābāhumapradhṛṣyaparākramam
ce_text: evam uktvā sa dharmātmā bhrātā bhrātaram acyutam / arthatattvavibhāgajñaḥ kuntīputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / virarāma mahātejās tam evārthaṃ vicintayan

vulgate_text: tataste tu mahāyakṣāḥ kruddhaṃ dṛṣṭvā dhaneśvaram / harṣayāmāsuranyonyamiṅgitairvijayāvahaiḥ
ce_text: śobhamānā rathe yuktās tariṣyanta ivāśugāḥ / harṣayām āsur anyonyam iṅgitair vijayāvahaiḥ

vulgate_text: taṃ prayāntaṃ mahātmānaṃ sarve yakṣā dhanādhipam / anujagmurmahātmānaṃ dhanadaṃ ghoradarśanāḥ
ce_text: taṃ prayāntaṃ mahātmānaṃ sarvayakṣadhanādhipam / raktākṣā hemasaṃkāśā mahākāyā mahābalāḥ

vulgate_text: kuberaṃ ca mahātmānaṃ yakṣarakṣogaṇāvṛtam / dadṛśurhṛṣṭaromāṇaḥ pāṇḍavāḥ priyadarśanam
ce_text: taṃ mahāntam upāyāntaṃ dhaneśvaram upāntike / dadṛśur hṛṣṭaromāṇaḥ pāṇḍavāḥ priyadarśanam

vulgate_text: te pakṣiṇa ivāpeturgiriśṛṅgaṃ mahājavāḥ / tasthusteṣāṃ sakāśe vai dhaneśvarapuraḥsarāḥ
ce_text: te pakṣiṇa ivotpatya gireḥ śṛṅgaṃ mahājavāḥ / tasthus teṣāṃ samabhyāśe dhaneśvarapuraḥsarāḥ

vulgate_text: nyaṣṭhīvadākāśagato maharṣestasya mūrdhani / tataḥ kruddhaḥ sa bhagavānuvācedaṃ tapodhanaḥ
ce_text: rākṣasādhipatiḥ śrīmān maṇimān nāma me sakhā / maurkhyād ajñānabhāvāc ca darpān mohāc ca bhārata / nyaṣṭhīvad ākāśagato maharṣes tasya mūrdhani

vulgate_text: alakāṃ saha gandharvairyakṣaiśca saha kinnaraiḥ / gamiṣyāmi mahābāho tvaṃ cāpi badarīṃ vraja

vulgate_text: tathaiva cānnapānāni svādūni ca babūni ca / āhariṣyanti matpreṣyāḥ sadā vaḥ puruṣarṣabhāḥ
ce_text: tathaiva cānnapānāni svādūni ca bahūni ca / upasthāsyanti vo gṛhya matpreṣyāḥ puruṣarṣabha

vulgate_text: teṣāṃ hi śāpakālaḥ sa kṛto'gastyena dhīmatā / samare nihatāstasmācchāpasyānto'bhavattadā
ce_text: teṣāṃ hi śāpakālo 'sau kṛto 'gastyena dhīmatā / samare nihatās tasmāt sarve maṇimatā saha

vulgate_text: tataḥ sūryodaye dhaumyaḥ pāñcālīsahitāṃsca tān / ārṣṭiṇena sahitaḥ pāṇḍavānabhyavartata
ce_text: tataḥ sūryodaye dhaumyaḥ kṛtvāhnikam ariṃdama / ārṣṭiṣeṇena sahitaḥ pāṇḍavān abhyavartata

vulgate_text: ārṣṭiṣeṇaṃ pariṣvajya putravadbharatarṣabha dharmarājaṃ spṛśanpāṇau pāṇinā sa mahātapāḥ / prācīṃ diśamabhiprekṣya maharṣiridamabravīt
ce_text: tato yudhiṣṭhiraṃ dhaumyo gṛhītvā dakṣiṇe kare / prācīṃ diśam abhiprekṣya maharṣir idam abravīt

vulgate_text: na taṃ jyotīṃpi sarvāṇi prāpya bhāsanti pāṇḍava / svayaṃprabhuracintyātmā tatra hyativirājate
ce_text: tad vai jyotīṃṣi sarvāṇi prāpya bhāsanti no 'pi ca / svayaṃ vibhur adīnātmā tatra hy abhivirājate

vulgate_text: tatra gatvā punarnemaṃ lokamāyānti bhārata / svayaṃbhuvaṃ mahātmānaṃ devadevaṃ sanātanam
ce_text: yogasiddhā mahātmānas tamomohavivarjitāḥ / tatra gatvā punar nemaṃ lokam āyānti bhārata

vulgate_text: evametaṃ tvatikramya mahāmerumatandritaḥ somaśca vibhajankālaṃ bahudhā parvasandhiṣu / bhāsayansarvabhūtāni punargacchati sāgaram
ce_text: evam eṣa parikramya mahāmerum atandritaḥ / bhāvayan sarvabhūtāni punar gacchati mandaram

vulgate_text: krīḍāpradeśāṃsca samṛddharūpānsavedikāṃste nyavasansuveśān / maṇiprakīrṇāṃśca manoramāṃśca yathā bhaveyurnadasya rājñaḥ
