vulgate_text: payāṃsi dadhisarpīṣi rasavanti hitāni ca / salilāni prasannāni sarve bhāvāśca śobhanāḥ
ce_text: gāvaś ca bahulās tatra na kṛśā na ca durduhāḥ / payāṃsi dadhisarpīṃṣi rasavanti hitāni ca

vulgate_text: dharmāśca tatra sarvaistu sevitāśca dvijātibhiḥ svaiḥsvairguṇaiśca saṃyuktā kasminvarṣe trayodaśe / deśe tasminbhaviṣyanti tata pāṇḍavasaṃśrite
ce_text: svaiḥ svair guṇaiḥ susaṃyuktās tasmin varṣe trayodaśe / deśe tasmin bhaviṣyanti tāta pāṇḍavasaṃyute

vulgate_text: śubhatviṣaḥ śubhecchāśca nityatuṣṭāḥ śriyā'nvitāḥ / bhaviṣyanti janāstatra yatra rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
ce_text: iṣṭadāno mahotsāhaḥ śaśvad dharmaparāyaṇaḥ / aśubhadviṭ śubhaprepsur nityayajñaḥ śubhavrataḥ / bhaviṣyati janas tatra yatra rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ

vulgate_text: dharmajñaḥ sa tu durjñeyaḥ sarvajñaiśca dvijātibhiḥ / kiṃpunaḥ prākṛtaistāta pārtho vijñāyate kvacit
ce_text: dharmātmā sa tadādṛśyaḥ so 'pi tāta dvijātibhiḥ / kiṃ punaḥ prākṛtaiḥ pārthaḥ śakyo vijñātum antataḥ

vulgate_text: tasmānnivāsaḥ pārthānāṃ cintyatāṃ yadbravīmi vaḥ / gatirvā paramā tatra notsahe vaktumanyathā
ce_text: tasmāt tatra nivāsaṃ tu channaṃ satreṇa dhīmataḥ / gatiṃ vā paramāṃ tasya notsahe vaktum anyathā

vulgate_text: evametattu saṃcintya yatkṛtyaṃ sādhu manyase tatkṣipraṃ kuru kauravya yadyetacchraddadhāsi me / kulasya hi kṣamaṃ tāta yadahaṃ prabravīmi te
ce_text: evam etat tu saṃcintya yatkṛtaṃ manyase hitam / tat kṣipraṃ kuru kauravya yady evaṃ śraddadhāsi me

vulgate_text: dharmārthasahitaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ sarvaṃ satyaṃ sahetukam / tatrānurūpaṃ bhīṣmasya mamāpi vacanaṃ śṛṇu
ce_text: dharmārthasahitaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ tattvataś ca sahetumat / tatrānurūpaṃ bhīṣmeṇa mamāpy atra giraṃ śṛṇu

vulgate_text: nāvajñeyo ripustāta prākṛto'pi bubhūṣatā / kiṃ punaḥ pāṇḍavāḥ śūrā vidvāṃso balinastathā
ce_text: nāvajñeyo ripus tāta prākṛto 'pi bubhūṣatā / kiṃ punaḥ pāṇḍavās tāta sarvāstrakuśalā raṇe

vulgate_text: rāṣṭraṃ mamāsakṛdrājanrājñā mātsyena bādhitam
ce_text: asakṛn matsyarājñā me rāṣṭraṃ bādhitam ojasā / praṇetā kīcakaś cāsya balavān abhavat purā

vulgate_text: praṇetā kīcakastasya balotsikto'bhavanpurā amarṣī durjayo jetā prakhyātabalapauruṣaḥ / sa hatastatra gandharvaiḥ pāpakarmā nṛśaṃsakṛt
ce_text: krūro 'marṣī sa duṣṭātmā bhuvi prakhyātavikramaḥ / nihatas tatra gandharvaiḥ pāpakarmā nṛśaṃsavān

vulgate_text: prajñāvānkulavṛddhaśca sarveṣāṃ naḥ pitāmahaḥ / ācāryaśca kṛpo vidvāñśakuniścāpi saubalaḥ
ce_text: prajñāvān kuruvṛddho 'yaṃ sarveṣāṃ naḥ pitāmahaḥ / ācāryaś ca tathā droṇaḥ kṛpaḥ śāradvatas tathā

vulgate_text: tadbhavāṃścaturaṅgeṇa balena mahatā vṛtaḥ virāṭanagaraṃ yātu sarvasainyena bhārata / ādāsyāmo'tha gāstasya vividhāni vasūni ca
ce_text: yāmo rājann anudvignā virāṭaviṣayaṃ vayam / ādāsyāmo hi gās tasya vividhāni vasūni ca

vulgate_text: suśarmā tu yathoddiṣṭaṃ deśaṃ yātu mahārathaḥ trigartaiḥ sahitaḥ sarvaiḥ prakhyātabalapauruṣaiḥ / prāgeva hi susaṃyatto virāṭanagaraṃ prati
ce_text: yathoddeśaṃ ca gacchāmaḥ sahitāḥ sarvakauravaiḥ / suśarmā tu yathoddiṣṭaṃ deśaṃ yātu mahārathaḥ

vulgate_text: tathā gatvā yathoddeśaṃ virāṭanagarāntike / kṣipraṃ goṣṭhaṃ samāsādya gṛhṇantu vipulaṃ dhanam
ce_text: te yātvā sahasā tatra virāṭanagaraṃ prati / kṣipraṃ gopān samāsādya gṛhṇantu vipulaṃ dhanam

vulgate_text: ādatta gāḥ suśarmā'tha kṛṣṇapakṣasya cāṣṭamīm
ce_text: sa sma gatvā yathoddiṣṭāṃ diśaṃ vahner mahīpatiḥ / ādatta gāḥ suśarmātha gharmapakṣasya saptamīm

vulgate_text: apare divase sarve rājansaṃbhūya kauravāḥ navamyāṃ te nyagṛhṇanta gokulāni sahasraśaḥ / kauravāstu mahāvīryā matsyānāṃ viṣayāntare
ce_text: aparaṃ divasaṃ sarve rājan saṃbhūya kauravāḥ / aṣṭamyāṃ tāny agṛhṇanta gokulāni sahasraśaḥ

vulgate_text: javena mahatā caiva gopālāḥ puramāvrajan / virāṭanagaraṃ prāpya narā rājānamabruvan
ce_text: tato javena mahatā gopāḥ puram athāvrajat / apaśyan matsyarājaṃ ca rathāt praskandya kuṇḍalī

vulgate_text: sabhāyāṃ rājaśārdūlamāsīnaṃ pāṇḍavaiḥ saha / śūraiḥ parivṛtaṃ yodhaiḥ kuṇḍalāṅgadadhāribhiḥ
ce_text: śūraiḥ parivṛtaṃ yodhaiḥ kuṇḍalāṅgadadhāribhiḥ / sadbhiś ca mantribhiḥ sārdhaṃ pāṇḍavaiś ca nararṣabhaiḥ

vulgate_text: sadbhiśca paṇḍitaiḥ sārdhaṃ mantribhiścāpi saṃvṛtam / dṛṣṭvā śīghraṃ tu gopālā virāṭamidamabravan
ce_text: śūraiḥ parivṛtaṃ yodhaiḥ kuṇḍalāṅgadadhāribhiḥ / sadbhiś ca mantribhiḥ sārdhaṃ pāṇḍavaiś ca nararṣabhaiḥ

vulgate_text: śrutvā tu vacanaṃ teṣāṃ gopālānāmariṃdamaḥ sa rājā mahatīṃ senāṃ mātsyānāṃ samavāhayat / rathanāgāśvakalilāṃ pattidhvajasamākulām
ce_text: tac chrutvā nṛpatiḥ senāṃ matsyānāṃ samayojayat / rathanāgāśvakalilāṃ pattidhvajasamākulām

vulgate_text: pṛthakkāñcanasannāhānratheṣvaśvānayojayan / utkṛṣya pāśānmaurvīṇāṃ śūrāścāpeṣvayojayan
ce_text: sūpaskareṣu śubhreṣu mahatsu ca mahārathāḥ / pṛthak kāñcanasaṃnāhān ratheṣv aśvān ayojayan

vulgate_text: dṛḍhamāyasagarbhaṃ ca śvetaṃ rukmapariṣkṛtam / virāṭasya suto jyeṣṭho vīraḥ śaṅkho'bhyahārayat
ce_text: dṛḍham āyasagarbhaṃ tu śvetaṃ varma śatākṣimat / virāṭasya suto jyeṣṭho vīraḥ śaṅkho 'bhyahārayat

vulgate_text: tato nānātanutrāṇi svānisvāni mahābalāḥ / yuyutsavo'bhyanahyanta devakalpāḥ prahāriṇaḥ
ce_text: śataśaś ca tanutrāṇi yathāsvāni mahārathāḥ / yotsyamānābhyanahyanta devarūpāḥ prahāriṇaḥ

vulgate_text: dhvajānbahuvidhākārānsauvarṇānhemamālinaḥ / yathāsvaṃ kṣatriyāḥ śūrā ratheṣu samayojayan
ce_text: athānyān vividhākārān dhvajān hemavibhūṣitān / yathāsvaṃ kṣatriyāḥ śūrā ratheṣu samayojayan

vulgate_text: atha mātsyo'bravīdrājā śatānīkaṃ jaghanyajam / kaṅkaśca valalaḥ sūdo dāmagranthiśca vīryavān
ce_text: atha matsyo 'bravīd rājā śatānīkaṃ jaghanyajam / kaṅkaballavagopālā dāmagranthiś ca vīryavān / yudhyeyur iti me buddhir vartate nātra saṃśayaḥ

vulgate_text: tantripālaśca gosaṅkhyo yathā te puruṣarṣabhāḥ śūrāḥ suvīrāḥ puruṣā nāgarājavaropamāḥ / yuddhyeyuriti me buddhirvartate nātra saṃśayaḥ
ce_text: atha matsyo 'bravīd rājā śatānīkaṃ jaghanyajam / kaṅkaballavagopālā dāmagranthiś ca vīryavān / yudhyeyur iti me buddhir vartate nātra saṃśayaḥ

vulgate_text: sahadevāya rājñe ca bhīmāya nakulāya ca / tāndṛṣṭvā sahasā sūtā rājabhaktipuraskṛtāḥ
ce_text: etac chrutvā tu nṛpater vākyaṃ tvaritamānasaḥ / śatānīkas tu pārthebhyo rathān rājan samādiśat / sahadevāya rājñe ca bhīmāya nakulāya ca

vulgate_text: bhīmarūpāśca mātaṅgāḥ prabhinnakaraṭāmukhāḥ / svārūḍhā yuddhakuśalairmahāmātrādhirohitāḥ
ce_text: bhīmāś ca mattamātaṅgāḥ prabhinnakaraṭāmukhāḥ / kṣaranta iva jīmūtāḥ sudantāḥ ṣaṣṭihāyanāḥ

vulgate_text: dṛḍhāyudhajanākīrṇaṃ rathāśvagajasaṃkulam / tadbalāgraṃ virāṭasya śakrasyeva tadā babhau
ce_text: tad balāgryaṃ virāṭasya saṃprasthitam aśobhata / dṛḍhāyudhajanākīrṇaṃ gajāśvarathasaṃkulam

vulgate_text: taṃ prayāntaṃ mahārāja ninīṣantaṃ gavāṃ padam / viśāradānāṃ vaiśyānāṃ prakṛṣṭānāṃ tadā nṛpa
ce_text: tad anīkaṃ virāṭasya śuśubhe bharatarṣabha / saṃprayātaṃ mahārāja ninīṣantaṃ gavāṃ padam

vulgate_text: viṃśatistu sahasrāṇi narāṇāmanuyāyinām aṣṭau rathasahasrāṇi daśa nāgaśatāni ca / viṃśaccāśvasahasrāṇi mātsyānāṃ tvaritaṃ yayuḥ
ce_text: viśāradānāṃ vaśyānāṃ hṛṣṭānāṃ cānuyāyinām / aṣṭau rathasahasrāṇi daśa nāgaśatāni ca / ṣaṣṭiś cāśvasahasrāṇi matsyānām abhiniryayuḥ

vulgate_text: tadanīkaṃ virāṭasya śuśubhe'tīva bhārata / vasante bahupuṣpāḍhyaṃ kānanaṃ citritaṃ yathā
ce_text: tad anīkaṃ virāṭasya śuśubhe bharatarṣabha / saṃprayātaṃ mahārāja ninīṣantaṃ gavāṃ padam

vulgate_text: teṣāṃ samāgamo ghorastumulo romaharṣaṇaḥ / ghnatāṃ parasparaṃ rājanyamarāṣṭravivardhanaḥ
ce_text: teṣāṃ samāgamo ghoras tumulo lomaharṣaṇaḥ / devāsurasamo rājann āsīt sūrye vilambati

vulgate_text: devāsurasamo rājannāsītsūrye'balambati / padātirathanāgendrahayārohabalaughavān
ce_text: teṣāṃ samāgamo ghoras tumulo lomaharṣaṇaḥ / devāsurasamo rājann āsīt sūrye vilambati

vulgate_text: anyonyamabhyāpatatāṃ nighnatāṃ cetaretaram / udatiṣṭhadrajo bhaumaṃ na prājñāyata kiṃcana
ce_text: udatiṣṭhad rajo bhaumaṃ na prajñāyata kiṃ cana / pakṣiṇaś cāpatan bhūmau sainyena rajasāvṛtāḥ

vulgate_text: rukmapṛṣṭhāni cāpāni vicerurvidyuto yathā / nardatāṃ lokavīrāṇāṃ savyaṃ dakṣiṇamasyatām
ce_text: rukmapṛṣṭhāni cāpāni vyatiṣaktāni dhanvinām / patatāṃ lokavīrāṇāṃ savyadakṣiṇam asyatām

vulgate_text: nighnantaḥ samare'nyonyaṃ hṛṣṭāḥ parighapāṇayaḥ / na śekuratisaṃkruddhāḥ śūrāḥ kartuṃ parāṅbhukham
ce_text: nighnantaḥ samare 'nyonyaṃ śūrāḥ parighabāhavaḥ / na śekur abhisaṃrabdhāḥ śūrān kartuṃ parāṅmukhān

vulgate_text: raktādharoṣṭhaṃ sunasaṃ klṛptaśmaśru svalaṃkṛtam / adṛśyata śiraśchinnaṃ rajovidhvastakuṇḍalam
ce_text: kḷptottaroṣṭhaṃ sunasaṃ kḷptakeśam alaṃkṛtam / adṛśyata śiraś chinnaṃ rajodhvastaṃ sakuṇḍalam

vulgate_text: virāṭastatra saṃgrāme hatvā pañcaśataṃ rathān / kuñjarāṇāṃ śataṃ caiva sahasraṃ vājināṃ tathā
ce_text: virāṭas tatra saṃgrāme hatvā pañcaśatān rathān / hayānāṃ ca śatāny atra hatvā pañca mahārathān

vulgate_text: tau tu prāharatāṃ tatra maheṣvāsau mahābalau / anyonyamabhinighnantau goṣu govṛṣabhāviva
ce_text: tau vyāvaharatāṃ tatra mahātmānau mahābalau / anyonyam abhigarjantau goṣṭhe govṛṣabhāv iva

vulgate_text: rājasiṃhau susaṃrabdhau virejaturamarṣaṇau / kṛtāsrau niśitairbāṇairasiśaktiparaśvathaiḥ
ce_text: anyonyaṃ cātisaṃrabdhau viceratur amarṣaṇau / kṛtāstrau niśitair bāṇair asiśaktigadābhṛtau

vulgate_text: anyonyamabhisaṃrabdhau dantābhyāmiva kuñjarau / kṛtāstrau niśitairbāṇairdārayāmāsatū raṇe
ce_text: anyonyaṃ cātisaṃrabdhau viceratur amarṣaṇau / kṛtāstrau niśitair bāṇair asiśaktigadābhṛtau

vulgate_text: mātsyo rājā suśarmāṇaṃ vivyādha niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ / pañcabhiḥ pañcabhirbāṇairvivyādha caturo hayān
ce_text: tato rājā suśarmāṇaṃ vivyādha daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ / pañcabhiḥ pañcabhiś cāsya vivyādha caturo hayān

vulgate_text: dvābhyāṃ sūtaṃ ca vivyādha ketuṃ ca tribhirāśugaiḥ tathaiva mātsyarājaṃ tu suśarmā yuddhadurmadaḥ / pañcāśadbhiḥ śitairbāṇaivivyādha paramāstravit
ce_text: tathaiva matsyarājānaṃ suśarmā yuddhadurmadaḥ / pañcāśatā śitair bāṇair vivyādha paramāstravit

vulgate_text: tayorbalāni rājendra samastāni mahāraṇe / nājānanta tadā'nyonyaṃ pradoṣe rajasā vṛte
ce_text: tataḥ sainyaṃ samāvṛtya matsyarājasuśarmaṇoḥ / nābhyajānaṃs tadānyonyaṃ pradoṣe rajasāvṛte

vulgate_text: tau nihatya pṛthagdhuryānubhayoḥ pārṣṇisārathī / āstāṃ tulyadhanurgrāhau kṛṣṇakaṃsāvivoddhatau
ce_text: tau nihatya pṛthag dhuryāv ubhau ca pārṣṇisārathī / virathaṃ matsyarājānaṃ jīvagrāham agṛhṇatām

vulgate_text: suśarmā paravīraghno balavānvīryavāngadī / virathaṃ matsyarājānaṃ jīvagrāhamathāgrahīt
ce_text: tau nihatya pṛthag dhuryāv ubhau ca pārṣṇisārathī / virathaṃ matsyarājānaṃ jīvagrāham agṛhṇatām

vulgate_text: tasmingṛhīte virathe virāṭe balavattare / balaṃ sarvaṃ vibhagnaṃ tannirutsāhaṃ nirāśakam
ce_text: tasmin gṛhīte virathe virāṭe balavattare / prādravanta bhayān matsyās trigartair arditā bhṛśam

vulgate_text: prādravanta bhayānmātsyāstrigartairarditā raṇe / vidikṣuḥ dikṣu sarvāsu palāyanti ca yānti ca
ce_text: tasmin gṛhīte virathe virāṭe balavattare / prādravanta bhayān matsyās trigartair arditā bhṛśam

vulgate_text: teṣu vidrāṃvyamāṇeṣu kuntīputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / abhyabhāṣata dharmātmā bhimasenamarindamam
ce_text: teṣu saṃtrāsyamāneṣu kuntīputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / abhyabhāṣan mahābāhuṃ bhīmasenam ariṃdamam

vulgate_text: ayaṃ vṛkṣo mahāśākho girimātro vanaspatiḥ / ahamenaṃ samārujya pothayiṣyāmi śātravān
ce_text: suskandho 'yaṃ mahāvṛkṣo gadārūpa iva sthitaḥ / enam eva samārujya drāvayiṣyāmi śātravān

vulgate_text: trigartāḥ samabhikramya ayudhyanta jayaiṣiṇaḥ tānbhīmasenaḥ saṃkruddhaḥ sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃvaraḥ / vairāṭiḥ paramakruddho yuyudhe paramādbhutam
ce_text: tān nivṛttarathān dṛṣṭvā pāṇḍavān sā mahācamūḥ / vairāṭī paramakruddhā yuyudhe paramādbhutam

vulgate_text: sahasraṃ prāhiṇīdrājā kuntīputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / nakulaścāpi saptaiva śatāni prāhiṇoccharaiḥ
ce_text: sahasraṃ nyavadhīt tatra kuntīputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / bhīmaḥ saptaśatān yodhān paralokam adarśayat / nakulaś cāpi saptaiva śatāni prāhiṇoc charaiḥ

vulgate_text: praviśya mahatīṃ senāṃ trigartānāṃ mahābalaḥ / kṣobhayansarvabhūtāni siṃhaḥ kṣudramṛgāniva
ce_text: śatānīkaḥ śataṃ hatvā viśālākṣaś catuḥśatam / praviṣṭau mahatīṃ senāṃ trigartānāṃ mahārathau / ārcchetāṃ bahusaṃrabdhau keśākeśi nakhānakhi

vulgate_text: svabāhubalasaṃpannā hrīniṣevā yatavratāḥ virāṭasya mahātmānaḥ parikleśavināśanāḥ / sthitāḥ samakṣaṃ te sarve tvatha bhīmo'bhyabhāṣata
ce_text: svabāhubalasaṃpannā hrīniṣedhā yatavratāḥ / saṃgrāmaśiraso madhye tāṃ rātriṃ sukhino 'vasan

vulgate_text: visṛjya tu suśarmāṇaṃ pāṇḍavāste hatadviṣaḥ svabāhubalasaṃpannā hīniṣevā yatavratāḥ / saṃgrāmaśiraso madhye tāṃ rātriṃ sukhino'vasan
ce_text: svabāhubalasaṃpannā hrīniṣedhā yatavratāḥ / saṃgrāmaśiraso madhye tāṃ rātriṃ sukhino 'vasan

vulgate_text: taṃ tathāvādinaṃ tatra kauraveyāḥ pṛthakpṛthak / ūcuḥ prahṛṣṭamanaso yudhiṣṭhirapurogamāḥ
ce_text: tathābhivādinaṃ matsyaṃ kauraveyāḥ pṛthak pṛthak / ūcuḥ prāñjalayaḥ sarve yudhiṣṭhirapurogamāḥ

vulgate_text: pratinandāmahe vācaṃ sarvathaiva viśāṃpate / etāvatā'dya prītāḥsmo yattvaṃ muktosi śatrubhiḥ
ce_text: pratinandāma te vākyaṃ sarvaṃ caiva viśāṃ pate / etenaiva pratītāḥ smo yat tvaṃ mukto 'dya śatrubhiḥ

vulgate_text: athābravītprītamanā mātsyarājo yudhiṣṭhiram / nirbharaḥ prītipūreṇa harṣagadgadayā girā
ce_text: athābravīt prītamanā matsyarājo yudhiṣṭhiram / punar eva mahābāhur virāṭo rājasattamaḥ / ehi tvām abhiṣekṣyāmi matsyarājo 'stu no bhavān

vulgate_text: ānṛśaṃsyaparo nityaṃ sumukhaḥ satataṃ bhavān / punareva virāṭaśca rājā kaṅkamabhāṣata
ce_text: ānṛśaṃsyaparo nityaṃ susukhaḥ satataṃ bhava / gacchantu dūtās tvaritaṃ nagaraṃ tava pārthiva / suhṛdāṃ priyam ākhyātuṃ ghoṣayantu ca te jayam

vulgate_text: yāte trigartānmātsye tu paśūṃstānvai parīpsati / duryodhanaḥ sahāmātyairvirāṭa puramabhyagāt
ce_text: yāte trigartaṃ matsye tu paśūṃs tān svān parīpsati / duryodhanaḥ sahāmātyo virāṭam upayād atha

vulgate_text: iṣvastranipuṇo yodhaḥ sadā vīraśca me sutaḥ / samarthaḥ samare yoddhuṃ kauravaiḥ saha tādṛśai
ce_text: iṣvastre nipuṇo yodhaḥ sadā vīraś ca me sutaḥ / tasya tat satyam evāstu manuṣyendrasya bhāṣitam

vulgate_text: tasya tatsatyamevāstu manuṣyendrasya bhāṣitam / jayaśca niyato yuddhe kauravāśca dhruvaṃ hatāḥ
ce_text: iṣvastre nipuṇo yodhaḥ sadā vīraś ca me sutaḥ / tasya tat satyam evāstu manuṣyendrasya bhāṣitam

vulgate_text: niryāhi nagarācchīghraṃ rājaputra kimāsyate śvetāḥ kāñcanasaṃnāhā rathe yujyantu te hayāḥ / dhvajaṃ ca sihaṃ sauvarṇamucchrayasva tathā vibho
ce_text: śvetā rajatasaṃkāśā rathe yujyantu te hayāḥ / dhvajaṃ ca siṃhaṃ sauvarṇam ucchrayantu tavābhibhoḥ

vulgate_text: yadyahaṃ tvadhigaccheyaṃ yo me yantā bhavedyudhi / tvarāvānadya yāsyāmi samucchritamahādhvajaḥ
ce_text: sa labheyaṃ yadi tv anyaṃ hayayānavidaṃ naram / tvarāvān adya yātvāhaṃ samucchritamahādhvajam

vulgate_text: sa cānena sahāyena khāṇḍavaṃ cādahatpurā / arjunasya tadā'nena saṃgṛhītā hayottamāḥ
ce_text: yadā tat pāvako dāvam adahat khāṇḍavaṃ mahat / arjunasya tadānena saṃgṛhītā hayottamāḥ

vulgate_text: dhanūṃṣi ca vicitrāṇi bāṇāṃśca rucirānbahūn / āyudhāni ca vai tatra rathopasthe ca sa nyasat
ce_text: dhanūṃṣi ca mahārhāṇi bāṇāṃś ca rucirān bahūn / ādāya prayayau vīraḥ sa bṛhannaḍasārathiḥ

vulgate_text: nātidūramatho gatvā mātsyaputradhanañjayau / avaikṣetāmavitrastau kurūṇāṃ balināṃ balam
ce_text: nātidūram atho yātvā matsyaputradhanaṃjayau / avekṣetām amitraghnau kurūṇāṃ balināṃ balam / śmaśānam abhito gatvā āsasāda kurūn atha

vulgate_text: dṛṣṭipraṇāśo bhūtānāṃ divaspṛkkurusattama tadanīkamatho vīkṣya gajāśvarathasaṃkulam
ce_text: dadṛśe pārthivo reṇur janitas tena sarpatā / dṛṣṭipraṇāśo bhūtānāṃ divaspṛṅ narasattama

vulgate_text: hṛṣṭaromā bhayodvigno nimīlya svadṛśau tadā / kampamānaśarīraśca pārthaṃ vairāṭirabravīt
ce_text: droṇena ca saputreṇa maheṣvāsena dhīmatā / hṛṣṭaromā bhayodvignaḥ pārthaṃ vairāṭir abravīt

vulgate_text: nāśaṃse bhāratīṃ senāṃ praveṣṭuṃ bhīmakārmukām / devairapi sahendreṇa na śakyaṃ kiṃpunarnaraiḥ
ce_text: nāśaṃse bhāratīṃ senāṃ praveṣṭuṃ bhīmakārmukām / rathanāgāśvakalilāṃ pattidhvajasamākulām / dṛṣṭvaiva hi parān ājāv ātmā pravyathatīva me

vulgate_text: nītimanto maheṣvāsāḥ sarve yuddhaviśāradāḥ / mattā iva mahānāgā yuktadhvajapatākinaḥ
ce_text: duryodhanas tathā vīro rājā ca rathināṃ varaḥ / dyutimanto maheṣvāsāḥ sarve yuddhaviśāradāḥ

vulgate_text: dṛṣṭvā tu mahatīṃ senāṃ kurūṇāṃ dṛḍhadhanvinām / paridevayate mandaḥ sakāśe savyasācinaḥ
ce_text: aviyāto viyātasya maurkhyād dhūrtasya paśyataḥ / paridevayate mandaḥ sakāśe savyasācinaḥ

vulgate_text: madhyamāmiṣagṛdhrūnāṃ kurūṇāmātatāyinām neṣyāmi tvāṃ mahābāho mā tvaṃ hi vimanā bhava / samudramiva gambhīraṃ kurusainyamarindama
ce_text: madhyam āmiṣagṛdhrāṇāṃ kurūṇām ātatāyinām / neṣyāmi tvāṃ mahābāho pṛthivyām api yudhyatām

vulgate_text: tathā strīṣu pratiśrutya pauruṣaṃ puruṣeṣu ca / rathamāruhya niryātvā kimarthaṃ nāvabudhyase
ce_text: tathā strīṣu pratiśrutya pauruṣaṃ puruṣeṣu ca / katthamāno 'bhiniryāya kimarthaṃ na yuyutsase

vulgate_text: vikramantaṃ padanyāsairnamayantaṃ ca bhūtalam vidhūya veṇīṃ dhāvantamajānanto'rjunaṃ tadā / sainikāḥ prāhasankecidyoṣidrūpamavekṣya tam
ce_text: vidhūya veṇīṃ dhāvantam ajānanto 'rjunaṃ tadā / sainikāḥ prāhasan ke cit tathārūpam avekṣya tam

vulgate_text: taṃ ca śīghraṃ pradhāvantaṃ saṃprekṣya kuravo'bruvan / ko'yaṃ dhāvatyasaṅgena pūrvaṃ muktvā rathottamam
ce_text: taṃ śīghram abhidhāvantaṃ saṃprekṣya kuravo 'bruvan / ka eṣa veṣapracchanno bhasmaneva hutāśanaḥ

vulgate_text: ākāramarjunasyeva klībarūpaṃ bibharti ca / rūpeṇa pārthasadṛśaḥ strīveṣasamalaṃkṛtaḥ
ce_text: kiṃ cid asya yathā puṃsaḥ kiṃ cid asya yathā striyaḥ / sārūpyam arjunasyeva klībarūpaṃ bibharti ca

vulgate_text: droṇena caivamuktastu karṇaḥ provāca buddhimān / ekaḥ putro virāṭasya śūnye saṃnihitaḥ pure
ce_text: ekaḥ putro virāṭasya śūnye saṃnihitaḥ pure / sa eṣa kila niryāto bālabhāvān na pauruṣāt

vulgate_text: nūnaṃ tameva dhāvantaṃ jighṛkṣati dhanañjayaḥ / sārathiṃ hyuttaraṃ kṛtvā svayaṃ yoddhumihecchati
ce_text: sa no manye dhvajān dṛṣṭvā bhīta eṣa palāyati / taṃ nūnam eṣa dhāvantaṃ jighṛkṣati dhanaṃjayaḥ

vulgate_text: iti sma kuravaḥ sarve vimṛśantaḥ pṛthakpṛthak / na ca vyavasituṃ vīrā arjunaṃ śaknuvanti te
ce_text: iti sma kuravaḥ sarve vimṛśantaḥ pṛthak pṛthak / na ca vyavasituṃ kiṃ cid uttaraṃ śaknuvanti te / channaṃ tathā taṃ satreṇa pāṇḍavaṃ prekṣya bhārata

vulgate_text: channaṃ tathā taṃ veṣeṇa pāṇḍavaṃ prekṣya sainikāḥ arjuneti ca netyeva na vyavasyanti te punaḥ / iti sma kuravaḥ sarve vimṛśantaḥ punaḥ punaḥ
ce_text: iti sma kuravaḥ sarve vimṛśantaḥ pṛthak pṛthak / na ca vyavasituṃ kiṃ cid uttaraṃ śaknuvanti te / channaṃ tathā taṃ satreṇa pāṇḍavaṃ prekṣya bhārata

vulgate_text: mattāṃśca daśa mātaṅgānmuñca māṃ tvaṃ bṛhannale / gamiṣyāmi puraṃ ṣaṇḍa draṣṭuṃ mātaramadya tām
ce_text: hemadaṇḍapraticchannaṃ rathaṃ yuktaṃ ca suvrajaiḥ / mattāṃś ca daśa mātaṅgān muñca māṃ tvaṃ bṛhannaḍe

vulgate_text: ahaṃ taiḥ kurubhiryotsye pratyāneṣyāmi te paśūn / praviśaitadrathānīkamapradhṛṣyaṃ durāsadam
ce_text: praviśyaitad rathānīkam apradhṛṣyaṃ durāsadam / yantā bhūs tvaṃ naraśreṣṭha yotsye 'haṃ kurubhiḥ saha

vulgate_text: yantā bhava naraśreṣṭha yotsye'haṃ kurubhiḥ saha / śūrānsamaracaṇḍāṃśca nayiṣye yamasādanam
ce_text: praviśyaitad rathānīkam apradhṛṣyaṃ durāsadam / yantā bhūs tvaṃ naraśreṣṭha yotsye 'haṃ kurubhiḥ saha

vulgate_text: itastato viveṣṭantamakāmaṃ bhayapīḍitam / rathamāropamāyāsa pārthaḥ parapuraṃjayaḥ
ce_text: tata enaṃ viceṣṭantam akāmaṃ bhayapīḍitam / ratham āropayām āsa pārthaḥ praharatāṃ varaḥ

vulgate_text: yādṛśānyatra dṛśyante rūpāṇi vividhāni ca / yattā bhavantastiṣṭhantu yuddhaṃ syātsamupasthitam
ce_text: yādṛśāny atra rūpāṇi saṃdṛśyante bahūny api / yattā bhavantas tiṣṭhantu syād yuddhaṃ samupasthitam

vulgate_text: eṣa pārtho hi vikrāntaḥ savyasācī parantapaḥ / ye jetāro mahīpānāmamunā kuravo hatāḥ
ce_text: sa eṣa pārtho vikrāntaḥ savyasācī paraṃtapaḥ / nāyuddhena nivarteta sarvair api marudgaṇaiḥ

vulgate_text: nājitvā vinivarteta sarvānapi marudgaṇān
ce_text: sa eṣa pārtho vikrāntaḥ savyasācī paraṃtapaḥ / nāyuddhena nivarteta sarvair api marudgaṇaiḥ

vulgate_text: mahādevopi pārthena śrūyate yuddhatoṣitaḥ / kirātaveṣapracchanno girau himavati prabhuḥ
ce_text: nehāsya pratiyoddhāram ahaṃ paśyāmi kauravāḥ / mahādevo 'pi pārthena śrūyate yudhi toṣitaḥ

vulgate_text: tāṃ śamīmabhisaṃgamya pārtho vairāṭimabravīt / sukhasaṃvardhitaṃ pitrā samarāṇāmakovidam
ce_text: tāṃ śamīm upasaṃgamya pārtho vairāṭim abravīt / sukumāraṃ samājñātaṃ saṃgrāme nātikovidam

vulgate_text: nemānīṣvāsanānīha soḍhuṃ śakṣyanti me balam / nālaṃ bhāraṃ guruṃ bhettuṃ kuñjaraṃ vā pramarditum
ce_text: samādiṣṭo mayā kṣipraṃ dhanūṃṣy avaharottara / nemāni hi tvadīyāni soḍhuṃ śakṣyanti me balam

vulgate_text: mama vā bāhuvikṣepaṃ śatrūniha vijeṣyataḥ / necchāmi tairahaṃ kartuṃ karma vaijayikaṃ tviha
ce_text: bhāraṃ vāpi guruṃ hartuṃ kuñjaraṃ vā pramarditum / mama vā bāhuvikṣepaṃ śatrūn iha vijeṣyataḥ

vulgate_text: śarīramiha cāsaktaṃ śamyāṃ śuṣkaṃ purā kila / tadahaṃ rājaputraḥ sanspṛśeyaṃ pāṇinā katham
ce_text: asmin vṛkṣe kilodbaddhaṃ śarīram iti naḥ śrutam / tad ahaṃ rājaputraḥ san spṛśeyaṃ pāṇinā katham

vulgate_text: tamanvaśāsacchatrughno rathe tiṣṭhandhanañjayaḥ / avaropaya vṛkṣāgrāddhanūṃṣyetāni māciram
ce_text: tam anvaśāsac chatrughno rathe tiṣṭhan dhanaṃjayaḥ / pariveṣṭanam eteṣāṃ kṣipraṃ caiva vyapānuda

vulgate_text: pariveṣṭanameteṣāṃ sarvaṃ muñcasva māciram teṣāṃ saṃnahanīyāni parimucya parantapaḥ / apaśyattatra gāṇḍīvaṃ caturbhiraparaiḥ saha
ce_text: tathā saṃnahanāny eṣāṃ parimucya samantataḥ / apaśyad gāṇḍivaṃ tatra caturbhir aparaiḥ saha

vulgate_text: sa teṣāṃ rūpamālekya bhogināmiva dṛmbhatām / hṛṣṭaromā bhayodvigraḥ pravepitatanustadā
ce_text: sa teṣāṃ rūpam ālokya bhoginām iva jṛmbhatām / hṛṣṭaromā bhayodvignaḥ kṣaṇena samapadyata

vulgate_text: bindavaścātra sauvarṇā maṇiprotāḥ samantataḥ / śaśisūryaprabhāḥ pṛṣṭhe bhānti rukmapariṣkṛtāḥ
ce_text: calāś ca vātāḥ saṃvānti rūkṣāḥ paruṣaniḥsvanāḥ / bhasmavarṇaprakāśena tamasā saṃvṛtaṃ nabhaḥ

vulgate_text: kasyeme kṣuranārācāḥ sahasraṃ lomavāpinaḥ / prakṣiptāstīkṣṇatuṇḍāgrā upāsaṅge hiraṇmaye
ce_text: ime ca kasya nārācāḥ sahasrā lomavāhinaḥ / samantāt kaladhautāgrā upāsaṅge hiraṇmaye

vulgate_text: vipāṭhāḥ pṛthavaḥ kasya gṛdhrapatrārdhavājitāḥ / varāhakarṇāstīkṣṇāgrāḥ kasyeme rucirāḥ śarāḥ
ce_text: vipāṭhāḥ pṛthavaḥ kasya gārdhrapatrāḥ śilāśitāḥ / hāridravarṇāḥ sunasāḥ pītāḥ sarvāyasāḥ śarāḥ

vulgate_text: vaiyāghrakośaḥ kasyāyaṃ divyaḥ śaṅkho mahāprabhaḥ / kasyārthamasayaścaite pañca śārdūlalakṣaṇāḥ
ce_text: kasyāyam asitāvāpaḥ pañcaśārdūlalakṣaṇaḥ / varāhakarṇavyāmiśraḥ śarān dhārayate daśa

vulgate_text: attareṇaivamuktastu pārtho vairāṭimabravīt / mṛdvyā pratyāyayanvācā bhītaṃ śaṅkāvaśaṃ gatam
ce_text: tāṃ śamīm upasaṃgamya pārtho vairāṭim abravīt / sukumāraṃ samājñātaṃ saṃgrāme nātikovidam

vulgate_text: attvayā prathamaṃ pṛṣṭaṃ śatrusenāṅgamardanam / pārthasyedaṃ dhanurdivyaṃ gāṇḍīvamiti viśrutam
ce_text: yan māṃ pūrvam ihāpṛcchaḥ śatrusenānibarhaṇam / gāṇḍīvam etat pārthasya lokeṣu viditaṃ dhanuḥ

vulgate_text: abhedyamabhayaṃ śrīmaddivyamacchedyamavraṇam / sarvāyudhamahāmātraṃ śātakumbhamayaṃ dhanuḥ
ce_text: sarvāyudhamahāmātraṃ śātakumbhapariṣkṛtam / etat tad arjunasyāsīd gāṇḍīvaṃ paramāyudham

vulgate_text: yena devāsurānpārthaḥ sarvānviṣahate raṇe / etadvarṣasahasraṃ tu brahmā pūrvamadhārayat
ce_text: devadānavagandharvaiḥ pūjitaṃ śāśvatīḥ samāḥ / etad varṣasahasraṃ tu brahmā pūrvam adhārayat

vulgate_text: umāpatiścatuḥṣaṣṭiṃ śakro'śītiṃ ca pañca ca / somaḥ pañcasahasrāṇi tathā ca varuṇaḥ śatam
ce_text: somaḥ pañcaśataṃ rājā tathaiva varuṇaḥ śatam / pārthaḥ pañca ca ṣaṣṭiṃ ca varṣāṇi śvetavāhanaḥ

vulgate_text: bindavaścātra sauvarṇāḥ pṛṣṭhe sādhuniyojitāḥ / viśrutaṃ bhīmasenasya jātarūpagrahaṃ dṛḍham
ce_text: supārśvaṃ bhīmasenasya jātarūpagrahaṃ dhanuḥ / yena pārtho 'jayat kṛtsnāṃ diśaṃ prācīṃ paraṃtapaḥ

vulgate_text: yena bhīmo'jayatkṛtsnāṃ diśaṃ prācīṃ paraṃtapaḥ / pṛṣṭhe vibhaktāḥ śobhante kuśāgnipratidīpitāḥ
ce_text: supārśvaṃ bhīmasenasya jātarūpagrahaṃ dhanuḥ / yena pārtho 'jayat kṛtsnāṃ diśaṃ prācīṃ paraṃtapaḥ

vulgate_text: pūjitaṃ suramartyeṣu prathitaṃ dhanuruttamam / tālapramāṇaṃ bhīmasya ratnarukmavibhūṣitam
ce_text: mahāvīryaṃ mahad divyam etat tad dhanur uttamam / pūjitaṃ suramartyeṣu bibharti paramaṃ vapuḥ

vulgate_text: yastvayaṃ pārṣate kośe nikṣipto ruciratsaruḥ / nakulasyaiṣa nistriṃśo vaiśvānarasamaprabhaḥ
ce_text: yas tu pāñcanakhe kośe nihitaś citrasevane / nakulasyaiṣa nistriṃśo gurubhārasaho dṛḍhaḥ

vulgate_text: sairandhrīṃ draupadīṃ viddhi yadarthe kīcako hataḥ / bhīmasenena durvṛttaḥ sahabhrātṛbhirāhave
ce_text: aśvabandho 'tha nakulaḥ sahadevas tu gokule / sairandhrīṃ draupadīṃ viddhi yatkṛte kīcakā hatāḥ

vulgate_text: arjunaḥ phalguno jiṣṇuḥ kirīṭī śvetavāhanaḥ bībhatsurvijayaḥ pārthaḥ savyasācī dhanañjayaḥ / etāni mama nāmāni sthāpitāni surottamaiḥ
ce_text: hanta te 'haṃ samācakṣe daśa nāmāni yāni me / arjunaḥ phalguno jiṣṇuḥ kirīṭī śvetavāhanaḥ / bībhatsur vijayaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ savyasācī dhanaṃjayaḥ

vulgate_text: kenāsi vijayo nāma kenāsi śvetavāhanaḥ / savyasācī ca kenāsi jiṣṇurbībhatsureva ca
ce_text: kenāsi vijayo nāma kenāsi śvetavāhanaḥ / kirīṭī nāma kenāsi savyasācī kathaṃ bhavān

vulgate_text: śrutā me tasya vīrasya kevalā nāmahetavaḥ itastataścalatyetanmano me cañcalaṃ tvayi / arjuno vā bhavānneti vada śīghraṃ bṛhannale
ce_text: arjunaḥ phalguno jiṣṇuḥ kṛṣṇo bībhatsur eva ca / dhanaṃjayaś ca kenāsi prabrūhi mama tattvataḥ / śrutā me tasya vīrasya kevalā nāmahetavaḥ

vulgate_text: pṛthivyāṃ sāgarāntāyāṃ varṇo me durlabhaḥ samaḥ / śuddhatvādrupavattvācca tena māmārjunaṃ viduḥ
ce_text: pṛthivyāṃ caturantāyāṃ varṇo me durlabhaḥ samaḥ / karomi karma śuklaṃ ca tena mām arjunaṃ viduḥ

vulgate_text: yotsyāmi tairahaṃ sarvairna me tebhyaḥ parābhavaḥ / tena devamanuṣyeṣu jiṣṇurnāmāsmi viśrutaḥ
ce_text: ahaṃ durāpo durdharṣo damanaḥ pākaśāsaniḥ / tena devamanuṣyeṣu jiṣṇunāmāsmi viśrutaḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ pārthaṃ sa vairāṭiḥ prāñjalistvabhyavādayat / ahaṃ bhūmiṃjayo nāma praṇatosmi dhanaṃjaya
ce_text: tataḥ pārthaṃ sa vairāṭir abhyavādayad antikāt / ahaṃ bhūmiṃjayo nāma nāmnāham api cottaraḥ

vulgate_text: yadajñānādavocaṃ tvāṃ pramādena narottama / akṛtvā hṛdaye sarvaṃ kṣantumarhasi tanmama
ce_text: diṣṭyā tvāṃ pārtha paśyāmi svāgataṃ te dhanaṃjaya / lohitākṣa mahābāho nāgarājakaropama / yad ajñānād avocaṃ tvāṃ kṣantum arhasi tan mama

vulgate_text: āsthāya vipulaṃ vīra rathaṃ sārathinā mayā / duryodhanaṃ ca jitvā''jau nivartaya paśūnmama
ce_text: āsthāya vipulaṃ vīra rathaṃ sārathinā mayā / katamaṃ yāsyase 'nīkam ukto yāsyāmy ahaṃ tvayā

vulgate_text: gāṇḍīvaṃ devadattaṃ ca śarānkanakabhūṣaṇān etānsarvānupāsaṅgānkṣipraṃ badhnīhi me rathe / ekaṃ cāhara nistriṃśaṃ jātarūpapariṣkṛtam
ce_text: etān sarvān upāsaṅgān kṣipraṃ badhnīhi me rathe / etaṃ cāhara nistriṃśaṃ jātarūpapariṣkṛtam / ahaṃ vai kurubhir yotsyāmy avajeṣyāmi te paśūn

vulgate_text: ahaṃ vai kurubhiryotsye mokṣayiṣyāmi te paśūn / toṣayiṣyāmi rājānaṃ pravekṣyāmi puraṃ punaḥ
ce_text: etān sarvān upāsaṅgān kṣipraṃ badhnīhi me rathe / etaṃ cāhara nistriṃśaṃ jātarūpapariṣkṛtam / ahaṃ vai kurubhir yotsyāmy avajeṣyāmi te paśūn

vulgate_text: jyākṣepaninadārāvaṃ nemīninadadundubhiḥ śarajālavitānāḍhyamākṣveḍitamahāsvanam / nagaraṃ te mayā guptaṃ rathopasthaṃ bhaviṣyati
ce_text: jyākṣepaṇaṃ krodhakṛtaṃ nemīninadadundubhi / nagaraṃ te mayā guptaṃ rathopasthaṃ bhaviṣyati

vulgate_text: nāsmi klībo mahābāho paravāndharmasaṃyutaḥ / urvaśīśāpasaṃbhūtaṃ klaibyaṃ samupasaṃsthitam
ce_text: nāsmi klībo mahābāho paravān dharmasaṃyutaḥ / samāptavratam uttīrṇaṃ viddhi māṃ tvaṃ nṛpātmaja

vulgate_text: tadidaṃ samanuprāptaṃ vrataṃ cīrṇaṃ mayā'nagha / samāptavratamuttīrṇaṃ viddhi māṃ tvaṃ nṛpātmaja
ce_text: nāsmi klībo mahābāho paravān dharmasaṃyutaḥ / samāptavratam uttīrṇaṃ viddhi māṃ tvaṃ nṛpātmaja

vulgate_text: yasya yātena paśyanti bhūmau kṣiptaṃ padaṃpadam / dakṣiṇāṃ yo dhuraṃ voḍhā sugrīvoṇa samo hayaḥ
ce_text: yasya yāte na paśyanti bhūmau prāptaṃ padaṃ padam / dakṣiṇaṃ yo dhuraṃ yuktaḥ sugrīvasadṛśo hayaḥ

vulgate_text: yo'yaṃ vahati vai pārṣṇiṃ dakṣiṇāmañcitodyataḥ / valāhakādabhimatastejasā vīryavattaraḥ
ce_text: yo 'yaṃ vahati te pārṣṇiṃ dakṣiṇām añcitodyataḥ / balāhakād api mataḥ sa jave vīryavattaraḥ

vulgate_text: tato vimucya bāhubhyāṃ saṅkhacūḍāni pāṇḍavaḥ / tau ca dundubhisannādau pratibaddhya talāvubhau
ce_text: tato nirmucya bāhubhyāṃ valayāni sa vīryavān / citre dundubhisaṃnāde pratyamuñcat tale śubhe

vulgate_text: pratigṛhya tato'strāṇi prahlaṣṭavadano'bhavat / adhijyaṃ tarasā kṛtvā gāṇḍīvaṃ vyākṣipaddhanuḥ
ce_text: kṛṣṇān bhaṅgīmataḥ keśāñ śvetenodgrathya vāsasā / adhijyaṃ tarasā kṛtvā gāṇḍīvaṃ vyākṣipad dhanuḥ

vulgate_text: taṃ śabdaṃ kuravo rājanvisphoṭamaśaneriva / tārkṣyaṃ śabdamiva śrutvā vitresurdīnamānasāḥ
ce_text: taṃ śabdaṃ kuravo 'jānan visphoṭam aśaner iva / yad arjuno dhanuḥśreṣṭhaṃ bāhubhyām ākṣipad rathe

vulgate_text: yathendro vyākṣipadbhīmaṃ visphoṭamaśanerbhuvi / tathā'rjuno dhanuḥśreṣṭhaṃ bāhubhyāmākṣipadbalī
ce_text: taṃ śabdaṃ kuravo 'jānan visphoṭam aśaner iva / yad arjuno dhanuḥśreṣṭhaṃ bāhubhyām ākṣipad rathe

vulgate_text: dhvajaṃ ca siṃhaṃ mātsyasya bhrātṝṇāmāyudhāni ca / praṇidhāya śamīmadhye prayātumupacakrame
ce_text: dhvajaṃ siṃhaṃ rathāt tasmād apanīya mahārathaḥ / praṇidhāya śamīmūle prāyād uttarasārathiḥ

vulgate_text: sa ca taccintitaṃ jñātvā dhvaje bhūtānyayojayat / rathe vānaramucchritya gāṇḍīvaṃ vyākṣipaddhanuḥ
ce_text: manasā cintayām āsa prasādaṃ pāvakasya ca / sa ca tac cintitaṃ jñātvā dhvaje bhūtāny acodayat

vulgate_text: sapatākaṃ vicitrāṅgaṃ sopāsaṅgaṃ mahābalam / khātpapāta rathe tūrṇaṃ divyarūpaṃ manoramam
ce_text: sapatākaṃ vicitrāṅgaṃ sopāsaṅgaṃ mahārathaḥ / ratham āsthāya bībhatsuḥ kaunteyaḥ śvetavāhanaḥ

vulgate_text: rathamāsthāya bībhatsuḥ kaunteyaḥ śvetavāhanaḥ baddhāsiḥ satalatrāṇaḥ pragṛhītaśarāsanaḥ / tataḥ prāyādudīcīṃ sa kapipravaraketanaḥ
ce_text: baddhāsiḥ satanutrāṇaḥ pragṛhītaśarāsanaḥ / tataḥ prāyād udīcīṃ sa kapipravaraketanaḥ

vulgate_text: tasya śaṅkhasya śabdena dhanupo nisvanena ca vānarasya ninādena rathanemisvanena ca / jaṅgamasya bhayaṃ ghoramakarotpākaśāsaniḥ
ce_text: asya śaṅkhasya śabdena dhanuṣo nisvanena ca / rathasya ca ninādena mano muhyati me bhṛśam

vulgate_text: śaṅkhaśabdena pārthasya mukhenāśvāḥ patankṣitau / uttaraścāpi saṃtrastho rathopastha upāviśat
ce_text: tatas te javanā dhuryā jānubhyām agaman mahīm / uttaraś cāpi saṃtrasto rathopastha upāviśat

vulgate_text: śaṅkhaghoṣeṇa vitrastaṃ jyāghātena ca mūrchitam / uttaraṃ saṃpariṣvajya samāśvāsayadarjunaḥ
ce_text: saṃsthāpya cāśvān kaunteyaḥ samudyamya ca raśmibhiḥ / uttaraṃ ca pariṣvajya samāśvāsayad arjunaḥ

vulgate_text: asya śaṅkhasya śabdena dhanuṣo nisvanena ca amānuṣāṇāṃ śabdena bhūtānāṃ nisvasena ca / rathanemipraṇādena mano kame muhyate bhṛśam
ce_text: asya śaṅkhasya śabdena dhanuṣo nisvanena ca / rathasya ca ninādena mano muhyati me bhṛśam

vulgate_text: gomāyureṣa sainyānāṃ rudanmadhyena dhāvati / cāṣā nadanti cākāśe vedayanto mahadbhayam
ce_text: gomāyur eṣa senāyā ruvan madhye 'nudhāvati / anāhataś ca niṣkrānto mahad vedayate bhayam / bhavatāṃ romakūpāṇi prahṛṣṭāny upalakṣaye

vulgate_text: hastinaścāpi vitrastā yodhāścāpi vitatrasuḥ / parābhūtā ca vaḥ senā na kaścidyodbhumicchati
ce_text: parābhūtā ca vaḥ senā na kaś cid yoddhum icchati / vivarṇamukhabhūyiṣṭhāḥ sarve yodhā vicetasaḥ / gāḥ saṃprasthāpya tiṣṭhāmo vyūḍhānīkāḥ prahāriṇaḥ

vulgate_text: viṣaṇṇamukhabhūyiṣṭhāḥ sarve yodhā vicetasaḥ / diśaṃ te dakṣiṇāṃ sarve viprekṣante punaḥ punaḥ
ce_text: parābhūtā ca vaḥ senā na kaś cid yoddhum icchati / vivarṇamukhabhūyiṣṭhāḥ sarve yodhā vicetasaḥ / gāḥ saṃprasthāpya tiṣṭhāmo vyūḍhānīkāḥ prahāriṇaḥ

vulgate_text: mṛgāśca pakṣiṇaścaiva savyameva patanti naḥ vāditroddhṛṣṭaghoṣāśca na ca gāḍhaṃ svananti ca / dhvajāgreṣu nilīyante vāyasāstanna śobhanam
ce_text: praty ādityaṃ ca naḥ sarve mṛgā ghorapravādinaḥ / dhvajeṣu ca nilīyante vāyasās tan na śobhanam / śakunāś cāpasavyā no vedayanti mahad bhayam

vulgate_text: śaṅkhaśabdena pārthasya karṇau me badhirīkṛtau / sarvasainyaṃ ca vitrastaṃ nāyamanyo dhanañjayāt
ce_text: vyākulāś ca diśaḥ sarvā hṛdayaṃ vyathatīva me / dhvajena pihitāḥ sarvā diśo na pratibhānti me / gāṇḍīvasya ca śabdena karṇau me badhirīkṛtau

vulgate_text: teṣāṃ na tāvannirvṛtto vatsaraḥ sa trayodaśaḥ / ajñātavāse bībhatsurathāsmābhiḥ pariśrutaḥ
ce_text: teṣāṃ na tāvan nirvṛttaṃ vartate tu trayodaśam / ajñātavāsaṃ bībhatsur athāsmābhiḥ samāgataḥ

vulgate_text: uttaraṃ mārgamāṇānāṃ mātsyasenāṃ yuyutsatām / yadi bībhatsurāyātaḥ kiṃtu kṛtyamataḥ param
ce_text: uttaraṃ mārgamāṇānāṃ matsyasenāṃ yuyutsatām / yadi bībhatsur āyātas teṣāṃ kaḥ syāt parāṅmukhaḥ

vulgate_text: teṣāṃ bhayābhipannānāṃ vastānāṃ trāṇabhicchatām / abhayaṃ yācamānānāṃ tadā'smābhiḥ pariśrutam
ce_text: teṣāṃ bhayābhipannānāṃ tad asmābhiḥ pratiśrutam / prathamaṃ tair grahītavyaṃ matsyānāṃ godhanaṃ mahat

vulgate_text: prathamaṃ vairgrahītavyaṃ mātsyānāṃ godhanaṃ mahat / aṣṭamyāścāparāhṇe tu iti nastaiḥ samāhitam
ce_text: teṣāṃ bhayābhipannānāṃ tad asmābhiḥ pratiśrutam / prathamaṃ tair grahītavyaṃ matsyānāṃ godhanaṃ mahat

vulgate_text: navamyāṃ punarasmābhiḥ sūryasyodayanaṃ prati / imā gāvo grahītavyā yāte matsye gavāṃpadam
ce_text: saptamīm aparāhṇe vai tathā nas taiḥ samāhitam / aṣṭamyāṃ punar asmābhir ādityasyodayaṃ prati

vulgate_text: athavā tānupādāya mātsyo jānapadaiḥ saha / sarvathā senayā sārdhamasmāneṣa yuyutsati
ce_text: atha vā tān upāyāto matsyo jānapadaiḥ saha / sarvayā senayā sārdham asmān yoddhum upāgataḥ

vulgate_text: atha kasmātthitā hyete ratheṣu rathisattamāḥ bhīṣmadroṇakṛpāḥ karṇo vikarṇo drauṇireva ca / saṃbhrāntamanasaḥ sarve prāpte hyasmindhanañjaye
ce_text: atha kasmāt sthitā hy ete ratheṣu rathasattamāḥ / bhīṣmo droṇaḥ kṛpaś caiva vikarṇo drauṇir eva ca

vulgate_text: nānyatra yuddhācchreyosti tathā''tmā praṇidhīyatām / sarvalokena vā yuddhaṃ devairvā'stu savāsavaiḥ
ce_text: saṃbhrāntamanasaḥ sarve kāle hy asmin mahārathāḥ / nānyatra yuddhāc chreyo 'sti tathātmā praṇidhīyatām

vulgate_text: yadyeṣa jāmadagnyo vā yadi vendraḥ puraṃdaraḥ vāsudevena sahito yadi bībhatsurāgataḥ / ahamenaṃ nirotsyāmi veleva varuṇālayam
ce_text: yady eṣa rājā matsyānāṃ yadi bībhatsur āgataḥ / aham āvārayiṣyāmi veleva makarālayam

vulgate_text: pātrībhūtastu kaunteyo brāhmaṇo guṇavāniva / śaramālāṃ sa gṛhṇātu matprasṛṣṭāṃ svadhāmiva
ce_text: pātrībhūtaś ca kaunteyo brāhmaṇo guṇavān iva / śaraughān pratigṛhṇātu mayā muktān sahasraśaḥ

vulgate_text: mama hastapramuktānāṃ śarāṇāṃ nataparvaṇām / nivṛttirgacchatāṃ nāsti vaiśvānaraśikhārciṣām
ce_text: mama cāpapramuktānāṃ śarāṇāṃ nataparvaṇām / nāvṛttir gacchatām asti sarpāṇām iva sarpatām

vulgate_text: itaścetaśca muktānāṃ śarāṇāṃ nataparvaṇām / tugulaḥ śrūyatāṃ nādaḥ ṣaṭpadāṃ gāyatāmiva
ce_text: mama cāpapramuktānāṃ śarāṇāṃ nataparvaṇām / nāvṛttir gacchatām asti sarpāṇām iva sarpatām

vulgate_text: antarā saṃpatadbhistu gṛdhrapatraiḥ śilāśitaiḥ / śalabhānāmivākāśe chāyā saṃprati dṛśyatām
ce_text: antarā chidyamānānāṃ puṅkhānāṃ vyatiśīryatām / śalabhānām ivākāśe pracāraḥ saṃpradṛśyatām

vulgate_text: adya matkārmukotsṛṣṭāḥ śitāḥ pārthasya marmagāḥ / śarīramupasarpantu valmīkamiva pannagāḥ
ce_text: matkārmukavinirmuktāḥ pārtham āśīviṣopamāḥ / śarāḥ samabhisarpantu valmīkam iva pannagāḥ

vulgate_text: adya tvahamṛṇānmokṣye yanmayā tatpratiśrutam / dhārtarāṣṭrasya tatkāle nihatya samare'rjunam
ce_text: adyāham ṛṇam akṣayyaṃ purā vācā pratiśrutam / dhārtarāṣṭrasya dāsyāmi nihatya samare 'rjunam

vulgate_text: adya duryodhanasyāhaṃ śokaṃ hṛdi ciraṃ sthitam / samūlamapaneṣyāmi haranpārthaśiraḥ śaraiḥ
ce_text: adya duryodhanasyāhaṃ śalyaṃ hṛdi cirasthitam / samūlam uddhariṣyāmi bībhatsuṃ pātayan rathāt

vulgate_text: adya matkārmukotsṛṣṭairbhallaiśca nataparvabhiḥ hatāśvaṃ virathaṃ pārthaṃ pauruṣe paryavasthitam / niśvasantaṃ yathā nāgamadya paśyantu kauravāḥ
ce_text: hatāśvaṃ virathaṃ pārthaṃ pauruṣe paryavasthitam / niḥśvasantaṃ yathā nāgam adya paśyantu kauravāḥ

vulgate_text: kāmaṃ gacchantu kuravo gāḥ pragṛhya paraṃtapāḥ / ratheṣu vā'pi tiṣṭhanto yuddhaṃ paśyantu māmakam
ce_text: kāmaṃ gacchantu kuravo dhanam ādāya kevalam / ratheṣu vāpi tiṣṭhanto yuddhaṃ paśyantu māmakam

vulgate_text: deśakālena saṃyuktaṃ yuddhaṃ vijayadaṃ bhavet / hīnakālaṃ tadeveha anarthāyopakalpate
ce_text: deśakālena saṃyuktaṃ yuddhaṃ vijayadaṃ bhavet / hīnakālaṃ tad eveha phalavan na bhavaty uta / deśe kāle ca vikrāntaṃ kalyāṇāya vidhīyate

vulgate_text: eko hi śatrūnsamare samarthaḥ pratibādhitum / ekaḥ kurūnabhyarakṣadekaścāgnimatarpayat
ce_text: paricintya tu pārthena saṃnipāto na naḥ kṣamaḥ / ekaḥ kurūn abhyarakṣad ekaś cāgnim atarpayat

vulgate_text: saindhavaṃ vanavāse tu jitvā kṛṣṇāmathānayat / ekaśca pañca varṣāṇi śakrādasrāṇyaśikṣata
ce_text: ekaś ca pañca varṣāṇi śakrād astrāṇy aśikṣata / ekaḥ sāṃyaminīṃ jitvā kurūṇām akarod yaśaḥ

vulgate_text: utsṛṣṭaṃ tūlarāśau tu eko'gniṃ śamayetkatham / saha yuddhyāmahe pārthamāgataṃ yuddhadurmadam
ce_text: saha yudhyāmahe pārtham āgataṃ yuddhadurmadam / sainyās tiṣṭhantu saṃnaddhā vyūḍhānīkāḥ prahāriṇaḥ

vulgate_text: yattā vayaṃ parākrāntā vyūḍhānīkāḥ prahāriṇaḥ / yuddhāyāvasthitaṃ pārthamāgataṃ pākaśāsanim
ce_text: saha yudhyāmahe pārtham āgataṃ yuddhadurmadam / sainyās tiṣṭhantu saṃnaddhā vyūḍhānīkāḥ prahāriṇaḥ

vulgate_text: saṃgrāmānvipulāñjitvā labdhā ca vipulaṃ dhanam / vijitya ca mahīṃ kṛtsnāṃ neha katthanti paṇḍitāḥ
ce_text: saṃgrāmān subahūñ jitvā labdhvā ca vipulaṃ dhanam / vijitya ca parāṃ bhūmiṃ nāhuḥ kiṃ cana pauruṣam

vulgate_text: prāpya dyūtena ko rājyaṃ kṣatriyaḥ stoṣṭurmahati / tathā nṛśaṃsarūpoyaṃ dhārtarāṣṭraśca nirghṛṇaḥ
ce_text: prāpya dyūtena ko rājyaṃ kṣatriyas toṣṭum arhati / tathā nṛśaṃsarūpeṇa yathānyaḥ prākṛto janaḥ

vulgate_text: naiva devā na gandharvā nāsurā na ca rākṣasāḥ / bhayādiha na yuddhyeranpāṇḍuputreṇa dhīmatā
ce_text: naiṣa devān na gandharvān nāsurān na ca rākṣasān / bhayād iha na yudhyeta kuntīputro dhanaṃjayaḥ

vulgate_text: sādhu paśyati vai droṇaḥ kṛpaḥ sādhvanupaśyati / ācāryaputraḥ sahajaṃ niścitaṃ sādhu bhāṣate
ce_text: sādhu paśyati vai droṇaḥ kṛpaḥ sādhv anupaśyati / karṇas tu kṣatradharmeṇa yathāvad yoddhum icchati

vulgate_text: karṇastu kṣatradharmeṇa kevalaṃ yoddhumicchati ācāryo nāvamantavyaḥ puruṣeṇa vijānatā / deśakālau tu saṃprekṣya yoddhavyamiti me matiḥ
ce_text: ācāryo nābhiṣaktavyaḥ puruṣeṇa vijānatā / deśakālau tu saṃprekṣya yoddhavyam iti me matiḥ

vulgate_text: svārthe sarve vimuhyanti ye'pi dharmavido janāḥ / tasmāttatvaṃ na jānāti yattu kāryaṃ narādhipaḥ
ce_text: svārthe sarve vimuhyanti ye 'pi dharmavido janāḥ / tasmād rājan bravīmy eṣa vākyaṃ te yadi rocate

vulgate_text: yathā duryodhanaṃ pārtho nopasarpati saṃgare / sāhasādyadi vā mohāttathā nītirvidhīyatām
ce_text: yathā duryodhane 'yatte nāgaḥ spṛśati sainikān / sāhasād yadi vā mohāt tathā nītir vidhīyatām

vulgate_text: tasmādyadatra kalyāṇaṃ loke sadbhiranuṣṭhitam / tatsaṃvidhīyatāṃ śīghraṃ mā vo hyartho'bhyagātparam
ce_text: pratiyudhyāma samare sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varam / tasmād yad atra kalyāṇaṃ loke sadbhir anuṣṭhitam / tat saṃvidhīyatāṃ kṣipraṃ mā no hy artho 'tigāt parān

vulgate_text: atra yā māmikā buddhiḥ śrūyatāṃ yadi rocate / sarvathā hi mayā śreyo vaktavyaṃ kurunandana
ce_text: atra yā māmakī buddhiḥ śrūyatāṃ yadi rocate / kṣipraṃ balacaturbhāgaṃ gṛhya gaccha puraṃ prati / tato 'paraś caturbhāgo gāḥ samādāya gacchatu

vulgate_text: ahaṃ bhīṣmaśca karṇaśca aśvatthāmā kṛpastathā / pratiyotsyāma bībhatsumāgataṃ kṛtaniścayam
ce_text: eṣa vyavasthito droṇo drauṇiś ca tadanantaram / bhīṣmaḥ kṛpaś ca karṇaś ca maheṣvāsā vyavasthitāḥ

vulgate_text: droṇasyoparate vākye bhīṣmaḥ provāca buddhimān ācārya madhye tiṣṭha tvamaśvatthāmā tu savyataḥ / kṛpaḥ śāradvato dhīmānpārśvaṃ rakṣatu dakṣiṇam
ce_text: ācāryo madhyatas tiṣṭhatv aśvatthāmā tu savyataḥ / kṛpaḥ śāradvato dhīmān pārśvaṃ rakṣatu dakṣiṇam

vulgate_text: agnerindrasya somasya yamasya varuṇasya ca tathā dhāturvidhātuśca mitrasya dhanadasya ca / rudrasya viṣṇo savitustridaśānāṃ tathaiva ca
ce_text: agner īśasya somasya varuṇasya prajāpateḥ / tathā dhātur vidhātuś ca kuberasya yamasya ca

vulgate_text: divyaśca vāyuḥ pravavau gandhamādāya sarvaśaḥ / ṛtavaḥ puṣpamādāya samatiṣṭhanta bhārata
ce_text: divyānāṃ tatra mālyānāṃ gandhaḥ puṇyo 'tha sarvaśaḥ / prasasāra vasantāgre vanānām iva puṣpitām

vulgate_text: droṇaṃ kṛpaṃ ca bhīṣmaṃ ca pṛṣatkairabhyavādayat / tatastatsarvamālokya droṇo vacanamabravīt
ce_text: tatas tat sarvam ālokya droṇo vacanam abravīt / mahāratham anuprāptaṃ dṛṣṭvā gāṇḍīvadhanvinam

vulgate_text: etaddhvajāgraṃ pārthasya dūrataḥ pratidṛśyate / meghaḥka savidyutstanito roravīti ca vānaraḥ
ce_text: etad dhvajāgraṃ pārthasya dūrataḥ saṃprakāśate / eṣa ghoṣaḥ sajalado roravīti ca vānaraḥ

vulgate_text: sarvānanyānanādṛtya dṛṣṭvā tamatimāninam / siṃhaḥ kṣudramṛgasyeva patiṣye tasya mūrdhani
ce_text: sarvān anyān anādṛtya dṛṣṭvā tam atimāninam / tasya mūrdhni patiṣyāmi tata ete parājitāḥ

vulgate_text: āsthito madhyamācāryopyaśvatthāmā'pyanantaram / kṛpakarṇau purastāttu maheṣvāsau vyavasthitau
ce_text: eṣa vyavasthito droṇo drauṇiś ca tadanantaram / bhīṣmaḥ kṛpaś ca karṇaś ca maheṣvāsā vyavasthitāḥ

vulgate_text: duryodhanaṃ na paśyāmi kva nu rājā sa tiṣṭhati / utsṛṃjyaitadrathānīkaṃ yāhi yatra suyodhanaḥ
ce_text: utsṛjyaitad rathānīkaṃ gaccha yatra suyodhanaḥ / tatraiva yotsye vairāṭe nāsti yuddhaṃ nirāmiṣam / taṃ jitvā vinivartiṣye gāḥ samādāya vai punaḥ

vulgate_text: kiṃ no gāvaḥ kariṣyanti dravyaṃ vā vipulaṃ tathā / duryodhanaḥ pārthagataḥ purā prāṇānvimuñcati
ce_text: kiṃ no gāvaḥ kariṣyanti dhanaṃ vā vipulaṃ tathā / duryodhanaḥ pārthajale purā naur iva majjati

vulgate_text: śalabhairiva cākāśaṃ dhārābhiriva parvatam / nirāvakāśamabhavaccharaiḥ kṣiptaiḥ kirīṭinā
ce_text: tathaiva gatvā bībhatsur nāma viśrāvya cātmanaḥ / śalabhair iva tāṃ senāṃ śaraiḥ śīghram avākirat

vulgate_text: sā cāpi bahulā senā pārthabāṇābhipīḍitā / nāpaśyadvivṛtāṃ bhūmiṃ nāntarikṣaṃ diśopi vā
ce_text: kīryamāṇāḥ śaraughais tu yodhās te pārthacoditaiḥ / nāpaśyan nāvṛtāṃ bhūmim antarikṣaṃ ca patribhiḥ

vulgate_text: teṣāṃ naivāpayāne ca nābhiyāne bhavanmatiḥ / śīghratāmeva pārthasya pūjayantastu vismitāḥ
ce_text: teṣāṃ nātmanino yuddhe nāpayāne 'bhavan matiḥ / śīghratvam eva pārthasya pūjayanti sma cetasā

vulgate_text: candrāvadātaṃ sāmudraṃ kurusainyabhayaṃkaram tataḥ śaṅkhamupādhmāsīddviṣatāṃ romaharṣaṇam / jyāghoṣaṃ talaghoṣaṃ ca kṛtvā bhūtānyamohayat
ce_text: tataḥ śaṅkhaṃ pradadhmau sa dviṣatāṃ lomaharṣaṇam / visphārya ca dhanuḥśreṣṭhaṃ dhvaje bhūtāny acodayat

vulgate_text: tasya śaṅkhasya śabdena dhanuṣo nisvanena ca śabdenāmānuṣāṇāṃ ca bhūtānāṃ dhvajavāsinām / viyadgatānāṃ devānāṃ mānuṣāṇāṃ raveṇa ca
ce_text: tasya śaṅkhasya śabdena rathanemisvanena ca / amānuṣāṇāṃ teṣāṃ ca bhūtānāṃ dhvajavāsinām

vulgate_text: ūrdhvaṃ pucchaṃ vidhūnvānā hemamāṇāḥ samantataḥ / gāvaḥ savatsāḥ saṃtrastā nivṛttā dakṣiṇāṃ diśaṃ
ce_text: ūrdhvaṃ pucchān vidhunvānā rebhamāṇāḥ samantataḥ / gāvaḥ pratinyavartanta diśam āsthāya dakṣiṇām

vulgate_text: atiṣṭhannivakāśeṣu pādātāḥ saha vājibhiḥ / bhīmarūpāśca mātaṅgāstomarāṅkuśacoditāḥ
ce_text: abhyāśe vājinas tasthuḥ samārūḍhāḥ prahāribhiḥ / bhīmarūpāś ca mātaṅgās tomarāṅkuśacoditāḥ

vulgate_text: tāni dṛṣṭvā hyanīkāni vitatāni mahātmanām / vairāṭimuttaraṃ taṃ tu pratyabhāṣata pāṇḍavaḥ
ce_text: teṣām anīkāni bahūni gāḍhaṃ vyūḍhāni dṛṣṭvā bahuladhvajāni / matsyasya putraṃ dviṣatāṃ nihantā vairāṭim āmantrya tato 'bhyuvāca

vulgate_text: yadi me prahareddroṇaḥ śarīre me prahṛṣyataḥ / tato'sminprahariṣyāmi nānyathā buddhirasti me
ce_text: yadi me prathamaṃ droṇaḥ śarīre prahariṣyati / tato 'sya prahariṣyāmi nāsya kopo bhaviṣyati

vulgate_text: dhvajāgre govṛṣo yasya kāñcano'bhivirājate / ācāryavaramukhyastu kṛpa eṣa mahārathaḥ
ce_text: asyāvidūre tu dhanur dhvajāgre yasya dṛśyate / ācāryasyaiṣa putro vai aśvatthāmā mahārathaḥ

vulgate_text: yastu śvetāvadātena pañcatālena ketunā / vaiḍūryamayadaṇḍena tālavṛkṣeṇa rājate
ce_text: yas tu nīlānusāreṇa pañcatāreṇa ketunā / hastāvāpī bṛhaddhanvā rathe tiṣṭhati vīryavān

vulgate_text: śīghraśca laguvedhī ca laghuhastaḥ pratāpavān / eṣa śāntanavo bhīṣmaḥ sarveṣāṃ naḥ pitāmahaḥ
ce_text: eṣa śāṃtanavo bhīṣmaḥ sarveṣāṃ naḥ pitāmahaḥ / rājaśriyāvabaddhas tu duryodhanavaśānugaḥ

vulgate_text: kakudaḥ sarvasainyānāṃ sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃvaraḥ jayaśriyā'vabaddhastu suyodhanavaśānugaḥ / paścādeṣa prayātavyo na me vighnakaro bhavet
ce_text: paścād eṣa prayātavyo na me vighnakaro bhavet / etena yudhyamānasya yattaḥ saṃyaccha me hayān

vulgate_text: karṇa yastvaṃ sabhāmadhye bahvabaddhaṃ vikatthase / na me yudhi samo'stīti tadidaṃ pratyupasthitam
ce_text: karṇa yat te sabhāmadhye bahu vācā vikatthitam / na me yudhi samo 'stīti tad idaṃ pratyupasthitam

vulgate_text: duḥsahaṃ daśabhirbāṇairarjunaḥ samavidhyata duśyāsanaṃ dvādaśabhiḥ kṛpaṃ śāradvataṃ tribhiḥ / bhīṣmaṃ śāntanavaṃ ṣaṣṭyā pratyavidhyatstanāntare
ce_text: duḥśāsanas tu bhallena viddhvā vairāṭim uttaram / dvitīyenārjunaṃ vīraḥ pratyavidhyat stanāntare

vulgate_text: teṣāmanīkāni kirīṭamālī vyūḍhāni dṛṣṭvā vipuladhvajāni / gāṇḍīvadhanvā dviṣatāṃ nihantā vairāṭimāmantrya tato'bhyuvāca
ce_text: teṣām anīkāni bahūni gāḍhaṃ vyūḍhāni dṛṣṭvā bahuladhvajāni / matsyasya putraṃ dviṣatāṃ nihantā vairāṭim āmantrya tato 'bhyuvāca

vulgate_text: etena śīghraṃ pratipādayemān śvetānhayānkāñcanajālakakṣyān / sarvaṃ javaṃ tatra vidarśayiṣye hyāsādayaitadrathavīravṛndam
ce_text: etena tūrṇaṃ pratipādayemāñ śvetān hayān kāñcanaraśmiyoktrān / javena sarveṇa kuru prayatnam āsādayaitad rathasiṃhavṛndam

vulgate_text: gajo gajaneva hi yoddhukāmo mayā sadā kāṅkṣati sūtaputraḥ tameva māṃ prāpaya sūtaputraṃ duryodhanopāśrayajātadarpam / taṃ pātayiṣyāmi rathasya madhye sahasranetro'śanineva vṛtram
ce_text: gajo gajeneva mayā durātmā yo yoddhum ākāṅkṣati sūtaputraḥ / tam eva māṃ prāpaya rājaputra duryodhanāpāśrayajātadarpam

vulgate_text: hatāstu pārthena rathapravīrā bhūmau yuvānaḥ supupuḥ sukeśāḥ / suvarṇalohāyasavarmagātrā vṛkṣā yathā haimavate nikṛttāḥ
ce_text: hatās tu pārthena narapravīrā bhūmau yuvānaḥ suṣupuḥ suveṣāḥ / vasupradā vāsavatulyavīryāḥ parājitā vāsavajena saṃkhye / suvarṇakārṣṇāyasavarmanaddhā nāgā yathā haimavatāḥ pravṛddhāḥ

vulgate_text: suśīrṇaparṇāni yathā vasante vidhūnayanvāyurivālpasārān / tathā sapatnānvidhamankirīṭī cacāra saṅkhye'tiratho rathena
ce_text: prakīrṇaparṇāni yathā vasante viśātayitvātyanilo nudan khe / tathā sapatnān vikiran kirīṭī cacāra saṃkhye 'tiratho rathena

vulgate_text: taṃ śatrusenāṅganibarhaṇāni karmāṇi kurvāṇamamānuṣāṇi / vaikartanaḥ pūrvamamṛṣyamāṇaḥ samārpayallakṣyamivāśu pārtham
ce_text: taṃ śātravāṇāṃ gaṇabādhitāraṃ karmāṇi kurvāṇam amānuṣāṇi / śatruṃtapaḥ kopam amṛṣyamāṇaḥ samarpayat kūrmanakhena pārtham

vulgate_text: tatra māṃ vaha bhadraṃ te droṇaṃ yotsyāmi sattamam / bhāradvājena yotsye'hamācāryeṇa mahātmanā
ce_text: yatraiṣā kāñcanī vedī pradīptāgniśikhopamā / ucchritā kāñcane daṇḍe patākābhir alaṃkṛtā / tatra māṃ vaha bhadraṃ te droṇānīkāya māriṣa

vulgate_text: amī śoṇāḥ prakāśante turagāḥ sādhuvāhinaḥ / muktā rathavare tasya sarvaśikṣāviśāradāḥ
ce_text: aśvāḥ śoṇāḥ prakāśante bṛhantaś cāruvāhinaḥ / snigdhavidrumasaṃkāśās tāmrāsyāḥ priyadarśanāḥ / yuktā rathavare yasya sarvaśikṣāviśāradāḥ

vulgate_text: yato rathavare śūraḥ sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃvaraḥ / snigdhavaiḍūryasaṃkāśastāmrākṣaḥ priyadarśanaḥ
ce_text: aśvāḥ śoṇāḥ prakāśante bṛhantaś cāruvāhinaḥ / snigdhavidrumasaṃkāśās tāmrāsyāḥ priyadarśanāḥ / yuktā rathavare yasya sarvaśikṣāviśāradāḥ

vulgate_text: catvāro nikhilā vedāḥ sāṅgopāṅgāḥ salakṣaṇāḥ / dhanurvedaśca kārtsnyena brāhmaṃ cāstraṃ pratiṣṭhitam
ce_text: sasaṃhārāṇi divyāni sarvāṇy astrāṇi māriṣa / dhanurvedaś ca kārtsnyena yasmin nityaṃ pratiṣṭhitaḥ

vulgate_text: kṣamā damaśca satyaṃ ca tejo mārdavamārjavam / pratiṣṭhitā guṇā yasminbahavo dvijasattame
ce_text: kṣamā damaś ca satyaṃ ca ānṛśaṃsyam athārjavam / ete cānye ca bahavo guṇā yasmin dvijottame

vulgate_text: uttarastvevamukto'śvāṃścodayāmāsa taṃ prati / ājagāmārjunaratho bhāradvājarathaṃ prati
ce_text: arjunenaivam uktas tu vairāṭir hemabhūṣitān / codayām āsa tān aśvān bhāradvājarathaṃ prati

vulgate_text: tamāpatantaṃ vegena pāṇḍavaṃ sarathaṃ raṇe / droṇopyabhyadravatpārthaṃ mato mattamiva dvipam
ce_text: tam āpatantaṃ vegena pāṇḍavaṃ rathināṃ varam / droṇaḥ pratyudyayau pārthaṃ matto mattam iva dvipam

vulgate_text: ahaṃ tu tāḍitaḥ pūrvaṃ prahareyaṃ tavānagha / iti me vartate buddhistadbhavānkṣantumarhati
ce_text: ahaṃ tu prahṛte pūrvaṃ prahariṣyāmi te 'nagha / iti me vartate buddhis tad bhavān kartum arhati

vulgate_text: tataḥ prādhmāpayacchaṅkhaṃ bherīpaṭahavāditam / vyakṣobhata balaṃ sarvamuddhūtamiva sāgaram
ce_text: tataḥ prādhmāpayac chaṅkhaṃ bherīśatanināditam / pracukṣubhe balaṃ sarvam uddhūta iva sāgaraḥ

vulgate_text: aśvāñśoṇānmahāvegānhaṃsavarṇaistu vājibhiḥ / miśritānsamare dṛṣṭvā vyasmayanta pṛthagjanāḥ
ce_text: atha śoṇān sadaśvāṃs tān haṃsavarṇair manojavaiḥ / miśritān samare dṛṣṭvā vyasmayanta raṇe janāḥ

vulgate_text: rathaṃ rathena pārthasya samāhatya paraṃtapaḥ / harṣayuktastadā''cāryaḥ pratyagṛhṇātsa pāṇḍavam
ce_text: harṣayuktas tathā pārthaḥ prahasann iva vīryavān / rathaṃ rathena droṇasya samāsādya mahārathaḥ

vulgate_text: samāśliṣṭāvivānyonyaṃ droṇapāṇḍavayordhvajau / dṛṣṭvā prākampata muhurbhāratānāṃ mahācamūḥ
ce_text: samāśliṣṭau tadānyonyaṃ droṇapārthau mahābalau / dṛṣṭvā prākampata muhur bharatānāṃ mahad balam

vulgate_text: tattu yuddhaṃ pravavṛte hyācāryasyārjunasya ca / vimuñcatoḥ śarānugrānviśikhāndīptatejasaḥ
ce_text: evaṃ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ bhāradvājakirīṭinoḥ / samaṃ vimuñcatoḥ saṃkhye viśikhān dīptatejasaḥ

vulgate_text: ubhau viśrutakarmāṇāvubhau śramagatau jaye ubhāvatirathau loke hyubhau parapuṃrajayau / kṣipantau śarajālāni kṣatriyānmoha āviśat
ce_text: tāv ubhau khyātakarmāṇāv ubhau vāyusamau jave / ubhau divyāstraviduṣāv ubhāv uttamatejasau / kṣipantau śarajālāni mohayām āsatur nṛpān

vulgate_text: chādyetāṃ śaraughaistāvanyonyamuparājitau / saṃyuge saṃcakāśetāṃ kālasūryāvivoditau
ce_text: vīrau tāv api saṃrabdhau saṃnikṛṣṭau mahārathau / chādayetāṃ śaravrātair anyonyam aparājitau

vulgate_text: arjunastu tadā droṇaṃ mahāvegairmahārathaḥ / vivyādha śataśo bāṇairdhārābhiriva parvatam
ce_text: pārthaṃ ca sa mahābāhur mahāvegair mahārathaḥ / vivyādha niśitair bāṇair megho vṛṣṭyeva parvatam

vulgate_text: śobhate sma mahāvāhurgāṇḍīvaṃ vikṣipandhanuḥ / śarāṃśca visṛjaṃścitrānsuvarṇavikṛtānbahūn
ce_text: tathaiva divyaṃ gāṇḍīvaṃ dhanur ādāya pāṇḍavaḥ / śatrughnaṃ vegavad dhṛṣṭo bhārasādhanam uttamam / visasarja śarāṃś citrān suvarṇavikṛtān bahūn

vulgate_text: saratho'pyacaratpārthaḥ prekṣaṇīyo mahārathaḥ / yugapaddikṣu sarvāsu sarvato'strāṇyavāsṛjam
ce_text: sa rathena caran pārthaḥ prekṣaṇīyo dhanaṃjayaḥ / yugapad dikṣu sarvāsu sarvaśastrāṇy adarśayat

vulgate_text: taptajāmbūnadamayairdīptairagnisamaiḥ śaraiḥ / prācchādayadameyātmā diśaḥ sūryasya ca prabhām
ce_text: jāmbūnadamayaiḥ puṅkhaiś citracāpavarātigaiḥ / prācchādayad ameyātmā diśaḥ sūryasya ca prabhām

vulgate_text: tataḥ kāñcanapaṅkhānāṃ śarāṇāṃ nataparvaṇām / viyadgatānāṃ caratāṃ dṛśyante bahavo vrajāḥ
ce_text: tataḥ kanakapuṅkhānāṃ śarāṇāṃ nataparvaṇām / viyaccarāṇāṃ viyati dṛśyante bahuśaḥ prajāḥ

vulgate_text: śarāsanāttu droṇasya prabhavanti sma sāyakāḥ eko dīrgha ivābhāntaḥ pradṛśyante mahāśarāḥ / ākāśe samadṛśyanta haṃsānāmiva paṅktayaḥ
ce_text: droṇasya puṅkhasaktāś ca prabhavantaḥ śarāsanāt / eko dīrgha ivādṛśyad ākāśe saṃhataḥ śaraḥ

vulgate_text: tattu yuddhaṃ mahāghoraṃ tayoḥ saṃrabdhayorabhūt / atyadbhutamacintyaṃ ca vṛtravāsavayoriva
ce_text: yuddhaṃ samabhavat tatra susaṃrabdhaṃ mahātmanoḥ / droṇapāṇḍavayor ghoraṃ vṛtravāsavayor iva

vulgate_text: jighāṃsantaṃ naravyāghramarjunaṃ bhīmadarśanam / vivyādha niśitairdroṇaḥ śaraiḥ sannataparvabhiḥ
ce_text: jighāṃsantaṃ naravyāghram arjunaṃ tigmatejasam / ācāryamukhyaḥ samare droṇaḥ śastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ / arjunena sahākrīḍac charaiḥ saṃnataparvabhiḥ

vulgate_text: hṛṣṭaḥ samabhavaddroṇo raṇaśauṇḍaḥ pratāpavān / arjunena samaṃ krīḍañśaraiḥ sannataparvabhiḥ
ce_text: jighāṃsantaṃ naravyāghram arjunaṃ tigmatejasam / ācāryamukhyaḥ samare droṇaḥ śastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ / arjunena sahākrīḍac charaiḥ saṃnataparvabhiḥ

vulgate_text: astrairastrāṇi saṃvārya pārtho droṇamavārayat
ce_text: divyāny astrāṇi muñcantaṃ bhāradvājaṃ mahāraṇe / astrair astrāṇi saṃvārya phalgunaḥ samayodhayat

vulgate_text: tayorāsītsaṃprahāraḥ kruddhayornarasiṃhayoḥ / amṛṣyamāṇayoḥ saṅkhye balivāsavayoriva
ce_text: tayor āsīt saṃprahāraḥ kruddhayor narasiṃhayoḥ / amarṣiṇos tadānyonyaṃ devadānavayor iva

vulgate_text: evaṃ śūrau maheṣvāsau visṛjantau śilāśitān / ekacchāyamakurvātāṃ gaganaṃ śaravṛṣṭibhiḥ
ce_text: evaṃ śūrau maheṣvāsau visṛjantau śitāñ śarān / ekacchāyaṃ cakratus tāv ākāśaṃ śaravṛṣṭibhiḥ

vulgate_text: droṇaṃ yuddhārṇave magnaṃ dṛṣṭvā putraḥ pratāpavān tato vṛndena mahatā rathināṃ rathiyūthapaḥ / ācāryaputrastu śaraiḥ pāṇḍavaṃ pratyavārayat
ce_text: tato vṛndena mahatā rathānāṃ rathayūthapaḥ / ācāryaputraḥ sahasā pāṇḍavaṃ pratyavārayat

vulgate_text: hayāṃstasyārjunaḥ saṅkhye kṛtavānalpatejasāḥ / te rājanna prajānanti diśaṃ kāṃcana mohitāḥ
ce_text: hayān asyārjunaḥ sarvān kṛtavān alpajīvitān / sa rājan na prajānāti diśaṃ kāṃ cana mohitaḥ

vulgate_text: tadasyāpūjayandevāḥ karma dṛṣṭvā'timānuṣam / na śakto'nyaḥ pumānsthātumṛte drauṇerdhanaṃjayam
ce_text: tato drauṇir mahāvīryaḥ pārthasya vicariṣyataḥ / vivaraṃ sūkṣmam ālokya jyāṃ ciccheda kṣureṇa ha / tad asyāpūjayan devāḥ karma dṛṣṭvātimānuṣam

vulgate_text: so'nyaṃ rathaṃ samāsthāya pratyāyādrathipuṅgavaḥ / vāraṇeneva mattena matto vāraṇayūthapaḥ
ce_text: tato 'rdhacandram āvṛtya tena pārthaḥ samāgamat / vāraṇeneva mattena matto vāraṇayūthapaḥ

vulgate_text: tau samājaghnaturvīrau parasparajayaiṣiṇau / śarai rāśīviṣākārairjvaladbhiriva pāvakaiḥ
ce_text: tau samājaghnatur vīrāv anyonyaṃ puruṣarṣabhau / śarair āśīviṣākārair jvaladbhir iva pannagaiḥ

vulgate_text: samāgamya tataḥ sarve bhīṣmadroṇamukhā rathāḥ / arjunaṃ sahasā yuktāḥ pratyayudhyanta bhārata
ce_text: atha saṃgamya sarve tu kauravāṇāṃ mahārathāḥ / arjunaṃ sahitā yattāḥ pratyayudhyanta bhārata

vulgate_text: nāgāśvakāyānnirbhidya lauhāni kavacāni ca / pārthasya śaravarṣāṇi nyapatañśataśaḥ kṣitau
ce_text: narāśvakāyān nirbhidya lohāni kavacāni ca / pārthasya śarajālāni viniṣpetuḥ sahasraśaḥ

vulgate_text: aviṣahya śarānsarve pārthacāpacyupānraṇe udakprayānti vidhvastā rathebhyo rathinastadā / sādinaścāśvapṛṣṭhebhyo bhūmau cāpi padātayaḥ
ce_text: upaplavanta vitrastā rathebhyo rathinas tadā / sādinaś cāśvapṛṣṭhebhyo bhūmau cāpi padātayaḥ

vulgate_text: channamāyodhanaṃ jajñe śarīrairgatacetasām / śrāntyā galitaśastrāṇāṃ patatāmaśvasādinām
ce_text: channam āyodhanaṃ sarvaṃ śarīrair gatacetasām / gajāśvasādibhis tatra śitabāṇāttajīvitaiḥ

vulgate_text: śūnyānkurvanrathopasthānmānavairāstṛṇonmahīm / pranṛtyanniva saṃgrāme cāpahaste dhanaṃjayaḥ
ce_text: rathopasthābhipatitair āstṛtā mānavair mahī / pranṛtyad iva saṃgrāme cāpahasto dhanaṃjayaḥ

vulgate_text: śirāṃsyapātayatsaṅkhye kṣatriyāṇāṃ nararṣabhaḥ śrutvā gāṇḍīvanirghoṣaṃ viṣṇūjitamivāśane / trastāni sarvasainyāni vyalīyanta ca bhāgaśa
ce_text: śrutvā gāṇḍīvanirghoṣaṃ visphūrjitam ivāśaneḥ / trastāni sarvabhūtāni vyagacchanta mahāhavāt

vulgate_text: darśayitvā tadā''tmānaṃ raudraṃ raudraparākramaḥ / jaghāna samare śūrāñchataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ
ce_text: darśayitvā tathātmānaṃ raudraṃ rudraparākramaḥ / avaruddhaś caran pārtho daśavarṣāṇi trīṇi ca / krodhāgnim utsṛjad ghoraṃ dhārtarāṣṭreṣu pāṇḍavaḥ

vulgate_text: tasya mārgānvicarato nighnataśca raṇājire / prāvartata nadī ghorā śoṇitāntrataraṅgiṇī
ce_text: prāvartayan nadīṃ ghorāṃ śoṇitaughataraṅgiṇīm / asthiśaivalasaṃbādhāṃ yugānte kālanirmitām

vulgate_text: prāvartayannadīṃ ghorāṃ piśācagaṇasevitām / apārāmanivāsāṃ ca raktodāṃ sarvato vṛtām
ce_text: prāvartayan nadīṃ ghorāṃ śoṇitaughataraṅgiṇīm / asthiśaivalasaṃbādhāṃ yugānte kālanirmitām

vulgate_text: abhīkṣṇamakarotpārtho nadīmuttamaśoṇitām / gajavarmamahādvīpāmaśvadehamahāśilām
ce_text: śaracāpaplavāṃ ghorāṃ māṃsaśoṇitakardamām / mahārathamahādvīpāṃ śaṅkhadundubhinisvanām / cakāra mahatīṃ pārtho nadīm uttaraśoṇitām

vulgate_text: athainaṃ pañcabhirbhūyaḥ pratyavidhyatstanāntare / sa pārthabāṇābhihato rathātpraskandya dudruve
ce_text: athainaṃ daśabhir bāṇaiḥ pratyavidhyat stanāntare / yatamānaṃ parākrāntaṃ kuntīputro dhanaṃjayaḥ

vulgate_text: tathā hi gupta eteṣāṃ durādharṣaḥ pitāmahaḥ / hanyamāneṣu yogheṣu dhanaṃjayamupādravat
ce_text: tataḥ śāṃtanavo bhīṣmo durādharṣaḥ pratāpavān / vadhyamāneṣu yodheṣu dhanaṃjayam upādravat

vulgate_text: tamavekṣya samāyāntaṃ kaunteyaḥ paravīrahā pratyagṛhṇādameyātmā priyātithimivāgatam / devadattaṃ mahāśaṅkhaṃ pradadhmau yudhi vīryavān
ce_text: tam udvīkṣya tathāyāntaṃ kaunteyaḥ paravīrahā / pratyagṛhṇāt prahṛṣṭātmā dhārādharam ivācalaḥ

vulgate_text: vāsudevasya sadṛśau kārtavīryasamāvubhau ubhau viśrutakarmāṇāvubhau śūrau mahābalau / sarvāstraviduṣāṃ śreṣṭhau sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varau
ce_text: ubhau viśrutakarmāṇāv ubhau yuddhaviśāradau / ubhau sadṛśakarmāṇāv ubhau yudhi durāsadau

vulgate_text: tadyuddhamabhavaddhoraṃ romaharṣaṇamadbhutam / bhīṣmasya saha pārthena balivāsavayoriva
ce_text: tayos tad abhavad yuddhaṃ tumulaṃ lomaharṣaṇam / bhīṣmasya saha pārthena balivāsavayor iva

vulgate_text: agnivakropamaṃ ghoraṃ maṇḍalīkṛtamāhave / gāṇḍīvamabhavañjiṣṇoḥ savyaṃ dakṣiṇamasyataḥ
ce_text: agnicakram ivāviddhaṃ savyadakṣiṇam asyataḥ / gāṇḍīvam abhavad rājan pārthasya sṛjataḥ śarān

vulgate_text: parvataṃ vāridhārābhiśchādayanniva toyadaḥ / arjunaśchādayadbhīṣmaṃ śaravarṣairanekaśaḥ
ce_text: sa taiḥ saṃchādayām āsa bhīṣmaṃ śaraśataiḥ śitaiḥ / parvataṃ vāridhārābhiś chādayann iva toyadaḥ

vulgate_text: tāṃ samudramivoddhūtāṃ śaravṛṣṭiṃ samudyatām / vyadhamatsāyakairbhīṣmaḥ sorjunaṃ ca nyavārayat
ce_text: tāṃ sa velām ivoddhūtāṃ śaravṛṣṭiṃ samutthitām / vyadhamat sāyakair bhīṣmo arjunaṃ saṃnivārayat

vulgate_text: tatastāni visṛṣṭāni śarajālāni saṅghaśaḥ / āhatāni vyaśīryantaṃ arjunasya rathaṃ prati
ce_text: tatas tāni nikṛttāni śarajālāni bhāgaśaḥ / samare 'bhivyaśīryanta phalgunasya rathaṃ prati

vulgate_text: tato devarṣigandharvāḥ sādhusādhvityapūjayan / duṣkaraṃ kṛtavānbhīṣmo yadarjunamavārayat
ce_text: tatas te kuravaḥ sarve sādhu sādhv iti cābruvan / duṣkaraṃ kṛtavān bhīṣmo yad arjunam ayodhayat

vulgate_text: naitadanyo manuṣyeṣu pradarśayitumāhave / mahāsrāṇāṃ saṃprayogaṃ samare bhīṣmapārthayoḥ
ce_text: nedaṃ yuktaṃ manuṣyeṣu yo 'yaṃ saṃdṛśyate mahān / mahāstrāṇāṃ saṃprayogaḥ samare bhīṣmapārthayoḥ

vulgate_text: atha jiṣṇurudāvṛtya śitadhāreṇa kārmukam / nyakṛntadgṛdhrapatreṇa śātakumbhapariṣkṛtam
ce_text: evaṃ sarvāstraviduṣor astrayuddham avartata / atha jiṣṇur upāvṛtya pṛthudhāreṇa kārmukam / cakarta bhīṣmasya tadā jātarūpapariṣkṛtam

vulgate_text: śarāṃśca subahunkruddho mumocāśu dhanaṃjaye arjunopi śarāṃstīkṣṇānbhīṣmāya niśitānbahūn / cikṣepa ca mahātejāstathā bhīṣmaśca pāṇḍave
ce_text: arjuno 'pi śarāṃś citrān bhīṣmāya niśitān bahūn / cikṣepa sumahātejās tathā bhīṣmaś ca pāṇḍave

vulgate_text: ubhau viśrutakarmāṇāvubhau śūrau mahīkṣitām / ubhau vicitrakarmāṇāvubhau yudhi durāsadau
ce_text: ubhau viśrutakarmāṇāv ubhau yuddhaviśāradau / ubhau sadṛśakarmāṇāv ubhau yudhi durāsadau

vulgate_text: ityukto devarājastu pārthabhīṣmasamāgamam pūjayāmāsa divyena puṣpavarṣeṇa bhārata - - a[aśvatthāmā tato'bhyetya drutaṃ karṇamabhāṣata ahameko haniṣyāmi sametānsarvapāṇḍavān
ce_text: ity ukto devarājas tu pārthabhīṣmasamāgamam / pūjayām āsa divyena puṣpavarṣeṇa bhārata

vulgate_text: karṇa yattatsabhāmadhye bahvabaddhaṃ prabhāṣase / na me yudhi samo'stīti tadidaṃ pratyupasthitam
ce_text: karṇa yat te sabhāmadhye bahu vācā vikatthitam / na me yudhi samo 'stīti tad idaṃ pratyupasthitam

vulgate_text: karṇaṃ parājitaṃ dṛṣṭvā pārtho vairāṭimabravīt / etaṃ māṃ prāpayedānīṃ rathavṛndaṃ prahāriṇām
ce_text: tato vaikartanaṃ jitvā pārtho vairāṭim abravīt / etan māṃ prāpayānīkaṃ yatra tālo hiraṇmayaḥ

vulgate_text: yatra śāntanavo bhīṣmaḥ sarveṣāṃ naḥ pitāmahaḥ / suyuddhaṃ kāṅkṣamāṇo vai rathe tiṣṭhati daṃśitaḥ
ce_text: atra śāṃtanavo bhīṣmo rathe 'smākaṃ pitāmahaḥ / kāṅkṣamāṇo mayā yuddhaṃ tiṣṭhaty amaradarśanaḥ / ādāsyāmy aham etasya dhanurjyām api cāhave

vulgate_text: asyantaṃ divyamastrāṇi citramuttara paśyasi
ce_text: asyantaṃ divyam astraṃ māṃ citram adya niśāmaya / śatahradām ivāyāntīṃ stanayitnor ivāmbare

vulgate_text: śatahradāṃ jṛmbhamāṇāṃ meghasthāṃ prāvṛṣīva ca / suvarṇapṛṣṭhaṃ gāṇḍīvaṃ paśyantu kuravo mama
ce_text: suvarṇapṛṣṭhaṃ gāṇḍīvaṃ drakṣyanti kuravo mama / dakṣiṇenātha vāmena katareṇa svid asyati / iti māṃ saṃgatāḥ sarve tarkayiṣyanti śatravaḥ

vulgate_text: astrodakāṃ hayāvartāṃ nāganakrāṃ rathahradām / nadīṃ praskandayiṣyāmi paralokāpahāriṇīm
ce_text: śoṇitodāṃ rathāvartāṃ nāganakrāṃ duratyayām / nadīṃ prasyandayiṣyāmi paralokapravāhinīm

vulgate_text: dhvajavṛkṣaṃ śaratṛṇaṃ nāgāśvaśvāpadākulam rathasiṃhagaṇairyuktaṃ dhanurvallisamākulam / vanamādīpayiṣyāmi kurūṇāmastratejasā
ce_text: dhvajavṛkṣaṃ pattitṛṇaṃ rathasiṃhagaṇāyutam / vanam ādīpayiṣyāmi kurūṇām astratejasā

vulgate_text: jayato bhāratīṃ senāmekasya mama saṃyuge / śataṃ mārgā bhaviṣyanti pāvakasyeva kānane
ce_text: jayataḥ kauravīṃ senām ekasya mama dhanvinaḥ / śataṃ mārgā bhaviṣyanti pāvakasyeva kānane / mayā cakram ivāviddhaṃ sainyaṃ drakṣyasi kevalam

vulgate_text: mayā cakramivāviddhaṃ sainyaṃ drakṣyasi kevalam tānahaṃ rathanīḍebhyaḥ paralokāya śātravān / ekaḥ pradrāvayiṣyāmi cakrapāṇirivāsurān
ce_text: jayataḥ kauravīṃ senām ekasya mama dhanvinaḥ / śataṃ mārgā bhaviṣyanti pāvakasyeva kānane / mayā cakram ivāviddhaṃ sainyaṃ drakṣyasi kevalam

vulgate_text: asaṃbhrānto rathe tiṣṭhansameṣu viṣameṣu ca / mārgamāvṛtya tiṣṭhantamapi bhetsyāmi parvatam
ce_text: asaṃbhrānto rathe tiṣṭha sameṣu viṣameṣu ca / divam āvṛtya tiṣṭhantaṃ giriṃ bhetsyāmi dhāribhiḥ

vulgate_text: nivātakavacānhatvā gāṇḍīvāstraiḥ sahasraśaḥ / paraṃ pāre samudrasya hiraṇyapuramārujam
ce_text: ahaṃ pāre samudrasya hiraṇyapuram ārujam / jitvā ṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi rathinām ugradhanvinām

vulgate_text: raudraṃ rudrādahaṃ vedmi vāruṇaṃ varuṇādapi / sauryaṃ sūryādahaṃ vedmi yāmyaṃ daṇḍadharādapi
ce_text: raudraṃ rudrād ahaṃ hy astraṃ vāruṇaṃ varuṇād api / astram āgneyam agneś ca vāyavyaṃ mātariśvanaḥ / vajrādīni tathāstrāṇi śakrād aham avāptavān

vulgate_text: astramāgneyamagneśca vāyavyaṃ mātariśvanaḥ / anyairdevairahaṃ prāptaḥ ko māṃ viṣahate pumān
ce_text: raudraṃ rudrād ahaṃ hy astraṃ vāruṇaṃ varuṇād api / astram āgneyam agneś ca vāyavyaṃ mātariśvanaḥ / vajrādīni tathāstrāṇi śakrād aham avāptavān

vulgate_text: rathisiṃhamanādhṛṣyaṃ jigīṣantaṃ parānraṇe / abhyadhāvattadaivogro jyāṃ vikarṣandhanañjayaḥ
ce_text: tam āyāntaṃ mahābāhuṃ jigīṣantaṃ raṇe parān / abhyavārayad avyagraḥ krūrakarmā dhanaṃjayam

vulgate_text: duḥśāsano vikarṇaśca vṛṣaseno viviśatiḥ / abhītā bhīmadhanvānaṃ pāṇḍavaṃ paryavārayan
ce_text: duḥśāsano vikarṇaś ca duḥsaho 'tha viviṃśatiḥ / āgatya bhīmadhanvānaṃ bībhatsuṃ paryavārayan

vulgate_text: tasya jiṣṇurudāvṛtya kṣuradhāreṇa kārmukam / prākṛntadgṛdhrapatreṇa jātarūpapariṣkṛtam
ce_text: tasya jiṣṇur upāvṛtya pṛthudhāreṇa kārmukam / cakarta gārdhrapatreṇa jātarūpapariṣkṛtam

vulgate_text: sarvā diśaścābhyapatadbībhatsurapārājitaḥ taṃ vikarṇaḥ śaraistīkṣṇairgṛdhrapakṣaiḥ śilāśitaiḥ / vivyādha paravīradhnamarjunaṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrajaḥ
ce_text: taṃ vikarṇaḥ śarais tīkṣṇair gārdhrapatrair ajihmagaiḥ / vivyādha paravīraghnam arjunaṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrajaḥ

vulgate_text: kirīṭamālī kaunteyo labdhalakṣaḥ pratāpavān / pātayannuttamāṅgāni bāhūśca parighopamān
ce_text: sarvā diśaś cābhyapatad bībhatsur aparājitaḥ / kirīṭamālī kaunteyo labdhalakṣo mahābalaḥ

vulgate_text: tenārdito nāga iva prabhinnaḥ pārthena viddho dhṛtarāṣṭraputraḥ / yuyutsamāno'tirathena saṅkhye svayaṃ vigṛhyārjunamāsasāda
ce_text: bhīṣme tu saṃgrāmaśiro vihāya palāyamāne dhṛtarāṣṭraputraḥ / ucchritya ketuṃ vinadan mahātmā svayaṃ vigṛhyārjunam āsasāda

vulgate_text: sa tena bāṇena samarpitena jāmbūnadābhena susaṃhitena / rarāja pārtho rudhiraṃ kṣaranvai yathaikaraśmirbhagavāndivārkaḥ
ce_text: sa tena bāṇena samarpitena jāmbūnadābhena susaṃśitena / rarāja rājan mahanīyakarmā yathaikaparvā ruciraikaśṛṅgaḥ

vulgate_text: taṃ bhītarūpaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajantaṃ duryodhanaṃ śatrusaho niṣaṅgī / ityabravītprītamanāḥ kirīṭī bāṇābhitaptaṃ rudhiraṃ vamantam
ce_text: taṃ bhīmarūpaṃ tvaritaṃ dravantaṃ duryodhanaṃ śatrusaho niṣaṅgī / prākṣveḍayad yoddhumanāḥ kirīṭī bāṇena viddhaṃ rudhiraṃ vamantam

vulgate_text: vihāya kīrtiṃ ca yaśaśca loke yuddhātparāvṛtya palāyase kim / na nandayiṣyanti tavāhatāni tūryāṇi yuddhādavaropitasya
ce_text: vihāya kīrtiṃ vipulaṃ yaśaś ca yuddhāt parāvṛtya palāyase kim / na te 'dya tūryāṇi samāhatāni yathāvad udyānti gatasya yuddhe

vulgate_text: moghaṃ tavaitadbhuvi nāmadheyaṃ duryodhanetīha kṛtaṃ purastāt duryodhanastvaṃ prathitosi nāmnā suyodhanaḥ sannikṛtipradhānaḥ
ce_text: moghaṃ tavedaṃ bhuvi nāmadheyaṃ duryodhanetīha kṛtaṃ purastāt / na hīha duryodhanatā tavāsti palāyamānasya raṇaṃ vihāya

vulgate_text: āhūyamānastu sa tena saṅkhye mahātmanā vai dhṛ nivartitaścāpi girāṅkuśena gajo madonmatta ivāṅkuśena
ce_text: āhūyamānas tu sa tena saṃkhye mahāmanā dhṛtarāṣṭrasya putraḥ / nivartitas tasya girāṅkuśena gajo yathā matta ivāṅkuśena

vulgate_text: raśmīnsamutsṛjya tato mahātmā rathādavaplutya virāṭaputraḥ / vastrāṇyupādāya mahārathānāṃ nānāvidhānyadbhutavarṇakāni
ce_text: raśmīn samutsṛjya tato mahātmā rathād avaplutya virāṭaputraḥ / vastrāṇy upādāya mahārathānāṃ tūrṇaṃ punaḥ svaṃ ratham āruroha

vulgate_text: māṇikyabāhvaṅgadakaṅkaṇāni anyāni rājñāṃ maṇibhūṣaṇāni / vastrāṇyupādāya mahārathānāṃ tūrṇaṃ punaḥ khaṃ rathamāruroha
ce_text: raśmīn samutsṛjya tato mahātmā rathād avaplutya virāṭaputraḥ / vastrāṇy upādāya mahārathānāṃ tūrṇaṃ punaḥ svaṃ ratham āruroha

vulgate_text: tānprasthitānprītamanāḥ samartho dhanañjayaḥ sarvakurupravīraḥ / āmantrya vīro'nuyayau muhūrtaṃ gāṇḍīvaghoṣeṇa vinadya lokam
ce_text: tān prasthitān prītamanāḥ sa pārtho dhanaṃjayaḥ prekṣya kurupravīrān / ābhāṣamāṇo 'nuyayau muhūrtaṃ saṃpūjayaṃs tatra gurūn mahātmā

vulgate_text: tānarjuno dūrataraṃ vibhajya dhanaṃ ca sarvaṃ nikhilaṃ nivartya āpṛcchya tāndūramanuprayātvā dhanañjayastatra kurūnmahātmā / gurūṃśca sarvānabhivādya bāṇairnyavartatodagramanāḥ śaraiḥ saha
ce_text: tān prasthitān prītamanāḥ sa pārtho dhanaṃjayaḥ prekṣya kurupravīrān / ābhāṣamāṇo 'nuyayau muhūrtaṃ saṃpūjayaṃs tatra gurūn mahātmā

vulgate_text: pitāmahaṃ śāntanavaṃ mahātmā dvābhyāṃ śarābhyāmabhivādya vīraḥ droṇaṃ kṛpaṃ caiva kurūṃśca mānyāñśaraiśca sarvānabhivādya saṅkhye / duryodhanasyottamaratnacitraṃ ciccheda pārtho makuṭaṃ śaraughaiḥ
ce_text: duryodhanasyottamaratnacitraṃ ciccheda pārtho mukuṭaṃ śareṇa / āmantrya vīrāṃś ca tathaiva mānyān gāṇḍīvaghoṣeṇa vinādya lokān

vulgate_text: āvartayāśvānpaśavo jitāste yātāḥ pare praihi puraṃ prahṛṣṭaḥ uddhuṣyatāṃ te vijayo'dya śīghraṃ gātraṃ tu te sevatu mālyagandhaḥ / mātā tu te nandatu bāndhavāśca tvāmadya dṛṣṭvā samudīrṇaharṣam
ce_text: dṛṣṭvā prayātāṃs tu kurūn kirīṭī hṛṣṭo 'bravīt tatra sa matsyaputram / āvartayāśvān paśavo jitās te yātāḥ pare yāhi puraṃ prahṛṣṭaḥ

vulgate_text: muktakeśāḥ pradṛśyante sthitāḥ prāñjalayastadā kṣutpiṇasāpariśrāntā videśasthā vicetasaḥ / ūcuḥ prāñjalayaḥ sarve pārtha kiṃ karavāmahe
ce_text: kṣutpipāsāpariśrāntā videśasthā vicetasaḥ / ūcuḥ praṇamya saṃbhrāntāḥ pārtha kiṃ karavāma te

vulgate_text: tato nivṛttāḥ kuravaḥ prabhagnāḥ śamamāsthitāḥ / parasparamavekṣyaiva jagmuste hṛtavāsasaḥ
ce_text: tato nivṛttāḥ kuravaḥ prabhagnā vaśam āsthitāḥ / panthānam upasaṃgamya phalguno vākyam abravīt

vulgate_text: panthānamupasaṃgamya phalguno vākyamabravīt rājaputra prapadyasva dhanānīmāni sarvaśaḥ / gokulāni mahābāho vīragopālakaiḥ saha
ce_text: rājaputra pratyavekṣa samānītāni sarvaśaḥ / gokulāni mahābāho vīra gopālakaiḥ saha

vulgate_text: tataḥ sa rājā mātsyānāṃ virāṭo vāhinīpatiḥ praviśyāntaḥpuraṃ ramyaṃ strīśatairupaśobhitam / uttaraṃ tatra nāpaśyatkva yāta iti cābravīt
ce_text: tataḥ sa rājā matsyānāṃ virāṭo vāhinīpatiḥ / uttaraṃ paripapraccha kva yāta iti cābravīt

vulgate_text: tato virāṭaḥ paramābhitaptaḥ putraṃ niśamyaikarathena yātam / bṛhannalāsārathimājimardanaṃ provāca sarvānatha mantrimukhyān
