vulgate_text: akṣauhiṇībhiḥ pāñcālastisṛbhiśca mahābalaḥ / draupadyāśca sutā vīrāḥ śikhaṇḍī cāparājitaḥ
ce_text: akṣauhiṇyā ca tejasvī yajñaseno mahābalaḥ / draupadyāś ca sutā vīrāḥ śikhaṇḍī cāparājitaḥ

vulgate_text: dhṛṣṭadyumnaśca durdharṣaḥ sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃvaraḥ / upaplāvyaṃ yayuḥ śīghraṃ pāṇḍavārthe mahābalāḥ
ce_text: dhṛṣṭadyumnaś ca durdharṣaḥ sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ / samastākṣauhiṇīpālā yajvāno bhūridakṣiṇāḥ / sarve śastrāstrasaṃpannāḥ sarve śūrās tanutyajaḥ

vulgate_text: tānāgatānabhiprekṣya pārtho jñānabhṛtāṃ varaḥ / pūjayāmāsa vidhivadyathārhaṃ rājasattamān
ce_text: tān āgatān abhiprekṣya matsyo dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ / prīto 'bhavad duhitaraṃ dattvā tām abhimanyave

vulgate_text: tataḥ śaṅkhā mṛdaṅgāśca gomukhā ḍiṇḍimāstadā / abhimanyorvivāhe tu nedurmātsyasya veśmani
ce_text: tataḥ śaṅkhāś ca bheryaś ca gomukhāḍambarās tathā / pārthaiḥ saṃyujyamānasya nedur matsyasya veśmani

vulgate_text: tatrātiṣṭhadgṛhītvā tu rūpamindrāsya dhārayan / snuṣāṃ tāṃ parigṛhṇānaḥ kuntīputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
ce_text: tatrātiṣṭhan mahārājo rūpam indrasya dhārayan / snuṣāṃ tāṃ pratijagrāha kuntīputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ

vulgate_text: saptaite'kṣauhiṇīpālā yajvāno bhūridakṣiṇāḥ / pāṇḍavaṃ parivāryaite niveśaṃ cakrire tadā
ce_text: dhṛṣṭadyumnaś ca durdharṣaḥ sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ / samastākṣauhiṇīpālā yajvāno bhūridakṣiṇāḥ / sarve śastrāstrasaṃpannāḥ sarve śūrās tanutyajaḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ pārthāya saṃhṛṣṭo mātsyarājo dhanaṃ mahat / tasmai śatasahasrāṇi hayānāṃ vātaraṃhasām
ce_text: tasmai sapta sahasrāṇi hayānāṃ vātaraṃhasām / dve ca nāgaśate mukhye prādād bahu dhanaṃ tadā

vulgate_text: dve ca nāgaśate mukhye dhanaṃ bahuvidhaṃ tadā / prādānmātsyapatirhṛṣṭaḥ kanyādhanamanuttamam
ce_text: tasmai sapta sahasrāṇi hayānāṃ vātaraṃhasām / dve ca nāgaśate mukhye prādād bahu dhanaṃ tadā

vulgate_text: nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam / devīṃ sarasvatīṃ caiva tato jayamudīrayet / kṛtvā vivāhaṃ tu kurupravīrāstadā'bhimanyormuditāḥ sapakṣāḥ / viśramya rātrāvuṣasi pratītāḥ sabhāṃ virāṭasya tato'bhijagmuḥ
ce_text: kṛtvā vivāhaṃ tu kurupravīrās tadābhimanyor muditasvapakṣāḥ / viśramya catvāry uṣasaḥ pratītāḥ sabhāṃ virāṭasya tato 'bhijagmuḥ

vulgate_text: trayodaśaścaiva sudustaro'yamajñāyamānairbhavatāṃ samīpe / kleśānasahyānvividhānsahadbhirmahātmabhiścāpi vane niviṣṭam etaiḥ parapreṣyaniyogayuktairicchadbhirāptaṃ svakulena rājyam
ce_text: trayodaśaś caiva sudustaro 'yam ajñāyamānair bhavatāṃ samīpe / kleśān asahyāṃś ca titikṣamāṇair yathoṣitaṃ tad viditaṃ ca sarvam

vulgate_text: nivāryamāṇaśca kurupravīraḥ sarvaiḥ suhṛdbhirhyamapyatañjhaḥ / sa dīvyamānaḥ pratidīvya cainaṃ gāndhārarājasya sutaṃ matākṣam
ce_text: nivāryamāṇaś ca kurupravīraiḥ sarvaiḥ suhṛdbhir hy ayam apy atajjñaḥ / gāndhārarājasya sutaṃ matākṣaṃ samāhvayed devitum ājamīḍhaḥ

vulgate_text: hitvā hi karṇaṃ ca suyodhanaṃ ca samāhvayaddevitumājamīḍhaḥ / durodarāstatra sahasraśo'nye yudhiṣṭhiro yānviṣaheta jetum
ce_text: durodarās tatra sahasraśo 'nye yudhiṣṭhiro yān viṣaheta jetum / utsṛjya tān saubalam eva cāyaṃ samāhvayat tena jito 'kṣavatyām

vulgate_text: tathā hi śakyo dhṛtarāṣṭraputraḥ svārtheṃ niyoktuṃ puruṣeṇa tena / ayuddhamākāṅkṣata kauravāṇāṃ sāmnaiva duryodhanamāśvasadhvam
ce_text: tasmāt praṇamyaiva vaco bravītu vaicitravīryaṃ bahusāmayuktam / tathā hi śakyo dhṛtarāṣṭraputraḥ svārthe niyoktuṃ puruṣeṇa tena

vulgate_text: yamau ca dṛḍhadhanvānau yamakalpau mahādyutī / virāṭadrupadau vīrau yamakālopamadyutī
ce_text: yamau ca dṛḍhadhanvānau yamakalpau mahādyutī / ko jijīviṣur āsīded dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ ca pārṣatam

vulgate_text: śakānāṃ pahlavānāṃ karṇaveṣṭaśca pārthivaḥ / surāriśca nadījaśca karṇaveṣṭaśca pārthivaḥ
ce_text: adāriś ca nadījaś ca karṇaveṣṭaś ca pārthivaḥ / samarthaś ca suvīraś ca mārjāraḥ kanyakas tathā

vulgate_text: saṃkulā ca tadā bhūmiścaturaṅgavalānvitā / balāni teṣāṃ vīrāṇāmāgacchanti tatastataḥ
ce_text: balāni teṣāṃ vīrāṇām āgacchanti tatas tataḥ / cālayantīva gāṃ devīṃ saparvatavanām imām

vulgate_text: dvijeṣu vaidyāḥ śreyāṃso vaidyeṣu kṛtabuddhayaḥ / kṛtabuddhiṣu kartāraḥ kartṛṣu brahmavādinaḥ
ce_text: dvijeṣu vaidyāḥ śreyāṃso vaidyeṣu kṛtabuddhayaḥ / sa bhavān kṛtabuddhīnāṃ pradhāna iti me matiḥ

vulgate_text: sa bhavānkṛbuddhīnāṃ pradhāna iti me matiḥ kulena ca viśiṣṭo'si vayasā ca śrutena ca / prajñayā sadṛśaścāsi śukreṇāṅgirasena ca
ce_text: kulena ca viśiṣṭo 'si vayasā ca śrutena ca / prajñayānavamaś cāsi śukreṇāṅgirasena ca

vulgate_text: purohitaṃ te prasthāpya nagaraṃ nāgasāhvayam / dūtānprasthāpayāmāsuḥ pārthivebhyastatastataḥ
ce_text: tathānuśiṣṭaḥ prayayau drupadena mahātmanā / purodhā vṛttasaṃpanno nagaraṃ nāgasāhvayam

vulgate_text: duryodhanastu prathamaṃ vāsudevamupāśrayat / ucchīrṣataśca kṛṣṇasya niṣasāda varāsane
ce_text: tataḥ śayāne govinde praviveśa suyodhanaḥ / ucchīrṣataś ca kṛṣṇasya niṣasāda varāsane

vulgate_text: pratibuddhaḥ sa vārṣṇeyo dadarśāgre kirīṭinām / siṃhāsanagataṃ paścātparivṛtya ca dṛṣṭavān
ce_text: pratibuddhaḥ sa vārṣṇeyo dadarśāgre kirīṭinam / sa tayoḥ svāgataṃ kṛtvā yathārhaṃ pratipūjya ca / tadāgamanajaṃ hetuṃ papraccha madhusūdanaḥ

vulgate_text: ahaṃ cābhigataṃ santo bhajante pūrvasāriṇaḥ tvaṃ ca śreṣṭhatamo loke satāmadya janārdana
ce_text: ahaṃ cābhigataḥ pūrvaṃ tvām adya madhusūdana / pūrvaṃ cābhigataṃ santo bhajante pūrvasāriṇaḥ

vulgate_text: ityevamuktastu tadā pariṣvajya halāyudham / kṛṣṇaṃ cāpi mahābāhumāmantrya bharatarṣabha
ce_text: ity evam uktaḥ sa tadā pariṣvajya halāyudham / kṛṣṇaṃ cāpahṛtaṃ jñātvā yuddhān mene jitaṃ jayam

vulgate_text: tataḥ pītāmbaradharo jagatsraṣṭā janārdanaḥ / gate duryodhane kṛṣṇaḥ kirīṭinamathābravīt
ce_text: gate duryodhane kṛṣṇaḥ kirīṭinam athābravīt / ayudhyamānaḥ kāṃ buddhim āsthāyāhaṃ tvayā vṛtaḥ

vulgate_text: akṣauhiṇīpatī rājanmahāvīryaparākramāḥ / vicitrakavacāḥ śūrā vicitradhvajakārmukāḥ
ce_text: vicitrakavacāḥ śūrā vicitradhvajakārmukāḥ / vicitrābharaṇāḥ sarve vicitrarathavāhanāḥ

vulgate_text: vicitrābharaṇāḥ sarve vicitrarathavāhanāḥ / vicitrasragdharāḥ sarve vivitrāmbarabhūṣaṇāḥ
ce_text: vicitrakavacāḥ śūrā vicitradhvajakārmukāḥ / vicitrābharaṇāḥ sarve vicitrarathavāhanāḥ

vulgate_text: saṃprahṛṣṭo yadā śalyo diditsurapi jīvitam / gūḍho duryodhanastatra darśayāmāsa mātulam
ce_text: gūḍho duryodhanas tatra darśayām āsa mātulam / taṃ dṛṣṭvā madrarājas tu jñātvā yatnaṃ ca tasya tam / pariṣvajyābravīt prīta iṣṭo 'rtho gṛhyatām iti

vulgate_text: tathā bhīmārjunau hṛṣṭau svastrīyau ca yamāvubhau / draupadī ca subhadrā ca abhimanyuśca bhārata
ce_text: tathā bhīmārjunau hṛṣṭau svasrīyau ca yamāv ubhau / āsane copaviṣṭas tu śalyaḥ pārtham uvāca ha

vulgate_text: sametya ca mahāpāhuṃ śalyaṃ pāṇḍusutastadā / pādyamarghyaṃ ca gāṃ caiva pratigrāhya purodhasā
ce_text: sametya tu mahābāhuḥ śalyaḥ pāṇḍusutais tadā / pādyam arghyaṃ ca gāṃ caiva pratyagṛhṇād yathāvidhi

vulgate_text: sa taiḥ parivṛtaḥ sarvaiḥ pāṇḍavairdharmacāribhiḥ / āsane copaviṣṭaḥ sa śalyaḥ pārthamathābravīt
ce_text: tathā bhīmārjunau hṛṣṭau svasrīyau ca yamāv ubhau / āsane copaviṣṭas tu śalyaḥ pārtham uvāca ha

vulgate_text: duṣkaraṃ te kṛtaṃ rājannirjane gahane vane / bhrātṛbhiḥ saha kaunteya kṛṣṇāyā cānayā'nagha
ce_text: suduṣkaraṃ kṛtaṃ rājan nirjane vasatā vane / bhrātṛbhiḥ saha rājendra kṛṣṇayā cānayā saha

vulgate_text: ekaṃ tvicchāmi bhadraṃ te kriyamāṇaṃ mahīpate / rājannakartavyamapi kartumarhasi sattama
ce_text: sukṛtaṃ te kṛtaṃ rājan prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā / duryodhanasya yad vīra tvayā vācā pratiśrutam / ekaṃ tv icchāmi bhadraṃ te kriyamāṇaṃ mahīpate

vulgate_text: mama tvavekṣayā vīra śṛṇu vijñāpayāmi te / bhavāniha mahārāja vāsudevasamo yudhi
ce_text: bhavān iha mahārāja vāsudevasamo yudhi / karṇārjunābhyāṃ saṃprāpte dvairathe rājasattama / karṇasya bhavatā kāryaṃ sārathyaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ

vulgate_text: śṛṅgāraveṣāḥ suśroṇyo hārairyuktā manoharaiḥ / hāvabhāvasamāyuktāḥ sarvāḥ saundaryaśobhitāḥ
ce_text: śṛṅgāraveṣāḥ suśroṇyo bhāvair yuktā manoharaiḥ / pralobhayata bhadraṃ vaḥ śamayadhvaṃ bhayaṃ mama

vulgate_text: nṛttaṃ saṃdarśayāmāsustathaivāṅgeṣu sauṣṭhavam / nābhyagacchatpraharṣaṃ tāḥ sa paśyansumahātapāḥ
ce_text: indreṇa tās tv anujñātā jagmus triśiraso 'ntikam / tatra tā vividhair bhāvair lobhayantyo varāṅganāḥ / nṛtyaṃ saṃdarśayantyaś ca tathaivāṅgeṣu sauṣṭhavam

vulgate_text: hato'pi dīptatejāḥ sa jīvanniva hi dṛśyate / ghātitasya śirāṃsyājau jīvantīvādbhutāni vai
ce_text: taṃ tu vajrahataṃ dṛṣṭvā śayānam acalopamam / na śarma lebhe devendro dīpitas tasya tejasā / hato 'pi dīptatejāḥ sa jīvann iva ca dṛśyate

vulgate_text: tadaraṇyaṃ mahārāja yatrāste'sau nipātitaḥ / sa bhītastatra takṣāṇaṃ ghaṭamānaṃ śacīpatiḥ
ce_text: abhitas tatra takṣāṇaṃ ghaṭamānaṃ śacīpatiḥ / apaśyad abravīc cainaṃ satvaraṃ pākaśāsanaḥ / kṣipraṃ chindhi śirāṃsy asya kuruṣva vacanaṃ mama

vulgate_text: tatasteṣu nikṛtteṣu vijvaro maghavānatha takṣṇe tathā varaṃ dattvā prahṛṣṭastridaśeśvaraḥ
ce_text: tatas teṣu nikṛtteṣu vijvaro maghavān abhūt / jagāma tridivaṃ hṛṣṭas takṣāpi svagṛhān yayau

vulgate_text: jagāma tridivaṃ devastakṣā'pi svagṛhānyayau / mene kṛtārthamātmānaṃ hatvā śatruṃ surārihā
ce_text: tatas teṣu nikṛtteṣu vijvaro maghavān abhūt / jagāma tridivaṃ hṛṣṭas takṣāpi svagṛhān yayau

vulgate_text: yuktaḥ sadā'bhavaccāpi śakro harṣasamanvitaḥ vṛtrasya vadhasaṃyuktānupāyānanvacintayat - - a abhisandhirmahendrasya sandhikarmaṇi yaḥ kṛtaḥ ṛṣibhistvīritaṃ yacca mahendrastadanusmaran
ce_text: yattaḥ sadābhavac cāpi śakro 'marṣasamanvitaḥ / vṛtrasya vadhasaṃyuktān upāyān anucintayan / randhrānveṣī samudvignaḥ sadābhūd balavṛtrahā

vulgate_text: chidrānveṣī samudvignaḥ sadā vasati devarāṭ / sa kadācinsamudrānte samapaśyanmahāsuram
ce_text: sa kadā cit samudrānte tam apaśyan mahāsuram / saṃdhyākāla upāvṛtte muhūrte ramyadāruṇe

vulgate_text: tejasvī ca yaśasvī ca dhārmikaścaiva nityadā / te gatvā tvabruvansarve rājā no bhava pārthiva
ce_text: ṛṣayo 'thābruvan sarve devāś ca tridaśeśvarāḥ / ayaṃ vai nahuṣaḥ śrīmān devarājye 'bhiṣicyatām / te gatvāthābruvan sarve rājā no bhava pārthiva

vulgate_text: brahmarṣīścāpi devāṃśca gopāyasva triviṣṭape / abhiṣiktaḥ sa rājendra tato rājā triviṣṭape
ce_text: dharmaṃ puraskṛtya sadā sarvalokādhipo bhava / brahmarṣīṃś cāpi devāṃś ca gopāyasva triviṣṭape

vulgate_text: nāhamicchāmi nahuṣaṃ patiṃ devarṣisattama / śaraṇāgatāsmi te brahaṃstrāyasva mahato bhayāt
ce_text: nāham icchāmi nahuṣaṃ patim anvāsya taṃ prabhum / śaraṇāgatāsmi te brahmaṃs trāhi māṃ mahato bhayāt

vulgate_text: atha devāḥ sagandharvā gurumāhuridaṃ vacaḥ / kathaṃ sunītaṃ nu bhavenmantrayasva bṛhaspate
ce_text: atha devās tam evāhur gurum aṅgirasāṃ varam / kathaṃ sunītaṃ tu bhaven mantrayasva bṛhaspate

vulgate_text: prāvepata bhayodvignā pravāte kadalī yathā / praṇamya sā hi brahmāṇaṃ śirasā tu kṛtāñjaliḥ
ce_text: evam uktā tu sā devī nahuṣeṇa pativratā / prāvepata bhayodvignā pravāte kadalī yathā

vulgate_text: ahamindro'smi devānāṃ lokānāṃ ca maheśvaraḥ mayi havyaṃ ca kavyaṃ ca lokāścaiva sanātanāḥ / tasmātte vacanaṃ devi kariṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ
ce_text: tasmāt te vacanaṃ devi kariṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ / saptarṣayo māṃ vakṣyanti sarve brahmarṣayas tathā / paśya māhātmyam asmākam ṛddhiṃ ca varavarṇini

vulgate_text: sa tu darpeṇa mahatā paribhūya mahāmunīn vimāne yojayitvā ca ṛṣīnniyamāmāsthitān
ce_text: evam uktvā tu tāṃ devīṃ visṛjya ca varānanām / vimāne yojayitvā sa ṛṣīn niyamam āsthitān

vulgate_text: bṛhaspatirmahātejā devarājopalabdhaye / hutvā'gniṃ sobravīdrājañchakra anviṣyatāmiti
ce_text: tataḥ prajvālya vidhivaj juhāva paramaṃ haviḥ / bṛhaspatir mahātejā devarājopalabdhaye

vulgate_text: sa tānyathāvacca hi lokapālānsametsa vai prītamanā mahendraḥ / uvāca cainānpratibhāṣya śakraḥ saṃcodayiṣyannahuṣasyāntareṇa
ce_text: sa tān yathāvat pratibhāṣya śakraḥ saṃcodayan nahuṣasyāntareṇa / rājā devānāṃ nahuṣo ghorarūpas tatra sāhyaṃ dīyatāṃ me bhavadbhiḥ

vulgate_text: paraśvathairbhiṇḍipālaiḥ śūlatomaramudgaraiḥ / parighairyaṣṭibhiḥ pāśaiḥ karavālaiśca nirmalaiḥ
ce_text: paraśvadhair bhiṇḍipālaiḥ śaktitomaramudgaraiḥ / śaktyṛṣṭiparaśuprāsaiḥ karavālaiś ca nirmalaiḥ

vulgate_text: babhūva kauraveyāṇāṃ balenātīva saṃvṛtaḥ / tatra sainyaṃ tathā yuktaṃ dadarśa sa purohitaḥ
ce_text: tatra sainyaṃ tathāyuktaṃ dadarśa sa purohitaḥ / yaḥ sa pāñcālarājena preṣitaḥ kauravān prati

vulgate_text: te sarvaṃ pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtvā tatpūrvaṃ karma kilviṣam / sāmnaiva kurubhiḥ sandhimicchanti kurupuṅgavāḥ
ce_text: te sarve pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtvā tat sarvaṃ pūrvakilbiṣam / sāmaiva kurubhiḥ sārdham icchanti kurupuṃgavāḥ

vulgate_text: tato duryodhanasyāṅke vartantāmakutobhayāḥ / adhārmikīṃ tu mā buddhiṃ maurkhyātkurvantu kevalāt
ce_text: tato duryodhanasyāṅke vartantām akutobhayāḥ / adhārmikām imāṃ buddhiṃ kuryur maurkhyād dhi kevalam

vulgate_text: kiṃ nu rādheya vācā te karma tatsmartumarhasi eka eva yadā pārthaḥ ṣaḍrathāñjitavānyudhi - - a virāṭanagare dhīraḥ kiṃ tvaṃ tatraiva nāgataḥ bahuśo jīyamānasya karma dṛṣṭaṃ tadaiva te
ce_text: kiṃ nu rādheya vācā te karma tat smartum arhasi / eka eva yadā pārthaḥ ṣaḍ rathāñ jitavān yudhi

vulgate_text: putro mahyaṃ mṛtyuvaśaṃ jagāma duryodhanaḥ sañjaya rāgabuddhiḥ / teṣāṃ hīmau hīnasukhapriyāṇāṃ mahātmanāṃ saṃjanayato hi tejaḥ
ce_text: anyatra pāpād viṣamān mandabuddher duryodhanāt kṣudratarāc ca karṇāt / teṣāṃ hīme hīnasukhapriyāṇāṃ mahātmanāṃ saṃjanayanti tejaḥ

vulgate_text: etadbalaṃ pūrṇamasmākamevaṃ yatsatyaṃ tānprāpya nāstīti manye / teṣāṃ madhye vartamānastarasvī dhṛṣṭadyumnaḥ pāṇḍavānāmihaikaḥ
ce_text: teṣāṃ madhye vartamānas tarasvī dhṛṣṭadyumnaḥ pāṇḍavānām ihaikaḥ / sahāmātyaḥ somakānāṃ prabarhaḥ saṃtyaktātmā pāṇḍavānāṃ jayāya

vulgate_text: na cedgacchetsaṅgaraṃ mandabuddhistābhyāṃ labheccharma tadā suto me / no cetkurūnsañjaya nirdahetāmindrāviṣṇū daityasenāṃ yathaiva
ce_text: no ced gacchet saṃgaraṃ mandabuddhis tābhyāṃ suto me viparītacetāḥ / no cet kurūn saṃjaya nirdahetām indrāviṣṇū daityasenāṃ yathaiva / mato hi me śakrasamo dhanaṃjayaḥ sanātano vṛṣṇivīraś ca viṣṇuḥ

vulgate_text: kaccinna pāpaṃ kathayanti tāta te pāṇḍavānāṃ kuravaḥ sarva eva / droṇaḥ saputraśca kṛpaśca vīro nāsmāsu pāpāni vadanti kaccit
ce_text: kaccin na pāpaṃ kathayanti tāta te pāṇḍavānāṃ kuravaḥ sarva eva / kaccid dṛṣṭvā dasyusaṃghān sametān smaranti pārthasya yudhāṃ praṇetuḥ

vulgate_text: kaccidrājye dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ saputraṃ sametyāhuḥ kuravaḥ sarva eva / kacciddṛṣṭvā dasyusaṅghānsametānsmaranti pārthasya yudhāṃ praṇetuḥ
ce_text: kaccin na pāpaṃ kathayanti tāta te pāṇḍavānāṃ kuravaḥ sarva eva / kaccid dṛṣṭvā dasyusaṃghān sametān smaranti pārthasya yudhāṃ praṇetuḥ

vulgate_text: dharmodayaṃ sukhamāśaṃsamānāḥ kṛcchropāyaṃ tattvataḥ karma duḥkham / sukhaṃ prepsurvijighāṃsuśca duḥkhaṃ karmārabhedyacca dharmānapetam
ce_text: karmodayaṃ sukham āśaṃsamānaḥ kṛcchropāyaṃ tattvataḥ karma duḥkham / sukhaprepsur vijighāṃsuś ca duḥkhaṃ ya indriyāṇāṃ prītivaśānugāmī / kāmābhidhyā svaśarīraṃ dunoti yayā prayukto 'nukaroti duḥkham

vulgate_text: ka indriyāṇāṃ prītivaśānurānāṃ karmābhijñaḥ svaśarīraṃ dunoti / yayā pramukto na karoti duḥkhaṃ tṛṣṇāṃ tyajetsarvadharmādapetām
ce_text: karmodayaṃ sukham āśaṃsamānaḥ kṛcchropāyaṃ tattvataḥ karma duḥkham / sukhaprepsur vijighāṃsuś ca duḥkhaṃ ya indriyāṇāṃ prītivaśānugāmī / kāmābhidhyā svaśarīraṃ dunoti yayā prayukto 'nukaroti duḥkham

vulgate_text: nāśreyānīśvaro vigrahāṇāṃ nāśreyānvai gītaśabdaṃ śrṛṇoti / nāśreyānvai sevate mālyagandhānna cāpyaśreyānanulepanāni nāśreyānvai prāvārānsaṃvivaste kathaṃ tvasmānsaṃpraṇudetkurubhyaḥ
ce_text: nāśreyasām īśvaro vigrahāṇāṃ nāśreyasāṃ gītaśabdaṃ śṛṇoti / nāśreyasaḥ sevate mālyagandhān na cāpy aśreyāṃsy anulepanāni

vulgate_text: gāṇḍīvaviṣphāritaśabdamātraṃ śrutvaiva te dhārtarāṣṭrā mriyante / kruddhaṃ na cedīkṣate bhīmasenaṃ suyodhano manyate siddhamartham
ce_text: gāṇḍīvavisphāritaśabdam ājāv aśṛṇvānā dhārtarāṣṭrā dhriyante / kruddhasya ced bhīmasenasya vegāt suyodhano manyate siddham artham

vulgate_text: yamo rājā vaiśravaṇaḥ kubero gandharvayakṣāpsarasaśca sūta / brahmavidyāṃ brahmacaryaṃ kriyāṃ ca nipevamāṇā ṛṣayo'mutra bhānti
ce_text: nakṣatrāṇi karmaṇāmutra bhānti rudrādityā vasavo 'thāpi viśve / yamo rājā vaiśravaṇaḥ kubero gandharvayakṣāpsarasaś ca śubhrāḥ / brahmacaryaṃ vedavidyāḥ kriyāś ca niṣevamāṇā munayo 'mutra bhānti

vulgate_text: sa dharmātmā dharmamadhītya puṇyaṃ yadṛcchayā vrajati brahmalokam / vaiśyo'dhītya kṛṣigorakṣapaṇyairvittaṃ cinvanpālayannapramattaḥ
ce_text: vaiśyo 'dhītya kṛṣigorakṣapaṇyair vittaṃ cinvan pālayann apramattaḥ / priyaṃ kurvan brāhmaṇakṣatriyāṇāṃ dharmaśīlaḥ puṇyakṛd āvased gṛhān

vulgate_text: svayaṃ tvahaṃ prārthaye tatra gantuṃ samādhātuṃ kāryametadvipannam / jānāsi tvaṃ dhārtarāṣṭrasya mohaṃ durātmanaḥ pāpavaśānugasya
ce_text: jānāsi tvaṃ saṃjaya sarvam etad dyūte 'vācyaṃ vākyam evaṃ yathoktam / svayaṃ tv ahaṃ prārthaye tatra gantuṃ samādhātuṃ kāryam etad vipannam

vulgate_text: vanaṃ rājā dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ saputraḥ siṃhā vane sañjaya pāṇḍaveyāḥ / siṃhābhiguptaṃ na vanaṃ vinaśyet siṃho na naśyeta vanābhiguptaḥ
ce_text: vanaṃ rājā dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ saputro vyāghrā vane saṃjaya pāṇḍaveyāḥ / mā vanaṃ chindhi savyāghraṃ mā vyāghrān nīnaśo vanāt

vulgate_text: ślāghasva māṃ kuśalinaṃ sma tebhyo hyanāmayaṃ tāta pṛccherjaghanyam / ye jīvti vyavahāreṇa rāṣṭre paśūṃśca ye pālayanto vasanti kṛṣīvalā bibhrati ye ca lokaṃ teṣāṃ sarvaṣāṃ kuśalaṃ sma pṛccheḥ
ce_text: dāsīputrā ye ca dāsāḥ kurūṇāṃ tadāśrayā bahavaḥ kubjakhañjāḥ / ākhyāya māṃ kuśalinaṃ sma tebhyo anāmayaṃ paripṛccher jaghanyam

vulgate_text: ye caivānye kurumukhyā yuvānaḥ putrāḥ pautrā bhrātaraścaiva ye naḥ / yaṃyameṣāṃ manyase yena yogyaṃ tattatprocyānāmayaṃ sūta vācyāḥ
ce_text: ye caivānye kurumukhyā yuvānaḥ putrāḥ pautrā bhrātaraś caiva ye naḥ / yaṃ yam eṣāṃ yena yenābhigaccher anāmayaṃ madvacanena vācyaḥ

vulgate_text: balaṃ jijñāsamānasya ācakṣīthā yathātatham / atha mantra mantrayitvā yāthātathyena hṛṣṭavat
ce_text: alaṃ vijñāpanāya syād ācakṣīthā yathātatham / atho mantraṃ mantrayitvā anyonyenātihṛṣṭavat

vulgate_text: apāpāṃ yadupaikṣastvaṃ kṛṣṇāmetāṃ sabhāgatām / tadduḥkhamatitikṣāma mā vadhīṣma kurūniti
ce_text: apaśyan mām upekṣantaṃ kṛṣṇām ekāṃ sabhāgatām / tadduḥkham atitikṣāma mā vadhīṣma kurūn iti

vulgate_text: ācakṣva dhṛtarāṣṭrāsya dvā'stha māṃ samupāgatam / sakāśātpāṇḍuputrāṇāṃ sañjayaṃ māciraṃ kṛthāḥ
ce_text: ācakṣva māṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrāya dvāḥstha upāgataṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ sakāśāt / jāgarti ced abhivades tvaṃ hi kṣattaḥ praviśeyaṃ vidito bhūmipasya

vulgate_text: .....rti cedabhivadestvaṃ hi dvāḥstha .....viśeyaṃ vidito bhūmipasya / .....dyamatrātyayikaṃ hi me'sti ..... stho'tha śrutvā nṛpatiṃ jagāda
ce_text: ācakṣva māṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrāya dvāḥstha upāgataṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ sakāśāt / jāgarti ced abhivades tvaṃ hi kṣattaḥ praviśeyaṃ vidito bhūmipasya

vulgate_text: anujñāto'syāvasathaṃ parehi prapadyasva śayanaṃ sūtaputra / prātaḥ śrotāraḥ kuravaḥ sabhāyāmajātaśatrorvacanaṃ tvayoktam
ce_text: anujñāto rathavegāvadhūtaḥ śrānto nipadye śayanaṃ nṛsiṃha / prātaḥ śrotāraḥ kuravaḥ sabhāyām ajātaśatror vacanaṃ sametāḥ

vulgate_text: tanme brūhi vidura tvaṃ yathāvanmanīṣitaṃ sarvamajātaśatroḥ / yathā na nastāta hitaṃ bhavecca prajāśca sarvāḥ sukhitā bhaveyuḥ
ce_text: pāpāśaṅkī pāpam evānupaśyan pṛcchāmi tvāṃ vyākulenātmanāham / kave tan me brūhi sarvaṃ yathāvan manīṣitaṃ sarvam ajātaśatroḥ

vulgate_text: rājā lakṣaṇasaṃpannastrailokyasyādhipo bhavet / preṣyaste preṣitaścaiva dhṛtarāṣṭra yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
ce_text: rājā lakṣaṇasaṃpannas trailokyasyāpi yo bhavet / śiṣyas te śāsitā so 'stu dhṛtarāṣṭra yudhiṣṭhiraḥ

vulgate_text: prāyeṇa śrīmatāṃ loke bhoktuṃ śaktirna vidyate / jīryantyapi hi kāṣṭhāni daridrāṇāṃ mahīpate
ce_text: prāyeṇa śrīmatāṃ loke bhoktuṃ śaktir na vidyate / daridrāṇāṃ tu rājendra api kāṣṭhaṃ hi jīryate

vulgate_text: abhivādyo bhavānbrahmansākṣye caiva niyojitaḥ putra eko mama brahmaṃstvaṃ ca sākṣādihāsthitaḥ / tayorvivadatoḥ praśnaṃ kathamasmadvidho vadet
ce_text: putro vānyo bhavān brahman sākṣye caiva bhavet sthitaḥ / tayor vivadatoḥ praśnaṃ katham asmadvidho vadet

vulgate_text: putro vā'nyo bhavedbrahmansākṣye cāpi bhavetsthitaḥ / tayorvivadatorhaṃsa kathaṃ dharmaḥ pravartate
ce_text: putro vānyo bhavān brahman sākṣye caiva bhavet sthitaḥ / tayor vivadatoḥ praśnaṃ katham asmadvidho vadet

vulgate_text: atha yo naiva prabrūyātsatyaṃ vā yadi vā'nṛtam / haṃsa tatvaṃ ca pṛcchāmi kiyadenaḥ karoti saḥ
ce_text: atha yo naiva prabrūyāt satyaṃ vā yadi vānṛtam / etat sudhanvan pṛcchāmi durvivaktā sma kiṃ vaset

vulgate_text: mohādvā caiva kāmādvā mithyāvādaṃ yadi bruvan / dhṛtarāṣṭra tatvaṃ pṛcchāmi durvivaktā tu kiṃ vaset

vulgate_text: tasmātpāpaṃ na kurvīta puruṣaḥ śaṃsitavrataḥ / pāpaṃ prajñāṃ nāśayati kriyamāṇaṃ puḥna puḥnaḥ
ce_text: pāpaṃ prajñāṃ nāśayati kriyamāṇaṃ punaḥ punaḥ / naṣṭaprajñaḥ pāpam eva nityam ārabhate naraḥ

vulgate_text: tapo damo brahmavittvaṃ titikṣā ijyā vivāhāḥ sāntvanaṃ cānnadānam / aṣṭāvete nityamevaṃ bhavanti satāṃ guṇāstāni mahākulāni
ce_text: tapo damo brahmavit tvaṃ vitānāḥ puṇyā vivāhāḥ satatānnadānam / yeṣv evaite sapta guṇā bhavanti samyag vṛttās tāni mahākulāni

vulgate_text: gobhiḥ paśubhiraśvaiśca kṛṣyā ca susamṛddhayā / kulāni na prarohanti yāni hīnāni vṛttataḥ
ce_text: kulāni samupetāni gobhiḥ puruṣato 'śvataḥ / kulasaṃkhyāṃ na gacchanti yāni hīnāni vṛttataḥ

vulgate_text: avadhyā brāhmaṇā gāvo jñātayaḥ śiśivaḥ striyaḥ yeṣāṃ cānnāni bhuñjīta ye ca syuḥka śaraṇāgatāḥ / mahatyapyaparādhe'pi teṣāṃ daṇḍo visarjanam
ce_text: avadhyā brāhmaṇā gāvaḥ striyo bālāś ca jñātayaḥ / yeṣāṃ cānnāni bhuñjīta ye ca syuḥ śaraṇāgatāḥ

vulgate_text: yaścāpi labdhvā na smarāmīti vādī dattvā ca yaḥ katthati yācyamānaḥ / yaścāsataḥ sāntvamupānayīta etānnayanti nirayaṃ pāśahastāḥ
ce_text: yaś caiva labdhvā na smarāmīty uvāca dattvā ca yaḥ katthati yācyamānaḥ / yaś cāsataḥ sāntvam upāsatīha ete 'nuyānty anilaṃ pāśahastāḥ

vulgate_text: nāparīkṣya mahīpālaḥ kuryātsacivamātmanaḥ / amātye hyarthalipsā ca mantrarakṣaṇameva ca
ce_text: nāsuhṛt paramaṃ mantraṃ bhāratārhati veditum / apaṇḍito vāpi suhṛt paṇḍito vāpy anātmavān / amātye hy arthalipsā ca mantrarakṣaṇam eva ca

vulgate_text: gūḍhamantrasya nṛpatestasya siddhirasaṃśayam apraśastāni kāryāṇi yo mohādanutiṣṭhati
ce_text: kṛtāni sarvakāryāṇi yasya vā pārṣadā viduḥ / gūḍhamantrasya nṛpates tasya siddhir asaṃśayam

vulgate_text: sa teṣāṃ viparibhraṃśādbhraśyate jīvitādapi karmaṇāṃ tu praśastānāmanuṣṭhānaṃ sukhāvaham
ce_text: apraśastāni karmāṇi yo mohād anutiṣṭhati / sa teṣāṃ viparibhraṃśe bhraśyate jīvitād api

vulgate_text: teṣāmevānanuṣṭhānaṃ paścāttāpakaraṃ matam anadhītya yathā vedānna vipraḥ śrāddhamarhati
ce_text: karmaṇāṃ tu praśastānām anuṣṭhānaṃ sukhāvaham / teṣām evānanuṣṭhānaṃ paścāttāpakaraṃ mahat

vulgate_text: evamaśrutaṣāṅguṇyo na mantraṃ śrotumarhati sthānavṛddhikṣayajñasya ṣāṅguṇyaviditātmanaḥ
ce_text: sthānavṛddhikṣayajñasya ṣāḍguṇyaviditātmanaḥ / anavajñātaśīlasya svādhīnā pṛthivī nṛpa

vulgate_text: anavajñātaśīlasya svādhīnā pṛthivī nṛpa amoghakrodhaharṣasya svayaṃ kṛtvānvavekṣiṇaḥ
ce_text: amoghakrodhaharṣasya svayaṃ kṛtyānvavekṣiṇaḥ / ātmapratyayakośasya vasudheyaṃ vasuṃdharā

vulgate_text: bhṛtyebhyo visṛjedarthānnaikaḥ sarvaharo bhavet brāhmaṇaṃ brāhmaṇo veda bhartā veda striyaṃ tathā
ce_text: nāmamātreṇa tuṣyeta chatreṇa ca mahīpatiḥ / bhṛtyebhyo visṛjed arthān naikaḥ sarvaharo bhavet

vulgate_text: amātyaṃ nṛpatirveda rājā rājānameva ca na śatrurvaśamāpanno moktavyo vadhyatāṃ gataḥ
ce_text: brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇaṃ veda bhartā veda striyaṃ tathā / amātyaṃ nṛpatir veda rājā rājānam eva ca

vulgate_text: nyagbhūtvā paryupāsīta vadhvaṃ hanyādbale sati / ahatāddhi bhayaṃ tasmājjāyate nacirādiva
ce_text: na śatrur aṅkam āpanno moktavyo vadhyatāṃ gataḥ / ahatād dhi bhayaṃ tasmāj jāyate nacirād iva

vulgate_text: na vṛddhirbahumantavyā yā vṛddhiḥ kṣayamāvahet / kṣayo'pi bahumantavyo yaḥ kṣayo vṛddhimāvahet
ce_text: na sa kṣayo mahārāja yaḥ kṣayo vṛddhim āvahet / kṣayaḥ sa tv iha mantavyo yaṃ labdhvā bahu nāśayet

vulgate_text: ye vai bhedanaśīlāstu sakāmā nistrapāḥ śaṭhāḥ / ye pāpā iti vikhyātāḥ saṃvāse pirigarhitāḥ
ce_text: ye pāpā iti vikhyātāḥ saṃvāse parigarhitāḥ / yuktāś cānyair mahādoṣair ye narās tān vivarjayet

vulgate_text: mayā cāpi hitaṃ vācyaṃ viddhi māṃ tvaddhitaiṣiṇam jñātibhirvigrahastāta na kartavyaḥ śubhārthinā / sukhāni saha bhojyāni jñātibhirbharatarṣabha
ce_text: jñātibhir vigrahas tāta na kartavyo bhavārthinā / sukhāni saha bhojyāni jñātibhir bharatarṣabha

vulgate_text: anāmnāyamalā vedā brāhmaṇasyāvrataṃ malam / malaṃ pṛthivyā vāhlīkāḥ puruṣasyānṛtaṃ malam
ce_text: anāmnāyamalā vedā brāhmaṇasyāvrataṃ malam / kautūhalamalā sādhvī vipravāsamalāḥ striyaḥ

vulgate_text: ete vai sapta doṣāḥ syuḥ sadā vidyārthināṃ matāḥ sukhārthinaḥ kuto vidyā nāsti vidyārthinaḥ sukhaṃ / sukhārthī vā tyajedvidyāṃ vidyārthī vā tyajetsukham

ce_text: utsṛjya vinivartante jñātayaḥ suhṛdaḥ sutāḥ / agnau prāstaṃ tu puruṣaṃ karmānveti svayaṃkṛtam

vulgate_text: asyādeśānniḥsarate narāṇāṃ krodhaḥ pramādo lobharūpaśca mṛtyuḥ / ahaṃ gatenaiva caranvimārgānna cātmano yogamupaiti kaścit
ce_text: āsyād eṣa niḥsarate narāṇāṃ krodhaḥ pramādo moharūpaś ca mṛtyuḥ / te mohitās tadvaśe vartamānā itaḥ pretās tatra punaḥ patanti

ce_text: tatas taṃ devā anu viplavante ato mṛtyur maraṇākhyām upaiti / karmodaye karmaphalānurāgās tatrānu yānti na taranti mṛtyum

vulgate_text: amūḍhavṛtteḥ puruṣasyeha kuryātkiṃ vai mṛtyustārṇa ivāsya vyāghraḥ / amanyamānaḥ kṣatriya kiñcidanyannādhīyate tārṇa ivāsya sarpaḥ
ce_text: amanyamānaḥ kṣatriya kiṃ cid anyan nādhīyate tārṇa ivāsya vyāghraḥ / krodhāl lobhān mohamayāntarātmā sa vai mṛtyus tvac charīre ya eṣaḥ

vulgate_text: gatvobhayaṃ karmaṇā yujyate sthiraṃ śubhasya pāpasya sa cāpi karmaṇā / dharmeṇa pāpaṃ praṇudatīha vidvān dharmo balīyāniti tatra viddhiḥ
ce_text: ubhayam eva tatropabhujyate phalaṃ dharmasyaivetarasya ca / dharmeṇādharmaṃ praṇudatīha vidvān dharmo balīyān iti tasya viddhi

vulgate_text: yeṣāṃ dharme ca vispardhā teṣāṃ jajjñānasādhanam / te brāhmaṇā ito muktāḥ svargaṃ yānti triviṣṭapam
ce_text: yeṣāṃ bale na vispardhā bale balavatām iva / te brāhmaṇā itaḥ pretya svargaloke prakāśate

vulgate_text: yo vā kathayamānasya hyātmānaṃ nānusaṃjvaret brahmasvaṃ nopabhuñjīta tadannaṃ saṃmataṃ satām / kuśavalkalacelādyaṃ brahmasvaṃ yogino viduḥ
ce_text: yo vākathayamānasya ātmānaṃ nānusaṃjvaret / brahmasvaṃ nopabhuñjed vā tadannaṃ saṃmataṃ satām

vulgate_text: kohyevamantarātmānaṃ brāhmaṇo hantumarhati / nirliṅgamacalaṃ śuddhaṃ sarvadvandvavivarjitam
ce_text: ko hy evam antarātmānaṃ brāhmaṇo hantum arhati / tasmād dhi kiṃ cit kṣatriya brahmāvasati paśyati

vulgate_text: anāḍhyā mānuṣe vitte āḍhyā daive tathā kratau / te durdharṣā duṣprakampyāstānvidyādbrahmaṇastanum

ce_text: yuddhāya kṣatriyaḥ sṛṣṭaḥ saṃjayeha jayāya ca / krūrāya karmaṇe nityaṃ prajānāṃ paripālane / jayan vā vadhyamāno vā prāpnotīndrasalokatām

vulgate_text: kirātā barbarāḥ siddhā vaidehāstāmraliptakāḥ / oṇḍrā mlecchāḥ saisiridhrāḥ pārvatīyāśca māriṣa
ce_text: kacchā gopālakacchāś ca lāṅgalāḥ paravallakāḥ / kirātā barbarāḥ siddhā videhās tāmraliṅgakāḥ

vulgate_text: karṇāṭakā mahiṣakā vikalpā mūṣakāstathā / jhillikāḥ kuntalāścaiva sauhṛdānabhakānanāḥ
ce_text: draviḍāḥ keralāḥ prācyā bhūṣikā vanavāsinaḥ / unnatyakā māhiṣakā vikalpā mūṣakās tathā

vulgate_text: dhvajinyutsavasaṃketāstrigartāḥ sālvasenayaḥ / vyūkāḥ kokabakāḥ proṣṭhāḥ sarmavegavaśāstathā
ce_text: samaṅgāḥ kopanāś caiva kukurāṅgadamāriṣāḥ / dhvajiny utsavasaṃketās trigartāḥ sarvasenayaḥ

vulgate_text: kulindāḥ kāladāścaiva kuṇḍalāḥ karaṭāstathā / mūṣakāstanabālāśca sanīpā ghaṭasṛñjayāḥ
ce_text: mālakā mallakāś caiva tathaivāparavartakāḥ / kulindāḥ kulakāś caiva karaṇṭhāḥ kurakās tathā

vulgate_text: aṭhidāḥ pāśivāṭāśca tanayāḥ sunayāstathā / ṛṣikā vidabhāḥ kākāstaṅgaṇāḥ parataṅgaṇāḥ
ce_text: hṛṣīvidarbhāḥ kāntīkās taṅgaṇāḥ parataṅgaṇāḥ / uttarāś cāpare mlecchā janā bharatasattama

vulgate_text: sakṛdgrahāḥ kulatthāśca hūṇāḥ pārasikaiḥ saha / tathaiva ramaṇāścīnāstathaiva daśamālikāḥ
ce_text: tathaiva maradhāś cīnās tathaiva daśamālikāḥ / kṣatriyopaniveśāś ca vaiśyaśūdrakulāni ca

vulgate_text: khāśīrāścāntacārāśca pahlavā girigahvarāḥ / ātreyāḥ sabharadvājāstathaiva stanapoṣikāḥ
ce_text: śūdrābhīrātha daradāḥ kāśmīrāḥ paśubhiḥ saha / khaśikāś ca tukhārāś ca pallavā girigahvarāḥ

vulgate_text: ete cānye janapadāḥ prācyodīcyāstathaiva ca / uddeśamātreṇa mayā deśāḥ saṃkīrtitā vibho
ce_text: tāmarā haṃsamārgāś ca tathaiva karabhañjakāḥ / uddeśamātreṇa mayā deśāḥ saṃkīrtitāḥ prabho

vulgate_text: mahābalā mahāsatvāḥ prajñāguṇasamanvitāḥ / prajāyante ca jātāśca śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ
ce_text: mahābalā mahāsattvāḥ prajāguṇasamanvitāḥ / ajāyanta kṛte rājan munayaḥ sutapodhanāḥ

vulgate_text: jātāḥ kṛtayuge rājandhaninaḥ prayadarśanāḥ / prajāyante ca jātāśca munayo vai tapodhanāḥ
ce_text: mahotsāhā mahātmāno dhārmikāḥ satyavādinaḥ / jātāḥ kṛtayuge rājan dhaninaḥ priyadarśanāḥ

vulgate_text: mahotsāhā mahātmāno dhārmikāḥ satyavādinaḥ / priyadarśanā vapuṣmanto mahāvīryā dhanurdharāḥ
ce_text: mahotsāhā mahātmāno dhārmikāḥ satyavādinaḥ / jātāḥ kṛtayuge rājan dhaninaḥ priyadarśanāḥ

vulgate_text: varārhā yudhi jāyante kṣatriyāḥ śūrasattamāḥ / tretāyāṃ kṣatriyā rājansarve vai cakravartinaḥ
ce_text: āyuṣmanto mahāvīrā dhanurdharavarā yudhi / jāyante kṣatriyāḥ śūrās tretāyāṃ cakravartinaḥ

vulgate_text: sarvavarṇāśca jāyante sadā caiva ca dvāpare / mahotsāhā vīryavantaḥ parasparajayaiṣiṇaḥ
ce_text: sarvavarṇā mahārāja jāyante dvāpare sati / mahotsāhā mahāvīryāḥ parasparavadhaiṣiṇaḥ

vulgate_text: kṣīrodo bharataśreṣṭha yena saṃparivāritāḥ tatra puṇyā janapadāstatra na mriyate janaḥ / kuta eva hi durbhikṣaṃ kṣamātejoyutā hi te
ce_text: tatra puṇyā janapadā na tatra mriyate janaḥ / kuta eva hi durbhikṣaṃ kṣamātejoyutā hi te

vulgate_text: śyāmo yasmātpravṛtto vai tasmācchyāmo giriḥsmṛtaḥ
ce_text: śyāmo yasmāt pravṛtto vai tat te vakṣyāmi bhārata / āste 'tra bhagavān kṛṣṇas tat kāntyā śyāmatāṃ gataḥ

vulgate_text: tatra ratnāni divyāni svayaṃ rakṣati keśavaḥ / prasannaścābhavattatra prajānāṃ vyadadhatsukham
ce_text: tatra ratnāni divyāni svayaṃ rakṣati keśavaḥ / prajāpatim upāsīnaḥ prajānāṃ vidadhe sukham

vulgate_text: akarodduṣkaraṃ karma raṇe pāṇḍusuteṣu yaḥ / grasamānamanīkāni ya enaṃ paryavārayan
ce_text: grasamānam anīkāni ya enaṃ paryavārayan / kṛtinaṃ taṃ durādharṣaṃ samyag yāsyantam antike / kathaṃ śāṃtanavaṃ yuddhe pāṇḍavāḥ pratyavārayan

vulgate_text: gadāsimakarāvāsaṃ hayāvarttaṃ gajākulam / padātimatsyakalilaṃ śaṅkhadundubhiniḥsvanam
ce_text: iṣvastrasāgaraṃ ghoraṃ bāṇagrāhaṃ durāsadam / kārmukormiṇam akṣayyam advīpaṃ samare 'plavam / gadāsimakarāvartaṃ hayagrāhaṃ gajākulam

vulgate_text: yasmijjāte mahāvīrye śāntanurlokaviśrutaḥ / śokaṃ dainyaṃ ca duḥsvaṃ ca prājahātsa ca tatkṣaṇe
ce_text: yasmiñ jāte mahāvīrye śaṃtanur lokaśaṃkare / śokaṃ duḥkhaṃ ca dainyaṃ ca prājahāt putralakṣmaṇi

vulgate_text: prāṇadyūte pratibhaye ke'dīvyanta nararṣabhāḥ ke jīyante jitāstatra kṛtalakṣyā nipātitāḥ / anye bhīṣmāccāntanavāttanmamācakṣva sañjaya
ce_text: ke 'jayan ke jitās tatra hṛtalakṣā nipātitāḥ / anye bhīṣmāc chāṃtanavāt tan mamācakṣva saṃjaya

vulgate_text: na hi me śāntirastīha śrutvā devavrataṃ hatam / pitaraṃ bhīmakarmāṇaṃ bhīṣmamāhavaśobhinam
ce_text: na hi me śāntir astīha yudhi devavrataṃ hatam / pitaraṃ bhīmakarmāṇaṃ śrutvā me duḥkham āviśat

vulgate_text: rājendra tava putrāṇāṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ tathaiva ca / duṣpradhṛṣyāṇi cāstrāṇi saśasrakavacāni ca
ce_text: udatiṣṭhan mahārāja sarvaṃ yuktam aśeṣataḥ / sūryodaye mahat sainyaṃ kurupāṇḍavasenayoḥ / tava rājendra putrāṇāṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ tathaiva ca

vulgate_text: kṣemadhanvā ca śalyaśca tasthuḥ pramukhato rathāḥ syandanena mahārheṇa ketunā vṛṣabheṇa ca / prakarṣanneva senāgnaṃ māgadhasya kṛpo yayau
ce_text: syandanena mahārheṇa ketunā vṛṣabheṇa ca / prakarṣann iva senāgraṃ māgadhaś ca nṛpo yayau

vulgate_text: kuruyodhavarā rājanvicitrāyudhakārmukāḥ / udyatairāyuthaiścitraistalabaddhāḥ patākinaḥ
ce_text: udyatair āyudhaiś citrais talabaddhāḥ patākinaḥ / ṛṣabhākṣā maheṣvāsāś camūmukhagatā babhuḥ

vulgate_text: bhīmasenaṃ tadā rājandarśayasva mahābalam / kekayā dhṛṣṭaketuśca cekitānaśca vīryavān
ce_text: kekayā dhṛṣṭaketuś ca cekitānaś ca vīryavān / eta tiṣṭhanti sāmātyāḥ prekṣakās te nareśvara

vulgate_text: ete gacchantu sāmātyāḥ prakarṣanto janādhipa / dhṛtarāṣṭrasya dāyādāniti bībhatsurabravīt
ce_text: dhṛtarāṣṭrasya dāyādā iti bībhatsur abravīt / bruvāṇaṃ tu tathā pārthaṃ sarvasainyāni māriṣa / apūjayaṃs tadā vāgbhir anukūlābhir āhave

vulgate_text: pṛṣṭhato'pyarjunasyāsīdyuyudhāno mahābalaḥ / cakrarakṣau tu pāñcālyau yudhāmanyūttamojasau
ce_text: pṛṣṭhagopo 'rjunasyāpi yuyudhāno mahārathaḥ / cakrarakṣau tu pāñcālyau yudhāmanyūttamaujasau

vulgate_text: akṣauhiṇyātha pāñcālyo yajñaseno mahāmanāḥ virāṭamanvayātpaścātpāṇḍavārthaṃ parākramī - - ateṣāmādityacandrābhāḥ kanakottamabhūṣaṇāḥ nānācihnadharā rājanratheṣvāsanmahādhvajāḥ
ce_text: akṣauhiṇyā ca pāñcālyo yajñaseno mahāmanāḥ / virāṭam anvayāt paścāt pāṇḍavārthe parākramī

vulgate_text: kṣaranta iva jīmūtā mahārhāḥ padmagandhinaḥ / rājānamanvayuḥ yaścājjīmūtā iva vārṣikāḥ
ce_text: kṣaranta iva jīmūtā madārdrāḥ padmagandhinaḥ / rājānam anvayuḥ paścāc calanta iva parvatāḥ

vulgate_text: atha saṃnahyamāneṣu sainyeṣu bharatarṣabha / niṣprabho'bhyudyayau sūryaḥ saghoṣaṃ bhūścacāla ca
ce_text: atha sajjīyamāneṣu sainyeṣu bharatarṣabha / niṣprabho 'bhyudiyāt sūryaḥ saghoṣo bhūś cacāla ha / vyaśīryata sanādā ca tadā bharatasattama

vulgate_text: mahārathairvaṣṇibhojaiḥ suguptaṃ surāṣṭrakairviditairāttaśastraiḥ / bṛhadbalaṃ kṛtavarmābhiguptaṃ balaṃ tvadīyaṃ dakṣiṇenābhiyāti
ce_text: mahārathair andhakavṛṣṇibhojaiḥ saurāṣṭrakair nairṛtair āttaśastraiḥ / bṛhadbalaḥ kṛtavarmābhigupto balaṃ tvadīyaṃ dakṣiṇato 'bhipāti

vulgate_text: tvaktvā'dharmaṃ tathā sarve dharmaṃ cottamamāsthitāḥ / yudhyadhvamatahaṃkārā yato dharmastato jayaḥ
ce_text: tyaktvādharmaṃ ca lobhaṃ ca mohaṃ codyamam āsthitāḥ / yudhyadhvam anahaṃkārā yato dharmas tato jayaḥ

vulgate_text: vāditraśabdastumulaḥ śaṅkhabherīvimiśritaḥ / śūrāṇāṃ raṇaśūrāṇāṃ garjatāmitaretaram
ce_text: vāditraśabdas tumulaḥ śaṅkhabherīvimiśritaḥ / kuñjarāṇāṃ ca nadatāṃ sainyānāṃ ca prahṛṣyatām

vulgate_text: ubhayoḥ senayo rājanmahānvyatikaro'bhavat anyonyaṃ vīkṣamāṇānāṃ yodhānāṃ bharatarṣabha / kuñjarāṇāṃ ca nadatāṃ sainyānāṃ ca prahṛṣyatām
ce_text: vāditraśabdas tumulaḥ śaṅkhabherīvimiśritaḥ / kuñjarāṇāṃ ca nadatāṃ sainyānāṃ ca prahṛṣyatām

vulgate_text: dṛṣṭvā yudhiṣṭhiraṃ dūrāddhārtarāṣṭrasya sainikāḥ mithaḥ saṃkathayāṃcakrureṣo hi kulapāṃsanaḥ - - avyaktaṃ bhīta ivābhyeti rājāsau bhīṣmamantikam yudhiṣṭhiraḥ sasodaryaḥ śaraṇārthaṃ prayācakaḥ
ce_text: vyaktaṃ bhīta ivābhyeti rājāsau bhīṣmam antikāt / yudhiṣṭhiraḥ sasodaryaḥ śaraṇārthaṃ prayācakaḥ

vulgate_text: anumānaye tvāṃ durdharṣa yotsye vigatakalmaṣaḥ / jayeyaṃ nu parānrājannanujñātastvayā ripūn
ce_text: anumānaye tvāṃ yotsyāmi guro vigatakalmaṣaḥ / jayeyaṃ ca mahārāja anujñātas tvayā ripūn

vulgate_text: kurūṇāṃ sṛñjayānāṃ ca jigīṣūṇāṃ parasparam / siṃhānāmiva saṃhrādo divamurvī ca nādayan
ce_text: kurūṇāṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ ca saṃgrāme vijigīṣatām / siṃhānām iva saṃhrādo divam urvīṃ ca nādayan

vulgate_text: sahadevastato vīro durmukhasya mahāraṇe śareṇa bhṛtaśīkṣṇena pātayāmāsa sārathim - - atāvanyonyaṃ samāsādya samare yuddhadurmadau - - btrāsayetāṃ śarairghoraiḥ kṛtapratikṛtaiṣiṇau
ce_text: tāv anyonyaṃ samāsādya samare yuddhadurmadau / trāsayetāṃ śarair ghoraiḥ kṛtapratikṛtaiṣiṇau

vulgate_text: tridhā ciccheda samare pāñcālyasya tu kārmukam / śaraṃ caiva mahāghoraṃ kāladaṇḍamivāparam
ce_text: śaraṃ caiva mahāghoraṃ kāladaṇḍam ivāparam / preṣayām āsa samare so 'sya kāye nyamajjata

vulgate_text: tathaiva śaravarṣeṇa ulūkaṃ samaviddhyata / ulūkaścāpi taṃ bāṇairniśitairlomavāhibhiḥ
ce_text: cedirāṭ samare rājann ulūkaṃ samabhidravat / ulūkaś cāpi taṃ bāṇair niśitair lomavāhibhiḥ

vulgate_text: prabhinnairapi saṃsaktāḥ kecittatra mahāgajāḥ / krauñcavanninadaṃ kṛtvā dudruvuḥ sarvato diśam
ce_text: prabhinnair api saṃsaktāḥ ke cit tatra mahāgajāḥ / krauñcavan ninadaṃ muktvā prādravanta tatas tataḥ

vulgate_text: aśvārohaiśca samare hastisādibhireva ca pratimāneṣu gātreṣu pārśvaṣvabhi ca vāraṇān / āśugā vimalāstīkṣṇāḥ saṃpeturbhujagopamāḥ
ce_text: tair vimuktā mahāprāsā jāmbūnadavibhūṣaṇāḥ / āśugā vimalās tīkṣṇāḥ saṃpetur bhujagopamāḥ

vulgate_text: sa śirāṃsi raṇe'rīṇāṃ rathāṃśca sayugadhvajān / nicakarta mahāvegairbhallaiḥ sannataparvabhiḥ
ce_text: śirāṃsi ca tadā bhīṣmo bāhūṃś cāpi sahāyudhān / nicakarta mahāvegair bhallaiḥ saṃnataparvabhiḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ śarasahasreṇa saubhadraṃ pratitāmahaḥ / avākiradameyātmā tadadbhutamivābhavat
ce_text: tataḥ śatasahasreṇa saubhadraṃ prapitāmahaḥ / avākirad ameyātmā śarāṇāṃ nataparvaṇām

vulgate_text: śikhaṇḍinaṃ puraskṛtya trātumaicchanmahārathāḥ / abhyavartanta bhīṣmasya rathaṃ hemapariṣkṛtam
ce_text: taṃ sātyakir bhīmaseno dhṛṣṭadyumnaś ca pārṣataḥ / abhyadravanta bhīṣmasya rathaṃ hemapariṣkṛtam

vulgate_text: tena tena sma dṛśyante dhāvamānāḥ samaṃtataḥ / gajo hataḥ śiraśchinnaṃ marma bhinnaṃ hayo hataḥ
ce_text: virathā rathinaś cānye dhāvamānāḥ samantataḥ / tatra tatraiva dṛśyante sāyudhāḥ sāṅgadair bhujaiḥ

vulgate_text: vyāghrāviva susaṃrabdhāvanyonyamabhijaghnatuḥ / astrairastrāṇi saṃvārya tatastau puruṣarṣabhau
ce_text: tau tatra samare hṛṣṭau kṛtapratikṛtaiṣiṇau / anyonyaṃ viśikhais tīkṣṇair jaghnatuḥ puruṣarṣabhau

vulgate_text: nigṛhya kārmukaṃ śveto bhīṣmaṃ vivyādha saptabhiḥ / parākramaṃ tatastasya parākramya parākramī
ce_text: amarṣitas tato rājan parākramya camūmukhe / droṇo drupadaputrasya punaś ciccheda kārmukam

vulgate_text: sahitāstvabhyavartanta parīpsanto mahārathāḥ / sātyakirbhīmasenaśca dhṛṣṭadyumnaśca pārṣataḥ
ce_text: taṃ sātyakir bhīmaseno dhṛṣṭadyumnaś ca pārṣataḥ / abhyadravanta bhīṣmasya rathaṃ hemapariṣkṛtam

vulgate_text: avahāraṃ śanaiścakrurnihate vāhinīpatau / tato'vahāraḥ sainyānāṃ tava teṣāṃ ca bhārata
ce_text: tato 'vahāraḥ sainyānāṃ tava teṣāṃ ca bhārata / astaṃ gacchati sūrye 'bhūt saṃdhyākāle ca vartati

vulgate_text: gatapūrvāhṇabhūyiṣṭhe tasminnahani dāruṇe / tāvakānāṃ pareṣāṃ ca punaryuddhamavartata
ce_text: gatapūrvāhṇabhūyiṣṭhe tasminn ahani dāruṇe / vartamāne mahāraudre mahāvīravarakṣaye

vulgate_text: śvetaṃ tu nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā virāṭasya camūpatim / kṛtavarmaṇā ca sahitaṃ dṛṣṭvā śalyamavasthitam
ce_text: uttaraṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā vairāṭir bhrātaraṃ śubham / kṛtavarmaṇā ca sahitaṃ dṛṣṭvā śalyam avasthitam / śaṅkhaḥ krodhāt prajajvāla haviṣā havyavāḍ iva

vulgate_text: abhyadhāvajjighāṃsanvai śalyaṃ madrādhipaṃ yudhi / mahatā rathasaṅghena samantātparirakṣitaḥ
ce_text: sa visphārya mahac cāpaṃ kārtasvaravibhūṣitam / abhyadhāvaj jighāṃsan vai śalyaṃ madrādhipaṃ balī

vulgate_text: śokārtaṃ tamatho jñātvā duḥkhopahatacetasam abravīttatra govindo harṣayansarvapāṇḍavān - - amāśuco bharataśreṣṭa na tvaṃ śocitumarhasi yasya te bhrātaraḥ śūrāḥ sarvalokeṣu dhanvinaḥka
ce_text: mā śuco bharataśreṣṭha na tvaṃ śocitum arhasi / yasya te bhrātaraḥ śūrāḥ sarvalokasya dhanvinaḥ

vulgate_text: śikhaṇḍī ca mahābāho bhīṣmasya nidhanaṃ kila etacchrutvā tato dharmo dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ mahāratham / abravītsamitau tasyāṃ vāsudevasya śrṛṇvataḥ
ce_text: etac chrutvā tato rājā dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ mahāratham / abravīt samitau tasyāṃ vāsudevasya śṛṇvataḥ

vulgate_text: mārutā dhenukāścaiva taṃgamāḥ parataṃgaṇāḥ / bāhlikāstittirāścaiva colāḥ pāṇḍyāśca bhārata
ce_text: bāhlikās tittirāś caiva colāḥ pāṇḍyāś ca bhārata / ete janapadā rājan dakṣiṇaṃ pakṣam āśritāḥ

vulgate_text: ete janapadā rājandakṣiṇaṃ pakṣamāśritāḥ / agniveśāstudduṇḍāśca mālavā dānabhārayaḥ
ce_text: bāhlikās tittirāś caiva colāḥ pāṇḍyāś ca bhārata / ete janapadā rājan dakṣiṇaṃ pakṣam āśritāḥ

vulgate_text: tathā vyūḍheṣvanīkeṣu sannaddharuciradhvajāḥ tāvakāḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ sārdhaṃ yathā'yudhyanta tacchṛṇu / apāramiva saṃdṛśya sāgarapratimaṃ balam
ce_text: samaṃ vyūḍheṣv anīkeṣu saṃnaddhā ruciradhvajāḥ / apāram iva saṃdṛśya sāgarapratimaṃ balam

vulgate_text: prāyāccharaṇadaḥ śīghraṃ suhṛdāṃ harṣavardhanaḥ / tamāpatantaṃ vegena prabhinnamiva vāraṇam
ce_text: tam āpatantaṃ vegena prabhinnam iva vāraṇam / trāsayānaṃ raṇe śūrān pātayantaṃ ca sāyakaiḥ

vulgate_text: tato bhīṣmo mahārāja sarvalokamahārathaḥ / arjunaṃ saptatasaptatyā nārācānāṃ samācinot
ce_text: tato bhīṣmo mahārāja kauravāṇāṃ pitāmahaḥ / arjunaṃ saptasaptatyā nārācānāṃ samāvṛṇot

vulgate_text: tato'rjuno bhṛśaṃ kruddho nirviddhaṃ prekṣya mādhavam / sārathiṃ kuruvṛddhasya nirbibheda śitaiḥ śaraiḥ
