vulgate_text: poyayanrathabṛndāni vājibṛndani cābhibhūḥ / karṣayanrathavṛndāni bāhuvegena pāṇḍavaḥ
ce_text: tataḥ śaikyāyasīṃ gurvīṃ pragṛhya mahatīṃ gadām / avadhīt tāvakān yodhān daṇḍapāṇir ivāntakaḥ / pothayan rathavṛndāni vājivṛndāni cābhibhūḥ

vulgate_text: vinidhranyacatatsaṅkhye yugānte kālavidvibhuḥ / ūruvegena saṃkarṣanrathajālāni pāṇḍavaḥ
ce_text: ūruvegena saṃkarṣan rathajālāni pāṇḍavaḥ / pramardayan gajān sarvān naḍvalānīva kuñjaraḥ

vulgate_text: balāni saṃmamardāśu naḍvalānīva kuñjaraḥ / mṛdganrathebhyo rathino gajebhyo gajayodhinaḥ
ce_text: mṛdnan rathebhyo rathino gajebhyo gajayodhinaḥ / sādinaś cāśvapṛṣṭhebhyo bhūmau caiva padātinaḥ

vulgate_text: sādinaścāśvapṛṣṭhebhyo bhūmau vāpi padātinaḥ / gadayā vyavamatsarvānvāto vṛkṣānivaujasā
ce_text: mṛdnan rathebhyo rathino gajebhyo gajayodhinaḥ / sādinaś cāśvapṛṣṭhebhyo bhūmau caiva padātinaḥ

vulgate_text: adṛśyata mahāraudrā gadā nāgāśvapātanī / tatratatra hataiścāpi manuṣyagajavājibhiḥ
ce_text: tatra tatra hataiś cāpi manuṣyagajavājibhiḥ / raṇāṅgaṇaṃ tad abhavan mṛtyor āghātasaṃnibham

vulgate_text: avidhyadenaṃ daśabhiḥ pṛṣatkaiḥralambuso rākṣaso'sau tadānīm / śaraiścaturbhiḥ pratividdhya taṃ ca naptā śinerabhyapatadrathena
ce_text: avidhyad enaṃ niśitaiḥ śarāgrair alambuso rājavarārśyaśṛṅgiḥ / taṃ vai caturbhiḥ pratividhya vīro naptā śiner abhyapatad rathena

vulgate_text: na tatra kaścinnaviṣaṇṇa āsīdṛte rājansomadattasya putrāt / sa vai samādāya dhanurmahātmā bhiriśravā bhārata saumadattiḥ
ce_text: nāśaknuvan vārayituṃ variṣṭhaṃ madhyaṃdine sūryam ivātapantam / na tatra kaś cinn aviṣaṇṇa āsīd ṛte rājan somadattasya putrāt

vulgate_text: vivyādha viśikhaiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ kaṅkapatraiḥ śilāśitaiḥ / duryodhanastadā rājanbhīmasenaṃ mahāratham
ce_text: rathair anekasāhasraiḥ krodhāmarṣasamanvitaḥ / nandakas tava putras tu bhīmasenaṃ mahābalam / vivyādha niśitaiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ kaṅkapatraiḥ śilāśitaiḥ

vulgate_text: māmeva bhṛśasaṃkruddhā hantumabhyudyatā yudhi / manorathadrumo'smākaṃ cintito bahuvārṣikaḥ
ce_text: ete mahārathāḥ śūrā dhārtarāṣṭrā mahābalāḥ / mām eva bhṛśasaṃkruddhā hantum abhyudyatā yudhi

vulgate_text: bhrātaraścāsya sannaddhāḥ kulaputrā madotkaṭāḥ / etānadya haniṣyāmi paśyataste na saṃśayaḥ
ce_text: etān adya haniṣyāmi paśyatas te na saṃśayaḥ / tasmān mamāśvān saṃgrāme yattaḥ saṃyaccha sārathe

vulgate_text: tasmānmamāśvānsaṃgrame yattaḥ saṃyaccha sārathe / evamuktvā tataḥ pārthastava putraṃ viśāṃpate
ce_text: etān adya haniṣyāmi paśyatas te na saṃśayaḥ / tasmān mamāśvān saṃgrāme yattaḥ saṃyaccha sārathe

vulgate_text: so'paviddhya dhanuśchinnaṃ putraste krodhamūrcchitaḥ / anyatkārmukamādatta satvaraṃ vegavattaram
ce_text: so 'pavidhya dhanuś chinnaṃ krodhena prajvalann iva / anyat kārmukam ādatta satvaraṃ vegavattaram

vulgate_text: abhipatya mahābāhurgarutmāniva vegitaḥ / senāpateḥ kṣurapreṇa śiraściccheda pāṇḍavaḥ
ce_text: putrāṃs tu tava saṃprekṣya bhīmaseno mahābalaḥ / sṛkkiṇī vilihan vīraḥ paśumadhye vṛko yathā / senāpateḥ kṣurapreṇa śiraś ciccheda pāṇḍavaḥ

vulgate_text: saṃprahasya ca hṛṣṭātmā tribhirbāṇairmahābhujaḥ / jalasandhaṃ vinirbhidya so'nayadyamasādanam
ce_text: jalasaṃdhaṃ vinirbhidya so 'nayad yamasādanam / suṣeṇaṃ ca tato hatvā preṣayām āsa mṛtyave

vulgate_text: nināya samare vīraḥ paralokāya pāṇḍavaḥ / bhīmaṃ bhīmarathaṃ cobhau bhīmaseno hasanniva
ce_text: bhīmaṃ bhīmarathaṃ cobhau bhīmaseno hasann iva / bhrātarau rabhasau rājann anayad yamasādanam

vulgate_text: putrau te durmadau rājannanayadyamasādanam / tataḥ sulocanaṃ bhīmaḥ kṣurapreṇa mahāmṛdhe
ce_text: tataḥ sulocanaṃ bhīmaḥ kṣurapreṇa mahāmṛdhe / miṣatāṃ sarvasainyānām anayad yamasādanam

vulgate_text: sa śastravṛṣṭyā'bhihataḥ samastaistairmahārathaiḥ / prāgjyotiṣagajo rājannānāliṅgaiḥ sutejanaiḥ
ce_text: sa śastravṛṣṭyābhihataḥ prādravad dviguṇaṃ padam / prāgjyotiṣagajo rājan nānāliṅgaiḥ sutejanaiḥ

vulgate_text: ājaghāna mahārāja śareṇānataparvaṇā so'tividdho maheṣvāsastena rājñā mahārathaḥ
ce_text: so 'tividdho maheṣvāsas tena rājñā mahārathaḥ / mūrchayābhiparītāṅgo dhvajayaṣṭim upāśritaḥ

vulgate_text: mūrcchayā'bhiparītātmā dhvajayaṣṭiṃ samāśrayat / tāṃstu bhītānsamālakṣya bhīmasenaṃ ca mūrcchitam
ce_text: tāṃs tu bhītān samālakṣya bhīmasenaṃ ca mūrchitam / nanāda balavan nādaṃ bhagadattaḥ pratāpavān

vulgate_text: adṛśyata nimeṣārdhāddhorarūpaṃ samāsthitaḥ / airāvataṃ samārūḍhaḥ sa vai māyākṛtaṃ svayam
ce_text: sa kṛtvā dāruṇāṃ māyāṃ bhīrūṇāṃ bhayavardhinīm / adṛśyata nimeṣārdhād ghorarūpaṃ samāśritaḥ

vulgate_text: bhīṣmasya tadvacaḥ śrutvā sarva eva mahārathāḥ / droṇabhīṣmau puraskṛtya bhagadattaparīpsayā
ce_text: bhīṣmasya tad vacaḥ śrutvā bhāradvājapurogamāḥ / sahitāḥ sarvarājāno bhagadattaparīpsayā / uttamaṃ javam āsthāya prayayur yatra so 'bhavat

vulgate_text: idānīṃ yudhi nirjetuṃ na śakyo'sau sa rākṣasaḥ astamabhyeti savitā rātrau yoddhuṃ kana śakyate / avahāramataḥ kurmaḥ śvo yotsyāmaḥ parai saha
ce_text: tan na me rocate yuddhaṃ pāṇḍavair jitakāśibhiḥ / ghuṣyatām avahāro 'dya śvo yotsyāmaḥ paraiḥ saha

vulgate_text: kauraveṣu nivṛtteṣu pāṇḍavā jitakāśinaḥ / siṃhanādānbhṛśaṃ cakruḥ śaṅkhāndadhmuśca bhārata
ce_text: kauraveṣu nivṛtteṣu pāṇḍavā jitakāśinaḥ / siṃhanādam akurvanta śaṅkhaveṇusvanaiḥ saha

vulgate_text: dharmeṇa sarvakāryāṇi jīvitādīni bhārata / ārabhante sadā pārthāḥ prārthayānā mahadyaśaḥ
ce_text: yudhyanti te yathānyāyaṃ śaktimantaś ca saṃyuge / dharmeṇa sarvakāryāṇi kīrtitānīti bhārata / ārabhante sadā pārthāḥ prārthayānā mahad yaśaḥ

vulgate_text: tasya pāpasya satataṃ kriyamāṇasya karmaṇaḥ / sāṃprataṃ sumahaddhoraṃ phalaṃ prāptaṃ janeśvara
ce_text: tasya pāpasya satataṃ kriyamāṇasya karmaṇaḥ / saṃprāptaṃ sumahad ghoraṃ phalaṃ kiṃpākasaṃnibham / sa tad bhuṅkṣva mahārāja saputraḥ sasuhṛjjanaḥ

vulgate_text: tasyāhamagrajaḥ putraḥ sarvasya jagataḥ prabhuḥ / vāsudevo'rcanīyo vaḥ sarvalokamaheśvaraḥ
ce_text: tasyāham ātmajo brahmā sarvasya jagataḥ patiḥ / vāsudevo 'rcanīyo vaḥ sarvalokamaheśvaraḥ

vulgate_text: apsu vai śayanaṃ cakre mahātmā puruṣottamaḥ / sarvadevamayo devaḥ śayānaḥ śayane sukham
ce_text: sa sṛṣṭvā pṛthivīṃ devaḥ sarvalokeśvaraḥ prabhuḥ / apsu vai śayanaṃ cakre mahātmā puruṣottamaḥ / sarvatoyamayo devo yogāt suṣvāpa tatra ha

vulgate_text: tamugramugrakarmāṇamugrāṃ buddhaiṃ samāsthitam harantaṃ brahmaṇo vedāñjaghāna brahmaṇaḥ pitā / brahmaṇopacitiṃ kurvanmahātmā puruṣottamaḥ
ce_text: karṇasrotodbhavaṃ cāpi madhuṃ nāma mahāsuram / tam ugram ugrakarmāṇam ugrāṃ buddhiṃ samāsthitam / brahmaṇo 'pacitiṃ kurvañ jaghāna puruṣottamaḥ

vulgate_text: stavaṃ vai brahmasaṃyuktaṃ śṛṇu kṛṣṇasya bhārata / brahmarṣibhiśca devaiśca yaḥ purā kathito bhuvi
ce_text: śṛṇu cedaṃ mahārāja brahmabhūtastavaṃ mama / brahmarṣibhiś ca devaiś ca yaḥ purā kathito bhuvi

vulgate_text: devānāmapi devaṃ ca tvāmāha bhagavānbhṛguḥ / purāṇāṃ caiva paramaṃ viṣṇo rūpaṃ taveti ca
ce_text: yajñānāṃ caiva yajñaṃ tvāṃ tapaś ca tapasām api / devānām api devaṃ ca tvām āha bhagavān bhṛguḥ / purāṇe bhairavaṃ rūpaṃ viṣṇo bhūtapateti vai

vulgate_text: tāndṛṣṭvā'bhyudyatānsaṅkhye pāṇḍavā hi yaśasvinaḥ / śyenavyūhena saṃvyūhya samanahyanta saṃyuge
ce_text: tān dṛṣṭvā prodyatān saṃkhye pāṇḍavāś ca yaśasvinaḥ / śyenena vyūharājena tenājayyena saṃyuge

vulgate_text: kimu pāṇḍusutākanyuddhe hīnavīryaparākramān / sa tathā kuru bhadraṃ te yathā vadhyanti pāṇḍavāḥ
ce_text: devān api raṇe jetuṃ prārthayāmo na saṃśayaḥ / kim u pāṇḍusutān yuddhe hīnavīryaparākramān

vulgate_text: evamuktastato droṇastava putreṇa māriṣa / tatra saṃprekṣya rājanaṃ saṃkruddha iva niścasan
ce_text: evam uktas tato droṇas tava putreṇa māriṣa / abhinat pāṇḍavānīkaṃ prekṣamāṇasya sātyakeḥ

vulgate_text: yathābalaṃ yathāvīryaṃ karma kuryāmahaṃ hi te ityuktavā te sutaṃ rājannabhyapadyata vāhinīm / abhinatpāṇḍavānīkaṃ prekṣamāṇasya sātyakeḥ
ce_text: evam uktas tato droṇas tava putreṇa māriṣa / abhinat pāṇḍavānīkaṃ prekṣamāṇasya sātyakeḥ

vulgate_text: sātyakistu tato drauṇaṃ vārayāmāta bhārata / tayoḥ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ ghorarūpaṃ bhayāvaham
ce_text: sātyakis tu tadā droṇaṃ vārayām āsa bhārata / tataḥ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ tumulaṃ lomaharṣaṇam

vulgate_text: tadyuddhamabhavaddhoraṃ devānāṃ dānavairiva / jayamākāṅkṣatāṃ saṅkṣye yaśaśca sumahādbhutam
ce_text: tad yuddham abhavad ghoraṃ devānāṃ dānavair iva / jayaṃ ca kāṅkṣatāṃ nityaṃ yaśaś ca paramādbhutam

vulgate_text: babhramuḥ kuñjarāścātra śarairviddhā niraṅkuśāḥ / aśvāśca paryadhāvanta hatārohā diśo daśa
ce_text: krośanti kuñjarās tatra śaravarṣapratāpitāḥ / tāvakānāṃ pareṣāṃ ca saṃyuge bharatottama / aśvāś ca paryadhāvanta hatārohā diśo daśa

vulgate_text: patitaiḥ pātyamānaiśca viceṣṭadbhiśca bhūtale / ghoramāyodhanaṃ jajñe tatratatra janeśvara
ce_text: rathibhir vāraṇair aśvaiḥ padātaiś ca samīritam / ghoram āyodhanaṃ jajñe mahābhrasadṛśaṃ rajaḥ

vulgate_text: siṃhalāṅgūlamākāśe jvalantamiva parvatam / asañjamānaṃ vṛkṣeṣu dhūmaketumivotthitam
ce_text: asajjamānaṃ vṛkṣeṣu dhūmaketum ivotthitam / bahuvarṇaṃ ca citraṃ ca divyaṃ vānaralakṣaṇam / apaśyāma mahārāja dhvajaṃ gāṇḍivadhanvanaḥ

vulgate_text: atha kāmbhojaijaraśvairmahadbhiḥ śīghragāmibhiḥ / gopānāṃ bahusāhastrairbālairgāpāyanairvṛtaḥ
ce_text: atha kāmbojamukhyais tu bṛhadbhiḥ śīghragāmibhiḥ / gopānāṃ bahusāhasrair balair govāsano vṛtaḥ

vulgate_text: vapurbhiśca narendrāṇāṃ candrasūryasamaprabhaiḥ / virarāja tadā rājaṃstatratatra raṇāṅgaṇam
ce_text: kavacānāṃ vicitrāṇāṃ bhūṣaṇānāṃ prabhās tathā / khaṃ diśaḥ pradiśaś caiva bhāsayām āsur ojasā / virarāja tadā rājaṃs tatra tatra raṇāṅgaṇam

vulgate_text: nyahanatpāṇḍavīṃ senāmāsurīmiva vṛtrāhā te vadhyamānā bhīṣmeṇa pāñcālāḥ somakaiḥ saha / sthirāṃ yuddhe matiṃ kṛtvā bhīṣmamevābhidudruvuḥ
ce_text: te vadhyamānā bhīṣmeṇa pāñcālāḥ somakaiḥ saha / āryāṃ yuddhe matiṃ kṛtvā bhīṣmam evābhidudruvuḥ

vulgate_text: yattatsakhyustu pūrveṇa arjunādupaśikṣitam pragāḍhaṃ laghu citraṃ ca darśayanhastalāghavam / prāmuñcatpuṅkhasaṃyuktāñśarānāśīviṣopamān
ce_text: prāmuñcat puṅkhasaṃyuktāñ śarān āśīviṣopamān / prakāśaṃ laghu citraṃ ca darśayann astralāghavam

vulgate_text: samadattistataḥ kruddhasteṣāṃ cāpāni bhārata / ciccheda samare rājanyudhyamāno mahārathaiḥ
ce_text: saumadattis tataḥ kruddhas teṣāṃ cāpāni bhārata / ciccheda daśabhir bāṇair nimeṣeṇa mahārathaḥ

vulgate_text: sātyakirdharmarājaśca vyūhagrīvāṃ samāsthitāḥ pṛṣṭhamāsīnmahārāja virāṭo vāhinīpatiḥ - - adhṛṣṭadyumno mahārāja mahatyā senayā vṛtaḥ kekayā bhrātaraḥ pañca vāmapārśvaṃ samāśritāḥ
ce_text: pṛṣṭham āsīn mahārāja virāṭo vāhinīpatiḥ / dhṛṣṭadyumnena sahito mahatyā senayā vṛtaḥ

vulgate_text: kampaneṣu ca cāpeṣu kaṇapeṣu ca sarvaśaḥ / kṣeṇaṇīyeṣu citreṣu muṣṭayuddheṣu ca kṣamam
ce_text: kampaneṣu ca cāpeṣu kaṇapeṣu ca sarvaśaḥ / kṣepaṇīṣu ca citrāsu muṣṭiyuddheṣu kovidam

vulgate_text: dhvajabhūṣaṇasaṃbādhaṃ ratnapaṭṭasusaṃcitam / paridhāvadbhiraśvaiśca vāyuvegavikampitam
ce_text: dhvajabhūṣaṇasaṃbādhaṃ ratnapaṭṭena saṃcitam / vāhanaiḥ parisarpadbhir vāyuvegavikampitam

vulgate_text: guptaṃ pravīrairlaukaiśca sāravadbhirmahātmabhiḥ / yadahanyata sainyaṃ me diṣṭamatra parāyaṇam
ce_text: guptaṃ pravīrair lokasya sāravadbhir mahātmabhiḥ / yad ahanyata saṃgrāme diṣṭam etat purātanam

vulgate_text: ukto'pi vidureṇāhaṃ hitaṃ pathyaṃ ca nityaśaḥ / na ca jagrāha tanmandaḥ putro duryodhano mama
ce_text: ukto hi vidureṇeha hitaṃ pathyaṃ ca saṃjaya / na ca gṛhṇāti tan mandaḥ putro duryodhano mama

vulgate_text: athālokya praviṣṭaṃ tamūcuste sarva eva tu / jīvagrāhaṃ nigṛhṇīmo vayamenaṃ narādhipāḥ
ce_text: athāhvayanta te 'nyonyam ayaṃ prāpto vṛkodaraḥ / jīvagrāhaṃ nigṛhṇīmo vayam enaṃ narādhipāḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ śatasahasrāṇi rathināṃ sarvaśaḥ prabho / udyatāni śaraistīvraistamekaṃ parivavrire
ce_text: tataḥ śatasahasrāṇi rathināṃ sarvaśaḥ prabho / chādayānaṃ śarair ghorais tam ekam anuvavrire

vulgate_text: tato rathaṃ samutsṛjya gadāmādāya pāṇḍavaḥ / uvāca sārathiṃ bhīmaṃ sthīyatāmiti bhārata
ce_text: tato rathaṃ samutsṛjya gadām ādāya pāṇḍavaḥ / jaghāna dhārtarāṣṭrāṇāṃ taṃ balaughamahārṇavam

vulgate_text: yāvadetānhaniṣyāmi dhārtarāṣṭrānsahānugān ityuktvā bhīmasenastu praviśya mahatīṃ camūm / jaghāna dhārtarāṣṭrāṇāṃ tadbalaughamahārṇavam
ce_text: tato rathaṃ samutsṛjya gadām ādāya pāṇḍavaḥ / jaghāna dhārtarāṣṭrāṇāṃ taṃ balaughamahārṇavam

vulgate_text: punaryuddhāya samare pratyudyātā jigīṣavaḥ / tato yudhiṣṭhiraḥ prāha samāhūya svasainikān
ce_text: tato yudhiṣṭhiraḥ prāha samāhūya svasainikān / gacchantu padavīṃ śaktyā bhīmapārṣatayor yudhi

vulgate_text: pravṛttimadhigacchantu na hi śuddhyati me manaḥ / pravṛttirbhimasenasya pārṣatasya ca saṃyuge
ce_text: saubhadrapramukhā vīrā rathā dvādaśa daṃśitāḥ / pravṛttim adhigacchantu na hi śudhyati me manaḥ

vulgate_text: droṇamiṣvastrakuśalaṃ sarvavidyāsu pāragam dṛṣṭvā tu sahasāyāntaṃ pāñcālyo gurumātmanaḥ / nāśaṃsata vadhaṃ vīraḥ putrāṇāṃ tava pārṣataḥ
ce_text: dṛṣṭvā ca sahasāyāntaṃ pāñcālyo gurum ātmanaḥ / nāśaṃsata vadhaṃ vīraḥ putrāṇāṃ tava pārṣataḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ saṃprekṣya putraiste bhīmasenaṃ samāvṛtam / abhimanyuprabhṛtayaste dvadaśa mahārathāḥ
ce_text: tataḥ saṃsthāpya samare svāny anīkāni sarvaśaḥ / abhimanyuprabhṛtayas te dvādaśa mahārathāḥ

vulgate_text: athābhimanyuḥ samare bhīmasenena saṃgataḥ / pārṣatena ca te sarve kaikayā draupadīsutāḥ
ce_text: athābhimanyuṃ samare bhīmasenena saṃgatam / pārṣatena ca saṃprekṣya tava sainye mahārathāḥ

vulgate_text: sa gāḍhaviddho vyathito bhīmasenena saṃyuge / niṣasāda rathopasthe mūrcchābhihatacetanaḥ
ce_text: sa gāḍhaviddho vyathito bhīmasenena saṃyuge / niṣasāda rathopasthe rājā duryodhanas tadā

vulgate_text: tataḥ sa rājā sindhūnāṃ rathaśreṣṭho mahābalaḥ / duryodhanasya jagrāha pārṣṇiṃ svapuruṣairvṛtaḥ
ce_text: tatas tu rājā sindhūnāṃ rathaśreṣṭho jayadrathaḥ / duryodhanasya jagrāha pārṣṇiṃ satpuruṣocitām

vulgate_text: kṛpaśca rathināṃ śreṣṭhastava putramacetanam / āropayadrathaṃ rājanduryodhanamamarṣaṇam
ce_text: kṛpaś ca rathināṃ śreṣṭhaḥ kauravyam amitaujasam / āropayad rathaṃ rājan duryodhanam amarṣaṇam

vulgate_text: sa tairvikarṇasya rathātpātayāmāsa vīryavān / dhvajaṃ sūtaṃ hayāṃścaiva nṛtyamāna ivāhave
ce_text: vikarṇasya tato bhallān preṣayām āsa bhārata / caturdaśa rathaśreṣṭho ghorān āśīviṣopamān / dhvajaṃ sūtaṃ hayāṃś cāsya chittvā nṛtyann ivāhave

vulgate_text: vivyādha daśabhistūrṇaṃ jayatsenaṃ śilīmukhaiḥ / nanāda sumahānādaṃ prabhinna iva vāraṇaḥ
ce_text: śatānīkas tu samare dṛḍhaṃ visphārya kārmukam / vivyādha daśabhis tūrṇaṃ jayatsenaṃ śilīmukhaiḥ

vulgate_text: sa papāta tato bhūmau vajrāhata iva drumaḥ / duṣkarṇaṃ vyathitaṃ dṛṣṭvā pañca rājanmahārathāḥ
ce_text: duṣkarṇaṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā pañca rājan mahārathāḥ / jighāṃsantaḥ śatānīkaṃ sarvataḥ paryavārayan

vulgate_text: nāśayāmāsaturvīrau dhṛṣṭadyumnavṛkodarau / karavāṇāmanīkāni śaraiḥ sannataparvabhiḥ
ce_text: ājaghāna tatas tūrṇam abhimanyur mahāmanāḥ / ekaikaṃ pañcabhir viddhvā śaraiḥ saṃnataparvabhiḥ / vajramṛtyupratīkāśair vicitrāyudhaniḥsṛtaiḥ

vulgate_text: raṇe tavārthāya mahānubhāva na jīvitaṃ rakṣitavyaṃ mamādya / sarvāṃstavārthāya sadevadaityām̐llokāndaheyaṃ kimu śatrusenām - - atānpāṇḍavānyodhayiṣyāmi rājan priyaṃ ca te sarvamahaṃ kariṣye / śrutvā pituste vacanaṃ pratīto duryodhanaḥ prītamanā babhūva
ce_text: raṇe tavārthāya mahānubhāva na jīvitaṃ rakṣyatamaṃ mamādya / sarvāṃs tavārthāya sadevadaityāṃl lokān daheyaṃ kim u śatrūṃs taveha

vulgate_text: dṛṣṭvā duryodhano rājā raṇe pārthasya vikramam tvaramāṇaḥ samabhyetya sarvāṃstānabravīnnṛpān - - ateṣāṃ tu pramukhe śūraṃ suśarmāṇaṃ mahābalam madhye sarvasya sainyasya bhṛśaṃ saṃharṣayanniva
ce_text: dṛṣṭvā duryodhano rājan raṇe pārthasya vikramam / tvaramāṇaḥ samabhyetya sarvāṃs tān abravīn nṛpān

vulgate_text: ........ māghavatā jitvā bhārata sātyakiḥ / śaineyaḥ prāṇadajjitvā yodhānāṃ tava paśyatām
ce_text: tam ajeyaṃ rākṣasendraṃ saṃkhye maghavatā api / śaineyaḥ prāṇadaj jitvā yodhānāṃ tava paśyatām

vulgate_text: teṣāṃ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ samuhadroṇaharṣaṇam / yudhāmanyuḥ susaṃkruddho bhrātarau devarūpiṇau
ce_text: irāvāṃs tu susaṃkruddho bhrātarau devarūpiṇau / vivyādha niśitais tūrṇaṃ śaraiḥ saṃnataparvabhiḥ / tāv enaṃ pratyavidhyetāṃ samare citrayodhinau

vulgate_text: tataḥ prahasya samare nakulasya mahārathaḥ / dhvajaṃ ciccheda bāṇena dhanuścaikena māriṣa
ce_text: tataḥ prahasya samare nakulasya mahārathaḥ / aśvān vai caturo rājaṃś caturbhiḥ sāyakottamaiḥ / preṣayām āsa samare yamasya sadanaṃ prati

vulgate_text: tatastu tvarito rājañśrutāyuṣamarindaman / nijaghne sāyakaistīkṣṇairnavabhirnataparvabhiḥka
ce_text: abhyadhāvat tato rājā śrutāyuṣam ariṃdamam / vinighnan sāyakais tīkṣṇair navabhir nataparvabhiḥ

vulgate_text: āryāṃ yuddhe matiṃ kṛtvā na tyajanti sma saṃyugam / yathotsāhaṃ tu samare nijaghnustāvakā raṇe
ce_text: te hanyamānāḥ samare tāvakāḥ puruṣarṣabha / āryāṃ yuddhe matiṃ kṛtvā na tyajanti sma saṃyugam / yathotsāhaṃ ca samare jaghnur lokaṃ mahārathāḥ

vulgate_text: paśya vyūhaṃ maheṣvāsa nirmitaṃ sāgaropamam / prativyūhaṃ raṇe śūra kuru kṣipraṃ mahāratha
ce_text: paśya vyūhaṃ maheṣvāsa nirmitaṃ sāgaropamam / prativyūhaṃ tvam api hi kuru pārṣata māciram

vulgate_text: tataḥ śūrāḥ samāsādya samare te parasparama netrairanimiṣai rājannavaikṣanta parasparam - - amanobhiste manuṣyendra yuddhaṃ yodhāḥ pracakrire punarāhūya te'nyonyaṃ śarīrairapi cakrire
ce_text: tataḥ śūrāḥ samāsādya samare te parasparam / netrair animiṣai rājann avaikṣanta prakopitāḥ

vulgate_text: kekayā dhṛṣṭaketuśca kuntibhojaśca daṃśitaḥ / śuktānīkā mahārāja bhīṣmameva samabhyayuḥ
ce_text: dhṛṣṭadyumnaḥ śikhaṇḍī ca sātyakiś ca mahārathaḥ / yuktānīkā mahārāja bhīṣmam eva samabhyayuḥ

vulgate_text: arjuno draupadaścaiva kuntibhojaśca daṃśitaḥ / duryodhanasamādiṣṭānrājñaḥ sarvānsamabhyayuḥ
ce_text: arjuno draupadeyāś ca cekitānaś ca saṃyuge / duryodhanasamādiṣṭān rājñaḥ sarvān samabhyayuḥ

vulgate_text: vanāyujānāṃ śubhrāṇāṃ tathā parvatavāsinām / vājināṃ bahubhiḥ saṅkhye samantātparivārayan
ce_text: vanāyujānāṃ śubhrāṇāṃ tathā parvatavāsinām / ye cāpare tittirajā javanā vātaraṃhasaḥ

vulgate_text: khamutpatya mahārāja nāgarāṭ satyavikramaḥ / indralokaṃ jagāmāśu śrutvā tatrārjunaṃ gatam
ce_text: rūpavān vīryasaṃpanno guṇavān satyavikramaḥ / indralokaṃ jagāmāśu śrutvā tatrārjunaṃ gatam

vulgate_text: nyavedayata cātmānamarjunasya mahātmanaḥ / irāvānasmi bhadraṃ te putraścāhaṃ tava prabho
ce_text: so 'bhigamya mahātmānaṃ pitaraṃ satyavikramam / abhyavādayad avyagro vinayena kṛtāñjaliḥ / irāvān asmi bhadraṃ te putraś cāhaṃ tavābhibho

vulgate_text: yuddhakāle tu sāhāyyaṃ dātavyaṃ no bhavediti / bāḍhamityevamuktvā tu yuddhakāla ihāgataḥ
ce_text: bāḍham ity evam uktvā ca yuddhakāla upāgataḥ / kāmavarṇajavair aśvaiḥ saṃvṛto bahubhir nṛpa

vulgate_text: kāmavarṇajavairaśvaiḥ sarvataḥ śuśubhe vṛtaḥ / te hayāḥ kāñcanāpīḍā nānāvarṇā manojavāḥ
ce_text: te hayāḥ kāñcanāpīḍā nānāvarṇā manojavāḥ / utpetuḥ sahasā rājan haṃsā iva mahodadhau

vulgate_text: abravītsamare yodhānsvānvicitrahayasthitān / yathaite dhārtarāṣṭrasya yodhāḥ sānugavāhanāḥ
ce_text: yathaite dhārtarāṣṭrasya yodhāḥ sānugavāhanāḥ / hanyante samare sarve tathā nītir vidhīyatām

vulgate_text: irāvānapi khaṅgena darśayanpāṇilāghavam / abhyavartata devāṃśca mānuṣāṃścaiva saṃyuge
ce_text: irāvān api khaḍgena darśayan pāṇilāghavam / abhyavartata tān sarvān saubalān baladarpitaḥ

vulgate_text: bhūmiṣṭhamatha taṃ sahkhye hyantarikṣādavaplutam / parivārya bhṛśaṃ sarve grahītumupacakramuḥ
ce_text: bhūmiṣṭham atha taṃ saṃkhye saṃpradṛśya tataḥ punaḥ / parivārya bhṛśaṃ sarve grahītum upacakramuḥ

vulgate_text: [hataśeṣairmahārāja dvisāhastrairhayottamaiḥ] nihantukāmaḥ samare irāvantaṃ mahābalam
ce_text: svārūḍhair yuddhakuśalair vimalaprāsayodhibhiḥ / vīraiḥ prahāribhir yuktaḥ svair anīkaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ / nihantukāmaḥ samare irāvantaṃ mahābalam

vulgate_text: paraśvathena tīkṣṇena ciccheda ca punaḥ punaḥ sa tena balinā vīraśchidyamāna iva drumaḥ - - arākṣaso vyanadaddhoraṃ sa śabdastumulo'bhavat paraśvathakṣataṃ rakṣaḥ susrāva bahuśoṇitam
ce_text: sa tena balinā vīraś chidyamāna iva drumaḥ / rākṣaso vyanadad ghoraṃ sa śabdas tumulo 'bhavat

vulgate_text: kṛtvā ghoraṃ mahadrūpaṃ grahītumupacakrame / arjunasya sutaṃ vīramirāvantaṃ yaśasvinam
ce_text: ārśyaśṛṅgis tato dṛṣṭvā samare śatrum ūrjitam / kṛtvā ghoraṃ mahad rūpaṃ grahītum upacakrame / saṃgrāmaśiraso madhye sarveṣāṃ tatra paśyatām

vulgate_text: na sma paśyāmahe kaṃcitprāṇānyaḥ parirakṣati / daivāsurābhe samare tasminyodhā narādhipa
ce_text: na sma paśyāmahe kaṃ cid yaḥ prāṇān parirakṣati / saṃgrāme daityasaṃkāśe tasmin yoddhā narādhipa

vulgate_text: antarikṣaṃ diśaścaiva sarvāśca pradiśastathā celuśca sahasā tatra tena nādena nāditāḥ
ce_text: nadatas tasya śabdena pṛthivī sāgarāmbarā / saparvatavanā rājaṃś cacāla subhṛśaṃ tadā / antarikṣaṃ diśaś caiva sarvāś ca pradiśas tathā

vulgate_text: adyānṛṇyaṃ gamiṣyāmi pitṝṇāṃ mātureva ca / ye tvayā sunṛśaṃsena dīrghakālaṃ pravāsitāḥ
ce_text: athainam abravīt kruddhaḥ krūraḥ saṃraktalocanaḥ / ye tvayā sunṛśaṃsena dīrghakālaṃ pravāsitāḥ / yac ca te pāṇḍavā rājaṃś chaladyūte parājitāḥ

vulgate_text: bhūyaśca ninanādoṣaṃ krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ / trāsayāmāsa raunyāni yugante jalado yathā
ce_text: bhūya eva nanādograḥ krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ / trāsayan sarvabhūtāni yugānte jalado yathā

vulgate_text: droṇaśca somadattaśca bāhlīko'tha jayadrathaḥ / kṛpo bhiriśravāḥ śalya āvantyaḥ sa bṛhadbalaḥ
ce_text: droṇaś ca somadattaś ca bāhlikaś ca jayadrathaḥ / kṛpo bhūriśravāḥ śalyaś citraseno viviṃśatiḥ

vulgate_text: aśvatthāmā vikarṇaśca citraseno viviṃśatiḥ / rathāścānekasāhasrā ye teṣāmanuyāyinaḥ
ce_text: aśvatthāmā vikarṇaś ca āvantyaś ca bṛhadbalaḥ / rathāś cānekasāhasrā ye teṣām anuyāyinaḥ / abhidrutaṃ parīpsantaḥ putraṃ duryodhanaṃ tava

vulgate_text: bhūriśravasi saṃkruddhaḥ prāhiṇodbharatarṣabha / te varma bhittvā tasyāśu viviśurdharaṇītalam
ce_text: tataḥ punar ameyātmā nārācān daśa pañca ca / bhūriśravasi saṃkruddhaḥ prāhiṇod bharatarṣabha / te varma bhittvā tasyāśu prāviśan medinītalam

vulgate_text: atibhāraṃ ca paśyāmi tasminrākṣasapuṅgave / pitāmahaśca saṃkruddhaḥ pāñcālānhantumudyataḥ
ce_text: pitāmahaś ca saṃkruddhaḥ pāñcālān hantum udyataḥ / teṣāṃ ca rakṣaṇārthāya yudhyate phalgunaḥ paraiḥ

vulgate_text: hayā hayaiḥ samājagmuḥ pādātāśca padātibhiḥ rathā rathaiḥ samāgacchannāgā nāgaiśca saṃyuge / anyonyaṃ samare rājanprārthayānāḥ samabhyayuḥ
ce_text: hayā gajaiḥ samājagmuḥ pādātā rathibhiḥ saha / anyonyaṃ samare rājan prārthayānā mahad yaśaḥ

vulgate_text: yena lokatrayaṃ krodhātrāsitaṃ svena tejasāka - - bsa rudreṇa jitaḥ pūrvaṃ nihato mātariśvanā / tathā nīlena nirbhinnaḥ samyaṅbhuktena patriṇā
ce_text: vipracittiṃ durādharṣaṃ devatānāṃ bhayaṃkaram / yena lokatrayaṃ krodhāt trāsitaṃ svena tejasā

vulgate_text: jaghāna caturo vāhānpātayāmāsa ca dhvajam sūtaṃ caikena bhallena rathanīḍādapāharat / saptamena ca bhallena nīlaṃ vivyādha vakṣasi
ce_text: tataḥ saṃdhāya vimalān bhallān karmārapāyitān / jaghāna caturo vāhān pātayām āsa ca dhvajam

vulgate_text: ghaṭotkaco'bhisaṃkruddho jñātibhiḥ parivāritaḥ abhidudrāva vegena drauṇimāhavaśobhinam / tathetare cābhyadhāvanrākṣasā yuddhadurmadāḥ - - a bhīmaseno mahābāhurnīlaṃ nīlāñjanaprabham āropya svarathaṃ vīro duryodhanamapādravat
ce_text: abhidudrāva vegena drauṇim āhavaśobhinam / tathetare abhyadhāvan rākṣasā yuddhadurmadāḥ

vulgate_text: anyonyaṃ samapaśyanta nikṛttā medinītale / viceṣṭamānāḥ kṛpaṇāḥ śoṇitena pariplutāḥ
ce_text: tatas te tāvakāḥ sarve māyayā vimukhīkṛtāḥ / anyonyaṃ samapaśyanta nikṛttān medinītale / viceṣṭamānān kṛpaṇāñ śoṇitena samukṣitān

vulgate_text: ghaṭotkacena sahitāḥ siṃhanādānpracakrire / śaṅkhadundubhinirghoṣaiḥ samantānnedire bhṛśam
ce_text: tāṃś ca pradravato dṛṣṭvā jayaṃ prāptāś ca pāṇḍavāḥ / ghaṭotkacena sahitāḥ siṃhanādān pracakrire / śaṅkhadundubhighoṣāś ca samantāt sasvanur bhṛśam

vulgate_text: bhavantaṃ samupāśritya droṇaṃ caiva pitāmaha / pāṇḍavairvigraho ghoraḥ samārabdho mayā prabho
ce_text: bhavantaṃ samupāśritya vāsudevaṃ yathā paraiḥ / pāṇḍavair vigraho ghoraḥ samārabdho mayā prabho

vulgate_text: arjunena yamābhyāṃ vā bhīmasenena vā punaḥ / anyairvā pṛthivīpālai rājā rājānamṛcchati
ce_text: arjunena yamābhyāṃ vā bhīmasenena vā punaḥ / rājadharmaṃ puraskṛtya rājā rājānam ṛcchati

vulgate_text: na tu kāryastvayā rājanhaiḍimbena durātmā ahaṃ droṇaḥ kṛpo drauṇiḥ kṛtavarmā ca sātvataḥ / śalyaśca vṛṣasenaśca vikarṇaśca mahārathaḥ
ce_text: ahaṃ droṇaḥ kṛpo drauṇiḥ kṛtavarmā ca sātvataḥ / śalyaś ca saumadattiś ca vikarṇaś ca mahārathaḥ

vulgate_text: sa bhīmaṃ śaradhārābhistājayāmāsa pārthivaḥ / parvataṃ vāridhārābhistapānte jalado yathā
ce_text: sa bhīmaṃ śaradhārābhis tāḍayām āsa pārthivaḥ / parvataṃ vāridhārābhiḥ prāvṛṣīva balāhakaḥ

vulgate_text: cedipo dhṛṣṭaketuśca saṃrabdhāḥ sarva eva te / uttamāstrāṇi divyāni darśayanto mahābalāḥ
ce_text: uttamāstrāṇi divyāni darśayanto mahābalāḥ / tam ekaṃ kuñjaraṃ kruddhāḥ samantāt paryavārayan

vulgate_text: sādhusādhviti sainyāni tvadīyānyabhyapūjayan / tataḥ prāgjyotiṣaḥ kruddhastomarānvai caturdaśa
ce_text: tataḥ prāgjyotiṣaḥ kruddhas tomarān vai caturdaśa / prāhiṇot tasya nāgasya pramukhe nṛpasattama

vulgate_text: tamāpatantaṃ sahasā dṛṣṭvā prāgjyotiṣo nṛpaḥ / cikṣepa ruciraṃ tīkṣṇamardhacandraṃ sudāruṇam
ce_text: tam āpatantaṃ sahasā dṛṣṭvā jvālākulaṃ raṇe / cikṣepa ruciraṃ tīkṣṇam ardhacandraṃ sa pārthivaḥ / ciccheda sumahac chūlaṃ tena bāṇena vegavat

vulgate_text: abhimanyuṃ tribhiścaiva kekayānpañca pañcabhiḥ / pūrṇāyatavisṛṣṭena śareṇānataparvaṇā
ce_text: bhīmam ekena vivyādha rākṣasaṃ navabhiḥ śaraiḥ / abhimanyuṃ tribhiś caiva kekayān pañcabhis tathā

vulgate_text: etadarthaṃ mayā yuddhaṃ rocitaṃ madhusūdana / saṃcodaya hayāñśīghraṃ dhārtarāṣṭracamūṃ prati
ce_text: saṃcodaya hayān kṣipraṃ dhārtarāṣṭracamūṃ prati / pratariṣye mahāpāraṃ bhujābhyāṃ samarodadhim / nāyaṃ klībayituṃ kālo vidyate mādhava kva cit

vulgate_text: vyūḍhoraskastato bhīmaḥ pothayāmāsa pārthivam / kṣurapreṇa sutīkṣṇena sumuktena mahāraṇe
ce_text: vyūḍhoraskaṃ tato bhīmaḥ pātayām āsa pārthiva / kṣurapreṇa sutīkṣṇena so 'bhavad gatajīvitaḥ

vulgate_text: tāḍayāmāsa saṃkruddhaḥ so'bhavadvyathitendriyaḥ apareṇa tu bhallena pītena niśitena tu / apātayatkuṇḍalitaṃ siṃhaḥ kṣudramṛgaṃ yathā
ce_text: apareṇa tu bhallena pītena niśitena ca / apātayat kuṇḍalinaṃ siṃhaḥ kṣudramṛgaṃ yathā

vulgate_text: khaṅgāśca dāntatsaravo jātarūpapariṣkṛtāḥ / carmāṇi cāpaviddhāni rukmacitrāṇi dhanvināṃ
ce_text: hastidantatsarūn khaḍgāñ jātarūpapariṣkṛtān / carmāṇi cāpaviddhāni rukmapṛṣṭhāni dhanvinām

vulgate_text: rathaiśca sarvato bhagnaiḥ kiṅkiṇījālabhūṣitaiḥ / vājibhiśca hatairbāṇaiḥ srastajihvaiḥ saśoṇitaiḥ
ce_text: rathaiś ca bahubhir bhagnaiḥ kiṅkiṇījālamālibhiḥ / vājibhiś ca hataiḥ kīrṇaiḥ srastajihvaiḥ saśoṇitaiḥ

vulgate_text: yantraiśca bahudhā cchinnaistomaraiścāpi kāñcanaiḥ rarāja subhṛśaṃ bhūmistatratatra viśāṃpate / aśvānāṃ reṇukapilai rukmacchannairuraśchadaiḥ
ce_text: aśvānāṃ reṇukapilai rukmacchannair uraśchadaiḥ / sādināṃ ca bhujaiś chinnaiḥ patitaiḥ sāṅgadais tathā

vulgate_text: ghore niśāmukhe raudre vartamāne mahābhaye avahāraṃ tataḥ kṛtvā sahitāḥ kurupāṇaḍvāḥ / nyaviśanta niśākāle gatvā svaśibiraṃ tadā
ce_text: tato 'vahāraṃ sainyānāṃ pracakruḥ kurupāṇḍavāḥ / ghore niśāmukhe raudre vartamāne sudāruṇe

vulgate_text: āgamiṣye tataḥ kṣipraṃ tvatsakāśamarindama / apakrānte tato bhīṣme prahariṣyasi saṃyuge
ce_text: āgamiṣye tataḥ kṣipraṃ tvatsakāśam ariṃdama / tatas tvaṃ puruṣavyāghra prakariṣyasi saṃyugam

vulgate_text: vākśalyaistava putreṇa so'tividdho mahāmanāḥ / novāca duḥkhopahato hyapriyaṃ priyamaṇvapi
ce_text: vākśalyais tava putreṇa so 'tividdhaḥ pitāmahaḥ / duḥkhena mahatāviṣṭo novācāpriyam aṇv api

vulgate_text: udvṛtya cakṣuṣī lopānnirdahanniva bhārata / sadevāsuragandharvaṃ lokaṃ kāla ivāparaḥ
ce_text: udvṛtya cakṣuṣī kopān nirdahann iva bhārata / sadevāsuragandharvaṃ lokaṃ lokavidāṃ varaḥ / abravīt tava putraṃ tu sāmapūrvam idaṃ vacaḥ

vulgate_text: abravīttava putraṃ ca sāmapūrvamidaṃ vacaḥ / kiṃ tvaṃ duryodhanaivaṃ māṃ vākśalyairapakṛntasi
ce_text: udvṛtya cakṣuṣī kopān nirdahann iva bhārata / sadevāsuragandharvaṃ lokaṃ lokavidāṃ varaḥ / abravīt tava putraṃ tu sāmapūrvam idaṃ vacaḥ

vulgate_text: vijitya ca yadā karṇaṃ sadā puruṣamāninam / uttarāyai dadau vastraṃ paryāptaṃ tannidarśanam
ce_text: yadā tu pāṇḍavaḥ śūraḥ khāṇḍave 'gnim atarpayat / parājitya raṇe śakraṃ paryāptaṃ tan nidarśanam

vulgate_text: ko hi śakto raṇe jetuṃ pāṇḍavaṃ rabhasaṃ tadā / yasya goptā jagadgoptā śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ
ce_text: ko hi śakto raṇe jetuṃ pāṇḍavaṃ rabhasaṃ raṇe / tvaṃ tu mohān na jānīṣe vācyāvācyaṃ suyodhana

vulgate_text: ukto'sti bahuśo rājannāradādyairmaharṣibhiḥ / tvaṃ tu mohānna jānīṣe vācyāvācyaṃ suyodhana
ce_text: ko hi śakto raṇe jetuṃ pāṇḍavaṃ rabhasaṃ raṇe / tvaṃ tu mohān na jānīṣe vācyāvācyaṃ suyodhana

vulgate_text: abhimanyurmaheṣvāso drupadaśca mahābalaḥ / yuyudhāno maheṣvāso yudhāmanyuśca vīryavān
ce_text: abhimanyur maheṣvāso drupadaś ca mahārathaḥ / kekayā bhrātaraḥ pañca sthitā yuddhāya daṃśitāḥ

vulgate_text: bhīṣmaṃ yoddhumabhīpsantaḥ saṃgrāme vijayaiṣiṇaḥ / kṣvelāḥ kilakilāḥ śaṅkhānkrakacāngoviṣāṇikāḥ
ce_text: kṣveḍāḥ kilikilāśabdān krakacān goviṣāṇikāḥ / bherīmṛdaṅgapaṇavān nādayantaś ca puṣkarān / pāṇḍavā abhyadhāvanta nadanto bhairavān ravān

vulgate_text: sarathānrathinastūrṇaṃ hayāṃścaiva sasādinaḥ / gajārohāṃśca sagajāndārayāmāsa phālguniḥ
ce_text: rathinaṃ ca rathāt tūrṇaṃ hayapṛṣṭhāc ca sādinam / gajārohāṃś ca sagajān pātayām āsa phālguniḥ

vulgate_text: tāṃ vadhyamānāṃ ca tathā pāṇḍavānāṃ mahācamūm / pratyadyayau raṇe rakṣo devasenāṃ yathā balaḥ
ce_text: sā vadhyamānā samare pāṇḍavānāṃ mahācamūḥ / pratyudyayau raṇe rakṣo devasenā yathā balim

vulgate_text: parasparamavekṣetāṃ kālānalasamau yudhi āśīviṣāviva kruddhau netrābhyāmitaretaram / tayoḥ samāgamo ghoro babhūva kaṭukodayaḥ
ce_text: tayoḥ samāgamo ghoro babhūva kaṭukodayaḥ / yathā devāsure yuddhe śakraśambarayor iva

vulgate_text: abhidudrāva vegena tiṣṭhatiṣṭheti cābravīt / abhimanyuśca vegena siṃhavadvinadanmuhuḥ
ce_text: alambusas tu samare abhimanyuṃ mahāratham / vinadya sumahānādaṃ tarjayitvā muhur muhuḥ / abhidudrāva vegena tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti cābravīt

vulgate_text: abhimanyustataḥ kruddho navabhirnataparvabhiḥ / bibheda niśisairbāṇai rākṣasendraṃ mahorasi
ce_text: abhimanyus tataḥ kruddho navatiṃ nataparvaṇām / cikṣepa niśitān bāṇān rākṣasasya mahorasi

vulgate_text: puṣpitaiḥ kiṃśukai rājansaṃstīrṇa iva parvataḥ / sa saṃdadhānaśca śarānhemapuṅkhānmahābalaḥ
ce_text: te tasya viviśus tūrṇaṃ kāyaṃ nirbhidya marmaṇi / sa tair vibhinnasarvāṅgaḥ śuśubhe rākṣasottamaḥ / puṣpitaiḥ kiṃśukai rājan saṃstīrṇa iva parvataḥ

vulgate_text: prāduścakre mahāmāyāṃ tāmasīmarighātinīm / tataste tamasā sarve vṛtāścāsanmahīpate
ce_text: vimukhaṃ ca tato rakṣo vadhyamānaṃ raṇe 'riṇā / prāduścakre mahāmāyāṃ tāmasīṃ paratāpanaḥ

vulgate_text: śaineyo'pi tataḥ kruddhaścāpamānamya vegavān / gautamāntakaraṃ tūrṇaṃ samādhatta śilīmukham
ce_text: śaineyo 'pi tataḥ kruddho bhṛśaṃ viddho mahārathaḥ / gautamāntakaraṃ ghoraṃ samādatta śilīmukham

vulgate_text: kathaṃ droṇo maheṣvāsaḥ pāṇḍavaśca dhanañjayaḥ / samīyatū raṇe yattau tāvubhau puruṣarṣabhau
ce_text: kathaṃ droṇo maheṣvāsaḥ pāṇḍavaś ca dhanaṃjayaḥ / samīyatū raṇe śūrau tan mamācakṣva saṃjaya

vulgate_text: viṣāṇollikhitairgātraurviṣāṇābhihato bhṛśam / viṣāṇe dantinaṃ gṛhya nirviṣāṇamathākarot
ce_text: viṣāṇe dantinaṃ gṛhya nirviṣāṇam athākarot / viṣāṇena ca tenaiva kumbhe 'bhyāhatya dantinam / pātayām āsa samare daṇḍahasta ivāntakaḥ

vulgate_text: saṃmamarda ca tatsainyaṃ pitā devavratastava / mardayecca yathā rājansiṃhaḥ prāpya mṛgavrajam
ce_text: saṃmamarda ca tat sainyaṃ pitā devavratas tava / dhānyānām iva lūnānāṃ prakaraṃ gogaṇā iva

vulgate_text: so'tividdho mahārāja śoṇitaughapariplutaḥ / vasante puṣpaśabalo raktāśoka ivābabhau
ce_text: so 'tividdho mahārāja bhīṣmaḥ saṃkhye mahātmabhiḥ / vasante puṣpaśabalo raktāśoka ivābabhau

vulgate_text: abhyadravanta gāṅgeyaṃ yudhiṣṭhirasamājñayā / prati rakṣaṇakāryārthaṃ dhṛṣṭadyumnamukhānraṇe
ce_text: abhyadravanta gāṅgeyaṃ yudhiṣṭhirahitepsayā / rirakṣiṣantaḥ pāñcālyaṃ dhṛṣṭadyumnamukhan raṇe

vulgate_text: carmabhiścāmaraiścitraiḥ patākābhiśca māriṣa / chatraiḥ sitairhemadaṇḍaiścāmaraiśca samantataḥ
ce_text: varmabhiś cāmaraiś chatraiḥ patākābhiś ca māriṣa / kakṣyābhir atha tottraiś ca ghaṇṭābhis tomarais tathā

vulgate_text: rathāścaiva samāsādya patitāṃsturagānbhuvi / vyamṛdgansamare rājaṃsturagāṃśca narānrame
ce_text: tathaiva ca rathān rājan saṃmamarda raṇe gajaḥ / rathaś caiva samāsādya padātiṃ turagaṃ tathā

vulgate_text: evaṃ te bahudhā rājanpratyamṛdganparasparam dṛśyantesma mahābāho tatratatra mahābalāḥ
ce_text: vyamṛdnāt samare rājaṃs turagāṃś ca narān raṇe / evaṃ te bahudhā rājan pramṛdnantaḥ parasparam

vulgate_text: etasmātkāraṇāddhoro vartate svajanakṣayaḥ daivādvā puruṣavyāghra tava cāpanayānnṛpa iti śrāmanmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi navamadivasayuddhe tryadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
ce_text: etasmāt kāraṇād ghoro vartate sma janakṣayaḥ / daivād vā puruṣavyāghra tava cāpanayān nṛpa

vulgate_text: ārjuniścitrasenena viddho bahubhiraśugaiḥ atiṣṭhadāhave śūraḥ kiranbāṇānsahasraśaḥ / citrasenaṃ tribhirbāṇairvivyādha samare bhṛśam
ce_text: ārjuniś citrasenena viddho bahubhir āśugaiḥ / citrasenaṃ tribhir bāṇair vivyādha hṛdaye bhṛśam

vulgate_text: heṣatāṃ caiva śabdena na prājñāyata kiṃcana antardadhe mahāñśabdastena śabdena mohitaḥ
ce_text: vegavadbhir hayais tais tu kṣobhitaṃ pāṇḍavaṃ balam / nipatadbhir mahāvegair haṃsair iva mahat saraḥ / heṣatāṃ caiva śabdena na prājñāyata kiṃ cana

vulgate_text: samādino hayā rājaṃstatratatra niṣūditāḥ / patitāḥ pātyamānāśca pratyadṛśyanta sarvaśaḥ
ce_text: sasādino hayā rājaṃs tatra tatra niṣūditāḥ / patitāḥ pātyamānāś ca śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ

vulgate_text: eṣa pāṇḍusuto jyeṣṭho yamābhyāṃ sahito raṇe / paśyatāṃ vo mahābāho senāṃ drāvayati prabho
ce_text: eṣa pāṇḍusuto jyeṣṭho jitvā mātula māmakān / paśyatāṃ no mahābāho senāṃ drāvayate balī

vulgate_text: gāṅgeyastvabravītpārthaṃ dhanviśreṣṭhamariṃdama / sādhusādhu mahābāho sādhu kuntīsuteti ca
ce_text: tasya tat pūjayām āsa lāghavaṃ śaṃtanoḥ sutaḥ / sādhu pārtha mahābāho sādhu kuntīsuteti ca

vulgate_text: utsṛjya rajataprakhyānhayānpārthasya māriṣa / vāsudevastato yogī pracaskanda mahārathāt
ce_text: utsṛjya rajataprakhyān hayān pārthasya māriṣa / kruddho nāma mahāyogī pracaskanda mahārathāt / abhidudrāva bhīṣmaṃ sa bhujapraharaṇo balī

vulgate_text: tvayā hi deva saṃgrāme hatasyāpi mamānagha / śreya eva paraṃ kṛṣṇa loke bhavati sarvataḥ
ce_text: tvayā hi deva saṃgrāme hatasyāpi mamānagha / śreya eva paraṃ kṛṣṇa loke 'muṣminn ihaiva ca / saṃbhāvito 'smi govinda trailokyenādya saṃyuge

vulgate_text: saṃbhāvito'smi govinda trailokyenādya saṃyuge / praharasva yatheṣṭaṃ vai dāso'smi tava cānagha
ce_text: tvayā hi deva saṃgrāme hatasyāpi mamānagha / śreya eva paraṃ kṛṣṇa loke 'muṣminn ihaiva ca / saṃbhāvito 'smi govinda trailokyenādya saṃyuge

vulgate_text: kurvāṇaṃ samare karmāṇyatimānuṣavikramam / vīkṣāṃcakrurmahārāja pāṇḍavā bhayapīḍitāḥ
ce_text: te vadhyamānā bhīṣmeṇa kāleneva yugakṣaye / vīkṣāṃ cakrur mahārāja pāṇḍavā bhayapīḍitāḥ

vulgate_text: vimṛdgatastasya tu pāṇḍusenāmastaṃ jagāmātha sahasraraśmiḥ / tato hi bhīṣmaḥ sabalānsasainyānnyavārayatpāṇḍusutāñśaraughaiḥ
ce_text: vimṛdnatas tasya tu pāṇḍusenām astaṃ jagāmātha sahasraraśmiḥ / tato balānāṃ śramakarśitānāṃ mano 'vahāraṃ prati saṃbabhūva

vulgate_text: jaghāna caitānsubhṛśaṃ mahābalo mahāvrataḥ pāṇḍusutānmahāstraiḥ / raṇe karūṇādhipacedipairbalairvṛtānsadā cakradharasya paśyataḥ tato balānāṃ śramakarśitānāṃ / mano'vahāraṃ prati saṃbabhūva
ce_text: vimṛdnatas tasya tu pāṇḍusenām astaṃ jagāmātha sahasraraśmiḥ / tato balānāṃ śramakarśitānāṃ mano 'vahāraṃ prati saṃbabhūva

vulgate_text: tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā sandhyāṃ saṃdṛśya bhārata / vadhyamānaṃ ca bhīṣmeṇa tyaktāstraṃ bhayavihvalam
ce_text: tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā saṃdhyāṃ saṃdṛśya bhārata / vadhyamānaṃ balaṃ cāpi bhīṣmeṇāmitraghātinā

vulgate_text: somakāṃśca jitāndṛṣṭvā nirutsāhānmahārathān niśāmukhaṃ ca saṃprekṣya ghorarūpaṃ bhayānakam / cintayitvā tato rājñāmapahāramakārayat
ce_text: somakāṃś ca jitān dṛṣṭvā nirutsāhān mahārathān / cintayitvā ciraṃ dhyātvā avahāram arocayat

vulgate_text: samayastu kṛtaḥ kaścinmama bhīṣmeṇa saṃyuge / mantrayiṣye tavārthāya na tu yotsye kathaṃcana
ce_text: samayas tu kṛtaḥ kaś cid bhīṣmeṇa mama mādhava / mantrayiṣye tavārthāya na tu yotsye kathaṃ cana / duryodhanārthe yotsyāmi satyam etad iti prabho

vulgate_text: gatvā śāntanavaṃ vṛddhaṃ mantraṃ pṛcchāma bhārata / sa no dāsyati mantraṃ yaṃ tena yotsyāmahe parān
ce_text: te vayaṃ tatra gacchāmaḥ praṣṭuṃ kurupitāmaham / praṇamya śirasā cainaṃ mantraṃ pṛcchāma mādhava / sa no dāsyati yaṃ mantraṃ tena yotsyāmahe parān

vulgate_text: yuddhādanyatra he vatsāḥ prīyantāṃ mā viśaṅkatha sarvātmanāpi kartāsmi yadapi syātsaduṣkaram / tathā bruvāṇaṃ gāṅgeyaṃ prītiyuktaṃ punaḥpunaḥ
ce_text: tathā bruvāṇaṃ gāṅgeyaṃ prītiyuktaṃ punaḥ punaḥ / uvāca vākyaṃ dīnātmā dharmaputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ

vulgate_text: uvāca rājā dīnātmā prītiyuktamidaṃ vacaḥ / kathaṃ jayema sarvajña kathaṃ rājyaṃ labhemahi
ce_text: kathaṃ jayema dharmajña kathaṃ rājyaṃ labhemahi / prajānāṃ saṃkṣayo na syāt kathaṃ tan me vadābhibho

vulgate_text: ko'thavotsahate jetuṃ vāṃ pumānbharatarṣabha / varṣatā śaravarṣāṇi mahānti puruṣarṣabha
ce_text: narāśvarathanāgānāṃ hantāraṃ paravīrahan / ka ivotsahate hantuṃ tvāṃ pumān bharatarṣabha

vulgate_text: mama sainyasya ca kṣemaṃ tanme brūhi pitāmaha - - ḷsañjaya uvāca tato'bravīcchāntanavaḥ pāṇḍavānpāṇḍupūrvaja
ce_text: yathā yudhi jayeyaṃ tvāṃ yathā rājyaṃ bhaven mama / bhavet sainyasya vā śāntis tan me brūhi pitāmaha

vulgate_text: na kathaṃcana kaunteya mayi jīvati saṃyuge / jayo bhavati sarvajña satyametadbravīmi te
ce_text: tato 'bravīc chāṃtanavaḥ pāṇḍavān pāṇḍupūrvaja / na kathaṃ cana kaunteya mayi jīvati saṃyuge / yuṣmāsu dṛśyate vṛddhiḥ satyam etad bravīmi vaḥ

vulgate_text: nirjite mayi yuddhena raṇe jeṣyatha pāṇḍavāḥ / kṣipraṃ mayi praharata yadīcchatha raṇe jayam
ce_text: nirjite mayi yuddhe tu dhruvaṃ jeṣyatha kauravān / kṣipraṃ mayi praharata yadīcchatha raṇe jayam / anujānāmi vaḥ pārthāḥ praharadhvaṃ yathāsukham

vulgate_text: nāhaṃ jetuṃ raṇe śakyaḥ sendrairapi surāsuraiḥ āttaśastro raṇe yatto gṛhītavarakārmukaḥ / tato māṃ nyastaśastraṃ tu ete hanyurmahārathāḥ
ce_text: āttaśastro raṇe yatto gṛhītavarakārmukaḥ / nyastaśastraṃ tu māṃ rājan hanyur yudhi mahārathāḥ

vulgate_text: strījite strīpradhāne ca strīpradhāyini dharmaja striyāṃ strīnāmadheye ca vikale caikaputriṇi / aprasūte ca ṣaṇḍe ca na yuddhaṃ rocate mama
ce_text: striyāṃ strīnāmadheye ca vikale caikaputrake / aprasūte ca duṣprekṣye na yuddhaṃ rocate mama

vulgate_text: pārṣataṃ tu purodhāya klībamadya mamāgrataḥ āttaśastro raṇe yatto gṛhītavarakārmukaḥ / māṃ pātayatu bībhatsurevaṃ tava jayo dhruvam
ce_text: eṣa tasmāt purodhāya kaṃ cid anyaṃ mamāgrataḥ / māṃ pātayatu bībhatsur evaṃ te vijayo bhavet

vulgate_text: dṛṣṭametatpurā devairbhaviṣyatyavaśasya te / yaddṛṣṭaṃ hi purā pārtha tattathā na tadanyathā
ce_text: diṣṭam etat purā devair bhaviṣyaty avaśasya te / hantā bhīṣmasya pūrvendra iti tan na tad anyathā

vulgate_text: jyāyāṃsamapi cedvṛddhaṃ guṇairapi samanvitam / ātatāyinamāyāntaṃ hanyāddhātakamātmanaḥ
ce_text: jyāyāṃsam api cec chakra guṇair api samanvitam / ātatāyinam āmantrya hanyād ghātakam āgatam

vulgate_text: āttaśastro raṇe yatnādvārayāmāsa sāyakaiḥ / nānāśastrāstravarṣaistānvīryāmarṣapraveritaiḥ
ce_text: sa pāṇḍavānāṃ pravarān pañca rājan mahārathān / āttaśastrān raṇe yattān vārayām āsa sāyakaiḥ / nārācair vatsadantaiś ca śitair añjalikais tathā

vulgate_text: ahamāvārayiṣyāmi veleva makarālayam kurūṃśca sahitānsarvānyudhyamānānmahābalān / nivārayiṣyāmi raṇe sādhayasva pitāmaham
ce_text: kurūṃś ca sahitān sarvān ye caiṣāṃ sainikāḥ sthitāḥ / nivārayiṣyāmi raṇe sādhayasva pitāmaham

vulgate_text: saṃgrāmādapayāsyāmi hyetatkarma samāhitam / iti tatkṛtavāṃścāhaṃ yathoktaṃ bharatarṣabha
ce_text: hatvā daśa sahasrāṇi kṣatriyāṇāṃ mahātmanām / saṃgrāmād vyapayātavyam etat karma mamāhnikam / iti tat kṛtavāṃś cāhaṃ yathoktaṃ bharatarṣabha

vulgate_text: abhyadravata mābhaiṣṭa bhīṣmo hi prāpsyate na vaḥ / arjunaṃ samare yoddhuṃ notsahetāpi vāsavaḥ
ce_text: arjunaṃ samare yoddhuṃ notsahetāpi vāsavaḥ / kim u bhīṣmo raṇe vīrā gatasattvo 'lpajīvitaḥ

vulgate_text: bhīṣmasya jīvitākāṅkṣī dhanañjayamupādravat - - btathaiva pāṇḍavāḥ śūrā gāṅgeyasya rathaṃ prati
ce_text: duḥśāsano mahārāja bhayaṃ tyaktvā mahārathaḥ / bhīṣmasya jīvitākāṅkṣī dhanaṃjayam upādravat

vulgate_text: yamadaṇḍopamāṃ ghorāṃ cikṣepa paramāhave / tāmāpatantīṃ sahasā tasya bāhubaleritām
ce_text: tām āpatantīṃ sahasā tasya bāhor baleritām / sātyakiḥ samare rājaṃs tridhā ciccheda sāyakaiḥ / sā papāta tadā bhūmau maholkeva hataprabhā

vulgate_text: drupadaśca tribhirbāṇairvivyādha niśitaistadā / guruputraṃ samāsādya praharantau mahābalau
ce_text: drupadaś ca tribhir bāṇair vivyādha niśitais tathā / guruputraṃ samāsādya bhīṣmasya purataḥ sthitam

vulgate_text: haiḍimbastu raṇe rājandurmukhaṃ śatrutāpanam / ājaghānorasi kruddhaḥ śareṇānataparvaṇā
ce_text: haiḍimbas tu tato rājan durmukhaṃ śatrutāpanam / ājaghānorasi kruddho navatyā niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ

vulgate_text: ājaghāna mahābāhuḥ pārṣataṃ taṃ mahāratham / taṃ caiva pārṣato rājanhārdikyaṃ navabhiḥ śaraiḥ
ce_text: tathaiva pārṣato rājan hārdikyaṃ navabhiḥ śaraiḥ / vivyādha niśitais tīkṣṇaiḥ kaṅkapatraparicchadaiḥ

vulgate_text: vidhunvāno naraśreṣṭho drāvayāṇo varūthinīm / pṛtanāṃ pāṇḍaveyānāṃ gāhamāno mahābalaḥ
ce_text: vidhunvāno dhanuḥ śreṣṭhaṃ drāvayāṇo mahārathān / pṛtanāṃ pāṇḍaveyānāṃ pātayāno mahārathaḥ

vulgate_text: asaṃkalpadhvajaścaiva yājñasenirmahābalaḥ / na cāmaṅgalike tasminpraharedāpagāsutaḥ
ce_text: amaṅgalyadhvajaś caiva yājñasenir mahārathaḥ / na cāmaṅgalaketoḥ sa prahared āpagāsutaḥ

vulgate_text: paśyādyaitanmahāghore saṃyuge vaiśasaṃ mahat / hemacitrāṇi śūraṇāṃ mahānti ca śubhāni ca
ce_text: paśya caitan mahābāho vaiśasaṃ samupasthitam / hemacitrāṇi śūrāṇāṃ mahānti ca śubhāni ca

vulgate_text: ko hi necchetpriyaṃ putraṃ jīvantaṃ śāśvatīḥ samāḥ / kṣatradharmaṃ tu saṃprekṣya tatastvāṃ niyunajmyaham
ce_text: ko hi necchet priyaṃ putraṃ jīvantaṃ śāśvatīḥ samāḥ / kṣatradharmaṃ puraskṛtya tatas tvā viniyujmahe

vulgate_text: pravīrānsarvalokasya dhārtarāṣṭrānmahārathān / jaghāna samare vīraḥ pāṇḍavaḥ paravīrahā
ce_text: sa tān sarvān mahārāja bhrājamānān pṛthak pṛthak / pravīrān sarvalokasya dhārtarāṣṭrān mahārathān / vivyādha bahubhir bāṇair bhīmaseno mahābalaḥ

vulgate_text: saptabhiḥ śalyamāvidhyatkṛtavarmāṇamaṣṭabhiḥ / kṛpasya saśaraṃ cāpaṃ madhye ciccheda bhārata
ce_text: śalyaṃ pañcāśatā viddhvā kṛtavarmāṇam aṣṭabhiḥ / kṛpasya saśaraṃ cāpaṃ madhye ciccheda bhārata / athainaṃ chinnadhanvānaṃ punar vivyādha pañcabhiḥ

vulgate_text: apīḍayetāṃ samare trigartānāṃ mahadbalam / suśarmāṇi raṇe pārthaṃ śarairnavabhirāśugaiḥ
ce_text: tau tatra rathināṃ śreṣṭhau kaunteyau bharatarṣabhau / apīḍayetāṃ samare trigartānāṃ mahad balam

vulgate_text: nanāda balavannādaṃ trāsayāno mahadbalam / anye ca rathinaḥ śūrā bhīmasenadhanañjayau
ce_text: anye ca rathinaḥ śūrā bhīmasenadhanaṃjayau / vivyadhur niśitair bāṇai rukmapuṅkhair ajihmagaiḥ

vulgate_text: vivyadhurniśitairbāṇai rukmapuṅkhairajihmagaiḥ / teṣāṃ ca rathināṃ madhye kaunteyau bharatarṣabhau
ce_text: anye ca rathinaḥ śūrā bhīmasenadhanaṃjayau / vivyadhur niśitair bāṇai rukmapuṅkhair ajihmagaiḥ

vulgate_text: droṇaśca vivaraṃ dṛṣṭvā bhīmasenaṃ śilīmukhaiḥ / vivyādha bāṇairniśitaiḥ pañcaṣaṣṭibhirāyasaiḥ
ce_text: droṇas tu vivaraṃ labdhvā bhīmasenaṃ śilīmukhaiḥ / vivyādha bāṇaiḥ suśitaiḥ pañcaṣaṣṭyā tam āyasaiḥ

vulgate_text: pārthahetoḥ parākrānto bhīṣmasya nidhanaṃ prati / ārjuniṃ kosalendrastu viddhvā pañcabhirāyasaiḥ
ce_text: saubhadro rājaputraṃ tu bṛhadbalam ayodhayat / ārjuniṃ kosalendras tu viddhvā pañcabhir āyasaiḥ / punar vivyādha viṃśatyā śaraiḥ saṃnataparvabhiḥ

vulgate_text: tāñcharāñcharaghātena ciccheda sa mahārathaḥ / droṇo drupadaputrāya prāhiṇotpañca sāyakān
ce_text: tāñ śarāñ śarasaṃghais tu saṃnivārya mahārathaḥ / droṇo drupadaputrāya prāhiṇot pañca sāyakān

vulgate_text: arjunastu mahārāja śikhaṇḍinamabhāṣata / abhitvarasvāsya vadhe śikhaṇḍinrathasattama
ce_text: arjunas tu mahārāja śikhaṇḍinam abhāṣata / abhitvarasva tvarito jahi cainaṃ pitāmaham

vulgate_text: vidrutaṃ dikṣu sarvāsu śarairbalamadṛśyata / atha pārtho mahārāja drāvayitvā varūthinīm
ce_text: atha pārtho mahābāhur drāvayitvā varūthinīm / duḥśāsanāya samare preṣayām āsa sāyakān

vulgate_text: saṃprādravanta samare nirjitāḥ savyasācinā / pūrvāhṇe bharataśreṣṭha parājitya mahārathān
ce_text: evaṃ te virathāḥ pañca kṛpaḥ śalyaś ca māriṣa / duḥśāsano vikarṇaś ca tathaiva ca viviṃśatiḥ / saṃprādravanta samare nirjitāḥ savyasācinā

vulgate_text: icchanto nidhanaṃ yuddhe svargalokaparāyaṇāḥ / pāṇḍavānabhyavartanta tāvakā yuddhadurmadāḥ
ce_text: icchanto nidhanaṃ yuddhe svargaṃ kṛtvā parāyaṇam / pāṇḍavān abhyavartanta tasmin vīravarakṣaye

vulgate_text: senāpatistu samare prāha senāṃ mahārathaḥ / abhyadravata gāṅgeyaṃ sainikāḥ kiṃ kṛtena vaḥ
ce_text: senāpatis tu samare prāha senāṃ mahārathaḥ / abhidravata gāṅgeyaṃ somakāḥ sṛñjayaiḥ saha

vulgate_text: ca hyanīkamanīkeṣu samasañjata saṃkale / rathā na rathibhiḥ sārdhaṃ pādātā na padātibhiḥ
ce_text: na hy anīkam anīkena samasajjata saṃkule / na rathā rathibhiḥ sārdhaṃ na padātāḥ padātibhiḥ

vulgate_text: aśvā nāśvairayudhyanta gajā na gajayodhibhiḥ / unmattavanmahārāja yudhyante tatra bhārata
ce_text: aśvā nāśvair ayudhyanta na gajā gajayodhibhiḥ / mahān vyatikaro raudraḥ senayoḥ samapadyata

vulgate_text: abhyavartanta te putrāḥ sarve sainyapuraskṛtāḥ / icchanto nidhanaṃ yuddhe svargaṃ kṛtvā parāyaṇam
ce_text: icchanto nidhanaṃ yuddhe svargaṃ kṛtvā parāyaṇam / pāṇḍavān abhyavartanta tasmin vīravarakṣaye

vulgate_text: sahasrāṇi mahārāja rājñāṃ bhallairapātayat / udvignāḥ samare yodhā vikrośanti dhanañjayam
ce_text: śatānīkaṃ ca samare hatvā bhīṣmaḥ pratāpavān / sahasrāṇi mahārāja rājñāṃ bhallair nyapātayat

vulgate_text: matsyapāñcālacedīnāṃ tamekamabhidhāvatām / te narāśvarathavrātairmārgaṇaiśca paraṃtapa
ce_text: tataḥ kilakilāśabdaḥ kṣaṇena samapadyata / matsyapāñcālacedīnāṃ tam ekam abhidhāvatām

vulgate_text: ṣaḍetānniśitairbhīṣmaḥ pravivyādhottakaiḥ śaraiḥ / tasya te niśitānbāṇātsannivārya mahārathāḥ
ce_text: tasya te niśitān bāṇān saṃnivārya mahārathāḥ / daśabhir daśabhir bhīṣmam ardayām āsur ojasā

vulgate_text: uddhūtānāṃ yathā śabdaḥ samudrāṇāṃ yugakṣaye / ghnata tvarata gṛhṇīta viddhyadhvamavakartata
ce_text: teṣām āpatatāṃ śabdaḥ śuśruve phalgunaṃ prati / udvṛttānāṃ yathā śabdaḥ samudrāṇāṃ yugakṣaye

vulgate_text: yadyeṣāṃ na bhavedgoptā viṣvakseno mahābalaḥ ajayyaścaiva sarveṣāṃ lokānāmiti me matiḥ / kāraṇadvayamāsthāya nāhaṃ yotsyāmi pāṇḍavān
ce_text: śakto 'haṃ dhanuṣaikena nihantuṃ sarvapāṇḍavān / yady eṣāṃ na bhaved goptā viṣvakseno mahābalaḥ

vulgate_text: yatte vyavasitaṃ tāta tadasmākamapi priyam / tatkuruṣva mahārāja yuddhe buddhiṃ nivartaya
ce_text: yat te vyavasitaṃ vīra asmākaṃ sumahat priyam / tat kuruṣva maheṣvāsa yuddhād buddhiṃ nivartaya

vulgate_text: sarvagātreṣu saṃkruddhastathā marmasvatāḍayat / evamanyairapi bhṛśaṃ viddhyamānaḥ sahasraśaḥ
ce_text: punaḥ śaraśatenainaṃ tvaramāṇo dhanaṃjayaḥ / sarvagātreṣu saṃkruddhaḥ sarvamarmasv atāḍayat

vulgate_text: nivārayāmāsa śaraiḥ samaṃ sannataparvabhiḥ / śikhaṇḍī tu raṇe bāṇānyānmumoca mahārathaḥ
ce_text: śikhaṇḍī tu raṇe bāṇān yān mumoca mahāvrate / te bhīṣmaṃ viviśus tūrṇaṃ svarṇapuṅkhāḥ śilāśitāḥ

vulgate_text: tadapyasya śitairbhallaistridhā tribhiraghātayat / nimeṣārdhena kaunteya āttamāttaṃ mahāraṇe
ce_text: so 'nyat kārmukam ādatta gāṅgeyo balavattaram / tad apy asya śitair bhallais tridhā tribhir upānudat / nimeṣāntaramātreṇa āttam āttaṃ mahāraṇe

vulgate_text: māṃ cāpi śaktā nirjetuṃ kimu martyā mahārathāḥ - - bṛte'rjunaṃ susaṃkruddhametatsatyaṃ bravīmi te
ce_text: na caiṣa śakyaḥ samare jetuṃ vajrabhṛtā api / na cāpi sahitā vīrā devadānavarākṣasāḥ / māṃ caiva śaktā nirjetuṃ kim u martyāḥ sudurbalāḥ

vulgate_text: tato duḥśāsanaṃ bhīṣmaḥ smayamāna ivābravīt / ardito niśitairbāṇairbhṛśaṃ gāṇḍīvadhanvanā
ce_text: tato duḥśāsanaṃ bhūyaḥ smayamāno 'bhyabhāṣata / atividdhaḥ śitair bāṇair bhṛśaṃ gāṇḍīvadhanvanā

vulgate_text: iti bruvañchāntanavo didhakṣuriva pāṇḍavam / śaktiṃ bhīṣmaḥ sa pārthāya tataścikṣepa bhārata
ce_text: iti bruvañ śāṃtanavo didhakṣur iva pāṇḍavam / saviṣphuliṅgāṃ dīptāgrāṃ śaktiṃ cikṣepa bhārata

vulgate_text: tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā svānyanīkānyacodayat / abhidravata gāṅgeyaṃ mā vo'stu bhayamaṇvapi
ce_text: vinadyoccaiḥ siṃha iva svāny anīkāny acodayat / abhidravata gāṅgeyaṃ māṃ vo 'stu bhayam aṇv api

vulgate_text: nihatya samare rājañśataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ / na tasyāsīdanirbhinnaṃ gātre dvyaṅgulamantaram
ce_text: abhihatya śaraughais taṃ śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ / na tasyāsīd anirbhinnaṃ gātreṣv aṅgulamātrakam

vulgate_text: indradhvaja ivotsṛṣṭaḥ ketuḥ sarvadhanuṣmatām / dharaṇīṃ na sa pasparśa śarasaṅghaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ
ce_text: sa papāta mahābāhur vasudhām anunādayan / indradhvaja ivotsṛṣṭaḥ ketuḥ sarvadhanuṣmatām / dharaṇīṃ nāspṛśac cāpi śarasaṃghaiḥ samācitaḥ

vulgate_text: sthito'smīti ca gāṅgeyastacchrutvā vākyamabravīt / dhārayiṣyāmyahaṃ prāṇānpatiti'pi mahītale
ce_text: sthito 'smīti ca gāṅgeyas tac chrutvā vākyam abravīt / dhārayām āsa ca prāṇān patito 'pi hi bhūtale / uttarāyaṇam anvicchan bhīṣmaḥ kurupitāmahaḥ

vulgate_text: uttarāyaṇamanvicchansugatipratikāṅkṣayā / tasya tanmatamājñāya gahgā himavataḥ sutāḥ
ce_text: tasya tan matam ājñāya gaṅgā himavataḥ sutā / maharṣīn haṃsarūpeṇa preṣayām āsa tatra vai

vulgate_text: dhārayiṣyāmyahaṃ prāṇānuttarāyaṇakāṅkṣayā / prāṇānāṃ ca samutsarga aiśvaryaṃ niyataṃ mama
ce_text: dhārayiṣyāmy ahaṃ prāṇān uttarāyaṇakāṅkṣayā / aiśvaryabhūtaḥ prāṇānām utsarge niyato hy aham / tasmāt prāṇān dhārayiṣye mumūrṣur udagāyane

vulgate_text: chandataste bhavenmṛtyuriti tatsatyamastu me / dhārayiṣye tataḥ prāṇānutsarge niyate sati
ce_text: dhārayiṣye tataḥ prāṇān utsarge niyate sati / ity uktvā tāṃs tadā haṃsān aśeta śaratalpagaḥ

vulgate_text: avadhye śantanoḥ putre hate bhīṣme mahaujasi duḥkhārtāste tato rājankurūṇāṃ patayo'bhavan / abhāva sahasā rājankururājasya tarkitaḥ
ce_text: avadhye śaṃtanoḥ putre hate bhīṣme mahaujasi / abhāvaḥ sumahān rājan kurūn āgād atandritaḥ

vulgate_text: āsphoṭayāmāsa bhṛśaṃ bhīmaseno nanāda ca / senayorubhayoścāpi gāṅgeye nihate vibhau
ce_text: tatas tūryasahasreṣu nadatsu sumahābalaḥ / āsphoṭayām āsa bhṛśaṃ bhīmaseno nanarta ca

vulgate_text: yadanyannihatenājau bhīṣmeṇa jayamicchatā / ceṣṭitaṃ kurusiṃhena tanme kathaya suvrata
ce_text: yad adya nihatenājau bhīṣmeṇa jayam icchatā / ceṣṭitaṃ narasiṃhena tan me kathaya saṃjaya

vulgate_text: sa hato draupadeyena pāñcālyena śikhaṇḍinā / sāyāhne nyapatadbhūmau dhārtarāṣṭrānviṣādayan
ce_text: sāyāhne nyapatad bhūmau dhārtarāṣṭrān viṣādayan / pāñcālānāṃ dadad dharṣaṃ kuruvṛddhaḥ pitāmahaḥ

vulgate_text: pāñcālānharṣayaṃścaiva bhīṣmaḥ kurupitāmahaḥ / sa śete śaratalpastho medinīmaspṛśaṃstadā
ce_text: sa śete śaratalpastho medinīm aspṛśaṃs tadā / bhīṣmo rathāt prapatitaḥ pracyuto dharaṇītale

vulgate_text: bhīṣmo rathātprapatitaḥ saṃchinno bahubhiḥ śaraiḥ / hāheti tumulaḥ śabdo bhūtānāṃ samapadyata
ce_text: hā heti tumulaḥ śabdo bhūtānāṃ samapadyata / sīmāvṛkṣe nipatite kurūṇāṃ samitikṣaye

vulgate_text: iti sma śaratalpasthaṃ bharatānāṃ pitāmaham / ṛṣayastvabhyabhāṣanta sahitāḥ siddhacāraṇaiḥ
ce_text: iti sma śaratalpasthaṃ bharatānām amadhyamam / ṛṣayaḥ paryadhāvanta sahitāḥ siddhacāraṇaiḥ

vulgate_text: harṣāttūryasahasreṣu vādyamāneṣu cānagha / apaśyāma mahārāja bhīmasenaṃ mahābalam
ce_text: bhṛśaṃ tūryaninādeṣu vādyamāneṣu cānagha / apaśyāma raṇe rājan bhīmasenaṃ mahābalam / ākrīḍamānaṃ kaunteyaṃ harṣeṇa mahatā yutam

vulgate_text: kṣatradharmasya vettā ca buddhisatvaguṇānvitaḥ / phalguno'pi tathetyuktvā vyavasāyaṃ paraṃjayaḥ
ce_text: tvaṃ hi pārtha mahābāho śreṣṭhaḥ sarvadhanuṣmatām / kṣatradharmasya vettā ca buddhisattvaguṇānvitaḥ

vulgate_text: prāha sarvānsamudvīkṣya bharatānbhārataṃ prati / kuntīputraṃ yudhāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ suhṛdāṃ prītivardhanam
ce_text: upadhānena dattena pratyanandad dhanaṃjayam / kuntīputraṃ yudhāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ suhṛdāṃ prītivardhanam

vulgate_text: paśyadhvamupadhānaṃ me pāṇaḍavenābhisandhitam / śayeyamasyāṃ śayyāyāṃ yāvadāvartanaṃ raveḥ
ce_text: śayeyam asyāṃ śayyāyāṃ yāvad āvartanaṃ raveḥ / ye tadā pārayiṣyanti te māṃ drakṣyanti vai nṛpāḥ

vulgate_text: ye tadā dhārayiṣyanti te ca prekṣyanti māṃ nṛpāḥ / diśaṃ vaiśravaṇākrāntāṃ yadā gantā divākaraḥ
ce_text: diśaṃ vaiśravaṇākrāntāṃ yadā gantā divākaraḥ / arciṣmān pratapaṃl lokān rathenottamatejasā / vimokṣye 'haṃ tadā prāṇān suhṛdaḥ supriyān api

vulgate_text: nūnaṃ saptāśvayuktena rathenottamatejasā / rakṣye'haṃ vai mama prāṇānsuhṛdaḥ supriyāniva
ce_text: diśaṃ vaiśravaṇākrāntāṃ yadā gantā divākaraḥ / arciṣmān pratapaṃl lokān rathenottamatejasā / vimokṣye 'haṃ tadā prāṇān suhṛdaḥ supriyān api

vulgate_text: kanyāścandanacūrṇaiśca lājairmālyaiśca sarvaśaḥ / avākirañchāntanavaṃ tatra gatvā sahasraśaḥ
ce_text: kanyāś candanacūrṇaiś ca lājair mālyaiś ca sarvaśaḥ / striyo bālās tathā vṛddhāḥ prekṣakāś ca pṛthagjanāḥ / samabhyayuḥ śāṃtanavaṃ bhūtānīva tamonudam

vulgate_text: tūryāṇi śatasaṅkhyāni tathaiva naṭanartakāḥ / śilpinaśca tathā''jagmuḥ kuruvṛddhaṃ pitāmaham
ce_text: tūryāṇi gaṇikā vārās tathaiva naṭanartakāḥ / upānṛtyañ jaguś caiva vṛddhaṃ kurupitāmaham

vulgate_text: śarābhitaptakāyo hi śastrasaṃpātamūrcchitaḥ / pānīyamita saṃprekṣya rājñastānpratyabhāṣata
ce_text: śarābhitaptakāyo 'haṃ śarasaṃtāpamūrchitaḥ / pānīyam abhikāṅkṣe 'haṃ rājñas tān pratyabhāṣata

vulgate_text: upānītaṃ tu pānīyaṃ dṛṣṭvā śāntanavo'bravīt / na me'dya sevituṃ yogyā bhogāḥ kevalamānuṣāḥ
ce_text: upanītaṃ ca tad dṛṣṭvā bhīṣmaḥ śāṃtanavo 'bravīt / nādya tāta mayā śakyaṃ bhogān kāṃś cana mānuṣān

vulgate_text: evamuktvā śāntanavo nindanvākyena pārthivān / arjunaṃ draṣṭumicchāmītyabhyabhāṣata bhārata
ce_text: evam uktvā śāṃtanavo dīnavāk sarvapārthivān / dhanaṃjayaṃ mahābāhum abhyabhāṣata bhārata

vulgate_text: dahyatīva śarīra me saṃvṛtasya taveṣubhiḥ / marmāṇi paridūyante mukhaṃ ca pariśuṣyati
ce_text: dahyate 'daḥ śarīraṃ me saṃsyūto 'smi maheṣubhiḥ / marmāṇi paridūyante vadanaṃ mama śuṣyati

vulgate_text: aindraṃ pāśupataṃ brahmaṃ pārameṣṭhyaṃ prajāpateḥ / dhātustvaṣṭuśca saviturvaivasvatamathāpi vā
ce_text: āgneyaṃ vāruṇaṃ saumyaṃ vāyavyam atha vaiṣṇavam / aindraṃ pāśupataṃ brāhmaṃ pārameṣṭhyaṃ prajāpateḥ / dhātus tvaṣṭuś ca savitur divyāny astrāṇi sarvaśaḥ

vulgate_text: tena satvavatā saṅkhye śūreṇāhavaśobhinā / jiṣṇunā samare rājansaṃdhirbhavatu mā ciram
ce_text: amānuṣāṇi karmāṇi yasyaitāni mahātmanaḥ / tena sattvavatā saṃkhye śūreṇāhavaśobhinā / kṛtinā samare rājan saṃdhis te tāta yujyatām

vulgate_text: tāvatte pāṇḍavairvīraiḥ sauhārdaṃ mama rocate / yuddhaṃ madantamevāstu tāta saṃśāmya pāṇḍavaiḥ
ce_text: yuddhaṃ madantam evāstu tāta saṃśāmya pāṇḍavaiḥ / etat te rocatāṃ vākyaṃ yad ukto 'si mayānagha / etat kṣemam ahaṃ manye tava caiva kulasya ca

vulgate_text: na vipriyaṃ mamaiveha yatspardhethā mayā saha / yadi māṃ nādhigacchethā na te śreyo dhruvaṃ bhavet
ce_text: ehy ehi me vipratīpa spardhase tvaṃ mayā saha / yadi māṃ nābhigacchethā na te śreyo bhaved dhruvam

ce_text: vyacarat sa tadā rājan senāṃ vikṣobhayan prabhuḥ / vardhayām āsa saṃtrāsaṃ śātravāṇām amānuṣam

vulgate_text: naranāgāśvakalilāṃ śaravegaughavāhinīm / śarīradārusaṅghāṭāṃ rathakacchapasaṅkulām
ce_text: naranāgāśvasaṃbhūtāṃ śaravegaughavāhinīm / śarīradāruśṛṅgāṭāṃ bhujanāgasamākulām

vulgate_text: uttamāṅgaiḥ paṅkajinīṃ nistriṃśajhaṣasaṅkulām / rathanāgahūdopetāṃ nānābhāraṇabhūṣitām
ce_text: uttamāṅgopalatalāṃ nistriṃśajhaṣasevitām / rathanāgahradopetāṃ nānābharaṇanīrajām

vulgate_text: bhagadattastu rājānaṃ drupadaṃ nataparvabhiḥ / saniyantṛdhvajarathaṃ vivyādha puruṣarṣabhaḥ
ce_text: śatamāyas tu śakuniḥ sahadevaṃ samādravat / saniyantṛdhvajarathaṃ vivyādha niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ

vulgate_text: yuddhaṃ yodhavarau loke saumadattiśikhaṇḍinau / bhūtānāṃ trāsajananaṃ cakrāte'straviśāradau
ce_text: drupadas tu svayaṃ rājā bhagadattena saṃgataḥ / tayor yuddhaṃ mahārāja citrarūpam ivābhavat / bhūtānāṃ trāsajananaṃ cakrāte 'straviśāradau

vulgate_text: taṃ tu sandhitamājñāya sāyakaṃ ghoradarśanam / dvābhyāṃ śarābhyāṃ hārdikyaściccheda saśaraṃ dhanuḥ
ce_text: dvābhyāṃ śarābhyāṃ hārdikyaś cakarta saśaraṃ dhanuḥ / tad utsṛjya dhanuś chinnaṃ saubhadraḥ paravīrahā / udbabarha sitaṃ khaḍgam ādadānaḥ śarāvaram

vulgate_text: taṃ śūramāryavratinaṃ mantrāstreṣu kṛtaścamam / cakrarakṣataṃ parāmṛdrātkumāraṃ dvijapuṅgavaḥ
ce_text: taṃ śūram āryavratinam astrārthakṛtaniśramam / cakrarakṣam apāmṛdnāt kumāraṃ dvijasattamaḥ

vulgate_text: taṃ vijitya mahātejā bhāradvājo mahāmanāḥ / abhyavartata samprepsuḥ kuntīputraṃ yudhiṣṭhiram
ce_text: vyakṣobhayad raṇe yodhān yathāmukhyān abhidravan / abhyavartata saṃprepsuḥ kuntīputraṃ yudhiṣṭhiram

vulgate_text: asminmahūrte droṇastu pāṇḍavaṃ gṛhya harṣitaḥ / āgamiṣyati no nūnaṃ dhārtarāṣṭrasya saṃyuge
ce_text: abruvan sainikās tatra dṛṣṭvā droṇasya vikramam / adya rājā dhārtarāṣṭraḥ kṛtārtho vai bhaviṣyati / āgamiṣyati no nūnaṃ dhārtarāṣṭrasya saṃyuge

vulgate_text: arjunena parityakto na cettrāsātpalāyate / māmupāyāntamālokya gṛhītaṃ viddhi pāṇḍavam
ce_text: arjunena vihīnas tu yadi notsṛjate raṇam / mām upāyāntam ālokya gṛhītam iti viddhi tam

vulgate_text: svabhāryāmṛtukāleṣu mohādvai nābhigacchatām / śrāddhamaithunikānāṃ ca ye cāpyātmāpahāriṇām
ce_text: jāyāṃ ca ṛtukāle vai ye mohād abhigacchatām / śrāddhasaṃgatikānāṃ ca ye cāpy ātmāpahāriṇām

vulgate_text: athavā harṣakālo'yaṃ traigartānāmasaṃśayam kunarairduravāpānhi lokānprāpsyanti saṃyuge / mayā hatā hiṃ saṅgrāme lokānprāpsyanti puṣkalān evamuktvā mahābāhurhṛṣīkeśaṃ tato'rjunaḥ āsasāda raṇe vyūḍhāṃ trigartānāmanīkinīm
ce_text: evam uktvā mahābāhur hṛṣīkeśaṃ tato 'rjunaḥ / āsasāda raṇe vyūḍhāṃ traigartānām anīkinīm

vulgate_text: jahāra pārthaḥ sainyeṣu sahasre dve ca yodhinām / tasminnipatite vīre trastāstasya padānugāḥ
ce_text: tasmiṃs tu patite vīre trastās tasya padānugāḥ / vyadravanta bhayād bhītā yena dauryodhanaṃ balam

vulgate_text: bhūyiṣṭhaṃ pratiruddhā ye hatairyodhairyaśasvinaḥ / vyadravanta bhayādbhītā yatra dauryodhanaṃ balam
ce_text: tasmiṃs tu patite vīre trastās tasya padānugāḥ / vyadravanta bhayād bhītā yena dauryodhanaṃ balam

vulgate_text: anyonyaṃ samare jaghnustāvakā bharatarṣabha / mohitāḥ paramāstreṇa kṣayaṃ jagmuḥ parasparam
ce_text: mohitāḥ paramāstreṇa kṣayaṃ jagmuḥ parasparam / aśobhanta raṇe yodhāḥ puṣpitā iva kiṃśukāḥ

vulgate_text: rudhirokṣitagātrāste prekṣamāṇaḥ parasparam / aśobhanta raṇe yodhāḥ puṣpitā iva kiṃśukāḥ
ce_text: mohitāḥ paramāstreṇa kṣayaṃ jagmuḥ parasparam / aśobhanta raṇe yodhāḥ puṣpitā iva kiṃśukāḥ

vulgate_text: tasya tadbhāṣitaṃ śrutvā tvaramāṇo dhanañjayaḥ / vāyavyāstreṇa tairastāṃ śaravṛṣṭimapāharat
ce_text: tasya taṃ mānuṣaṃ bhāvaṃ bhāvajño ''jñāya pāṇḍavaḥ / vāyavyāstreṇa tair astāṃ śaravṛṣṭim apāharat

vulgate_text: rajaśca cāpyabhavaddurgā kabandhaśatasaṅkulā tadbabhau raudrabībhatsaṃ bībhatsoryānamāhave
ce_text: tad babhau raudrabībhatsaṃ bībhatsor yānam āhave / ākrīḍa iva rudrasya ghnataḥ kālātyaye paśūn

vulgate_text: tamevābhimukhāḥ kṣīṇāḥ śakrasyātithitāṃ gatāḥ sā bhūmīrbharataśreṣṭha nihataistairmahārathaiḥ
ce_text: te vadhyamānāḥ pārthena vyākulāśvarathadvipāḥ / tam evābhimukhāḥ kṣīṇāḥ śakrasyātithitāṃ gatāḥ

vulgate_text: āstīrṇā sambabhau sarvā pretībhūtaiḥ samantataḥ etasminnantare caiva pramatte savyasācini
ce_text: sā bhūmir bharataśreṣṭha nihatais tair mahārathaiḥ / āstīrṇā saṃbabhau sarvā pretībhūtaiḥ samantataḥ

vulgate_text: pariṇāmya niśāṃ tāṃ tu bhāradvājo mahārathaḥ / uktvā subahu rājendra vacanaṃ vai suyodhanam
ce_text: pariṇāmya niśāṃ tāṃ tu bhāradvājo mahārathaḥ / bahūktvā ca tato rājan rājānaṃ ca suyodhanam

vulgate_text: vidhāya goptṝnpārthasya saṃśaptakagaṇaiḥ saha / niṣkrānte ca tadā pārthe saṃśaptakavadhaṃ prati
ce_text: vidhāya yogaṃ pārthena saṃśaptakagaṇaiḥ saha / niṣkrānte ca raṇāt pārthe saṃśaptakavadhaṃ prati

vulgate_text: śakā yavanakāmbhojāstathā haṃsapathāśca ye grīvāyāṃ śūrasenāśca darandā madrakekayāḥ / gajāśvarathapattyoghāstasthuḥ paramadaṃśitāḥ
ce_text: kaliṅgāḥ siṃhalāḥ prācyāḥ śūrābhīrā daśerakāḥ / śakā yavanakāmbojās tathā haṃsapadāś ca ye

vulgate_text: sa śīghrataramādāya dhanuranyatpratāpavān / droṇamabyahanadrājaṃstriṃśatā kaṅkapatribhiḥ
ce_text: sa śīghrataram ādāya dhanur anyat pratāpavān / droṇaṃ so 'bhijaghānāśu viṃśadbhiḥ kaṅkapatribhiḥ

vulgate_text: samareṣu tu nirdiṣṭāḥ pāṇḍavāḥ kṛṣṇabāndhavāḥ / pāñcālāḥ kekayā mātsyāḥ pāṇḍaveyāśca sarvaśaḥ
ce_text: tam ete cānuvartante sātyakipramukhā rathāḥ / pāñcālāḥ kekayā matsyāḥ pāṇḍavāś ca viśeṣataḥ

vulgate_text: śūrāśca balavantaśca vikrāntāśca mahārathāḥ / hīmantaḥ śatrumaraṇe nipuṇāḥ puṇyalakṣaṇāḥ
ce_text: śūrāś ca balavantaś ca vikrāntāś ca mahārathāḥ / viśeṣataś ca bhīmena saṃrabdhenābhicoditāḥ

vulgate_text: sarveṣāmeva me brūhi rathacihvāni sañjaya ye droṇamabhyavartanta kruddhā bhīmapurogamāḥ / tānyahaṃ śrotumicchāmi vistareṇa pṛthakpṛthak
ce_text: sarveṣām eva me brūhi rathacihnāni saṃjaya / ye droṇam abhyavartanta kruddhā bhīmapurogamāḥ

vulgate_text: dantavarṇāstu rājānaṃ kālavālā yudhiṣṭhiram / bhīmavegā naravyāghramavahanvātaraṃhasaḥ
ce_text: kṛṣṇās tu meghasaṃkāśāḥ sahadevam udāyudham / bhīmavegā naravyāghram avahan vātaraṃhasaḥ

vulgate_text: āmapātranikāśāstu pāñcālyamamitaujasam / dattāstumburuṇā divyāḥ śikhaṇḍinamudāvahan
ce_text: āmapātranibhākārāḥ pāñcālyam amitaujasam / dāntās tāmrāruṇā yuktāḥ śikhaṇḍinam udāvahan

vulgate_text: sutasomaṃ tu yodhāgryaṃ bhīmaputraṃ mahābalam / māṣapuṣpasavarṇāstamavahanvājino raṇe
ce_text: sutasomaṃ tu yaṃ dhaumyāt pārthaḥ putram ayācata / māṣapuṣpasavarṇās tam avahan vājino raṇe

vulgate_text: varṇairuccāvacairanyaiḥ sadaśvānāṃ prabhadrakāḥ / sannyavartanta yuddhāya bahavo devarūpiṇaḥ
ce_text: suvarṇavarṇā dharmajñam anīkasthaṃ yudhiṣṭhiram / rājaśreṣṭhaṃ hayaśreṣṭhāḥ sarvataḥ pṛṣṭhato 'nvayuḥ / varṇaiś coccāvacair divyaiḥ sadaśvānāṃ prabhadrakāḥ

vulgate_text: kathaṃ ca vo manastāta nivṛtteṣvabhavattadā / māmakānāṃ ca ye śūrāḥ ke kāṃstatra nyavārayan
ce_text: yathāsīc ca nivṛtteṣu pāṇḍaveṣu ca saṃjaya / mama sainyāvaśeṣasya saṃnipātaḥ sudāruṇaḥ / māmakānāṃ ca ye śūrāḥ kāṃs tatra samavārayan

vulgate_text: yena nāgena maghavānajayaddaityadānavān / tadanvayena nāgena bhīmasenamupādravat
ce_text: yena nāgena maghavān ajayad daityadānavān / sa nāgapravaro bhīmaṃ sahasā samupādravat

vulgate_text: vyāvṛttanayanaḥ krudvaḥ pramathanniva pāṇḍavam / vṛkodararathaṃ sāśvamaviśeṣamacūrṇayat
ce_text: śravaṇābhyām atho padbhyāṃ saṃhatena kareṇa ca / vyāvṛttanayanaḥ kruddhaḥ pradahann iva pāṇḍavam

vulgate_text: so'dhiṣṭhāya padā vāhānyuyutsoḥ sūtamārujat / yuyutsustu rathādrājannapākrāmattvarānvitaḥ
ce_text: so 'dhiṣṭhāya padā vāhān yuyutsoḥ sūtam ārujat / putras tu tava saṃbhrāntaḥ saubhadrasyāpluto ratham

vulgate_text: tataḥ pāṇḍavayodhāste nāgarājaṃ śarairdrutam / siṣicurbhairavānnādānvinadanto jighāṃsavaḥ

vulgate_text: sa tu dolāyamāno'būddvaidhībhāvena pāṇḍavaḥ / vadhena tu narāgryāṇāmakarottāṃ mṛṣā tadā
ce_text: sa tu saṃvartayām āsa dvaidhībhāvena pāṇḍavaḥ / rathena tu rathāgryāṇām akarot tāṃ mṛṣā tadā

vulgate_text: tataḥ prāgjyotiṣo rājā śaravarṣe nivārite / saṃraktanayano roṣātpārthaṃ punaravākirat
ce_text: tataḥ prāgjyotiṣo rājā śaravarṣaṃ nivārya tat / śarair jaghne mahābāhuṃ pārthaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca bhārata

vulgate_text: sa tathā śaravarṣeṇa pārthaṃ samabhihatya vai / codayāmāsa taṃ nāgaṃ vadhāyācyutapārthayoḥ
ce_text: tataḥ sa śarajālena mahatābhyavakīrya tau / codayām āsa taṃ nāgaṃ vadhāyācyutapārthayoḥ

vulgate_text: tato nāgasya tadvarma vyadhamatpākaśāsaniḥ / śarajālena mahatā tadvyaśīryata bhūtale
ce_text: tato nāgasya tad varma vyadhamat pākaśāsaniḥ / śarajālena sa babhau vyabhraḥ parvatarāḍ iva

vulgate_text: vaijayantyabhavanmālā tadastraṃ keśavorasi / padmakośavicitrā sā sarvartukusumotkarā
ce_text: vaijayanty abhavan mālā tad astraṃ keśavorasi / tato 'rjunaḥ klāntamanāḥ keśavaṃ pratyabhāṣata

vulgate_text: śuśubhe'bhyadhikaṃ śauriratasīpuṣpasannibhaḥ / tato'rjunaḥ klāntamanāḥ keśavaṃ pratyabhāṣata
ce_text: vaijayanty abhavan mālā tad astraṃ keśavorasi / tato 'rjunaḥ klāntamanāḥ keśavaṃ pratyabhāṣata

vulgate_text: tamomayaṃ jaganmene bhagadattaḥ pratāpavān / tataścandrārdhabimbena bāṇena nataparvaṇā
ce_text: tataś candrārdhabimbena śareṇa nataparvaṇā / bibheda hṛdayaṃ rājño bhagadattasya pāṇḍavaḥ

vulgate_text: śarāsanaṃ śarāṃścaiva gatāsuḥ pramumoca ha śirasastasya vibhraṣṭaṃ papāta ca varāṃśukam / nālatāḍanavibhraṣṭaṃ palāśaṃ nalinādiva
ce_text: śirasas tasya vibhraṣṭaḥ papāta ca varāṅkuśaḥ / nālatāḍanavibhraṣṭaṃ palāśaṃ nalinād iva

vulgate_text: tattamo bhairavaṃ ghoraṃ bhayakartṛ mahāhave / uttamāstreṇa mahatā jyautiṣeṇārjuno'vadhīt
ce_text: tat tamo 'streṇa mahatā jyotiṣeṇārjuno 'vadhīt / hate tasmiñ jalaughās tu prādurāsan bhayānakāḥ

vulgate_text: yaṃyaṃ pramathate droṇaḥ pāñcālānāṃ rathavrajam / tatratatra tu pāñcālyo dhṛṣṭadyumno'bhyavartata
ce_text: yaṃ yaṃ sma bhajate droṇaḥ pāñcālānāṃ rathavrajam / tatra tatra sma pāñcālyo dhṛṣṭadyumno 'tha dhīyate

vulgate_text: teṣāṃ bhāgyaviparyāsaiḥ saṅgrāme bhairave sati / vīrāḥ samāsadanvīrānkurvanto bhairavaṃ ravam
ce_text: yathābhāgaviparyāse saṃgrāme bhairave sati / vīrāḥ samāsadan vīrān agacchan bhīravaḥ parān

vulgate_text: nānusmaranti saṅgrāmamapi vṛddhāstathāvidham / ye pūrvadevairdevānāmapaśyanyuddhamadbhutam

vulgate_text: ghūrṇato'pi balaughasya divaṃ stabdhveva niḥsvanaḥ / ajātaśatrostatsainyamāviveśa subhairavaḥ
ce_text: ghūrṇato hi balaughasya divaṃ stabdhveva nisvanaḥ / ajātaśatroḥ kruddhasya putrasya tava cābhavat

vulgate_text: ānantaryamabhiprepsuḥ ṣaḍviṃśatyā śamārpayat / karṇo dvādaśabhirbāṇairaśvatthāmā ca saptabhiḥ
ce_text: karṇo dvādaśabhir bāṇair aśvatthāmā ca saptabhiḥ / ṣaḍbhir duryodhano rājā tata enam avākirat

vulgate_text: asiśaktyṛṣṭisaṅghātairyuddhamāsītparaśvathaiḥ / prakṛṣṭamasiyuddhaṃ ca babhūva kaṭukodayam
ce_text: nikṛṣṭam asiyuddhaṃ ca babhūva kaṭukodayam / kuñjarāṇāṃ ca saṃghātair yuddham āsīt sudāruṇam

vulgate_text: śiraḥ pradhvaṃsayāmāsa vakṣasyākramya kuñjaraḥ / aparāṃścāpare'mṛdranvāraṇāḥ patitānnarān
ce_text: tatrānyasya ca saṃmarde patitasya vivarmaṇaḥ / śiraḥ pradhvaṃsayām āsa vakṣasy ākramya kuñjaraḥ

vulgate_text: hīmantaḥ kālasamparkātsuduḥsvānyanuśerate / hanti smātra pitā putraṃ rathenābhyetya saṃyuge
ce_text: hanti smātra pitā putraṃ rathenābhyativartate / putraś ca pitaraṃ mohān nirmaryādam avartata

vulgate_text: hā tāta hā putra sakhe kvāsi tiṣṭha kva dhāvasi praharāhara jahmenaṃ smitaśveḍitagarjitaiḥ / ityevamuccairatyarthaṃ śrūyante vividhā giraḥ
ce_text: praharāhara jahy enaṃ smitakṣveḍitagarjitaiḥ / ity evam uccarantyaḥ sma śrūyante vividhā giraḥ

vulgate_text: tasya dīptaśaraughasya dīptacāpadharasya ca vāruṇena tadastreṇa vidhūyātha dhanañjayaḥ / śaraughāñśarajālena vidudhāva dhanañjayaḥ
ce_text: tasya dīptaśaraughasya dīptacāpadharasya ca / śaraughāñ śarajālena vidudhāva dhanaṃjayaḥ / astram astreṇa saṃvārya prāṇadad visṛjañ śarān

vulgate_text: tathaivādhirathistasya bāṇājjvalitatejasaḥ / astramastreṇa saṃvārya prāṇadadvisṛjañśarān
ce_text: tasya dīptaśaraughasya dīptacāpadharasya ca / śaraughāñ śarajālena vidudhāva dhanaṃjayaḥ / astram astreṇa saṃvārya prāṇadad visṛjañ śarān

vulgate_text: sa kṛtvā duṣkaraṃ karma hatvā vīrānsahasraśaḥ / rājaputraśataṃ hatvā kausalyaṃ ca bṛhadbalam
ce_text: sa kṛtvā duṣkaraṃ karma hatvā vīrān sahasraśaḥ / ṣaṭsu vīreṣu saṃsakto dauḥśāsanivaśaṃ gataḥ

vulgate_text: mahārathaṃ śalyaputraṃ pautraṃ te lakṣmaṇaṃ tathā ṣaṭsu vīreṣu saṃsakto dauḥśāsanivaśaṃ gataḥ / saubhadraḥ pṛthivīpāla jahau prāṇānparantapa
ce_text: sa kṛtvā duṣkaraṃ karma hatvā vīrān sahasraśaḥ / ṣaṭsu vīreṣu saṃsakto dauḥśāsanivaśaṃ gataḥ

vulgate_text: śaśvatkarmānvayairbuddhyā prakṛtyā yaśasā śriyā / na bhūto bhavitā vāpi kṛṣṇasya sadṛśaḥ pumān
ce_text: sattvakarmānvayair buddhyā prakṛtyā yaśasā śriyā / naiva bhūto na bhavitā kṛṣṇatulyaguṇaḥ pumān

vulgate_text: vikrīḍitaṃ kumāreṇa yathānīkaṃ bibhitsatā / ārugṇāśca yathā vīrā duḥsādhyāścāpi vipluve
ce_text: yan māṃ pṛcchasi rājendra saubhadrasya nipātanam / tat te kārtsnyena vakṣyāmi śṛṇu rājan samāhitaḥ / vikrīḍitaṃ kumāreṇa yathānīkaṃ bibhitsatā

vulgate_text: sarve raktapatākāśca sarve vai hemamālinaḥ / candanāgurudigdhāṅgāḥ sragviṇaḥ sūkṣmavāsasaḥ
ce_text: raktāmbaradharāḥ sarve sarve raktavibhūṣaṇāḥ / sarve raktapatākāś ca sarve vai hemamālinaḥ

vulgate_text: sahitāḥ paryadhāvanta kārṣṇi pratiyuyutsavaḥ / teṣāṃ daśasahasrāṇi babhūvurdṛḍhadhanvinām

vulgate_text: bhavitā nu kathaṃ kṛtyamidamityabruvañjanāḥ / śvo'hatvā sindhurājaṃ vai dhūmaketuṃ pravekṣyati

vulgate_text: ahaṃ vijitya tānsarvānsahasā sahayadvipān / arjunārthe haniṣyāmi sakarṇānsasuyodhanān
ce_text: ahaṃ dhvajinyaḥ śatrūṇāṃ sahayāḥ sarathadvipāḥ / arjunārthe haniṣyāmi sakarṇāḥ sasuyodhanāḥ

vulgate_text: pāñcajanyasya nirghoṣaṃ parjanyaninadopamam / śrutvā ca bhairavaṃ nādamupeyāstvaṃ javena mām

ce_text: daśa caikā ca tāḥ kṛṣṇa akṣauhiṇyaḥ sudurjayāḥ / pratijñāyāṃ ca hīnāyāṃ kathaṃ jīveta madvidhaḥ

vulgate_text: pratijñāpāraṇaṃ cāpi na bhaviṣyati keśava / pratijñāyāṃ ca hīnāyāṃ kathaṃ jīvati madvidhaḥ
ce_text: daśa caikā ca tāḥ kṛṣṇa akṣauhiṇyaḥ sudurjayāḥ / pratijñāyāṃ ca hīnāyāṃ kathaṃ jīveta madvidhaḥ

vulgate_text: tatastāvāgatau dṛṣṭvā naranārāyaṇāvubhau / suprasannamanāḥ śarvaḥ provāca prahasanniva

vulgate_text: kumāragurave tubhyaṃ nīlagrīvāya vedhase / pinākine haviṣyāya satyāya vibhave sadā

vulgate_text: abhigamyāya kāmyāya stutyāyāryāya sarvadā namo'stu devadevāya mahābhūtadharāya ca / namo viśvasya pataye pattīnāṃ pataye namaḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ pārthaḥ prasannātmā prāñjalirvṛṣabhadhvajam / dadarśotphullanayanaḥ samastaṃ tejasāṃ nidhim
ce_text: tato 'rjunaḥ prītamanā vavande vṛṣabhadhvajam / dadarśotphullanayanaḥ samastaṃ tejasāṃ nidhim

ce_text: tatas tāv āgatau śarvaḥ provāca prahasann iva / svāgataṃ vāṃ naraśreṣṭhāv uttiṣṭhetāṃ gataklamau / kiṃ ca vām īpsitaṃ vīrau manasaḥ kṣipram ucyatām

vulgate_text: tataḥ pāśupataṃ divyamavāpya punarīśvarāt / saṃhṛṣṭaromā durdharṣaḥ kṛtaṃ kāryamamanyata
ce_text: saṃhṛṣṭaromā durdharṣaḥ kṛtaṃ kāryam amanyata / vavandatuś ca saṃhṛṣṭau śirobhyāṃ tau maheśvaram

vulgate_text: tato'rjunahṛṣīkaiśau punaḥ punarariṃdamau / vavandatuśca saṃhṛṣṭau śirobhyāṃ taṃ maheśvaram
ce_text: saṃhṛṣṭaromā durdharṣaḥ kṛtaṃ kāryam amanyata / vavandatuś ca saṃhṛṣṭau śirobhyāṃ tau maheśvaram

vulgate_text: tathā bhavenānumatau mahāsuranighātinā / idrāvīṣṇū yathā prītau jambhasya vadhakāṅkṣiṇau

vulgate_text: praveśyatāṃ samīpaṃ me kimarthaṃ pravilambase āsanaṃ ca madhughnāya dīyatāṃ paramārcitam / tataḥ praveśya vārṣṇeyamupaveśya varāsane
ce_text: tataḥ praveśya vārṣṇeyam upaveśya varāsane / satkṛtya satkṛtas tena paryapṛcchad yudhiṣṭhiraḥ

vulgate_text: vāsudevo'pi tadyuktaṃ pratyuvāca yudhiṣṭhiram / darśanādeva te saumya na kiñcidaśubhaṃ mama

vulgate_text: virāṭaṃ bhīmasenaṃ ca dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ ca sātyakim / cedipaṃ dhṛṣṭaketuṃ ca drupadaṃ ca mahāratham
ce_text: anujñātaś ca rājñā sa prāveśayata taṃ janam / virāṭaṃ bhīmasenaṃ ca dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ ca sātyakim

vulgate_text: nahi tatkurute yodhaḥ kārtavīryasamo'pi yaḥ / yudhi yatkuruṣe kṛṣṇa sārathyaṃ tvaṃ samāsthitaḥ
ce_text: na hi tat kurute saṃkhye kārtavīryasamas tv api / rathī yat kurute kṛṣṇa sārathir yatnam āsthitaḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ puruṣaśārdūlaḥ sajjaṃ sarvaṃ nyavedayat / rathaṃ puruṣasiṃhasya sadhvajaṃ supatākinam
ce_text: tataḥ puruṣaśārdūlaḥ sajjaḥ sajjaṃ puraḥsaraḥ / kṛtāhnikāya pārthāya nyavedayata taṃ ratham

vulgate_text: tatastasminkṣaṇe rājanvividhāni śubhāni ca / prādurāsannimittāni vijayāya bahūni ca
ce_text: prādurāsan nimittāni vijayāya bahūni ca / pāṇḍavānāṃ tvadīyānāṃ viparītāni māriṣa

vulgate_text: mayyapekṣā na kartavyā goptā'yaṃ mama keśavaḥ / rājña eva parā guptiḥ kāryā sarvātmanā tvayā
ce_text: mayy apekṣā na kartavyā kathaṃ cid api sātvata / rājany eva parā guptiḥ kāryā sarvātmanā tvayā

vulgate_text: kintu sañjaya saṅgrame vṛttaṃ duryodhanaṃ prati / paridevo mahānadya śrūyate hi gṛhegṛhe
ce_text: kiṃ nu saṃjaya saṃgrāme vṛttaṃ duryodhanaṃ prati / paridevo mahān atra śruto me nābhinandanam

vulgate_text: sūtamāgadhabandīnāṃ nartakānāṃ ca niḥsvanaḥ / so'dya na śrūyate śabdaḥ sūta putra yathā purā

vulgate_text: kālaprāptamahaṃ manye mā tvaṃ duryodhanātigāḥ / saṃśāmya bhrātṛbhistaistu kṣatriyānabhipālaya

vulgate_text: śalo bhūriśravāścaiva purumitro viviṃśatiḥ / jayaḥ kṛpo vā dharmātmā ye cānye mama bāndhavāḥ

vulgate_text: na ca tvā'bhibhaviṣyanti hitvā dharmaṃ pṛthātmajāḥ / niyujyamānāḥ sthāsyanti pāṇḍavā dharmavartmani
ce_text: niyujyamānāḥ sthāsyanti pāṇḍavā dharmavartmani / santi no jñātayas tāta yeṣāṃ śroṣyanti pāṇḍavāḥ

vulgate_text: droṇasyātha vikarṇasya bāhlīkasya kṛpasya ca anyeṣāṃ caiva vṛddhānāṃ bharatānāṃ mahātmanām / tvadarthamabravaṃ tāta na jahurvacanāni te
ce_text: anyeṣāṃ caiva vṛddhānāṃ bharatānāṃ mahātmanām / tvadarthaṃ bruvatāṃ tāta kariṣyanti vaco hitam

vulgate_text: duryodhanaṃ cāvidheyaṃ badhnīyāstvaṃ purā yadi / avekṣya kauravānrājanprāpsyase tvaṃ mahadyaśaḥ

vulgate_text: na tathā manyate kṛṣṇo na ca rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / na bhīṣmo naiva ca droṇo yathā tvaṃ manyase nṛpa
ce_text: na tathā manyate kṛṣṇo rājānaṃ pāṇḍavaṃ purā / na bhīṣmaṃ naiva ca droṇaṃ yathā tvāṃ manyate nṛpa

vulgate_text: vyajānīta yadā tu tvāṃ lubdhaṃ dharmapravādinam / tadāprabhṛti kṛṣmastvāṃ na tathā bahumanyate

vulgate_text: śarairāśīviṣasparśairnirbhinnāḥ savyasācinā / te gajāḥ samasīdanta magnāḥ paṅkārṇaveṣviva

vulgate_text: sā visphurantī jvalitā vajravegasamā gadā / hatvā śrutāyudhaṃ vīraṃ dharaṇīmanvapadyata

vulgate_text: śete sma nihato bhūmau kāmbhojāstaraṇocitaḥ / mahārhābharaṇopetaḥ sānumāniva parvataḥ

vulgate_text: drāviḍāstatra yudhyante mattamātaṅgavikramāḥ / goyoniprabhavā mlecchāḥ kālakalpāḥ prahāriṇaḥ
ce_text: goyoniprabhavā mlecchāḥ kālakalpāḥ prahāriṇaḥ / dārvābhisārā daradāḥ puṇḍrāś ca saha bāhlikaiḥ

ce_text: na te sma śakyāḥ saṃkhyātuṃ vrātāḥ śatasahasraśaḥ / vṛṣṭis tathāvidhā hy āsīc chalabhānām ivāyatiḥ

ce_text: na te sma śakyāḥ saṃkhyātuṃ vrātāḥ śatasahasraśaḥ / vṛṣṭis tathāvidhā hy āsīc chalabhānām ivāyatiḥ

vulgate_text: tato gajaśiraḥprakhyairupalaiḥ śailavāsinaḥ / udyatairyuyudhānasya puratastasthurāhave
ce_text: tato gajaśiśuprakhyair upalaiḥ śailavāsinaḥ / udyatair yuyudhānasya sthitā maraṇakāṅkṣiṇaḥ

vulgate_text: te hanyamānāḥ samare sātvatena mahātmanā / aśmavṛṣṭiṃ mahāghorāṃ pātayanti sma sātvate
ce_text: viparītam ahaṃ manye mandabhāgyān sutān prati / yatrāvadhyanta samare sātvatena mahātmanā

vulgate_text: lambakaiśca kuṇindaiśca kṣiptāḥ kṣiptāśca sātyakiḥ / nārācaiḥ praticiccheda pratipattiviśāradaḥ
ce_text: ambaṣṭhaiś ca kuṇindaiś ca kṣiptāṃ kṣiptāṃ sa sātyakiḥ / nārācaiḥ prativivyādha prekṣamāṇo mahābalaḥ

vulgate_text: ityetadvacanaṃ śrutvā bhāradvājasya sārathiḥ / pratyuvāca tato droṇaṃ sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varam
ce_text: ity evaṃ bruvato rājan bhāradvājasya dhīmataḥ / pratyuvāca tato yantā droṇaṃ śastrabhṛtāṃ varam

vulgate_text: sa vadhyamāno bahudhā rājaputrairmahārathaiḥ / krodhamāhārayatteṣāmabhāvāya dvijarṣabhaḥ
ce_text: sa vadhyamāno bahudhā rājaputrair mahārathaiḥ / vyaśvasūtarathāṃś cakre kumārān kupito raṇe

vulgate_text: tānvimūḍhānraṇe droṇaḥ prahasanniva bhārata / vyaśvasūtarathāṃścakre kumārānkupito raṇe
ce_text: sa vadhyamāno bahudhā rājaputrair mahārathaiḥ / vyaśvasūtarathāṃś cakre kumārān kupito raṇe

vulgate_text: pratyāśvastastato droṇo dhanurgṛhya mahāravam / āsannamāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ jighāṃsayā
ce_text: pratyāśvastas tato droṇo dhanur gṛhya mahābalaḥ / śarair vaitastikai rājan nityam āsannayodhibhiḥ / yodhayām āsa samare dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ mahāratham

vulgate_text: śarairvaitastikai rājanvivyādhāsannavedhibhiḥ / yodhayāmāsa samare dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ mahāratham
ce_text: pratyāśvastas tato droṇo dhanur gṛhya mahābalaḥ / śarair vaitastikai rājan nityam āsannayodhibhiḥ / yodhayām āsa samare dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ mahāratham

vulgate_text: taṃ tu duḥśāsanaḥ śūraḥ sāyakairāvṛṇodbhṛśam / rathavrātena mahatā nānādeśodbhavena ca
ce_text: sa tu duḥśāsanaṃ vīraḥ sāyakair āvṛṇod bhṛśam / maśakaṃ samanuprāptam ūrṇanābhir ivorṇayā

vulgate_text: athavā śūnyamāsīttadyena yātaḥ sa sātyakiḥ / hatabhūyiṣṭhamathavā yena yātaḥ sa sātyakiḥ
ce_text: atha vā śūnyam āsīt tad yena yātaḥ sa sātyakiḥ / eko vai bahulāḥ senāḥ pramṛdnan puruṣarṣabhaḥ

vulgate_text: na santi tasmātputrā me yathā sañjaya bhāṣase / eko vai bahulāḥ senāḥ prāmṛdgātsatyavikramaḥ
ce_text: atha vā śūnyam āsīt tad yena yātaḥ sa sātyakiḥ / eko vai bahulāḥ senāḥ pramṛdnan puruṣarṣabhaḥ

vulgate_text: tatra rājanmahānāsītsaṅgrāmo bhītivardhanaḥ / pāṇḍavasya mahābāho tāvakānāṃ ca dāruṇaḥ
ce_text: tatra rājan mahān āsīt saṃgrāmo bhūrivardhanaḥ / rudrasyākrīḍasaṃkāśaḥ saṃhāraḥ sarvadehinām

vulgate_text: rudrasyākrīḍasaṅkāśaḥ saṃhāraḥ sarvadehinām / tataḥ śabdo mahānāsītprāyādyatra dhanañcayaḥ
ce_text: tatra rājan mahān āsīt saṃgrāmo bhūrivardhanaḥ / rudrasyākrīḍasaṃkāśaḥ saṃhāraḥ sarvadehinām

vulgate_text: tathā prayatamānānāṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ mahātmanām / duryodhano mahārājanvyagāhata mahadbalam
ce_text: tathā prayatamāneṣu pāṇḍaveyeṣu nirbhayaḥ / duryodhano mahārāja vyagāhata mahad balam

vulgate_text: duryodhanena samare pṛtanā pāṇḍavī raṇe / nalinī dvarideneva samantātpratiloḍitā
ce_text: duryodhanena sahasā pāṇḍavī pṛtanā raṇe / nalinī dviradeneva samantād vipraloḍitā

vulgate_text: tatastāṃ prahatāṃ senāṃ dṛṣṭvā putreṇa te nṛpa / bhīmasenapurogāstaṃ pāñcālāḥ samupādruvan
ce_text: tathā senāṃ kṛtāṃ dṛṣṭvā tava putreṇa kaurava / bhīmasenapurogās taṃ pāñcālāḥ samupādravan

vulgate_text: tasya tānnighnataḥ śatrūnhemapṛṣṭhaṃ mahaddhanuḥ / ajasraṃ maṇḍalībhūtaṃ dadṛśuḥ samare janāḥ
ce_text: tasya tān nighnataḥ śatrūn hemapṛṣṭhaṃ mahad dhanuḥ / bhallābhyāṃ pāṇḍavo jyeṣṭhas tridhā ciccheda māriṣa

vulgate_text: vivyādha cainaṃ daśabhiḥ samyagastaiḥ śarottamaiḥ / varma cāśu samāsādya te bhittvā kṣitimāviśan
ce_text: vivyādha cainaṃ bahubhiḥ samyag astaiḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ / varmāṇy āśu samāsādya te bhagnāḥ kṣitim āviśan

vulgate_text: tato'nyaddhanurādāya tava putraḥ pratāpavān / tiṣṭhetiṣṭheti rājānaṃ bruvanpāṇḍavamabhyayāt
ce_text: atha duryodhano rājā dṛḍham ādāya kārmukam / tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti rājānaṃ bruvan pāṇḍavam abhyayāt

vulgate_text: tamāyāntamabhiprekṣya tava putraṃ mahāmṛdhe / pratyudyayuḥ samuditāḥ pāñcālā jayagṛddhinaḥ
ce_text: taṃ tathā vādinaṃ rājaṃs tava putraṃ mahāratham / pratyudyayuḥ pramuditāḥ pāñcālā jayagṛddhinaḥ

vulgate_text: tatra rājanmahānāsītsaṅgrāmo romaharṣaṇaḥ / pāṇḍavānāṃ mahābāho tāvakānāṃ ca saṃyuge
ce_text: tatra rājan mahān āsīt saṃgrāmo bhūrivardhanaḥ / rudrasyākrīḍasaṃkāśaḥ saṃhāraḥ sarvadehinām

vulgate_text: tāṃstu droṇavinirmuktānkruṃddhāśīviṣasannibhān / ekaikaṃ pañcabhirbāṇairyudhi ciccheda hṛṣṭavat
ce_text: tāṃs tu droṇadhanurmuktān ghorān āśīviṣopamān / ekaikaṃ daśabhir bāṇair yudhi ciccheda hṛṣṭavat

vulgate_text: tato'stre nihate brāhme bṛhatkṣatrastu bhārata / vivyādha brāhmaṇaṃ ṣaṣṭyā svarṇapuṅkhaiḥ śilāśitaiḥ
ce_text: pratihanya tad astraṃ tu bhāradvājasya saṃyuge / vivyādha brāhmaṇaṃ ṣaṣṭyā svarṇapuṅkhaiḥ śilāśitaiḥ

vulgate_text: vyākulīkṛtya taṃ droṇo bṛhatkṣatraṃ mahāratham / aśvāṃścaturbhiranyavadhīccaturo'sya patattribhiḥ
ce_text: vyākulīkṛtya taṃ droṇo bṛhatkṣatraṃ mahāratham / vyasṛjat sāyakaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ kekayaṃ prati bhārata

vulgate_text: tasya droṇo dhanurmadhye kṣurapreṇa śitena ca / cakarta gārdhrapatreṇa yatamānasya śuṣmiṇaḥ
ce_text: tasya droṇo dhanurmadhye kṣurapreṇa śitena ha / ciccheda rājño balino yatamānasya saṃyuge

vulgate_text: tāmāpatantīmālokya kālarātrimivodyatām aśmasāramayīṃ gurvīṃ tapanīyavibhūṣitām / śarairanekasāhasrairbhādvājo'cchinacchitaiḥ
ce_text: tām āpatantīṃ sahasā ghorarūpāṃ bhayāvahām / aśmasāramayīṃ gurvīṃ tapanīyavibhūṣitām / śarair anekasāhasrair bhāradvājo nyapātayat

vulgate_text: sā chinnā bahubhirbāṇaibhāradvājena māriṣa / gadā papāta kauravya nādayantī dharātalam
ce_text: sā papāta gadā bhūmau bhāradvājena sāditā / raktamālyāmbaradharā tāreva nabhasas talāt

vulgate_text: sa tu droṇaṃ mahābāhuḥ śaradhārābhirāhave / adṛśyamakarottūrṇaṃ jalado bhāskaraṃ yathā
ce_text: sa tu droṇaṃ mahārāja chādayan sāyakaiḥ śitaiḥ / adṛśyam akarot tūrṇaṃ jalado bhāskaraṃ yathā

vulgate_text: te tu nāmāṅkitā bāṇā droṇenāstāḥ śilāśitāḥ / narānnāgānhayāṃścaiva nijaghnuḥ śataśo mṛdhe
ce_text: tato droṇāṅkitā bāṇāḥ svarṇapuṅkhāḥ śilāśitāḥ / narān nāgān hayāṃś caiva nijaghnuḥ sarvato raṇe

vulgate_text: bruvantaśca raṇe'nyonyaṃ cedipāñcālasṛñjayāḥ / hata droṇaṃ hata droṇamiti te droṇamabhyayuḥ
