ce_text: hata droṇaṃ hata droṇam iti te droṇam abhyayuḥ / yatantaḥ puruṣavyāghrāḥ sarvaśaktyā mahādyutim / ninīṣanto raṇe droṇaṃ yamasya sadanaṃ prati

vulgate_text: anyatkārmukamādāya bhāsvaraṃ vegavattaram / tatrādhāya śaraṃ tīkṣṇaṃ parānīkaviśātanam
ce_text: sa saṃrabdhataro bhūtvā droṇaḥ kṣatriyamardanaḥ / anyat kārmukam ādāya bhāsvaraṃ vegavattaram

vulgate_text: caturbhiḥ sārathiṃ cāsya caturbhiścaturo hayān / tamācāryastribhirbāṇairbāhvorurasi cārdayat
ce_text: sa droṇaṃ daśabhir bāṇaiḥ pratyavidhyat stanāntare / caturbhiḥ sārathiṃ cāsya caturbhiś caturo hayān

vulgate_text: dhvajaṃ saptabhirunmathya yantāramavadhīttribhiḥ / tasya sūte hate te'śvā rathamādāya vidrutāḥ
ce_text: tasya sūte hate te 'śvā ratham ādāya vidrutāḥ / samare śarasaṃvītā bhāradvājena māriṣa

vulgate_text: abravīdvacanaṃ rājankuntīputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ yaḥ sadevānsagandharvāndaityāṃścaikaratho'jayat
ce_text: yaḥ sadevān sagandharvān daityāṃś caikaratho 'jayat / tasya lakṣma na paśyāmi bhīmasenānujasya te

vulgate_text: cakoranetrastāmrāsyo dviṣatāṃ bhayavardhanaḥ / mama priyahitārthaṃ ca śakralokādihāgataḥ
ce_text: vyūḍhorasko mahāskandho mattadviradavikramaḥ / cakoranetras tāmrākṣo dviṣatām aghavardhanaḥ

vulgate_text: tasyābhigamanaṃ jāne bhīma nāvartanaṃ punaḥ / tadidaṃ mama bhadraṃ te śokasthānamarindama
ce_text: tad idaṃ mama bhadraṃ te śokasthānam ariṃdama / arjunārthaṃ mahābāho sātvatasya ca kāraṇāt

vulgate_text: sahayo nāsya vai kaścittena vindāmi kaśmalam / tasmātkṛṣṇo raṇe nūnaṃ yudhyate yuddhakovidaḥ
ce_text: tasmāt kṛṣṇo raṇe nūnaṃ yudhyate yuddhakovidaḥ / yasya vīryavato vīryam upajīvanti pāṇḍavāḥ

vulgate_text: na hi me śudhyate bhāvastayoreva parantapa / sa tatra gaccha kaunteya yatra yāto dhanañjayaḥ
ce_text: sa tatra gaccha kaunteya yatra yāto dhanaṃjayaḥ / sātyakiś ca mahāvīryaḥ kartavyaṃ yadi manyase / vacanaṃ mama dharmajña jyeṣṭho bhrātā bhavāmi te

vulgate_text: dharmarājasya vacane sthātavyamaviśaṅkayā / yāsyāmi padavīṃ bhrātuḥ sātvatasya ca dhīmataḥ
ce_text: evam ukto 'smi pārthena prativaktuṃ sma notsahe / prayāsye tatra yatrāsau mumūrṣuḥ saindhavaḥ sthitaḥ / dharmarājasya vacane sthātavyam aviśaṅkayā

vulgate_text: bhīmaseno mahābāhuḥ kavacī śubhakuṇḍalī sagadaḥ satalatrāṇaḥ saśarī rathināṃ varaḥ / rathamāruhya niryuktaṃ sarvopakaraṇānvitam
ce_text: bhīmaseno mahābāhuḥ kavacī śubhakuṇḍalī / sāṅgadaḥ satanutrāṇaḥ saśarī rathināṃ varaḥ

vulgate_text: baddhagodhāṅgulitrāṇaḥ pragṛhītaśarāsanaḥ / jyeṣṭhena prahito bhrātrā bhrātā bhrātuḥ priyaṅkaraḥ
ce_text: gaccha gaccheti ca punar bhīmasenam abhāṣata / bhṛśaṃ sa prahito bhrātrā bhrātā bhrātuḥ priyaṃkaraḥ / āhatya dundubhiṃ bhīmaḥ śaṅkhaṃ pradhmāya cāsakṛt

vulgate_text: tena śabdena vīrāṇāṃ pātayitvā manāṃsyuta / darśayanghoramātmānamamitrānsahasā'bhyayāt
ce_text: vinadya siṃhanādaṃ ca jyāṃ vikarṣan punaḥ punaḥ / darśayan ghoram ātmānam amitrān sahasābhyayāt

vulgate_text: *mahāntaṃ talaśabdaṃ ca kṛtvā droṇāntikaṃ yayau / tamāvārayadācāryo velevodvṛttamarṇavam
ce_text: punaś cātītya vegena droṇānīkam upādravat / tam avārayad ācāryo velevodvṛttam arṇavam

vulgate_text: tasya droṇo rathaṃ rājañchādayāmāsa saṃyuge / sāśvasūtadhvajaṃ tūrṇaṃ tadadbhutamivābhavat
ce_text: tasmin kṣaṇe tasya yantā tūrṇam aśvān acodayat / bhīmasenasya kauravya tad adbhutam ivābhavat

vulgate_text: sāśvasūtadhvajaṃ yānaṃ droṇasyāpothayattadā / tadadbhutamapaśyāma pāṇḍaveyasya vikramam
ce_text: sāśvasūtadhvajaṃ yānaṃ droṇasyāpothayat tadā / prāmṛdnāc ca bahūn yodhān vāyur vṛkṣān ivaujasā

vulgate_text: droṇaṃ tu virathaṃ kṛtvā bhīmaseno mahābalaḥ / abhyavartata sainyāni tāvakāni samantataḥ
ce_text: tataḥ svaratham āsthāya bhīmaseno mahābalaḥ / abhyavartata vegena tava putrasya vāhinīm

vulgate_text: sa mṛdraṃstarasā yodhānvāyurvṛkṣānivaujasā / vicacāra raṇe rājanvāyutulyaparākramaḥ
ce_text: sāśvasūtadhvajaṃ yānaṃ droṇasyāpothayat tadā / prāmṛdnāc ca bahūn yodhān vāyur vṛkṣān ivaujasā

vulgate_text: nirjitastu tadā tena pāṇḍavena mahātmanā / anyaṃ tu rathamātiṣṭhaddroṇaḥ praharatāṃ varaḥ
ce_text: taṃ punaḥ parivavrus te tava putrā rathottamam / anyaṃ ca ratham āsthāya droṇaḥ praharatāṃ varaḥ

vulgate_text: samuttīrṇaṃ rathānīkaṃ pāṇḍavaṃ vihasanraṇe / vivārayiṣurācāryaḥ śaravarṣairavākirat
ce_text: tam uttīrṇaṃ rathānīkāt tamaso bhāskaraṃ yathā / didhārayiṣur ācāryaḥ śaravarṣair avākirat

vulgate_text: sa taistu saṃvṛto bhīmaḥ krodhena pradahanniva udyacchansa gadāṃ tebhyaḥ sughorāṃ siṃhavannadan / avāsṛjacca vegena śatrupakṣavināśinīm
ce_text: sa tathā saṃvṛto bhīmaḥ prahasann iva bhārata / udayacchad gadāṃ tebhyo ghorāṃ tāṃ siṃhavan nadan / avāsṛjac ca vegena teṣu tān pramathad balī

vulgate_text: indrāśanirivendreṇa praviddhā saṃhatātmanā / prāmathnātsā mahārāja sainikāṃstava saṃyuge
ce_text: sendrāśanir ivendreṇa praviddhā saṃhatātmanā / ghoṣeṇa mahatā rājan pūrayitveva medinīm / jvalantī tejasā bhīmā trāsayām āsa te sutān

vulgate_text: siṃhanādamasahyaṃ hi śrutvā bhīmasya saṃyuge / prāpatanmunujāstrastā rathebhyo rathinastadā
ce_text: taṃ ca śabdam asaṃsahyaṃ tasyāḥ saṃlakṣya māriṣa / prāpatan manujās tatra rathebhyo rathinas tadā

vulgate_text: rathamanyaṃ samāruhya vyūhadvāraṃ yayau punaḥ / tamāyāntaṃ tathā dṛṣṭvā bhagnotsāhaṃ guruṃ tadā
ce_text: droṇas tu satvaro rājan kṣipto bhīmena saṃyuge / ratham anyaṃ samāsthāya vyūhadvāram upāyayau

vulgate_text: bhojānīkaṃ samāsādya hārdikyenābhirakṣitam / pramathya tarasā vīrastadapyatibalo'bhyayāt
ce_text: bhojānīkaṃ samāsādya hārdikyenābhirakṣitam / pramathya bahudhā rājan bhīmasenaḥ samabhyayāt

vulgate_text: taṃ tasya ninadaṃ ghoraṃ pārthaḥ śuśrāva nardataḥ / vāsudevaśca kauravya bhīmasenasya saṃyuge
ce_text: arjunaṃ tatra dṛṣṭvātha cukrośa mahato ravān / taṃ tu tasya mahānādaṃ pārthaḥ śuśrāva nardataḥ

vulgate_text: śeṣasya rakṣaṇārthaṃ ca sandhāsyati suyodhanaḥ evaṃ bahuvidhaṃ tasya rājñaścintayatastadā
ce_text: kaccid bhīṣmeṇa no vairam ekenaiva praśāmyati / śeṣasya rakṣaṇārthaṃ ca saṃdhāsyati suyodhanaḥ

vulgate_text: gadāṃ yuyutsamānasya kālasyeveha sañcaya / na hi paśyāmyahaṃ yuddhe yastiṣṭhedagrataḥ pumān
ce_text: gadām udyacchamānasya kālasyeva mahāmṛdhe / na hi paśyāmy ahaṃ tāta yas tiṣṭheta raṇājire

vulgate_text: tatastu sarvayodhānāṃ yatanāṃ prekṣatāṃ tadā / prāvepanniva gātrāṇi karṇabhīmasamāgame
ce_text: prāvepann iva gātrāṇi karṇabhīmasamāgame / rathināṃ sādināṃ caiva tayoḥ śrutvā talasvanam

vulgate_text: samare sarvayodhānāṃ dhanūṃṣyabhyapatankṣitau / śastrāṇi nyapatandorbhyaḥ keṣāñciccāsavo'dravan
ce_text: punar ghoreṇa nādena pāṇḍavasya mahātmanaḥ / samare sarvayodhānāṃ dhanūṃṣy abhyapatan kṣitau

vulgate_text: prādurāsannimittāni ghorāṇi subahūnyuta / gṛdhrakaṅkabalaiścāsīdantarikṣaṃ samāvṛtam
ce_text: prādurāsan nimittāni ghorāṇi ca bahūni ca / tasmiṃs tu tumule rājan bhīmakarṇasamāgame

vulgate_text: kiñcidvicalitaḥ karṇaḥ suprahārābhipīḍitaḥ / ākarṇapūrṇamākṛṣya bhīmaṃ vivyādha sāyakaiḥ
ce_text: kiṃ cid vicalitaḥ karṇaḥ suprahārābhipīḍitaḥ / sasāyakaṃ dhanuḥ kṛtvā bhīmaṃ vivyādha māriṣa / cikṣepa ca punar bāṇāñ śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ

vulgate_text: cikṣepa ca punarbāṇāñśataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ sa śarairarditastena karṇena dṛḍhadhanvinā / dhanurjyāmacchinattūrṇaṃ bhīmastasya kṣureṇa ha
ce_text: sa chādyamānaḥ sahasā karṇena dṛḍhadhanvinā / dhanurjyām acchinat tūrṇam utsmayan pāṇḍunandanaḥ

vulgate_text: sārathiṃ cāsya bhallena rathanīḍādapātayat / vāhāṃśca caturastasya vyasūṃścakre mahārathaḥ
ce_text: sārathiṃ cāsya bhallena prāhiṇod yamasādanam / vāhāṃś ca caturaḥ saṃkhye vyasūṃś cakre mahārathaḥ

vulgate_text: sa śaṅkhabāṇaninadairharṣādrājā svavāhinīm / cakre yudhiṣṭhiraḥ saṅkhye harṣanādaiśca saṅkulām / gāṇḍīvaṃ vyākṣipatpārthaḥ kṛṣṇo'pyabjamavādayat
ce_text: samantāc chaṅkhaninadaṃ pāṇḍusenākarot tadā / śatrusenādhvaniṃ śrutvā tāvakā hy api nānadan / gāṇḍīvaṃ prākṣipat pārthaḥ kṛṣṇo 'py abjam avādayat

vulgate_text: tamantardhāya ninadaṃ bhīmasya nadato dhvaniḥ / aśrūyata tadā rājansarvasainyeṣu dāruṇaḥ
ce_text: tam antardhāya ninadaṃ dhvanir bhīmasya nardataḥ / aśrūyata mahārāja sarvasainyeṣu bhārata

vulgate_text: duśśalaṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā bhīmasenena māriṣa / tasyaiva dhanurādāya karṇo vivyādha pāṇḍavam
ce_text: tathaiva bhīmasenena lokaḥ saṃvadate bhṛśam / kathaṃ droṇo jitaḥ saṃkhye dhanurvedasya pāragaḥ

vulgate_text: kathaṃ droṇo jitaḥ saṅkhye dhanurvedasya pāragaḥ / ityevaṃ bruvate yodhā aśraddheyamidaṃ tava
ce_text: tathaiva bhīmasenena lokaḥ saṃvadate bhṛśam / kathaṃ droṇo jitaḥ saṃkhye dhanurvedasya pāragaḥ

vulgate_text: cintyaṃ bahuvidhaṃ tāta yatkṛtyaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva me / trayo hi samatikrāntāḥ pāṇḍavānāṃ mahārathāḥ
ce_text: cintyaṃ bahu mahārāja kṛtyaṃ yat tatra me śṛṇu / trayo hi samatikrāntāḥ pāṇḍavānāṃ mahārathāḥ / yāvad eva bhayaṃ paścāt tāvad eṣāṃ puraḥsaram

vulgate_text: samprāptaṃ tadidaṃ dyūtaṃ yattacchakunibuddhijam na sabhāyāṃ jayo vṛtto nāpi tatra parājayaḥ / iha no glahamānānāmadya tāvajjayājayau
ce_text: na sabhāyāṃ jayo vṛtto nāpi tatra parājayaḥ / iha no glahamānānām adya tāta jayājayau

vulgate_text: saindhave tu mahaddyūṃta samāsaktaṃ paraiḥ saha / atra te dhruvamāyatto jayo vā'jaya eva vā
ce_text: glahaṃ ca saindhavaṃ rājann atra dyūtasya niścayaḥ / saindhave hi mahādyūtaṃ samāsaktaṃ paraiḥ saha

vulgate_text: tathottamaujāḥ saṅkruddhaḥ śarairhemavibhūṣitaiḥ / avidhyatsārathiṃ cāsya prāhiṇodyamasādanam
ce_text: sārathiṃ cāsya bhallena prāhiṇod yamasādanam / vāhāṃś ca caturaḥ saṃkhye vyasūṃś cakre mahārathaḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ sa hemacitraṃ taṃ gadayā syandanaṃ gatī / saṅkruddhaḥ pothayāmāsa sāśvasūtadhvajaṃ nṛpa
ce_text: tataḥ sa hemacitraṃ taṃ syandanapravaraṃ gadī / gadayā pothayām āsa sāśvasūtadhvajaṃ raṇe

vulgate_text: pāñcālānāṃ tato mukhyau rājaputrau mahārathau / rathāvanyau samāruhya bībhatsumabhijagmutaḥ
ce_text: pāñcālānāṃ tu mukhyau tau rājaputrau mahābalau / ratham anyaṃ samāruhya dhanaṃjayam abhīyatuḥ

vulgate_text: bhayādyasya mahābāho na śete bahulāḥ samāḥ cintayannityaśo vīryaṃ rādheyasya mahātmanaḥ / taṃ kathaṃ sūtaputraṃ tu bhīmo'yodhayatāhave
ce_text: bhayān na śete satataṃ cintayan vai mahāratham / taṃ kathaṃ sūtaputraṃ hi bhīmo 'yudhyata saṃyuge

vulgate_text: yau tau samīyaturvīrau vaikartanavṛkodarau / kathaṃ tāvatra yudhyetāṃ mahābalaparākramau
ce_text: yau tau samīyatur vīrāv arjunasya rathaṃ prati / kathaṃ nu tāv ayudhyetāṃ sūtaputravṛkodarau

vulgate_text: hatvā tasyānugāṃstaṃ ca hantukāmo mahābalaḥ tasmai vyasṛjadugrāṇi vividhāni parantapaḥ / amarṣātpāṇḍavaḥ kruddhaḥ śaravarṣāṇi māriṣa
ce_text: tasmai prāsṛjad ugrāṇi vividhāni paraṃtapaḥ / amarṣī pāṇḍavaḥ kruddhaḥ śaravarṣāṇi māriṣa

vulgate_text: yudhyamānaṃ tu saṃrambhādbhīmasenaṃ hasanniva / abhyapadyata kaunteyaṃ karṇo rājanvṛkodaram
ce_text: saṃrambheṇa tu yudhyantaṃ bhīmasenaṃ smayann iva / abhyapadyata rādheyas tam amarṣī vṛkodaram

vulgate_text: hemapuṅkhā mahāvegā bhīmasenadhanuścyutāḥ / prācchādayaṃste rādheyaṃ śalabhā iva pāvakam
ce_text: hemapuṅkhā mahārāja bhīmasenadhanuścyutāḥ / abhyadravaṃs te rādheyaṃ vṛkāḥ kṣudramṛgaṃ yathā

vulgate_text: rudhirokṣitasarvāṅgo bhīmaseno vyarājata / samṛddhakusumāpīḍo vasante'śokavṛkṣavat
ce_text: rudhirokṣitasarvāṅgo bhīmaseno vyarocata / tapanīyanibhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ palāśa iva kānane

vulgate_text: tattu bhīmo mahābāhoḥ karṇasya caritaṃ raṇe / nāmṛṣyata mahābāhuḥ krodhādudvṛttalocanaḥ
ce_text: tat tu bhīmo mahārāja karṇasya caritaṃ raṇe / nāmṛṣyata maheṣvāsaḥ krodhād udvṛtya cakṣuṣī

vulgate_text: punaranyena bāṇena bhīmasenaḥ pratāpavān / ciccheda kārmukaṃ tūrṇaṃ karṇasya prahasanniva
ce_text: tataḥ karṇasya saṃkruddho bhīmasenaḥ pratāpavān / ciccheda kārmukaṃ tūrṇaṃ sarvopakaraṇāni ca

vulgate_text: te jagmurdharaṇīmāśu karṇaṃ nirbhidya patriṇaḥ / yathā jaladharaṃ bhittvā divākaramarīcayaḥ
ce_text: te jagmur dharaṇīṃ sarve karṇaṃ nirbhidya māriṣa / yathā hi jaladaṃ bhittvā rājan sūryasya raśmayaḥ

vulgate_text: punareva tayo rājanghora āsītsamāgamaḥ / vaikartanasya śūrasya bhīmasya ca mahātmanaḥ
ce_text: punar eva tato rājan mahān āsīt sudāruṇaḥ / vimardaḥ sūtaputrasya bhīmasya ca viśāṃ pate

vulgate_text: krodharakrekṣaṇau tīvrau niḥśvasantāvivoragau / śūrāvanyonyamāsādya tatakṣaturarindamau
ce_text: krodharaktekṣaṇau kruddhau niḥśvasantau mahārathau / yuddhe 'nyonyaṃ samāsādya tatakṣatur ariṃdamau

vulgate_text: tābhyāṃ muktāḥ śarā rājangārdhrapatrāścakāśire / śreṇyaḥ śaradi mattānāṃ sārasanāmivāmbare
ce_text: tābhyāṃ muktā vyakāśanta kaṅkabarhiṇavāsasaḥ / paṅktyaḥ śaradi mattānāṃ sārasānām ivāmbare

vulgate_text: śamakāmaḥ sasodaryo dīrghaprekṣī yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / aśakta iti matvā tu mama putrairnirākṛtaḥ
ce_text: śamakāmaḥ sadā pārtho dīrghaprekṣī yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / aśakta iti manvānaiḥ putrair mama nirākṛtaḥ

vulgate_text: atha karṇaḥ śaravrātairbhīmasenaṃ samārpayat / nanāda ca mahānādaṃ punarvivyādha corasi
ce_text: atha karṇaḥ śaravrātair bhīmaṃ balavad ardayat / nanāda balavan nādaṃ punar vivyādha corasi

vulgate_text: karṇastu navabhirbhīmaṃ bhittvā rājaṃstanāntare / dhvajamekena vivyādha viśokaṃ ca tribhiḥ śaraiḥ
ce_text: karṇas tu navabhir bhīmaṃ viddhvā rājan stanāntare / dhvajam ekena vivyādha sāyakena śitena ha

vulgate_text: tato bhīmo mahābāhuḥ krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ vajrakalpāṃ catuṣkiṣkuṃ gurvī rukmāṅgadāṃ gadām / prāhiṇotmūtaputrāya ṣaḍasrāmavicārayan
ce_text: sarvaśaikyāṃ catuṣkiṣkuṃ gurvīṃ rukmāṅgadāṃ gadām / prāhiṇot sūtaputrāya ṣaḍasrām avicārayan

vulgate_text: āgaskṛtamivātmānaṃ mene cādhirathistadā / yatpratyakṣaṃ tava sutā bhīmena nihatā raṇe
ce_text: āgaskṛtam ivātmānaṃ mene cādhirathis tadā / bhīmasenaṃ tataḥ kruddhaḥ samādravata saṃbhramāt

vulgate_text: avicintyātha tānbāṇānkarṇenāstānvṛkodaraḥ / raṇe vivyādha rādheyaṃ śareṇānataparvaṇā
ce_text: avahāsaṃ tu taṃ pārtho nāmṛṣyata vṛkodaraḥ / tato vivyādha rādheyaṃ śatena nataparvaṇām

vulgate_text: tāmāpatantīmālakṣya bhīmaseno mahāgadām / śarairavārayadrājansarvasainyasya paśyataḥ
ce_text: tām āpatantīṃ sahasā gadāṃ dṛṣṭvā vṛkodaraḥ / śarair avārayad rājan sarvasainyasya paśyataḥ

vulgate_text: taṃ parāṅmukhamālokya padātiṃ sūtanandanam / kaunteyaśarasañchannaṃ rājā duryodhano'bravīt
ce_text: rādheyaṃ tu raṇe dṛṣṭvā padātinam avasthitam / bhīmasenena saṃrabdhaṃ rājā duryodhano 'bravīt / tvaradhvaṃ sarvato yattā rādheyasya rathaṃ prati

vulgate_text: citrāyudhaścitravarmā samare citrayodhinaḥ / tānāpatata evāśu bhīmaseno mahārathaḥ
ce_text: citropacitraś citrākṣaś cārucitraḥ śarāsanaḥ / citrāyudhaś citravarmā samare citrayodhinaḥ

vulgate_text: ekaikena śareṇājau pātayāmāsa te sutān / te hatā nyapatanbhūmau vātarūgṇā iva drumāḥ
ce_text: āgacchatas tān sahasā bhīmo rājan mahārathaḥ / sāśvasūtadhvajān yattān pātayām āsa saṃyuge / te hatā nyapatan bhūmau vātanunnā iva drumāḥ

vulgate_text: tāvanyonyaṃ śarairbhittvā svarṇapuṅkhaiḥ śilāśitaiḥ / vyabhrājetāṃ yathā meghau saṃsyūtau sūryaraśmibhiḥ
ce_text: tāv anyonyaṃ śarair viddhvā svarṇapuṅkhaiḥ śilāśitaiḥ / vyabhrājetāṃ mahārāja puṣpitāv iva kiṃśukau

vulgate_text: krodhāgnitejasā diptau saṃrambhādraktalocanau / vyabhrājetāṃ mahārāja vidhūmāviva pāvakau
ce_text: tāv anyonyaṃ śarair viddhvā svarṇapuṅkhaiḥ śilāśitaiḥ / vyabhrājetāṃ mahārāja puṣpitāv iva kiṃśukau

vulgate_text: vyāghrāviva naravyāghrau daṃṣṭrābhiritaretaram / śaradhārāsṛjau vīrau meghāviva vavarṣatuḥ
ce_text: vyāghrāv iva naravyāghrau daṃṣṭrābhir itaretaram / śaradaṃṣṭrā vidhunvānau tatakṣatur ariṃdamau

vulgate_text: nādayantau praharṣantau vikrīḍantau parasparam / maṇḍalāni vikurvāṇau rathābhyāṃ rathiṣūttamau
ce_text: tau rathābhyāṃ mahārāja maṇḍalāvartanādiṣu / vyarocetāṃ mahātmānau vṛtravajradharāv iva

vulgate_text: tato bhīmo mahābāhurbāhubhyāṃ vikṣipandhanuḥ / vyarājata raṇe rājansavidyudiva toyadaḥ
ce_text: sahastābharaṇābhyāṃ tu bhujābhyāṃ vikṣipan dhanuḥ / vyarocata raṇe bhīmaḥ savidyud iva toyadaḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ śarasahasreṇa samyagastena bhārata / pāṇḍavo vyakiratkarṇaṃ bhīmo bhīmaparākramaḥ
ce_text: tataḥ śarasahasreṇa dhanurmuktena bhārata / pāṇḍavo vyakirat karṇaṃ ghano 'drim iva vṛṣṭibhiḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ karṇo mahārāja bhīmaṃ viddhā tribhiḥ śūraiḥ punaśca ṣaḍbhistīkṣṇāgrairavidhyatkaṅkapatribhiḥ / mumoca śaravarṣāṇi vicitrāṇi bahūni ca
ce_text: tataḥ karṇo mahārāja bhīmaṃ viddhvā tribhiḥ śaraiḥ / mumoca śaravarṣāṇi citrāṇi ca bahūni ca

vulgate_text: sa karṇaṃ karṇinā karṇe pītena niśitena ca / vivyādha subhṛśaṃ saṅkhye tailadhautena māriṣa
ce_text: sa karṇaṃ karṇinā karṇe pītena niśitena ca / vivyādha yudhi rājendra bhīmasenaḥ patatriṇā

vulgate_text: athāpareṇa bhallena sūtaputraṃ stanāntare / ājaghāna bhṛśaṃ kruddho hasanniva vṛkodaraḥ
ce_text: athāpareṇa bhallena sūtaputraṃ stanāntare / ājaghāna bhṛśaṃ bhīmaḥ smayann iva mahābalaḥ

vulgate_text: punarasya tvaranbhīpo nārācāndaśa bhārata / raṇe praiṣīnmahābāhurnirmuktāśīviṣopamān
ce_text: punar asya tvaran bhīmo nārācān daśa bhārata / raṇe praiṣīn mahāvegān yamadaṇḍopamāṃs tathā

vulgate_text: tāvubhau naraśārdūlau śārdūlāviva daṃṣṭriṇau śaradaṃṣṭrau samāsādya tatakṣaturarindamau / jimūtāviva cānyonyaṃ pravavarṣaturāhave
ce_text: jīmūtāv iva cānyonyaṃ tau vavarṣatur āhave / talaśabdaravaiś caiva trāsayantau parasparam

vulgate_text: anyonyaṃ samare kruddhau kṛtapratikṛtaiṣiṇau / tato bhīmo mahābāhuḥ sūtaputrasya bhārata
ce_text: śarajālaiś ca vividhaiś chādayām āsatur mṛdhe / anyonyaṃ samare kruddhau kṛtapratikṛtaiṣiṇau

vulgate_text: anyatkārmukamādatta bhāraghnaṃ vegavattaram / tadapyatha nimeṣārdhāccicchedāsya vṛkodaraḥ
ce_text: tataḥ prahasyādhirathir anyad ādatta kārmukam / śatrughnaṃ samare kruddho dṛḍhajyaṃ vegavattaram

vulgate_text: te tu cāpabaloddhūtāḥ śātakumbhavibhūṣitāḥ / ajasramapatanbāṇā bhīmasenarathaṃ prati
ce_text: te tu cāpabaloddhūtāḥ śātakumbhavibhūṣitāḥ / ajasram anvakīryanta śarāḥ pārtharathaṃ prati

vulgate_text: cāpādādhirathermuktāḥ prapatantaścakāśire / eko dīrgha ivātyarthamākāśe saṃsthitaḥ śaraḥ
ce_text: cāpād ādhirather muktāḥ prapatantaḥ sma sāyakāḥ / eko dīrgha iva prāṃśuḥ prabhavan dṛśyate śaraḥ

vulgate_text: tatra bhārata bhīmasya balaṃ vīryaṃ parākramam / vyavasāyaṃ ca putrāste dadṛśuḥ sahasainikāḥ
ce_text: tatra bhārata bhīmasya balavīryaparākramam / vyavasāyaṃ ca putrās te praikṣanta kurubhiḥ saha

vulgate_text: tasyāśvāṃśca punarhatvā sūtaṃ vivyādha pañcabhiḥ / sopasṛtya drutaṃ sūto yudhāmanyo rathaṃ yayau
ce_text: athāsyāśvān punar hatvā tribhir vivyādha sārathim / so 'vaplutya drutaṃ sūto yuyudhānarathaṃ yayau

vulgate_text: vihasanniva bhīmasya kruddhaḥ kālānaladyutiḥ / dhvajaṃ ciccheda rādheyaḥ patākāṃ ca vyapātayat
ce_text: utsmayann iva bhīmasya kruddhaḥ kālānalaprabhaḥ / dhvajaṃ ciccheda rādheyaḥ patākāś ca nyapātayat

vulgate_text: sā'pataddṛśadhā chinnā karṇasya niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ / asyataḥ sūtaputrasya mitrārthe citrayodhinaḥ
ce_text: sāpatad daśadhā rājan nikṛttā karṇasāyakaiḥ / asyataḥ sūtaputrasya mitrārthe citrayodhinaḥ

vulgate_text: sa carmādatta kaunteyo jātarūpapariṣkṛtam / khaṅgaṃ cānyataraprepsurjayaṃ maraṇameva vā
ce_text: sa carmādatta kaunteyo jātarūpapariṣkṛtam / khaḍgaṃ cānyataraprepsur mṛtyor agre jayasya vā / tad asya sahasā karṇo vyadhamat prahasann iva

vulgate_text: sa dhanuḥ sūtaputrasya sajyaṃ chittvā mahānasiḥ / papāta bhuvi rājendra kruddhaḥ sarpa ivāmbarāt
ce_text: sa dhanuḥ sūtaputrasya chittvā jyāṃ ca susaṃśitaḥ / apatad bhuvi nistriṃśaś cyutaḥ sarpa ivāmbarāt

vulgate_text: sa vadhyamāno balavānkarṇacāpacyutaiḥ śaraiḥ / vaihāyasaṃ prākramaddhai karṇasya rathamāviśat
ce_text: sa bhīmasenaḥ kupito balavān satyavikramaḥ / vihāyasaṃ prākramad vai karṇasya vyathayan manaḥ

vulgate_text: mahauṣadhisamāyuktaṃ hanūmāniva parvatam / tamasya viśikhaiḥ karṇo vyadhamatkuñjaraṃ punaḥ
ce_text: tam asya viśikhaiḥ karṇo vyadhamat kuñjaraṃ punaḥ / hastyaṅgāny atha karṇāya prāhiṇot pāṇḍavo nadan

vulgate_text: apriyaṃ sumahatkṛtvā sindhurājaḥ kirīṭinaḥ kruddhasya devarājasya śakrasyeva mahādyuteḥ / cakṣurviṣayamāpannaḥ kathaṃ jīvitamāpnuyāt
ce_text: apriyaṃ sumahat kṛtvā sindhurājaḥ kirīṭinaḥ / cakṣurviṣayam āpannaḥ kathaṃ mucyeta jīvitaḥ

vulgate_text: udīcīṃ dakṣiṇāṃ prācīṃ pratīcīṃ vidiśastathā / punarmadhyagato vīra āhave yuddhadurmadaḥ
ce_text: udīcīṃ dakṣiṇāṃ prācīṃ pratīcīṃ prasṛtas tathā / nṛtyann ivācarac chūro yathā rathaśataṃ tathā

vulgate_text: ekaḥ paryacaranraṅge bahudhā sa mahābalaḥ / nṛtyannivācaracchūro yathā rathaśataṃ tathā
ce_text: udīcīṃ dakṣiṇāṃ prācīṃ pratīcīṃ prasṛtas tathā / nṛtyann ivācarac chūro yathā rathaśataṃ tathā

vulgate_text: tairvyavāharadāryātmā muhūrtādeva sātyakiḥ / tataḥ kaliṅgairyuyudhe so'cintyabalavikramaḥ
ce_text: tān nyavārayad āyastān muhūrtam iva sātyakiḥ / tataḥ kaliṅgair yuyudhe so 'cintyabalavikramaḥ

vulgate_text: nāhaṃ bhīṣayituṃ śakyo vāṅmātreṇa tu kevalam / sa māṃ nihanyātsaṅgrāme yo māṃ kuryānnirāyudham
ce_text: sa māṃ nihanyāt saṃgrāme yo māṃ kuryān nirāyudham / samās tu śāśvatīr hanyād yo māṃ hanyād dhi saṃyuge

vulgate_text: cirakālepsitaṃ loke yuddhamadyāstu kaurava tvarate me matistāta tava yuddhābhikāṅkṣiṇī / nāhatvā'haṃ nivartiṣye tvāmadya puruṣādhama
ce_text: tvarate me matis tāta tvayi yuddhābhikāṅkṣiṇi / nāhatvā saṃnivartiṣye tvām adya puruṣādhama

vulgate_text: asibhyāṃ carmaṇī citre śatacandre narādhipa / nikṛtya puruṣavyāghrau bāhuyuddhaṃ pracakratuḥ
ce_text: asibhyāṃ carmaṇī śubhre vipule ca śarāvare / nikṛtya puruṣavyāghrau bāhuyuddhaṃ pracakratuḥ

vulgate_text: dvipāviva viṣāṇāgraiḥ śṛṅgairiva maharṣabhau / bhujayokrāvabandhaiśca śirobhyāṃ cāvaghātanaiḥ
ce_text: dvipāv iva viṣāṇāgraiḥ śṛṅgair iva maharṣabhau / yuyudhāte mahātmānau kurusātvatapuṃgavau

vulgate_text: gatapratyāgatākṣepaiḥ pātanotthānasamputaiḥ / yuyudhāte mahātmānau kurusātvatapuṅgavau
ce_text: dvipāv iva viṣāṇāgraiḥ śṛṅgair iva maharṣabhau / yuyudhāte mahātmānau kurusātvatapuṃgavau

vulgate_text: tathā tu kṛṣyamāṇaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā sātyakimāhave / vāsudevastadā vākyaṃ bhūyo'pyarjunamabravīt
ce_text: tathā tu parikṛṣyantaṃ dṛṣṭvā sātvatam āhave / vāsudevas tato rājan bhūyo 'rjunam abhāṣata

vulgate_text: pravaraṃ vṛṣṇivīrāṇāṃ yannihantyeṣa sātyakim / mahādvipamivāraṇye karṣanniva harirbhṛśam
ce_text: pravaraṃ vṛṣṇivīrāṇāṃ yan na hanyād dhi sātyakim / mahādvipam ivāraṇye mṛgendra iva karṣati

vulgate_text: evaṃ tu manasā rājanpārthaḥ sampūjya kauravam / ayudhyatāribhirvīrastaṃ ca samprekṣate muhuḥ
ce_text: evaṃ tu manasā rājan pārthaḥ saṃpūjya kauravam / vāsudevaṃ mahābāhur arjunaḥ pratyabhāṣata

vulgate_text: atha kośādviniṣkṛṣya khaṅgaṃ bhūriśravāḥ śitam mūrdhajeṣu ca jagrāha padā corasyātāḍayat / ākramya cāpyathodyamya sahāsiṃ subhujo bhujam
ce_text: atha kośād viniṣkṛṣya khaḍgaṃ bhūriśravā raṇe / mūrdhajeṣu nijagrāha padā corasy atāḍayat

vulgate_text: eṣa tvasukaraṃ karma yādavārthe karomyaham mama śiṣyo mamārthāya yudhyate mama śatrubhiḥ / taṃ kṛṣṇa mokṣayiṣyāmi dāvātsiṃhaśiśuṃ yathā
ce_text: saindhavāsaktadṛṣṭitvān nainaṃ paśyāmi mādhava / eṣa tv asukaraṃ karma yādavārthe karomy aham

vulgate_text: ityuktvā vacanaṃ kurvanvāsudevasya pāṇḍavaḥ / tataḥ kṣurapraṃ niśitaṃ gāṇḍīve samayojayat
ce_text: ity uktvā vacanaṃ kurvan vāsudevasya pāṇḍavaḥ / sakhaḍgaṃ yajñaśīlasya patriṇā bāhum acchinat

vulgate_text: sa bāhurnyapatadbhūmau sakhaṅgaḥ saśubhāṅgadaḥ ādadhajjīvalokasya duḥkhamadbhutamuttamaḥ / yantramukto mahendrasya dhvajo vṛttotsavo yathā
ce_text: sa bāhur apatad bhūmau sakhaḍgaḥ saśubhāṅgadaḥ / ādadhaj jīvalokasya duḥkham uttamam uttamaḥ

vulgate_text: yeṣu yeṣu naraḥ pārtha vartate susamāhitaḥ / āśu tacchīlatāmeti tadidaṃ dṛśyate tvayi
ce_text: yeṣu yeṣu naraḥ pārtha yatra yatra ca vartate / āśu tacchīlatām eti tad idaṃ tvayi dṛśyate

vulgate_text: āttaśastrasya hi raṇe vṛṣṇiputraṃ jighāṃsataḥ / chinnavānyadahaṃ bāhuṃ naitallokavigarhitam
ce_text: āttaśastrasya hi raṇe vṛṣṇivīraṃ jighāṃsataḥ / yad ahaṃ bāhum acchaitsaṃ na sa dharmo vigarhitaḥ

vulgate_text: tataste sarvasenāsu janāḥ kṛṣṇadhanañjayau / garhayāmāsurapyetau śaśaṃsurbhūridakṣiṇam
ce_text: tataḥ sa sarvasenāyāṃ janaḥ kṛṣṇadhanaṃjayau / garhayām āsa taṃ cāpi śaśaṃsa puruṣarṣabham

vulgate_text: nyastaśastrasya bālasya virathasya vivarmaṇaḥ / nābhimanyorvadhaṃ yūyaṃ garhayadhvaṃ kutastadā
ce_text: nyastaśastrasya bālasya virathasya vivarmaṇaḥ / abhimanyor vadhaṃ tāta dhārmikaḥ ko na pūjayet

vulgate_text: martavyameva sarveṇa caramaṃ pūrvameva vā / manyadhvaṃ mṛta ityeṣa mābhūdvo buddhilāghavam
ce_text: ceṣṭamānaṃ pratīghāte sabhujaṃ māṃ sacakṣuṣaḥ / manyadhvaṃ mṛtam ity evam etad vo buddhilāghavam / yukto hy asya pratīghātaḥ kṛto me kurupuṃgavāḥ

vulgate_text: api cāpaṃ purā gītaḥ śloko vālmīkinā bhuvi / na hantavyāḥ striya iti yadbravīṣi plavaṅgama
ce_text: api cāyaṃ purā gītaḥ śloko vālmīkinā bhuvi / pīḍākaram amitrāṇāṃ yat syāt kartavyam eva tat

vulgate_text: sarvakālaṃ manuṣyeṇa vyavasāyavatā sadā pīḍākaramamitrāṇāṃ yatsyātkartavyameva tat / anuṣṭhitaṃ mayā tacca kasmādgarhatha mūḍhavat
ce_text: api cāyaṃ purā gītaḥ śloko vālmīkinā bhuvi / pīḍākaram amitrāṇāṃ yat syāt kartavyam eva tat

vulgate_text: brahmaṇastvabhavatputro mānaso'trirmahātapāḥ / atreḥ putro'bhavatsomaḥ somasya tu budhaḥ smṛtaḥ
ce_text: atreḥ putro 'bhavat somaḥ somasya tu budhaḥ smṛtaḥ / budhasyāsīn mahendrābhaḥ putra ekaḥ purūravāḥ

vulgate_text: budhasyailo mahābāhuḥ putra āsītpurūravāḥ / purūravasa āyustu āyuṣo nahuṣaḥ sutaḥ
ce_text: purūravasa āyus tu āyuṣo nahuṣaḥ smṛtaḥ / nahuṣasya yayātis tu rājarṣir devasaṃmitaḥ

vulgate_text: tayoryuddhamabhūdrājandinārdhaṃ citramudbhatam / bāhuyuddhaṃ subalinoḥ prasaktaṃ puruṣarṣabhaḥ
ce_text: tayor yuddham abhūd rājan dinārdhaṃ citram adbhutam / bāhuyuddhaṃ subalinoḥ śakraprahrādayor iva

vulgate_text: apātayacca samare saumadattiḥ śineḥ sutam / paśyatāṃ sarvasainyānāṃ padā cainamatāḍayat
ce_text: sa tena varadānena labdhavān bhūridakṣiṇam / nyapātayac ca samare saumadattiḥ śineḥ sutam

vulgate_text: yo'sau karṇena vīrasya vārṣṇeyasya samāgamaḥ / hate tu bhūriśravasi tadyuddhamabhavatkatham
ce_text: yo 'sau karṇena vīreṇa vārṣṇeyasya samāgamaḥ / hate tu bhūriśravasi saindhave ca nipātite

vulgate_text: hanta te kathayiṣyāmi yathāvṛttaṃ mahāraṇe paśyatāṃ sarvasainyānāṃ keśavāryunayorapi / śuśrūṣasva sthiro bhūtvā durācaritamātmanaḥ
ce_text: hanta te varṇayiṣyāmi yathāvṛttaṃ mahāraṇe / śuśrūṣasva sthiro bhūtvā durācaritam ātmanaḥ

vulgate_text: ratho me yujyatāṃ kalyamiti rājanmahābālaḥ na hi devā na gandharvā na yakṣoragarākṣasāḥ / mānavā vā'pi jetāraḥ kṛṣṇayoḥ santi kecana
ce_text: na hi devā na gandharvā na yakṣoragarākṣasāḥ / mānavā vā vijetāraḥ kṛṣṇayoḥ santi ke cana

vulgate_text: taṃ tu sakrodhamālokya sātyakiḥ pratyayudhyata / mahatā śaravarṣeṇa gajaṃ pratigajo yathā
ce_text: taṃ tu saṃprekṣya saṃkruddhaṃ sātyakiḥ pratyavidhyata / mahatā śaravarṣeṇa gajaḥ pratigajaṃ yathā

vulgate_text: tathā tu virathaṃ karṇaṃ putrāṃśca paripālayan / duḥśāsanamukhānvīrānnāvadhītsātyakirvaśī
ce_text: tathā tu virathe karṇe putrān vai tava pārthiva / duḥśāsanamukhāñ śūrān nāvadhīt sātyakir vaśī

vulgate_text: kṛṣṇayoḥ sadṛśo vīrye sātyakiḥ śatrutāpanaḥ / jitavānsarvasainyāni tāvakāni hasanniva
ce_text: kṛṣṇayoḥ sadṛśo vīrye sātyakiḥ śatrukarśanaḥ / kṛṣṇo vāpi bhavel loke pārtho vāpi dhanurdharaḥ / śaineyo vā naravyāghraś caturtho nopalabhyate

vulgate_text: kṛṣṇo vā'pi bhavelloke pārtho bā'pi dhanurdharaḥ / śaineyo vā naravyāghra caturthastu na vidyate
ce_text: kṛṣṇayoḥ sadṛśo vīrye sātyakiḥ śatrukarśanaḥ / kṛṣṇo vāpi bhavel loke pārtho vāpi dhanurdharaḥ / śaineyo vā naravyāghraś caturtho nopalabhyate

vulgate_text: tattathā prayatiṣye'haṃ paraṃ śaktyāḷḷḷḷsuyodhana / yathā pāṇḍavamukhyo'sau na haniṣyāti saindhavam
ce_text: yotsyāmi tu tathā rājañ śaktyāhaṃ parayā raṇe / yathā pāṇḍavamukhyo 'sau na haniṣyati saindhavam

vulgate_text: saindhavārthe paraṃ yatnaṃ kariṣyāmyadya saṃyuge / tvatpriyārthaṃ mahārāja jayo daive pratiṣṭhitaḥ
ce_text: adya yotsye 'rjunam ahaṃ pauruṣaṃ svaṃ vyapāśritaḥ / tvadarthaṃ puruṣavyāghra jayo daive pratiṣṭhitaḥ

vulgate_text: ciccheda niśitairbāṇaiḥ śūrāṇāmanivartinām
ce_text: ciccheda tīkṣṇāgramukhaiḥ śūrāṇām anivartinām / bhujān parighasaṃkāśān hastihastopamān raṇe

vulgate_text: hastihastāndvipaskandhānrathākṣāṃśca samantataḥ / śoṇitāktānhayārohāngṛhītaprāsatomarān
ce_text: śoṇitāktān hayārohān gṛhītaprāsatomarān / kṣuraiś ciccheda bībhatsur dvidhaikaikaṃ tridhaiva ca

vulgate_text: kṣuraiściccheda bībhatsurdvidhaikaikaṃ tridhaiva ca hayānvāraṇamukhyāṃśca padātīṃśca samantataḥ / dhvajāṃśchatrāṇi cāpāni cāmarāṇi śirāṃsi ca
ce_text: hayavāraṇamukhyāś ca prāpatanta sahasraśaḥ / dhvajāś chatrāṇi cāpāni cāmarāṇi śirāṃsi ca

vulgate_text: athānyaddhanurādāya sūtaputraḥ pratāpavān / sāyakairaṣṭasāhasraiśchādayāmāsa pāṇḍavam
ce_text: athānyad dhanur ādāya sūtaputraḥ pratāpavān / karṇo 'pi dviṣatāṃ hantā chādayām āsa phalgunam / sāyakair bahusāhasraiḥ kṛtapratikṛtepsayā

vulgate_text: yatnādrakṣata rādheyaṃ nāhatvā samare'rjunam / nivartiṣyati rādheyo na vā'jitvā'dya phalgunaṃ
ce_text: tato duryodhano rājaṃs tāvakān abhyabhāṣata / yattā rakṣata rādheyaṃ nāhatvā samare 'rjunam / nivartiṣyati rādheya iti mām uktavān vṛṣaḥ

vulgate_text: madrarājaśca kaunteyamavidhyattriṃśatā śaraiḥ / āvavre'rjunamārgaṃ ca śarajālena bhārata
ce_text: madrarājas tu kaunteyam avidhyat triṃśatā śaraiḥ / śāradvatas tu viṃśatyā vāsudevaṃ samārpayat / dhanaṃjayaṃ dvādaśabhir ājaghāna śilīmukhaiḥ

vulgate_text: ādadānaṃ mahārāja sandadhānaṃ ca pāṇḍavam / utkarṣantaṃ sṛjantaṃ ca na sma paśyāma lāghavāt
ce_text: ādadānaṃ maheṣvāsaṃ saṃdadhānaṃ ca pāṇḍavam / visṛjantaṃ ca kaunteyaṃ nānupaśyāmahe tadā

vulgate_text: nikṣipantaṃ mahāstrāṇi prekṣaṇīyaṃ dhanañjayam / nṛtyantaṃ rathamārgeṣu dhanurjyātalanādinam
ce_text: saṃrabdhāḥ saindhavasyārthe samāvṛṇvan kirīṭinam / nṛtyantaṃ rathamārgeṣu dhanurjyātalanisvanaiḥ

vulgate_text: nirīkṣituṃ na śekuste yatnavanto'pi pārthivāḥ / madhyandinagataṃ sūryaṃ pratapantamivāmbare
ce_text: madhyaṃdinagataṃ sūryaṃ pratapantam ivāmbare / na śekuḥ sarvabhūtāni pāṇḍavaṃ prativīkṣitum

vulgate_text: evaṃ tattava rājendra caturaṅgabalaṃ tadā / vyākulīkṛtya kaunteyo jayadrathamupādravat
ce_text: tathā sarvā diśo rājan sarvāṃś ca rathino raṇe / ākulīkṛtya kaunteyo jayadratham upādravat / vivyādha ca catuḥṣaṣṭyā śarāṇāṃ nataparvaṇām

vulgate_text: ākarṇapūrṇāṃścikṣepa phalgunasya rathaṃ prati / tribhistu vidvā govindaṃ nārācaiḥ ṣaḍbhirarjunam
ce_text: tribhis tu viddhvā gāṇḍīvaṃ nārācaiḥ ṣaḍbhir arjunam / aṣṭābhir vājino 'vidhyad dhvajaṃ caikena patriṇā

vulgate_text: aṣṭabhirvājino'vidhyaddhvajaṃ caikena patriṇā / bhūyaścaivārjunaṃ saṅkhye śaravarṣairavākirat
ce_text: tribhis tu viddhvā gāṇḍīvaṃ nārācaiḥ ṣaḍbhir arjunam / aṣṭābhir vājino 'vidhyad dhvajaṃ caikena patriṇā

vulgate_text: sa cchinnayaṣṭiḥ sumahāndhanañjayaśarāhataḥ / varāhaḥ sindhurājasya papātendusamaprabhaḥ
ce_text: sa chinnayaṣṭiḥ sumahāñ śīryamāṇaḥ śarāhataḥ / varāhaḥ sindhurājasya papātāgniśikhopamaḥ

vulgate_text: evaṃ tūṇīśayaṃ ghoramindrāśanisamaprabham varmabhedinamatyarthaṃ gandhamālyārcitaṃ sadā / visasarja tatastūrṇaṃ saindhavasya rathaṃ prati
ce_text: sarvabhārasahaṃ śaśvadgandhamālyārcitaṃ śaram / visasarjārjunas tūrṇaṃ saindhavasya vadhe vṛtaḥ

vulgate_text: śrutvā tu vacanaṃ tasya tvaramāṇo'stramāyayā tathā'haracchirastasya śarairūrdhvaṃ dhanañjayaḥ / durhṛdāmapaharṣāya suhṛdāṃ harṣaṇāya ca
ce_text: aharat tat punaś caiva śarair ūrdhvaṃ dhanaṃjayaḥ / durhṛdām apraharṣāya suhṛdāṃ harṣaṇāya ca

vulgate_text: śaraiḥ kandukavatkṛtvā tasyālokāya pāṇḍavaḥ / syamantapañcakādbāhye śirastadaharaccharaiḥ
ce_text: śaraiḥ kadambakīkṛtya kāle tasmiṃś ca pāṇḍavaḥ / samantapañcakād bāhyaṃ śiras tad vyaharat tataḥ

vulgate_text: tasyāpi śatadhā mūrdhā phaliṣyati na saṃśayaḥ / yadi cedasti me lābhastapaso vā damasya vā
ce_text: saṃgrāme yudhyamānasya vahato mahatīṃ dhuram / dharaṇyāṃ mama putrasya pātayiṣyati yaḥ śiraḥ / tasyāpi śatadhā mūrdhā phaliṣyati na saṃśayaḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ sumahadāścaryaṃ tatrāpaśyāma bhārata / syamantapañcakādbāhyaṃ śiro yadvyaharattataḥ
ce_text: śaraiḥ kadambakīkṛtya kāle tasmiṃś ca pāṇḍavaḥ / samantapañcakād bāhyaṃ śiras tad vyaharat tataḥ

vulgate_text: tato dṛṣṭvā vinihataṃ sindhurājaṃ jayadratham / karmaṇā tena pārthasya vismitāḥ sarvadevatāḥ
ce_text: tato dṛṣṭvā vinihataṃ sindhurājaṃ jayadratham / putrāṇāṃ tava netrebhyo duḥkhād bahv apataj jalam

vulgate_text: dṛṣṭvā tu nihataṃ saṅkhye sindhurājaṃ mahāratham / putrāṇāṃ tava netrebhyo duḥkhādāsraṃ pravartata
ce_text: tato dṛṣṭvā vinihataṃ sindhurājaṃ jayadratham / putrāṇāṃ tava netrebhyo duḥkhād bahv apataj jalam

vulgate_text: paśyatāṃ sarvasainyānāṃ māmakānāṃ mahāraṇe / ahanyata kathaṃ yuddhe saindhavaḥ savyasācinā
ce_text: paśyatāṃ sarvasainyānāṃ keśavasya mamaiva ca / viratho bhīmasenena kṛto 'si bahuśo raṇe / na ca tvāṃ paruṣaṃ kiṃ cid uktavān paṇḍunandanaḥ

vulgate_text: tena nātibhṛśaṃ trastau viśikhairbhṛśapīḍitau / bahutvāttu parāmārtiṃ śarāṇāṃ tāvagacchatām
ce_text: te nātibhṛśam abhyaghnan viśikhā jayacoditāḥ / bahutvāt tu parām ārtiṃ śarāṇāṃ tāv agacchatām

vulgate_text: dṛṣṭvā śāradvataṃ pārtho mūrcchitaṃ śarapīḍitam dhigdhiṅmāmiti caivoktvā kṛpaṇaṃ paryadevayat / aśrupūrṇamukho dīno vacanaṃ cedamabravīt
ce_text: dṛṣṭvā śāradvataṃ pārtho mūrchitaṃ śarapīḍitam / ratha eva maheṣvāsaḥ kṛpaṇaṃ paryadevayat

vulgate_text: putraśokābhitaptena śarairabhyarditena ca / abhyasto bahubhirbāṇairdaśadharmagatena vai
ce_text: śarārditena hi mayā prekṣaṇīyo mahādyutiḥ / pratyasto bahubhir bāṇair daśadharmagatena vai

vulgate_text: śarārditaḥ sa hi mayā prekṣamāṇo mahādyutiḥ śocayatyeṣa niyataṃ bhūyaḥ putravadhāddhi mām / kṛpaṇaṃ svarathe sannaṃ paśya kṛṣṇa yathāgatam
ce_text: śocayaty eṣa nipatan bhūyaḥ putravadhād dhi mām / kṛpaṇaṃ svarathe sannaṃ paśya kṛṣṇa yathā gatam

vulgate_text: atyadbhutamidaṃ kṛṣṇa kṛtaṃ pārthena dhīmatā / diṣṭyā paśyāmi saṅgrāme tīrṇabhārau mahārathau
ce_text: diṣṭyā paśyāmi saṃgrāme tīrṇabhārau mahārathau / diṣṭyā ca nihataḥ pāpaḥ saindhavaḥ puruṣādhamaḥ

vulgate_text: kṛṣṇa diṣṭyā mama prītirmahatī pratipāditā / tvayā guptena govinda ghnatā pāpaṃ jayadratham
ce_text: kṛṣṇa diṣṭyā mama prītir mahatī pratipāditā / diṣṭyā śatrugaṇāś caiva nimagnāḥ śokasāgare

vulgate_text: purāṇaṃ paramaṃ devaṃ devadevaṃ sanātanam / ye prapannāḥ suraguruṃ na te muhyanti karhicit
ce_text: sraṣṭāraṃ sarvalokānāṃ paramātmānam acyutam / ye prapannā hṛṣīkeśaṃ na te muhyanti karhi cit

vulgate_text: gāyanti caturo vedā yaśca deveṣu gīyate / taṃ prapadya mahātmānaṃ bhūtimaśnāmyanuttamām
ce_text: yo 'gāta caturo vedān yaś ca vedeṣu gīyate / taṃ prapadya mahātmānaṃ bhūtim āpnoty anuttamām

vulgate_text: jñānayoniṃ hariṃ viṣṇuṃ mumukṣūṇāṃ parāyaṇam / paraṃ purāṇaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇānāṃ paraṃ ca yat
ce_text: paraṃ purāṇaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇānāṃ paraṃ ca yat / prapadyatas taṃ paramaṃ parā bhūtir vidhīyate

vulgate_text: durlabho vijayasteṣāṃ samprāme ripughātinām / yātā mṛtyuvaśaṃ te vai yeṣāṃ kruddho'pi mādhava
ce_text: durlabho hi jayas teṣāṃ saṃgrāme ripusūdana / yātā mṛtyuvaśaṃ te vai yeṣāṃ kruddho 'si pāṇḍava

vulgate_text: diṣṭyā droṇo jitaḥ saṅkhye hārdikyaśca mahābalaḥ / diṣṭyā vikarṇibhiḥ karṇoraṇe nītaḥ parābhavam
ce_text: yuvāṃ vijayinau cāpi diṣṭyā paśyāmi saṃyuge / diṣṭyā droṇo jitaḥ saṃkhye hārdikyaś ca mahābalaḥ

vulgate_text: mama vākyakarau vīrau mama gauravayantritau / sainyārṇavaṃ samuttīrṇau diṣṭyā paśyāmi vāmaham
ce_text: sainyārṇavaṃ samuttīrṇau diṣṭyā paśyāmi cānaghau / samaraślāghinau vīrau samareṣv apalāyinau / mama prāṇasamau caiva diṣṭyā paśyāmi vām aham

vulgate_text: durmanā niḥśvasanduṣṭo bhagnadaṃṣṭra ivoragaḥ / āgaskṛtsarvalokasya putraste'rtiṃ parāmagāt
ce_text: evaṃ klāntamanā rājann upāyād droṇam īkṣitum / āgaskṛt sarvalokasya putras te bharatarṣabha

vulgate_text: so'haṃ tatra gamiṣyāmi yatra te puruṣarṣabhāḥ hatā madarthe saṅgrāme yudhyamānāḥ kirīṭinā - - na hīdānīṃ sahāyā me parīpsantyanupaskṛtāḥ śreyo hi pāṇḍūnmanyante na tathāsmānmahābhuja
ce_text: na hīdānīṃ sahāyā me parīpsanty anupaskṛtāḥ / śreyo hi pāṇḍūn manyante na tathāsmān mahābhuja

vulgate_text: akṣāṃstu manyase bāṇāñchobhamānāñchitāñśarān ta ete ghnanti nastāta viśikhāḥ pārthacoditāḥ / tāṃstadā''khyāyamānastvaṃ vidureṇa na buddhavān
ce_text: ta ete ghnanti nas tāta viśikhā jayacoditāḥ / yāṃs tadā khyāpyamānāṃs tvaṃ vidureṇa na budhyase

vulgate_text: anicchataḥ kathaṃ vīra droṇasya yudhi pāṇḍavaḥ / bhindyātsudurbhidaṃ vyṛhaṃ yatamānasya śupmiṇaḥ
ce_text: kathaṃ hy anicchamānasya droṇasya yudhi phalgunaḥ / bhindyāt sudurbhidaṃ vyūhaṃ yatamāno 'pi saṃyuge

vulgate_text: dayitaḥ phalguno nityamācāryasya mahātmanaḥ / tato'sya dattavāndvāramayuddhenaiva śatruhan
ce_text: priyo hi phalguno nityam ācāryasya mahātmanaḥ / tato 'sya dattavān dvāraṃ nayuddhenārimardana

vulgate_text: yadyadāsyadanujñāṃ vai pūrvameva gṛhānprati / pramthātuṃ sindhurājasya na bhavejjīvitakṣayaḥ
ce_text: yady adāsyam anujñāṃ vai pūrvam eva gṛhān prati / sindhurājasya samare nābhaviṣyaj janakṣayaḥ

vulgate_text: ācāryaṃ mā vigarhasva śaktyā'sau yudhyate dvijaḥ / yathābalaṃ yathotsāhaṃ tyaktvā jīvitamātmanaḥ
ce_text: ācāryaṃ mā vigarhasva śaktyā yudhyaty asau dvijaḥ / ajayyān pāṇḍavān manye droṇenāstravidā mṛdhe

vulgate_text: yadyenaṃ samatikramya praviṣṭaḥ śvetavāhanaḥ / nātra sūkṣmo'pi doṣaḥsyādācāryasya kathañcana
ce_text: tathā hy enam atikramya praviṣṭaḥ śvetavāhanaḥ / daivadṛṣṭo 'nyathābhāvo na manye vidyate kva cit

vulgate_text: tataḥ parivṛtā yodhāḥ parivavruryudhiṣṭhiram / vṛtreṇa saha yudhyantaṃ yadvaddevāḥ śatakratum
ce_text: tataḥ pramuditā yodhāḥ parivavrur yudhiṣṭhiram / vṛtrahatyai yathā devāḥ parivavruḥ puraṃdaram

vulgate_text: tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā tava putrasya māriṣa śaraṃ ca sūryaraśmyābhamatyugramanivāraṇam / hā hato'sīti rājānamuktvā'muñcadyudhiṣṭhiraḥ
ce_text: tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā tava putrasya māriṣa / śaraṃ paramadurvāraṃ preṣayām āsa saṃyuge / sa tena bhṛśasaṃviddho niṣasāda rathottame

vulgate_text: yatprāviśanmaheṣvāsaḥ pāñcālānaparājitaḥ / nṛtyansa rathamārgeṣu sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ
ce_text: nṛtyan sa rathamārgeṣu sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ / dhūmaketur iva kruddhaḥ kathaṃ mṛtyum upeyivān

vulgate_text: nirdahansarvasainyāni pāñcālānāṃ ratharṣabhaḥ / dhūmaketuriva kruddhaḥ kathaṃ mṛtyumupeyivān
ce_text: nṛtyan sa rathamārgeṣu sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ / dhūmaketur iva kruddhaḥ kathaṃ mṛtyum upeyivān

vulgate_text: hatāṃścaiva viṣaktāṃśca parābhūtāṃśca śaṃsasi rathino virathāṃścaiva kṛtānyuddheṣu māmakān - - teṣāṃ saṃloḍyamānānāṃ pāṇḍavairhatacetasām andhe tamasi magnānāmabhavatkā matistadā
ce_text: hatāṃś caiva viṣaktāṃś ca parābhūtāṃś ca śaṃsasi / rathino virathāṃś caiva kṛtān yuddheṣu māmakān

vulgate_text: tathā cūrṇamabhūttatra karṇabhrātā drumastathā / sa tadā pāṇḍuputreṇa balinā'bhihato'patat
ce_text: tataḥ śatrurathaṃ tyaktvā bhīmo dhruvarathaṃ gataḥ / dhruvaṃ cāsyantam aniśaṃ muṣṭinā samapothayat / sa tathā pāṇḍuputreṇa balinā nihato 'patat

vulgate_text: tamāyāntaṃ jighāṃsantaṃ bhīmaṃ kruddhamivāntakam nyavārayanmahābāhuṃ tava putrā viśāmpate / mahatā śaravarṣeṇa cchādayanto mahārathāḥ
ce_text: tatas tava sutā rājan bhīmasya ratham āvrajan / mahatā śaravarṣeṇa chādayanto vṛkodaram

vulgate_text: durmadastu tato yānaṃ duṣkarṇasyāvacakrame tāvekarathamārūḍhau bhrātarau paratāpanau
ce_text: durmadasya tato bhīmaḥ prahasann iva saṃyuge / sārathiṃ ca hayāṃś caiva śarair ninye yamakṣayam / durmadas tu tato yānaṃ duṣkarṇasyāvapupluve

vulgate_text: dhṛṣṭadyumno'bhyayātkruddhaḥ pragṛhya mahatīṃ camūm / abhyarakṣanmahābāhuḥ sātvataṃ satyavikramam
ce_text: rakṣyamāṇaś ca balibhiś chādayām āsa sātyakim / taṃ chādyamānaṃ viśikhair dṛṣṭvā saṃnataparvabhiḥ / dhṛṣṭadyumno 'bhyayāt kruddhaḥ pragṛhya mahatīṃ camūm

vulgate_text: taṃ visaṃjñaṃ samālakṣya yuyudhānaśarārditam / abhyadravattato droṇo yaduvīrajighāṃsayā
ce_text: taṃ visaṃjñaṃ samālokya yuyudhānaśarārditam / drauṇir abhyadravat kruddhaḥ sātvataṃ raṇamūrdhani

vulgate_text: tau dṛṣṭvā bhrātarau yattau droṇānīkamabhidrutau pāñcālāḥ sṛñjayā mātsyāścedikārūśakosalāḥ / anvagacchanmahārāja kekayāśca mahārathāḥ
ce_text: tau tadā sṛñjayāś caiva pāñcālāś ca mahaujasaḥ / anvagacchan mahārāja matsyāś ca saha sātvataiḥ

vulgate_text: bībhatsurdakṣiṇaṃ pārśvamuttaraṃ ca vṛkodaraḥ / mahadbhyāṃ rathabṛndābhyāṃ balaṃ jagṛhatustava
ce_text: bībhatsur dakṣiṇaṃ pārśvam uttaraṃ tu vṛkodaraḥ / bhāradvājaṃ śaraughābhyāṃ mahadbhyām abhyavarṣatām

vulgate_text: vikṣiptayantrasannāhaṃ mahāmeghaughaniḥsvanam / yuktaṃ gajanibhairvāhairna hayairnāpi vāraṇaiḥ
ce_text: kārṣṇāyasamayaṃ ghoram ṛkṣacarmāvṛtaṃ mahat / yuktaṃ gajanibhair vāhair na hayair nāpi vā gajaiḥ

vulgate_text: kimahaṃ kātaro drauṇe pṛthagjana ivāhave / yanmāṃ bhīṣayase vāgbhirasadetadvacastava
ce_text: kim ahaṃ kātaro drauṇe pṛthagjana ivāhave / bhīmāt khalv aham utpannaḥ kurūṇāṃ vipule kule

vulgate_text: taṃ dahantamanīkāni śarairāśīviṣopamaiḥ / teṣu rājasahasreṣu pāṇḍaveyeṣu bhārata
ce_text: teṣu rājasahasreṣu pāṇḍaveyeṣu bhārata / nainaṃ nirīkṣituṃ kaś cic chaknoti drauṇim āhave / ṛte ghaṭotkacād vīrād rākṣasendrān mahābalāt

vulgate_text: sva sūtamabravītkruddho droṇaputrāya māṃ vaha / sa yayau ghorarūpeṇa supatākena bhāsvatā
ce_text: sa punar bharataśreṣṭha krodhād raktāntalocanaḥ / talaṃ talena saṃhatya saṃdaśya daśanacchadam / svasūtam abravīt kruddho droṇaputrāya māṃ vaha

vulgate_text: dvairathaṃ droṇaputreṇa punarapyarisūdanaḥ / sa vinadya mahānādaṃ siṃhavadbhīmavikramaḥ
ce_text: sa yayau ghorarūpeṇa tena jaitrapatākinā / dvairathaṃ droṇaputreṇa punar apy arisūdanaḥ

vulgate_text: kaṅkagṛghramahāgrāhāṃ naikāyudhajhaṣākulām / vistīrṇagajapāṣāṇāṃ hatāśvamakarākulām
ce_text: kaṅkagṛdhramahāgrāhāṃ naikāyudhajhaṣākulām / rathakṣiptamahāvaprāṃ patākāruciradrumām

vulgate_text: yodhārtaravanirghoṣāṃ kṣatajormisamākulām / prayāntīṃ sumahāghorāṃ yamarāṣṭramahodadhim
ce_text: śoṇitaughamahāvegāṃ drauṇiḥ prāvartayan nadīm / yodhārtaravanirghoṣāṃ kṣatajormisamākulām

vulgate_text: punaḥ śatruñjayaṃ nāma drupadasyātmajaṃ raṇe / balānīkaṃ jayānīkaṃ jayāśvaṃ cābhijaghnivān
ce_text: balānīkaṃ jayānīkaṃ jayāśvaṃ cābhijaghnivān / śrutāhvayaṃ ca rājendra drauṇir ninye yamakṣayam

vulgate_text: taṃ dṛṣṭvā samupāyāntaṃ rukmapuṅkhaiḥ śilāśitaiḥ / daśabhiḥ sātvatasyārthe bhīmo vivyādha sāyakaiḥ
ce_text: daśabhiḥ sātvatasyārthe bhīmo vivyādha kauravam / somadatto 'pi taṃ vīraṃ śatena pratyavidhyata

vulgate_text: vṛddhaṃ vṛddhaguṇairyuktaṃ yayātimiva nāhuṣam vivyādha daśabhistīkṣṇaiḥ śarairvajranipātanaiḥ / śaktyā cainaṃ vinirbhidya punarvivyādha saptabhiḥ
ce_text: vivyādha daśabhis tīkṣṇaiḥ śarair vajranipātibhiḥ / śaktyā cainam athāhatya punar vivyādha saptabhiḥ

vulgate_text: subhago bhānudattaśca śūrāḥ pañca mahārathāḥ / abhidrutya śaraistīkṣṇairbhīmasenamatāḍayan
ce_text: amarṣayanto nihataṃ śatacandraṃ mahāratham / śakuner bhrātaro vīrā gajākṣaḥ śarabho vibhuḥ / abhidrutya śarais tīkṣṇair bhīmasenam atāḍayan

vulgate_text: tataste pāṇḍavā rājanpāñcālāśca yaśasvinaḥ / ājagmuḥ sahitāḥ karṇaṃ tarjayantaḥ samantataḥ
ce_text: tatas te pāṇḍavā rājan pāñcālāś ca yaśasvinaḥ / dṛṣṭvā karṇaṃ mahābāhum uccaiḥ śabdam athānadan

vulgate_text: bībhatsurapi rājendra pāñcālairabhisaṃvṛtaḥ / pratyudyayau tadā karṇaṃ yathā vṛtraṃ śatakratuḥ
ce_text: āyāntaṃ dṛśya kaunteyaṃ vṛtraṃ devacamūm iva / pratyudyayau tadā karṇo yathā śakraḥ pratāpavān

vulgate_text: tamāpatantaṃ vegena vaikartanamajihmagaiḥ / chādayāmāsa pārtho'tha karṇastu vijayaṃ śaraiḥ
ce_text: tam āpatantaṃ vegena vaikartanam ajihmagaiḥ / vārayām āsa tejasvī pāṇḍavaḥ śatrutāpanaḥ

vulgate_text: sa karṇaṃ śarajālena cchādayāmāsa pāṇḍavaḥ / tataḥ karṇaḥ susaṃrabdhaḥ śaraistribhiravidhyata
ce_text: taṃ karṇaḥ śarajālena chādayām āsa māriṣa / vivyādha ca susaṃkruddhaḥ śarais tribhir ajihmagaiḥ

vulgate_text: aśvatthāmaṃstvarāyukto yāhi śīghramarindama / ādau vā yadi vā paścāttavedaṃ karma māriṣa
ce_text: ādau vā yadi vā paścāt tavedaṃ karma māriṣa / tvam utpanno mahābāho pāñcālānāṃ vadhaṃ prati

vulgate_text: evaṃ siddhā'bruvanvāco bhaviṣyati ca tattathā / tasmāttvaṃ puruṣavyāghra pāñcālāñjahi sānugān
ce_text: kariṣyasi jagat sarvam apāñcālaṃ kilācyuta / evaṃ siddhābruvan vāco bhaviṣyati ca tat tathā

vulgate_text: gacchagaccha mahābāho na naḥ kālātyayo bhavet / iyaṃ hi dravate senā pārtasāyakapīḍitā
ce_text: yudhyate 'sau raṇe karṇo daṃśitaḥ sarvapārthivaiḥ / paśyaitāṃ dravatīṃ senāṃ karṇasāyakapīḍitām / kārttikeyena vidhvastām āsurīṃ pṛtanām iva

vulgate_text: duryodhanenaivamukto drauṇirāhavadurmadaḥ cakārārivadhe yatnamindro daityavadhe yathā / pratyuvāca mahābāhustava putramidaṃ vacaḥ
ce_text: duryodhanenaivam ukto drauṇir āhavadurmadaḥ / pratyuvāca mahābāho yathā vadasi kaurava

vulgate_text: yudhyāma pāṇḍavācchaktyā te cāpyasmānyathābalam / tejastejaḥ samāsādya praśamaṃ yātu bhārata
ce_text: yudhyatāṃ pāṇḍavāñ śaktyā teṣāṃ cāsmān yuyutsatām / tejas tu teja āsādya praśamaṃ yāti bhārata

vulgate_text: tataḥ suniśitairbāṇaiḥ pārthaṃ vivyādha saptabhiḥ / yudhiṣṭhiro'pi saṅkruddhaḥ prativivyādha pañcabhiḥ
ce_text: tataḥ suniśitair bāṇaiḥ pārthaṃ vivyādha saptabhiḥ / so 'tividdho mahābāhuḥ sṛkkiṇī parisaṃlihan / yudhiṣṭhirasya ciccheda dhvajaṃ kārmukam eva ca

vulgate_text: yāvanmātreṇa ca mayā sahāyena dhanañjayaḥ / bhīmaśca rathaśārdūlo yudhyate kauravaiḥ saha
ce_text: parivarjya guruṃ yāhi yatra rājā suyodhanaḥ / bhīmaś ca rathaśārdūlo yudhyate kauravaiḥ saha

vulgate_text: droṇo'pi pāṇḍupāñcālānvyadhamadrajanīmukhe / nādayaṃstalaghoṣeṇa tava sainyāni māriṣa
ce_text: bhīmasya nighnataḥ śatrūn pārṣṇiṃ jagrāha pāṇḍavaḥ / droṇo 'pi pāṇḍupāñcālān vyadhamad rajanīmukhe

vulgate_text: sarveṣu sainyeṣu padātisaṅghā vimiśritā hastirathāśvabṛndaiḥ / vyadīpayaṃste dhvajinīṃ pradīptā-- stathā balaṃ pāṇḍaveyābhiguptam
ce_text: sarveṣu sainyeṣu padātisaṃghā vyāmiśritā hastirathāśvavṛndaiḥ / madhye tathānye jvalitāgnihastā vyadīpayan pāṇḍusutasya senām

vulgate_text: pradīpānāṃ sahasraiśca dīpyamānaiḥ samantataḥ / ratnācitaiḥ svarṇadaṇḍairgandhatailāvasiñcitaiḥ
ce_text: pradīpānāṃ sahasraiś ca dīpyamānaiḥ samantataḥ / virarāja tadā bhūmir dyaur grahair iva bhārata

vulgate_text: devagandharvadīpādyaiḥ prabhābhiradhikojjvalaiḥ / virarāja tadā bhūmirgrahairdyauriva bhārata
ce_text: pradīpānāṃ sahasraiś ca dīpyamānaiḥ samantataḥ / virarāja tadā bhūmir dyaur grahair iva bhārata

vulgate_text: tasminrātrimukhe ghore tava putrasya śāsanāt / caturaṅgasya sainyasya sampātaśca mahāranabhūt
ce_text: rathā rathavarair eva samājagmur mudānvitāḥ / tasmin rātrimukhe ghore putrasya tava śāsanāt

vulgate_text: ke cainaṃ samare vīraṃ pratyudyayurarindamāḥ / droṇaṃ ca ke vyarakṣanta praviṣṭe śvetavāhane
ce_text: ke cainaṃ samare vīraṃ pratyudyayur ariṃdamam / ke 'rakṣan dakṣiṇaṃ cakraṃ ke ca droṇasya savyataḥ

vulgate_text: ke'rakṣandakṣiṇaṃ cakraṃ ke ca droṇasya savyataḥ ke pṛṣṭhataścāpyabhavanvīrā vīrānvinighnataḥ / ke purastādagacchanta nighnantaḥ śāstravānraṇe
ce_text: ke pṛṣṭhato 'sya hy abhavan vīrā vīrasya yudhyataḥ / ke purastād agacchanta nighnataḥ śātravān raṇe

vulgate_text: avyagrāneva hi parānkathayasyaparājitān / hṛṣṭānudīrṇānsaṅgrāme na tathā sūta māmakān
ce_text: avyagrān eva hi parān kathayasy aparājitān / hatāṃś caiva viṣaṇṇāṃś ca viprakīrṇāṃś ca śaṃsasi / rathino virathāṃś caiva kṛtān yuddheṣu māmakān

vulgate_text: pāṇḍavīyeṣu sainyeṣu na taṃ paśyāma kañcana / yo yodhayedraṇe droṇaṃ dhṛṣṭadyumnādṛte pumān
ce_text: pāṇḍaveyeṣu sainyeṣu yodhaṃ paśyāmy ahaṃ na tam / yo jayeta raṇe droṇaṃ dhṛṣṭadyumnād ṛte nṛpāḥ

vulgate_text: tathā'rjunaṃ ca rādheyo haniṣyati mahārathaḥ bhīmasenamahaṃ cāpi yuddhejeṣyāmi dīkṣitaḥ / śeṣāṃśca pāṇḍavānyodhāḥ prasabhaṃ hīnatejasaḥ
ce_text: tathārjunaṃ raṇe karṇo vijeṣyati mahārathaḥ / bhīmasenam ahaṃ cāpi yuddhe jeṣyāmi daṃśitaḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ rātrau bharatasattama / ubhayoḥ senayorghoraṃ parasparajigīṣayā
ce_text: tataḥ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ rātrau tad bharatarṣabha / ubhayoḥ senayor ghoraṃ vijayaṃ prati kāṅkṣiṇoḥ

vulgate_text: bhaimasenimathāyāntaṃ māyāśataviśāradam / aśvatthāmā mahārāja rākṣasaṃ pratyaṣedhayat
ce_text: bhaimasenim athāyāntaṃ māyāśataviśāradam / aśvatthāmā pitur mānaṃ kurvāṇaḥ pratyaṣedhayat

vulgate_text: tiṣṭhatiṣṭheti cābhāṣya śaineyaṃ sa narādhipa / abhyavarṣaccharaugheṇa meruṃ vṛṣṭyā yathāmbudaḥ
ce_text: taṃ tu dṛṣṭvā hataṃ śūram aśvatthāmā mahārathaḥ / abhyadhāvata vegena śaineyaṃ prati saṃyuge / abhyavarṣac charaugheṇa meruṃ vṛṣṭyā yathāmbudaḥ

vulgate_text: yuddhaśraddhāmahaṃ te'dya vineṣyāmi raṇājire ityuktvā krodhatāmrākṣo rākṣasaḥ paravīrahā / droṇimabhyadravatkruddho gajendramiva kesarī
ce_text: ity uktvā roṣatāmrākṣo rākṣasaḥ paravīrahā / drauṇim abhyadravat kruddho gajendram iva kesarī

vulgate_text: tato duryodhanaḥ kruddho bhanuranyanmahattaram gṛhītvā bharataśreṣṭho bhīmasenaṃ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ / apīḍayadraṇamukhe paśyatāṃ sarvadhanvinām
ce_text: tato duryodhanaḥ kruddho bhīmasenasya māriṣa / cikṣepa sa śarān rājan paśyatāṃ sarvadhanvinām

vulgate_text: putrastu tava rājendra bhīmādbhītaḥ praṇaśya ca / āruroha rathaṃ cānyaṃ nandakasya mahātmanaḥ
ce_text: putras tu tava rājendra rathād dhemapariṣkṛtāt / āplutaḥ sahasā yānaṃ nandakasya mahātmanaḥ

vulgate_text: rathacakraṃ pragṛhyājau mumocādhirathaṃ prati tadāpatadvai sahasā kālacakramivodyatam / śarairanekasāhasrairācchinatsūtanandanaḥ
ce_text: tam āpatantaṃ sahasā kālacakram ivodyatam / śarair anekasāhasrair acchinat sūtanandanaḥ

vulgate_text: sa nirāyudhamātmānaṃ jñātvā mādravatīsutaḥ / vāryamāṇastu viśikhaiḥ sahadevo raṇaṃ jahau
ce_text: tasmiṃs tu vitathe cakre kṛte tena mahātmanā / vāryamāṇaś ca viśikhaiḥ sahadevo raṇaṃ jahau

vulgate_text: atitīvraṃ mahādyuddhaṃ nararākṣasayostadā draṣṭṝṇāṃ prītijananaṃ sarveṣāṃ tatra bhārata / gṛdhrakākabalolūkakaṅkagomāyuharṣaṇam
ce_text: atitīvram abhūd yuddhaṃ nararākṣasayor mṛdhe / draṣṭṝṇāṃ prītijananaṃ sarveṣāṃ bharatarṣabha

vulgate_text: punaḥ sajyaṃ kṛtaṃ cāpaṃ tadapyasya dvidhā'cchinat / virathasyodyataṃ khaṅgaṃ śareṇāsya dvidhā'karot
ce_text: sārathiṃ ca tribhir bāṇais tribhir eva triveṇukam / dhanur ekena ciccheda caturbhiś caturo hayān / virathasyodyataṃ khaḍgaṃ śareṇāsya dvidhācchinat

vulgate_text: nākuliścitrasenaṃ tu viddhvā pañcabhirāśugaiḥ / sa tu taṃ prativivyādha daśabhirniśitaiḥ śaraiḥ
ce_text: nākuliś citrasenaṃ tu nārācenārdayad bhṛśam / sa ca taṃ prativivyādha daśabhir niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ

vulgate_text: so'tividdho mahārāja rathopastha upāviśat / dhvajayaṣṭiṃ parikliśya kāmukaḥ kāminīṃ yathā
ce_text: so 'tividdho mahārāja rathopastha upāviśat / taṃ visaṃjñaṃ nipatitaṃ dṛṣṭvā syālaṃ tavānagha / apovāha rathenāśu sārathir dhvajinīmukhāt

vulgate_text: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā mādrīputrasya sārathiḥ / prāyāttena tadā rājanyatra droṇo vyavasthitaḥ
ce_text: tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā mādrīputrasya dhīmataḥ / prāyāt tena raṇe rājan yena droṇo 'nvayudhyata

vulgate_text: tasminkolāhale yuddhe vartamāne niśāmukhe / na kiñcidvidurātmānamayamasmīti bhārata
ce_text: tasmin kolāhale yuddhe vartamāne niśāmukhe / avadhīt samare putraṃ pitā bharatasattama

vulgate_text: avadhītsamare putraṃ pitā bharatasattama putraśca pitaraṃ mohātsakhāyaṃ ca sakhā tathā / svasrīyaṃ mātulaścāpi svasrīyaścāpi mātulam
ce_text: putraś ca pitaraṃ mohāt sakhāyaṃ ca sakhā tathā / saṃbandhinaṃ ca saṃbandhī svasrīyaṃ cāpi mātulaḥ

vulgate_text: sa cchinno bahudhā rājansūtaputreṇa dhanvinā / nipapāta śarastūrṇaṃ nirviṣo bhujago yathā
ce_text: sa chinno bahudhā rājan sūtaputreṇa māriṣa / nipapāta śaras tūrṇaṃ nikṛttaḥ karṇasāyakaiḥ

vulgate_text: eṣa sarvāṃ camūṃ hatvā mukhyāṃścaiva nararṣabhān / pauravāṃśca maheṣvāso vikṣipannuttamaṃ dhanuḥ
ce_text: eṣa sarvāñ śibīn hatvā mukhyaśaś ca nararṣabhān / pauravāṃś ca maheṣvāsān gāṇḍīvaninado mahān

vulgate_text: pārtho vijayate tatra gāṇḍīvaninado mahān / śrūyate rathaghoṣaśca vāsavasyeva nardataḥ
ce_text: śrūyate rathaghoṣaś ca vāsavasyeva nardataḥ / karoti pāṇḍavo vyaktaṃ karmaupayikam ātmanaḥ

vulgate_text: śṛṇu dundubhinirghoṣamarjunasya rathaṃ prati / niśīthe rājaśārdūla stanayitnorivāmbare
ce_text: dravatāṃ yodhamukhyānāṃ gāṇḍīvapreṣitaiḥ śaraiḥ / viddhānāṃ śataśo rājañ śrūyate ninado mahān / niśīthe rājaśārdūla stanayitnor ivāmbare

vulgate_text: te tvaradhvaṃ tathā śūrāḥ śarāṇāṃ mokṣaṇe bhṛśam yathā tviha vrajatyeṣa paralokāya mādhavaḥ / tathā kuru mahārāja sunītyā suprayuktayā
ce_text: te tvaradhvaṃ yathā śūrāḥ śarāṇāṃ mokṣaṇe bhṛśam / yathā tūrṇaṃ vrajaty eṣa paralokāya mādhavaḥ

vulgate_text: bhāradvājastato gatvā dhṛṣṭadyumnarathaṃ prati mahadyuddhaṃ tadāsīttuṃ droṇasya niśi bhārata / dhṛṣṭadyumnena vīreṇa pāñcālaiśca sahādbhutam
ce_text: mahad yuddhaṃ tadāsīt tu droṇasya niśi bhārata / dhṛṣṭadyumnena śūreṇa pāñcālaiś ca mahātmanaḥ

vulgate_text: bhujaiśchinnairmahīpāla hastihastopamairmṛdhe / samākīrṇā mahī bhāti pañcāsyairiva pannagaiḥ
ce_text: bhujaiś chinnair mahārāja śarīraiś ca sahasraśaḥ / samāstīrṇā dharā tatra babhau puṣpair ivācitā

vulgate_text: kṛtvā tatkarma bībhatsurugramugraparākramaḥ / vivyādha śakuniṃ bhūyaḥ pañcabhirnataparvabhiḥ
ce_text: sa viddhvā śakuniṃ bhūyaḥ pañcabhir nataparvabhiḥ / ulūkaṃ tribhir ājaghne tribhir eva mahāyasaiḥ

vulgate_text: atāḍayadulūkaṃ ca tribhireva tathā śaraiḥ / ulūkaṃ punarājaghne tribhireva mahāyaśāḥ
ce_text: sa viddhvā śakuniṃ bhūyaḥ pañcabhir nataparvabhiḥ / ulūkaṃ tribhir ājaghne tribhir eva mahāyasaiḥ

vulgate_text: arjunaḥ śakuneścāpaṃ sāyakairacchinadraṇe / ninye ca caturo vāhānyamasya sadanaṃ prati
ce_text: arjunas tu drutaṃ gatvā śakuner dhanur ācchinat / ninye ca caturo vāhān yamasya sadanaṃ prati

vulgate_text: tadaivāhaṃ vacaḥ śrutvā bhavaddhyāmanusampatam / nākariṣyamidaṃ pārthairvairaṃ yodhavināśanam
ce_text: tadaivāhaṃ vacaḥ śrutvā bhavadbhyām anusaṃmatam / kṛtavān pāṇḍavaiḥ sārdhaṃ vairaṃ yodhavināśanam

vulgate_text: punarevābravīdrājanharṣayanniva pāṇḍavam eṣa bhīmo raṇaślāghī vṛtaḥ somakapāṇḍavaiḥ
ce_text: vṛkodaraṃ tathāyāntaṃ dṛṣṭvā tatra janārdanaḥ / punar evābravīd rājan harṣayann iva pāṇḍavam

vulgate_text: abhyavartata vegena droṇakarṇau mahārathau etena sahito yuddhya pāñcālaiśca mahārathaiḥ
ce_text: etena sahito yudhya pāñcālaiś ca mahārathaiḥ / āśvāsanārthaṃ sarveṣāṃ sainyānāṃ pāṇḍunandana

vulgate_text: āśvāsanārthaṃ sainyānāṃ sarveṣāṃ pāṇḍunandana tatastau puruṣavyāghrāvubhau mādhavapāṇḍavau
ce_text: tatas tau puruṣavyāghrāv ubhau mādhavapāṇḍavau / droṇakarṇau samāsādya dhiṣṭhitau raṇamūrdhani

vulgate_text: āruroha rathaṃ cāpi sahadevasya māriṣa / prayātukāmaḥ karṇāya vārito dharmasūnunā
ce_text: viddhaś ca bahubhis tena śarair āśīviṣopamaiḥ / tato yudhiṣṭhirānīkaṃ padbhyām evānvavartata / āruroha rathaṃ cāpi sahadevasya māriṣa

vulgate_text: rakṣyate śaktireṣā hi raudrāṃ rūpaṃ bibharti ca / ghaṭotkacastu rādheyaṃ pratyudyātu mahābalaḥ
ce_text: ghaṭotkacas tu rādheyaṃ pratyudyātu mahābalaḥ / sa hi bhīmena balinā jātaḥ suraparākramaḥ

vulgate_text: yāvanti ca tavāstrāṇi santi māyāśca rākṣasīḥ / adyaiva samayasteṣāṃ māyānāṃ caiva rākṣasa
ce_text: sa bhavān majjamānānāṃ bandhūnāṃ tvaṃ plavo yathā / vividhāni tavāstrāṇi santi māyā ca rākṣasī

vulgate_text: paśya karṇena haiḍimbe pāṇḍavānāmanīkinīm / kālyamānāṃ raṇe tāta siṃhanevetarānmṛgān
ce_text: paśya karṇena haiḍimba pāṇḍavānām anīkinī / kālyamānā yathā gāvaḥ pālena raṇamūrdhani

vulgate_text: tamāpatantaṃ saṅkruddhaṃ dīptāsyaṃ dīptamūrdhajam / prahasanpuruṣavyāghraḥ pratijagrāha sūtajaḥ
ce_text: tam āpatantaṃ saṃkruddhaṃ dīptāsyam iva pannagam / abhyasyan parameṣvāsaḥ pratijagrāha sūtajaḥ

vulgate_text: rakṣa karṇaṃ raṇe yatto vṛtaḥ sainyena mānada / mā karṇaṃ rākṣaso ghoraḥ pramādānnāśayiṣyati
ce_text: karṇo vaikartano yuddhe rākṣasena yuyutsati / rakṣa karṇaṃ raṇe yatto vṛtaḥ sainyena mānada

vulgate_text: tvaṃ tu gaccha mayā''jñapto jahi yuddhe ghaṭotkacam / rākṣasaṃ krūrakarmāṇaṃ rakṣomānuṣasambhavam
ce_text: tam abravīt tato rājā prīyamāṇaḥ punaḥ punaḥ / droṇakarṇādibhiḥ sārdhaṃ paryāpto 'haṃ dviṣadvadhe / tvaṃ tu gaccha mayājñapto jahi yuddhaṃ ghaṭotkacam

vulgate_text: śirastaccāpi saṅgṛhya keśeṣu rudhirokṣitam / yayau ghaṭotkacastūrṇaṃ duryodhanarathaṃ prati
ce_text: tacchiro rudhirābhyaktaṃ gṛhya keśeṣu rākṣasaḥ / ghaṭotkaco yayāv āśu duryodhanarathaṃ prati

vulgate_text: droṇakarṇakṛpānyodhānatītya sumahābalaḥ / abhyetya ca mahābāhuḥ smayamānaḥ sa rākṣasaḥ
ce_text: abhyetya ca mahābāhuḥ smayamānaḥ sa rākṣasaḥ / rathe 'sya nikṣipya śiro vikṛtānanamūrdhajam / prāṇadad bhairavaṃ nādaṃ prāvṛṣīva balāhakaḥ

vulgate_text: evamuktvā tataḥ prāyātkarṇaṃ prati nareśvaraḥ / kirañcharagaṇāṃstīkṣṇānruṣito raṇamūrdhani
ce_text: evam uktvā tataḥ prāyāt karṇaṃ prati janeśvara / kirañ śaraśatāṃs tīkṣṇān vimuñcan karṇamūrdhani

vulgate_text: kīdṛśaṃ cābhavadrūpaṃ tasya ghorasya rakṣasaḥ / yena vaikartanaḥ karṇaḥ saṅgrāme tena nirjitaḥ
ce_text: kīdṛśaṃ cābhavad yuddhaṃ tasya ghorasya rakṣasaḥ / rathaś ca kīdṛśas tasya māyāḥ sarvāyudhāni ca

vulgate_text: mattamātaṅgasaṅkāśā lohitākṣā vibhīpaṇāḥ / kālavarṇāsamāyuktā balavantaḥ śataṃ hayāḥ
ce_text: tatra mātaṅgasaṃkāśā lohitākṣā vibhīṣaṇāḥ / kāmavarṇajavā yuktā balavanto 'vahan hayāḥ

vulgate_text: rākṣaso'sya virūpākṣaḥ sūto dīptāsyakuṇḍalaḥ ghorarūpo mahākāyaḥ karālo vikṛtānanaḥ / raśmibhiḥ sūryaraśmyāhvaiḥ sañjagrāha hayānraṇe
ce_text: rākṣaso 'sya virūpākṣaḥ sūto dīptāsyakuṇḍalaḥ / raśmibhiḥ sūryaraśmyābhaiḥ saṃjagrāha hayān raṇe / sa tena sahitas tasthāv aruṇena yathā raviḥ

vulgate_text: sañchindantau ca gātrāṇi sandadhānau ca sāyakān / dahantau ca śarolkābhirduṣprekṣyau ca babhūvatuḥ
ce_text: saṃchindantau hi gātrāṇi saṃdadhānau ca sāyakān / dhakṣyamāṇau śaravrātair nodīkṣitum aśaknutām

vulgate_text: rākṣasāśca piśācāśca yātudhānāstathaiva ca / śālāvṛkāśca bahavo vṛkāśca vikṛtānanāḥ
ce_text: rākṣasāś ca piśācāś ca yātudhānāḥ śalāvṛkāḥ / te karṇaṃ bhakṣayiṣyantaḥ sarvataḥ samupādravan / athainaṃ vāgbhir ugrābhis trāsayāṃ cakrire tadā

vulgate_text: tasyāpi rathanirghopo mahāmegharavopamaḥ / syāpi sumahaccāpaṃ dṛḍhajyaṃ kanakojjvalam / tasyāpyakṣasamā bāṇā rukma puṅkhāḥ śilāśitāḥ so'pi vīro mahābāhuryathaiva sa ghaṭotkacaḥ
ce_text: tasyāpi rathanirghoṣo mahāmegharavopamaḥ / tasyāpi sumahac cāpaṃ dṛḍhajyaṃ balavattaram

vulgate_text: saṃdṛśya samare bhīmaṃ rakṣasā grastamantikāt / vāsudevo'vravīdrājanghaṭotkacamidaṃ vacaḥ
ce_text: saṃprekṣya samare bhīmaṃ rakṣasā grastam antikāt / vāsudevo 'bravīd vākyaṃ ghaṭotkacam idaṃ tadā

vulgate_text: tayoḥ sutumulaṃ yuddhaṃ babhūva niśi rakṣasoḥ / alāyudhasya caivograṃ heḍimbeścāpi bhārata
ce_text: sa vārṣṇeyavacaḥ śrutvā karṇam utsṛjya vīryavān / yuyudhe rākṣasendreṇa bakabhrātrā ghaṭotkacaḥ / tayoḥ sutumulaṃ yuddhaṃ babhūva niśi rakṣasoḥ

vulgate_text: tau yuddhvā vividhairghorairāyudhairviśikhaistathā / utsṛjya ca śitau khaṅkhāgavanyomabhipetatuḥ
ce_text: tau yuddhvā vividhair ghorair āyudhair viśikhais tathā / pragṛhya niśitau khaḍgāv anyonyam abhijaghnatuḥ

vulgate_text: tenāstreṇāvadhīttasya rathaṃ sahayasārathim / virathaścāpi haiḍimbiḥ kṣipramantaradhīyata
ce_text: tenāstreṇa hayān pūrvaṃ hatvā karṇasya rākṣasaḥ / sārathiṃ caiva haiḍimbaḥ kṣipram antaradhīyata

vulgate_text: vikīrṇāntrā vihatairuttamāṅgaiḥ sambhagnāṅgaḥ śiśyire tatra śūrāḥ / chinnā hayāḥ kuñjarāścāpi bhagnā na mucyante yācamānāḥ subhītāḥ
ce_text: niṣkīrṇāntrā vihatair uttamāṅgaiḥ saṃbhagnāṅgāḥ śerate tatra śūrāḥ / bhinnā hayāḥ kuñjarāś cāvabhagnāḥ saṃcūrṇitāś caiva rathāḥ śilābhiḥ

vulgate_text: haiḍimbiṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā viśīrṇamiva parvatam / babhūvuḥ pāṇḍavāḥ sarve śokabāṣpākulekṣaṇāḥ
ce_text: haiḍimbaṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā vikīrṇam iva parvatam / pāṇḍavā dīnamanasaḥ sarve bāṣpākulekṣaṇāḥ

vulgate_text: hataṃ ghaṭotkacaṃ jñātvā vāsudevaḥ pratāpavān / vinadya ca mahānādaṃ paryaṣvajata phalgunam
ce_text: vāsudevas tu harṣeṇa mahatābhipariplutaḥ / nanāda siṃhavan nādaṃ vyathayann iva bhārata / vinadya ca mahānādaṃ paryaṣvajata phalgunam

vulgate_text: kavacena vihīnaśca kuṇḍalābhyāṃ ca pāṇḍava / so'dya mānuṣatāṃ prāpto vimuktaḥ śakradattayā
ce_text: tapānte toyado yadvac charadhārāḥ kṣaraty asau / divyāstrajaladaḥ karṇaḥ parjanya iva vṛṣṭimān / so 'dya mānuṣatāṃ prāpto vimuktaḥ śakradattayā

vulgate_text: phalgunasya hi sā mṛtyuriti cintayato'niśam / na nidrā na ca me hārṣo manaso'sti yudhāṃvara
ce_text: phalgunasya hi tāṃ mṛtyum avagamya yuyutsataḥ / na nidrā na ca me harṣo manaso 'sti yudhāṃ vara

vulgate_text: tato bherīḥ samājaghnuḥ paṇavānakagomukhān śahkhaśabdaravāṃścaiva pāṇiśabdāṃśca daṃśitāḥ / pāñcālāḥ pāṇḍavāścaiva yudhiṣṭhirapurogamāḥ
ce_text: tato bherīḥ samājaghnuḥ śaṅkhān dadhmuś ca daṃśitāḥ / pāñcālāḥ pāṇḍavāś caiva yudhiṣṭhirapurogamāḥ

vulgate_text: asmākaṃ ca mahārāja parebhyo bahavo janāḥ / yoddhavyamiti tiṣṭhanto nidāsaṃraktalocanāḥ
ce_text: nānāvāco vimuñcanto nidrāndhās te mahāraṇe / yoddhavyam iti tiṣṭhanto nidrāsaṃsaktalocanāḥ

vulgate_text: saṃsarpanto raṇe kecinnidrāndhāste tathāparān / jaghruḥ śūrā raṇe śūrāṃstasmiṃstamasi dāruṇe
ce_text: saṃmardyānye raṇe ke cin nidrāndhāś ca parasparam / jaghnuḥ śūrā raṇe rājaṃs tasmiṃs tamasi dāruṇe

vulgate_text: tattathā nidrayā bhagnaṃ tadbabhau niḥsvanaṃ balam / kuśalaiḥ śilpibhirnyastaṃ paṭe citramivādbhutam
ce_text: tat tathā nidrayā bhagnam avācam asvapad balam / kuśalair iva vinyastaṃ paṭe citram ivādbhutam

vulgate_text: rathā rathairibhairnāgāstathaiva bharatarṣabha / saṃsaktāśca viyuktāśca yodhāḥ sannyapatanraṇe
ce_text: rathair hayā hayair nāgāḥ pādātāś cāpi kuñjaraiḥ / hayā hayaiḥ samājagmuḥ pādātāś ca padātibhiḥ / saṃsaktāś ca viyuktāś ca yodhāḥ saṃnyapatan raṇe

vulgate_text: taddhoraṃ mahadāścaryaṃ yuddhaṃ daivāsuropamam / ratharṣabhāṇāmugrāṇāṃ sannipātamamānuṣam
ce_text: tad ghoraṃ mahad āścaryaṃ sarve praikṣan samantataḥ / ratharṣabhāṇām ugrāṇāṃ saṃnipātam amānuṣam

vulgate_text: apasavyaṃ kṛtaṃ saṅkhye bhrātṛvyenātyamarṣiṇā nāmṛṣyata tamapyājau praticakre parantapaḥ / putrastava mahārāja rājā duryodhano drutam
ce_text: apasavyaṃ kṛtaḥ saṃkhye bhrātṛvyenātyamarṣiṇā / so 'marṣitas tam apy ājau praticakre 'pasavyataḥ

vulgate_text: sa nivṛttastataḥ karṇaḥ saṅghaṭṭita ivoragaḥ bhīmamāvārayāmāsa vikiranniśitāñcharān / tato'bhūttumulaṃ yuddhaṃ bhīmarādheyayostadā
ce_text: saṃnyavartata taṃ karṇaḥ saṃghaṭṭita ivoragaḥ / tad abhūt tumulaṃ yuddhaṃ bhīmarādheyayos tadā

vulgate_text: tato bhīmaḥ punargurvīṃ cikṣepādhirathergadām / tāṃ gadāṃ bahubhiḥ karṇaḥ supuṅkhaiḥ supravejitaiḥ
ce_text: tato bhīmaḥ punar gurvīṃ cikṣepādhirather gadām / tāṃ śarair daśabhiḥ karṇaḥ supuṅkhaiḥ susamāhitaiḥ / pratyavidhyat punaś cānyaiḥ sā bhīmaṃ punar āvrajat

vulgate_text: pratyavidhyatpunaścānyaiḥ sā bhīmaṃ punarāvrajat / vyālīva mantrābhihatā karṇabāṇairabhidrutā
ce_text: tato bhīmaḥ punar gurvīṃ cikṣepādhirather gadām / tāṃ śarair daśabhiḥ karṇaḥ supuṅkhaiḥ susamāhitaiḥ / pratyavidhyat punaś cānyaiḥ sā bhīmaṃ punar āvrajat

vulgate_text: sa karṇaṃ sāyakānaṣṭau vyasṛjatkrodhamūrcchitaḥ / taistasya niśitaistīkṣṇairbhīmaseno mahābalaḥ
ce_text: sa karṇe sāyakān aṣṭau vyasṛjat krodhamūrchitaḥ / dhvaje śarāsane caiva śarāvāpe ca bhārata

vulgate_text: karṇo'pyanyaddhanurgṛhya hemapṛṣṭhaṃ durāsadam tataḥ punastu rādheyo hayānasya ratheṣubhiḥ / ṛkṣavarṇāñjaghānāśu tathobhau pārṣṇisārathī
ce_text: tataḥ punas tu rādheyo hayān asya ratheṣubhiḥ / ṛṣyavarṇāñ jaghānāśu tathobhau pārṣṇisārathī

vulgate_text: tatrāsmāntarhitā vāco vyacaranta punaḥ punaḥ / droṇapārthastavopetā vyaśrūyanta narādhipa
ce_text: tatra smāntarhitā vāco vyacaranta punaḥ punaḥ / droṇasya stavasaṃyuktāḥ pārthasya ca mahātmanaḥ / visṛjyamāneṣv astreṣu jvālayatsu diśo daśa

vulgate_text: visṛjyamāneṣvastreṣu jvālayastu diśo daśa / abruvaṃstatra siddhāśca ṛṣayaśca samāgatāḥ
ce_text: tatra smāntarhitā vāco vyacaranta punaḥ punaḥ / droṇasya stavasaṃyuktāḥ pārthasya ca mahātmanaḥ / visṛjyamāneṣv astreṣu jvālayatsu diśo daśa

vulgate_text: yadā droṇaṃ mahārāja viśeṣayati pāṇḍavaḥ / tato droṇo brāhmamastraṃ prāduścakre mahāmatiḥ
ce_text: tato droṇo brāhmam astraṃ prāduścakre mahāmatiḥ / saṃtāpayan raṇe pārthaṃ bhūtāny antarhitāni ca

vulgate_text: tadastraṃ saṃhitaṃ rājandhorarūpaṃ mahāhave / santāpayadraṇe pārthaṃ bhūtānyantarhitāni ca
ce_text: tato droṇo brāhmam astraṃ prāduścakre mahāmatiḥ / saṃtāpayan raṇe pārthaṃ bhūtāny antarhitāni ca

vulgate_text: ityevaṃ vyaktamābhāṣya pratibhāṣya ca sātyakiḥ / abhyayāttūrṇamavyagro dayāṃ nākurutātmani
ce_text: ity evaṃ vyaktam ābhāṣya pratibhāṣya ca sātyakiḥ / abhyayāt tūrṇam avyagro nirapekṣo viśāṃ pate

vulgate_text: bhīmasenastu saṅkruddhaḥ sūtaputramayodhayat tasmiṃstathā vartamāne kruddho dharmasuto'bravīt / pāñcālānāṃ naravyāghrānmātsyāṃśca puruṣarṣabhān
ce_text: saṃkule vartamāne tu rājā dharmasuto 'bravīt / pāñcālānāṃ naravyāghrān matsyānāṃ ca nararṣabhān

vulgate_text: naiṣa yuddhena saṅgrāme jetuṃ śakyaḥ kathañcana / sadhanurdhanvināṃ śreṣṭho devairapi savāsavaiḥ
ce_text: naiṣa yuddhena saṃgrāme jetuṃ śakyaḥ kathaṃ cana / api vṛtrahaṇā yuddhe rathayūthapayūthapaḥ

vulgate_text: nyastaśastrastu saṅgārame śakyo hantuṃ bhavennṛbhiḥ āsthīyatāṃ jaye yogo dharmamutsṛjya pāṇḍavāḥ / yathā na saṃyuge sarvānnihanyādrukmavāhanaḥ
ce_text: āsthīyatāṃ jaye yogo dharmam utsṛjya pāṇḍava / yathā vaḥ saṃyuge sarvān na hanyād rukmavāhanaḥ

vulgate_text: vidhūya tānbāṇagaṇānpāñcālānāṃ mahārathaḥ / prāduścakre tato droṇo brāhmamastraṃ parantapaḥ
ce_text: tato droṇo brāhmam astraṃ prāduścakre mahāmatiḥ / saṃtāpayan raṇe pārthaṃ bhūtāny antarhitāni ca

vulgate_text: utsraṣṭukāmaḥ śastrāṇi ṛṣivākyapracoditaḥ / tejasā pūryamāṇaśca yuyudhe na yathā purā
ce_text: utsraṣṭukāmaḥ śastrāṇi vipravākyābhicoditaḥ / tejasā preryamāṇaś ca yuyudhe so 'timānuṣam

vulgate_text: yaccāsya bāṇavikṛtaṃ dhanūṃṣi ca viśāmpate / sarvaṃ ciccheda durdharṣo gadāṃ khaṅgaṃ ca varjayan
ce_text: yac cāsya bāṇaṃ vikṛtaṃ dhanūṃṣi ca viśāṃ pate / sarvaṃ saṃchidya durdharṣo gadāṃ khaḍgam athāpi ca

vulgate_text: dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ ca vivyādha navabhirniśitaiḥ śaraiḥ / jīvitāntakaraiḥ kruddhaḥ śilādhautaiḥ parantapaḥ
ce_text: dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ tato 'vidhyan navabhir niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ / jīvitāntakaraiḥ kruddhaḥ kruddharūpaṃ paraṃtapaḥ

vulgate_text: sa cchinnadhanvā pāñcālyo nikṛttadhvajasārathiḥ / uttamāmāpadaṃ prāpya gadāṃ vīraḥ parāmṛśat
ce_text: sa chinnadhanvā viratho hatāśvo hatasārathiḥ / uttamām āpadaṃ prāpya gadāṃ vīraḥ parāmṛśat

vulgate_text: tasya pārāvatānaśvānrathaśaktyā parābhinat / sarvānekaikaśo droṇo raktānaśvānvivarjayan
ce_text: tasyāśvān rathaśaktyāsau tadā kruddhaḥ parākramī / sarvān ekaikaśo droṇaḥ kapotābhān ajīghanat

vulgate_text: sa tadā vividhānmargānpravarāṃścaikaviṃśatim / darśayāmāsa kauravya pārṣato vicaranraṇe
ce_text: so 'carad vividhān mārgān prakārān ekaviṃśatim / bhrāntam udbhrāntam āviddham āplutaṃ prasṛtaṃ sṛtam

vulgate_text: sampātaṃ samudīrṇaṃ ca darśayāmāsa pārṣataḥ bhārataṃ kauśikaṃ caiva sātvataṃ caiva śikṣayā
ce_text: parivṛttaṃ nivṛttaṃ ca khaḍgaṃ carma ca dhārayan / saṃpātaṃ samudīrṇaṃ ca darśayām āsa pārṣataḥ

vulgate_text: hastānāmuttamāṅgānāṃ kārmukāṇāṃ ca bhārata chatrāṇāṃ cāpaviddhānāṃ cāmarāṇāṃ ca sañcayaiḥ / rāśayaḥ sma vyadṛśyanta tatratatra raṇājire
ce_text: hastānām uttamāṅgānāṃ kārmukāṇāṃ ca bhārata / chatrāṇāṃ cāpaviddhānāṃ cāmarāṇāṃ ca saṃyuge

vulgate_text: adya droṇaṃ raṇe kruddho ghātayiṣyati pārpataḥ te yūyaṃ sahitā bhūtvā yudhyadhvaṃ kumbhasambhavam
ce_text: yādṛśāni hi rūpāṇi dṛśyante no mahāraṇe / adya droṇaṃ raṇe kruddhaḥ pātayiṣyati pārṣataḥ / te yūyaṃ sahitā bhūtvā kumbhayoniṃ parīpsata

vulgate_text: papāta mahatī colkā ādityānniścarantyuta / dīpayantī ubhe sene śaṃsantīva mahadbhayam
ce_text: papāta mahatī colkā ādityān nirgateva ha / dīpayantīva tāpena śaṃsantīva mahad bhayam

vulgate_text: hataujā iva cāpyāsīdbhāradvājo mahārathaḥ / prāsphurannayanaṃ cāsya vāmabāhustathaiva ca
ce_text: hataujā iva cāpy āsīd bhāradvājo mahārathaḥ / ṛṣīṇāṃ brahmavādānāṃ svargasya gamanaṃ prati / suyuddhena tataḥ prāṇān utsraṣṭum upacakrame

vulgate_text: śvapākavanmlecchagaṇānhatvā cānyānpṛthagvidhān / bharanti hi sutāndārāṃstadvadajñānamohitāḥ
ce_text: śvapākavan mlecchagaṇān hatvā cānyān pṛthagvidhān / ajñānān mūḍhavad brahman putradāradhanepsayā

vulgate_text: sa vai ca nihataḥ śete tava putraḥ sumandadhīḥ / dharmarājasya tadvākyaṃ nābhiśaṅkitumarhasi
ce_text: sa cādya patitaḥ śete pṛṣṭenāveditas tava / dharmarājena tad vākyaṃ nātiśaṅkitum arhasi

vulgate_text: evamuktastato droṇo bhīmenotsṛjya tadvanuḥ sannyāsāya śarīrasya yokṣyamāṇaḥ sa vai dvijaḥ / sarvāṇyastrāṇi dharmātmā hātukāmo'bhyabhāpata
ce_text: evam uktas tato droṇo bhīmenotsṛjya tad dhanuḥ / sarvāṇy astrāṇi dharmātmā hātukāmo 'bhyabhāṣata / karṇa karṇa maheṣvāsa kṛpa duryodhaneti ca

vulgate_text: karṇaṃ duryodhanaṃ rājaṃstvaramāṇaḥ parākramam / karṇakarṇa maheṣvāsa kṛpa duryodhaneti ca
ce_text: evam uktas tato droṇo bhīmenotsṛjya tad dhanuḥ / sarvāṇy astrāṇi dharmātmā hātukāmo 'bhyabhāṣata / karṇa karṇa maheṣvāsa kṛpa duryodhaneti ca

vulgate_text: tasya tacchidranājñāya dhṛṣṭadyumnaḥ pratāpavān saśaraṃ tadvanurghoraṃ sannyasyātha rathe tataḥ / khaṅgī rathādavaplutya sahasā droṇamabhyayāt
ce_text: tasya tac chidram ājñāya dhṛṣṭadyumnaḥ samutthitaḥ / khaḍgī rathād avaplutya sahasā droṇam abhyayāt

vulgate_text: pradrute tvatha droṇāya dhṛṣṭadyumne mahārathe / hāhākṛtāni bhūtāni mānuṣāṇītarāṇi ca
ce_text: hāhākṛtāni bhūtāni mānuṣāṇītarāṇi ca / droṇaṃ tathāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā dhṛṣṭadyumnavaśaṃ gatam

vulgate_text: smaritvā devadeveśamakṣaraṃ paramaṃ prabhum / divamākrāmadācāryaḥ sākṣātsadbhirdurākramām
ce_text: tathoktvā yogam āsthāya jyotirbhūto mahātapāḥ / divam ākrāmad ācāryaḥ sadbhiḥ saha durākramam

vulgate_text: samapadyata colkābhaṃ droṇasya nidhane tadā / nimeṣamātreṇa ca tajjyotirantaradhīyata
ce_text: nimeṣamātreṇa ca taj jyotir antaradhīyata / āsīt kilakilāśabdaḥ prahṛṣṭānāṃ divaukasām / brahmalokaṃ gate droṇe dhṛṣṭadyumne ca mohite

vulgate_text: anye tu sarve nāpaśyanbhāradvājasya dhīmataḥ mahimānaṃ mahārāja yogayuktasya gacchataḥ / brahmalokaṃ mahaddivyaṃ devaguhyaṃ hi tatparam
ce_text: anye tu sarve nāpaśyan bhāradvājasya dhīmataḥ / mahimānaṃ mahārāja yogamuktasya gacchataḥ

vulgate_text: vitunnāṅgaṃ śaravrātairanyastāyudhamasṛkkṣaram vikṛṣya pārṣataḥ khaṅgaṃ krodhāmarṣavaśaṃ gataḥ / dṛśyamānaḥ sarvabhūtaiḥ keśapakṣe parāmṛśat
ce_text: vitunnāṅgaṃ śaraśatair nyastāyudham asṛkkṣaram / dhikkṛtaḥ pārṣatas taṃ tu sarvabhūtaiḥ parāmṛśat

vulgate_text: saṃśaptakagaṇādgṛhya hataśeṣānkirīṭinā / suśarmā prādrāvadrājandṛṣṭvā droṇaṃ nipātitam
ce_text: padātigaṇasaṃyuktas trasto rājan bhayārditaḥ / ulūkaḥ prādravat tatra dṛṣṭvā droṇaṃ nipātitam

vulgate_text: gajānrathānsamāruhya vyudasya ca hayāñjanāḥ / prādravansarvataḥ saṅkhye dṛṣṭvā rukmarathaṃ hatam
ce_text: gajān rathān samāruhya parasyāpi hayāñ janāḥ / prakīrṇakeśā vidhvastā na dvāv ekatra dhāvataḥ

vulgate_text: tiṣṭhatiṣṭheti na ca te svayaṃ tatrāvatasthire dhuryānunmucya ca rathāddhatasūtātsvalaṅkṛtān / adhiruhya hayānyodhāḥ kṣipraṃ padbhiracodayan
ce_text: dhuryān pramucya tu rathād dhatasūtān svalaṃkṛtān / adhiruhya hayān yodhāḥ kṣipraṃ padbhir acodayan

vulgate_text: tamatathyabhaye magno jaye sakto yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / aśvatthāmānamāyodhe hataṃ dṛṣṭvā mahāgajam
ce_text: tam atathyabhaye magno jaye sakto yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / avyaktam abravīd rājan hataḥ kuñjara ity uta

vulgate_text: jānannapyanṛtasyātha doṣānsa dvijasattamam / avyaktamabravīdrājā hataḥ kuñjara ityuta
ce_text: tam atathyabhaye magno jaye sakto yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / avyaktam abravīd rājan hataḥ kuñjara ity uta

vulgate_text: sa tvāṃ nihatamākrande śrutvā santāpatāpitaḥ / niyamya divyānyastrāṇi nāyudhyata yathā purā
ce_text: tac chrutvā vimanās tatra ācāryo mahad apriyam / niyamya divyāny astrāṇi nāyudhyata yathā purā

vulgate_text: bhṛśamiṣvasanādadya matprayuktā mahāhave / darśayantaḥ śarā vīryaṃ pramathiṣyanti pāṇḍavān
ce_text: kṛśāśvatanayā hy adya matprayuktā mahāmṛdhe / darśayanto ''tmano vīryaṃ pramathiṣyanti pāṇḍavān

vulgate_text: paraśvathāṃśca niśitānutsrakṣye'hamasaṃśayam
ce_text: yatheṣṭam aśmavarṣeṇa pravarṣiṣye raṇe sthitaḥ / ayomukhaiś ca vihagair drāvayiṣye mahārathān / paraśvadhāṃś ca vividhān prasakṣye 'ham asaṃśayam

vulgate_text: hayapṛṣṭhagatāścānye kṛṣyante'rdhacyutāsanāḥ / gajaskandheṣu saṃsyūtā nārācaiścalitāsanāḥ
ce_text: gajaskandheṣu saṃsyūtā nārācaiś calitāsanāḥ / śarārtair vidrutair nāgair hṛtāḥ ke cid diśo daśa

vulgate_text: jalena kledayantyanye vimucya kavacanānyapi / palāyanaparāścānye yodhāḥ śatasahasraśaḥ
ce_text: putrān pitṝn sakhīn bhrātṝn samāropya dṛḍhakṣatān / jalena kledayanty anye vimucya kavacāny api

vulgate_text: hīmantaṃ taṃ mahābāhuṃ mattadviradagāminam / indraviṣmusamaṃ vīrye kope'ntakamiva sthitam
ce_text: hrīmantaṃ taṃ mahābāhuṃ mattadviradagāminam / vyākhyāsyāmy ugrakarmāṇaṃ kurūṇām abhayaṃkaram

vulgate_text: bṛhaspatisamaṃ buddhyā nītimantaṃ mahāratham / ākhyāsyāmyugrakarmāṇaṃ kurūṇāmabhayaṅkaram
ce_text: hrīmantaṃ taṃ mahābāhuṃ mattadviradagāminam / vyākhyāsyāmy ugrakarmāṇaṃ kurūṇām abhayaṃkaram

vulgate_text: vāsudeve sthite cāpi droṇaputraṃ praśaṃsasi / yaḥ kalāṃ ṣoḍaśīṃ pūrṇāṃ dhanañjaya na te'rhati
ce_text: adharmam etad vipulaṃ dhārmikaḥ san na budhyase / yat tvam ātmānam asmāṃś ca praśaṃsyān na praśaṃsasi / yaḥ kalāṃ ṣoḍaśīṃ tvatto nārhate taṃ praśaṃsasi

vulgate_text: mama nāgāyutaṃ pārtha balaṃ bāhvorvidhīyate / dārayeyaṃ mahīṃ krodhādvikireyaṃ ca parvatān
ce_text: svayam evātmano vaktuṃ na yuktaṃ guṇasaṃstavam / dārayeyaṃ mahīṃ krodhād vikireyaṃ ca parvatān

vulgate_text: nānṛtī pāṇḍavo jyeṣṭho nāhaṃ vā'dhārmiko'rjuna / na kṣatriya iti prāhuryo na hanti raṇājire
ce_text: nānṛtaḥ pāṇḍavo jyeṣṭho nāhaṃ vādhārmiko 'rjuna / śiṣyadhruṅ nihataḥ pāpo yudhyasva vijayas tava

vulgate_text: yaḥ kṣatriyasuto hanyātpitaraṃ vā guruṃ ca vā aniṣṭaṃ kṣatriyo hanyātsa vai kṣatriya ucyate / śiṣyadrohī hataḥ pāpo yudhyasva vijayastava
ce_text: nānṛtaḥ pāṇḍavo jyeṣṭho nāhaṃ vādhārmiko 'rjuna / śiṣyadhruṅ nihataḥ pāpo yudhyasva vijayas tava

vulgate_text: tasminnākruśyati droṇe samakṣaṃ pāpakarmaṇā / nīcaṃ karma kṛtaṃ tena kṣudreṇa gurughātinā
ce_text: tasminn ākruśyati droṇe maharṣitanaye tadā / nīcātmanā nṛśaṃsena kṣudreṇa gurughātinā

vulgate_text: adharmeṇāpakṛṣṭaśca madrarājaḥ parairitaḥ / adharmeṇa tathā bālaḥ saubhadro vinipātitaḥ
ce_text: adharmeṇāpakṛṣṭaś ca madrarājaḥ parair itaḥ / ito 'py adharmeṇa hato bhīṣmaḥ kurupitāmahaḥ / bhūriśravā hy adharmeṇa tvayā dharmavidā hataḥ

vulgate_text: ito'pyadharmeṇa hato bhīṣmaḥ parapurañjayaḥ / bhūriśravā hyadharmeṇa tvayā dharmavidā hataḥ
ce_text: adharmeṇāpakṛṣṭaś ca madrarājaḥ parair itaḥ / ito 'py adharmeṇa hato bhīṣmaḥ kurupitāmahaḥ / bhūriśravā hy adharmeṇa tvayā dharmavidā hataḥ

vulgate_text: catuścakrā dvicakrāśca śataghno bahulā gadāḥ / cakrāṇi ca kṣurāntāni maṇḍalānīva bhāsvataḥ
ce_text: caturdiśaṃ vicitrāś ca śataghnyo 'tha hutāśadāḥ / cakrāṇi ca kṣurāntāni maṇḍalānīva bhāsvataḥ

vulgate_text: vāsudevo'pi dharmātmā kariṣyatyātmanaḥ kṣamam / śreyo hyupadiśatyeṣa lokasya kimutātmanaḥ
ce_text: vāsudevo 'pi dharmātmā kariṣyaty ātmanaḥ kṣamam / upadeṣṭuṃ samartho 'yaṃ lokasya kim utātmanaḥ

vulgate_text: pravavuśca śivā vātāḥ praśāntā mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ / vāhanāni ca hṛṣṭāni praśānte'stre sudurjaye
ce_text: pravavuś ca śivā vātāḥ praśāntā mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ / vāhanāni ca hṛṣṭāni yodhāś ca manujeśvara

vulgate_text: eṣa cāstrapratīghātaṃ vāsudevaḥ prayuktavān / asya tu hyeṣa vai dātā mānuṣeṣu na vidyate
ce_text: eṣa cāstrapratīghātaṃ vāsudevaḥ prayuktavān / anyathā vihitaḥ saṃkhye vadhaḥ śatror janādhipa

vulgate_text: tvayi śastrāṇi divyāni tryambake cāmitaujasi ghnataitānsumahāvīrya śātravānyudvakovidaḥ / icchato na hi te mucyetsaṅkruddho hi purandaraḥ
ce_text: tvayi hy astrāṇi divyāni yathā syus tryambake tathā / icchato na hi te mucyet kruddhasyāpi puraṃdaraḥ

vulgate_text: te viṃśatipade yattā guruputramamarṣaṇam / pañcabhiḥ pañcabhirbāṇairabhyaghnansarvataḥ samam
ce_text: kirīṭī bhīmasenaś ca vṛddhakṣatraś ca pauravaḥ / yuvarājaś ca cedīnāṃ mālavaś ca sudarśanaḥ / pañcabhiḥ pañcabhir bāṇair abhyaghnan sarvataḥ samam

vulgate_text: sūtaṃ vidvvāḥ bhīmasenasya ṣaḍbhi-- rdvābhyāṃ vidvvā kārmukaṃ ca dhvajaṃ ca / punaḥ pārthaṃ śaravarṣeṇa vidvvā drauṇirghoraṃ siṃhanādaṃ nanāda
ce_text: tato 'rjunaṃ ṣaḍbhir athājaghāna drauṇāyanir daśabhir vāsudevam / bhīmaṃ daśārdhair yuvarājaṃ caturbhir dvābhyāṃ chittvā kārmukaṃ ca dhvajaṃ ca / punaḥ pārthaṃ śaravarṣeṇa viddhvā drauṇir ghoraṃ siṃhanādaṃ nanāda

vulgate_text: taṃ dṛṣṭvā pradrutairaśvairapakṛṣṭaṃ raṇājirāt / dadhmau pramuditaḥ śaṅkhaṃ bṛhantamaparājitaḥ
ce_text: tān nihatya raṇe vīro droṇaputro yudhāṃ patiḥ / dadhmau pramuditaḥ śaṅkhaṃ bṛhantam aparājitaḥ

vulgate_text: te vadhyamānāḥ samare droṇaputreṇa pārthivāḥ / droṇaputrabhayādrājandiśaḥ sarvāśca bhejire
ce_text: te vadhyamānāḥ samare droṇaputreṇa kṣatriyāḥ / droṇaputraṃ bhayād rājan dikṣu sarvāsu menire

vulgate_text: yacca bhūyo'sti tejaste tatsarvaṃ mayi darśaya / sa eva droṇahantā te darpaṃ chetsyati pārṣataḥ
ce_text: sa eva droṇahantā te darpaṃ bhetsyati pārṣataḥ / kālānalasamaprakhyo dviṣatām antako yudhi / samāsādaya pāñcālyaṃ māṃ cāpi sahakeśavam

vulgate_text: kālānalasamaprakhyaṃ dviṣāmantakopamam samāsādaya pāñcālyaṃ māṃ cāpi sahakeśavam / darpaṃ nāśayitāsmyadya tavodvṛttasya saṃyuge
ce_text: sa eva droṇahantā te darpaṃ bhetsyati pārṣataḥ / kālānalasamaprakhyo dviṣatām antako yudhi / samāsādaya pāñcālyaṃ māṃ cāpi sahakeśavam

vulgate_text: tatastumulamākāśe śaravarṣamajāyata / pāvakārciparītaṃ tatpārthamevābhipupluve
ce_text: tatas tumulam ākāśe śaravarṣam ajāyata / vavuś ca śiśirā vātāḥ sūryo naiva tatāpa ca

vulgate_text: rakṣāṃsi ca piśācāśca vineduratisaṅgatāḥ / vavuścāśiśirā vātāḥ sūryo naiva tatāpa ca
ce_text: tatas tumulam ākāśe śaravarṣam ajāyata / vavuś ca śiśirā vātāḥ sūryo naiva tatāpa ca

vulgate_text: vāyasāścāpi cākrandandikṣu sarvāsu bhairavam / rudhiraṃ cāpi varṣanto ninedustoyadā divi
ce_text: cukruśur dānavāś cāpi dikṣu sarvāsu bhairavam / rudhiraṃ cāpi varṣanto vinedus toyadāmbare

vulgate_text: digbhyaḥ pradigbhyaḥ khādbhūmeḥ sarvataḥ śaravṛṣṭayaḥ / uccāvacā nipeturvai garuḍānilaraṃhasaḥ
ce_text: diśaḥ khaṃ pradiśaś caiva bhuvaṃ ca śaravṛṣṭayaḥ / uccāvacā nipetur vai garuḍānilaraṃhasaḥ

vulgate_text: apare pradrutā nāgā bhayatrastā viśāmpate / tresurdiśo yathā pūrvaṃ vane dāvāgnisaṃvṛtāḥ
ce_text: apare pradrutās tatra dahyamānā mahāgajāḥ / tresus tathāpare ghore vane dāvāgnisaṃvṛtāḥ

vulgate_text: sarvaghāni mayā muktamastraṃ paramadāruṇam / kenemau martyadharmāṇau nādhākṣītkeśavārjunau
ce_text: kenemau martyadharmāṇau nāvadhīt keśavārjunau / etat prabrūhi bhagavan mayā pṛṣṭo yathātatham

vulgate_text: etatprabrūhi bhagavanmayā pṛṣṭo yathātatham / śrotumicchāmi tattvena sarvametanmahāmune
ce_text: kenemau martyadharmāṇau nāvadhīt keśavārjunau / etat prabrūhi bhagavan mayā pṛṣṭo yathātatham

vulgate_text: yo'sau nārāyaṇo nāma pūrveṣāmapi pūrvajaḥ / ādidevo jagannātho lokakartā svayaṃ prabhuḥ
ce_text: yo 'sau nārāyaṇo nāma pūrveṣām api pūrvajaḥ / ajāyata ca kāryārthaṃ putro dharmasya viśvakṛt

vulgate_text: devānāṃ hitakāmārthaṃ lokānāṃ caiva sattamaḥ / ajāyata ca kāryārthaṃ putro dharmasya viśvakṛt
ce_text: yo 'sau nārāyaṇo nāma pūrveṣām api pūrvajaḥ / ajāyata ca kāryārthaṃ putro dharmasya viśvakṛt

vulgate_text: aṇīyāṃsamaṇubhyaśca bṛhadbhyaśca bṛhattamam / rudramīśānavṛṣabhaṃ haraṃ śaṃbhuṃ kapardinam
ce_text: dadarśa bhṛśadurdarśaṃ sarvadevair apīśvaram / aṇīyasām aṇīyāṃsaṃ bṛhadbhyaś ca bṛhattaram

vulgate_text: cekitānaṃ parāṃ yoniṃ tiṣṭhato gacchataśca ha durvāraṇaṃ sudurdharṣaṃ durnirīkṣyaṃ durāsadam / atimanyuṃ mahātmānaṃ sarvabhūtapracetasam
ce_text: durvāraṇaṃ durdṛśaṃ tigmamanyuṃ mahātmānaṃ sarvaharaṃ pracetasam / divyaṃ cāpam iṣudhī cādadānaṃ hiraṇyavarmāṇam anantavīryam

vulgate_text: varadaṃ pṛthucārvaṅgyā pārvatyā sahitaṃ prabhum / krīḍamānaṃ mahātmānaṃ bhūtasaṅghagaṇairvṛtam
ce_text: varadaṃ pṛthucārvaṅgyā pārvatyā sahitaṃ prabhum / ajam īśānam avyagraṃ kāraṇātmānam acyutam

vulgate_text: divyāmṛtau mānasau dvau suparṇā-- vavākśākhaḥ pippalaḥ saptagoptaḥ / vācaścārthā devatāḥ lokapālā lokānanye ye purā dhārayitvā gatā hi tebhyaḥ paramaṃ tatparaṃ ca tvatsambhūtāste ca tebhyaḥ parastvam
ce_text: divyāvṛtau mānasau dvau suparṇāv avākśākhaḥ pippalaḥ sapta gopāḥ / daśāpy anye ye puraṃ dhārayanti tvayā sṛṣṭās te hi tebhyaḥ paras tvam / bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhavitā cāpy adhṛṣyaṃ tvatsaṃbhūtā bhuvanānīha viśvā

vulgate_text: bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhavitā cāpradhṛṣyaṃ tvatsambhūtā bhuvanānīha viśvā / bhaktaṃ ca māṃ bhajamānaṃ bhajasva prītyā māṃ vai lokapitāmaheśa
ce_text: divyāvṛtau mānasau dvau suparṇāv avākśākhaḥ pippalaḥ sapta gopāḥ / daśāpy anye ye puraṃ dhārayanti tvayā sṛṣṭās te hi tebhyaḥ paras tvam / bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhavitā cāpy adhṛṣyaṃ tvatsaṃbhūtā bhuvanānīha viśvā

vulgate_text: evamādīnvarām̐llabdhvā prasādādatha śūlinaḥ / sa eṣa devaścarati māyayā mohayañjagat
ce_text: evam ete varā labdhāḥ purastād viddhi śauriṇā / sa eṣa devaś carati māyayā mohayañ jagat

vulgate_text: haṣṭaromā ca vaśyātmā so'bhivādya maharṣaye / varūthinīmabhiprekṣya hyavahāramakārayat
ce_text: hṛṣṭalomā ca vaśyātmā namaskṛtya maharṣaye / varūthinīm abhipretya avahāram akārayat

vulgate_text: mahādevaṃ haraṃ sthāṇuṃ varadaṃ bhuvaneśvaram / jagatpradhānamajitaṃ jagatprītimadhīśvaram
ce_text: īśānaṃ varadaṃ pārtha dṛṣṭavān asi śaṃkaram / taṃ gaccha śaraṇaṃ devaṃ sarvādiṃ bhuvaneśvaram
