vulgate_text: jñānātmānaṃ jñānagamyaṃ jñānaśreṣṭhaṃ sudurvidam / dātāraṃ caiva bhaktānāṃ prasādavihitānvarān
ce_text: mahādevaṃ mahātmānam īśānaṃ jaṭilaṃ śivam / tryakṣaṃ mahābhujaṃ rudraṃ śikhinaṃ cīravāsasam / dātāraṃ caiva bhaktānāṃ prasādavihitān varān

vulgate_text: ye bhaktā varadaṃ deva śivaṃ rudramumāpatim / ananyabhāvena sadā sarveśaṃ samupāsate
ce_text: ye bhaktā varadaṃ devaṃ śivaṃ rudram umāpatim / iha loke sukhaṃ prāpya te yānti paramāṃ gatim

vulgate_text: saṅgrāmeṣu jayaṃ prāpya pālayanti mahīmimām / iha loke sukhaṃ prāpya te yānti paramāṃ gatim
ce_text: ye bhaktā varadaṃ devaṃ śivaṃ rudram umāpatim / iha loke sukhaṃ prāpya te yānti paramāṃ gatim

vulgate_text: namo vṛkṣāya senānye madhyamāya namonamaḥ harikeśāya muṇḍāya kṛśāyottāraṇāya ca / bhāskāraya sutīrthāya devadevāya raṃhase
ce_text: kāmyāya harinetrāya sthāṇave puruṣāya ca / harikeśāya muṇḍāya kṛśāyottaraṇāya ca

vulgate_text: bahurūpāya viśvasya pataye muñcavāsase sahasraśirase caiva sahasracaraṇāya ca / sahasrabāhave caiva sahasravadanāya ca
ce_text: sahasraśirase caiva sahasranayanāya ca / sahasrabāhave caiva sahasracaraṇāya ca

vulgate_text: dhanurdharāya devāya priyadhanvāya dhanvine / dhanvantarāya dhanuṣe dhanvācāryāya te namaḥ
ce_text: sruvahastāya devāya sukhadhanvāya dhanvine / dhanvantarāya dhanuṣe dhanvācāryāya dhanvine

vulgate_text: vanaspatīnāṃ pataye narāṇāṃ pataye namaḥ / mātṝṇāṃ pataye caiva gaṇānāṃ pataye namaḥ
ce_text: vanaspatīnāṃ pataye narāṇāṃ pataye namaḥ / apāṃ ca pataye nityaṃ yajñānāṃ pataye namaḥ

vulgate_text: dakṣasya yajamānasya vidhivatsaṃbhṛtaṃ purā vivyādha kupito yajñaṃ nirdayastvabhavattadā / dhanuṣā bāṇamutsṛjya saghoṣaṃ vinanāda ca
ce_text: vivyādha kupito yajñaṃ nirbhayas tu bhavas tadā / dhanuṣā bāṇam utsṛjya saghoṣaṃ vinanāda ca

vulgate_text: punaśca sandadhe dīptāndevānāṃ niśitāñśarān / sadhūmānsasphuliṅgāṃśca vidyuttoyadasannibhān
ce_text: tato niścakramur devā vepamānā natāḥ sma tam / punaś ca saṃdadhe dīptaṃ devānāṃ niśitaṃ śaram

vulgate_text: taṃ dṛṣṭvā tu surāḥ sarve praṇipatya maheśvaram / rudrasya yajñabhāgaṃ ca viśiṣṭaṃ te tvakalpayan
ce_text: rudrasya yajñabhāgaṃ ca viśiṣṭaṃ te nv akalpayan / bhayena tridaśā rājañ śaraṇaṃ ca prapedire

vulgate_text: bhayena tridaśā rājañcharaṇaṃ ca prapedire tena caivātikopena sa yajñaḥ sandhitastadā / bhagnāścāpi surā āsanbhītāścādyāpi taṃ prati
ce_text: tena caivātikopena sa yajñaḥ saṃdhitas tadā / yattāś cāpi surā āsan yattāś cādyāpi taṃ prati

vulgate_text: sauvarṇaṃ kamalākṣasya tārakākṣasya rājatam tṛtīyaṃ tu puraṃ teṣāṃ vidyunmālina āyasam / na śaktastāni maghavānbhettuṃ sarvāyudhairapi
ce_text: āyasaṃ tārakākṣasya kamalākṣasya rājatam / sauvarṇaṃ paramaṃ hy āsīd vidyunmālina eva ca

vulgate_text: sa tathoktastathetyuktvā devānāṃ hitakāmyayā / gandhamādanavindhyau ca kṛtvā vaṃśadhvajau haraḥ
ce_text: sa tathoktas tathety uktvā devānāṃ hitakāmyayā / atiṣṭhat sthāṇubhūtaḥ sa sahasraṃ parivatsarān

vulgate_text: stūyamānaḥ suraiḥ pārtha ṛṣibhiśca tapodhanaiḥ sthānaṃ māheśvaraṃ kṛtvā divyamapratimaṃ prabhuḥ / atiṣṭhatsthāṇubhūtaḥ sa sahasraṃ parivatsarān
ce_text: sa tathoktas tathety uktvā devānāṃ hitakāmyayā / atiṣṭhat sthāṇubhūtaḥ sa sahasraṃ parivatsarān

vulgate_text: te mayā sahitā yūyaṃ prāpadyadhvaṃ tameva hi] / sa eṣa bhagavāndevaḥ sarvalokeśvaraḥ prabhuḥ
ce_text: bāhuṃ savajraṃ śakrasya kruddhasyāstambhayat prabhuḥ / sa eṣa bhagavān devaḥ sarvalokeśvaraḥ prabhuḥ

vulgate_text: api varṣasahasreṇa satataṃ pāṇḍunandana / sarvairgrahairgṛhītānvai sarvapāpasamanvitān
ce_text: sarvair grahair gṛhītān vai sarvapāpasamanvitān / sa mocayati suprītaḥ śaraṇyaḥ śaraṇāgatān

vulgate_text: tasya devasya yadvaktraṃ samudre tadadhiṣṭhitam / baḍabāmukheti vikhyātaṃ pibattoyamayaṃ haviḥ
ce_text: bahubhir bahudhā rūpair viśvaṃ vyāpnoti vai jagat / asya devasya yad vaktraṃ samudre tad atiṣṭhata

vulgate_text: nirāśānpāṇḍavānkṛtvā dṛḍhaṃ rājansasātyakān / pāñcālānāṃ rathāṃścaiva vinihatya sahasraśaḥ
ce_text: sa pīḍayitvā pāñcālān pāṇḍavāṃś ca tarasvinaḥ / hatvā sahasraśo yodhān arjunena nipātitaḥ

vulgate_text: putrāṇāṃ rājyakāmena tvayā rājanhitaiṣiṇā / caritānyahitānyeva teṣāṃ te phalamāgatam
ce_text: putrāṇāṃ rājyakāmānāṃ tvayā rājan hitaiṣiṇā / ahitānīva cīrṇāni teṣāṃ te phalam āgatam

vulgate_text: śokārṇave mahāghore nimagnā bharatastriyaḥ / rurudurduḥkhaśokārtā bhṛśamudvignacetasaḥ
ce_text: sa śabdaḥ pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ pūrayām āsa sarvaśaḥ / śokārṇave mahāghore nimagnā bharatastriyaḥ

vulgate_text: etacchrutvā mahārāja dhṛtarāṣṭro'mbikāsutaḥ dahyamāno'bravītsūtaṃ muhūrtaṃ tiṣṭha sañjaya / vyākulaṃ me manastāta mā tāvatkiṃciducyatām
ce_text: etac chrutvā mahārāja dhṛtarāṣṭro 'mbikāsutaḥ / abravīt saṃjayaṃ sūtaṃ śokavyākulacetanaḥ

vulgate_text: rājāpi nābravītkiñcitsañjayo vidurastathā / tūṣṇīmbhūtastadā so'tha babhūva jagatīpatiḥ
ce_text: muhyamāno 'bravīc cāpi muhūrtaṃ tiṣṭha saṃjaya / vyākulaṃ me manas tāta śrutvā sumahad apriyam / naṣṭacittas tataḥ so 'tha babhūva jagatīpatiḥ

vulgate_text: pitāmahastava tathā bāhlīkaḥ saha bāhlikaiḥ / nihato bhīmasenena mahābālaparākramaḥ
ce_text: pitāmahas tava tathā bāhlikaḥ saha bāhlikaiḥ / bhīmasenena vikramya gamito yamasādanam

vulgate_text: ubhau kaliṅgavṛṣakau bhrātarau yuddhadurmadau / kṛtvā cāsukaraṃ karma gatau vaivasvatakṣayam
ce_text: vindānuvindāv āvantyau rājaputrau mahābalau / kṛtvā nasukaraṃ karma gatau vaivasvatakṣayam

vulgate_text: gokule nityasaṃvṛddhā yuddhe paramakopanāḥ / gopālāḥ kṛtavīrāste nihatāḥ savyasācinā
ce_text: gokule nityasaṃvṛddhā yuddhe paramakovidāḥ / śreṇayo bahusāhasrāḥ saṃśaptakagaṇāś ca ye / te sarve pārtham āsādya gatā vaivasvatakṣayam

vulgate_text: yathā kṛṣṇena narako muruśca nihato raṇe / kārtavīryaśca rāmeṇa bhārgaveṇa yathā hataḥ
ce_text: mahendreṇa yathā vṛtro yathā rāmeṇa rāvaṇaḥ / yathā kṛṣṇena nihato muro raṇanipātitaḥ / kārtavīryaś ca rāmeṇa bhārgaveṇa hato yathā

vulgate_text: yathā skandena mahiṣo yathā rudreṇa cāndhakaḥ / tathā'rjunena sa hato dvairathe yuddhadurmadaḥ
ce_text: tathārjunena nihato dvairathe yuddhadurmadaḥ / sāmātyabāndhavo rājan karṇaḥ praharatāṃ varaḥ

vulgate_text: na kṛtaṃ ca tvayā pūrvaṃ daivena vidhinā balāt / tadidaṃ samanuprāptaṃ vyasanaṃ sumahātyayam
ce_text: ucyamāno mahārāja bandhubhir hitakāṅkṣibhiḥ / tad idaṃ samanuprāptaṃ vyasanaṃ tvāṃ mahātyayam

vulgate_text: droṇaputrasya vikrāntaṃ rādheyasyaiva cobhayoḥ / paśyantu pāṇḍuputrāste viṣṇuvāsavayoriva
ce_text: droṇaputrasya vikrāntaṃ rādheyasyaiva cobhayoḥ / pāṇḍupāñcālasainyeṣu drakṣyathāpi mahātmanoḥ

vulgate_text: sarva eva bhavantaśca śaktāḥ pratyekaśo'pi vā pāṇḍuputrānraṇe hantuṃ sasainyānkisu saṃhatāḥ / vīryavantaḥ kṛtāstrāśca drakṣyathādya parasparam
ce_text: sarva eva bhavantaś ca śūrāḥ prājñāḥ kulodgatāḥ / śīlavantaḥ kṛtāstrāś ca drakṣyathādya parasparam

vulgate_text: saināpatyamathāvāpya karṇo rājanmahārathaḥ / siṃhanādaṃ vinadyoccaiḥ prāyudhyata raṇotkaṭaḥ
ce_text: evam ukte mahārāja karṇo vaikartano nṛpaḥ / siṃhanādaṃ vinadyoccaiḥ prāyudhyata mahābalaḥ

vulgate_text: hatapravarasainyaṃ me yathā śaṃsasi sañjaya / ahatānapi me śaṃsa ye'tra jīvanti kecana
ce_text: hatapravīre sainye 'smin māmake vadatāṃ vara / ahatāñ śaṃsa me sūta ye 'tra jīvanti ke cana

vulgate_text: eteṣu hi mṛteṣvadya ye tvayā parikīrtitāḥ / ye'pi jīvanti te sarve mṛtā iti matirmama
ce_text: eteṣu nihateṣv adya ye tvayā parikīrtitāḥ / ahatān manyase yāṃs tvaṃ te 'pi svargajito matāḥ

vulgate_text: gāndhārarājaḥ sasutaśca rāja-- ndurdyūtadevī kalahapriyaśca / gāndhāramukhyairyavanaiśca rāja-- nvyavasthito yodvukāmastvadarthe
ce_text: ājāneyaiḥ saindhavaiḥ pārvatīyair nadījakāmbojavanāyubāhlikaiḥ / gāndhārarājaḥ svabalena yukto vyavasthito yoddhukāmas tvadarthe

vulgate_text: duryodhano nāgakulasya madhye vyavasthitaḥ siṃha ivābabhāse / rathena jāmbūnadabhūṣaṇena vyavasthitaḥ samare yotsyamānaḥ
ce_text: duryodhano nāgakulasya madhye mahāvīryaḥ saha sainyapravīraiḥ / rathena jāmbūnadabhūṣaṇena vyavasthitaḥ samare yoddhukāmaḥ

vulgate_text: hīniṣevo bhāratarājaputra ugrāyudhaḥ śrutavarmā jayaśca / śalaśca satyavrataduḥśalau ca vyavasthitāḥ sahasainyā narāgryāḥ
ce_text: hrīniṣedhā bharatā rājaputrāś citrāyudhaḥ śrutakarmā jayaś ca / śalaś ca satyavrataduḥśalau ca vyavasthitā balino yoddhukāmāḥ

vulgate_text: athāparau karṇasutau varāstrau vyavasthitau laghuhastau narendra / bale mahatyulbaṇasatvavīryau samāsthitau yodvukāmau tvadarthe
ce_text: karṇātmajaḥ satyaseno mahātmā vyavasthitaḥ samare yoddhukāmaḥ / athāparau karṇasutau varārhau vyavasthitau laghuhastau narendra / balaṃ mahad durbhidam alpadhairyaiḥ samāśritau yotsyamānau tvadarthe

vulgate_text: vyākulaṃ me manastāta śrutvā sumahadapriyam mano muhyati cāṅgāni na ca śaknomi dhāvitum / ityevamuktvā vacanaṃ dhṛtarāṣṭro'mbikāsutaḥ bhrāntacittastataḥ so'tha babhūva jagatīpatiḥ
ce_text: muhyamāno 'bravīc cāpi muhūrtaṃ tiṣṭha saṃjaya / vyākulaṃ me manas tāta śrutvā sumahad apriyam / naṣṭacittas tataḥ so 'tha babhūva jagatīpatiḥ

vulgate_text: yo'jayatsarvakāmbhojānāvantyānkekayaiḥ saha gāndhārānmadrakānmātsyāṃstrigartāṃstaṅkaṇāñśakān
ce_text: yaś cājaiṣīd atibalān amitrān api durjayān / gāndhārān madrakān matsyāṃs trigartāṃs taṅgaṇāñ śakān

vulgate_text: vatsānkaliṅgāndaradānaśmakānṛṣikānapi / śabarānhārahūṇāṃśca praghūṇānsaralānapi
ce_text: vatsān kaliṅgāṃs taralān aśmakān ṛṣikāṃs tathā / yo jitvā samare vīraś cakre balibhṛtaḥ purā

vulgate_text: senāgopaśca sa kathaṃ śatrubhiḥ paramāstravit / ghātitaḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ śūraiḥ samare vīryaśālibhiḥ
ce_text: duryodhanasya vṛddhyarthaṃ pṛthivīṃ yo 'jayat prabhuḥ / sa jitaḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ śūraiḥ samarthair vīryaśālibhiḥ

vulgate_text: yo'jitaḥ pārthivaiḥ śūraiḥ samarthairvīryaśālibhiḥ / duryodhanasya vṛddhyarthaṃ kṛtsnāmurvīmathājayat
ce_text: duryodhanasya vṛddhyarthaṃ pṛthivīṃ yo 'jayat prabhuḥ / sa jitaḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ śūraiḥ samarthair vīryaśālibhiḥ

vulgate_text: taṃ vṛṣaṃ nihataṃ śrutvā dvairathe rathināṃ varam / śokārṇave nimagno'hamapluvaḥ sāgare yathā
ce_text: taṃ śrutvā nihataṃ karṇaṃ dvairathe savyasācinā / śokārṇave nimagno 'ham aplavaḥ sāgare yathā

vulgate_text: śokasyāntaṃ na paśyāmi pāraṃ jalanidheriva / cintā me vardhate'tīva mumūrṣā cāpi jāyate
ce_text: śokasyāntaṃ na paśyāmi samudrasyeva viplukāḥ / cintā me vardhate tīvrā mumūrṣā cāpi jāyate

vulgate_text: duḥkhādduḥkhataraṃ bhanye prāptavānasmi sañjaya / bhīṣmadroṇavadhenaiva karṇasya ca mahātmanaḥ
ce_text: tasmād bhīṣmavadhe caiva droṇasya ca mahātmanaḥ / nātra śeṣaṃ prapaśyāmi sūtaputre hate yudhi

vulgate_text: paṅgorivādhvagamanaṃ daridrasyeva kāmitam / duryodhanasya lobhaśca samānyetāni sañjaya
ce_text: paṅgor ivādhvagamanaṃ daridrasyeva kāmitam / duryodhanasya cākūtaṃ tṛṣitasyeva piplukāḥ

vulgate_text: tathā draupadinā droṇo nyastasarvāyudho yudhi / dharmarājavacaḥ śrutvā aśvatthāmā hatastviti
ce_text: tathā draupadinā droṇo nyastasarvāyudho yudhi / yuktayogo maheṣvāsaḥ śarair bahubhir ācitaḥ / nihataḥ khaḍgam udyamya dhṛṣṭadyumnena saṃjaya

vulgate_text: yaśca māyāsahasrāṇi vikurvāṇaṃ jayaiṣiṇam / ghaṭotkacaṃ rākṣasendraṃ śakraśaktyā nijaghnivān
ce_text: yaś ca māyāsahasrāṇi dhvaṃsayitvā raṇotkaṭam / ghaṭotkacaṃ rākṣasendraṃ śakraśaktyābhijaghnivān

vulgate_text: madrarājo maheṣvāsaḥ śalyaḥ samitiśobhanaḥ dṛṣṭvā vinihataṃ karṇaṃ sārathye rathināṃ varaḥ / kimabhāṣata sauvīro madrāṇāmadhipo balī
ce_text: madrarājo maheṣvāsaḥ śalyaḥ samitiśobhanaḥ / diṣṭaṃ tena hi tat sarvaṃ yathā karṇo nipātitaḥ

vulgate_text: dṛṣṭvā vinihataṃ sarve yodhā vāraṇadurjayāḥ ye ca kena rājānaḥ pṛthivyāṃ yodvumāgatāḥ / vaikartanaṃ hataṃ dṛṣṭavā kānyabhāṣanta sañjaya
ce_text: ye ca ke cana rājānaḥ pṛthivyāṃ yoddhum āgatāḥ / vaikartanaṃ hataṃ dṛṣṭvā kim abhāṣanta saṃjaya

vulgate_text: punaḥ punarna mṛṣyāmi vadhaṃ karṇasya pāṇḍavaiḥ / yasya bāhvorbalaṃ tulyaṃ kuñjarāṇāṃ śataṃ śatam
ce_text: na mṛṣyāmi ca rādheyaṃ hatam āhavaśobhinam / yasya bāhvor balaṃ tulyaṃ kuñjarāṇāṃ śataṃ śatam

vulgate_text: te vayaṃ pravaraṃ nṝṇāṃ sarvairyodhaguṇairyutam / karṇamevābhiṣebhyāmaḥ saināpatyena bhārata
ce_text: te vayaṃ pravaraṃ nṝṇāṃ sarvair guṇagaṇair yutam / karṇaṃ senāpatiṃ kṛtvā pramathiṣyāmahe ripūn

vulgate_text: etadācāryatanayācchrutvā rājaṃstavātmajaḥ / duryodhano mahārāja bhṛśaṃ prītamanāstadā
ce_text: svaṃ manaḥ samavasthāpya bāhuvīryam upāśritaḥ / duryodhano mahārāja rādheyam idam abravīt

vulgate_text: jahi śatrugaṇānsarvānmahendro dānavāniva avasthitaṃ rame dṛṣṭvā pāṇḍavāstvāṃ mahārathāḥ / draviṣyanti ca pāñcālā viṣṇuṃ dṛṣṭveva dānavāḥ
ce_text: avasthitaṃ raṇe jñātvā pāṇḍavās tvāṃ mahāratham / draviṣyanti sapāñcālā viṣṇuṃ dṛṣṭveva dānavāḥ / tasmāt tvaṃ puruṣavyāghra prakarṣethā mahācamūm

vulgate_text: hitaśca priyakāmaśca mama putrasya nityaśaḥ / akarotkiṃ mahāprājñastanmamācakṣva sañjaya
ce_text: yogam ājñāpya senāyā āditye 'bhyudite tadā / akarot kiṃ mahāprājñas tan mamācakṣva saṃjaya

vulgate_text: mahatyapararātre ca tava sainyasya māriṣa / yogo yoga iti hyāśu prādurāsīnmahāsvanaḥ
ce_text: mahaty apararātre tu tava putrasya māriṣa / yogo yogeti sahasā prādurāsīn mahāsvanaḥ

vulgate_text: dhmāpayanvārijaṃ rājanhemajālavibhūṣintam / vidhrunvāno mahaccāpaṃ kārtasvaravibhūṣitam
ce_text: dhamantaṃ vārijaṃ tāta hemajālavibhūṣitam / vidhunvānaṃ mahac cāpaṃ kārtasvaravibhūṣitam

vulgate_text: tataḥ śaṅkhāśca bheryaśca paṇavānakagomukhāḥ / ḍiṇḍimāścāpyahanyanta jharjharāśca samantataḥ
ce_text: tataḥ śaṅkhāś ca bheryaś ca paṇavānakagomukhāḥ / sahasaivābhyahanyanta saśabdāś ca samantataḥ

vulgate_text: ubhe sainye mahārāja prahṛṣṭanarasaṅkule / yodvukāme sthite rājanhantumanyonyamojasā
ce_text: ubhe sene mahāsattve prahṛṣṭanarakuñjare / yoddhukāme sthite rājan hantum anyonyam añjasā

vulgate_text: vijaye jātasaṃrambhe dṛṣṭvā'nyonyaṃ vyavasthite / anīkamadhye rājendra ceratuḥ karṇapāṇḍavau
ce_text: tatra yattau susaṃrabdhau dṛṣṭvānyonyaṃ vyavasthitau / anīkamadhye rājendra rejatuḥ karṇapāṇḍavau

vulgate_text: nṛtyantyāviva te sene sameyātāṃ parasparam / tayoḥ pakṣaprapakṣebhyo niryayuryudvalipsavaḥ
ce_text: nṛtyamāne tu te sene sameyātāṃ parasparam / tayoḥ pakṣaiḥ prapakṣaiś ca nirjagmur vai yuyutsavaḥ

vulgate_text: tato nānārathāśvebhāḥ pattayaścogravikramāḥ / samprahārānbhṛśaṃ cakrurdehapāpmavināśanān
ce_text: tato gajā rathāś cāśvāḥ pattayaś ca mahāhave / saṃprahāraṃ paraṃ cakrur dehapāpmapraṇāśanam

vulgate_text: vyāyatāyatabāhūnāṃ vyāyatāyatabāhubhiḥ / vāhavaḥ pātitā rejurdharaṇyāṃ sāyudhāṅgadaiḥ
ce_text: vyāyatāyatabāhūnāṃ vyāyatāyatabāhubhiḥ / vyāyatā bāhavaḥ petuś chinnamuṣṭyāyudhāṅgadāḥ

vulgate_text: sa papāta mahānāgo bhīmasenasya bhārata / purā nāgasya patanādavaplutya sthito mahīm
ce_text: purā nāgasya patanād avaplutya sthito mahīm / bhīmaseno ripor nāgaṃ gadayā samapothayat

vulgate_text: uddhṛtya svaṅgaṃ niśitamabhyadhāvatsa pāṇḍavam / udyatāyudhamāyāntaṃ sadayā'hanvṛkodaraḥ
ce_text: tasmāt pramathitān nāgāt kṣemadhūrtim avadrutam / udyatāsim upāyāntaṃ gadayāhan vṛkodaraḥ

vulgate_text: kṣurapreṇa sutīkṣṇena hyanuvindaśiro'harat / apatattacchiro rājankuṇḍalopacitaṃ mahat
ce_text: tataḥ kruddho mahārāja sātvato yuddhadurmadaḥ / dhanur anyat samādāya sajyaṃ kṛtvā ca saṃyuge / kṣurapreṇa sutīkṣṇena anuvindaśiro 'harat

vulgate_text: sātyakiṃ ca tatastūrṇaṃ kekayānāṃ mahārathaḥ / śarairanekasāhasrairbāhvorurasi cārpayat
ce_text: sa sātyakiṃ punaḥ kruddhaḥ kekayānāṃ mahārathaḥ / śarair agniśikhākārair bāhvor urasi cārdayat

vulgate_text: sa śaraiḥ kṣatasarvāṅgaḥ sātyakiḥ satyavikramaḥ / rarāja samare rājansapuṣpa iva kiṃśukaḥ
ce_text: tataḥ sa rudhirāktāṅgo rudhireṇa kṛtacchaviḥ / rarāja samare rājan sapuṣpa iva kiṃśukaḥ

vulgate_text: virathāvasiyuddhāya samājagmaturāhave / śatacandracite gṛhya carmaṇī subhujau tathā
ce_text: śatacandracite gṛhya carmaṇī subhujau tu tau / vyarocetāṃ mahāraṅge nistriṃśavaradhāriṇau / yathā devāsure yuddhe jambhaśakrau mahābalau

vulgate_text: anyonyasya vadhe caiva cakraturyatnamuttamam / kaikeyasya dvidhā carma tataściccheda sātvataḥ
ce_text: kekayasya tataś carma dvidhā ciccheda sātvataḥ / sātyakeś ca tathaivāsau carma ciccheda pārthivaḥ

vulgate_text: sa śaraiścitrito rājā citramālyadharo yuvā / aśobhata mahāraṅge śvāvicchalalo yathā
ce_text: sa śaraiś citrito rājaṃś citramālyadharo yuvā / yuveva samaśobhat sa goṣṭhīmadhye svalaṃkṛtaḥ

vulgate_text: śrutakarmāṇi samare nārācena samarpitaḥ / susrāva rudhiraṃ tatra gairikāmbu yathā'calaḥ
ce_text: śrutakarmāpi samare nārācena samarditaḥ / susrāva rudhiraṃ bhūri gairikāmbha ivācalaḥ

vulgate_text: athainaṃ chinnadhanvānaṃ nārācānāṃ śataistribhiḥ / chādayansamare rājanvivyādha ca supatribhiḥ
ce_text: athainaṃ chinnadhanvānaṃ nārācānāṃ tribhiḥ śataiḥ / vivyādha bharataśreṣṭha śrutakarmā mahāyaśāḥ

vulgate_text: tāṃstu vidravato dṛṣṭvā nirutsāhāndviṣajjaye / drāvayanniṣubhistīkṣṇaiḥ śrutakarmā vyarocata
ce_text: tataḥ kruddho maheṣvāsas tat sainyaṃ prādravac charaiḥ / antakāle yathā kruddhaḥ sarvabhūtāni pretarāṭ / drāvayann iṣubhis tūrṇaṃ śrutakarmā vyarocata

vulgate_text: tataḥ śaktiṃ mahārāja svarṇaghaṇṭāṃ durāsadām / prāhiṇotprativindhyāya vicinvantīmasūniva

vulgate_text: tataḥ pravikṛte yatnaṃ kurvāṇau tau mahāraṇe / kṛtapratikṛte yattau śarasaṅghairabhītavat

vulgate_text: cakāśete muhūrtena tatastāvapyarindamau / vimuktāvabhrajālena aṅgārakabudhāviva

ce_text: śrūyante sma tadā vācaḥ siddhānāṃ vai muhur muhuḥ / siṃhanādaś ca saṃjajñe sametānāṃ divaukasām / adbhutaṃ cāpy acintyaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā karma tayor mṛdhe

ce_text: tathaiva pāṇḍavaṃ rājan vihvalantaṃ muhur muhuḥ / apovāha rathenājau sārathiḥ śatrutāpanam

ce_text: sahadevas tataḥ kruddhaḥ khaḍgaṃ gṛhya mahāhave / vyāvidhyata yudhāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ śrīmāṃs tava sutaṃ prati

vulgate_text: parājitya raṇe taṃ tu kauravyaṃ pāṇḍunandanaḥ / duryodhanabalaṃ dṛṣṭvā pramamātha samantataḥ
ce_text: parājitya raṇe taṃ tu pāṇḍavaḥ pāṇḍupūrvaja / duryodhanabalaṃ hṛṣṭaḥ prāmathad vai samantataḥ

vulgate_text: te śarā hemavikṛtāḥ sampantau muhurmuhuḥ / śreṇīkṛtā vyakāśānta krauñcāḥ śreṇīkṛtā iva
ce_text: te śarā hemavikṛtāḥ saṃpatanto muhur muhuḥ / śreṇīkṛtā abhāsanta haṃsāḥ śreṇīgatā iva

vulgate_text: bāṇajālavṛte vyomni cchādite ca divākare / na sma sampatate bhūtaṃ kiñcidapyantarikṣagam
ce_text: bāṇajālāvṛte vyomni chādite ca divākare / samasarpat tato bhūtaṃ kiṃ cid eva viśāṃ pate

vulgate_text: te sene hanyamāne tu tābhyāṃ divyairmahāśaraiḥ / śarapātamapākramya tasthatuḥ prekṣike tadā

vulgate_text: śaraveśmapraviṣṭau tau dadṛśāte na kaiścana / sūryācandramasau rājañchādyamānau ghanairiva

vulgate_text: śatacandraṃ ca taccarma sarvāpakaraṇāni ca / suvarṇavikṛtaṃ tacca dhanuḥ śaramāhave

vulgate_text: yathaiva cāsito meghaḥ śakracāpena śobhitaḥ / aśobhata mahārāja pāṇḍuputrastathā raṇe
ce_text: tataḥ sa śuśubhe rājan kaṇṭhāsaktamahādhanuḥ / pariveṣam anuprāpto yathā syād vyomni candramāḥ / yathaiva ca sito meghaḥ śakracāpena śobhitaḥ

vulgate_text: vadhaprāptaṃ tu taṃ śūro nāhanadvarmavittadā / smṛtvā kuntyā vaco rājaṃstata enaṃ vyasarjayat
ce_text: evam uktvā mahārāja vyasarjayata taṃ tataḥ / vadhaprāptaṃ tu taṃ rājan nāvadhīt sūtanandanaḥ / smṛtvā kuntyā vaco rājaṃs tata enaṃ vyasarjayat

vulgate_text: prāsaiḥ khaṅgaiśca rahitānṛṣṭibhiścāpi bhārata / hayasādīnapaśyāma kañcukoṣṇīṣadhāriṇaḥ
ce_text: prāsaiḥ khaḍgaiś ca saṃsyūtān ṛṣṭibhiś ca narādhipa / hayayodhān apaśyāma kañcukoṣṇīṣadhāriṇaḥ

vulgate_text: vihīnānrathinastatra dhāvamānāṃstatastataḥ / sūtaputraśaraistīkṣṇairhanyamānānviśāmpate

vulgate_text: viśastrāṃśca tathaivānyānsaśastrāṃśca hatānbahūn / tārakājālasañchannānvaraghaṇṭāviśobhitān
ce_text: viśastrāṃś ca tathaivānyān saśastrāṃś ca bahūn hatān / tāvakāñ jālasaṃchannān uroghaṇṭāvibhūṣitān

vulgate_text: sutamomaṃ tu śakunirvidvvā tu niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ / nākampayata saṅkrudvo vāryogha iva parvatam
ce_text: sutasomas tu śakuniṃ vivyādha niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ / nākampayata saṃrabdho vāryogha iva parvatam

vulgate_text: nākampayata saṅkruddho vāryogha iva parvatam tasyāśvānketanaṃ sūtaṃ tilaśo vyadhamaccharaiḥ / śyālastava mahārāja tata uccukruśurjanāḥ
ce_text: tasyāśvān ketanaṃ sūtaṃ tilaśo vyadhamac charaiḥ / syālas tava mahāvīryas tatas te cukruśur janāḥ

vulgate_text: vyasṛjatsāyakāṃścaiva svarṇapuṅkhāñśilāśitān chādayāmāsuratha te tava śyālasya taṃ ratham / śaḻabhānāmiva vrātāḥ śaravrātā mahāratham
ce_text: chādayām āsur atha te tava syālasya taṃ ratham / pataṃgānām iva vrātāḥ śaravrātā mahāratham

vulgate_text: sañchādyamāno'pi dṛḍhaṃ vivyathe naiva saubalaḥ / pramamātha śarāṃstasya śaravrātairmahāyaśāḥ
ce_text: rathopasthān samīkṣyāpi vivyathe naiva saubalaḥ / pramṛdnaṃś ca śarāṃs tāṃs tāñ śaravrātair mahāyaśāḥ

vulgate_text: sa cchinnaḥ sahasā bhūmau nipapāta mahānasiḥ / adharmasya sthitaṃ haste sutsarostatra bhārata
ce_text: sa cchinnaḥ sahasā bhūmau nipapāta mahān asiḥ / avaśasya sthitaṃ haste taṃ khaḍgaṃ satsaruṃ tadā

vulgate_text: tadā jalpanti pāṇḍūnāṃ rathinaḥ sādinastathā / droṇasya nidhanānnūnaṃ saṅkrudvo dvipadāṃ varaḥ
ce_text: tatrāvocan vimanaso rathinaḥ sādinas tathā / droṇasya nidhane nūnaṃ saṃkruddho dvipadāṃ varaḥ

vulgate_text: pārṣataśca mahāyudve vimukho'dyābhilakṣyate ityevaṃ vividhā vācastāvakānāṃ paraiḥ saha / vyaśrūyanta mahārāja tayostatra samāgame
ce_text: pārṣataś ca bhṛśaṃ yuddhe vimukho 'dyāpi lakṣyate / ity evaṃ vividhā vācas tāvakānāṃ paraiḥ saha

vulgate_text: śaṅkhaṃ ca pūrayāmāsa muhurmuhurarindamaḥ / pārṣataṃ trāsayāmāsa mahendro namuciṃ yathā
ce_text: śaṅkhaṃ ca pūrayām āsa muhur muhur ariṃdamaḥ / pārṣataṃ prādravad yantaṃ mahendra iva śambaram

vulgate_text: kṛtavarmā tu saṅkruddho mārgaṇaiḥ kṣatavikṣataḥ / vavāma rudhiraṃ gātraiḥ kumbhavakrādivodakam
ce_text: kṛtavarmā tu saṃkruddho mārgaṇaiḥ kṛtavikṣataḥ / dhanur anyat samādāya samārgaṇagaṇaṃ prabho / śikhaṇḍinaṃ bāṇavaraiḥ skandhadeśe 'bhyatāḍayat

vulgate_text: skandhadeśasthitairbāṇaiḥ śikhaṇḍī tu vyarājata / śākhāpraśākhāvipulaḥ sumahānpādapo yathā
ce_text: skandhadeśe sthitair bāṇaiḥ śikhaṇḍī ca rarāja ha / śākhāpratānair vimalaiḥ sumahān sa yathā drumaḥ

vulgate_text: tāvubhau śaravanunnāṅgau parasparaśarakṣatau / anyonyaśṛṅgābhihatau rejaturvṛṣabhāviva
ce_text: tāv anyonyaṃ bhṛśaṃ viddhvā rudhireṇa samukṣitau / anyonyaśṛṅgābhihatau rejatur vṛṣabhāv iva

vulgate_text: pratyudyayustrigartāstaṃ śibayaḥ kauravaiḥ saha / vasātayo'tha sālvāśca gopālāśca yaśasvinaḥ
ce_text: pratyudyayus trigartās taṃ śibayaḥ kauravaiḥ saha / śālvāḥ saṃśaptakāś caiva nārāyaṇabalaṃ ca yat

vulgate_text: te hanyamānāḥ samare na jahuḥ pāṇḍavaṃ raṇe / hanyamānā mahārāja śalabhā iva pāvakam
ce_text: te vadhyamānāḥ samare nājahuḥ pāṇḍavaṃ tadā / dahyamānā yathā rājañ śalabhā iva pāvakam

vulgate_text: navabhirmitravarmāṇaṃ suśarmāṇaṃ tathā'ṣṭabhiḥ / śrutañjayaṃ ca rājānaṃ hatvā tatra śilāśitaiḥ
ce_text: śatruṃjayaṃ ca rājānaṃ hatvā tatra śilāśitaiḥ / sauśruteḥ saśirastrāṇaṃ śiraḥ kāyād apāharat / tvaritaś candradevaṃ ca śarair ninye yamakṣayam

vulgate_text: pratodaṃ gṛhya so'nyattu raśmīnsaṅgṛhya ca drutam / vāhayāmāsa tānaśvānsatyadevarathaṃ prati
ce_text: sa pratodaṃ punar gṛhya raśmīṃś caiva mahāyaśāḥ / vāhayām āsa tān aśvān satyasenarathaṃ prati

vulgate_text: viṣvaksenaṃ sunirvidvaṃ dṛṣṭvā pārtho dhanañjayaḥ / satyadevaṃ śaraistīkṣṇairvārayitvā mahārathaḥ
ce_text: viṣvaksenaṃ tu nirbhinnaṃ prekṣya pārtho dhanaṃjayaḥ / satyasenaṃ śarais tīkṣṇair dārayitvā mahābalaḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ śarasahasrāṇi prādurāsanviśāmpate / kārmukātpāṇḍuputrasya pārthasyāmitatejasaḥ
ce_text: abhyarditas tu tair jiṣṇuḥ śakratulyaparākramaḥ / aindram astram ameyātmā prāduścakre mahārathaḥ / tataḥ śarasahasrāṇi prādurāsan viśāṃ pate

vulgate_text: tatastu cchidyamānānāṃ dhvajānāṃ dhanuṣāṃ tathā / rathānāṃ sapatākānāṃ tūṇīrāṇāṃ yugaiḥ saha
ce_text: dhvajānāṃ chidyamānānāṃ kārmukāṇāṃ ca saṃyuge / rathānāṃ sapatākānāṃ tūṇīrāṇāṃ śaraiḥ saha

vulgate_text: hārāṇāmatha niṣkāṇāṃ tanutrāṇāṃ ca bhārata chatrāṇāṃ vyajanānāṃ ca śirasāṃ kumuṭaiḥ saha / rāśayaścātra dṛśyante patitānāṃ mahītale
ce_text: hārāṇām atha niṣkāṇāṃ tanutrāṇāṃ ca bhārata / chatrāṇāṃ vyajanānāṃ ca śirasāṃ mukuṭaiḥ saha / aśrūyata mahāñ śabdas tatra tatra viśāṃ pate

vulgate_text: nihatai rājaputraiśca kṣatriyaiśca mahābalaiḥ / arjunena mahārāja tatratatra mahāraṇe
ce_text: nihatai rājaputraiś ca kṣatriyaiś ca mahābalaiḥ / hastibhiḥ patitaiś caiva turagaiś cābhavan mahī / agamyamārgā samare viśīrṇair iva parvataiḥ

vulgate_text: te śūrāḥ samare sarve citraṃ laghu ca suṣṭhu ca / ayudhyanta mahāvegāḥ parasparavadhaiṣiṇaḥ
ce_text: ayudhyanta mahāvegāḥ parasparavadhaiṣiṇaḥ / anyonyaṃ samare jaghnur yodhavratam anuṣṭhitāḥ / na hi te samaraṃ cakruḥ pṛṣṭhato vai kathaṃ cana

vulgate_text: sāśvārohāṃśca turagānviṣāmairvivyadhū ruṣā / apare cikṣipurvegātpragṛhyātibalāstadā
ce_text: sāśvārohāṃś ca turagān viṣāṇair bibhidū raṇe / aparāṃś cikṣipur vegāt pragṛhyātibalās tathā

vulgate_text: sahayāḥ sādinastatra tomareṇa mahāmṛdhe / bhūmāvamṛdranvegena sacarmāṇaṃ padātinam
ce_text: sarathaṃ sādinaṃ tatra apare tu mahāgajāḥ / bhūmāv amṛdnan vegena savarmāṇaṃ patākinam

vulgate_text: cachā sāvaraṇānkāṃścittatratatra viśāmpate rathānnāgāḥ samāsādya parigṛhya ca māriṣa / vyākṣipansahasā tatra ghorarūpe bhayānake
ce_text: rathaṃ nāgāḥ samāsādya dhuri gṛhya ca māriṣa / vyākṣipan sahasā tatra ghorarūpe mahāmṛdhe

vulgate_text: patataścāparo rājanvijahārāsinā śiraḥ / mṛtamanyo mahārāja padā tāḍitavāṃstadā
ce_text: mṛtam anyo mahārāja padbhyāṃ tāḍitavāṃs tadā / jīvataś ca tathaivānyaḥ śastraṃ kāye nyamajjayat

vulgate_text: jīvataśca tathaivānyaḥ śastraṃ kāye nyamajjayat muṣṭiyuddhaṃ mahaccāsīdyodhānāṃ tatra bhārata / tathā keśagrahaścogro bāhuyuddhaṃ ca bhairavam
ce_text: muṣṭiyuddhaṃ mahac cāsīd yodhānāṃ tatra bhārata / tathā keśagrahaś cogro bāhuyuddhaṃ ca kevalam

vulgate_text: agamyarūpā pṛthivī kṣaṇena samapadyata / kṣaṇenāsīnmahīpāla kṣatajaughapravartinī
ce_text: agamyarūpā pṛthivī māṃsaśoṇitakardamā / kṣaṇenāsīn mahārāja kṣatajaughapravartinī

vulgate_text: evameṣa kṣayo vṛttaḥ kurupāṇḍavasenayoḥ / aparāhṇe gate sūrye kāṅkṣatāṃ vipulaṃ yaśaḥ
ce_text: evam eṣa kṣayo vṛttaḥ kurupāṇḍavasenayoḥ / aparāhṇe mahārāja kāṅkṣantyor vipulaṃ jayam

vulgate_text: yathā tvaṃ me kathayase yathā yudvamavartata / na santi sūta kauravyā iti me niścitā matiḥ
ce_text: tathā tu me kathayase yathā yuddhaṃ tu vartate / na santi sūta kauravyā iti me naiṣṭhikī matiḥ

vulgate_text: dīpyamānāṃ mahāvegāṃ maholkāṃ jvalitāmiva / yamadaṇḍanibhāṃ ghorāṃ kālarātrimivāparām
ce_text: tam ālakṣyodyatagadaṃ daṇḍahastam ivāntakam / dharmarājo mahāśaktiṃ prāhiṇot tava sūnave / dīpyamānāṃ mahāvegāṃ maholkāṃ jvalitām iva

vulgate_text: evaṃ tadabhavadyuddhaṃ tvadīyānāṃ paraiḥ saha / aparāhṇe mahārāja kāṅkṣatāṃ vijayaṃ yudhi
ce_text: bhīmo 'pi mahatīṃ gṛhya gadāṃ hemapariṣkṛtām / abhidudrāva vegena kṛtavarmāṇam āhave / evaṃ tad abhavad yuddhaṃ tvadīyānāṃ paraiḥ saha

vulgate_text: na te nindyāḥ praśasyāste yatte cakrurbravīhi tat / tato duryodhanaḥ sūta paścātkimakarottadā
ce_text: eko 'bhyarakṣad bharatān eko bhavam atoṣayat / tenaikena jitāḥ sarve madīyā ugratejasaḥ / te na nindyāḥ praśasyāś ca yat te cakrur bravīhi tat

vulgate_text: evamuktastathetyuktvā so'nujajñe nṛpottamān / te'nujñātā nṛpāḥ sarve svāni veśmāni bhejire
ce_text: evam uktas tathety uktvā so 'nujajñe nṛpottamān / sukhoṣitās te rajanīṃ hṛṣṭā yuddhāya niryayuḥ

vulgate_text: sarveṣāṃ caiva sainyānāṃ karṇamevāgamanmanaḥ / sūtaputraṃ maheṣvāsaṃ bandhumātyayikeṣviva
ce_text: puraṃdarasamaṃ yuddhe marudgaṇasamaṃ bale / kārtavīryasamaṃ vīrye karṇaṃ rājño 'gaman manaḥ / sūtaputraṃ maheṣvāsaṃ bandhum ātyayikeṣv iva

vulgate_text: tato duryodhanaḥ sūta paścātkimakarottadā / yadvo'gamanmano mandāḥ karṇaṃ vaikartanaṃ prati
ce_text: yad vo 'gaman mano mandāḥ karṇaṃ vaikartanaṃ tadā / apy adrākṣata taṃ yūyaṃ śītārtā iva bhāskaram

vulgate_text: apyapaśyata rādheyaṃ śītārtā iva bhāskaram / kṛte'vahāre sainyānāṃ pravṛtte ca raṇe punaḥ
ce_text: kṛte 'vahāre sainyānāṃ pravṛtte ca raṇe punaḥ / kathaṃ vaikartanaḥ karṇas tatrāyudhyata saṃjaya / kathaṃ ca pāṇḍavāḥ sarve yuyudhus tatra sūtajam

vulgate_text: duryodhanaṃ ca tatrājau pāṇḍavena bhṛśārditam / parākrāntānpāṇḍusutāndṛṣṭvā'pi bhṛśārditam
ce_text: duryodhanaṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā pāṇḍavena bhṛśārditam / parākrāntān pāṇḍusutān dṛṣṭvā cāpi mahāhave

vulgate_text: yaḥ saubalaṃ tathā tāta nītimāniti manyate / karṇaṃ cāgratimaṃ yudve devairapi durutsaham
ce_text: saubalaṃ ca tathā tāta nītimān iti manyate

vulgate_text: saubalaṃ ca tadā tāta nītimāniti manyate / karṇaśca rabhaso nityaṃ rājā ta cāpyanuvrataḥ
ce_text: saubalaṃ ca tathā tāta nītimān iti manyate

vulgate_text: yadevaṃ vartamāneṣu mahāyudveṣu sañjaya / aśrauṣaṃ nihatānputrānnityameva vinirjitān
ce_text: yuddheṣu nāma divyeṣu vartamāneṣu saṃjaya / aśrauṣaṃ nihatān putrān nityam eva ca nirjitān

vulgate_text: ukto'si bahudhā rājñanmā yudhyasveti pāṇḍavaiḥ / na ca tattvagrahīrdveṣātpāṇḍaveṣu viśāmpate
ce_text: ukto 'si bahudhā rājan mā yudhyasveti pāṇḍavaiḥ / gṛhṇīṣe na ca tan mohāt pāṇḍaveṣu viśāṃ pate

vulgate_text: prāṇe śaurye'tha vijñāne vikrame cāpi bhārata / nimittajñānayoge ca savyasācī na matsamaḥ
ce_text: kāyasya mahato bhede lāghave dūrapātane / sauṣṭhave cāstrayoge ca savyasācī na matsamaḥ

vulgate_text: tena yotsye mahābāhumarjunaṃ jayatāṃ varam yathendraḥ samare sarvāndaiteyānvai samāgatān / nijaghāna tathā sarvāñjeṣyāmi yudhi pāṇḍavān
ce_text: tad divyaṃ bhārgavo mahyam adadād dhanur uttamam / yena yotsye mahābāhum arjunaṃ jayatāṃ varam / yathendraḥ samare sarvān daiteyān vai samāgatān

vulgate_text: jyā tasya dhanuṣo divyā tathā'kṣayye maheṣudhī / sārathistasya govindo mama tādṛṅga vidyate
ce_text: jyā tasya dhanuṣo divyā tathākṣayyau maheṣudhī / tasya divyaṃ dhanuḥ śreṣṭhaṃ gāṇḍīvam ajaraṃ yudhi

vulgate_text: samudyātuṃ na śakṣyanti devā api savāsavāḥ / etatkṛtaṃ mahārāja tvayecchāmi parantapa
ce_text: etat kṛtaṃ mahārāja tvayecchāmi paraṃtapa / evaṃ kṛte kṛtaṃ mahyaṃ sarvakāmair bhaviṣyati

vulgate_text: kriyatāmeṣa kāmo me mā vaḥ kālo'tyagādayam / evaṃ kṛte kṛtaṃ mahyaṃ tvayā sarvaṃ bhaviṣyati
ce_text: etat kṛtaṃ mahārāja tvayecchāmi paraṃtapa / evaṃ kṛte kṛtaṃ mahyaṃ sarvakāmair bhaviṣyati

vulgate_text: tato drakṣyasi saṅgrāme yatkariṣyāmi bhārata / sarvathā pāṇḍavānsaṅkhye vijeṣye vai samāgatān
ce_text: tato draṣṭāsi samare yat kariṣyāmi bhārata / sarvathā pāṇḍavān sarvāñ jeṣyāmy adya samāgatān

vulgate_text: madrājaṃ ca samare praṇamya ca mahāratham / vinayenopasaṅgamya praṇayādvākyamabravīt
ce_text: putras tava mahārāja madrarājam idaṃ vacaḥ / vinayenopasaṃgamya praṇayād vākyam abravīt

vulgate_text: tasmātpārthavināśārthaṃ hitārthaṃ mama caiva hi / tvaṃ pāhi sarvataḥ karṇaṃ bhavaṃ brahmeva suvrata
ce_text: tasmāt pārthavināśārthaṃ hitārthaṃ mama caiva hi / sārathyaṃ rathināṃ śreṣṭha sumanāḥ kartum arhasi

vulgate_text: sārathyaṃ rathināṃ śreṣṭha praṇayātkartumarhasi / tvayi yantari rādheyo vidviṣo me vijeṣyate
ce_text: tasmāt pārthavināśārthaṃ hitārthaṃ mama caiva hi / sārathyaṃ rathināṃ śreṣṭha sumanāḥ kartum arhasi

vulgate_text: tābhyāmatītya tau bhāgau nihatā mama śatravaḥ / vṛdvau hi tau maheṣvāsau chalena nihatau yudhi
ce_text: naiva bhāgo 'tra bhīṣmasya droṇasya ca mahātmanaḥ / tābhyām atītya tau bhāgau nihatā mama śatravaḥ

vulgate_text: hatavīramidaṃ sainyaṃ pāṇḍavaiḥ samare vibho / karṇo hyeko mahābāhurasmatpriyahite rataḥ
ce_text: karṇo hy eko mahābāhur asmatpriyahite rataḥ / bhavāṃś ca puruṣavyāghra sarvalokamahārathaḥ / tasmiñ jayāśā vipulā mama madrajanādhipa

vulgate_text: bhavāṃśca puruṣavyāghra sarvalokamahārathaḥ / śalya karṇo'rjunenādya yodvumicchati saṃyuge
ce_text: karṇo hy eko mahābāhur asmatpriyahite rataḥ / bhavāṃś ca puruṣavyāghra sarvalokamahārathaḥ / tasmiñ jayāśā vipulā mama madrajanādhipa

vulgate_text: tasmiñjayāśā vipulā madrarāja narādhipa / tasyābhīṣugrahavaro nānyo'sti bhuvi kaścana
ce_text: karṇo hy eko mahābāhur asmatpriyahite rataḥ / bhavāṃś ca puruṣavyāghra sarvalokamahārathaḥ / tasmiñ jayāśā vipulā mama madrajanādhipa

vulgate_text: pārthasya samare kṛṣṇo yathā'bhīṣugraho varaḥ / tathā tvamapi karṇasya rathe'bhīṣugraho bhava
ce_text: pārthasya sacivaḥ kṛṣṇo yathābhīśugraho varaḥ / tathā tvam api rādheyaṃ sarvataḥ paripālaya

vulgate_text: pūrvaṃ naḥ samare hyevamadhīdarjuno ripūn / idānīṃ vikramo hyasya kṛṣṇena sahitasya ca
ce_text: pūrvaṃ na samare hy evam avadhīd arjuno ripūn / ahany ahani madreśa drāvayan dṛśyate yudhi

vulgate_text: kṛṣṇena sahitaḥ pārtho dhārtarāṣṭrīṃ mahācamūm / ahanyahani madreśa drāvayandṛśyate yudhi
ce_text: pūrvaṃ na samare hy evam avadhīd arjuno ripūn / ahany ahani madreśa drāvayan dṛśyate yudhi

vulgate_text: rathināṃ pravaraḥ karṇo yantṝṇāṃ pravaro bhavān / saṃyogo yuvayorloke nābhūnna ca bhaviṣyati
ce_text: rathānāṃ pravaraḥ karṇo yantṝṇāṃ pravaro bhavān / saṃnipātaḥ samo loke bhavator nāsti kaś cana

vulgate_text: duryodhanavacaḥ śrutvā śalyaḥ krodhasamanvitaḥ / dhārtarāṣṭramathovāca sṛkviṇī parilelihan
ce_text: duryodhanavacaḥ śrutvā śalyaḥ krodhasamanvitaḥ / triśikhāṃ bhrukuṭīṃ kṛtvā dhunvan hastau punaḥ punaḥ

vulgate_text: triśikhāṃ bhrukuṭiṃ kṛtvā dhunvanhastau punaḥpunaḥ krodharakte mahānetre parivṛtya mahābhujaḥ / kulaiśvaryaśrutabalairdṛptaḥ śalyo'bravīdidam
ce_text: krodharakte mahānetre parivartya mahābhujaḥ / kulaiśvaryaśrutibalair dṛptaḥ śalyo 'bravīd idam

vulgate_text: yo hyabhyupagataṃ mitraṃ garīyāṃsaṃ viśeṣataḥ / vaśe pāpīyaso dhatte tatkāryamadharottaram
ce_text: yo hy abhyupagataṃ prītyā garīyāṃsaṃ vaśe sthitam / vaśe pāpīyaso dhatte tat pāpam adharottaram

vulgate_text: brahmakṣatrasya vihitāḥ sūtā vai paricārakāḥ / na kṣatriyo vai sūtānāṃ śṛṇuyācca kathañcana
ce_text: brahmakṣatrasya vihitāḥ sūtā vai paricārakāḥ / na viṭśūdrasya tatraiva śṛṇu vākyaṃ mamānagha

vulgate_text: ahaṃ mūrdhābhiṣikto hi rājarṣikulajo nṛpaḥ / mahārathasamākhyātaḥ sevyaḥ stutyaśca vandināṃ
ce_text: so 'haṃ mūrdhāvasiktaḥ san rājarṣikulasaṃbhavaḥ / mahārathaḥ samākhyātaḥ sevyaḥ stavyaś ca bandinām

vulgate_text: gadāṃ ca paśya gāndhāre hemapaṭṭavibhūṣitām dārayeyaṃ mahīṃ kruddho vikireyaṃ ca parvatān / śoṣayeyaṃ samudrāṃśca pātayeyaṃ ca bhāskaram
ce_text: dārayeyaṃ mahīṃ kruddho vikireyaṃ ca parvatān / śoṣayeyaṃ samudrāṃś ca tejasā svena pārthiva

vulgate_text: taṃ māmevaṃvidhaṃ rājansamarthamarinigrahe / kasmādyunaṅkṣi sārathye sūtasyādhirathestu mām
ce_text: tan mām evaṃvidhaṃ jānan samartham arinigrahe / kasmād yunakṣi sārathye nyūnasyādhirather nṛpa

vulgate_text: na cāhaṃ prākṛtaḥ kaścinna cāsmyadhigataḥ svayam / ayaṃ cāpyavamāno me na kartavyaḥ kathañcana
ce_text: yudhi cāpy avamāno me na kartavyaḥ kathaṃ cana / paśya hīmau mama bhujau vajrasaṃhananopamau

vulgate_text: na karṇo'bhyadhikastvatto na cānye caiva pārthivāḥ / na ca madreśvara tvāṃ vai kṛṣṇaḥ soḍhuṃ ca śakṣyati
ce_text: na karṇo 'bhyadhikas tvattaḥ śaṅke naiva kathaṃ cana / na hi madreśvaro rājā kuryād yad anṛtaṃ bhavet

vulgate_text: manye cābhyadhikaṃ śalya guṇaiḥ karṇaṃ dhanañjayāt / bhavantaṃ vāsudevācca loko'yamatimanyate
ce_text: yathā hy abhyadhikaṃ karṇaṃ guṇais tāta dhanaṃjayāt / vāsudevād api tvāṃ ca loko 'yam iti manyate

vulgate_text: yaduktavānpiturmahyaṃ mārkaṇḍeyo mahātapāḥ bruvatastadaśeṣeṇa mama rājarṣisattama / nibodha manasā cātra na te kāryā vicāraṇā
ce_text: yad uktavān pitur mahyaṃ mārkaṇḍeyo mahān ṛṣiḥ / tad aśeṣeṇa bruvato mama rājarṣisattama / tvaṃ nibodha na cāpy atra kartavyā te vicāraṇā

vulgate_text: tānabravīttadā devaḥ sarvalokaguruḥ prabhuḥ nāsti sarvāmaratvaṃ vai nivartadhvamito'surāḥ / anyaṃ varaṃ vṛṇīdhvaṃ vai rocate yādṛśo hi vaḥ
ce_text: tān abravīt tadā devo lokānāṃ prabhur īśvaraḥ / nāsti sarvāmaratvaṃ hi nivartadhvam ato 'surāḥ / varam anyaṃ vṛṇīdhvaṃ vai yādṛśaṃ saṃprarocate

vulgate_text: teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā dānavānāṃ pitāmahaḥ / evamastviti tāndevaḥ pratyuktvā prāviśaddivam
ce_text: samāgatāni caitāni yo hanyād bhagavaṃs tadā / ekeṣuṇā devavaraḥ sa no mṛtyur bhaviṣyati / evam astv iti tān devaḥ pratyuktvā prāviśad divam

vulgate_text: ekaikaṃ yojanaśataṃ vistṛtaṃ tāvadāyatam / dṛḍhaṃ cāṭṭālakayutaṃ bṛhatprākāratoraṇam
ce_text: ekaikaṃ yojanaśataṃ vistārāyāmasaṃmitam / gṛhāṭṭāṭṭālakayutaṃ bṛhatprākāratoraṇam

vulgate_text: gṛhapravarasambādhamasambādhamahāpatham / prāsādairvividhaiścāpi dvāraiścaivopaśobhitam
ce_text: guṇaprasavasaṃbādham asaṃbādham anāmayam / prāsādair vividhaiś caiva dvāraiś cāpy upaśobhitam

vulgate_text: māṃsāśinaḥ sudṛptāśca surairvinikṛtāḥ purā / mahadaiśvaryamicchantastripuraṃ durgamāśritāḥ
ce_text: teṣāṃ dānavamukhyānāṃ prayutāny arbudāni ca / koṭyaś cāprativīrāṇāṃ samājagmus tatas tataḥ / mahad aiśvaryam icchantas tripuraṃ durgam āśritāḥ

vulgate_text: yena rūpeṇa yo daityo yena veṣeṇa cāpyatha kṣipyate nihato vāpyāṃ tādṛśenaiva jāyate / sampūrṇabalavīryastu rājañchauryasamanvitaḥ
ce_text: yena rūpeṇa daityas tu yena veṣeṇa caiva ha / mṛtas tasyāṃ parikṣiptas tādṛśenaiva jajñivān

vulgate_text: evaṃ vīryeṇa saṃyuktāṃ kṛtāṃ tena mahātmanā / tāṃ prāpya traipurā vāpīṃ lokānsarvānbabādhire
ce_text: tāṃ prāpya traipurasthās tu sarvāṃl lokān babādhire / mahatā tapasā siddhāḥ surāṇāṃ bhayavardhanāḥ / na teṣām abhavad rājan kṣayo yuddhe kathaṃ cana

vulgate_text: tadā bhītaḥ surapatirmuktvā tāni purāṇyatha taireva vibudhaiḥ sārdhaṃ pitāmahamarindama / jagāmātha tadākhyātuṃ viprakāraṃ suretaraiḥ
ce_text: te devāḥ sahitāḥ sarve pitāmaham ariṃdama / abhijagmus tadākhyātuṃ viprakāraṃ suretaraiḥ

vulgate_text: te tattvaṃ sarvamākhyāya śirobhiḥ sampraṇamya ca / tadvadhopāyamācakṣva bhagavanniti cābruvan
ce_text: te tattvaṃ sarvam ākhyāya śirasābhipraṇamya ca / vadhopāyam apṛcchanta bhagavantaṃ pitāmaham

vulgate_text: śrutvā tadbhagavāndevo devānidamuvāca ha / śrūyatāṃ tridaśāḥ sarve yathedaṃ vākyagauravam
ce_text: śrutvā tad bhagavān devo devān idam uvāca ha / asurāś ca durātmānas te cāpi vibudhadviṣaḥ / aparādhyanti satataṃ ye yuṣmān pīḍayanty uta

vulgate_text: durātmāno'surā nityaṃ te cāpi vibudhā mama / na śaknuvanti te sarve yuṣmānvai pīḍayanti te
ce_text: śrutvā tad bhagavān devo devān idam uvāca ha / asurāś ca durātmānas te cāpi vibudhadviṣaḥ / aparādhyanti satataṃ ye yuṣmān pīḍayanty uta

vulgate_text: ahaṃ samastu sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ / avinītā nihantavyā ityevaṃ prabravīmi vaḥ
ce_text: ahaṃ hi tulyaḥ sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ / adhārmikās tu hantavyā ity ahaṃ prabravīmi vaḥ

vulgate_text: anaṅgamathanaṃ sarve bhavaṃ sarvātmanā gatāḥ / devadevaṃ paraṃ sthāṇuṃ varadaṃ tryambakaṃ śivam
ce_text: tapaḥ paraṃ samātasthur gṛṇanto brahma śāśvatam / ṛṣibhiḥ saha dharmajñā bhavaṃ sarvātmanā gatāḥ

vulgate_text: śarvamīḍyamajaṃ rudraṃ śaśāṅkāṅkitamūrdhajam tuṣṭuvurvāgbhirugrābhirbhayeṣvabhayamacyutam / sarvātmānaṃ mahātmānaṃ yenāptaṃ viśvamātmanā
ce_text: tuṣṭuvur vāgbhir arthyābhir bhayeṣv abhayakṛttamam / sarvātmānaṃ mahātmānaṃ yenāptaṃ sarvam ātmanā

vulgate_text: taṃ te dadṛśurīśānaṃ tejorāśimumāpatim pareṇa yatnena bhavaṃ tridaśāḥ śarvamīśvaram / ananyasadṛśaṃ loke pratapantamakalmaṣam
ce_text: te taṃ dadṛśur īśānaṃ tejorāśim umāpatim / ananyasadṛśaṃ loke vratavantam akalmaṣam

vulgate_text: amoghāya mṛgākṣāya pravarāyudhayodhine / arhāya caiva śudvāya kṣayāya krathanāya ca
ce_text: amoghāya mṛgākṣāya pravarāyudhayodhine / durvāraṇāya śukrāya brahmaṇe brahmacāriṇe

vulgate_text: hantavyāḥ śatravaḥ sarve yuṣmākamiti me matiḥ / na tvekaścotsahe hantuṃ balinaḥ suravidviṣaḥ
ce_text: hantavyāḥ śatravaḥ sarve yuṣmākam iti me matiḥ / na tv eko 'haṃ vadhe teṣāṃ samartho vai suradviṣām

vulgate_text: vayaṃ ca sarvathā deva rakṣaṇīyāstathaiva ca / sa no rakṣa mahādeva tvameva jahi śātravān
ce_text: bibhartuṃ tejaso 'rdhaṃ te na śakṣyāmo maheśvara / sarveṣāṃ no balārdhena tvam eva jahi śātravān

vulgate_text: tasmātpaśupatiścokto bhavatvācca bhaveti vai ardhamādāya sarveṣāṃ tejasā prajvalanniva
ce_text: tatas tatheti deveśas tair ukto rājasattama / ardham ādāya sarvebhyas tejasābhyadhiko 'bhavat

vulgate_text: trīnagnīnmantravaccakre rathasyātha triveṇukam / anukarṣānrathe dīptānvarūthāṃścāpi tārakāḥ
ce_text: anukarṣān grahān dīptān varūthaṃ cāpi tārakāḥ / dharmārthakāmasaṃyuktaṃ triveṇuṃ cāpi bandhuram / oṣadhīr vividhās tatra nānāpuṣpaphalodgamāḥ

vulgate_text: ahorātraiḥ kalābhiśca kāṣṭhābhirayanaistathā / dyāṃ yugaṃ yugaparvāṇi saṃvartakabalāharakān
ce_text: daśa nāgapatīn īṣāṃ dhṛtarāṣṭramukhān dṛḍhām / dyāṃ yugaṃ yugacarmāṇi saṃvartakabalāhakān

vulgate_text: śamyāṃ dhṛtiṃ ca medhāṃ ca sthitiṃ sannatimeva ca / ṛghvedaṃ sāmavedaṃ ca dhuryāvaśvāvakalpayat
ce_text: śamyāṃ dhṛtiṃ ca medhāṃ ca sthitiṃ saṃnatim eva ca / grahanakṣatratārābhiś carma citraṃ nabhastalam

vulgate_text: sinīvālīmanumatiṃ kuhūṃ rākāṃ ca suprabhām yoktāṇi cakre cāśvānāṃ kūśmāṇḍāṃścāpi pannagān
ce_text: surāmbupretavittānāṃ patīṃl lokeśvarān hayān / sinīvālīm anumatiṃ kuhūṃ rākāṃ ca suvratām / yoktrāṇi cakrur vāhānāṃ rohakāṃś cāpi kaṇṭhakam

vulgate_text: yajñāḥ sarve pṛthaklṛptā rathāṅgāni ca bhāgaśaḥ / adhiṣṭhānaṃ manaścāsītparirathyā sarasvatī
ce_text: karma satyaṃ tapo 'rthaś ca vihitās tatra raśmayaḥ / adhiṣṭhānaṃ manas tv āsīt parirathyaṃ sarasvatī

vulgate_text: evamasminmahārāja kalpite rathasattame / tvaṣṭrā manujaśārdūla dviṣatāṃ bhayavardhane
ce_text: evaṃ tasmin mahārāja kalpite rathasattame / devair manujaśārdūla dviṣatām abhimardane

vulgate_text: brahmadaṇḍaḥ kāladamḍo rudradaṇḍaśca te jvarāḥ / pariṣkārā rthasyāsansamantāddiśamuddhatāḥ
ce_text: brahmadaṇḍaḥ kāladaṇḍo rudradaṇḍas tathā jvaraḥ / pariskandā rathasyāsya sarvatodiśam udyatāḥ

vulgate_text: vicitramṛtubhiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ kṛtvā saṃvatsaraṃ dhanuḥ / chāyāmevātmanaścakre dhanurjyāmakṣayāṃ dhruvām
ce_text: vicitram ṛtubhiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ kṛtvā saṃvatsaraṃ dhanuḥ / tasmān nṝṇāṃ kālarātrir jyā kṛtā dhanuṣo 'jarā

vulgate_text: kālo hi bhagavānrudrastacca saṃvatsaraṃ dhanuḥ / tasmādraudrī kālarātrī jyā kṛtā dhanuṣo jarā
ce_text: vicitram ṛtubhiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ kṛtvā saṃvatsaraṃ dhanuḥ / tasmān nṝṇāṃ kālarātrir jyā kṛtā dhanuṣo 'jarā

vulgate_text: puṇyagandhavahaṃ rājañśvasanaṃ rājasattama / agnīṣomau śaramukhe kalpayāmāsa vai tadā
ce_text: tasya vājāṃs tato devāḥ kalpayāṃ cakrire vibhoḥ / puṇyagandhavahaṃ rājañ śvasanaṃ rājasattama

vulgate_text: agnīṣomātmakaṃ kṛtsnamucyate vaiṣṇavaṃ jagat / viṣṇurātmā bhagavato bhavasyāmitatejasaḥ
ce_text: viṣṇuś cātmā bhagavato bhavasyāmitatejasaḥ / tasmād dhanurjyāsaṃsparśaṃ na viṣehur harasya te

vulgate_text: tasmāddhanurjyāsaṃsparśaṃ sa viṣehe śarasya vai / tasmiñśare tīkṣṇamanyumamuñcadduḥsahaṃ prabhuḥ
ce_text: viṣṇuś cātmā bhagavato bhavasyāmitatejasaḥ / tasmād dhanurjyāsaṃsparśaṃ na viṣehur harasya te

vulgate_text: ādityāyutasaṅkāśastejojvālāvṛto bhavaḥ / duścaryacyāvako jetā hantā brahmadviṣāṃ varaḥ
ce_text: sa nīlalohito dhūmraḥ kṛttivāsā bhayaṃkaraḥ / ādityāyutasaṃkāśas tejojvālāvṛto jvalan

vulgate_text: etacchrutvā vaco devāḥ sarve gatvā pitāmaham / praṇipatyocurekāgrāḥ prasādyainaṃ maharṣibhiḥ
ce_text: etac chrutvā tato devā vākyam uktaṃ mahātmanā / gatvā pitāmahaṃ devaṃ prasādyaivaṃ vaco 'bruvan

vulgate_text: taṃ praviṣṭā rathaṃ devā rathayodvārameva ca / kavacāni ca śastrāṇi kārmukaṃ ca pitāmaha
ce_text: tatra sārathir eṣṭavyaḥ sarvair etair viśeṣavān / tatpratiṣṭho ratho deva hayā yoddhā tathaiva ca / kavacāni ca śastrāṇi kārmukaṃ ca pitāmaha

vulgate_text: sarvathā rathinaḥ śreyānkartavyo rathasārathiḥ tasmādetadyathātattvaṃ jñātvā yuṣmāṃśca saṅgatān / saṃyacchāmi hayāneṣa vibudhāya kapardine
ce_text: nātra kiṃ cin mṛṣā vākyaṃ yad uktaṃ vo divaukasaḥ / saṃyacchāmi hayān eṣa yudhyato vai kapardinaḥ

vulgate_text: sārathau kalpite devairīśānasya mahātmanaḥ tasminnārohati rathaṃ kalpitaṃ lokasambhṛtam / śirobhiḥ patitā bhūmau turagā vedasambhṛtāḥ
ce_text: tataḥ sa bhagavān devo lokasraṣṭā pitāmahaḥ / sārathye kalpito devair īśānasya mahātmanaḥ

vulgate_text: tato'dhirūḍhe varade rathaṃ paśupatistadā / sādhusādhviti deveśaṃ smayamāno'bhyabhāṣata
ce_text: tato 'dhirūḍhe varade prayāte cāsurān prati / sādhu sādhv iti viśveśaḥ smayamāno 'bhyabhāṣata

vulgate_text: tato'śvāṃścodayāmāsa manomārutaraṃhasaḥ / purāṇyuddiśya khasthāni dānavānāṃ tarasvinām
ce_text: abhīśūn hi trilokeśaḥ saṃgṛhya prapitāmahaḥ / tān aśvāṃś codayām āsa manomārutaraṃhasaḥ

vulgate_text: tasminsthite tato rājanrudre sajjitakārmuke / purāṇi tena kālena jagmurekatvamāśu vai
ce_text: tasmin sthite tadā rājan kruddhe vidhṛtakārmuke / purāṇi tāni kālena jagmur ekatvatāṃ tadā

vulgate_text: trīṇi dṛṣṭvaiva saṃsthāni purāṇyatha pinākadhṛt sa tadvikṛṣya bhagavāndivyaṃ lokeśvaro dhanuḥ / trailokyasāraṃ tamiṣuṃ mumoca tripuraṃ prati
ce_text: sa tad vikṛṣya bhagavān divyaṃ lokeśvaro dhanuḥ / trailokyasāraṃ tam iṣuṃ mumoca tripuraṃ prati / tat sāsuragaṇaṃ dagdhvā prākṣipat paścimārṇave

vulgate_text: bāṇatejognidagdhaṃ tadviprakīrṇaṃ sahasradhā mahadārtasvaraṃ kṛtvā nāvaśeṣamupāgatam / madreśa sāsuragaṇaṃ prāpatatpaścimārṇave
ce_text: sa tad vikṛṣya bhagavān divyaṃ lokeśvaro dhanuḥ / trailokyasāraṃ tam iṣuṃ mumoca tripuraṃ prati / tat sāsuragaṇaṃ dagdhvā prākṣipat paścimārṇave

vulgate_text: sa cātmakrodhajo vihnirdahetyukto nivāritaḥ / trailokyamaviśeṣeṇa punardagdhuṃ pracakrame
ce_text: sa cātmakrodhajo vahnir hāhety uktvā nivāritaḥ / mā kārṣīr bhasmasāl lokān iti tryakṣo 'bravīc ca tam

vulgate_text: kālāgnimiva nirdagdhumutthitaṃ taṃ punaḥ punaḥ / mākārṣīrbhasmāsāllokāniti tryakṣo'bravīdvacaḥ
ce_text: sa cātmakrodhajo vahnir hāhety uktvā nivāritaḥ / mā kārṣīr bhasmasāl lokān iti tryakṣo 'bravīc ca tam

vulgate_text: tataḥ prakṛtimāpannā delokāstatharṣayaḥ / tuṣṭuvurvāgbhiragryābhiḥ sthāṇuṃ tripuravairiṇam
ce_text: tataḥ prakṛtim āpannā devā lokās tatharṣayaḥ / tuṣṭuvur vāgbhir arthyābhiḥ sthāṇum apratimaujasam

vulgate_text: evaṃ rudrasya kṛtavānsārathyaṃ tu pitāmahaḥ / saṃyaccha turagānasya rādheyasya mahātmanaḥ
ce_text: yathaiva bhagavān brahmā lokadhātā pitāmahaḥ / saṃyaccha tvaṃ hayān asya rādheyasya mahātmanaḥ

vulgate_text: tvaṃ hi kṛṣṇācca karṇācca phalgunācca guṇādhikaḥ / balato rūpato yogādastrasampada eva ca
ce_text: tvaṃ hi kṛṣṇāc ca karṇāc ca phalgunāc ca viśeṣataḥ / viśiṣṭo rājaśārdūla nāsti tatra vicāraṇā

vulgate_text: vṛjinaṃ na bhavetkiñcidasya karṇasya pārthiva / sūtena vardhito nityaṃ na sūto nṛpa eva saḥ
ce_text: vṛjinaṃ hi bhavet kiṃ cid yadi karṇasya pārthiva / nāsmai hy astrāṇi divyāni prādāsyad bhṛgunandanaḥ

vulgate_text: viśuddhayoniṃ vijñāya divyānyastrāṇyadādbhṛguḥ nāpi sūtakule jātaṃ manye karṇaṃ kathañcana / devaputramadaṃ manye kṣatriyāṇāṃ kulodbhavam
ce_text: nāpi sūtakule jātaṃ karṇaṃ manye kathaṃ cana / devaputram ahaṃ manye kṣatriyāṇāṃ kulodbhavam

vulgate_text: sakuṇḍalaṃ sakavacaṃ dīrghabāhumarindamam / kathamādityasaṅkāśaṃ mṛgī siṃhaṃ prasūyate
ce_text: sakuṇḍalaṃ sakavacaṃ dīrghabāhuṃ mahāratham / katham ādityasadṛśaṃ mṛgī vyāghraṃ janiṣyati

vulgate_text: tato duryodhano bhūyo madrarājaṃ tarasvinam / uvāca rājansaṅgrāme'dhyuṣite paryupasthite
ce_text: tato duryodhano bhūyo madrarājaṃ tarasvinam / uvāca rājan saṃgrāme saṃyacchantaṃ hayottamān

vulgate_text: karṇasya yaccha saṅgrāme madrarāja hayottamān / tvayā'bhigupto rādheyo vijeṣyati dhanañjayam
ce_text: tvayābhigupto rādheyo vijeṣyati dhanaṃjayam / ity ukto ratham āsthāya tatheti prāha bhārata

vulgate_text: etacchrutvā vacastasya śalyaḥ karṇaṃ vaco'bravīt / kathaṃ nu tānmahāvīryānpāṇḍavānavamanyase
ce_text: sūtaputra kathaṃ nu tvaṃ pāṇḍavān avamanyase / sarvāstrajñān maheṣvāsān sarvān eva mahārathān

vulgate_text: prayāte tu tataḥ karṇe ratheṣu maditeṣu ca / cacāla ca mahī sarvā rarāsa ca suvisvaram
ce_text: prayāte tu tataḥ karṇe yodheṣu muditeṣu ca / cacāla pṛthivī rājan rarāsa ca suvisvaram

vulgate_text: śalyena sahitaṃ dṛṣṭvā karṇamāhavaśobhinam / nirjitānpāṇḍavāṃścaiva menire tatra kauravāḥ
ce_text: na ca tān gaṇayām āsuḥ sarve te daivamohitāḥ / prasthitaṃ sūtaputraṃ ca jayety ūcur narā bhuvi / nirjitān pāṇḍavāṃś caiva menire tava kauravāḥ

vulgate_text: na cettadabhimanyeta puruṣo'rjunadarśivān / śataṃ dadyāṃ gavāṃ tasmai naityakaṃ kāṃsyadohanam
ce_text: sa cet tad abhimanyeta puruṣo 'rjunadarśivān / anyaṃ tasmai punar dadyāṃ sauvarṇaṃ hastiṣaḍgavam

vulgate_text: na cettadabhimanyeta puruṣo'rjunadarśivān / tasmai dadyāṃ śataṃ nāgāñśataṃ grāmāñśataṃ rathān
ce_text: sa cet tad abhimanyeta puruṣo 'rjunadarśivān / anyaṃ tasmai punar dadyāṃ sauvarṇaṃ hastiṣaḍgavam

vulgate_text: na cettadabhimanyeta puruṣo'rjunadarśivān / anyadasmai varaṃ dadyāṃ vaiśyagrāmāṃścaturdaśa
ce_text: sa cet tad abhimanyeta puruṣo 'rjunadarśivān / anyaṃ tasmai punar dadyāṃ sauvarṇaṃ hastiṣaḍgavam

vulgate_text: mā sūtaputra manyeta sauvarṇaṃ hastiṣaṅgavam / prayacchasi mudhaiva tvaṃ drakṣyasyadya dhanañjayam
ce_text: mā sūtaputra mānena sauvarṇaṃ hastiṣaḍgavam / prayaccha puruṣāyādya drakṣyasi tvaṃ dhanaṃjayam

vulgate_text: purā sṛjasi yaccāpi vittaṃ bahu ca mūḍhavat / apātradānādye doṣāstānmohānnāvabudhyase

vulgate_text: yadā vai tvāṃ phalgunabāhuvegā-- jjyācoditā vegavanto'gnikalpāḥ / anvetāraḥ kaṅkapatrāḥ śitāgrā-- styakṣyatyeṣā svāṃ tadā karṇa buddhiḥ

ce_text: yadā divyaṃ dhanur ādāya pārthaḥ prabhāsayan pṛtanāṃ savyasācī / tvām ardayeta niśitaiḥ pṛṣatkais tadā paścāt tapsyase sūtaputra

ce_text: triśūlam āśliṣya sutīkṣṇadhāraṃ sarvāṇi gātrāṇi nigharṣasi tvam / sutīkṣṇadhāropamakarmaṇā tvaṃ yuyutsase yo 'rjunenādya karṇa

ce_text: siddhaṃ siṃhaṃ kesariṇaṃ bṛhantaṃ bālo mūḍhaḥ kṣudramṛgas tarasvī / samāhvayet tadvad etat tavādya samāhvānaṃ sūtaputrārjunasya

ce_text: petivān atha cakrāṅgaḥ petivān atha vāyasaḥ / visismāpayiṣuḥ pātair ācakṣāṇo ''tmanaḥ kriyām

vulgate_text: avamatya ca haṃsaṃ tamidaṃ kāko'bravīdvacaḥ / yo'sāvutpatito haṃsaḥ so'sāveva prahīyate

vulgate_text: gāmbhīryārdvi samudrasya na viśeṣaṃ kulādhama diśaśca nāmbhasāṃ karṇa samudrasthā vidurjanāḥ / vipaścitopyapāratvātkiṃ punaḥ karṇa vāyasaḥ

vulgate_text: atha haṃsopyatikrāmanmuhūrtamiva dūrataḥ / atikramya ca cakrāṅgaḥ kākaṃ taṃ samudaikṣata

vulgate_text: taṃ prahasya ca cakrāṅgaḥ kākaṃ mandagatiṃ tadā hīyamānamatho dṛṣṭvā haṃsaḥ prāha yathārthavat / ujjihīrṣurnimajjantaṃ smaransatpuruṣavratam
ce_text: taṃ tathā hīyamānaṃ ca haṃso dṛṣṭvābravīd idam / ujjihīrṣur nimajjantaṃ smaran satpuruṣavratam

vulgate_text: śatamekaṃ ca pātānāṃ patāmyahamiti sma ha / ślāghannātmānamadya tvaṃ kāka bhāṣitavānasi

vulgate_text: śaraṇaṃ tvāṃ prapanno'hamudakāntamavāpnuyām / haṃsedānīṃ pariśrāntamāpado māṃ samudvara

vulgate_text: tamevaṃ karuṇaṃ dīnaṃ vilapantamacetasam kākakāketi vāśantaṃ nimajjantaṃ mahārṇave / kṛpayā'bhiparīto vai kṛpāṃ cakre durātmani
ce_text: tam evaṃvādinaṃ dīnaṃ vilapantam acetanam / kāka kāketi vāśantaṃ nimajjantaṃ mahārṇave

vulgate_text: atha taṃ patataṃ dīnaṃ jalaklinnamacetanam / padbhyāmutkṣipya vepantaṃ pṛṣṭhamāro payattadā
ce_text: tathaitya vāyasaṃ haṃso jalaklinnaṃ sudurdaśam / padbhyām utkṣipya vepantaṃ pṛṣṭham āropayac chanaiḥ

vulgate_text: sa haṃsaḥ pṛṣṭhamāropya kākaṃ karṇa vicetasam avismayaṃstadā karṇa punareva samānayat / tameva deśaṃ tarasā spardhayā petaturyataḥ

ce_text: kṛtaghnatā paravittāpahāraḥ surāpānaṃ gurudārāvamarśaḥ / yeṣāṃ dharmas tān prati nāsty adharma āraṭṭakān pāñcanadān dhig astu

vulgate_text: iṅgita āśca magadhāḥ prekṣitajñāśca kosalāḥ / ardhoktāḥ kurupāñcālāḥ sarvoktā dākṣiṇāpathāḥ
ce_text: iṅgitajñāś ca magadhāḥ prekṣitajñāś ca kosalāḥ / ardhoktāḥ kurupāñcālāḥ śālvāḥ kṛtsnānuśāsanāḥ / pārvatīyāś ca viṣamā yathaiva girayas tathā

vulgate_text: evaṃ jñātvā joṣamāssva pratīpaṃ mā sma kruddhaḥ pāpabhṛtāṃ variṣṭha / pūrvaṃ hatvā tvāṃ saputraṃ balaiśca paścāddhaṃsye vāsudevārjunau ca
ce_text: etaj jñātvā joṣam āssva pratīpaṃ mā sma vai kṛthāḥ / sa tvāṃ pūrvam ahaṃ hatvā haniṣye keśavārjunau

vulgate_text: paśya karṇa mahāghoraṃ bhayaṃ vai romaharṣaṇam / arkaṃ jīmūtasaṅkāśaḥ kabandho vārya tiṣṭhati
ce_text: paśya karṇa mahāghoraṃ bhayadaṃ lomaharṣaṇam / kabandhaṃ meghasaṃkāśaṃ bhānum āvṛtya saṃsthitam

vulgate_text: paśya yūthaṃ mṛgaśataṃ mṛgāṇāṃ sarvatodiśam / rarāsa dīptalāṅgūlamādityāmabhi saṃsthitam
ce_text: paśya yūthair bahuvidhair mṛgāṇāṃ sarvatodiśam / balibhir dṛptaśārdūlair ādityo 'bhinirīkṣyate

vulgate_text: paśya kākāṃśca gṛdhrāṃśca samavetānsahasraśaḥ / ādityamabhivīkṣante hyaśivāḥ karṇa sasvarāḥ
ce_text: paśya kaṅkāṃś ca gṛdhrāṃś ca samavetān sahasraśaḥ / sthitān abhimukhān ghorān anyonyam abhibhāṣataḥ

vulgate_text: gajāśvarathapattyoghāṃstāvakānyudhi nighnataḥ / dhvajāgraṃ dṛśyate tasya jyāśabdaścaiva śrūyate

ce_text: dṛśyanta ete kārṣṇeyāḥ pañca pañcācalā iva / vyavasthitā yotsyamānāḥ sarve 'rjunasamā yudhi

ce_text: teṣāṃ padātināgānāṃ pādarakṣāḥ sahasraśaḥ / paṭṭiśāsidharāḥ śūrā babhūvur anivartinaḥ

vulgate_text: yathā yathā bhavānāha tattathā na tadanyathā yattasya vihitaṃ kāryaṃ tatkariṣyāmi suvrata / pradhānamatha caivāsya vināśaṃ ca karomyaham
ce_text: yas tv asya vihito ghātas taṃ kariṣyāmi bhārata / pradhānavadha evāsya vināśas taṃ karomy aham

ce_text: tat sthāne samavasthāpya pratyamitraṃ mahābalam / avyūhatārjuno vyūhaṃ putrasya tava durnaye

vulgate_text: tadaśvasaṅghabahulaṃ pattināgarathākulam / udīryamāṇaṃ saṃrabdhaṃ dhanañjayamabhidravat

vulgate_text: sa purastādarīnhatvā punaruttarato'vadhīt / dakṣiṇena ca paścācca kruddho rudraḥ paśūniva
ce_text: sa purastād arīn hatvā paścārdhenottareṇa ca / dakṣiṇena ca bībhatsuḥ kruddho rudraḥ paśūn iva

vulgate_text: jagrāheṣuvarānvīraḥ śīghraṃ vai daśa pañca ca / sātyakirvṛṣasenasya sūtaṃ hatvā tribhiḥ śaraiḥ
ce_text: sātyakir vṛṣasenasya hatvā sūtaṃ tribhiḥ śaraiḥ / dhanuś ciccheda bhallena jaghānāśvāṃś ca saptabhiḥ / dhvajam ekeṣuṇonmathya tribhis taṃ hṛdy atāḍayat

vulgate_text: athāvasannaḥ svarathe muhūrtātpunarutthitaḥ sa raṇe yuyudhānena visūtāśvarathadhvajaḥ / kṛto jighāṃsuḥ śaineyaṃ khaṅgacarmadhṛgabhyayāt
ce_text: athāvasannaḥ svarathe muhūrtāt punar utthitaḥ / atho jighāṃsuḥ śaineyaṃ khaḍgacarmabhṛd abhyayāt

vulgate_text: śikhaṇḍinaṃ ca daśabhirdharmarājaṃ śatena ca / etāṃścānyāṃśca rājendra pravīrāñcayagṛddhinaḥ
ce_text: ete cānye ca rājendra pravīrā jayagṛddhinaḥ / abhyardayan maheṣvāsaṃ sūtaputraṃ mahāmṛdhe

vulgate_text: tataste tu pare rājañchikhaṇḍī ca sasātyakiḥ rādheyātparirakṣanto rājānaṃ paryavārayan / muñcanto vividhānbāṇānsvarṇapuṅkhāñśilāśitān
ce_text: tatas te pāṇḍavā rājañ śikhaṇḍī ca sasātyakiḥ / rādheyāt parirakṣanto rājānaṃ paryavārayan

vulgate_text: tato yudhiṣṭhiraḥ karṇamadūrasthaṃ nivāritam / tairyodhapramukhairvīraṃ dṛṣṭvā vivyādha sāyakaiḥ
ce_text: tato yudhiṣṭhiraḥ karṇam adūrasthaṃ nivāritam / abravīt paravīraghnaḥ krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ kṣurābhyāṃ pāñcālyau cakrarakṣau mahātmanaḥ / jaghāna candradevaṃ ca daṇḍadhāraṃ ca saṃyuge
ce_text: tataḥ kṣurābhyāṃ pāñcālyau cakrarakṣau mahātmanaḥ / jaghāna samare śūraḥ śaraiḥ saṃnataparvabhiḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ prahasyādhirathiḥ ṣaṣṭhyā rājañśitaiḥ śaraiḥ / viddhvā yudhiṣṭhiraṃ saṅkhye nanādātirathastadā
ce_text: tataḥ prahasyādhirathir vidhunvānaḥ sa kārmukam / bhittvā bhallena rājānaṃ viddhvā ṣaṣṭyānadan mudā

vulgate_text: sa pāṇḍavānāṃ pravaraiḥ sarvataḥ samabhidrutaḥ / chādyamānaḥ śitatairghoraiḥ svasvanāmāṅkitaiḥ śaraiḥ
ce_text: sa pāṇḍavānāṃ pravaraiḥ sarvataḥ samabhidrutaḥ / udairayad brāhmam astraṃ śaraiḥ saṃpūrayan diśaḥ

vulgate_text: tadvarma hemavikṛtaṃ ratnacitraṃ babhau patat / savidyudabhraṃ savituḥ śliṣṭaṃ vātahataṃ yathā
ce_text: tad varma hemavikṛtaṃ rarāja nipatat tadā / savidyudabhraṃ savituḥ śiṣṭaṃ vātahataṃ yathā

vulgate_text: bhinnavarmā śaraiḥ pārtho rudhireṇa samukṣitaḥ / babhāse puruṣaśreṣṭha udyanniva divākaraḥ
ce_text: sa vivarmā śaraiḥ pārtho rudhireṇa samukṣitaḥ / kruddhaḥ sarvāyasīṃ śaktiṃ cikṣepādhirathiṃ prati

vulgate_text: tāṃ jvalantīmivākāśe śaktiṃ śaptabhirāśugaiḥ / bhallaiściccheda rādheyaḥ sā tvaśīryata vai raṇe
ce_text: tāṃ jvalantīm ivākāśe śaraiś ciccheda saptabhiḥ / sā chinnā bhūmim apatan maheṣvāsasya sāyakaiḥ

vulgate_text: udbhinnarudhiraḥ karṇaḥ krudvaḥ sarpa iva śvasan / jaghāna sūtaṃ pārthasya pārṣṭhiṃ ca navabhiḥ śaraiḥ
ce_text: udbhinnarudhiraḥ karṇaḥ kruddhaḥ sarpa iva śvasan / dhvajaṃ ciccheda bhallena tribhir vivyādha pāṇḍavam / iṣudhī cāsya ciccheda rathaṃ ca tilaśo 'cchinat

ce_text: mā sma yudhyasva kaunteya mā ca vīrān samāsadaḥ / mā cainān apriyaṃ brūhi mā ca vraja mahāraṇam

ce_text: kālyamānaṃ balaṃ dṛṣṭvā dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / tān yodhān abravīt kruddho hatainaṃ vai sahasraśaḥ

ce_text: uttiṣṭhata praharata praitābhipatateti ca / iti bruvāṇā anyonyaṃ jaghnur yodhā raṇājire

vulgate_text: vipatākadhvajacchatrā vyaśvasūtarathāyudhāḥ vyaṅgāṅgāvayavāḥ petuḥ kṣitau kṣīṇāḥ kṣitīśvarāḥ / śikharāṇīva śelānāṃ vajrabhinnāni māniṣa
ce_text: vipatākādhvajacchatrā vyaśvasūtāyudhā raṇe / vyaṅgāṅgāvayavāḥ petuḥ kṣitau kṣīṇā hateśvarāḥ

ce_text: chinnabhinnaviparyastair varmālaṃkāravigrahaiḥ / sārohās turagāḥ petur hatavīrāḥ sahasraśaḥ

ce_text: abhiyāsi mahābāho bhīmasenaṃ mahābalam / nirasya bhīmasenaṃ tu tataḥ prāpsyasi phalgunam

vulgate_text: evamukte tataḥ karṇaḥ śalyaṃ punarabhāṣata / hantā'hamenaṃ saṃrabdhaṃ māṃ vā hantā vṛkodaraḥ
ce_text: evam ukte tataḥ karṇaḥ śalyaṃ punar abhāṣata / hantāham arjunaṃ saṃkhye māṃ vā hantā dhanaṃjayaḥ / yuddhe manaḥ samādhāya yāhi yāhīty acodayat

ce_text: tataḥ parājite karṇe dhārtarāṣṭrīṃ mahācamūm / vyadrāvayad bhīmaseno yathendro dānavīṃ camūm

ce_text: taṃ karṇaḥ pañcaviṃśatyā nārācānāṃ samārdayat / madotkaṭaṃ vane dṛptam ulkābhir iva kuñjaram

ce_text: tatas te prādravan bhītāḥ pratīpaṃ prahitāḥ punaḥ / mahāmātrais tam āvavrur meghā iva divākaram
