vulgate_text: nāgamastraṃ tataḥ pārthaḥ prāduścakre hasanniva / pādabandhaṃ sa teṣāṃ vai cakre tena mahāstravit
ce_text: padabandhaṃ tataś cakre pāṇḍavaḥ paravīrahā / nāgam astraṃ mahārāja saṃprodīrya muhur muhuḥ

vulgate_text: yānuddiśya raṇe pārthaḥ pādabandhaṃ cakāra ha / te baddhāḥ pādabandhena yodhāḥ saṃśaptakāstadā
ce_text: yān uddiśya raṇe pārthaḥ padabandhaṃ cakāra ha / te baddhāḥ padabandhena pāṇḍavena mahātmanā / niśceṣṭā abhavan rājann aśmasāramayā iva

vulgate_text: sa gāḍhaviddho vyathito rathopastha upāviśatat / tata uccukruśuḥ sarve hataḥ pārtha iti bruvan
ce_text: suśarmā tu tato rājan bāṇenānataparvaṇā / arjunaṃ hṛdaye viddhvā vivyādhānyais tribhiḥ śaraiḥ / sa gāḍhaviddho vyathito rathopastha upāviśat

vulgate_text: vimukhīkṛtya samare suśarmāṇaṃ dhanañjayaḥ / aindramastramameyātmā prāduścakre hasanniva
ce_text: pratilabhya tataḥ saṃjñāṃ śvetāśvaḥ kṛṣṇasārathiḥ / aindram astram ameyātmā prāduścakre tvarānvitaḥ / tato bāṇasahasrāṇi samutpannāni māriṣa

vulgate_text: hayānpattīṃśca samare śastraiḥ śatasahasraśaḥ / rarāja samare rājañśakro nighnannivāsurān
ce_text: sarvadikṣu vyadṛśyanta sūdayanto nṛpa dvipān / hayān rathāṃś ca samare śastraiḥ śatasahasraśaḥ

vulgate_text: vadhyamāne tataḥ sainye bhayaṃ sumahadāviśat / saṃśaptakagaṇānāṃ ca gopālānāṃ ca bhārata
ce_text: vadhyamāne tataḥ sainye vipulā bhīḥ samāviśat / saṃśaptakagaṇānāṃ ca gopālānāṃ ca bhārata / na hi kaś cit pumāṃs tatra yo 'rjunaṃ pratyayudhyata

vulgate_text: na hi tatra pumānkaścidyo'rjunaṃ pratibudhyate / paśyatāṃ tatra vīrāṇāmahanyata balaṃ tava
ce_text: vadhyamāne tataḥ sainye vipulā bhīḥ samāviśat / saṃśaptakagaṇānāṃ ca gopālānāṃ ca bhārata / na hi kaś cit pumāṃs tatra yo 'rjunaṃ pratyayudhyata

vulgate_text: hanyamānaṃ ca tadabhūnniśceṣṭaṃ ca parākrame
ce_text: paśyatāṃ tatra vīrāṇām ahanyata mahad balam / hanyamānam apaśyaṃś ca niśceṣṭāḥ sma parākrame

vulgate_text: tatra yuddhaṃ mahaccāsīttāvakānāṃ viśāmpate śūreṇa balinā sārdhaṃ pāṇḍavena kirīṭinā / jitvā tānnyahanatpārthaḥ śatrūñśakra ivāsurān
ce_text: tatra yuddhaṃ mahad dhy āsīt tāvakānāṃ viśāṃ pate / śūreṇa balinā sārdhaṃ pāṇḍavena kirīṭinā

vulgate_text: tataḥ kṛpaḥ śaraistīkṣṇaiḥ so'tividdho mahārathaḥ tataḥ suniśitaistīkṣṇaiḥ kṣuraprairhemabhūṣitaiḥ / vyaśvasūtarathaṃ cakre śikhaṇḍinamatho dvijaḥ
ce_text: tataḥ kṛpaḥ śarais tīkṣṇaiḥ so 'tividdho mahārathaḥ / vyaśvasūtarathaṃ cakre pārṣataṃ tu dvijottamaḥ

vulgate_text: śikhaṇḍine tato bāṇānkṛpaḥ śāradvato yudhi / prāhiṇottavarayā yukto bībhatsoratha sannidhau
ce_text: śikhaṇḍinas tato bāṇān kṛpaḥ śāradvato yudhi / prāhiṇot tvarayā yukto didhakṣur iva māriṣa

vulgate_text: sa vicarmā mahārāja khaṅgapāṇirupādravat / kṛpastaṃ śarasaṅghātairādravantamapīḍayat
ce_text: sa vicarmā mahārāja khaḍgapāṇir upādravat / kṛpasya vaśam āpanno mṛtyor āsyam ivāturaḥ

vulgate_text: khaṅgena śitadhāreṇa sa hataḥ prāpatadrathāt / kṛtavarmā tato hṛṣṭastalaśabdaṃ cakāra ha
ce_text: sārathiṃ cāsya tarasā prāhiṇod yamasādanam / bhallena śitadhāreṇa sa hataḥ prāpatad rathāt

vulgate_text: bhāradvājaśaraiśchannaṃ na prājñāyata kiñcana / bāṇabhūtamabhūtsarvamāyodhanaśiro mahat
ce_text: drauṇāyaniśaracchannaṃ na prājñāyata kiṃ cana / bāṇabhūtam abhūt sarvam āyodhanaśiro hi tat

vulgate_text: tena cchanne raṇe rājanbāṇajālena bhāsvatā / abhracchāyeva sajajñe hṛtaraśmistamonudaḥ
ce_text: tena channe raṇe rājan bāṇajālena bhāsvatā / abhracchāyeva saṃjajñe bāṇaruddhe nabhastale

vulgate_text: tadadbhutamapaśyāma bāṇabhūte nabhasthale / na sma sampatate bhūtaṃ drauṇerdṛṣṭvā parākramam
ce_text: tatrāścaryam apaśyāma bāṇabhūte tathāvidhe / na sma saṃpatate bhūmau dṛṣṭvā drauṇeḥ parākramam

vulgate_text: tato dharmasuto rājanpragṛhyānyanmahaddhanuḥ / droṇaputraṃ tripaṣṭaḷḷ tatu bāhvorurasi cārpayayat
ce_text: tato dharmasuto rājan pragṛhyānyan mahad dhanuḥ / drauṇiṃ vivyādha saptatyā bāhvor urasi cārdayat

vulgate_text: sahasā patatastānvai krudvarūpānparantapaḥ / prahasanpratijagrāha droṇaputro mahāraṇe
ce_text: āgacchamānāṃs tān dṛṣṭvā raudrarūpān paraṃtapaḥ / prahasan pratijagrāha droṇaputro mahāraṇe

vulgate_text: tadbalaṃ pāṇḍaveyasya droṇaputraḥ śarārciṣā / tāpayanbharataśreṣṭha gabhastibhirivāṃśumān
ce_text: tad balaṃ pāṇḍuputrasya droṇaputrapratāpitam / cukṣubhe bharataśreṣṭha timineva nadīmukham

vulgate_text: dṛṣṭvā caiva mahārāja droṇaputraparākramam / sarvānduryodhanaḥ pārthānhatānyudve'bhyamanyata
ce_text: dṛṣṭvā te ca mahārāja droṇaputraparākramam / nihatān menire sarvān pāṇḍūn droṇasutena vai

vulgate_text: bhīmasenaṃ sapāñcālaṃ cedikekayasaṃvṛtam / senāpatiḥ svayaṃ kruddho vārayāmāsa sāyakaiḥ
ce_text: bhīmasenaṃ sapāñcālyaṃ cedikekayasaṃvṛtam / vaikartanaḥ svayaṃ ruddhvā vārayām āsa sāyakaiḥ

vulgate_text: tato'parābhyāṃ bhallābyāṃ dhanuṣī samakṛntata / yamayoḥ prasabhaṃ vīro vivyādhāśu tribhistribhiḥ
ce_text: tato 'parābhyāṃ bhallābhyāṃ dhanuṣī samakṛntata / yamayoḥ prahasan rājan vivyādhaiva ca saptabhiḥ

vulgate_text: tasya sāyakasañchannau mādreyau na virejatuḥ / meghacchannau yathā vyomni candrasūryau gataprabhau
ce_text: tasya sāyakasaṃchannau cakāśetāṃ ca pāṇḍavau / meghacchannau yathā vyomni candrasūryau hataprabhau

vulgate_text: tathāsya saśaraṃ cāpaṃ muṣṭideśe viśāmpate / kṣurapreṇa sutīkṣṇena rājā ciccheda saṃyuge
ce_text: athāsya saśaraṃ cāpaṃ hastāvāpaṃ ca māriṣa / kṣurapreṇa sutīkṣṇena rājā ciccheda saṃyuge

vulgate_text: so'tividdho mahārāja putraste'tivyarājata / vasantakāle sumahānpraphulla iva kiṃśukaḥ
ce_text: so 'tividdho mahārāja putras te 'tivyarājata / vasante puṣpaśabalaḥ sapuṣpa iva kiṃśukaḥ

vulgate_text: duryodhanaṃ tu virathaṃ chinnavarmāyudhadhvajam / bhrātaraṃ samudaikṣanta sodarā bharatarṣabha
ce_text: duryodhanaṃ tu virathaṃ chinnasarvāyudhaṃ raṇe / bhrātaraḥ paryarakṣanta sodaryā bharatarṣabha

vulgate_text: karṇastu sātyakiṃ hitvā rājagṛghnuramarṣaṇaḥ / dromahantāramugreṣuṃ sasārābhimukho raṇe
ce_text: karṇas tu sātyakiṃ jitvā rājagṛddhī mahābalaḥ / droṇahantāram ugreṣuṃ sasārābhimukhaṃ raṇe

vulgate_text: sa bhāratapurogānāṃ rājñāṃ ca sumahātmanām / karṇapārṣatayoryudve saṅkraddhānāṃ mahāraṇe
ce_text: sa bhārata mahān āsīd yodhānāṃ sumahātmanām / karṇapārṣatayor madhye tvadīyānāṃ mahāraṇaḥ

vulgate_text: teṣāmādhirathiḥ kruddhaḥ pradhānānvai tarasvinaḥ / vicinvanniva bāṇaughaiḥ samāsādayadagrataḥ
ce_text: teṣām ādhirathiḥ kruddho yatamānān manasvinaḥ / vicinvann eva bāṇāgraiḥ samāsādayad agrataḥ

vulgate_text: vyāghraketuḥ suśarmā ca śukraścitrāyudhaḥ kratuḥ durjayo rocamānaśca siṃhasenastathā'ṣṭamaḥ / mahatā rathavaṃśena parivavrurnarottamam
ce_text: vyāghraketuṃ suśarmāṇaṃ śaṅkuṃ cograṃ dhanaṃjayam / śuklaṃ ca rocamānaṃ ca siṃhasenaṃ ca durjayam

vulgate_text: sṛjantaḥ sāyakāṃstūrṇaṃ karṇamāhavaśobhinam yatamānāṃstu tāñśūrānmanujendraḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ / aṣṭābhiraṣṭau rādheyaḥ pāñcālānnyahanadraṇe
ce_text: yudhyamānāṃs tu tāñ śūrān manujendraḥ pratāpavān / aṣṭābhir aṣṭau rādheyo nyahanan niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ

vulgate_text: vaiśvānaramukhaṃ prāpya dahyante śalabhā yathā / karṇāgriṃ samare prāpya dagdhā bhārata sṛñjayaḥ
ce_text: vaiśvānaraṃ yathā dīptaṃ dahyante prāpya vai janāḥ / karṇāgninā raṇe tadvad dagdhā bhārata sṛñjayāḥ

vulgate_text: bāhlīkānkekayānmātsyānvāsātyānmadrasaindhavān / ekaḥ saṅkhye maheṣvāso yodhayanbahvaśobhata
ce_text: bhīmasenas tu saṃkruddhaḥ kurūn madrān sakekayān / ekaḥ saṃkhye maheṣvāso yodhayan bahv aśobhata

vulgate_text: prasannasalile kāle yathā syātsāgaro nṛpa / tadvattava balaṃ tadvai niścalaṃ samavasthitam
ce_text: niśceṣṭaṃ tumule dīnaṃ babhau tasmin mahāraṇe / prasannasalilaḥ kāle yathā syāt sāgaro nṛpa

vulgate_text: manyuvīryabalopetaṃ darpātpratyavaropitam / abhavattava putrasya tatsainyaṃ niṣprabhaṃ tadā
ce_text: manyuvīryabalopetaṃ balāt paryavaropitam / abhavat tava putrasya tat sainyam iṣubhis tadā / rudhiraughapariklinnaṃ rudhirārdraṃ babhūva ha

vulgate_text: te bale bharataśreṣṭha vadhyamāne parasparam / rudhiraughapariklinne rudhirārdre babhūvatuḥ
ce_text: manyuvīryabalopetaṃ balāt paryavaropitam / abhavat tava putrasya tat sainyam iṣubhis tadā / rudhiraughapariklinnaṃ rudhirārdraṃ babhūva ha

vulgate_text: sūtaputro'vadhītkrudvaḥ pāṇḍavānāmanīkinīm / bhīmasenaḥ kurūṇāṃ ca trigartānāṃ dhanañjayaḥ
ce_text: sūtaputro raṇe kruddhaḥ pāṇḍavānām anīkinīm / bhīmasenaḥ kurūṃś cāpi drāvayan bahv aśobhata

vulgate_text: durjayā hyeva samare devairapi savāsavaiḥ / apārayanto madbāṇānsiṃhaśabdaṃ mṛgā iva
ce_text: ete dhāvanti sagaṇāḥ saṃśaptakamahārathāḥ / apārayanto madbāṇān siṃhaśabdān mṛgā iva

vulgate_text: dīryate ca mahatsainyaṃ sṛñjayānāṃ mahāraṇe / kuravaścābhidhāvanti bhīmasenabhayārditāḥ
ce_text: dīryate ca mahat sainyaṃ sṛñjayānāṃ mahāraṇe / hastikakṣyo hy asau kṛṣṇa ketuḥ karṇasya dhīmataḥ / dṛśyate rājasainyasya madhye vicarato muhuḥ

vulgate_text: tatra yāhi yataḥ karṇo drāvayatyeṣa no balam trigartānvarjayanyāhi sūtaputraṃ mahāratham / etanme rocate kṛṣṇa yathā vā tava rocate
ce_text: varjayitvā raṇe yāhi sūtaputraṃ mahāratham / śramo mā bādhate kṛṣṇa yathā vā tava rocate

vulgate_text: tatastava mahāsainyaṃ govindapreritā hayāḥ / haṃsavarṇā viśaṃstūrṇaṃ vahanto'rjunamāhave
ce_text: tatas tava mahat sainyaṃ govindapreritā hayāḥ / haṃsavarṇāḥ praviviśur vahantaḥ kṛṣṇapāṇḍavau

vulgate_text: śaravarṣairmahārāja sarvataḥ pāṇḍunandanam / sa cchādyamānaḥ samare śaraiḥ parabalārdanaḥ
ce_text: sa chādyamānaḥ samare śaraiḥ parabalārdanaḥ / darśayan raudram ātmānaṃ pāśahasta ivāntakaḥ / nighnan saṃśaptakān pārthaḥ prekṣaṇīyataro 'bhavat

vulgate_text: saṃśaptakāṃstu kaunteyaḥ kurūṃścāpi vṛkodaraḥ / sūtaputrastu pāñcālāṃstrayo'ghnaṃstvaritāḥ śaraiḥ
ce_text: saṃśaptakāṃś ca kaunteyaḥ kurūṃś cāpi vṛkodaraḥ / vasuṣeṇaṃ ca pāñcālaḥ kṛtsnena vyadhamad raṇe

vulgate_text: kathaṃ saṃśaptakaiḥ sārdhamarjunasyābhavadraṇaḥ / sūtaputrasya pāñcālaiḥ kathaṃ yuddhaṃ pravartitam
ce_text: yathā saṃśaptakaiḥ sārdham arjunasyābhavad raṇaḥ / anyeṣāṃ ca madīyānāṃ pāṇḍavais tad bravīhi me

vulgate_text: aśvatthāmnastu yadyuddhamarjunasya ca sañjaya / anyeṣāṃ ca madīyānāṃ pāṇḍavaistadbravīhi me
ce_text: yathā saṃśaptakaiḥ sārdham arjunasyābhavad raṇaḥ / anyeṣāṃ ca madīyānāṃ pāṇḍavais tad bravīhi me

vulgate_text: taṃ pravīrāḥ susaṃrabdhā nardamānā ivarṣabhāḥ vāsitārthamiva kruddhamabhidrutya mahotkaṭāḥ / nighntamabhijaghnuste śaraiḥ śṛṅgairivarṣabhāḥ
ce_text: taṃ pravīraṃ pratīyātā nardamānā ivarṣabhāḥ / vāśitārtham abhikruddhā huṃkṛtvā cābhidudruvuḥ / nighnantam abhijaghnus te śaraiḥ śṛṅgair ivarṣabhāḥ

vulgate_text: ātithyakarmābhyutthāya dīyatāṃ yadi manyase / evamukto'vahatpārthaṃ kṛṣṇodroṇātmajāntike
ce_text: evam ukto 'vahat pārthaṃ kṛṣṇo droṇātmajāntikam / jaitreṇa vidhināhūtaṃ vāyur indram ivādhvare

vulgate_text: paśya mādhava daurātmyaṃ guruputrasya māṃ prati vadhaṃ prāptau manyate nau prāveśya śavareśmani / eṣosmi hanmi saṅkalpaṃ śikṣayā ca balena ca
ce_text: vadhaprāptau manyate nau praveśya śaraveśmani / eṣo 'sya hanmi saṃkalpaṃ śikṣayā ca balena ca

vulgate_text: bhallaiśchinnāḥ karāḥ petuḥ kariṇāṃ madavarṣiṇām / yathā vane paraśubhirnikṛttāḥ śālmalidrumāḥ
ce_text: bhallaiś chinnāḥ karāḥ petuḥ kariṇāṃ madakarṣiṇām / chinnā yathā paraśubhiḥ pravṛddhāḥ śaradi drumāḥ

vulgate_text: padmārkapūrṇendunibhānanāni kirīṭamālyābharaṇojjvalāni / bhallārdhacandrakṣurasannikṛttā-- nyapātayacchatruśirāṃsyajasram
ce_text: padmārkapūrṇendusamānanāni kirīṭamālāmukuṭotkaṭāni / bhallārdhacandrakṣurahiṃsitāni prapetur urvyāṃ nṛśirāṃsy ajasram

vulgate_text: gāṇḍīvamuktaiḥ kupitāhikalpai-- drauṇiṃ śaraiḥ saṃyati nirbibheda / chittvā tu raśmīṃsturagānavidhya-- tte taṃ raṇādūhuratīva dūram
ce_text: tatheti coktvācyutam apramādī drauṇiṃ prayatnād iṣubhis tatakṣa / chittvāśvaraśmīṃs turagān avidhyat te taṃ raṇād ūhur atīva dūram

vulgate_text: jānañjayaṃ niyataṃ vṛṣṇivīre dhanañjaye cāṅgirasāṃ variṣṭhaḥ / viveśa karṇasya balaṃ tarasvī bhagnotsāhaḥ kṣīṇavāṇāstrayogaḥ
ce_text: āvṛtya neyeṣa punas tu yuddhaṃ pārthena sārdhaṃ matimān vimṛśya / jānañ jayaṃ niyataṃ vṛṣṇivīre dhanaṃjaye cāṅgirasāṃ variṣṭhaḥ

vulgate_text: sa māgadhānāṃ pravaro mahābalo'-- śubhagraho yodhagaṇaiḥ samanvitaḥ / sapatnasenāṃ pramamātha dāruṇo bhīmaṃ samagrāṃ balavāniva graham
ce_text: sa māgadhānāṃ pravaro 'ṅkuśagraho graheṣv asahyo vikaco yathā grahaḥ / sapatnasenāṃ pramamātha dāruṇo mahīṃ samagrāṃ vikaco yathā grahaḥ

vulgate_text: sukalpitaṃ dānavanāgasannibhaṃ mahābhranirhādasamasvanaṃ raṇe / samāsthito nāgavaraṃ nareśvaro rathāśvamātaṅganarapramāthinam
ce_text: sukalpitaṃ dānavanāgasaṃnibhaṃ mahābhrasaṃhrādam amitramardanam / rathāśvamātaṅgagaṇān sahasraśaḥ samāsthito hanti śarair dvipān api

vulgate_text: dhuryāndhuryetarānsūtāndhvajāṃścapāsisāyakān / pāṇīnpāṇigatāñśastrānbāhūnapi śirāṃsi ca
ce_text: dhuryaṃ dhuryatarān sūtān rathāṃś ca parisaṃkṣipan / pāṇīn pāṇigataṃ śastraṃ bāhūn api śirāṃsi ca

vulgate_text: taṃ pravīrāstvadīyānāṃ nardamānā'bhidudruvuḥ vāsitārthe yuyutsanto vṛṣabhā vṛṣabhaṃ yathā / nipatantyarjunaṃ śūrāḥ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ
ce_text: vāśitārthe yuyutsanto vṛṣabhā vṛṣabhaṃ yathā / āpatanty arjunaṃ śūrāḥ śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ

vulgate_text: chinnatriveṇujaṅgheṣānhatāśvānhatasārathīn / visrastahastatūṇīrānvicakrathaketanān
ce_text: chinnatriveṇujaṅgheṣān nihatapārṣṇisārathīn / saṃchinnaraśmiyoktrākṣān vyanukarṣayugān rathān / vidhvastasarvasaṃnāhān bāṇaiś cakre 'rjunas tvaran

vulgate_text: tathetyuktvā'rjunaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ śiṣṭānsaṃśaptakāṃstadā / kṣapayiṣyaṃstadā bāṇairdaityānindra ivāvadhīt
ce_text: tathety uktvārjunaḥ kṣipraṃ śiṣṭān saṃśaptakāṃs tadā / ākṣipya śastreṇa balād daityān indra ivāvadhīt

vulgate_text: parighānbhiṇḍipālāṃśca bhuśuṇḍīḥ kaṇapānapi / ayaskuntāṃśca patitānmusalāni gurūṇi ca
ce_text: daṇḍaiḥ kanakacitraiś ca vipraviddhān paraśvadhān / ayaskuśāntān patitān musalāni gurūṇi ca

vulgate_text: gajavājimanuṣyāṇāṃ śaraśaktyṛṣṭitomaraiḥ kabandhaiḥ śoṇitādigdhaiśchinnagātraśirodharaiḥ / bhūrbhāti bharataśreṣṭha śāntāgnibhirivādhvare
ce_text: kabandhaiḥ śoṇitādigdhaiś chinnagātraśirodharaiḥ / bhūr bhāti bharataśreṣṭha śāntārcirbhir ivāgnibhiḥ

vulgate_text: vaidūryamaṇidaṇḍāṃśca patitāṃścāṅkuśānbhuvi / aśvānāṃ ca yugāpīḍānratnacitrānuraśchadān
ce_text: vaiḍūryamaṇidaṇḍāṃś ca patitān aṅkuśān bhuvi / baddhāḥ sādidhvajāgreṣu suvarṇavikṛtāḥ kaśāḥ

vulgate_text: sajīvāṃśca narānpaśya kūjamānānsamantataḥ upāsyamānāṃśca bahūnnyastaśastraiśca bhūpate / jñātibhiśca jalaklinnānrodamānairmuhurmuhuḥ
ce_text: sajīvāṃś ca narān paśya kūjamānān samantataḥ / upāsyamānān bahubhir nyastaśastrair viśāṃ pate

vulgate_text: pariṣvajya priyānanye bāndhavānbandhuvatsalāḥ / visaṃjñānsamare yodhāṃstatratatra mahāraṇe
ce_text: parityajya priyān anye bāndhavān bāndhavapriya / vyutkrāntāḥ samadṛśyanta tatra tatra mahāraṇe

vulgate_text: śaṅkhadundubhinirghoṣaṃ bherīpaṇavaniḥsvanam / rathāśvanaranāgānāṃ pādaśabdāṃśca dāruṇān
ce_text: śaṅkhadundubhinirghoṣān bherīpaṇavamiśritān / rathāśvagajanādāṃś ca śastraśabdāṃś ca dāruṇān

vulgate_text: tānacchinattadā pāṇḍyaścaturbhiraparaiḥ śaraiḥ / caturo'bhyāhanaccāśvānāśu te vyasavo'bhavan
ce_text: teṣāṃ pañcācchinat pāṇḍyaḥ pañcabhir niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ / catvāro 'bhyāhanan vāhān āśu te vyasavo 'bhavan

vulgate_text: divyaṃ dhanurathādhijyaṃ kṛtvā drauṇiramitrahā / prekṣya cāśu rathe yuktānnarairanyānhayottamān
ce_text: vijyaṃ dhanur athādhijyaṃ kṛtvā drauṇir amitrahā / tataḥ śarasahasrāṇi preṣayām āsa pāṇḍyataḥ / iṣusaṃbādham ākāśam akarod diśa eva ca

vulgate_text: hateśvaro dantivaraḥ sukalpita-- satvarābhisṛṣṭaḥ pratiśabdago balī / tamādravaddrauṇiśarāhatastvaran javena kṛtvā pratihastigarjitam
ce_text: hateśvaro dantivaraḥ sukalpitas tvarābhisṛṣṭaḥ pratiśarmago balī / tam adhyatiṣṭhan malayeśvaro mahān yathādriśṛṅgaṃ harir unnadaṃs tathā

vulgate_text: taṃ vāraṇaṃ vāraṇayuddhakovido dvipottamaṃ parvatasānusannibham / sambhyatiṣṭhanmalayadhvajastvara-- nyathā'driśṛṅgaṃ harirunnadaṃstathā
ce_text: hateśvaro dantivaraḥ sukalpitas tvarābhisṛṣṭaḥ pratiśarmago balī / tam adhyatiṣṭhan malayeśvaro mahān yathādriśṛṅgaṃ harir unnadaṃs tathā

vulgate_text: ta ime nānuvartante dhṛṣṭadyumnapurogamāḥ / pāñcālāḥ sṛñjayāścaiva pāṇḍavānāṃ camūmukham
ce_text: tam ete 'nu nivartante dhṛṣṭadyumnapurogamāḥ / pāñcālānāṃ sṛñjayānāṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ ca yan mukham / nivṛttaiś ca tathā pārthair bhagnaṃ śatrubalaṃ mahat

vulgate_text: tameṣa pradrutaḥ saṅkhye dhṛṣṭadyumno mahārathaḥ / aśvatthāmnā hatāḥ saṅkhye sarve kaunteya sṛñjayāḥ
ce_text: asau gacchati kauravya drauṇir astrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ / tam eṣa pradrutaḥ saṃkhye dhṛṣṭadyumno mahārathaḥ

vulgate_text: rathāśvanaranāgānāṃ kṛtaṃ ca kadanaṃ mahat / ityetatsarvamācaṣṭa vāsudevaḥ kirīṭine
ce_text: sarvaṃ vyācaṣṭa durdharṣo vāsudevaḥ kirīṭine / tato rājan prādurāsīn mahāghoro mahāraṇaḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ pravavṛte yūddhaṃ ghorarūpaṃ viśāmpate / karṇasya pāṇḍavānāṃ ca yamarāṣṭravivardhanam
ce_text: tataḥ pravavṛte bhīmaḥ saṃgrāmo lomaharṣaṇaḥ / karṇasya pāṇḍavānāṃ ca yamarāṣṭravivardhanaḥ

vulgate_text: tayorāsīnmahārāja saṅgrāmo ghoradarśanaḥ / pravṛddhayormahāraṅge balinorvijigīṣatoḥ
ce_text: tam āsādya tu te karṇaṃ vyaśīryanta mahārathāḥ / yathācalaṃ samāsādya jalaughāḥ sarvatodiśam / tayor āsīn mahārāja saṃgrāmo lomaharṣaṇaḥ

vulgate_text: vavarṣa śaravarṣāṇi toyavarṣānivāmbudaḥ / chādayāmāsa saṅkruddhaḥ pārṣataṃ navabhiḥ śaraiḥ
ce_text: vijayaṃ tu dhanuḥśreṣṭhaṃ vidhunvāno mahārathaḥ / pārṣatasya dhanuś chittvā śarān āśīviṣopamān / tāḍayām āsa saṃkruddhaḥ pārṣataṃ navabhiḥ śaraiḥ

vulgate_text: tadapāsya dhanuśchinnaṃ dhṛṣṭadyumnaḥ pratāpavān tato'nyaddhanurādāya sāravadbhārasādhanam / karṇaṃ vivyādha saptatyā śaraiḥ sannataparvabhiḥ
ce_text: tad apāsya dhanuś chinnaṃ dhṛṣṭadyumno mahārathaḥ / anyad dhanur upādāya śarāṃś cāśīviṣopamān / karṇaṃ vivyādha saptatyā śaraiḥ saṃnataparvabhiḥ

vulgate_text: dṛṣṭavānpatitaṃ bhūmau śaraṃ karṇo viśāmpate
ce_text: dṛṣṭvā vinihitaṃ bāṇaṃ śaraiḥ karṇo viśāṃ pate / sātyakiṃ śaravarṣeṇa samantāt paryavārayat

vulgate_text: pārṣataḥ śaravarṣeṇa samantātparyavārayat / vivyādha cainaṃ tvarito nārācaiḥ saptabhistadā
ce_text: dṛṣṭvā vinihitaṃ bāṇaṃ śaraiḥ karṇo viśāṃ pate / sātyakiṃ śaravarṣeṇa samantāt paryavārayat

vulgate_text: taṃ pratyavidhyaddaśabhiḥ śarairhemavibhūṣitaiḥ / tayoryuddhaṃ samabhavaddṛṣṭiśrotramanoharam
ce_text: vivyādha cainaṃ samare nārācais tatra saptabhiḥ / taṃ pratyavidhyac chaineyaḥ śarair hemavibhūṣitaiḥ

vulgate_text: tiṣṭhatiṣṭheti brahmaghna na me jīvanvimokṣyase ityuktvā subhṛśaṃ vīraḥ śīghrakṛnniśitaiḥ śaraiḥ / chādayāmāsa samare yatamāno mahārathaḥ
ce_text: ity uktvā subhṛśaṃ vīraḥ śīghrakṛn niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ / pārṣataṃ chādayām āsa ghorarūpaiḥ sutejanaiḥ / yatamānaṃ paraṃ śaktyā yatamāno mahārathaḥ

vulgate_text: yathā hi samare drauṇiḥ pārṣataṃ dṛśyata māriṣa / nātihṛṣṭamanā hyāsīnmanvāno mṛtyumātmanaḥ
ce_text: yathā hi samare drauṇiḥ pārṣataṃ vīkṣya māriṣa / tathā drauṇiṃ raṇe dṛṣṭvā pārṣataḥ paravīrahā / nātihṛṣṭamanā bhūtvā manyate mṛtyum ātmanaḥ

vulgate_text: tāvanyonyaṃ tu dṛṣṭvaiva saṃrambhaṃ jagmatuḥ param / pragṛhya mahatī cāpe śarāsanasamanvite
ce_text: drauṇis tu dṛṣṭvā rājendra dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ raṇe sthitam / krodhena niḥśvasan vīraḥ pārṣataṃ samupādravat / tāv anyonyaṃ tu dṛṣṭvaiva saṃrambhaṃ jagmatuḥ param

vulgate_text: adya tvaṃ prāpsyase tadvai yathā hyakuśalastathā arakṣyamāṇaḥ pārthena yadi tiṣṭhasi saṃyuge / nāpakrāmasi vā mohātsatyametadbravīmi te
ce_text: arakṣyamāṇaḥ pārthena yadi tiṣṭhasi saṃyuge / nāpakramasi vā mūḍha satyam etad bravīmi te

vulgate_text: evamuktaḥ pratyuvāca dhṛṣṭadyumnaḥ pratāpavān / āśiṣaṃ tāṃ pravaktavyāṃ māmako dāsyate tava
ce_text: evam uktaḥ pratyuvāca dhṛṣṭadyumnaḥ pratāpavān / prativākyaṃ sa evāsir māmako dāsyate tava / yenaiva te pitur dattaṃ yatamānasya saṃyuge

vulgate_text: yenaiva te piturdattā yatamānasya saṃyuge eṣa te prativākyaṃ vai asirdāsyati māmakaḥ / yena kṛttaṃ tava pituryatamānasya tacchiraḥ
ce_text: evam uktaḥ pratyuvāca dhṛṣṭadyumnaḥ pratāpavān / prativākyaṃ sa evāsir māmako dāsyate tava / yenaiva te pitur dattaṃ yatamānasya saṃyuge

vulgate_text: evamuktvā mahātejāḥ senāpatirarindamaḥ / sutīkṣṇenātha bhallena drauṇiṃ vivyādha pārṣataḥ
ce_text: evam uktvā mahārāja senāpatir amarṣaṇaḥ / niśitenātha bāṇena drauṇiṃ vivyādha pārṣataḥ

vulgate_text: rādheyo'pi mahārāja pāñcālānsaha pāṇḍavaiḥ / draupadeyā yudhāmanyumuttamaujasameva ca
ce_text: rādheyo 'pi mahārāja pāñcālān saha pāṇḍavaiḥ / draupadeyān yudhāmanyuṃ sātyakiṃ ca mahāratham / ekaḥ sa vārayām āsa prekṣaṇīyaḥ samantataḥ

vulgate_text: sātyakiśca mahārāja yodhāṃścānyānsahasraśaḥ / ekastānvārayāmāsa prekṣaṇīyaḥ samantataḥ
ce_text: rādheyo 'pi mahārāja pāñcālān saha pāṇḍavaiḥ / draupadeyān yudhāmanyuṃ sātyakiṃ ca mahāratham / ekaḥ sa vārayām āsa prekṣaṇīyaḥ samantataḥ

vulgate_text: dhṛṣṭadyumnastu samare drauṇeściccheda kārmukam / kṣurapreṇa sutīkṣṇena paśyatāṃ sarvayodhinām
ce_text: dhṛṣṭadyumno 'pi samare drauṇeś ciccheda kārmukam / tad apāsya dhanuś chinnam anyad ādatta kārmukam / vegavat samare ghoraṃ śarāṃś cāśīviṣopamān

vulgate_text: tasyāntamiṣubhī rājanyadā drauṇirna gacchati atha tyaktvā rathaṃ vīraḥ pārṣataṃ tvarito'nvagāt / pragṛhya vipulaṃ khahgaṃ jātarūpapariṣkṛtam
ce_text: tasyāntam iṣubhī rājan yadā drauṇir na jagmivān / atha tyaktvā dhanur vīraḥ pārṣataṃ tvarito 'nvagāt

vulgate_text: trāyasvainaṃ mahābāho pārṣataṃ yuddhadurmadam / drauṇerāsyagataṃ vīra mṛtyorāsyagataṃ yathā
ce_text: taṃ mocaya mahābāho pārṣataṃ śatrutāpanam / drauṇer āsyam anuprāptaṃ mṛtyor āsyagataṃ yathā

vulgate_text: dṛṣṭvā drauṇirmahārāja vāsudevadhanaṃjayau / dhṛṣṭadyumnavadhe rājaṃścakre yatnaṃ mahābalaḥ
ce_text: dṛṣṭvāyāntau mahāvīryāv ubhau kṛṣṇadhanaṃjayau / dhṛṣṭadyumnavadhe rājaṃś cakre yatnaṃ mahābalaḥ

vulgate_text: viddhastu taiḥ śarairghoraidroṇaputraḥ pratāpavān / utsṛjya samare rājanpāñcālamamitaujasam
ce_text: sa vidhvastaiḥ śarair ghorair droṇaputraḥ pratāpavān / ratham āruruhe vīro dhanaṃjayaśarārditaḥ / pragṛhya ca dhanuḥ śreṣṭhaṃ pārthaṃ vivyādha sāyakaiḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ karṇo mahārāja vyākṣipadvijayaṃ dhanuḥ dṛṣṭvārjunaṃ raṇe kruddhaḥ prekṣate ca muhurmuhuḥ / dvairathaṃ cāpi pārthena gantukāmo mahādyutiḥ
ce_text: tataḥ karṇo mahārāja vyākṣipad vijayaṃ dhanuḥ / arjunaṃ samare kruddhaḥ prekṣamāṇo muhur muhuḥ / dvairathaṃ cāpi pārthena kāmayāno mahāraṇe

vulgate_text: jyātalatradhanuḥśabdāñśastrāṇāṃ ca nipātyatām / tāḍitānāṃ ca patatā ninādāṃśca padātinām
ce_text: jyātalatradhanuḥśabdāḥ kuñjarāṇāṃ ca bṛṃhitam / tāḍitānāṃ ca patatāṃ ninādaḥ sumahān abhūt

vulgate_text: varma vā carma vā'śritya nipātamapi dehinaḥ / viṣehurnāsya saṃsparśaṃ dvitīyasya patattriṇaḥ
ce_text: carmavarmāṇi saṃchindya nirvāpam iva dehinām / viṣehur nāsya saṃparkaṃ dvitīyasya patatriṇaḥ

vulgate_text: varmayukteṣu deheṣu dhanuṣo'syañśitāñśarān / maurvyā talatre nyahanatkaśayā vājino yathā
ce_text: varmadehāsumathanair dhanuṣaḥ pracyutaiḥ śaraiḥ / maurvyā talatrair nyavadhīt kaśayā vājino yathā

vulgate_text: teṣu vyāyacchamāneṣu kurupāñcālapāṇḍuṣu / priyānasūnraṇe tyaktvā yodhā jaghnuḥ parasparam
ce_text: vyāyacchamānāḥ subhṛśaṃ kurupāṇḍavasṛñjayāḥ / priyān asūn raṇe tyaktvā yodhā jagmuḥ parasparam

vulgate_text: kṣurairbhallārdhacandraiśca cchinnāḥ peturmahītale / narāśvebharathānāṃ hinarāśvebharathaistathā
ce_text: dhvajāḥ śirāṃsi cchatrāṇi dvipahastā nṛṇāṃ bhujāḥ / kṣurair bhallārdhacandraiś ca chinnāḥ śastrāṇi tatyajuḥ

vulgate_text: pracchādyamānaṃ dviradairmeghairiva divākaram / paryayuḥ pāṇḍupāñcālā nadanto hyāttakārmukāḥ
ce_text: ekaikaṃ daśabhiḥ ṣaḍbhir aṣṭābhir api bhārata / dviradān abhivivyādha kṣiptair girinibhāñ śaraiḥ / pracchādyamāno dviradair meghair iva divākaraḥ

vulgate_text: tānnāgānabhivarṣanto jyātalatravinādinaḥ vīranṛtyaṃ pranṛtyantaḥ śūratālapracoditaiḥ / nakulaḥ sahadevaśca draupadeyāḥ prabhadrakāḥ
ce_text: paryāsuḥ pāṇḍupāñcālā nadanto niśitāyudhāḥ / tān nāgān abhivarṣanto jyātantrīśaranāditaiḥ

vulgate_text: sātyakiśca śikhaṇḍī ca cekitānaśca vīryavān / samantātsiṣicurvīrā meghāstoyairivācalān
ce_text: nakulaḥ sahadevaś ca draupadeyāḥ prabhadrakāḥ / sātyakiś ca śikhaṇḍī ca cekitānaś ca vīryavān

vulgate_text: teṣāṃ pravṛtte saṅgrāme vipule śoṇitodake / rarāja lohitenorvī saṃsiktā bahudhā bhṛśam
ce_text: tasmin pravṛtte saṃgrāme tumule śoṇitodake / saṃśaptakeṣu śūreṣu kiṃcicchiṣṭeṣu bhārata

vulgate_text: tato rajasi saṃśānte prakāśaḥ sarvato'bhavat etasminnantare pārthaṃ kṛṣṇo vacanamabravīt / darśayanniva kaunteyaṃ dharmarājaṃ yudhiṣṭhiram
ce_text: etasminn antare kṛṣṇaḥ pārthaṃ vacanam abravīt / darśayann iva kaunteyaṃ dharmarājaṃ yudhiṣṭhiram

vulgate_text: tamanvageva pāñcālāścedimātsyāśca bhārata / anuyānti mahātmānaṃ parīpsanto mahājavāḥ
ce_text: tathānuyānti saṃrabdhāḥ pāñcālā yuddhadurmadāḥ / yudhiṣṭhiraṃ mahātmānaṃ parīpsanto mahājavāḥ

vulgate_text: nadadbhiḥ siṃhanādāṃśca dhamadbhiścāpi vārijān / balavadbhirmaheṣvāsairvidhūnvānairdhanūṃṣi ca
ce_text: nadantaḥ siṃhanādāṃś ca dhamantaś cāpi vārijān / balavanto maheṣvāsā vidhunvanto dhanūṃṣi ca

vulgate_text: karṇena ca kṛto rājā vimukho'dya tu dṛśyate
ce_text: karṇena ca kṛto rājā vimukhaḥ śatrutāpanaḥ / balavāṃl laghuhastaś ca kṛtī yuddhaviśāradaḥ

vulgate_text: balavām̐llughuhastaśca kṛtī yuddhaviśāradaḥ rādheyaḥ pāṇḍavaśreṣṭhaṃ śaktaḥ pīḍayituṃ raṇe / sahito dhṛtarāṣṭrasya putraiḥ śūrairmahābalaiḥ
ce_text: rādheyaḥ pāṇḍavaśreṣṭhaṃ śaktaḥ pīḍayituṃ raṇe / sahito dhṛtarāṣṭrasya putraiḥ śūro mahātmabhiḥ

vulgate_text: ete naśyanti pāñcālā drāvyamāṇā mahātmanā / śakreṇeva yathā daityā drāvyamāṇā mahātmanā
ce_text: etān paśya ca pāñcālān drāvyamāṇān mahātmanā / śakreṇeva yathā daityān hanyamānān mahāhave

vulgate_text: eṣa karṇo dhanuḥśreṣṭhaṃ vidhūnvanbahuśobhate / śatruṃ jitvā yathā śakro devasaṅkhaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ
ce_text: paśya pārtha dhanuḥ śreṣṭhaṃ vikarṣan sādhu śobhate / śatrūñ jitvā yathā śakro devasaṃghaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ

vulgate_text: abhidravata bhadraṃ vo drutaṃ dravata kauravāḥ / yathā na jīvavānkaścinmucyeta yudhi sṛñjayaḥ
ce_text: abhidravata gacchadhvaṃ drutaṃ dravata kauravāḥ / yathā jīvan na vaḥ kaś cin mucyate yudhi sṛñjayaḥ

vulgate_text: paśya karṇaṃ raṇe pārtha śvetacchatravirājitam / udayaṃ parvataṃ yadvacchaśāṅkenābhiśobhitam
ce_text: paśya karṇaṃ raṇe pārtha śvetacchavivirājitam / udayaṃ parvataṃ yadvac chobhayan vai divākaraḥ

vulgate_text: asau nivṛtto rādheyo dṛṣṭvā te vānaradhvajam prārthayansamaraṃ pārtha tvayā saha parantapa / vadhāya hyātmano'bhyeti pāvakaṃ śalabho yathā
ce_text: asau nivṛtto rādheyo dṛśyate vānaradhvaja / vadhāya cātmano 'bhyeti dīpasya śalabho yathā

vulgate_text: karṇamekākinaṃ dṛṣṭvā dhārtarāṣṭro raṇājire / tvāṃ ca pārthābhisaṃrabdhaṃ karṇaṃ prati mahāratham
ce_text: karṇam ekākinaṃ dṛṣṭvā rathānīkena bhārata / rirakṣiṣuḥ susaṃyatto dhārtarāṣṭro 'bhivartate

vulgate_text: asau duryodhanaḥ kruddho rathānīkena bhārata / rirakṣiṣuḥ susaṃvṛtto dhārtarāṣṭro nivartate
ce_text: karṇam ekākinaṃ dṛṣṭvā rathānīkena bhārata / rirakṣiṣuḥ susaṃyatto dhārtarāṣṭro 'bhivartate

vulgate_text: ḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷ vīra balaṃ tāmabhivartate / dromaputraṃ puraskṛtya tacchīghraṃ sanniṣūdaya
ce_text: pañca nāgasahasrāṇi dviguṇā vājinas tathā / abhisaṃhatya kaunteya padātiprayutāni ca / anyonyarakṣitaṃ vīra balaṃ tvām abhivartate

vulgate_text: nikṛttyaitadrathānīkaṃ balinaṃ lokaviśrutam / sūtaputre maheṣvāse darśayātmānamātmanā
ce_text: sūtaputre maheṣvāse darśayātmānam ātmanā / uttamaṃ yatnam āsthāya pratyehi bharatarṣabha

vulgate_text: ācacakṣe priyaṃ pārtha tavedaṃ bharatarṣabha / rājāsau kuśalī śrīmāndharmaputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
ce_text: ācakṣe te priyaṃ pārtha tad evaṃ bharatarṣabha / rājā jīvati kauravyo dharmaputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ

vulgate_text: senā hi dhārtarāṣṭrasya vimukhā vyadravadraṇāt / vegena bhīmasenasya vihatā vividhaiḥ śaraiḥ
ce_text: senā hi dhārtarāṣṭrasya vimukhā cābhavad raṇāt / vipradhāvati vegena bhīmasya nihatā śaraiḥ

vulgate_text: ete nardinti pāñcālā dhmāpayanti ca vārijān / abhidravanti ca raṇe mṛdrantaḥ sāyakaiḥ parān
ce_text: ete nadanti pāñcālā dhamanty api ca vārijān / abhidravanti ca raṇe nighnantaḥ sāyakaiḥ parān

vulgate_text: paśya svargasya māhātmyaṃ pāñcālā hi parākramāt / dhārtarāṣṭrānvinighnanto viśantyete rathottamān
ce_text: paśya svargasya māhātmyaṃ pāñcālā hi paraṃtapa / dhārtarāṣṭrān vinighnanti kruddhāḥ siṃhā iva dvipān

vulgate_text: sarvataścābhipannaiṣā dhārtarāṣṭrī mahācamūḥ / tyaktvā prāṇānmaheṣvāsaiḥ pāñcālaiḥ paripātyate
ce_text: sarvataś cābhipannaiṣā dhārtarāṣṭrī mahācamūḥ / pāñcālair mānasād etya haṃsair gaṅgeva vegitaiḥ

vulgate_text: suhṛdaśca parākrāntāḥ kṛpakarṇādayo vibho / nivāraṇe maheṣvāsāḥ pāñcālānāṃ parantapa
ce_text: subhṛśaṃ ca parākrāntāḥ pāñcālānāṃ nivāraṇe / kṛpakarṇādayo vīrā ṛṣabhāṇām ivarṣabhāḥ

vulgate_text: anivṛttāṃśca bhītāṃstāndhārtarāṣṭrānparantapa / dhṛṣṭadyumnamukhā vīrā ghnanti śatrūnsahasraśaḥ
ce_text: sunimagnāṃś ca bhīmāstrair dhārtarāṣṭrān mahārathān / dhṛṣṭadyumnamukhā vīrā ghnanti śatrūn sahasraśaḥ / viṣaṇṇabhūyiṣṭharathā dhārtarāṣṭrī mahācamūḥ

vulgate_text: rathāśca vividhāḥ sarve nivṛtte bharatarṣabhe / vivarṇamukhabhūyiṣṭhā dhārtarāṣṭrī mahācamūḥ
ce_text: sunimagnāṃś ca bhīmāstrair dhārtarāṣṭrān mahārathān / dhṛṣṭadyumnamukhā vīrā ghnanti śatrūn sahasraśaḥ / viṣaṇṇabhūyiṣṭharathā dhārtarāṣṭrī mahācamūḥ

vulgate_text: abhijānāmi bhīmasya siṃhanādaṃ punaḥpunaḥ / nadataḥ pāṇḍaveyasya saṅgrāme jitakāśinaḥ
ce_text: nābhijānāsi bhīmasya siṃhanādaṃ durutsaham / nadato 'rjuna saṃgrāme vīrasya jitakāśinaḥ

vulgate_text: tasya caiva bhujau chinnau bhīmasenena garjataḥ / nāgaśca krakaraprakhyairnārācairdaśabhirhataḥ
ce_text: satomarāv asya bhujau chinnau bhīmena garjataḥ / tīkṣṇair agniśikhāprakhyair nārācair daśabhir hataḥ

vulgate_text: hantaite punarāyānti nāgā hyanye prahāriṇaḥ / nīlāñjanacayaprakhyā mahāmātrairadhiṣṭhitāḥ
ce_text: hatvainaṃ punar āyāti nāgān anyān prahāriṇaḥ / paśya nīlāmbudanibhān mahāmātrair adhiṣṭhitān / śaktitomarasaṃkāśair vinighnantaṃ vṛkodaram

vulgate_text: śaktitomarasaṅghatairvinighnanto vṛkodaram saptasapta ca nāgasthā vaijayantyaśca sadhvajāḥ / navatyā niśitairbāṇaiśchinnāḥ pārthāgrajena te
ce_text: sapta sapta ca nāgāṃs tān vaijayantīś ca sadhvajāḥ / nihatya niśitair bāṇaiś chinnāḥ pārthāgrajena te / daśabhir daśabhiś caiko nārācair nihato gajaḥ

vulgate_text: etacchrutvā mahābāhurvāsudevāddhanañjayaḥ bhīmasenena tatkarma kṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā suduṣkaram / arjuno vyadhamacchiṣṭānsaṃśaptakagaṇānbahūn
ce_text: bhīmasenena tat karma kṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā suduṣkaram / arjuno vyadhamac chiṣṭān ahitān niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ

vulgate_text: dravamāṇe balaughe ca nirākrande muhurmuhuḥ / avaśeṣaṃ na paśyāmi mama sainyeṣu sañjaya
ce_text: dravamāṇe balaughe ca nirākrande muhur muhuḥ / kim akurvanta kuravas tan mamācakṣva saṃjaya

vulgate_text: nakulaṃ tu tataḥ śūro vṛṣaseno hasanniva / nārācena sutīkṣṇena vivyādha hṛdaye bhṛśam
ce_text: nakulas tu tataḥ kruddho vṛṣasenaṃ smayann iva / nārācena sutīkṣṇena vivyādha hṛdaye dṛḍham

vulgate_text: etasminnantare yuddhaṃ kaṣṭamāsīdviśāmpate / nivṛtte tu tataḥ sainye nakulaḥ kauravānyayau
ce_text: dṛṣṭvā tu pradrutāṃ senāṃ dhārtarāṣṭrasya sūtajaḥ / nivārayām āsa balād anupatya viśāṃ pate / nivṛtte tu tataḥ karṇe nakulaḥ kauravān yayau

vulgate_text: ulūkastu raṇe kruddhaḥ sahadevena māriṣa / nivāritaḥ śaraśataiḥ kruddhena raṇamūrdhani
ce_text: ulūkas tu raṇe kruddhaḥ sahadevena vāritaḥ / tasyāśvāṃś caturo hatvā sahadevaḥ pratāpavān / sārathiṃ preṣayām āsa yamasya sadanaṃ prati

vulgate_text: tato'rjuno rathānsarvānhatvā tasya padānugān cakāra samare bhūmiṃ śoṇitaughapariplutām / [sarbalokavahāṃ raudrāṃ paralokavahāṃ nadīm]
ce_text: tato 'rjuno hayān hatvā sarvāṃs tasya mahātmanaḥ / cakāra samare bhūmiṃ śoṇitaughataraṅgiṇīm

vulgate_text: pārthena samare rājankṛto ghoro janakṣayaḥ nihatā rathinaḥ petuḥ pārthacāpacyutaiḥ śaraiḥ ]
ce_text: nihatā rathinaḥ petuḥ pārthacāpacyutaiḥ śaraiḥ / hayāś ca paryadhāvanta muktayoktrās tatas tataḥ

vulgate_text: vakṣodeśe bhṛśaṃ pārthaṃ tāḍayāmāsa nirdayam / so'tividdho raṇe tena droṇaputreṇa bhārata
ce_text: so 'tividdho raṇe tena droṇaputreṇa bhārata / ādatta parighaṃ ghoraṃ drauṇeś cainam avākṣipat

vulgate_text: tamāpantataṃ parighaṃ jāmbūnadapariṣkṛtam / ciccheda sahasā rājanprahasanniva pāṇḍavaḥ
ce_text: tam āpatantaṃ parighaṃ kārtasvaravibhūṣitam / drauṇiś ciccheda sahasā tata uccukruśur janāḥ

vulgate_text: sa papāta tadā bhūmau nikṛttaḥ pārthasāyakaiḥ / vikīrṇaḥ parvato rājanyathā vajreṇa tāḍitaḥ
ce_text: so 'nekadhāpatad bhūmau bhāradvājasya sāyakaiḥ / viśīrṇaḥ parvato rājan yathā syān mātariśvanā

vulgate_text: tataḥ kruddho mahārāja droṇaputro mahārathaḥ / aindreṇa cāstravegena bībhatsuṃ samavākirat
ce_text: tataḥ kruddho mahārāja droṇaputraḥ pratāpavān / arjunaṃ vāsudevaṃ ca chādayām āsa patribhiḥ

vulgate_text: sa viddhvā marmasu drauṇiṃ pāṇḍavaḥ paravīrahā / sārathiṃ cāsya bhallena rathanīḍādapātayat
ce_text: tato 'rjuno raṇe drauṇiṃ vivyādha daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ / sārathiṃ cāsya bhallena rathanīḍād apāharat

vulgate_text: tadā prahasya bībhasturdroṇaputrasya saṃyuge / kṣipraṃ raśmīnathāśvānāṃ kṣurapraiścicchide jayaḥ
ce_text: yadā tv agrasyata raṇe droṇaputreṇa phalgunaḥ / tato raśmīn rathāśvānāṃ kṣurapraiś cicchide jayaḥ

vulgate_text: tāvakī caturaṅgaiṣā pāṇḍavaistu mahācamūḥ / punaḥpunaratho vīraiḥ prabhagnā jitakāśibhiḥ
ce_text: pāṇḍavais tu mahārāja dhārtarāṣṭrī mahācamūḥ / punaḥ punar atho vīrair abhajyata jayoddhataiḥ

vulgate_text: vāhayāśvānnaravyāghra madrādhipa na saṃśayaḥ / evamuktvā mahārāja sūtaputraḥ pratāpavān
ce_text: evam uktvā mahārāja sūtaputraḥ pratāpavān / pragṛhya vijayaṃ vīro dhanuḥśreṣṭhaṃ purātanam / sajyaṃ kṛtvā mahārāja saṃmṛjya ca punaḥ punaḥ

vulgate_text: dhāvatāṃ ca tato rājaṃstrastānāṃ ca samantataḥ / ārtanādo babhūvātra bhūtānāmiva sampluve
ce_text: teṣāṃ tu krośatāṃ śrutvā bhītānāṃ raṇamūrdhani / dhāvatāṃ ca diśo rājan vitrastānāṃ samantataḥ / ārtanādo mahāṃs tatra pretānām iva saṃplave

vulgate_text: abhīkṣṇaṃ codayannaśvānprekṣate māṃ muhurmuhuḥ / naca śakṣyāmi karṇasya saṃyuge'haṃ palāyitum
ce_text: sutīkṣṇaṃ codayann aśvān prekṣate māṃ muhur muhuḥ / na ca paśyāmi samare karṇasya prapalāyitam

vulgate_text: rājānaṃ prati vārṣṇeya dūyate me dṛḍhaṃ manaḥ codayāśvānhṛṣīkeśa vihāyaitadbalārṇavam / ajātaśatruṃ rājānaṃ draṣṭumicchāmi keśava
ce_text: codayāśvān hṛṣīkeśa vigāhyaitaṃ rathārṇavam / ajātaśatruṃ rājānaṃ draṣṭum icchāmi keśava

vulgate_text: taṃ dṛṣṭvā puruṣavyāghraṃ kṣemiṇaṃ puruṣarṣabham / mudābhyanandatāṃ kṛṣṇāvaśvināviva vāsavam
ce_text: tau dṛṣṭvā puruṣavyāghrau kṣemiṇau puruṣarṣabha / mudābhyupagatau kṛṣṇāv aśvināv iva vāsavam

vulgate_text: manyamāno hataṃ karṇaṃ prītaḥ parapurañjayaḥ sa bhūtvā puruṣavyāghro rājā tatra yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / harṣagadgadayā vācā prītaḥ prāha parantapaḥ
ce_text: manyamāno hataṃ karṇaṃ dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / harṣagadgadayā vācā prītaḥ prāha paraṃtapau

vulgate_text: ariṣṭayorakṣatayoḥ karṇaṃ hatvā mahāratham / āśīvipasamaṃ yuddhe sarvaśastraviśāradam
ce_text: akṣatābhyām ariṣṭābhyāṃ kathaṃ yudhya mahāratham / āśīviṣasamaṃ yuddhe sarvaśastraviśāradam

vulgate_text: anujñātaṃ mahāvīryaṃ rāmeṇāstre sudurjayam / agryaṃ sarvasya lokasya rathinaṃ lokaviśrutam
ce_text: anujñātaṃ mahāvīryaṃ rameṇāstreṣu durjayam / trātāraṃ dhārtarāṣṭrāṇāṃ gantāraṃ vāhinīmukhe

vulgate_text: tena yuddhamabhītena mayā'dyāpyacyutārjunau kṛtaṃ ghoraṃ mahābāhū dhṛṣṭadyumnasya paśyataḥ / antakeneva kruddhena prajāḥ sarvā jighāṃsatā
ce_text: tena yuddham adīnena mayā hy adyācyutārjunau / kupitenāntakeneva prajāḥ sarvā jighāṃsatā

vulgate_text: ko nu me jīvitenārtho rājyenārtho bhavetpunaḥ / mamaivaṃ vikṣatasyādya karṇenāhavaśobhinā
ce_text: ko nu me jīvitenārtho rājyenārtho 'tha vā punaḥ / mamaivaṃ dhikkṛtasyeha karṇenāhavaśobhinā

vulgate_text: sarvā diśaḥ paryapatattvadarthaṃ tvāṃ sūtaputraḥ samare parīpsan / ditsannṛṇāṃ śakaṭaṃ ratnapūrṇaṃ kathaṃ tvayāsau nihato'dya karṇaḥ
ce_text: yaḥ paryupāsīt pradiśo diśaś ca tvāṃ sūtaputraḥ samare parīpsan / ditsuḥ karṇaḥ samare hastipūgaṃ sa hīdānīṃ kaṅkapatraiḥ sutīkṣṇaiḥ

vulgate_text: yo'sau sadā ślāghate rājamadhye duryodhanaṃ harṣayandarpayuktaḥ / hantā'smi sarvāniti pāṇḍuputrā-- nahaṃ hantā phalgunasyeti mohāt
ce_text: yo 'sau sadā ślāghate rājamadhye duryodhanaṃ harṣayan darpapūrṇaḥ / ahaṃ hantā phalgunasyeti mohāt kaccid dhatas tasya na vai tathā rathaḥ

vulgate_text: savyena vā yadi vā dakṣiṇena na jñāyate katareṇāsyatīti / ācāryavatsamare paryavarta-- nmahaccitraṃ darśayansarvataḥ sma
ce_text: naivādadānaṃ na ca saṃdadhānaṃ jānīmahe katareṇāsyatīti / vāmena vā yadi vā dakṣiṇena sa droṇaputraḥ samare paryavartat

vulgate_text: āvidhyanmāṃ pañcabhidroṇaputraḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ pañcabhirvāsudevam / abhyaghnaṃ bāṇaistamahaṃ sudhārai-- rnimeṣamātreṇa suvarṇapuṅkhaiḥ
ce_text: avidhyan māṃ pañcabhir droṇaputraḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ pañcabhir vāsudevam / ahaṃ tu taṃ triṃśatā vajrakalpaiḥ samārdayaṃ nimiṣasyāntareṇa

vulgate_text: sa nirviddho viratho droṇaputro rathānīkaṃ cādhiratherviveśa / mayābhibhūtānsvarathaprabarhā-- nastraṃ ca paśyanrudhirapradigdham
ce_text: sa vikṣaran rudhiraṃ sarvagātrai rathānīkaṃ sūtasūnor viveśa / mayābhibhūtaḥ sainikānāṃ prabarhān asāv apaśyan rudhireṇa pradigdhān

vulgate_text: mṛtyorāsyaṃ vyāttamivābhipadya prabhadrakāḥ karṇamāsādya sarve / yāsyāmi tāṃstārayiṣyanbalaughā-- ddiṣṭyā bhavānsvastimānpārtha dṛṣṭaḥ
ce_text: mahājhaṣasyeva mukhaṃ prapannāḥ prabhadrakāḥ karṇam abhi dravanti / mṛtyor āsyaṃ vyāttam ivānvapadyan prabhadrakāḥ karṇam āsādya rājan

vulgate_text: atha pravīreṇa mahānubhāva dviṣatsainyaṃ nirdahanvistareṇa / sametyāhaṃ sūtaputreṇa saṅkhye / vajrīva vṛtreṇa narendramukhya
ce_text: sametyāhaṃ sūtaputreṇa saṃkhye vṛtreṇa vajrīva narendramukhya / yotsye bhṛśaṃ bhārata sūtaputram asmin saṃgrāme yadi vai dṛśyate 'dya

vulgate_text: vaikartanaṃ kuśalinaṃ niśamya kruddhaḥ pārthaḥ phalgūnasyāmitaujāḥ / dhanañjayaṃ vākyamuvāca rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ karṇaśarābhitaptaḥ
ce_text: śrutvā karṇaṃ kalyam udāravīryaṃ kruddhaḥ pārthaḥ phalgunasyāmitaujāḥ / dhanaṃjayaṃ vākyam uvāca cedaṃ yudhiṣṭhiraḥ karṇaśarābhitaptaḥ

vulgate_text: ityevamuktvā bībhatsuṃ roṣātsaṃraktalocanaḥ / abravītpunarevātra dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
ce_text: ity evam uktvā punar āha pārtho yudhiṣṭhiraṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ variṣṭham / apy aputrā tena rādhā bhavitrī kuntī mayā vā tad ṛtaṃ viddhi rājan / prasīda rājan kṣama yan mayoktaṃ kāle bhavān vetsyati tan namas te

vulgate_text: idaṃ yadi dvaitavane tu sūktaṃ karṇaṃ niyoddhuṃ na sahe nṛpeti / vayaṃ tataḥ prāptakālaṃ yathāva-- tkṛtvā'bhyupekṣāma tathaiva rājyam
ce_text: idaṃ yadi dvaitavane hy avakṣyaḥ karṇaṃ yoddhuṃ na prasahe nṛpeti / vayaṃ tadā prāptakālāni sarve vṛttāny upaiṣyāma tadaiva pārtha

vulgate_text: yattadvṛthā vāguvācāntarikṣe saptāhni jāte tvayi mandabuddhau / apāpīyānvāsavātkuntijāto bahūnsaṅgrāmānayameva jetā
ce_text: yat tat pṛthāṃ vāg uvācāntarikṣe saptāhajāte tvayi mandabuddhau / jātaḥ putro vāsavavikramo 'yaṃ sarvāñ śūrāñ śātravāñ jeṣyatīti

vulgate_text: ayaṃ jetā pāṇḍavo devasaṅghān sarvāṇi bhūtānyapi cottamaujāḥ / ayaṃ jetā madrakaliṅgajātā-- ndaityāṃśca rakṣāṃsi samāgatāni
ce_text: ayaṃ jetā khāṇḍave devasaṃghān sarvāṇi bhūtāny api cottamaujāḥ / ayaṃ jetā madrakaliṅgakekayān ayaṃ kurūn hanti ca rājamadhye

vulgate_text: khaṅgaṃ vibhrajjātarūpatsaruṃ ca dhanurvedaṃ gāṇḍivaṃ tālamātram / sa keśavenohyamānaḥ kathaṃ nu karṇātpārthastvamapaituṃ samaiṣīḥ
ce_text: tvaṣṭrā kṛtaṃ vāham akūjanākṣaṃ śubhaṃ samāsthāya kapidhvajaṃ tvam / khaḍgaṃ gṛhītvā hemacitraṃ samiddhaṃ dhanuś cedaṃ gāṇḍivaṃ tālamātram / sa keśavenohyamānaḥ kathaṃ nu karṇād bhīto vyapayāto 'si pārtha

vulgate_text: sa gāṇḍīvaṃ keśavāya pradāya yantā bhavestvaṃ yadi keśavasya / tatastaretkeśavaḥ karṇamugraṃ marutsasvo vṛtramivāttavajraḥ
ce_text: dhanuś caitat keśavāya pradāya yantābhaviṣyas tvaṃ raṇe ced durātman / tato 'haniṣyat keśavaḥ karṇam ugraṃ marutpatir vṛtram ivāttavajraḥ

vulgate_text: māse'patiṣyo yadi pañcame tvaṃ na vā garbho yadyabhavaḥ pṛthāyāḥ / mattaḥ śreyānrājaputro'bhaviṣya-- nna te yaśaḥ phalguna ityapeyāt
ce_text: māse 'patiṣyaḥ pañcame tvaṃ prakṛcchre na vā garbho 'py abhaviṣyaḥ pṛthāyāḥ / tat te śramo rājaputrābhaviṣyan na saṃgrāmād apayātuṃ durātman

vulgate_text: tasya kopaṃ samājñāya cittajñaḥ keśavastadā / uvāca kimidaṃ khaṅgaṃ gṛhṇāsyarjuna śaṃma me
ce_text: tasya kopaṃ samudvīkṣya cittajñaḥ keśavas tadā / uvāca kim idaṃ pārtha gṛhītaḥ khaḍga ity uta

vulgate_text: na taṃ paśyāmi kaunteya yaste vadhyo bhavediha / prahartumicchase kasmātkiṃ vā te cittavibhramaḥ
ce_text: na taṃ paśyāmi kaunteya yas te vadhyo bhaved iha / kasmād bhavān mahākhaḍgaṃ parigṛhṇāti satvaram

vulgate_text: anyasmai dehi gāṇḍīvamiti māṃ yaḥ pracodayet bhindyāmahaṃ tasya śira ityupāṃśu vrataṃ mama / yudhiṣṭhireṇa tenāhamuktaścāsmi janārdana
ce_text: dada gāṇḍīvam anyasmā iti māṃ yo 'bhicodayet / chindyām ahaṃ śiras tasya ity upāṃśuvrataṃ mama

vulgate_text: yadukto'hamadīnārthaṃ rājñā'nena yaśasvinā / samakṣaṃ tava govinda na tatkṣantumihotsahe
ce_text: tad ukto 'ham adīnātman rājñāmitaparākrama / samakṣaṃ tava govinda na tat kṣantum ihotsahe

vulgate_text: jātastvatto hi dharmaścādharmaśceti parā śrutiḥ / tattathā prakariṣyāmi yathā māṃ vakṣyate bhavān
ce_text: kiṃ vā tvaṃ manyase prāptam asmin kāle samutthite / tvam asya jagatas tāta vettha sarvaṃ gatāgatam / tat tathā prakariṣyāmi yathā māṃ vakṣyate bhavān

vulgate_text: na hi dharmavigajñairevaṃ kāryaṃ dhanañjaya / yathā tvaṃ pāṇḍavādyeha dharmabhīruraṇḍitaḥ
ce_text: idānīṃ pārtha jānāmi na vṛddhāḥ sevitās tvayā / akāle puruṣavyāghra saṃrambhakriyayānayā / na hi dharmavibhāgajñaḥ kuryād evaṃ dhanaṃjaya

vulgate_text: yo'kāryāṇāṃ kriyāyāśca saṃyogaṃ nāvabudhyate / kāryāṇāmakriyāyāśca sa pārtha puruṣādhamaḥ
ce_text: akāryāṇāṃ ca kāryāṇāṃ saṃyogaṃ yaḥ karoti vai / kāryāṇām akriyāṇāṃ ca sa pārtha puruṣādhamaḥ

vulgate_text: prāṇināṃ hi vadhāttāta vṛthā dharmo mato mama / anṛtaṃ tu bhavedvācyaṃ na tu hiṃsā kadācana
ce_text: prāṇinām avadhas tāta sarvajyāyān mato mama / anṛtaṃ tu bhaved vācyaṃ na ca hiṃsyāt kathaṃ cana

vulgate_text: ayudhyamānasya gurostathā'śatrośca mānada / parāṅmukhasya dravataḥ śaraṇaṃ cāpi gacchataḥ
ce_text: ayudhyamānasya vadhas tathāśastrasya bhārata / parāṅmukhasya dravataḥ śaraṇaṃ vābhigacchataḥ / kṛtāñjaleḥ prapannasya na vadhaḥ pūjyate budhaiḥ

vulgate_text: kṛtāñjaleḥ prapannasya pramattasya tathaiva ca / na vadhaḥ pūjyate sadbhistacca sarvaṃ gurau tava
ce_text: ayudhyamānasya vadhas tathāśastrasya bhārata / parāṅmukhasya dravataḥ śaraṇaṃ vābhigacchataḥ / kṛtāñjaleḥ prapannasya na vadhaḥ pūjyate budhaiḥ

vulgate_text: svaguruṃ pārtha kasmāttvaṃ hantukāmo'bhidhāvasi / asampradhārya dharmāṇāṃ gatiṃ sūkṣmāṃ duratyayām
ce_text: sa guruṃ pārtha kasmāt tvaṃ hanyā dharmam anusmaran / asaṃpradhārya dharmāṇāṃ gatiṃ sūkṣmāṃ duranvayām

vulgate_text: viduro vā punaḥ kṣattā gāndhārī vā yaśasvinī kuntī vā bharataśreṣṭha draupadī vā yaśasvinī / tatte vakṣyāmi tattvena nibodhaitaddhanañjaya
ce_text: viduro vā tathā kṣattā kuntī vāpi yaśasvinī / tat te vakṣyāmi tattvena tan nibodha dhanaṃjaya

vulgate_text: satyasyaṃ vacanaṃ sādhu na satyādvidyate param / sudurvidaṃ hi tattvena tatsatyamiti me satiḥ
ce_text: satyasya vacanaṃ sādhu na satyād vidyate param / tattvenaitat sudurjñeyaṃ yasya satyam anuṣṭhitam

vulgate_text: sa kadācinmṛgaprepsurnānvavindanmṛgaṃ kvacit / athāpaśyatsa pīvānaṃ śvāpadaṃ ghrāṇacakṣuṣam
ce_text: sa kadā cin mṛgāṃl lipsur nānvavindat prayatnavān / athāpaśyat sa pītodaṃ śvāpadaṃ ghrāṇacakṣuṣam

vulgate_text: atha dasyubhayātkecittadā tadvanamāviśan / tatrāpi dasyavaḥ kruddhāstānamārganta yatnataḥ
ce_text: atha dasyubhayāt ke cit tadā tad vanam āviśan / dasyavo 'pi gatāḥ krūrā vyamārganta prayatnataḥ

vulgate_text: gataḥ sukaṣṭaṃ nirayaṃ dharmasūkṣmeṣvatattvavit / dṛṣṭapūrvaśruto mūḍho dharmāṇāmaviśāradaḥ
ce_text: tenādharmeṇa mahatā vāgduruktena kauśikaḥ / gataḥ sukaṣṭaṃ narakaṃ sūkṣmadharmeṣv akovidaḥ / aprabhūtaśruto mūḍho dharmāṇām avibhāgavit

vulgate_text: tatra te lakṣaṇoddeśaḥ kaścideva bhaviṣyati / duṣkaraṃ pratisaṃkhyānaṃ kārtsnyenātra vyavasthitiḥ
ce_text: vṛddhān apṛṣṭvā saṃdehaṃ mahac chvabhram ito 'rhati / tatra te lakṣaṇoddeśaḥ kaś cid eva bhaviṣyati

vulgate_text: satyaṃ dharma iti hyeke vadanti bahavo janāḥ / na ca pārthābhyasūyāmi naitatsarvatra śiṣyate
ce_text: duṣkaraṃ paramajñānaṃ tarkeṇātra vyavasyati / śrutir dharma iti hy eke vadanti bahavo janāḥ

vulgate_text: yatsyādahiṃsāsaṃyuktaṃ sa dharma iti niścayaḥ ahiṃsārthāya hiṃsrāṇāṃ dharmapravacanaṃ kṛtam / dhāraṇāddharmamityāhurdharmo dhārayate prajāḥ
ce_text: dhāraṇād dharmam ity āhur dharmo dhārayati prajāḥ / yaḥ syād dhāraṇasaṃyuktaḥ sa dharma iti niścayaḥ

vulgate_text: ye'nyāyena jigīṣanto dharmaṃ pṛcchanti mānavāḥ / akūjanena cenmokṣo nātra kūjetkathañcana
ce_text: ye 'nyāyena jihīrṣanto janā icchanti karhi cit / akūjanena cen mokṣo nātra kūjet kathaṃ cana

vulgate_text: avaśyaṃ kūjitavye ha śaṅkeranvāpyakūjanāt ye'nyāyena jihīrṣanto dharmaṃ pṛcchanti kasyacit / śreyastatrānṛtaṃ vaktuṃ satyāditi viniścitm
ce_text: avaśyaṃ kūjitavyaṃ vā śaṅkeran vāpy akūjataḥ / śreyas tatrānṛtaṃ vaktuṃ satyād iti vicāritam

vulgate_text: suhṛdbrūyādyathā'smākaṃ tathoktaṃ vacanaṃ tvayā bhavānmātṛsamo'smākaṃ bhavānpitṛsamo'pi ca / gatiśca paramā kṛṣṇa tvameva ca parāyaṇam
ce_text: bhavān mātṛsamo 'smākaṃ tathā pitṛsamo 'pi ca / gatiś ca paramā kṛṣṇa tena te vākyam adbhutam

vulgate_text: taṃ hanyāṃ cetkeśava jīvaloke sthātā nāhaṃ kālamapyalpamātram / dhyātvā nūnaṃ hyenasā cāpi mukto vadhaṃ rājño bhraṣṭavīryo vicetāḥ
ce_text: taṃ hatvā cet keśava jīvaloke sthātā kālaṃ nāham apy alpamātram / sā ca pratijñā mama lokaprabuddhā bhavet satyā dharmabhṛtāṃ variṣṭha / yathā jīvet pāṇḍavo 'haṃ ca kṛṣṇa tathā buddhiṃ dātum adyārhasi tvam

vulgate_text: rājā śrānto vikṣato duḥkhitaśca karṇena sahkhye niśitairbāṇasaṅghaiḥ / yaścāniśaṃ sūtaputreṇa vīra śarairbhṛśaṃ tāḍito yudhyamānaḥ
ce_text: rājā śrānto jagato vikṣataś ca karṇena saṃkhye niśitair bāṇasaṃghaiḥ / tasmāt pārtha tvāṃ paruṣāṇy avocat karṇe dyūtaṃ hy adya raṇe nibaddham

vulgate_text: nityodyukte satataṃ cāprasahye karṇe dyūtaṃ hyadya raṇe nibaddham / tasminhate kuravo nirjitāḥ syu-- revaṃ buddhiḥ pārthive dharmaputre
ce_text: tasmin hate kuravo nirjitāḥ syur evaṃbuddhiḥ pārthivo dharmaputraḥ / yadāvamānaṃ labhate mahāntaṃ tadā jīvan mṛta ity ucyate saḥ

vulgate_text: yadā mānaṃ labhate mānanārha-- stadā sa vai jīvati jīvaloke / yadā'vamānaṃ labhate mahāntaṃ tadā jīvanmṛta ityucyate saḥ
ce_text: tasmin hate kuravo nirjitāḥ syur evaṃbuddhiḥ pārthivo dharmaputraḥ / yadāvamānaṃ labhate mahāntaṃ tadā jīvan mṛta ity ucyate saḥ

vulgate_text: yadā hyaṃ pāṇḍava dharmarāja-- satvatto'yuktaṃ lapsyate caiva sādhu / tato'sya pādāvabhivādya paścā-- cchreyo brūyātsāntvayuktaṃ hitaṃ ca
ce_text: vadho hy ayaṃ pāṇḍava dharmarājñas tvatto yukto vetsyate caivam eṣaḥ / tato 'sya pādāv abhivādya paścāc chamaṃ brūyāḥ sāntvapūrvaṃ ca pārtham

vulgate_text: bhrātā prājñastava kopaṃ na jātu kuryādrājā dharmamārgānusārī / mukto'nṛtādvātṛvadhācca pāpā-- ddhṛṣṭaḥ karṇaṃ tvaṃ jahi pārtha paścāt
ce_text: bhrātā prājñas tava kopaṃ na jātu kuryād rājā kaṃ cana pāṇḍaveyaḥ / mukto 'nṛtād bhrātṛvadhāc ca pārtha hṛṣṭaḥ karṇaṃ tvaṃ jahi sūtaputram

vulgate_text: mā tvaṃ rājanvyāharasvādya pāpaṃ tvaṃ tiṣṭhasi krośamātre vyapetya / bhīmastu māmarhati garhaṇāya yo yudhyate sarvalokapravīraiḥ
ce_text: mā tvaṃ rājan vyāhara vyāharatsu na tiṣṭhase krośamātre raṇārdhe / bhīmas tu mām arhati garhaṇāya yo yudhyate sarvayodhapravīraḥ

vulgate_text: sa kuñjarāṇāmadhikaṃ sahasraṃ hatvā nadaṃstumulaṃ siṃhanādam / kāmbhojavānāyujapārvatīyā-- nīhāmṛgābhānvinihatya vājinaḥ
ce_text: kāle hi śatrūn pratipīḍya saṃkhye hatvā ca śūrān pṛthivīpatīṃs tān / yaḥ kuñjarāṇām adhikaṃ sahasraṃ hatvānadat tumulaṃ siṃhanādam

vulgate_text: mahārathāndaviradāñśailakalpā-- nsaheta yaḥ kuñjarānvadhyamānān / asau bhīmo dhārtarāṣṭreṣu magnaḥ sa māmupālabdhumarindamo'rhati
ce_text: mahārathān nāgavarān hayāṃś ca padātimukhyān api ca pramathya / eko bhīmo dhārtarāṣṭreṣu magnaḥ sa mām upālabdhum ariṃdamo 'rhati

vulgate_text: saṃyuktamāsthāya rathaṃ hi kāle dhanurvidhūnvañcharapūrṇamuṣṭiḥ / sṛjecca yo bāṇasaṅghānpareṣu mahābalo megha ivāmbudhārāḥ
ce_text: suyuktam āsthāya rathaṃ hi kāle dhanur vikarṣañ śarapūrṇamuṣṭiḥ / sṛjaty asau śaravarṣāṇi vīro mahāhave megha ivāmbudhārāḥ

vulgate_text: balaṃ na vādhiṣṭhitaṃ sattamānāṃ yatkṣatriyāṇāṃ bahulaṃ vadanti / tvaṃ cābalo bhārata niṣṭhuro'si tvameva māṃ vetsi yathāvidho'ham
ce_text: balaṃ tu vāci dvijasattamānāṃ kṣātraṃ budhā bāhubalaṃ vadanti / tvaṃ vāgbalo bhārata niṣṭhuraś ca tvam eva māṃ vetsi yathāvidho 'ham

vulgate_text: svayaṃ hyaśaktena narendra yuddhe nareṇa kāryā satataṃ kṣamaiva / balaṃ hi vāci dvijasattamānāṃ kṣātraṃ dvijā bāhubalaṃ vadanti
ce_text: balaṃ tu vāci dvijasattamānāṃ kṣātraṃ budhā bāhubalaṃ vadanti / tvaṃ vāgbalo bhārata niṣṭhuraś ca tvam eva māṃ vetsi yathāvidho 'ham

vulgate_text: na yucyate vai divi ceha yaḥ pumā-- nyaste madanyo'priyamārabheta / na cābhinandāmi tathāhi rājyaṃ yatastvamakṣeṣu dṛḍhaṃ prasaktaḥ
ce_text: na cābhinandāmi tavādhirājyaṃ yatas tvam akṣeṣv ahitāya saktaḥ / svayaṃ kṛtvā pāpam anāryajuṣṭam ebhir yuddhe tartum icchasy arīṃs tu

vulgate_text: svayaṃ kṛtaṃ pāpamanāryajuṣṭa-- masmābhirājau vyasanaṃ titīrṣasi / akṣeṣu doṣā bahavo vidharmyāḥ śrutāstvayā sahadevo'bravīdyān
ce_text: akṣeṣu doṣā bahavo vidharmāḥ śrutās tvayā sahadevo 'bravīd yān / tān naiṣi saṃtartum asādhujuṣṭān yena sma sarve nirayaṃ prapannāḥ

vulgate_text: tānnecchasi tyaktumanāryajuṣṭā-- nghore sma sarve niraye tvayā'stāḥ / tvaṃ devitā tvatkṛte rājyanāśaṃ-- stvatsambhavaṃ vyasanaṃ no narendra
ce_text: tvaṃ devitā tvatkṛte rājyanāśas tvat saṃbhavaṃ vyasanaṃ no narendra / māsmān krūrair vākpratodais tuda tvaṃ bhūyo rājan kopayann alpabhāgyān

vulgate_text: etā vācaḥ paruṣāḥ savyasācī sthirapratijñaḥ śrāvayitvā narendram / viniḥ śvasañjyeṣṭhamaniṣṭamuktvā tatastu kośādasimudvabarha
ce_text: etā vācaḥ paruṣāḥ savyasācī sthiraprajñaṃ śrāvayitvā tatakṣa / tadānutepe surarājaputro viniḥśvasaṃś cāpy asim udbabarha

vulgate_text: tathā tu kṛṣṇasya vaco niśamya tato'rjunaḥ prāha dhanuḥ pragṛhya / yudhiṣṭhiraṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ variṣṭhaṃ śṛṇuṣva rājanniti durvacaḥ svayam
ce_text: tathāstu kṛṣṇety abhinandya vākyaṃ dhanaṃjayaḥ prāha dhanur vināmya / yudhiṣṭhiraṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ variṣṭhaṃ śṛṇuṣva rājann iti śakrasūnuḥ

vulgate_text: pāṇī pṛṣatkālikhitāvimau puna-- rdhanuśca savye vitataṃ sabāṇam / pādau ca me lakṣaṇataḥ praśastau na mādṛśaṃ yuddhagataṃ jayanti
ce_text: pāṇau pṛṣatkā likhitā mameme dhanuś ca saṃkhye vitataṃ sabāṇam / pādau ca me saśarau sahadhvajau na mādṛśaṃ yuddhagataṃ jayanti

vulgate_text: śete mayā nihatā śatrusenā chinnairgātrairbhūmitale skhalantī / anastrajñānnaiva nihanmi cāstrai-- stasmānna bhasmaiva karomi lokān
ce_text: śete mayā nihatā bhāratī ca camū rājan devacamūprakāśā / ye nāstrajñās tān ahaṃ hanmi śastrais tasmāl lokaṃ neha karomi bhasmasāt

vulgate_text: ityevamuktvā punarāha pārtho yudhiṣṭhiraṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ variṣṭham / adyāputrā sūtamātā bhavitrī kuntī vātho vā mayā tena vāpi satyaṃ vadāmyadya na karṇamājau śarairahatvā kavacaṃ vimokṣye
ce_text: ity evam uktvā punar āha pārtho yudhiṣṭhiraṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ variṣṭham / apy aputrā tena rādhā bhavitrī kuntī mayā vā tad ṛtaṃ viddhi rājan / prasīda rājan kṣama yan mayoktaṃ kāle bhavān vetsyati tan namas te

vulgate_text: ityevamuktvā punareva pārtho yudhiṣṭhiraṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ variṣṭham / vimucya śastrāṇi dhanurvisṛjya kośe ca khaṅgaṃ vinidhāya tūrṇam
ce_text: ity evam uktvā punar āha pārtho yudhiṣṭhiraṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ variṣṭham / apy aputrā tena rādhā bhavitrī kuntī mayā vā tad ṛtaṃ viddhi rājan / prasīda rājan kṣama yan mayoktaṃ kāle bhavān vetsyati tan namas te

vulgate_text: sa vrīḍayā namraśirāḥ kirīṭī yudhiṣṭhiraṃ prāñjalirabhyuvāca / prasīda rājankṣama yanmayoktaṃ kāle bhavānvetsyati tannamaste
ce_text: ity evam uktvā punar āha pārtho yudhiṣṭhiraṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ variṣṭham / apy aputrā tena rādhā bhavitrī kuntī mayā vā tad ṛtaṃ viddhi rājan / prasīda rājan kṣama yan mayoktaṃ kāle bhavān vetsyati tan namas te

vulgate_text: tata āśliṣya taṃ premṇā mūrdhni cāghrāya pāṇḍavaḥ prītyā paramayā yukto vismayaṃśca punaḥpunaḥ / abravīttaṃ maheṣvāsaṃ dharmarājo dhanañjayam
ce_text: tata āśliṣya sa premṇā mūrdhni cāghrāya pāṇḍavam / prītyā paramayā yuktaḥ prasmayaṃś cābravīj jayam

vulgate_text: na cedadya hi taṃ vīraṃ nihaniṣyasi saṃyuge / prāṇāneva parityakṣye jīvitārtho hi ko mama
ce_text: tam adya yadi vai vīra na haniṣyasi sūtajam / prāṇān eva parityakṣye jīvitārtho hi ko mama

vulgate_text: satyena te śape rājaṃstvatpādena tathaiva ca / bhīmena ca naraśreṣṭha yamābhyāṃ ca mahīpate
ce_text: evam uktaḥ pratyuvāca vijayo bharatarṣabha / satyena te śape rājan prasādena tavaiva ca / bhīmena ca naraśreṣṭha yamābhyāṃ ca mahīpate

vulgate_text: upāvṛttāśca turagāḥ śikṣitāścāśvasādibhiḥ / rathopakaraṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ satvaraṃ yātu me rathaḥ
ce_text: upāvṛttāś ca turagāḥ śikṣitāś cāśvasādinaḥ / rathopakaraṇaiḥ sarvair upāyāntu tvarānvitāḥ

vulgate_text: ājñaptastvatha kṛṣṇena dāruko rājasattama yojayāmāsa ca rathaṃ vaiyāghnaṃ śatrutāpanam / sajjaṃ nivedayāmāsa pāṇḍavasya mahātmanaḥ
ce_text: ājñaptas tv atha kṛṣṇena dāruko rājasattama / yojayām āsa sa rathaṃ vaiyāghraṃ śatrutāpanam

vulgate_text: yuktaṃ tu rathamāsthāya dārukeṇa mahātmanā upasthitaṃ rathaṃ dṛṣṭvā padmanābho raṇāntakṛt / bhūyaścovāca matimānmādhavo dharmanandanam
ce_text: bhūyaś covāca matimān mādhavo dharmanandanam / yudhiṣṭhiremaṃ bībhatsuṃ tvaṃ sāntvayitum arhasi / anujñātuṃ ca karṇasya vadhāyādya durātmanaḥ

vulgate_text: prasādya dharmarājānaṃ prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā sampūjya devatāḥ sarva brāhmaṇānsvasti vācya ca / sumaṅgalaṃ svastyayanamāruroha rathottamam
ce_text: yuktaṃ tu ratham āsthāya dārukeṇa mahātmanā / āpṛcchya dharmarājānaṃ brāhmaṇān svasti vācya ca / samaṅgalasvastyayanam āruroha rathottamam

vulgate_text: śrutāyuṃ cāśrutāyuṃ ca śatāyuṃ ca mahāratham / pratyudgamya bhavetkṣemī yo na syāttvadvidhaḥ prabhuḥ
ce_text: śrutāyuṣaṃ mahāvīryam acyutāyuṣam eva ca / pratyudgamya bhavet kṣemī yo na syāt tvam iva kṣamī

vulgate_text: ko hi śakto raṇe jetuṃ kauravāṃstāta saṃyuge / anyatra pāṇḍavādyuddhe śvetāśvādvānaradhvajāt
ce_text: ko hi śakto raṇe jetuṃ kauravāṃs tāta saṃgatān / anyatra pāṇḍavān yuddhe tvayā guptān mahārathān

vulgate_text: akṣauhiṇīpatīnugrānsaṃhatānyuddhadurmadān / tvāmṛte puruṣavyāghra jetuṃ śaktaḥ pumāniha
ce_text: vīrān kṛtāstrān samare sarvān evānuvartinaḥ / akṣauhiṇīpatīn ugrān saṃrabdhān yuddhadurmadān

vulgate_text: daśame'hani samprāpte kṛtvā ghoraṃ parākramam / darśayitvā''tmano rūpaṃ rudropendrasamaṃ yudhi
ce_text: darśayitvātmano rūpaṃ rudropendrasamaṃ yudhi / pāṇḍavānām anīkāni pravigāhya vyaśātayat

vulgate_text: tathā carantaṃ samare tapantamiva bhāskaram / padātikoṭisāhasrāḥ pravarāyudhapāṇayaḥ
ce_text: majjantam aplave mandam ujjihīrṣuḥ suyodhanam / tathā carantaṃ samare tapantam iva bhāskaram / na śekuḥ sṛñjayā draṣṭuṃ tathaivānye mahīkṣitaḥ

vulgate_text: kaśca śakto raṇe kartuṃ tvadanyaḥ puruṣabruvaḥ / yādṛśaṃ te kṛtaṃ pārtha jayadrathavadhaṃ prati
ce_text: ka ivānyo raṇe kuryāt tvad anyaḥ kṣatriyo yudhi / yādṛśaṃ te kṛtaṃ pārtha jayadrathavadhaṃ prati

vulgate_text: yaśca yuṣmāsu pāpaṃ vai dhārtarāṣṭraḥ prayuktavān / tasya sarvasya durbuddhiḥ karṇo mūlamihārjuna
ce_text: yac ca yuṣmāsu pāpaṃ vai dhārtarāṣṭraḥ prayuktavān / tatra sarvatra duṣṭātmā karṇaḥ pāpamatir mukham

vulgate_text: sthitā buddhirnarendrāṇāṃ dhārtarāṣṭrasya cobhayoḥ / karṇaḥ pārthānraṇe sarvānnāśayiṣyati sāyakaiḥ
ce_text: sthirā buddhir narendrasya dhārtarāṣṭrasya mānada / karṇaḥ pārthān raṇe sarvān vijeṣyati na saṃśayaḥ

vulgate_text: karṇo jalpati vai nityamahaṃ pārthānsamāgatān vāsudevaṃ ca dāśārhaṃ vijeṣyāmi mahāraṇe / samitau valgate karṇastamadya jahi phalguna
ce_text: karṇo hi bhāṣate nityam ahaṃ pārthān samāgatān / vāsudevaṃ sarājānaṃ vijeṣyāmi mahāraṇe

vulgate_text: yacca yuṣmāsu pāpaṃ vai dhārtarāṣṭraḥ pratāpavān / sabhāyāṃ kṛtavānnityaṃ karṇamāśritya vai purā
ce_text: yac ca yuṣmāsu pāpaṃ vai dhārtarāṣṭraḥ prayuktavān / tatra sarvatra duṣṭātmā karṇaḥ pāpamatir mukham

vulgate_text: yacca taṃ dhārtarāṣṭrāṇāṃ ṣaḍbhiḥ śūrairmahārathaiḥ / paśyatāṃ saṃvṛtaṃ śūraṃ saubhadramaparājitam
ce_text: yac ca tad dhārtarāṣṭrāṇāṃ krūraiḥ ṣaḍbhir mahārathaiḥ / apaśyaṃ nihataṃ vīraṃ saubhadram ṛṣabhekṣaṇam

vulgate_text: nirmanuṣyāśca mātaṅgā virathāśca mahārathāḥ / pradravanti sma samare diśo bhītā'bhimanyave
ce_text: droṇadrauṇikṛpān vīrān kampayanto mahārathān / nirmanuṣyāṃś ca mātaṅgān virathāṃś ca mahārathān

vulgate_text: dṛṣṭvā droṇaṃ vadhopāyamabhimanyośca pṛṣṭavān / śrutvā droṇavacaḥ krūraṃ tataściccheda kārmukam
ce_text: atha droṇasya samare tat kālasadṛśaṃ tadā / śrutvā karṇo vacaḥ krūraṃ tataś ciccheda kārmukam

vulgate_text: prahasansa tu duṣṭātmā karṇo rājā ca kauravaḥ yacca karṇo'bravītkṛṣṇāṃ sabhāyāṃ paruṣaṃ vacaḥ / pramukhe pāṇḍaveyānāṃ kurūṇāṃ caiva paśyatām
ce_text: yac ca karṇo 'bravīt kṛṣṇāṃ sabhāyāṃ paruṣaṃ vacaḥ / pramukhe pāṇḍaveyānāṃ kurūṇāṃ ca nṛśaṃsavat

vulgate_text: uktavānsa ca pātātmā tathā paramadurmatiḥ / pāpaḥ pāpavacaḥ karṇaḥ paśyataste dhanañjaya
ce_text: ity uktavān adharmajñas tadā paramadurmatiḥ / pāpaḥ pāpaṃ vacaḥ karṇaḥ śṛṇvatas tava bhārata

vulgate_text: yāni cānyāni duṣṭātmā pāpāni kṛtavāṃstvayi / tānyadya bharataśreṣṭha nāśayantu śarāstava
ce_text: yāni cānyāni duṣṭātmā pāpāni kṛtavāṃs tvayi / tāny adya jīvitaṃ cāsya śamayantu śarās tava

vulgate_text: gāṇḍīvaprasṛtānvāṇānadya gātraspṛśaḥ śarān / yātu karṇo raṇe pārtha śvāvicchalalato yathā
ce_text: gāṇḍīvaprahitān ghorān adya gātraiḥ spṛśañ śarān / karṇaḥ smaratu duṣṭātmā vacanaṃ droṇabhīṣmayoḥ

vulgate_text: tamapyāsādya samare mitrārthe mitravatsala tathā jvalantamastraiśca śūraṃ sarvadhanuṣmatām / nirdahantaṃ samārūḍhaṃ durdharṣaṃ droṇamañjasā
ce_text: tathā jvalantam astrāgniṃ guruṃ sarvadhanuṣmatām / nirdahantaṃ samārohan durdharṣaṃ droṇam ojasā

vulgate_text: tānsamārohataḥ śūrānmitrārthe tyaktajīvitān / nistāraya mahābāho karṇāstrātpāvakopamāt
ce_text: tāṃs tathābhimukhān vīrān mitrārthe tyaktajīvitān / kṣayaṃ nayati rādheyaḥ pāñcālāñ śataśo raṇe

vulgate_text: tāpanaṃ sarvasainyasya ghorarūpaṃ bhayānakam / yamāśritya mahāsenā jvalate svena tejasā
ce_text: tāpanaṃ sarvasainyānāṃ ghorarūpaṃ sudāruṇam / samāvṛtya mahāsenāṃ jvalati svena tejasā

vulgate_text: ete caranti saṅgrāme karṇacāpacyutāḥ śarāḥ / prabhayā iha śatrūṇāṃ ghātayanto janānprabho
ce_text: ete caranti saṃgrāme karṇacāpacyutāḥ śarāḥ / bhramarāṇām iva vrātās tāpayantaḥ sma tāvakān

vulgate_text: ete bhramanti pāñcālā utkrayanti ca māriṣa / karṇāstraṃ samare prāpya durnivāryaṃ mahātmabhiḥ
ce_text: ete caranti pāñcālā dikṣu sarvāsu bhārata / karṇāstraṃ samare prāpya durnivāram anātmabhiḥ

vulgate_text: tvayā nāthena govinda dhruva eva jayo mama / prasanno yasya bhagavānbhūtabhavyabhaviṣyakṛt
ce_text: tvayā nāthena govinda dhruva eṣa jayo mama / prasanno yasya me 'dya tvaṃ bhūtabhavyabhavatprabhuḥ

vulgate_text: ḷḷḷḷḷḷḷṣ pāpasya madhusūdana / ḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷ sannataparvabhiḥ
ce_text: taṃ śikhaṇḍī samāsādya tvayā gupto mahāratham / jaghāna puruṣavyāghraṃ śaraiḥ saṃnataparvabhiḥ

vulgate_text: ḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷ nānyaṃ pṛthivyāmanumanyate / ḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷ sūtaputrasya bhūmiḥ pāsyati śoṇitam
ce_text: yo 'sau raṇe naraṃ nānyaṃ pṛthivyām abhimanyate / tasyādya sūtaputrasya bhūmiḥ pāsyati śoṇitam / gāṇḍīvasṛṣṭā dāsyanti karṇasya paramāṃ gatim

vulgate_text: anṛtaṃ tatkariṣyanti māmakā niśitāḥ śarāḥ / āśīviṣā iva kruddhāstasyapāsyanti śoṇitam
ce_text: ahaṃ vaḥ pāṇḍuputrebhyas trāsyāmīti yad abravīt / anṛtaṃ tat kariṣyanti māmakā niśitāḥ śarāḥ

vulgate_text: mayā hastavatā muktā nārācā vaidyutatviṣaḥ / gāṇḍīvasṛṣṭā dāsyanti karṇasya paramāṃ gatim
ce_text: yo 'sau raṇe naraṃ nānyaṃ pṛthivyām abhimanyate / tasyādya sūtaputrasya bhūmiḥ pāsyati śoṇitam / gāṇḍīvasṛṣṭā dāsyanti karṇasya paramāṃ gatim

vulgate_text: ete ṣaṇḍatilāḥ kṛṣṇe nirvīryā hatavikramāḥ ahaṃ vaḥ pāṇḍaveyebhyo bhayāttrāsyeti cābravīt / hantā'haṃ pāṇḍavānsarvānsaputrāniha bhārata
ce_text: hantāhaṃ pāṇḍavān sarvān saputrān iti yo 'bravīt / tam adya karṇaṃ hantāsmi miṣatāṃ sarvadhanvinām

vulgate_text: na jāne ca kathaṃ prītiḥ śaineyasyādya mādhava ahaṃ hatvā raṇe karṇaṃ putrāṃścāsya jayādhikān / prītiṃ dāsyāmi bhīmasya sātyakeryamayostathā
ce_text: ahaṃ hatvā raṇe karṇaṃ putraṃ cāsya mahāratham / prītiṃ dāsyāmi bhīmasya yamayoḥ sātyaker api

vulgate_text: dhṛṣṭadyumnasya vīrasya tathaiva ca śikhaṇḍinaḥ adyānṛṇyaṃ gamiṣyāmi hatvā karṇaṃ mahāhave / dharmarājasya saṃśrutya vārṣṇeyaśapathaṃ mithaḥ
ce_text: dhṛṣṭadyumnaśikhaṇḍibhyāṃ pāñcālānāṃ ca mādhava / adhyānṛṇyaṃ gamiṣyāmi hatvā karṇaṃ mahāraṇe

vulgate_text: bhavatsamakṣamaṃ vakṣyāmi punarevātmasaṃstavam / ityapyamitrapravaramadyāhaṃ hanmi sūtajam
ce_text: adya paśyantu saṃgrāme dhanaṃjayam amarṣaṇam / yudhyantaṃ kauravān saṃkhye pātayantaṃ ca sūtajam / bhavatsakāśe vakṣye ca punar evātmasaṃstavam

vulgate_text: teṣāmanīkāni mahādhvajāni raṇe samṛddhāni susaṅgatāni / bherīnirādonmukharāṇyaṃgarja-- nmeghā iva prāvṛṣi mārutāstāḥ
ce_text: teṣām anīkāni bṛhaddhvajāni raṇe samṛddhāni samāgatāni / garjanti bherīninadonmukhāni meghair yathā meghagaṇās tapānte

vulgate_text: arīnviśokānhi nirīkṣya sarvato mahāṃśca manyuḥ punareti māṃ bhṛśam / rājāturo nāgamadyatkirīṭī bahūni duḥkhānyabhicintayāmi
ce_text: arīn viśokābhinirīkṣya sarvato manas tu cintā pradunoti me bhṛśam / rājāturo nāgamad yat kirīṭī bahūni duḥkhāny abhijāto 'smi sūta

vulgate_text: rathe tavāsminniśitāḥ supītā-- stato bhallā dvādaśa vai sahasrāḥ / ṣaṇmārgaṇānāmayutāni vīra kṣurāśca bhallāśca tathāyutākhyāḥ
ce_text: ṣaṇmārgaṇānām ayutāni vīra kṣurāś ca bhallāś ca tathāyutākhyāḥ / nārācānāṃ dve sahasre tu vīra trīṇy eva ca pradarāṇāṃ ca pārtha

vulgate_text: etadvidvanmuñca sahasraśo'pi gadāsibāhudraviṇaṃ ca te'sti / prāsāśca mudrarāḥ śaktayastomarāśca mābhaiṣīstvaṃ saṃkṣayādāyudhānām
ce_text: asty āyudhaṃ pāṇḍaveyāvaśiṣṭaṃ na yad vahec chakaṭaṃ ṣaḍgavīyam / etad vidvan muñca sahasraśo 'pi gadāsibāhudraviṇaṃ ca te 'sti

vulgate_text: sūtādya madbāhuyutaiḥ samastā-- nsamāhanadbhiḥ pārthivānāśuvegaiḥ / cchannaṃ bāṇairāhavaṃ ghorarūpaṃ naṣṭādityaṃ mṛtyulokena tulyam
ce_text: sūtādyemaṃ paśya bhīmapramuktaiḥ saṃbhindadbhiḥ pārthivān āśuvegaiḥ / ugrair bāṇair āhavaṃ ghorarūpaṃ naṣṭādityaṃ mṛtyulokena tulyam

vulgate_text: kapirhyasau vīkṣate sarvato vai dhvajāgramāruhya dhanañjayasya / vitrāsayanri pusaṅghānvimarde bibhemyasmādātmanaivābhivīkṣya
ce_text: kapir hy asau vīkṣyate sarvato vai dhvajāgram āruhya dhanaṃjayasya / divākarābho maṇir eṣa divyo vibhrājate caiva kirīṭasaṃsthaḥ

vulgate_text: vibhrājate cātimātraṃ kirīṭaṃ vicitrametacca dhanañjayasya / divākarābho maṇireṣa divyo vibhrājate caiva kirīṭasaṃsthaḥ
ce_text: kapir hy asau vīkṣyate sarvato vai dhvajāgram āruhya dhanaṃjayasya / divākarābho maṇir eṣa divyo vibhrājate caiva kirīṭasaṃsthaḥ

vulgate_text: taṃ yāntamaśvā himaśaṅkhavarṇāḥ suvarṇamuktāmaṇijālanaddhāḥ / jambhaṃ jighāṃsuṃ pragṛhītavajraṃ hayā yathā tatra yathā vahaṃstadā
ce_text: āyāntam aśvair himaśaṅkhavarṇaiḥ suvarṇamuktāmaṇijālanaddhaiḥ / jambhaṃ jighāṃsuṃ pragṛhītavajraṃ jayāya devendram ivogramanyum

vulgate_text: pariveṣī yathā somaḥ paripūrṇo virājate sa rarāja tathā saṅkhye darśanīyo narottamaḥ / nirviśeṣo mahārāja vijayenaiva saṃyuge
ce_text: sa rarāja tathā saṃkhye darśanīyo narottamaḥ / nirviśeṣaṃ mahārāja yathā hi vijayas tathā

vulgate_text: dhanuḥkāśāṃ śarāvāpāṃ gadāparighaketanām / haṃsachatradhvajopetāmuṣṇīṣavaraphenilām
ce_text: dhanuṣkāśāṃ śarāvāpāṃ gadāparighaketanām / yodhavrātavatīṃ saṃkhye vahantīṃ yamasādanam

vulgate_text: yodhagrāhavatīṃ saṅkhye vahantīṃ pitṛsādanam / kṣaṇena puruṣavyāghraḥ prāvartayata nimnagām
ce_text: kṣaṇena puruṣavyāghraḥ prāvartayata nimnagām / yathā vaitaraṇīm ugrāṃ dustarām akṛtātmabhiḥ

vulgate_text: yathā vaitaraṇīmugrāṃ dustarāmakṛtātmabhiḥ / tathā dustaraṇīṃ ghorāṃ bhīrūṇāṃ bhayavardhanīm
ce_text: kṣaṇena puruṣavyāghraḥ prāvartayata nimnagām / yathā vaitaraṇīm ugrāṃ dustarām akṛtātmabhiḥ

vulgate_text: śakuniṃ vihvalaṃ dṛṣṭvā dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ parāṅmukhāḥ / pradudruvurdiśo bhītā bhīmasenabhayātprabho
ce_text: rathasthe tu naravyāghre dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ parāṅmukhāḥ / pradudruvur diśo bhītā bhīmāj jāte mahābhaye

vulgate_text: atyadbhutamahaṃ manye pāṇḍaveyasya vikramam / yadekaḥ samare sarvānyodhayāmāsa māmakān
ce_text: atyadbhutam idaṃ manye pāṇḍaveyasya vikramam / yathāpratijñaṃ yodhānāṃ rādheyaḥ kṛtavān api

vulgate_text: tadbhagraṃ svabalaṃ dṛṣṭvā kaunteyenāmitaujasā / dhanurdarāṇāṃ pravaraḥ karṇaḥ kimakarodyudhi
ce_text: tat prabhagnaṃ balaṃ dṛṣṭvā kaunteyenāmitaujasā / rādheyānām adhirathaḥ karṇaḥ kim akarod yudhi

vulgate_text: sahadevasya bhallena dhvajaṃ ciccheda māriṣa / sārathiṃ ca tribhirbāṇairājaghāna parantapaḥ
ce_text: bhīmasenas tu taṃ kruddho vivyādha triṃśatā śaraiḥ / sārathiṃ ca tribhir bāṇair ājaghāna paraṃtapaḥ

vulgate_text: tāñjaghāna śitairbāṇaiḥ sūtaputro mahārathaḥ te vadhyamānāḥ samare cedimātsyā viśāmpate / prādravanta raṇe bhītāḥ siṃhatrastā mṛgā iva
ce_text: te vadhyamānāḥ samare cedimatsyā viśāṃ pate / karṇam ekam abhidrutya śarasaṃghaiḥ samārdayan / tāñ jaghāna śitair bāṇaiḥ sūtaputro mahārathaḥ

vulgate_text: mṛgasaṅghānyathā kruddhaḥ siṃho drāvayate vane / pañcālānāṃ rathaśreṣṭhāndrāvayañśātravāṃstathā
ce_text: mṛgasaṃghān yathā kruddhaḥ siṃho drāvayate vane / karṇas tu samare yodhāṃs tatra tatra mahāyaśāḥ / kālayām āsa tat sainyaṃ yathā paśugaṇān vṛkaḥ

vulgate_text: karmaputrau tu rājendra bhrātarau satyavikramau / nijaghnāte balaṃ kruddhau pāṇḍavānāmitastataḥ
ce_text: karṇaputrau ca rājendra bhrātarau satyavikramau / anāśayetāṃ balinaḥ pāñcālān vai tatas tataḥ / tatra yuddhaṃ tadā hy āsīt krūraṃ viśasanaṃ mahat

vulgate_text: hatvā tu phalgunaḥ senāṃ kauravāṇāṃ pṛthakpṛthak / sūtaputrasya saṃrambhaṃ dṛṣṭvā caiva mahāraṇe
ce_text: arjunas tu mahārāja kṛtvā sainyaṃ pṛthagvidham / sūtaputraṃ susaṃrabdhaṃ dṛṣṭvā caiva mahāraṇe

vulgate_text: nadīṃ prāvartayitvā ca bībhatsuḥ paravīrahā / vāsudevamidaṃ vākyamabravītpuruṣarṣabhaḥ
ce_text: śoṇitodāṃ mahīṃ kṛtvā māṃsamajjāsthivāhinīm / vāsudevam idaṃ vākyam abravīt puruṣarṣabha

vulgate_text: mā sma karṇo raṇe pārthānsṛñjayāṃśca mahārathān / niḥśeṣānsamare kuryātpaśyatāṃ no janārdana
ce_text: rādheyo 'py anyathā pārthān sṛñjayāṃś ca mahārathān / niḥśeṣān samare kuryāt paśyator nau janārdana

vulgate_text: sa prayāto rathenāśu kṛṣṇo rājanmahāhave / āśvāsayanraṇe cāśu pāṇḍusainyāni sarvaśaḥ
ce_text: prayātaś ca mahābāhuḥ pāṇḍavānujñayā hariḥ / āśvāsayan rathenaiva pāṇḍusainyāni sarvaśaḥ

vulgate_text: rathaghoṣastatastasya pāṇḍavasya babhūva ha / vāsavāstranipātena parvateṣviva māriṣa
ce_text: rathaghoṣaḥ sa saṃgrāme pāṇḍaveyasya saṃbabhau / vāsavāśanitulyasya mahaughasyeva māriṣa

vulgate_text: tvaṃ hi kṛṣṇau raṇe śakto yoddhumetau parantapau / tavaiva bhāro rādheya pratyudyāhi dhanañjayam
ce_text: tvaṃ hi kṛṣṇau raṇe śaktaḥ saṃsādhayitum āhave / tavaiṣa bhāro rādheya pratyudyāhi dhanaṃjayam

vulgate_text: samāno hyasi bhīṣmeṇa dromadrauṇikṛpeṇa ca / savyasācinamāyāntaṃ nivāraya mahāraṇe
ce_text: tvaṃ kṛto hy eva bhīṣmeṇa droṇadrauṇikṛpair api / savyasācipratirathas taṃ nivartaya pāṇḍavam

vulgate_text: vāsudevaṃ ca vārṣṇeyaṃ prīyamāṇaṃ kirīṭinā / pratyudyāhi mahābāho pauruṣe mahati sthitaḥ
ce_text: tāṃ dhṛtiṃ kuru rādheya tataḥ pratyehi pāṇḍavam / vāsudevaṃ ca vārṣṇeyaṃ prīyamāṇaṃ kirīṭinā

vulgate_text: tamīdṛśaṃ vīryaguṇopapannaṃ kṛṣṇadvitīyaṃ paramaṃ nṛpāṇām / tamāhvayansāhasamuttamaṃ vai jāne svayaṃ sarvalokasya śalya
ce_text: tam īdṛśaṃ vīryaguṇopapannaṃ kṛṣṇadvitīyaṃ varaye raṇāya / anantavīryeṇa ca keśavena nārāyaṇenāpratimena guptam

vulgate_text: ubhau hi śūrau balinau dṛḍhāyudhau mahārathau saṃhananopapannau / etau vīrau naravīrau sametau sthānāccyutau devakumārarūpau
ce_text: ubhau hi śūrau kṛtinau dṛḍhāstrau mahārathau saṃhananopapannau / etādṛśau phalgunavāsudevau ko 'nyaḥ pratīyān mad ṛte nu śalya

vulgate_text: abhyetya putreṇa tavābhinanditāḥ sametya coktāḥ kuruvīrasattamāḥ / kṛpaśca bhojaśca mahārathāvubhau tathaiva gāndhārapatiḥ sahānujaḥ guroḥ sutastasya tavātmajāstathā padātisaṅghā dviradāstathā tadā
ce_text: abhyetya putreṇa tavābhinanditaḥ sametya covāca kurupravīrān / kṛpaṃ ca bhojaṃ ca mahābhujāv ubhau tathaiva gāndhāranṛpaṃ sahānujam / guroḥ sutaṃ cāvarajaṃ tathātmanaḥ padātino 'tha dvipasādino 'nyān

vulgate_text: tamabhyadhāvadvisṛjankṛpaḥ śarāṃ-- stathaiva bhojastava cātmajaḥ svayam / mahāratho droṇasutaśca sāyakai-- ravākiraṃstoyadharā yathā'calam
ce_text: tam abhyadhāvad visṛjañ śarān kṛpas tathaiva bhojas tava cātmajaḥ svayam / jighāṃsubhis tān kuśalaiḥ śarottamān mahāhave saṃjavitān prayatnataḥ / śaraiḥ praciccheda ca pāṇḍavas tvaran parābhinad vakṣasi ca tribhis tribhiḥ

vulgate_text: jighāṃsubhistānkuśalaiḥ śarottamān mahātmabhiḥ samprahitānprayatnataḥ / śaraiḥ praticcheda sa pāṇḍavastvaran parānvinirbhidya ca tāṃstribhistribhiḥ
ce_text: tam abhyadhāvad visṛjañ śarān kṛpas tathaiva bhojas tava cātmajaḥ svayam / jighāṃsubhis tān kuśalaiḥ śarottamān mahāhave saṃjavitān prayatnataḥ / śaraiḥ praciccheda ca pāṇḍavas tvaran parābhinad vakṣasi ca tribhis tribhiḥ
