vulgate_text: evaṃ kāryasya yogātpraśamārthamiti prabho / prajñayā ca svayā yuktyā tāṃ ca gṛhṇanti vai budhāḥ
ce_text: evaṃ kāryasya yogārthaṃ buddhiṃ kurvanti mānavāḥ / prajñayā hi svayā yuktās tāṃ ca nindanti mānavāḥ

vulgate_text: tathā vinihataḥ pāpaḥ pāñcālyaḥ paśuvanmayā / śastreṇa vijitām̐llokānnāpnuyāditi me matiḥ
ce_text: kathaṃ ca nihataḥ pāpaḥ pāñcālaḥ paśuvan mayā / śastrāhavajitāṃ lokān prāpnuyād iti me matiḥ

vulgate_text: tadadbhutatamaṃ dṛṣṭvā droṇaputro nirāyudhaḥ / acintayatsusantrastaḥ kṛpabhojavacaḥ smaran
ce_text: tad adbhutatamaṃ dṛṣṭvā droṇaputro nirāyudhaḥ / abravīd abhisaṃtaptaḥ kṛpavākyam anusmaran

vulgate_text: manasā hyanucintyainaṃ duṣkareṇālpacetasā / adya bhūtopahāreṇa yakṣye tripurāghātinam
ce_text: manasāpy asucintyena duṣkareṇālpacetasā / so 'ham ātmopahāreṇa yakṣye tripuraghātinam

vulgate_text: jvālākeśāśca rājendra jvaladromacaturbhujāḥ / meṣavaktrāstathaivānye tathā chāgamukhā nṛpa
ce_text: pradīptanetrajihvāś ca jvālāvaktrās tathaiva ca / meṣavaktrās tathaivānye tathā chāgamukhā nṛpa

vulgate_text: mahāsarpāṅgadadharāścitrābharaṇadhāriṇaḥ rajodhvajāḥ paṅkadigdhāḥ sarve citrāmbarasrajaḥ / nīlāṅgāḥ piṅgalāṅgāśca muṇḍavaktāstathaiva ca
ce_text: rajodhvastāḥ paṅkadigdhāḥ sarve śuklāmbarasrajaḥ / nīlāṅgāḥ kamalāṅgāś ca muṇḍavaktrās tathaiva ca

vulgate_text: gāyamānāstathaivānye saṃhṛṣṭāḥ puruṣarṣabhāḥ / laṅghayantaḥ pluvantaśca valgantaśca mahārathāḥ
ce_text: gāyamānās tathaivānye nṛtyamānās tathāpare / laṅghayantaḥ plavantaś ca valgantaś ca mahābalāḥ

vulgate_text: taṃ dṛṣṭvā tāni bhūtāni rakṣāṃsi ca samādravan abhitaḥ śibiraṃ yāntaṃ droṇaputraṃ mahāratham / devadevaṃ haraṃ sthāuṃ yāntaṃ sākṣādiveśvaram
ce_text: tam adṛśyāni bhūtāni rakṣāṃsi ca samādravan / abhitaḥ śatruśibiraṃ yāntaṃ sākṣād iveśvaram

vulgate_text: kaccidunmathya śibiraṃ hatvā somakapāṇḍavān / kṛtā pratijñā saphalā kaccitsañjaya sā niśi
ce_text: kaccit pramathya śibiraṃ hatvā somakapāṇḍavān / duryodhanasya padavīṃ gatau paramikāṃ raṇe

vulgate_text: duryodhanasya padavīṃ kaccitparamikāṃ raṇe / gatvātiṣṭhadasau drauṇiḥ kṛtvā karma suduṣkaram
ce_text: kaccit pramathya śibiraṃ hatvā somakapāṇḍavān / duryodhanasya padavīṃ gatau paramikāṃ raṇe

vulgate_text: sa vāryamāṇastarasā balādbalavatā balī / tudannakhaistu sa drauṇiṃ nātivyaktamudāharat
ce_text: tudan nakhais tu sa drauṇiṃ nātivyaktam udāharat / ācāryaputra śastreṇa jahi mā mā ciraṃ kṛthāḥ / tvatkṛte sukṛtāṃl lokān gaccheyaṃ dvipadāṃ vara

vulgate_text: gadāprahārābhihato nācaladdrauṇirāhave / tamabhidrutya vegena kṣitau cainamapātayat
ce_text: tam abhidrutya jagrāha kṣitau cainam apātayat / visphurantaṃ ca paśuvat tathaivainam amārayat

vulgate_text: saṃsuptāneva rājendra tatra tatra mahārathān pāñcālavīrānākramya kruddho nyahanadantike / sphurato vepamānāṃśca śamiteva paśūnmakhe
ce_text: tathā sa vīro hatvā taṃ tato 'nyān samupādravat / saṃsuptān eva rājendra tatra tatra mahārathān / sphurato vepamānāṃś ca śamiteva paśūn makhe

vulgate_text: ye tvajāgranta kauravya te'pi śabdena mohitāḥ / vīkṣamāṇāstu te tatra drauṇiṃ dṛṣṭvā pravivyathuḥ
ce_text: ye tv ajāgrata kauravya te 'pi śabdena mohitāḥ / nirīkṣyamāṇā anyonyaṃ drauṇiṃ dṛṣṭvā pravivyathuḥ

vulgate_text: śrutakarmā tu parighaṃ ghoraṃ gṛhya durāsadam / atāḍayatsamudyamya vegena drauṇimutsmayan
ce_text: śrutakarmā tu parighaṃ gṛhītvā samatāḍayat / abhidrutya tato drauṇiṃ savye sa phalake bhṛśam

vulgate_text: vahantīṃ vividhānpretānpāśabadvānvimūrdhajān / tathaiva ca sadā rājannyastaśastrānmahārathān
ce_text: dadṛśuḥ kālarātriṃ te smayamānām avasthitām / narāśvakuñjarān pāśair baddhvā ghoraiḥ pratasthuṣīm / harantīṃ vividhān pretān pāśabaddhān vimūrdhajān

vulgate_text: tatastacchastravitrastā bhayādabhyapatannarāḥ / nidrāndhā naṣṭasaṃjñāśca tatratatra nipetire
ce_text: tatas tacchastravitrastā utpatanto bhayāturāḥ / nidrāndhā naṣṭasaṃjñāś ca tatra tatra nililyire

vulgate_text: evaṃ hi bahubhiḥ śastrairghnato'pi balavattarān / tamasā rajanī ghorā babhau dāruṇadarśanā
ce_text: evaṃ vicaratas tasya nighnataḥ subahūn narān / tamasā rajanī ghorā babhau dāruṇadarśanā

vulgate_text: kecidūcurna tatkruddhairdhārtarāṣṭraiḥ kṛtaṃ raṇe yatkṛtaṃ naḥ prasuptānāṃ rakṣobhiḥ krūgkarmabhiḥ / asānnidhyādvi pārthānāmidaṃ vaḥ kadanaṃ kṛtam
ce_text: yat kṛtaṃ naḥ prasuptānāṃ rakṣobhiḥ krūrakarmabhiḥ / asāṃnidhyād dhi pārthānām idaṃ naḥ kadanaṃ kṛtam

vulgate_text: pañcādaṅgulayo rūkṣā virūpā bhairavasvanāḥ / gajānanāśca hasvāśca nīlavarṇā bibhīṣaṇāḥ
ce_text: paścād aṅgulayo rūkṣā virūpā bhairavasvanāḥ / ghaṭajānavo 'tihrasvāś ca nīlakaṇṭhā vibhīṣaṇāḥ

vulgate_text: yamupāsannṛpāḥ pūrvamarthahetormahīpatim / upātpate ca taṃ hyadya kravyādā māṃsagṛddhinaḥ
ce_text: upāsata nṛpāḥ pūrvam arthahetor yam īśvaram / dhik sadyo nihataḥ śete paśya kālasya paryayam

vulgate_text: dvāvanāthau kṛtau vīra tvayā nāthena vardhitau / bhikṣukau vicariṣyete śocantau pṛthivīmimām
ce_text: duryodhana na śocāmi tvām ahaṃ puruṣarṣabha / hataputrāṃ tu śocāmi gāndhārīṃ pitaraṃ ca te / bhikṣukau vicariṣyete śocantau pṛthivīm imām

vulgate_text: prāṇānupāsṛjadvīraḥ suhṛdāṃ duḥkhamādadhat / apākrāmaddivaṃ puṇyāṃ śarīraṃ kṣitimāviśat
ce_text: svasti prāpnuta bhadraṃ vaḥ svarge naḥ saṃgamaḥ punaḥ / ity evam uktvā tūṣṇīṃ sa kururājo mahāmanāḥ / prāṇān udasṛjad vīraḥ suhṛdāṃ śokam ādadhat

vulgate_text: etairnaragajāśvānāṃ prāsaśaktiparaśvayaiḥ / sahasrāmi vikṛndbhirniḥ śeṣaṃ śibiraṃ kṛtam
ce_text: etair naragajāśvānāṃ prāsaśaktiparaśvadhaiḥ / sahasrāṇi nikṛntadbhir niḥśeṣaṃ te balaṃ kṛtam

vulgate_text: ḷḷḷḷḷḷvihagaphalabhāranatasya ha ḷḷḷḷḷḷḷmahato vanasyeva paraśvathaiḥ / ḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷ sumahāñśabdo balasya tava bhārata
ce_text: chidyamānasya mahato vanasyeva paraśvadhaiḥ / śuśruve sumahāñ śabdo balasya tava bhārata

vulgate_text: tacchokajaṃ duḥkhamapārayantī kathaṃ bhaviṣyatyucitā sukhānām / rorūyate jñātivadhābhitaptā pradahvamāneva hutāśanena
ce_text: tac chokajaṃ duḥkham apārayantī kathaṃ bhaviṣyaty ucitā sukhānām / putrakṣayabhrātṛvadhapraṇunnā pradahyamāneva hutāśanena

vulgate_text: tasminmuhūrte javanairvājibhirhemamālibhiḥ / nakulaḥ kṛṣṇayā sārdhamupāyātparamārtayā
ce_text: tatas tasmin kṣaṇe kālye rathenādityavarcasā / nakulaḥ kṛṣṇayā sārdham upāyāt paramārtayā

vulgate_text: na babhau vadanaṃ tasyā rudantyāḥ śokakarśitam / phullapadmapalāśākṣyā meghāvṛta ivoḍurāṭ
ce_text: babhūva vadanaṃ tasyāḥ sahasā śokakarśitam / phullapadmapalāśākṣyās tamodhvasta ivāṃśumān

vulgate_text: sā samāśvāsitā tena bhīmasenena bhāminī / rudatī pāṇḍavajyeṣṭhamidaṃ vacanamabravīt
ce_text: sā samāśvāsitā tena bhīmasenena bhāminī / rudatī pāṇḍavaṃ kṛṣṇā sahabhrātaram abravīt

vulgate_text: ātmajānkṣatradharmeṇa śrutvā śūrānnipātitān / sthito rājye mayā sārdhaṃ viharanna smariṣyasi
ce_text: ātmajāṃs tena dharmeṇa śrutvā śūrān nipātitān / upaplavye mayā sārdhaṃ diṣṭyā tvaṃ na smariṣyasi

vulgate_text: prasuptānāṃ vadhaṃ śrutvā drauṇinā pāpakarmaṇā / śoko māṃ dahate gāḍho hutāśana ivāśrayam
ce_text: prasuptānāṃ vadhaṃ śrutvā drauṇinā pāpakarmaṇā / śokas tapati māṃ pārtha hutāśana ivāśayam

vulgate_text: te hayāḥ puruṣavyāghra dīpyamānāḥ svatejasā / vahantaḥ sahasā jagmurharayaḥ śīghragāminaḥ
ce_text: te hayāḥ puruṣavyāghra coditā vātaraṃhasaḥ / vegena tvaritā jagmur harayaḥ śīghragāminaḥ

vulgate_text: sarvayatnena tenāpi gṛhya nainamakampayat
ce_text: atha tad dakṣiṇenāpi grahītum upacakrame / sarvayatnena tenāpi gṛhṇann etad akalpayat

vulgate_text: yuktaṃ paramakāmbhojaisturagairhemamālibhiḥ / uditādityasaṅkāśaṃ sarvaratnavibhūṣitam
ce_text: evam uktvā yudhāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ sarvayādavanandanaḥ / sarvāyudhavaropetam āruroha mahāratham / yuktaṃ paramakāmbojais turagair hemamālibhiḥ

vulgate_text: dakṣiṇe hyāvahacchaibyaḥ sugrīvaḥ savyato dhuram / ṇarṣṇivāhau tu tasyāstāṃ meghapuṣpabalāhakau
ce_text: ādityodayavarṇasya dhuraṃ rathavarasya tu / dakṣiṇām avahat sainyaḥ sugrīvaḥ savyato 'vahat / pārṣṇivāhau tu tasyāstāṃ meghapuṣpabalāhakau

vulgate_text: te samarthā mahābāhuṃ kṣaṇena bharatarṣabha / bhīmasenaṃ maheṣvāsamanusasruḥ suvegitāḥ
ce_text: te samārchan naravyāghrāḥ kṣaṇena bharatarṣabha / bhīmasenaṃ maheṣvāsaṃ samanudrutya vegitāḥ

vulgate_text: sa tāmāpadamāsādya divyamastramudairayat amṛṣyamāṇastāñchūrāndivyāyudhadharānsthitān / apāṇḍavāyeti ruṣā vācamutsṛjya dāruṇam
ce_text: amṛṣyamāṇas tāñ śūrān divyāyudhadharān sthitān / apāṇḍavāyeti ruṣā vyasṛjad dāruṇaṃ vacaḥ

vulgate_text: mahāstraviduṣaḥ pūrve ye'pyatītā mahārathāḥ naitadasraṃ manuṣyeṣu taiḥ prayuktaṃ kathañcana / kimidaṃ sāhasaṃ vīrau kṛtavantau mahātyayam
ce_text: nānāśastravidaḥ pūrve ye 'py atītā mahārathāḥ / naitad astraṃ manuṣyeṣu taiḥ prayuktaṃ kathaṃ cana

vulgate_text: dṛṣṭaiva muniśārdūlau tāvagnisamatejasau gāṇḍīvadhanvā sañcintya prāptakālaṃ mahārathaḥ / sañjahāra śaraṃ divyaṃ tvaramāṇo dhanañjayaḥ
ce_text: dṛṣṭvaiva naraśārdūlas tāv agnisamatejasau / saṃjahāra śaraṃ divyaṃ tvaramāṇo dhanaṃjayaḥ

vulgate_text: evaṃ kuru na cānyā te buddhiḥ kāryā kathañcana / āgarbhātpāṇḍaveyānāṃ kṛtvā pātaṃ vinaṅkṣyati
ce_text: evaṃ kuru na cānyā te buddhiḥ kāryā kadā cana / garbheṣu pāṇḍaveyānāṃ visṛjyaitad upārama

vulgate_text: evaṃ bruvāṇaṃ govindaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ sarvasātvatām / drauṇiḥ paramasaṅkruddhaḥ pratyuvācedamuttaram
ce_text: evaṃ bruvāṇaṃ govindaṃ sātvatapravaraṃ tadā / drauṇiḥ paramasaṃrabdhaḥ pratyuvācedam uttaram

vulgate_text: amoghaḥ paramāstrasya pātastvadya bhaviṣyati / abhimanyoḥ sṛjaiṣīkāṃ garbhasthaḥ śāmyatāṃ śiśuḥ
ce_text: amoghaḥ paramāstrasya pātas tasya bhaviṣyati / sa tu garbho mṛto jāto dīrgham āyur avāpsyati

vulgate_text: ahamenaṃ mṛtaṃ jātaṃ jīvayiṣyāmi bālakam / sa tu garbho mṛto jāto dīrghamāyuravāpsyati
ce_text: amoghaḥ paramāstrasya pātas tasya bhaviṣyati / sa tu garbho mṛto jāto dīrgham āyur avāpsyati

vulgate_text: tataḥ paramamastraṃ tu drauṇirudyatamāhave / dvaipāyanamanādṛtya garbheṣu pramumoca ha
ce_text: tataḥ paramam astraṃ tad aśvatthāmā bhṛśāturaḥ / dvaipāyanavacaḥ śrutvā garbheṣu pramumoca ha

vulgate_text: bhavitrī na hi te kṣudra janamadhyeṣu saṃsthitiḥ pūyaśoṇigandhī ca durgakāntārasaṃśrayaḥ
ce_text: nirjanān asahāyas tvaṃ deśān pravicariṣyasi / bhavitrī na hi te kṣudra janamadhyeṣu saṃsthitiḥ

vulgate_text: ṣaṣṭiṃ varṣāmi dharmātmā vasudhāṃ pālayiṣyati itaścordhvaṃ mahābāhuḥ kururājo bhaviṣyati
ce_text: viditvā paramāstrāṇi kṣatradharmavrate sthitaḥ / ṣaṣṭiṃ varṣāṇi dharmātmā vasudhāṃ pālayiṣyati

vulgate_text: parikṣinnāma nṛpatirmiṣataste sudurmate [ahaṃ taṃ jīvayiṣyāmi dagdhaṃ śastrāgnitejasā]
ce_text: itaś cordhvaṃ mahābāhuḥ kururājo bhaviṣyati / parikṣin nāma nṛpatir miṣatas te sudurmate / paśya me tapaso vīryaṃ satyasya ca narādhama

vulgate_text: paśya me tapaso vīryaṃ satyasya ca narādhama / yasmādanādṛtya kṛtaṃ tvayā'smānkarma dāruṇam / brāhmaṇasya sataścedaṃ vṛttamanyāyavartinaḥ
ce_text: itaś cordhvaṃ mahābāhuḥ kururājo bhaviṣyati / parikṣin nāma nṛpatir miṣatas te sudurmate / paśya me tapaso vīryaṃ satyasya ca narādhama

vulgate_text: pāṇḍavāśca sadāśārhāstānṛṣīnabhivādya ca / kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaṃ caiva nāradaṃ caiva parvatam
ce_text: pāṇḍavāś cāpi govindaṃ puraskṛtya hatadviṣaḥ / kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaṃ caiva nāradaṃ ca mahāmunim

vulgate_text: bhūtagrāme vivṛdve tu sṛṣṭe devāsure tadā / udatiṣṭhajjalājjyeṣṭhaḥ prajāścemā dadarśa saḥ
ce_text: bhūtagrāme vivṛddhe tu tuṣṭe lokagurāv api / udatiṣṭhaj jalāj jyeṣṭhaḥ prajāś cemā dadarśa saḥ

vulgate_text: kiṃ kṛtaṃ salile śarva cirakālasthitena te / kimarthaṃ cedamutpādya liṅgaṃ bhūmau praveśitam
ce_text: kiṃ kṛtaṃ salile śarva cirakālaṃ sthitena te / kimarthaṃ caitad utpāṭya bhūmau liṅgaṃ praveritam

vulgate_text: prajāḥ sṛṣṭāḥ pareṇemāḥ prajārthaṃ me pitāmaha / oṣadhyaḥ parivarteranyathaivaṃ satataṃ prajāḥ
ce_text: tapasādhigataṃ cānnaṃ prajārthaṃ me pitāmaha / oṣadhyaḥ parivarteran yathaiva satataṃ prajāḥ

vulgate_text: kalpayāmāsuratha te sādhanāni havīṃṣi ca / bhāgārhā devatāścaiva yajñiyaṃ dravyameva ca
ce_text: kalpayām āsur avyagrā deśān yajñocitāṃs tataḥ / bhāgārhā devatāś caiva yajñiyaṃ dravyam eva ca

vulgate_text: lokayajñaḥ kriyāyajño gṛhayajñaḥ sanātanaḥ / pañcabhūtanṛyajñaśca jajñe sarvamidaṃ jagat
ce_text: lokayajñaḥ kriyāyajño gṛhayajñaḥ sanātanaḥ / pañcabhūtamayo yajño nṛyajñaś caiva pañcamaḥ

vulgate_text: tasminkruddhe'bhavatsarvamasusthaṃ bhuvanaṃ prabho / prasanne ca punaḥ susthaṃ jagadbhavati bhārata
ce_text: tasmin kruddhe 'bhavat sarvam asvasthaṃ bhuvanaṃ vibho / prasanne ca punaḥ svasthaṃ sa prasanno 'sya vīryavān

vulgate_text: nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam / devīṃ sarasvatīṃ vyāsaṃ tato jayamudīrayet / hate duryodhane caiva hate sainye ca sarvaśaḥ / dhṛtarāṣṭro mahārāja śrutvā kimakaronmune
ce_text: hate duryodhane caiva hate sainye ca sarvaśaḥ / dhṛtarāṣṭro mahārājaḥ śrutvā kim akaron mune

vulgate_text: ṛṣīṇāṃ ca tathā'nyeṣāṃ vyāsasyāmitatejasaḥ na kṛtaṃ tena vacanaṃ tava putreṇa bhārata / kṣapitāḥ kṣatriyāḥ sarve śatrūṇāṃ vardhitaṃ yaśaḥ
ce_text: na dharmaḥ satkṛtaḥ kaś cin nityaṃ yuddham iti bruvan / kṣapitāḥ kṣatriyāḥ sarve śatrūṇāṃ vardhitaṃ yaśaḥ

vulgate_text: svayamutpādayitvā'gniṃ parītastena yo'gninā / dahyamānaḥ punastāpaṃ bhajate na sa paṇḍitaḥ
ce_text: svayam utpādayitvāgniṃ vastreṇa pariveṣṭayet / dahyamāno manastāpaṃ bhajate na sa paṇḍitaḥ

vulgate_text: uttiṣṭha rājankiṃ śeṣe dhārayātmānamātmanā / eṣā vai sarvasatvānāṃ lokeśvara parā gatiḥ
ce_text: uttiṣṭha rājan kiṃ śeṣe dhārayātmānam ātmanā / sthirajaṅgamamartyānāṃ sarveṣām eṣa nirṇayaḥ

vulgate_text: na śocanmṛtamanveti na śocanmriyate naraḥ / evaṃ sāṃsiddhike loke kimarthamanuśocasi
ce_text: prākkarmabhis tu bhūtāni bhavanti na bhavanti ca / evaṃ sāṃsiddhike loke kimartham anutapyase

vulgate_text: kālaḥ karṣati bhūtāni sarvāṇi vividhānyuta / na kālasya priyaḥ kaścinna dveṣyaḥ kurusattama
ce_text: na kālasya priyaḥ kaś cin na dveṣyaḥ kurusattama / na madhyasthaḥ kva cit kālaḥ sarvaṃ kālaḥ prakarṣati

vulgate_text: anudhāvati dhāvantaṃ karma pūrvakṛtaṃ naram yasyāṃyasyāmavasthāyāṃ yatkaroti śubhāśubham

vulgate_text: tasyāṃtasyāmavasthāyāṃ tattatphalamavāpnute [yenayena śarīreṇa yadyatkarma karoti yaḥ
ce_text: yasyāṃ yasyām avasthāyāṃ yat karoti śubhāśubham / tasyāṃ tasyām avasthāyāṃ tat tat phalam upāśnute

vulgate_text: aniṣṭānāṃ ca saṃsargādiṣṭānāṃ ca nivartanāt / kathaṃ hi mānasaṃ duḥkhaṃ viprayujyanti paṇḍitāḥ
ce_text: aniṣṭānāṃ ca saṃsargād iṣṭānāṃ ca vivarjanāt / kathaṃ hi mānasair duḥkhaiḥ pramucyante 'tra paṇḍitāḥ

vulgate_text: bādhyamānaśca tairbhūyo naiva tṛptimupaiti saḥ [tadā nāvaiti caivāyaṃ prakurvansādhvasādhu vā ]

vulgate_text: tatrainaṃ paripaśyanti ye dhyānapariniṣṭhitāḥ / ayaṃ na budhyate tāvadyamalokādihāgame
ce_text: ayaṃ na budhyate tāvad yamalokam athāgatam / yamadūtair vikṛṣyaṃś ca mṛtyuṃ kālena gacchati

vulgate_text: samantātsamparikṣiptaṃ yasmāddraṣṭurmahadbhayam / tadasya dṛṣṭvā hṛdayamudvegamagamatparam

vulgate_text: atha tatrāpi cānyo'sya bhūyo jāta upadravaḥ / kūpamadhye mahānāgamapaśyata mahābalam

vulgate_text: kūpamadhye ca yā jātā vallī yatra sa mānavaḥ / proto yayā'bhavallagno jīvitāśā śarīriṇām
ce_text: kūpamadhye ca yā jātā vallī yatra sa mānavaḥ / pratāne lambate sā tu jīvitāśā śarīriṇām

ce_text: sa yas tu kūpavīnāhe taṃ vṛkṣaṃ parisarpati / ṣaḍvaktraḥ kuñjaro rājan sa tu saṃvatsaraḥ smṛtaḥ / mukhāni ṛtavo māsāḥ pādā dvādaśa kīrtitāḥ

ce_text: śakunir mātulaś caiva karṇaś ca paramaḥ sakhā / samutpannā vināśārthaṃ pṛthivyāṃ sahitā nṛpāḥ / etam arthaṃ mahābāho nārado veda tattvataḥ

vulgate_text: duṣṭaṃ rājānamāsādya gatāste tanayā nṛpa ] etamarthaṃ mahābāho nārado veda tattvavit
ce_text: śakunir mātulaś caiva karṇaś ca paramaḥ sakhā / samutpannā vināśārthaṃ pṛthivyāṃ sahitā nṛpāḥ / etam arthaṃ mahābāho nārado veda tattvataḥ

vulgate_text: vidurasya tu tadvākyaṃ śrutvā tu puruṣarṣabhaḥ / yujyatāṃ yānamityuktvā punarvacanamavravīt

vulgate_text: kṣipramānaya gāndhārīṃ sarvāśca bharatastriyaḥ / kuntīṃ caiva tathā kṣattaḥ samānaya mamā'ntikam

vulgate_text: te hatānātmajāñśrutvā pramattāḥ puruṣarṣabhāḥ / anviṣyantaḥ padaṃ śūrāḥ kṣiprameṣyanti pāṇḍavāḥ
ce_text: nihatān ātmajāñ śrutvā pramattān puruṣarṣabhāḥ / ninīṣantaḥ padaṃ śūrāḥ kṣipram eva yaśasvini

vulgate_text: hato bhīma iti jñātvā gatamanyurmahāmanāḥ / hāhābhīmeti cukrośa nṛpaḥ śokasamanvitaḥ

vulgate_text: sa vāryamāṇo nāsmākamakārṣīrvacanaṃ tadā / pāṇḍavānadhikāñcānanbale śaurye ca kaurava

vulgate_text: ucyamānastu yaḥ śreyo gṛhṇīte no hitāhite / āpadaḥ samanuprāpya so'bhyeti vilayaṃ kila
ce_text: ucyamānaṃ ca yaḥ śreyo gṛhṇīte no hitāhite / āpadaṃ samanuprāpya sa śocaty anaye sthitaḥ

vulgate_text: sa gaṅgāyāmupaspṛśya brahmarṣiḥ prayataḥ śuciḥ / taṃ deśamupasaṃpede pārāśaryo manojavaḥ

vulgate_text: puroktā yuddhakāle tvaṃ putreṇa jayamicchatā / jayamāśāsva me mātaryudhyamānasya śatrubhiḥ

vulgate_text: vācā'pyatīte mā krodhe manaḥ kuru yaśasvini / smarāmi bhāṣamāṇāṃ hi tvāmahaṃ satyavādinīm
ce_text: na cāpy atītāṃ gāndhāri vācaṃ te vitathām aham / smarāmi bhāṣamāṇāyās tathā praṇihitā hy asi

vulgate_text: sā tvaṃ dharmaṃ parismṛtya vācaṃ coktāṃ manasvinī / kopaṃ saṃyaccha gāndhāri pāṇḍaveṣu suteṣu te
ce_text: sā tvaṃ dharmaṃ parismṛtya vācā coktvā manasvini / kopaṃ saṃyaccha gāndhāri maivaṃ bhūḥ satyavādini

vulgate_text: adharmeṇa jitaḥ pūrvaṃ tena cāpi yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / nikṛtāśca sadaiva sma to viṣamamācaram

vulgate_text: sa pratijñāmakaravaṃ pibāmyasṛgareriti / rudhiraṃ nāticakrāma dantoṣṭhādamba mā śucaḥ

ce_text: tām abhyagacchad rājendro vepamānaḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ / yudhiṣṭhira idaṃ caināṃ madhuraṃ vākyam abravīt

vulgate_text: te pāṇḍavā anujñātā mātaraṃ vītamatsarāḥ / abhyagacchanta sahitāḥ pṛthāṃ pṛthuvalakṣasaḥ

vulgate_text: kṛcchrādutsārayanti sma gṛdhragomāyuvāyasān / duḥkhenārtā vighūrṇantyo mattā iva carantyuta

vulgate_text: grāmeyāngrāmadoṣāṃśca grāmikaḥ pratibhāveyet / tānācakṣīta daśine daśiko viṃśine punaḥ
ce_text: grāme yān grāmadoṣāṃś ca grāmikaḥ paripālayet / tān brūyād daśapāyāsau sa tu viṃśatipāya vai

vulgate_text: bhavetsa tānparikrāmetsarvāneva sabhāsadaḥ / teṣāṃ vṛttiṃ pariṇayetkaścidrāṣṭreṣu taccaraḥ
ce_text: nagare nagare ca syād ekaḥ sarvārthacintakaḥ / uccaiḥsthāne ghorarūpo nakṣatrāṇām iva grahaḥ / bhavet sa tān parikrāmet sarvān eva sadā svayam

vulgate_text: kalatramāditaḥ kṛtvā sarvaṃ vo vinaśediti / śarīraputradārārthamarthasaṃcaya iṣyate
ce_text: kalatram āditaḥ kṛtvā naśyet svaṃ svayam eva hi / api cet putradārārtham arthasaṃcaya iṣyate

vulgate_text: kṛtapāpastvasau rājā ya etānna niyacchati tathā kṛtasya dharmasya caturbhāgamupāśnute
ce_text: prabhur niyamane rājā ya etān na niyacchati / bhuṅkte sa tasya pāpasya caturbhāgam iti śrutiḥ / tathā kṛtasya dharmasya caturbhāgam upāśnute

vulgate_text: eṣā te rāṣṭravṛttiśca rājñāṃ guptiśca bhārata / proktoddiśyaitamevārthaṃ bhūyo vakṣyāmi pā--va
ce_text: eṣā te rāṣṭravṛttiś ca rāṣṭraguptiś ca bhārata / etam evārtham āśritya bhūyo vakṣyāmi pāṇḍava

vulgate_text: mattātpramattātpaugaṇḍādunmattācca viśeṣataḥ / ninditāccāsadācārāddurhṛdāṃ cāpi sevanāt
ce_text: mattāt pramattāt pogaṇḍād unmattāc ca viśeṣataḥ / tadabhyāsād upāvartād ahitānāṃ ca sevanāt

vulgate_text: agnitretā trayī vidyā yajñāśca sahadakṣiṇāḥ / sarva eva pramuhyante yadā rājā pramādyati
ce_text: cāturvarṇyaṃ tathā vedāś cāturāśramyam eva ca / sarvaṃ pramuhyate hy etad yadā rājā pramādyati

vulgate_text: mā sma tāta balasthastvaṃ bhuñjīthā durbalaṃ janam / mā tvāṃ durbalacakṣūṃṣi dahantvagnirivāśayam
ce_text: mā sma tāta bale stheyā bādhiṣṭhā māpi durbalam / mā tvā durbalacakṣūṃṣi dhakṣyanty agnir ivāśrayam

vulgate_text: saṃvibhajya yadā bhuṅkte nṛpatirdurbalānnarān / tadā bhavanti balinaḥ sa rājño dharma ucyate
ce_text: saṃvibhajya yadā bhuṅkte na cānyān avamanyate / nihanti balinaṃ dṛptaṃ sa rājño dharma ucyate

vulgate_text: pāpamācarato yatra karmaṇā vyāhṛtena vā / priyasyāpi na mṛṣyeta sa rājño dharma ucyate
ce_text: trāyate hi yadā sarvaṃ vācā kāyena karmaṇā / putrasyāpi na mṛṣyec ca sa rājño dharma ucyate

vulgate_text: evametairguṇairyukto yo'nurajyati bhūmipam / bharturartheṣvapramattaṃ niyuñjyādarthakarmaṇi
ce_text: evam eva guṇair yukto yo na rajyati bhūmipam / bhartur artheṣv asūyantaṃ na taṃ yuñjīta karmaṇi

vulgate_text: agrāmyacaritāṃ vṛttiṃ yo na seveta nityadā / jitānāmajitānāṃ ca kṣatradharmādapaiti saḥ
ce_text: yo 'tyantācaritāṃ vṛttiṃ kṣatriyo nānuvartate / jitānām ajitānāṃ ca kṣatradharmād apaiti saḥ

vulgate_text: yaḥ kalyāṇaguṇāñjñātīnpradveṣānno bubhūṣati / adṛḍhātmā dṛḍhakrodhaḥ nāsyārtho vasate'ntike
ce_text: yaḥ kalyāṇaguṇāñ jñātīn dveṣān naivābhimanyate / adṛḍhātmā dṛḍhakrodho nāsyārtho ramate 'ntike

vulgate_text: yasya yodhāḥ susaṃtuṣṭāḥ svanuraktāḥ supūjitāḥ / alpenāpi sa daṇḍena mahīṃ jayati pārthivaḥ
ce_text: yasya yodhāḥ susaṃtuṣṭāḥ sāntvitāḥ sūpadhāsthitāḥ / alpenāpi sa daṇḍena mahīṃ jayati bhūmipaḥ

vulgate_text: paurajānapadā yasya svanuraktā apīḍitāḥ / rāṣṭrakarmakarā hyete rāṣṭrasya ca virodhinaḥ
ce_text: paurajānapadā yasya svanuraktāḥ supūjitāḥ / sadhanā dhānyavantaś ca dṛḍhamūlaḥ sa pārthivaḥ

vulgate_text: maryādāṃ śāśvatīṃ bhindyādbrāhmaṇaṃ yo'bhilaṅghayet atha cellaṅghayedeva maryādāṃ kṣatriyabruvaḥ / asaṅkhyepatadūrdhvaṃ syādanādeyaśca saṃsadi
ce_text: atha cel laṅghayed enāṃ maryādāṃ kṣatriyabruvaḥ / apraśasyas tad ūrdhvaṃ syād anādeyaś ca saṃsadi

vulgate_text: raṇeṣu kadanaṃ kṛtvā suhṛdbhiḥ pratipūjita / tīkṣṇaiḥ śastrairabhikliṣṭaḥ kṣatriyo mutyumarhati
ce_text: raṇeṣu kadanaṃ kṛtvā jñātibhiḥ parivāritaḥ / tīkṣṇaiḥ śastraiḥ suvikliṣṭaḥ kṣatriyo mṛtyum arhati

vulgate_text: sarvatejomayaṃ divyaṃ vimānavaramāsthitam / u---gacchantaṃ sthānaṃ senāpatiṃ śubham
ce_text: sarvatejomayaṃ divyaṃ vimānavaram āsthitam / upary upari gacchantaṃ svaṃ vai senāpatiṃ prabhum

vulgate_text: de--ja sudevo'yaṃ mama senāpatiḥ purā āsādyodhaḥ praśāntātmā so'yaṃ kasmādatīva mām / vimānaṃ sūryasaṅkāśamāsthito modate divi
ce_text: devarāja sudevo 'yaṃ mama senāpatiḥ purā / āsīd yodhaḥ praśāntātmā so 'yaṃ kasmād atīva mām

vulgate_text: [saṅkhyāsamayavistīrṇamabhijātodbhavaṃ bahu ] āvedhādyacca rudhiraṃ saṃgrāme sravate bhuvi / sā'sya pūrṇāhutirhotraiḥ samṛddhā sarvakāmadhuk
ce_text: āvegād yat tu rudhiraṃ saṃgrāme syandate bhuvi / sāsya pūrṇāhutir hotre samṛddhā sarvakāmadhuk

vulgate_text: udgātā tatra saṃgrāme trisāmā dundubhirnṛpa brahmasve hriyamāṇe tu tyaktvā yuddhe priyāṃ tanum / ātmānaṃ yūpamucchritya sa yajño'nantadakṣiṇaḥ
ce_text: brāhmaṇārthe samutpanne yo 'bhiniḥsṛtya yudhyate / ātmānaṃ yūpam ucchritya sa yajño 'nantadakṣiṇaḥ

vulgate_text: yasya bhayato vyūhe bhavatyākāśamagrataḥ / sāsya vedistadā yajñairnityaṃ vyūhāstrayo'gnayaḥ
ce_text: yadā tūbhayato vyūho bhavaty ākāśam agrataḥ / sāsya vedī tathā yajñe nityaṃ vedās trayo 'gnayaḥ

vulgate_text: [agrataḥ puruṣānīkaṃ śaktaṃ cāpi kulodbhavam ] āvāsastoyavānmārgaḥ paryākāśaḥ praśasyate
ce_text: āvāsas toyavān durgaḥ paryākāśaḥ praśasyate / pareṣām upasarpāṇāṃ pratiṣedhas tathā bhavet

vulgate_text: bahubhirguṇajātaiśca ye yuddhakuśalā janāḥ [upanyāso bhavettatra balānāṃ nātidūrataḥ ]
ce_text: ākāśaṃ tu vanābhyāśe manyante guṇavattaram / bahubhir guṇajātais tu ye yuddhakuśalā janāḥ

vulgate_text: [na sannipāte pradaraṃ vadhaṃ vā kuryurīdṛśāḥ ] ātmānaṃ ca svapakṣaṃ ca pālayanhanti saṃyuge
ce_text: ātmānaṃ ca svapakṣaṃ ca palāyan hanti saṃyuge / dravyanāśo vadho 'kīrtir ayaśaś ca palāyane

vulgate_text: pratidhvastoṣṭhadantasya nyastasarvāyudhasya ca hitvā palāyamānasya sahāyānprāṇasaṃśaye / amitrairavaruddhasya dviṣatāmastu naḥ sadā
ce_text: hitvā palāyamānasya sahāyān prāṇasaṃśaye / amitrair anubaddhasya dviṣatām astu nas tathā

vulgate_text: udbandhā iva sugrīvā vinatāvihagā iva / piṇḍaśīrṣātivakrāśca pṛṣadaṃśamukhāstathā
ce_text: udvṛttāś caiva sugrīvā vinatā vihagā iva / piṇḍaśīrṣāhivaktrāś ca vṛṣadaṃśamukhā iva

vulgate_text: jayinyāḥ kāni rūpāṇi bhavanti bharatarṣabha / pṛtanāyāḥ praśastāni tāni cecchāmi veditum
ce_text: jaitryā vā kāni rūpāṇi bhavanti puruṣarṣabha / pṛtanāyāḥ praśastāni tānīhecchāmi veditum

vulgate_text: saṃsarpeṇa hi senāyā bhayaṃ bhīrūnprabādhate / vajrādiya prajvalitādiyaṃ svitkṣapayiṣyati
ce_text: saṃsarpaṇād dhi senāyā bhayaṃ bhīrūn prabādhate / vajrād iva prajvalitād iyaṃ kva nu patiṣyati

vulgate_text: na me priyā ye sma hatāḥ saṃprahṛṣṭāḥ pare'pi ca / na ca katthanamevāgryamucyamānaṃ punaḥ punaḥ
ce_text: na me priyaṃ yat sa hataḥ saṃprāhaivaṃ puro vacaḥ / na cakartha ca me vākyam ucyamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ

vulgate_text: saṃpradhārya sahāmātyairmantravidbhirmahātmabhiḥ upekṣyamāṇo vijñāto hṛdayenāparājitaḥ / athāsya praharetkāle vidhervittalito yadā
ce_text: saṃpradhārya sahāmātyair mantravidbhir mahātmabhiḥ / upekṣamāṇo 'vajñāte hṛdayenāparājitaḥ

vulgate_text: dīrghakālamapīkṣetta nigrāhyā eva śatravaḥ / kālakāṅgī ca yuktaḥ sannupāsīta śacīpate
ce_text: dīrghakālam api kṣāntvā vihanyād eva śātravān / kālākāṅkṣī yāmayec ca yathā visrambham āpnuyuḥ

vulgate_text: tathā priyaṃ ca vaktavyaṃ yathā visrambhamāpnuyāt na sadyo'rīnvihanyācca draṣṭavyo vijayo dhruvaḥ / bhūyaḥ śalyaṃ ghaṭayati navaṃ ca kurute vraṇam
ce_text: na sadyo 'rīn vinirhanyād dṛṣṭasya vijayo 'jvaraḥ / na yaḥ śalyaṃ ghaṭṭayati navaṃ ca kurute vraṇam

vulgate_text: aujasyaṃ janayedeva saṃgṛhṇansādhusaṃmatam / kālena sādhayetkṛtyamaprāpto na hi pīḍayet
ce_text: aurjasthyaṃ vijayed evaṃ saṃgṛhṇan sādhusaṃmatān / kālena sādhayen nityaṃ nāprāpte 'bhinipīḍayet

vulgate_text: tāṃ buddhimanuvijñāya tvamevainānparityaja / anarthāścārtharūpeṇa hyarthāścānartharūpiṇaḥ
ce_text: tāṃ buddhim upajijñāsus tvam evainān parityaja / anarthāṃś cārtharūpeṇa arthāṃś cānartharūpataḥ

vulgate_text: bravītu bhagavānnītimabhipanno'smyadhīhi bho / amogha eva me'dyāstu tvayā saha samāgamaḥ
ce_text: bravītu bhagavān nītim upapanno 'smy ahaṃ prabho / amogham idam adyāstu tvayā saha samāgatam

vulgate_text: dātumarhati te vittaṃ vaidehaḥ satyavikramaḥ / pramāṇaṃ sarvabhūteṣu pragrahaṃ ca gamiṣyasi
ce_text: pramāṇaṃ sarvabhūteṣu pragrahaṃ ca gamiṣyasi / tataḥ sahāyān sotsāhāṃl lapsyase 'vyasanāñ śucīn

vulgate_text: yadyevaṃ pratiṣeddhavyo yadyupekṣaṇamarhati sadaiva rājaśārdūla viduṣā hitamicchatā / na jātu vivṛtaḥ kāryaḥ śatruḥ sunayamicchatā
ce_text: yady eva pratiṣeddhavyo yady upekṣaṇam arhati / na jātu vivṛtaḥ kāryaḥ śatrur vinayam icchatā

vulgate_text: vasasva puramāmitraṃ viṣaye mitrasaṃmataḥ / bhajasva śvetakākīyairmitradharmamanathaikaiḥ
ce_text: vasasva paramāmitraviṣaye prājñasaṃmate / bhajasva śvetakākīyair mitrādhamam anarthakaiḥ

vulgate_text: dharmātmanāṃ kvacilloke nānyāsti gatirīdṛśī tadā rājaputro'yaṃ satāṃ mārgamanuṣṭhitaḥ / asaṃgṛhītastvevaiṣa tvayā dharmapurogamaḥ
ce_text: kṛtātmā rājaputro 'yaṃ satāṃ mārgam anuṣṭhitaḥ / susaṃgṛhītas tv evaiṣa tvayā dharmapurogamaḥ / saṃsevyamānaḥ śatrūṃs te gṛhṇīyān mahato gaṇān

vulgate_text: bhede gaṇā vinaśyurhi bhinnāstu sujayāḥ paraiḥ / tasmātsaṃghātayogena prayaterangaṇāḥ sadā
ce_text: bhedād gaṇā vinaśyanti bhinnāḥ sūpajapāḥ paraiḥ / tasmāt saṃghātayogeṣu prayateran gaṇāḥ sadā

vulgate_text: yena prīṇanti pitarastena prītaḥ prajāpatiḥ / prīṇāti jananīyena pṛthivī tena pūjitā
ce_text: yena prītāś ca pitaras tena prītaḥ pitāmahaḥ / prīṇāti mātaraṃ yena pṛthivī tena pūjitā

vulgate_text: ṛṣayaśca hi devāśca prīyante pitṛbhiḥ saha / pūjyamāneṣu guruṣu tasmātpūjyatamo guruḥ
ce_text: yena prīṇāty upādhyāyaṃ tena syād brahma pūjitam / mātṛtaḥ pitṛtaś caiva tasmāt pūjyatamo guruḥ / ṛṣayaś ca hi devāś ca prīyante pitṛbhiḥ saha

vulgate_text: bhṛto bhartāraṃ yo na vibhirti putraḥ svayonijaḥ pitaraṃ mātaraṃ ca / tasya pāpaṃ bhrūṇahatyāviṣiṣṭaṃ tasmānnānyaḥ pāpakṛdasti loke
ce_text: upādhyāyaṃ pitaraṃ mātaraṃ ca ye 'bhidruhyanti manasā karmaṇā vā / teṣāṃ pāpaṃ bhrūṇahatyāviśiṣṭaṃ tasmān nānyaḥ pāpakṛd asti loke

vulgate_text: śrutiṃ dharmaṃ vadantyanye mānānyāhuḥ pare janāḥ / na ca taṃ svabhyasūyāmo na hi sarvaṃ vidhīyate
ce_text: śrutidharma iti hy eke nety āhur apare janāḥ / na tu tat pratyasūyāmo na hi sarvaṃ vidhīyate

vulgate_text: ye'nye vā'pyanṛtaṃ kuryuḥ kuryādeva vicāraṇam / śreyastatrānṛtaṃ vaktuṃ satyāditi vicāritam
ce_text: śreyas tatrānṛtaṃ vaktuṃ satyād iti vicāritam / yaḥ pāpaiḥ saha saṃbandhān mucyate śapathād iti

vulgate_text: yaḥ pāpaiḥ saha saṃbandhānmucyate śapathādapi na ca tebhyo dhanaṃ dadyācchakye sati kathaṃcana / pāpebhyo hi dhanaṃ dattaṃ dātāramapi pīḍayet
ce_text: na ca tebhyo dhanaṃ deyaṃ śakye sati kathaṃ cana / pāpebhyo hi dhanaṃ dattaṃ dātāram api pīḍayet

vulgate_text: yaḥ kaściddharmasamayātpracyuto dharmajīvanaḥ / daṇḍenaiva sa hantavyastaṃ panthānaṃ samāśritaḥ
ce_text: pratiśrutya tu dātavyaṃ śvaḥkāryas tu balātkṛtaḥ / yaḥ kaś cid dharmasamayāt pracyuto 'dharmam āsthitaḥ

vulgate_text: cyutaḥ sadaiva dharmebhyo dhanavāndharmamāśritaḥ / kathaṃ svadharmamutsṛjya tamicchedupajīvitum
ce_text: śaṭhaḥ svadharmam utsṛjya tam icched upajīvitum / sarvopāyair nihantavyaḥ pāpo nikṛtijīvanaḥ

vulgate_text: avivāhyā hyasaṃbhojyā nikṛtyā nirayaṃ gatāḥ cyutā devamanuṣyebhyo yathā pretāstathaiva te / [niryajñāstapasā hīnā mā sma taiḥ saha saṃgamaḥ ]
ce_text: cyutā devamanuṣyebhyo yathā pretās tathaiva te / dhanādānād duḥkhataraṃ jīvitād viprayojanam

vulgate_text: pratyāhurnocyamānā ye na hiṃsanti ca hiṃsitāḥ / prayacchanti na yācante durgāṇyatitaranti te
ce_text: ye na mānitam icchanti mānayanti ca ye param / mānyamānā na manyante durgāṇy atitaranti te

vulgate_text: lokarakṣārthamutpannamadityāṃ kaśyapātmajam / devamindraṃ namasyanti durgāṇyatitaranti te
ce_text: sarvān devān namasyanti sarvān dharmāṃś ca śṛṇvate / ye śraddadhānā dāntāś ca durgāṇy atitaranti te

vulgate_text: tīkṣṇā iti vayaṃ khyātā bhavantaṃ jñāpayāmahe / mṛdupūrvaṃ praśādhi tvaṃ śreyaścādhigamiṣyasi
ce_text: tīkṣṇā vayam iti khyātā bhavato jñāpayāmahe / mṛdupūrvaṃ ghātinas te śreyaś cādhigamiṣyati

vulgate_text: idaṃ tasyedṛśaṃ karma kiṃ tena na kṛtaṃ bhavet / śrutaśca svāminā pūrvaṃ yādṛśo naiva tādṛśaḥ
ce_text: idaṃ cāsyedṛśaṃ karma vāllabhyena tu rakṣyate / śrutaś ca svāminā pūrvaṃ yādṛśo naiṣa tādṛśaḥ

vulgate_text: kāryārthaṃ bhojanādyeṣu vrateṣu kṛtavāñśramam / yadi vipratyayo hyeṣa tadidaṃ darśayām te
ce_text: vāṅmātreṇaiva dharmiṣṭhaḥ svabhāvena tu dāruṇaḥ / dharmacchadmā hy ayaṃ pāpo vṛthācāraparigrahaḥ / kāryārthaṃ bhojanārtheṣu vrateṣu kṛtavāñ śramam

vulgate_text: sa hatvā bhakṣayitvā ca tamuṣṭraṃ jambukastadā / vigate vātavarpe tu niścakrāma guhodarāt
ce_text: sa hatvā bhakṣayitvā ca jambukoṣṭraṃ tatas tadā / vigate vātavarṣe ca niścakrāma guhāmukhāt

vulgate_text: ākruśya dūṣyamāṇaśca sukṛtaṃ tasya vindati / duṣkṛtaṃ cātmano marṣī tasminneva pramārjati
ce_text: aruṣyan kruśyamānasya sukṛtaṃ nāma vindati / duṣkṛtaṃ cātmano marṣī ruṣyaty evāpamārṣṭi vai

vulgate_text: etanme cintayānasya rājadharmāndivāniśam / bṛhaspatisamo buddhyā bhavāñśaṃsitumarhati
ce_text: etān me saṃśayasthasya rājadharmān sudurlabhān / bṛhaspatisamo buddhyā bhavāñ śaṃsitum arhati

vulgate_text: pra--karaṭaḥ prāṃśuḥ pajhī vitatakumbhakaḥ / su--ṇo mahākāyo meghagambhīraniḥ svanaḥ
ce_text: prabhinnakaraṭaḥ prāṃśuḥ padmī vitatamastakaḥ / suviṣāṇo mahākāyo meghagambhīranisvanaḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ kṣudrasamācāro balena ca samanvitaḥ / iyeṣa taṃ muniṃ hantumakṛtajñaḥ kṛtānvayaḥ
ce_text: tato rudhiratarṣeṇa balinā śarabho 'nvitaḥ / iyeṣa taṃ muniṃ hantum akṛtajñaḥ śvayonijaḥ

vulgate_text: siṃhastvaṃ balamāpanno bhūyaḥ śarabhatāṃ gataḥ / mayā snehaparītena visṛṣṭo na kulānvayaḥ
ce_text: siṃho 'tibalasaṃyukto bhūyaḥ śarabhatāṃ gataḥ / mayā snehaparītena na vimṛṣṭaḥ kulānvayaḥ

ce_text: vināśaś cāpy anarho 'sya sukhaṃ prāpsyatha mānuṣāḥ / putraśokāgnidagdhānāṃ mṛtam apy adya vaḥ kṣamam

vulgate_text: svairaṃ rudanto visrabdhāściraṃ snehena paśyata / dāruṇe'sminvanoddeśe bhayaṃ vo na bhaviṣyati
ce_text: svairaṃ rudata visrabdhāḥ svairaṃ snehena paśyata / sthīyatāṃ yāvad ādityaḥ kiṃ vaḥ kravyādabhāṣitaiḥ

vulgate_text: ayaṃ saumyo vanoddeśaḥ pitṛṇāṃ nidhanākaraḥ sthīyatāṃ yāvadādityaḥ kiṃvaḥ kravyādabhāṣitaiḥ
ce_text: svairaṃ rudata visrabdhāḥ svairaṃ snehena paśyata / sthīyatāṃ yāvad ādityaḥ kiṃ vaḥ kravyādabhāṣitaiḥ

vulgate_text: devyā praṇodito devaḥ kāruṇyārdrīkṛtekṣaṇaḥ / tatastānāha manujānvarado'smīti śaṃkaraḥ
ce_text: tatas tān āha manujān varado 'smīti śūlabhṛt / te pratyūcur idaṃ vākyaṃ duḥkhitāḥ praṇatāḥ sthitāḥ

vulgate_text: tataste tvaritā rājaṃstyaktvā śokaṃ śiśūdbhavam / viviśuḥ putramādāya nagaraṃ hṛṣṭamānasāḥ
ce_text: tatas te tvaritā rājañ śrutvā śokam aghodbhavam / viviśuḥ putram ādāya nagaraṃ hṛṣṭamānasāḥ / eṣā buddhiḥ samastānāṃ cāturvarṇye nidarśitā

vulgate_text: na me vāyuḥ sakhā brahmanna bandhurmama nārada / ciraṃ me prīyate naiva yena māṃ rakṣate'nilaḥ
ce_text: na me vāyuḥ sakhā brahman na bandhur na ca me suhṛt / parameṣṭhī tathā naiva yena rakṣati mānilaḥ

vulgate_text: āgacchanparuṣo vāyurmayā viṣṭambhito balāt / bhañjandrumānparvatāṃśca yaccānyatsthāṇujaṅgamam
ce_text: āgacchan paramo vāyur mayā viṣṭambhito balāt / rujan drumān parvatāṃś ca yac cānyad api kiṃ cana

vulgate_text: te'pi jānanti vāyośca balamātmana eva ca / tasmātte nāvamanyante śvasanaṃ tarusattamāḥ
ce_text: taiś cāpi naivaṃ durbuddhe kṣipto vāyuḥ kṛtātmabhiḥ / te hi jānanti vāyoś ca balam ātmana eva ca

vulgate_text: tvaṃ tu mohānna jānīpe vāyorbalamanantakam / evaṃ tasmādgamiṣyāmi sakāśaṃ mātariśvanaḥ
ce_text: tasmāt te vai namasyanti śvasanaṃ drumasattamāḥ / tvaṃ tu mohān na jānīṣe vāyor balam anantakam

vulgate_text: tasya viśramaṇādeva prasādau matkṛtastava / abhūttasya prasādāttvāṃ na bhajyāmi drumādham
ce_text: tasya viśramaṇād eva prasādo yaḥ kṛtas tava / rakṣyase tena durbuddhe nātmavīryād drumādhama

vulgate_text: dharmavaitaṃsikāḥ kṣudrā muṣṇanti dhvajino jagat kurvate ca bahūnmārgāṃstānhetubalamāśritāḥ / sarvamārgānvilumpanti lobhajñāneṣvavasthitāḥ
ce_text: kurvate ca bahūn mārgāṃs tāṃs tān hetubalāśritāḥ / sarvaṃ mārgaṃ vilumpanti lobhājñāneṣu niṣṭhitāḥ

vulgate_text: na trāsino na capalā na raudrāḥ satpathe sthitāḥ / te sevyāḥ sādhubhirnityamasādhūṃśca vivarjayet
ce_text: na teṣāṃ bhidyate vṛttaṃ yat purā sādhubhiḥ kṛtam / na trāsino na capalā na raudrāḥ satpathe sthitāḥ

vulgate_text: etasya vā pravṛtteśca vṛddhyādīnyāṃśca pṛcchasi / vistareṇa mahārāja śṛṇu tacca viśeṣataḥ
ce_text: etayā yā pravṛttiś ca vṛddhyādīn yāṃś ca pṛcchasi / vistareṇa mahābāho śṛṇu tac ca viśāṃ pate

vulgate_text: kāmaṃ krādhaṃ ca lobhaṃ ca darpaṃ stambhaṃ vikatthanam / roṣamīrṣyāvamānaṃ ca naiva dānto niṣevate
ce_text: kāmaḥ krodhaś ca lobhaś ca darpaḥ stambho vikatthanam / moha īrṣyāvamānaś cety etad dānto na sevate

vulgate_text: śakunīnāmivākāśe matsyānāṃmiva codake / yathā gatirna dṛśyeta tathā tasya sa saṃśayaḥ
ce_text: śakunīnām ivākāśe jale vāricarasya vā / yathā gatir na dṛśyeta tathā tasya na saṃśayaḥ

vulgate_text: tapasaiva sasarjānnaṃ phalamūlāni yāni ca / trīm̐llokāṃstapasā siddhāḥ paśyanti susamāhitāḥ
ce_text: tapaso hy ānupūrvyeṇa phalamūlānilāśanāḥ / trīṃl lokāṃs tapasā siddhāḥ paśyanti susamāhitāḥ

vulgate_text: yaddurāpaṃ durārādhyaṃ durādharṣaṃ durutsaham tatsarvaṃ tapasā śakyaṃ tapo hi duratikramam / aiśvaryamṛṣayaḥ prāptāstapasaiva na saṃśayaḥ
ce_text: yad durāpaṃ durāmnāyaṃ durādharṣaṃ durutsaham / sarvaṃ tat tapasā śakyaṃ tapo hi duratikramam

vulgate_text: indriyāṇīha rakṣanti viprarṣipitṛdevatāḥ / tasmādarthe ca dharme ca tapo nānaśanātparam
ce_text: indriyāṇīha rakṣanti dhanadhānyābhiguptaye / tasmād arthe ca dharme ca tapo nānaśanāt param

vulgate_text: prāpyate ca yathā satyaṃ tacca vettumihārhasi / satyaṃ trayodaśāvadhaṃ sarvalokeṣu bhārata
ce_text: prāpyate hi yathā satyaṃ tac ca śrotuṃ tvam arhasi / satyaṃ trayodaśavidhaṃ sarvalokeṣu bhārata

vulgate_text: kalyāṇaṃ rute bāḍhaṃ dhīmānna glāyate kvacit / praśāntavāṅbhanā nityaṃ hrīstu dharmādavāpyate
ce_text: kalyāṇaṃ kurute gāḍhaṃ hrīmān na ślāghate kva cit / praśāntavāṅmanā nityaṃ hrīs tu dharmād avāpyate

vulgate_text: dhyānaṃ ca śāṭhyamityuktaṃ maunenaitadavāpyate āryatā nāma bhūtānāṃ yaḥ karoti prayatnataḥ / śubhaṃ karma nirākāro vītarāgastathaiva ca
ce_text: āryatā nāma bhūtānāṃ yaḥ karoti prayatnataḥ / śubhaṃ karma nirākāro vītarāgatvam eva ca

vulgate_text: eteṣāmudayaṃ sthānaṃ kṣayaṃ ca pṛthivīpate hanta te kathayiṣyāmi krodhasyotpattimāditaḥ / yathātattvaṃ kṣitipate tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu
ce_text: eteṣām udayaṃ sthānaṃ kṣayaṃ ca puruṣottama / hanta te vartayiṣyāmi tan me nigadataḥ śṛṇu

vulgate_text: saṃkalpājjāyate kāmaḥ sevyamāno vivardhate / yadā prājño viramate tadā sadyaḥ praṇaśyati
ce_text: saṃkalpāj jāyate kāmaḥ sevyamāno vivardhate / avadyadarśanād vyeti tattvajñānāc ca dhīmatām

vulgate_text: [parāmūyā krodhalobhāvantarā pratimucyate dayayā sarvabhūtānāṃ nirvedādvinivartate ] / avadyadarśanādeti tattvajñānācca naśyati
ce_text: saṃkalpāj jāyate kāmaḥ sevyamāno vivardhate / avadyadarśanād vyeti tattvajñānāc ca dhīmatām

vulgate_text: viruddhānīha śāstrāṇi ye paśyanti kurūdvaha / vidhitsā jāyate teṣāṃ tattvajñānānnivartate
ce_text: viruddhāni hi śāstrāṇi paśyantīhālpabuddhayaḥ / vivitsā jāyate tatra tattvajñānān nivartate

vulgate_text: anyebhyo vimalācārā yajante guṇataḥ sadā yasya traivārpikaṃ bhaktaṃ paryāptaṃ bhṛtyavṛttaye / adhikaṃ cāpi vidyeta sa somaṃ pātumarhati
ce_text: yasya traivārṣikaṃ bhaktaṃ paryāptaṃ bhṛtyavṛttaye / adhikaṃ vāpi vidyeta sa somaṃ pātum arhati

vulgate_text: adātṛbhyo haredvittaṃ vikhyāpya nṛpatiḥ sadā / tathaivācarato dharmo nṛpateḥ syādathākhilaḥ

vulgate_text: prabhuḥ prathamakalpasya yo'nukalpena vartate / sa nāpnoti phalaṃ tasya pretya ceha ca durmatiḥ
ce_text: prabhuḥ prathamakalpasya yo 'nukalpena vartate / na sāṃparāyikaṃ tasya durmater vidyate phalam

vulgate_text: na brāhmaṇo vedayīta kiṃcidrājani dharmavit avidyāvedanādvidyātsvavīryaṃ vīryavattaram / tasmādrājñaḥ sadā tejo duḥsahaṃ brahmavādinām
ce_text: na brāhmaṇān vedayeta kaś cid rājani mānavaḥ / avīryo vedanād vidyāt suvīryo vīryavattaram

vulgate_text: narake nipatantyete juhvānāḥ savanasya tat / tasmādvaitānakuśalo hotā syādvedapāragaḥ
ce_text: na vai kanyā na yuvatir nāmantro na ca bāliśaḥ / pariveṣṭāgnihotrasya bhaven nāsaṃskṛtas tathā / narake nipatanty ete juhvānāḥ sa ca yasya tat

vulgate_text: abhāryī śayane vibhracchūdraṃ vṛddhaṃ ca vai dvijaḥ abrāhmaṇaṃ bhanyamānastṛṇeṣvāsīta pṛṣṭhataḥ / tathā saṃśudhyate rājañśṛṇu cātra vaco mama
ce_text: anāryāṃ śayane bibhrad ujjhan bibhrac ca yo dvijām / abrāhmaṇo manyamānas tṛṇeṣv āsīta pṛṣṭhataḥ / tathā sa śudhyate rājañ śṛṇu cātra vaco mama

vulgate_text: na narmayuktamatṛtaṃ hinasti na strīṣu rājanna vivāhakāle / prāṇātyaye sarvadhanāpahāre pañcānṛtānyāhurapātakāni
ce_text: na narmayuktaṃ vacanaṃ hinasti na strīṣu rājan na vivāhakāle / na gurvarthe nātmano jīvitārthe pañcānṛtāny āhur apātakāni

vulgate_text: gobrāhmaṇahitārthaṃ ca varṇānāṃ saṃkareṣu ca / vaiśyo gṛhṇīta śastrāṇi paritrāṇārthamātmanaḥ
ce_text: gobrāhmaṇahitārthaṃ ca varṇānāṃ saṃkareṣu ca / gṛhṇīyāt tu dhanur vaiśyaḥ paritrāṇāya cātmanaḥ

vulgate_text: surāpo brahmahā caiva gurutalpagatastathā / acireṇa mahārāja patito vai bhavatyuta
ce_text: patitaiḥ saṃprayogāc ca brāhmaṇair yonitas tathā / acireṇa mahārāja tādṛśo vai bhavaty uta

vulgate_text: astenaṃ stena ityuktvā dviguṇaṃ pāpamāpnuyāt tribhāgaṃ brahmahatyāyāḥ kanyāṃ prāpnoti duṣyati / yastu dūṣayitā tasyāḥ śeṣaṃ prāpnoti pāpmanaḥ
ce_text: tribhāgaṃ brahmahatyāyāḥ kanyā prāpnoti duṣyatī / yas tu dūṣayitā tasyāḥ śeṣaṃ prāpnoti kilbiṣam

vulgate_text: aśvamedhena vā'pīṣṭvā athavā gosavena vā / marutsomena vā samyagiha pretya ca pūjyate

vulgate_text: tathaiva dvādaśasamāḥ kāpotaṃ dharmamācaret / ekakālaṃ caredbhaikṣaṃ svakarmodāharañjane
ce_text: tathaiva dvādaśa samāḥ kapālī brahmahā bhavet / brahmacārī cared bhaikṣaṃ svakarmodāharan muniḥ

vulgate_text: evaṃ vā tapasā yukto brahmahā savanī bhavet / evaṃ garbhamavijñātamātreyīṃ vā nipātayet
ce_text: evaṃ vā tapasā yukto brahmahā savanī bhavet / evaṃ vā garbham ajñātā cātreyīṃ yo 'bhigacchati / dviguṇā brahmahatyā vai ātreyīvyasane bhavet

vulgate_text: uktaḥ paśuvadhe doṣo rājanprāṇinipātanāt anasthikeṣu gomūtraṃ pānamekaṃ pracakṣate / prāyaścittānyathānyāni pravakṣyāmyanupūrvaśaḥ

vulgate_text: apakhyahaṃ pibeduṣṇāḥ saṃyatātmā jitendriyaḥ / apaḥ pītvā tu sa punarvāyubhakṣo bhaventryaham

vulgate_text: chinne ca kārmuke rājanprakṣīṇeṣu śareṣu ca / khaṅgena śakyate yoddhumātmānaṃ parirakṣitum
ce_text: viśīrṇe kārmuke rājan prakṣīṇeṣu ca vājiṣu / khaḍgena śakyate yuddhe sādhv ātmā parirakṣitum

vulgate_text: marīciṃ bhṛgumatriṃ ca pulastyaṃ pulahaṃ kratum / vasiṣṭhāṅgirasau cobhau bharadvājaṃ tathaiva ca
ce_text: marīcim ṛṣim atriṃ ca pulastyaṃ pulahaṃ kratum / vasiṣṭhāṅgirasau cobhau rudraṃ ca prabhum īśvaram

vulgate_text: na jagmuḥ saṃvidaṃ taiśca darpādasurasattamāḥ / atha vai bhagavānbrahmā sarvalokanamaskṛtaḥ
ce_text: na priyaṃ nāpy anukrośaṃ cakrur bhūteṣu bhārata / trīn upāyān atikramya daṇḍena rurudhuḥ prajāḥ / na jagmuḥ saṃvidaṃ taiś ca darpād asurasattamāḥ

vulgate_text: lonītpalasavarṇābhaṃ tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭraṃ kṛśodaram / prāṃśumuddharṣaṇaṃ cāpi tathaiva hyamitaujasam
ce_text: nīlotpalasavarṇābhaṃ tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭraṃ kṛśodaram / prāṃśu durdarśanaṃ caivāpy atitejas tathaiva ca

vulgate_text: asminnutpadyamāne ca pracacāsa vasuṃdharā / mahormikalilāvartaśrukṣubhe sa mahodadhiḥ
ce_text: tasminn utpatamāne ca pracacāla vasuṃdharā / tatrormikalilāvartaś cukṣubhe ca mahārṇavaḥ

vulgate_text: tatastu dānavānīkaṃ saṃpraṇetṛkamapyuta / khaṅgaṃ dṛṣṭvā balādhūtaṃ pramumoha cacāla ca
ce_text: tatas tad dānavānīkaṃ saṃpraṇetāram acyutam / rudrakhaḍgabaloddhūtaṃ pracacāla mumoha ca

vulgate_text: tasminmahati saṃvṛtte samare bhṛśadāruṇe / babhūva bhūḥ pratibhayā māṃsaśoṇitakardamā

vulgate_text: tatastvailabilāllebhe dhundhumāro nareśvaraḥ / dhundhumārācca kāmbhojo mucukundastato'bhajat
ce_text: tataś caiḍabiḍāl lebhe dhundhumāro janeśvaraḥ / dhundhumārāc ca kāmbojo mucukundas tato 'labhat

vulgate_text: agryaḥ praharaṇānāṃ ca khaṅgo bhuvi pariśrutaḥ maheśvarapraṇītaśca purāṇe niścayaṃ gataḥ / etāni caiva nāmāni purāṇe niścitāni vai
ce_text: agryaḥ praharaṇānāṃ ca khaḍgo mādravatīsuta / maheśvarapraṇītaś ca purāṇe niścayaṃ gataḥ

vulgate_text: ityeṣa prathamaḥ kalpo mayā te kathitaḥ punaḥ / evamevāsisargo'yaṃ yathāvadbharatarṣabha
ce_text: ity eṣa prathamaḥ kalpo vyākhyātas te suvistaraḥ / aser utpattisaṃsargo yathāvad bharatarṣabha

vulgate_text: tasmāddharmapradhānena bhavitavyaṃ yatātmanā / tathā ca sarvabhūteṣu vartitavyaṃ yatātmanā
ce_text: dharmo rājan guṇaśreṣṭho madhyamo hy artha ucyate / kāmo yavīyān iti ca pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ / tasmād dharmapradhānena bhavitavyaṃ yatātmanā

vulgate_text: samāptavacane tasminbhīmakarmā dhanañjayaḥ / tato'rthagatitattvajño jagau vākyaṃ pracoditaḥ
ce_text: samāptavacane tasminn arthaśāstraviśāradaḥ / pārtho vākyārthatattvajño jagau vākyam atandritaḥ

vulgate_text: duḥśīlo'thākṛtātmā ca nṛśaṃsaḥ kitavastathā / mitrairapakṛtirnityamaṭate'rthaṃ dhanepsayā
ce_text: duḥśīlo 'thākṛtātmā ca nṛśaṃsaḥ kitavas tathā / mitrair arthakṛtī nityam icchaty arthaparaś ca yaḥ

vulgate_text: dadataśca yathāśakti yo na tuṣyati mandadhīḥ / adhairyamapi yo yuṅkte sadā mitraṃ narādhamaḥ
ce_text: vahataś ca yathāśakti yo na tuṣyati mandadhīḥ / amitram iva yo bhuṅkte sadā mitraṃ nararṣabha

vulgate_text: alpe'pyapakṛte mūḍhe na saṃsmarani yatkṛtam kāryasevī ca mitreṣu mitradveṣī narādhipa
ce_text: alpe 'py apakṛte mūḍhas tathājñānāt kṛte 'pi ca / kāryopasevī mitreṣu mitradveṣī narādhipa

vulgate_text: kuṭusbārthaṃ ca dasyośca sāhāyyaṃ cāpyathākarot / so'vasadvarṣamekaṃ vai samṛddhe śabarālaye
ce_text: kuṭumbārtheṣu dasyoḥ sa sāhāyyaṃ cāpy athākarot / tatrāvasat so 'tha varṣāḥ samṛddhe śabarālaye / bāṇavedhye paraṃ yatnam akaroc caiva gautamaḥ

vulgate_text: bāṇavedhe paraṃ yatnamakaroccaiva gautamaḥ cakrāṅgānsa ca nityaṃ vai sarvato vanagocarān / jaghāna gautamo rājanyathā dasyugaṇāstathā
ce_text: vakrāṅgāṃs tu sa nityaṃ vai sarvato bāṇagocare / jaghāna gautamo rājan yathā dasyugaṇas tathā

vulgate_text: vinīto vedaśāstreṣu vedāntānāṃ ca pāragaḥ adṛśyata tatastatra sakhā tasyaiva tu dvijaḥ / taṃ dasyugrāmamagamadyatrāsau gautamo'bhavat
ce_text: vinīto niyatāhāro brahmaṇyo vedapāragaḥ / sabrahmacārī taddeśyaḥ sakhā tasyaiva supriyam / taṃ dasyugrāmam agamad yatrāsau gautamo 'bhavat

vulgate_text: tvaddarśanāttu viprendra kṛtārtho'smyadya vai dvija / adhvānaṃ saha yāsyāvaḥ śvo vasasvādya śarvarīm
ce_text: tvaddarśanāt tu viprarṣe kṛtārthaṃ vedmy ahaṃ dvija / ātmānaṃ saha yāsyāvaḥ śvo vasādyeha śarvarīm

vulgate_text: sa kathaṃcidbhayāttasmādvimukto prāyaśo'bhavat / kāṃdigbhūto jīvitārthī pradudrāvottarāṃ diśam
ce_text: sa kathaṃ cit tatas tasmāt sārthān mukto dvijas tadā / kāṃdigbhūto jīvitārthī pradudrāvottarāṃ diśam

vulgate_text: caturvidhā hyarthagatirbṛhaspatimataṃ yathā / mitraṃ vidyā hiraṇyaṃ ca buddhiśceti budhepsitā
ce_text: caturvidhā hy arthagatir bṛhaspatimataṃ yathā / pāraṃparyaṃ tathā daivaṃ karma mitram iti prabho

vulgate_text: pṛṣṭaśca gotracaraṇaṃ svādhyāyaṃ brahmacārikam / pṛṣṭo rājñā sa nājñāsīdgotramātramathābravīt

ce_text: iti tanmayam evaitat sarvaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam / pralīyate codbhavati tasmān nirdiśyate tathā

vulgate_text: mahābhūtāni pañcaiva sarvabhūteṣu bhūtakṛt / viṣayānkalpayāmāsa yasminyadanupaśyati
ce_text: mahābhūtāni pañcaiva sarvabhūteṣu bhūtakṛt / akarot teṣu vaiṣamyaṃ tat tu jīvo 'nu paśyati

vulgate_text: śabdaśrotre tathā khāni trayamākāśayonijam / rasaḥ snehaśca jihvā ca apāmete guṇāḥ smṛtāḥ
ce_text: śabdaḥ śrotraṃ tathā khāni trayam ākāśayonijam / vāyos tvaksparśaceṣṭāś ca vāg ity etac catuṣṭayam

vulgate_text: rūpaṃ cakṣurvipākaśca trividhaṃ jyotirūcyate / ghreyaṃ ghrāṇaṃ śarīraṃ ca ete bhūmiguṇāḥ smṛtāḥ
ce_text: ghreyaṃ ghrāṇaṃ śarīraṃ ca te tu bhūmiguṇās trayaḥ / mahābhūtāni pañcaiva ṣaṣṭhaṃ tu mana ucyate

vulgate_text: tamaḥ satvaṃ rajaśceti kālaḥ karma ca bhārata guṇairnenīyate buddhirbuddhirevendriyāṇi ca / manaḥ ṣaṣṭhāni sarvāṇi buddhyabhāve kuto guṇāḥ
ce_text: guṇān nenīyate buddhir buddhir evendriyāṇy api / manaḥṣaṣṭhāni sarvāṇi buddhyabhāve kuto guṇāḥ

vulgate_text: yena paśyati taccakṣuḥ śṛṇvatī śrotramucyate / jighratī bhavati ghrāṇaṃ rasatī rasanā rasān
ce_text: yena paśyati tac cakṣuḥ śṛṇoti śrotram ucyate / jighrati ghrāṇam ity āhū rasaṃ jānāti jihvayā

vulgate_text: sparśanaṃ sparśatī sparśānbuddhirvikriyate'sakṛt / yadā prārthayate kiṃcittadā bhavati sā manaḥ
ce_text: tvacā spṛśati ca sparśān buddhir vikriyate 'sakṛt / yena saṃkalpayaty arthaṃ kiṃ cid bhavati tan manaḥ

vulgate_text: adhiṣṭhānāni buddhyā hi pṛthagetāni pañcadhā / indriyāṇīti tānyāhusteṣu duṣṭeṣu duṣyati
ce_text: adhiṣṭhānāni buddher hi pṛthag arthāni pañcadhā / pañcendriyāṇi yāny āhus tāny adṛśyo 'dhitiṣṭhati

vulgate_text: liṅgāni rajasastāni dṛśyante hetvahetubhiḥ / avidyā rāgamohau ca pramādaḥ stabdhatā bhayam
ce_text: atuṣṭiḥ paritāpaś ca śoko lobhas tathākṣamā / liṅgāni rajasas tāni dṛśyante hetvahetubhiḥ

vulgate_text: asamṛddhistathā dainyaṃ pramohaḥ svapnatandritā / kathaṃcidupavartante vividhāstāmasā guṇāḥ
ce_text: abhimānas tathā mohaḥ pramādaḥ svapnatandritā / kathaṃ cid abhivartante vividhās tāmasā guṇāḥ

vulgate_text: pṛthagbhūtau prakṛtyā tu saṃprayuktau ca sarvadā / yathā matsyo'dbhiranyaḥ syātsaṃprayukto bhavettathā
ce_text: pṛthagbhūtau prakṛtyā tau saṃprayuktau ca sarvadā / yathā matsyo jalaṃ caiva saṃprayuktau tathaiva tau

vulgate_text: indriyaistu pradīpārthaṃ kriyate buddhirantarā / niścakṣurbhirajānadbhirindriyāṇi pradīpavat
ce_text: indriyais tu pradīpārthaṃ kurute buddhisaptamaiḥ / nirviceṣṭair ajānadbhiḥ paramātmā pradīpavat

vulgate_text: svabhāvasiddhamevaitadyadimānsṛjate guṇān / ūrṇanābhiryathā sūtraṃ vijñeyāstantuvadguṇāḥ
ce_text: svabhāvasiddhyā saṃsiddhān sa nityaṃ sṛjate guṇān / ūrṇanābhir yathā sraṣṭā vijñeyās tantuvad guṇāḥ

vulgate_text: yatkaroti bahudoṣamekata stacca dūṣayati yatpurā kṛtam / nāpriyaṃ tadubhayaṃ karotyasau yacca dūṣayati yatkaroti ca
ce_text: yat karoty anabhisaṃdhipūrvakaṃ tac ca nirṇudati yat purā kṛtam / nāpriyaṃ tad ubhayaṃ kutaḥ priyaṃ tasya taj janayatīha kurvataḥ

vulgate_text: nāpṛṣṭaḥ kasyacidbrūyānnāpyanyāyena pṛcchataḥ / jānannapi ca medhāvī jaḍavatsamupāviśet
ce_text: nāpṛṣṭaḥ kasya cid brūyān na cānyāyena pṛcchataḥ / jñānavān api medhāvī jaḍaval lokam ācaret

vulgate_text: kṛtārtha bhoginaṃ matvā sarvo ratiparāyaṇaḥ / lābhaṃ prātyasukhādanyaṃ ratito nānupaśyati
ce_text: kṛtārtho bhogato bhūtvā sa vai ratiparāyaṇaḥ / lābhaṃ grāmyasukhād anyaṃ ratito nānupaśyati

vulgate_text: maryādāyāṃ vartamāno'pi nāvasīdati / puṣṭasrota ivāsaktaḥ sphīto bhavati saṃcayaḥ
ce_text: maryādāyāṃ dharmasetur nibaddho naiva sīdati / puṣṭasrota ivāyattaḥ sphīto bhavati saṃcayaḥ

vulgate_text: buddhimārgaprayātasya sukhaṃ tviha paratra ca vistarāḥ kleśasaṃyuktāḥ saṃkṣepāstu sukhāvahāḥ / parārthaṃ vistarāḥ sarve tyāgamāṃtmahitaṃ viduḥ
ce_text: vistarāḥ kleśasaṃyuktāḥ saṃkṣepās tu sukhāvahāḥ / parārthaṃ vistarāḥ sarve tyāgam ātmahitaṃ viduḥ

vulgate_text: manaḥ praṇayate''tmānaṃ sa enamabhiyuñjati / yukto yadā sa bhavati tadā taṃ paśyate param
ce_text: yathā mṛṇālo 'nugatam āśu muñcati kardamam / tathātmā puruṣasyeha manasā parimucyate / manaḥ praṇayate ''tmānaṃ sa enam abhiyuñjati

vulgate_text: tulyaṃ śaucaṃ tayorekaṃ dayā bhūteṣu cānagha vratānāṃ dhāraṇaṃ tulyaṃ darśanaṃ na samaṃ tayoḥ / tayostu darśanaṃ samyaksūkṣmābhāve prasajyate
ce_text: tulyaṃ śaucaṃ tayor yuktaṃ dayā bhūteṣu cānagha / vratānāṃ dhāraṇaṃ tulyaṃ darśanaṃ na samaṃ tayoḥ

vulgate_text: viṣṇau krāntaṃ balaṃ śakre koṣṭhe saktaṃ tathā'nalam / apsu devīṃ samāsaktāmapastejasi saṃśritāḥ
ce_text: viṣṇuṃ krānte bale śakraṃ koṣṭhe saktaṃ tathānalam / apsu devīṃ tathā saktām apas tejasi cāśritāḥ

vulgate_text: paramā sā gatiḥ pārtha nirdvandvānāṃ mahātmanām / satyārjavaratānāṃ vai sarvabhūtadayāvatām
ce_text: paramātmānam āsādya tadbhūtāyatanāmalāḥ / amṛtatvāya kalpante na nivartanti cābhibho / paramā sā gatiḥ pārtha nirdvaṃdvānāṃ mahātmanām

vulgate_text: jalodare tṛṣāroge jvaragaṇḍe viṣūcake / śvitrakuṣṭhe'gnidagdhe ca sidhmāpasmārayorapi
ce_text: jalodare 'rśasāṃ roge jvaragaṇḍaviṣūcike / śvitre kuṣṭhe 'gnidāhe ca sidhmāpasmārayor api

vulgate_text: phalakaparidhānaśca tathā kaṇṭakavasradhṛt / kīṭakārpāsavasanaścīravāsāstathaiva ca
ce_text: kīṭakāvasanaś caiva cīravāsās tathaiva ca / vastrāṇi cānyāni bahūny abhimanyaty abuddhimān

vulgate_text: ṣaḍrātrabhojanaścaiva tathaivāṣṭāhabhojanaḥ / saptarātradaśāhāro dvādaśāhikabhojanaḥ
ce_text: caturthāṣṭamakālaś ca ṣaṣṭhakālika eva ca / ṣaḍrātrabhojanaś caiva tathaivāṣṭāhabhojanaḥ

vulgate_text: upāśramānapyaparānpāṣaṇḍānvividhānapi / viviktāśca śilācchāyāstathā prasravaṇāni ca
ce_text: viviktāś ca śilāchāyās tathā prasravaṇāni ca / vividhāni ca japyāni vividhāni vratāni ca

vulgate_text: pulināni viviktāni viviktāni vanāni ca / devasthānāni puṇyāni viviktāni sarāṃsi ca
ce_text: viviktāś ca śilāchāyās tathā prasravaṇāni ca / vividhāni ca japyāni vividhāni vratāni ca

vulgate_text: viviktāścāpi śailānāṃ guhā gṛhanibhopamāḥ / viviktāni ca japyāni vratāni vividhāni ca
ce_text: viviktāś ca śilāchāyās tathā prasravaṇāni ca / vividhāni ca japyāni vividhāni vratāni ca

vulgate_text: akartā kartṛ cātmānamabījo bījamātmanaḥ akṣaraḥ kṣaramātmānamabuddhistvabhimanyate
ce_text: abhavo bhavam ātmānam abhayo bhayam ātmanaḥ / akṣaraḥ kṣaram ātmānam abuddhis tv abhimanyate

vulgate_text: kalā pañcadaśī yonistaddhāma iti manyate / nityametaṃ vijānīhi somaṃ vai ṣauḍaśīṃ kalām
ce_text: kalāḥ pañcadaśā yonis tad dhāma iti paṭhyate / nityam etad vijānīhi somaḥ ṣoḍaśamī kalā

vulgate_text: [anyonyaguṇasaṃrodhādanyonyaguṇasaṃśrayāt ] evamevābhisaṃbaddhau nityaṃ prakṛtipūruṣau
ce_text: evam evābhisaṃbaddhau nityaṃ prakṛtipūruṣau / paśyāmi bhagavaṃs tasmān mokṣadharmo na vidyate

vulgate_text: nirvāte hi yathā dīpyandīpastadvatprakāśate / nirliṅgo vicalaścordhvaṃ na tiryaggatimāpnuyāt
ce_text: nivāte ca yathā dīpyan dīpas tadvat sa dṛśyate / niriṅgaś cācalaś cordhvaṃ na tiryaggatim āpnuyāt

vulgate_text: kimahaṃ kṛtavānevaṃ yohaṃ kālamimaṃ janam yadā matsyodakaṃ jñānamanuvartitavāṃstadā / matsyo jālaṃ hyavijñānādanuvartitavāniha
ce_text: kiṃ mayā kṛtam etāvad yo 'haṃ kālam imaṃ janam / matsyo jālaṃ hy avijñānād anuvartitavāṃs tathā

vulgate_text: caturviśaṃ mahābhāga ṣaṅviṃśasya prabodhanāt / eṣa hyapratibuddhaśca budhyamānaśca te'nagha
ce_text: eṣa hy apratibuddhaś ca budhyamānaś ca te 'nagha / prokto buddhaś ca tattvena yathāśrutinidarśanāt / nānātvaikatvam etāvad draṣṭavyaṃ śāstradṛṣṭibhiḥ

vulgate_text: avyaktarūpo bhagavāñśatadhā ca sahasradhā / śatadhā sahasradhā caiva tathā śatasahasradhā
ce_text: śatadhā sahasradhā caiva tathā śatasahasradhā / koṭiśaś ca karoty eṣa pratyagātmānam ātmanā

vulgate_text: nistatvaṃ kevalatvaṃ ca vinābhāvaṃ tathaiva ca / daivatāni ca me brūhi dehaṃ yānyāśritāni vai
ce_text: astitvaṃ kevalatvaṃ ca vinābhāvaṃ tathaiva ca / tathaivotkramaṇasthānaṃ dehino 'pi viyujyataḥ

vulgate_text: tathaivotkrāṇiṇaḥ sthānaṃ dehino vai vipadyataḥ / kālena yaddhi prāpnoti sthānaṃ tatprabravīhi me
ce_text: kālena yad dhi prāpnoti sthānaṃ tad brūhi me dvija / sāṃkhyajñānaṃ ca tattvena pṛthag yogaṃ tathaiva ca

vulgate_text: dhāraṇaṃ caiva manasaḥ prāṇāyāmaśca pārthiva / ekāgratā ca manasaḥ prāṇāyāmastathaiva ca
ce_text: dhāraṇā caiva manasaḥ prāṇāyāmaś ca pārthiva / prāṇāyāmo hi saguṇo nirguṇaṃ dhāraṇaṃ manaḥ

vulgate_text: prāṇāyāmo hi saguṇo nirguṇaṃ dhārayenmanaḥ yadyadṛśyati muñcanvai prāṇānmaithilasattama / vātādhikyaṃ bhavatyeva tasmāttaṃ na samācaret
ce_text: yatra dṛśyeta muñcan vai prāṇān maithilasattama / vātādhikyaṃ bhavaty eva tasmād dhi na samācaret

vulgate_text: arigani pravakṣyāmi vihitāni manīṣibhiḥ / saṃvatsarāddhimokṣastu saṃbhaveta śarīriṇaḥ
ce_text: ariṣṭāni tu vakṣyāmi vihitāni manīṣibhiḥ / saṃvatsaraviyogasya saṃbhaveyuḥ śarīriṇaḥ

vulgate_text: tathaiva ca sahasrāṃśuṃ saptarātreṇa mṛtyubhāk śavagandhamupāghrāti saptarātreṇa mṛtyubhāk
ce_text: śīrṇanābhi yathā cakraṃ chidraṃ somaṃ prapaśyati / tathaiva ca sahasrāṃśuṃ saptarātreṇa mṛtyubhāk

vulgate_text: tato'hamardhyaṃ vidhivatsarasvatyai nyavedayam / paraṃ yatnamavāpyaiva niṣaṇṇastatparāyaṇaḥ
ce_text: tato 'ham arghyaṃ vidhivat sarasvatyai nyavedayam / tapatāṃ ca variṣṭhāya niṣaṇṇas tatparāyaṇaḥ

vulgate_text: pañcaviṃśatimaṃ praśnaṃ papracchānvīkṣikīṃ tadā tathaiva puruṣavyāghra mitraṃ varuṇameva ca
ce_text: viśvāvasus tato rājan vedāntajñānakovidaḥ / caturviṃśatikān praśnān pṛṣṭvā vedasya pārthiva / pañcaviṃśatimaṃ praśnaṃ papracchānvīkṣikīṃ tathā

vulgate_text: jñānaṃ tu prakṛtiṃ prāhurjñeyaṃ puruṣameva ca / ajñamavyaktamityuktaṃ jñastu niṣkala ucyate
ce_text: jñānaṃ tu prakṛtiṃ prāhur jñeyaṃ niṣkalam eva ca / ajñaś ca jñaś ca puruṣas tasmān niṣkala ucyate

vulgate_text: ajñāvubhau dhruvau caiva akṣayau cāpyubhāvapi
ce_text: ajāv ubhāv aprajau ca akṣayau cāpy ubhāv api / ajau nityāv ubhau prāhur adhyātmagatiniścayāḥ

vulgate_text: avyakteneti taccintyamanyathā mā vicantaya dadāti ca naraśreṣṭha pratigṛhṇāti yacca ha / dadātyavyakta ityetatpratigṛhṇāti yacca vai
ce_text: dīyate yac ca labhate dattaṃ yac cānumanyate / dadāti ca naraśreṣṭha pratigṛhṇāti yac ca ha / dadāty avyaktam evaitat pratigṛhṇāti tac ca vai

vulgate_text: tathaiva vyabhicāreṇa na vartante parasparam / praśliṣṭaṃ ca na jānanti yathā''pa iva pāṃvasaḥ
ce_text: na veda cakṣuś cakṣuṣṭvaṃ śrotraṃ nātmani vartate / tathaiva vyabhicāreṇa na vartante parasparam / saṃśliṣṭā nābhijāyante yathāpa iha pāṃsavaḥ

vulgate_text: tadalpasukhamatyarthaṃ bahuduḥkhamasāravat / tṛṇāgnijvalanaprakhyaṃ phenabudbudasaṃnibham
ce_text: tad alpasukham atyarthaṃ bahuduḥkham asāravat / ko rājyam abhipadyeta prāpya copaśamaṃ labhet

vulgate_text: ye tu tuṣṭāḥ śrutiparā mahātmāno mahābalāḥ / dharmyaṃ panthānamārūḍhāstānupāssva ca pṛccha ca
ce_text: ye tu tuṣṭāḥ suniyatāḥ satyāgamaparāyaṇāḥ / dharmyaṃ panthānam ārūḍhās tān upāssva ca pṛccha ca

vulgate_text: samānakarmanikṣepaṃ vidhānaparirakṣaṇam / bhūtagrāmamimaṃ kālaḥ samantādapakarṣati
ce_text: svakarmaphalavikṣiptaṃ vidhānaparirakṣitam / bhūtagrāmam imaṃ kālaḥ samantāt parikarṣati

vulgate_text: samānaścāvamānaśca lābhālābhau jayājayau / pravṛttā na nivartante nidhanāntāḥ padepade
ce_text: saṃmānaś cāvamānaś ca lābhālābhau kṣayodayau / pravṛttā vinivartante vidhānānte punaḥ punaḥ

vulgate_text: samāvṛttaśca gārhasthye svadāranirato vaset / anasūyuryathānyāyamāhitāgniranāvṛtaḥ
ce_text: samāvṛttas tu gārhasthye sadāro niyato vaset / anasūyur yathānyāyam āhitāgnis tathaiva ca

vulgate_text: etasminnantare bhūte nāradaḥ punarāgamat / śukaṃ svādhyāyanirataṃ vedārthānpraṣṭumīpsavā
ce_text: etasminn antare śūnye nāradaḥ samupāgamat / śukaṃ svādhyāyanirataṃ vedārthān vaktum īpsitān

vulgate_text: badhyate mathyate caiva karmabhirmanthavatsadā / tato nibaddhaḥ svāṃ yoniṃ karmaṇāmudayādiha
ce_text: ajasram eva mohārto duḥkheṣu sukhasaṃjñitaḥ / badhyate mathyate caiva karmabhir manthavat sadā

vulgate_text: na tu yogamṛte śaktyā prāpnuyāṃ paramāṃ gatim / anubandho vimuktasya karmabhirnopapadyate
ce_text: na tu yogam ṛte śakyā prāptuṃ sā paramā gatiḥ / avabandho hi muktasya karmabhir nopapadyate

vulgate_text: kṣīyate hi sadā somaḥ punaścaivābhipūryate / necchāmyevaṃ viditvaite hrāsavṛddhī punaḥ punaḥ
ce_text: na hy eṣa kṣayam āpnoti somaḥ suragaṇair yathā / kampitaḥ patate bhūmiṃ punaś caivādhirohati / kṣīyate hi sadā somaḥ punaś caivābhipūryate

vulgate_text: pitaraṃ sa parityajya jagāma munisattamaḥ / kailāsapṛṣṭhaṃ vipulaṃ siddhasaṅghaniṣevitam
ce_text: nirapekṣaḥ śuko bhūtvā niḥsneho muktabandhanaḥ / mokṣam evānusaṃcintya gamanāya mano dadhe / pitaraṃ saṃparityajya jagāma dvijasattamaḥ

vulgate_text: drumāḥ śākhāśca mumucuḥ śikharāṇi ca parvatāḥ / nirghātaśabdairgurubhirbhūmirvyādīryateva ha
ce_text: drumāḥ śākhāś ca mumucuḥ śikharāṇi ca parvatāḥ / nirghātaśabdaiś ca girir himavān dīryatīva ha

vulgate_text: yajante tvāmaharaharnānāmūrtisamāsthitam pitā mātā ca sarvasya devatānāṃ ca śāśvatam / kaṃ tvadya yajase devaṃ pitaraṃ kaṃ na vidmahe
ce_text: pitā mātā ca sarvasya jagataḥ śāśvato guruḥ / kaṃ tv adya yajase devaṃ pitaraṃ kaṃ na vidmahe

ce_text: pitṛśeṣeṇa viprāṃś ca saṃvibhajyāśritāṃś ca saḥ / śeṣānnabhuk satyaparaḥ sarvabhūteṣv ahiṃsakaḥ / sarvabhāvena bhaktaḥ sa devadevaṃ janārdanam

vulgate_text: ekāgramanaso dāntā munayaḥ saṃyame ratāḥ / bhūtabhavyabhaviṣyajñāḥ satyadharmaparāyaṇāḥ
ce_text: ekāgramanaso dāntā munayaḥ saṃyame ratāḥ / idaṃ śreya idaṃ brahma idaṃ hitam anuttamam / lokān saṃcintya manasā tataḥ śāstraṃ pracakrire

ce_text: uvāca coparicaraṃ mayā bhāgo 'yam udyataḥ / grāhyaḥ svayaṃ hi devena matpratyakṣaṃ na saṃśayaḥ

vulgate_text: śṛṇu tvaṃ vacanaṃ putra asmābhiḥ samudāhṛtam naiṣa dharmaḥ kṛtayuge yattvaṃ roṣamihāhithāḥ
ce_text: ūcuś cainam asaṃbhrāntā na roṣaṃ kartum arhasi / naiṣa dharmaḥ kṛtayuge yas tvaṃ roṣam acīkṛthāḥ

vulgate_text: vareṇyaṃ varadaṃ taṃ vai devadevaṃ sanātanam / kathaṃ paśyemahi vayaṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ tviti
ce_text: meror uttarabhāge tu kṣīrodasyānukūlataḥ / sa deśo yatra nas taptaṃ tapaḥ paramadāruṇam / kathaṃ paśyemahi vayaṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ tv iti

vulgate_text: atha vratasyāvabhṛthe vāguvācāśarīriṇī / snigdhagambhīrayā vācā praharṣaṇakarī vibho

vulgate_text: prāpya śvetaṃ mahādvīpaṃ taccittāstaddidṛkṣavaḥ sahasā hi gatāḥ sarve tejasā tasya mohitāḥ
ce_text: prāpya śvetaṃ mahādvīpaṃ taccittās taddidṛkṣavaḥ / tato no dṛṣṭiviṣayas tadā pratihato 'bhavat

ce_text: na kilātaptatapasā śakyate draṣṭum añjasā / tataḥ punar varṣaśataṃ taptvā tātkālikaṃ mahat

vulgate_text: tairiṣṭaḥ pañcakālajñairharirekāntibhirnaraiḥ / bhaktyā paramayā yuktairmanovākkarmabhistadā
ce_text: tair iṣṭaḥ pañcakālajñair harir ekāntibhir naraiḥ / nūnaṃ tatrāgato devo yathā tair vāg udīritā / vayaṃ tv enaṃ na paśyāmo mohitās tasya māyayā

vulgate_text: nārāyaṇo mahadbhūtaṃ viśvasṛgghavyakavyabhuk / anādinidhano'vyakto devadānavapūjitaḥ
ce_text: evaṃ sutapasā caiva havyakavyais tathaiva ca / devo 'smābhir na dṛṣṭaḥ sa kathaṃ tvaṃ draṣṭum arhasi / nārāyaṇo mahad bhūtaṃ viśvasṛg ghavyakavyabhuk

ce_text: antarbhūmigataś caiva satataṃ dharmavatsalaḥ / nārāyaṇaparo bhūtvā nārāyaṇapadaṃ jagau

vulgate_text: asmācchāpābhighātena mahīṃ bhittvā pravekṣyasi viruddhaṃ vedasūtrāṇāmuktaṃ yadi bhavennṛpa / vayaṃ viruddhavacanā yadi tatra patāmahe
ce_text: surapakṣo gṛhītas te yasmāt tasmād divaḥ pata / adya prabhṛti te rājann ākāśe vihatā gatiḥ / asmacchāpābhighātena mahīṃ bhittvā pravekṣyasi

ce_text: yatas tvaṃ sahasā bhraṣṭa ākāśān medinītalam / ekaṃ tv anugrahaṃ tubhyaṃ dadmo vai nṛpasattama

ce_text: evaṃ dattvā varaṃ rājñe sarve tatra divaukasaḥ / gatāḥ svabhavanaṃ devā ṛṣayaś ca tapodhanāḥ

vulgate_text: evaṃ stutaḥ sa bhagavān guhyaistathyaiśca nāmabhiḥ bhagavānviśvasṛksiṃhaḥ sarvamūrtimayaḥ prabhuḥ / darśayāmāsa munaye rūpaṃ tatparamaṃ hariḥ
ce_text: evaṃ stutaḥ sa bhagavān guhyais tathyaiś ca nāmabhiḥ / taṃ muniṃ darśayām āsa nāradaṃ viśvarūpadhṛk

ce_text: na dṛśyaś cakṣuṣā yo 'sau na spṛśyaḥ sparśanena ca / na ghreyaś caiva gandhena rasena ca vivarjitaḥ

ce_text: paśyaikādaśa me rudrān dakṣiṇaṃ pārśvam āsthitān / dvādaśaiva tathādityān vāmaṃ pārśvaṃ samāsthitān

ce_text: yathā sūryasya gaganād udayāstamayāv iha / naṣṭau punar balāt kāla ānayaty amitadyutiḥ / tathā balād ahaṃ pṛthvīṃ sarvabhūtahitāya vai

vulgate_text: baliṃ caiva kariṣyāmi pātālatalavāsinam / dānavaṃ ca baliśreṣṭhamabadhyaṃ sarvadaivataiḥ
ce_text: tato rājyaṃ pradāsyāmi śakrāyāmitatejase / devatāḥ sthāpayiṣyāmi sveṣu sthāneṣu nārada / baliṃ caiva kariṣyāmi pātālatalavāsinam

vulgate_text: tayorye tvanvaye jātā bhaviṣyanti vanaukasaḥ mahābalā mahāvīryāḥ śakratulyaparākramāḥ
ce_text: tayor ye tv anvaye jātā bhaviṣyanti vanaukasaḥ / te sahāyā bhaviṣyanti surakārye mama dvija

vulgate_text: te sahāyā bhaviṣyanti surakārye mama dvija tato rakṣaḥpatiṃ ghoraṃ pulastyakulapāṃsanam / haniṣye rāvaṇaṃ raudraṃ sagaṇaṃ lokakaṇṭakam
ce_text: tato rakṣaḥpatiṃ ghoraṃ pulastyakulapāṃsanam / haniṣye rāvaṇaṃ saṃkhye sagaṇaṃ lokakaṇṭakam

vulgate_text: mama buddhiparispandādvadhastasya bhaviṣyati / śiśupālaṃ vadhiṣyāmi yajñe dharmasutasya vai

vulgate_text: vāsaviḥ susahāyo vai mama tveko bhaviṣyati / yudhiṣṭhiraṃ sthāpayiṣye svarājye bhrātṛbhiḥ saha
ce_text: samāgateṣu baliṣu pṛthivyāṃ sarvarājasu / vāsaviḥ susahāyo vai mama hy eko bhaviṣyati

vulgate_text: kariṣye pralayaṃ ghoramātmajñānābhisaṃśrayaḥ / dvārakāmātmasātkṛtvā samudraṃ gamayāmyaham
ce_text: kṛtvā bhārāvataraṇaṃ vasudhāyā yathepsitam / sarvasātvatamukhyānāṃ dvārakāyāś ca sattama / kariṣye pralayaṃ ghoram ātmajñātivināśanam

vulgate_text: aṣṭāviṃśatsahasrāṇi ṛṣīṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām ātmānugāmināṃ brahmā śrāvayāmāsa tatvataḥ / evaṃ purā prāptamidaṃ bhānunā munibhāṣitam
ce_text: teṣāṃ sakāśāt sūryaś ca śrutvā vai bhāvitātmanām / ātmānugāmināṃ brahma śrāvayām āsa bhārata

vulgate_text: mokṣaścoktastvayā brahmannirvāṇaṃ paramaṃ sukham ye tu muktā bhavantīha puṇyapāpavivarjitāḥ / te sahasrārciṣaṃ devaṃ praviśantīha śuśrum
ce_text: ye ca muktā bhavantīha puṇyapāpavivarjitāḥ / te sahasrārciṣaṃ devaṃ praviśantīti śuśrumaḥ

vulgate_text: ucathye'ntahiṃte caiva kadāciddevatājñayā / bṛhaspatirathāvindattāṃ patnīṃ tasya dhīmataḥ

vulgate_text: evamukto dadhīcastānabravīt sahasraṃ varṣāṇāmaindraṃ padamavāpyate mayā yadi jahyām tathetyuktvendraḥ svasthānaṃ datvā tapasvyabhavat indro dadhīco'bhavat tāvatpūrveṇa sendrā devā āgamankālo'yaṃ dehanyāsāyeti atha dadhīcastathaivā vimanāḥ sukhaduḥkhasamo mahāyogī ātmani paramātmānaṃ samādhāya śarīraparityāgaṃ cakāra
ce_text: devās tatrāgacchan yatra dadhīco bhagavān ṛṣis tapas tepe / sendrā devās tam abhigamyocur bhagavaṃs tapasaḥ kuśalam avighnaṃ ceti / tān dadhīca uvāca svāgataṃ bhavadbhyaḥ kiṃ kriyatām / yad vakṣyatha tat kariṣyāmīti / te tam abruvañ śarīraparityāgaṃ lokahitārthaṃ bhagavān kartum arhatīti / atha dadhīcas tathaivāvimanāḥ sukhaduḥkhasamo mahāyogī ātmānaṃ samādhāya śarīraparityāgaṃ cakāra

vulgate_text: atha śacī duḥkhaśokārtā bhartṛdarśanalālasānahuṣabhayagṛhītā bṛhaspatimupāgacchatsa ca tāmatyudvignāṃ dṛṣṭvaiva dhyānaṃ praviśya bhartṛkāryatatparāṃ jñātvā bṛhaspatiruvācānenaiva vratena tapasā cānvitā devīṃ varadāmupaśrutimāhvaya tadā sā te indraṃ darśayiṣyatīti sā'tha mahāniyamasthitā devīṃ varadāmupaśrutiṃ mantrairāhvayatsopaśrutiḥ śacīsamīpamagāduvāca caināmiyamastīti tvayā''hūtopasthitā kiṃ te priyaṃ karavāṇīti tāṃ bhūrdhnā praṇamyovāca śacī bhagavatyarhasi me bhartāraṃ darśayituṃ tvaṃ satyā mātā satāṃ ceti saināṃ mānasaṃ saro'nayattatrendraṃ visagranthigatamadarśayat
ce_text: sātha mahāniyamam āsthitā devīṃ varadām upaśrutiṃ mantrair āhvayat / sopaśrutiḥ śacīsamīpam agāt / uvāca cainām iyam asmi tvayopahūtopasthitā / kiṃ te priyaṃ karavāṇīti / tāṃ mūrdhnā praṇamyovāca śacī bhagavaty arhasi me bhartāraṃ darśayituṃ tvaṃ satyā matā ceti / saināṃ mānasaṃ saro 'nayat / tatrendraṃ bisagranthigatam adarśayat

vulgate_text: tāmatha patnīṃ śacīṃ kṛśāṃ ralānāṃ cendro dṛṣṭvā cintayāṃbabhūva aho mama duḥkhamidamupagataṃ naṣṭaṃ hi māmiyamanviṣya yatpatnyabhyagamadduḥsvārteti tāmindra uvāca kathaṃ varyasīti sā tamuvāca nahu po māmāhvayati patnīṃ kartuṃ kālaścāsya mayā kṛta iti tāmindra uvāca gaccha nahuṣastvayā vācyo'pūrveṇa māmṛṣiyuktena yānena tvamadhirūḍha udvahasveti indrasya mahānti vāhanāni santi manaḥ priyāṇyadhirūḍhāni mayā tvamanyenopayātumarhatīti saivamuktā hṛṣṭā jagāmendropi visagranthimevāviveśa bhūyaḥ
ce_text: tām indra uvāca / gaccha / nahuṣas tvayā vācyo 'pūrveṇa mām ṛṣiyuktena yānena tvam adhirūḍha udvahasva / indrasya hi mahānti vāhanāni manasaḥ priyāṇy adhirūḍhāni mayā / tvam anyenopayātum arhasīti / saivam uktā hṛṣṭā jagāma / indro 'pi bisagranthim evāviveśa bhūyaḥ

vulgate_text: athānindraṃ punastrailokyamabhavat tato devā ṛṣayaśca bhagavantaṃ viṣṇuṃ śaraṇamindrārthe'bhijagmurūcuścainaṃ bhagavannindraṃ brahmahatyābhibhūtaṃ trātumarhasīti tataḥ sa varadastānabravīdaśvamedhaṃ yajñaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ śakro'bhiyajatāṃ tataḥ svasthānaṃ prāpsyatīti tato devā ṛṣayaścendraṃ nāpaśyanyadā tadā śacīmūcurgaccha subhage indramānayasveti sā tatsara indramāhvayat indraśca tasmātsarasaḥ pratyutthāya gatvā sarasvatīmabhijagāma bṛhaspatiścāśvameghaṃ mahākratuṃ śakrāyāhārat tatra kṛṣṇasāraṅgaṃ medhyamaśvamatsṛjya pāvanaṃ tameva kṛtvā indraṃ marutpatiṃ bṛhaspatiḥ svaṃ sthānaṃ prāpayāmāsa
ce_text: tato devā ṛṣayaś cendraṃ nāpaśyan yadā tadā śacīm ūcur gaccha subhage indram ānayasveti / sā punas tat saraḥ samabhyagacchat / indraś ca tasmāt sarasaḥ samutthāya bṛhaspatim abhijagāma / bṛhaspatiś cāśvamedhaṃ mahākratuṃ śakrāyāharat / tataḥ kṛṣṇasāraṅgaṃ medhyam aśvam utsṛjya vāhanaṃ tam eva kṛtvā indraṃ marutpatiṃ bṛhaspatiḥ svasthānaṃ prāpayām āsa

vulgate_text: uktaścāpyapeyo bhaviṣyastetacca te toyaṃ baḍavāmukhasaṃjñitena pepīyamānaṃ madhuraṃ bhaviṣyati tadetadadyāpi baḍavāmukhasaṃjñitenānuvartinā toyaṃ samudrātpīyate punarumā dakṣakopāddhimavato girerduhitā babhūva
ce_text: nārāyaṇo lokahitārthaṃ vaḍavāmukho nāma maharṣiḥ purābhavat / tasya merau tapas tapyataḥ samudra āhūto nāgataḥ / tenāmarṣitenātmagātroṣmaṇā samudraḥ stimitajalaḥ kṛtaḥ / svedaprasyandanasadṛśaś cāsya lavaṇabhāvo janitaḥ / uktaś cāpeyo bhaviṣyasi / etac ca te toyaṃ vaḍavāmukhasaṃjñitena pīyamānaṃ madhuraṃ bhaviṣyati / tad etad adyāpi vaḍavāmukhasaṃjñitenānuvartinā toyaṃ sāmudraṃ pīyate

ce_text: tena me kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ nāma kṣetrajñasaṃjñitam / prādurbhāvāś ca kathitā bhaviṣyanti hi ye yathā

ce_text: ramate so 'rcyamāno hi sadā bhāgavatapriyaḥ / viśvabhuk sarvago devo bāndhavo bhaktavatsalaḥ / sa kartā kāraṇaṃ caiva kāryaṃ cātibaladyutiḥ

vulgate_text: uṣitvā varṣasāhasraṃ naranārāyaṇāśrame śrutvā bhagavadākhyānaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca harimavyayam / jagāma himavatkukṣāvāśramaṃ svaṃ surārcitam
ce_text: proṣya varṣasahasraṃ tu naranārāyaṇāśrame / śrutvā bhagavadākhyānaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca harim avyayam / himavantaṃ jagāmāśu yatrāsya svaka āśramaḥ
