vulgate_text: vajrahastaśca viṣkambhī camūstambhana eva ca / vṛttāvṛttakarastālo madhurmadhukalocanaḥ
ce_text: mahāseno viśākhaś ca ṣaṣṭibhāgo gavāṃ patiḥ / vajrahastaś ca viṣkambhī camūstambhana eva ca

vulgate_text: īśāna īśvaraḥ kālo niśācārī pinākavān / nimittastho nimittaṃ ca nandirnandikaro hariḥ
ce_text: brahmacārī lokacārī sarvacārī sucāravit / īśāna īśvaraḥ kālo niśācārī pinākadhṛk

vulgate_text: mahāmūrdhā mahābhātro mahānetro niśālayaḥ / mahāntako mahākarṇo mahoṣṭhaści mahāhanuḥ
ce_text: mahāmūrdhā mahāmātro mahānetro digālayaḥ / mahādanto mahākarṇo mahāmeḍhro mahāhanuḥ

vulgate_text: lokapālastathā loko mahātmā sarvapūjitaḥ / śuklastriśuklaḥ sampannaḥ śucirbhūtaniṣevitaḥ
ce_text: agaṇaś caiva lopaś ca mahātmā sarvapūjitaḥ / śaṅkus triśaṅkuḥ saṃpannaḥ śucir bhūtaniṣevitaḥ

vulgate_text: vibhurvarṇavibhāvī ca sarvakāmaguṇāvahaḥ / padmanābho mahāgarbhaścandravaktro'nilo'nalaḥ
ce_text: ratitīrthaś ca vāgmī ca sarvakāmaguṇāvahaḥ / padmagarbho mahāgarbhaś candravaktro manoramaḥ

vulgate_text: dhṛtimānmatimāndakṣaḥ satkṛtaśca yugādhipaḥ gopālirgopatirgrāmo gocarmavasano hariḥ
ce_text: amoghaḥ saṃyato hy aśvo bhojanaḥ prāṇadhāraṇaḥ / dhṛtimān matimān dakṣaḥ satkṛtaś ca yugādhipaḥ

vulgate_text: gāndhāraśca suvāsasca tapaḥsakto ratirnaraḥ / mahāgīto mahānṛtyo hyapsarogaṇasevitaḥ
ce_text: mahāgīto mahānṛtto hy apsarogaṇasevitaḥ / mahāketur dhanur dhātur naikasānucaraś calaḥ

vulgate_text: toraṇastāraṇo vātaḥ varidhī patikhecaraḥ / saṃyogo vardhano vṛddho ativṛddho guṇādhikaḥ
ce_text: saṃyogo vardhano vṛddho mahāvṛddho gaṇādhipaḥ / nitya ātmasahāyaś ca devāsurapatiḥ patiḥ

vulgate_text: āṣāḍhaśca suṣāṃḍhaśca dhruvo'tha hariṇo haraḥ / vapurāvartamānebhyo vasuśreṣṭho mahāpathaḥ
ce_text: vapur āvartamānebhyo vasuśreṣṭho mahāpathaḥ / śirohārī vimarṣaś ca sarvalakṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ

vulgate_text: ārohaṇo'dhirohaśca śīladhārī mahāyaśāḥ / senākalpo mahākalpo yogo yugakaro hariḥ
ce_text: senākalpo mahākalpo yugāyugakaro hariḥ / yugarūpo mahārūpaḥ pavano gahano nagaḥ

vulgate_text: bahumālo mahāmālaḥ śaśī harasulocanaḥ / vistāro lavaṇaḥ kūpastriyugaḥ saphalodayaḥ
ce_text: vistāro lavaṇaḥ kūpaḥ kusumaḥ saphalodayaḥ / vṛṣabho vṛṣabhāṅkāṅgo maṇibilvo jaṭādharaḥ

vulgate_text: trilocano viṣaṣṇāṅgo maṇividdho jaṭādharaḥ / bindurvisargaḥ sumukhaḥ śaraḥ sarvāyudhaḥ sahaḥ
ce_text: indur visargaḥ sumukhaḥ suraḥ sarvāyudhaḥ sahaḥ / nivedanaḥ sudhājātaḥ sugandhāro mahādhanuḥ

vulgate_text: dhatraṃ succhatro vikhyāto lokaḥ sarvāśrayaḥ kramaḥ muṇḍo virūpo vikṛto daṇḍī kuṇḍī vikurvaṇaḥ
ce_text: muṇḍo virūpo vikṛto daṇḍimuṇḍo vikurvaṇaḥ / haryakṣaḥ kakubho vajrī dīptajihvaḥ sahasrapāt

vulgate_text: sahasrabāhuḥ sarvāṅgaḥ śaraṇyaḥ sarvalokakṛt pavitraṃ trikakunmantraḥ kaniṣṭhaḥ kṛṣṇapiṅgalaḥ
ce_text: sahasramūrdhā devendraḥ sarvadevamayo guruḥ / sahasrabāhuḥ sarvāṅgaḥ śaraṇyaḥ sarvalokakṛt

vulgate_text: pītātmā paramātmā ca prayatātmā pradhānadhṛt / sarvapārśvamukhastryakṣo dharmasādhāraṇo varaḥ
ce_text: sarvapārśvasutas tārkṣyo dharmasādhāraṇo varaḥ / carācarātmā sūkṣmātmā suvṛṣo govṛṣeśvaraḥ

vulgate_text: carācarātmā sūkṣmātmā amṛto govṛṣeśvaraḥ sādhyarṣirvasurādityo vivasvānsavitā'mṛtaḥ
ce_text: sādhyarṣir vasur ādityo vivasvān savitā mṛḍaḥ / vyāsaḥ sarvasya saṃkṣepo vistaraḥ paryayo nayaḥ

vulgate_text: udbhittrivikramo vaidyo virajo nīrajo'maraḥ / īḍyo hastīśvaro vyāghro devasiṃho nararṣabhaḥ
ce_text: īḍyo hastī suravyāghro devasiṃho nararṣabhaḥ / vibudhāgravaraḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sarvadevottamottamaḥ

vulgate_text: vibudho'gravaraḥ sūkṣmaḥ sarvadevastapomayaḥ / suyuktaḥ śobhano vajrī prāsānāṃ prabhavo'vyayaḥ
ce_text: prayuktaḥ śobhano vajra īśānaḥ prabhur avyayaḥ / guruḥ kānto nijaḥ sargaḥ pavitraḥ sarvavāhanaḥ

vulgate_text: yathā pradhānaṃ bhagavāniti bhaktyā stuto mayā yanna brahmādayo devā vidustattvena narṣayaḥ / stotavyamarcyaṃ vandyaṃ ca kaḥ stoṣyati jagatpatim
ce_text: yaṃ na brahmādayo devā vidur yaṃ na maharṣayaḥ / taṃ stavyam arcyaṃ vandyaṃ ca kaḥ stoṣyati jagatpatim

vulgate_text: śṛṇvantaḥ śrāvayantaśca kathayantaśca te bhavam / stuvantaḥ stūyāmānāśca tuṣyanti ca ramanti ca
ce_text: jāgrataś ca svapantaś ca vrajantaḥ pathi saṃsthitāḥ / stuvanti stūyamānāś ca tuṣyanti ca ramanti ca / janmakoṭisahasreṣu nānāsaṃsārayoniṣu

vulgate_text: utpannā ca bhave bhaktiranatyā sarvabhāvataḥ / bhāvinaḥ kāraṇe cāsya sarvayuktasya sarvathā
ce_text: jantor viśuddhapāpasya bhave bhaktiḥ prajāyate / utpannā ca bhave bhaktir ananyā sarvabhāvataḥ

vulgate_text: ye sarvabhāvānugatāḥ prapadyante maheśvaram / prapannavatsalo devaḥ saṃsārāttānsamuddharet
ce_text: ye sarvabhāvopagatāḥ paratvenābhavan narāḥ / prapannavatsalo devaḥ saṃsārāt tān samuddharet

vulgate_text: evamanye vikurvanti devāḥ saṃsāramocanam / manuṣyāṇāmṛte devaṃ nānyā śaktistapobalam
ce_text: evam anye na kurvanti devāḥ saṃsāramocanam / manuṣyāṇāṃ mahādevād anyatrāpi tapobalāt

vulgate_text: stavametaṃ bhagavato brahmā svayamadhārayat / gīyate ca sa buddhyeta brahma śaṃkarasannidhau
ce_text: stavam etaṃ bhagavato brahmā svayam adhārayat / brahmā provāca śakrāya śakraḥ provāca mṛtyave

vulgate_text: idaṃ puṇyaṃ pavitraṃ ca sarvadā pāpanāśanam / yogadaṃ mokṣadaṃ caiva svargadaṃ toṣadaṃ tathā
ce_text: stavarājam imaṃ kṛtvā rudrāya dadhire manaḥ / sarvadoṣāpahaṃ puṇyaṃ pavitraṃ ca yaśasvinam

vulgate_text: etadrahasyaṃ paramaṃ brahmaṇo hṛdi saṃsthitam / brahmā provāca śakrāya śakraḥ provāca mṛtyave
ce_text: stavam etaṃ bhagavato brahmā svayam adhārayat / brahmā provāca śakrāya śakraḥ provāca mṛtyave

vulgate_text: piśācā yātudhānā vā guhyakā bhujagā api yaḥ paṭheta śuciḥ pārtha brahmacārī jitendriyaḥ / abhagrayogo varṣaṃ tu so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet
ce_text: yaḥ paṭheta śucir bhūtvā brahmacārī jitendriyaḥ / abhagnayogo varṣaṃ tu so 'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet

vulgate_text: vālmīkiścāha bhagavānyudhiṣṭhiramidaṃ vacaḥ / vivāde sāgnimunibhirbrahmaghno vai bhavāniti
ce_text: vālmīkiś cāpi bhagavān yudhiṣṭhiram abhāṣata / vivāde sāmni munibhir brahmaghno vai bhavān iti / uktaḥ kṣaṇena cāviṣṭas tenādharmeṇa bhārata

vulgate_text: jāmadagnyaśca kaunteyamidaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃvaraḥ / ṛṣimadhye sthitaḥ prāha jvalanniva divākaraḥ
ce_text: jāmadagnyaś ca kaunteyam āha dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ / ṛṣimadhye sthitas tāta tapann iva vibhāvasuḥ

vulgate_text: evameva mahādevaṃ bhaktā ye mānavā bhuvi na te saṃsāravaśagā iti me niścitā matiḥ / tataḥ kṛṣṇo'bravīdvākyaṃ dharmaputraṃ yudhiṣṭhiram
ce_text: tataḥ kṛṣṇo 'bravīd vākyaṃ punar matimatāṃ varaḥ / yudhiṣṭhiraṃ dharmanityaṃ puruhūtam iveśvaraḥ

vulgate_text: atha niṣkramya bhagavānprayayāvuttarāmukhaḥ / kailāse saṅkarāvāsamabhivīkṣya praṇamya ca
ce_text: atha niṣkramya bhagavān prayayāv uttarāmukhaḥ / kailāsaṃ mandaraṃ haimaṃ sarvān anucacāra ha

vulgate_text: manoddaṣṭiharai ramyaiḥ sarvataḥ saṃvṛtaṃ śubhaiḥ / ṛṣibhiścāvṛtaṃ tatra āśramaṃ taṃ manoharam
ce_text: nānāvidhaiś ca bhavanair vicitramaṇitoraṇaiḥ / muktājālaparikṣiptair maṇiratnavibhūṣitaiḥ / manodṛṣṭiharai ramyaiḥ sarvataḥ saṃvṛtaṃ śubhaiḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya kanyāstāstamṛṣiṃ tadā niścakramurgṛhāttasmātsā vṛddhā'tha vyatiṣṭhataḥ / tayā sampūjitastatra śayane cāpi nirmale
ce_text: tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya kanyās tās tam ṛṣiṃ tadā / nirākrāman gṛhāt tasmāt sā vṛddhātha vyatiṣṭhata

vulgate_text: sahasre kila nārīṇāṃ prāpyetaikā kadācana / tathā śatasahasreṣu yadi kācitpativratā
ce_text: sahasraikā yatā nārī prāpnotīha kadā cana / tathā śatasahasreṣu yadi kā cit pativratā

vulgate_text: yathā me paramā śaktirna vyutthāne kathaṃcana / na rocate hi vyutthānaṃ satyenāsādayāmyaham
ce_text: yathā paraṃ śaktidhṛter na vyutthāsye kathaṃ cana / na rocaye hi vyutthānaṃ dhṛtyaivaṃ sādhayāmy aham

vulgate_text: bhāryāścatasro rājendra brāhmaṇasya svadharmataḥ / brāhmaṇī kṣatriyā vaiśyā śūdrā ca bharatarṣabha
ce_text: catasro vihitā bhāryā brāhmaṇasya pitāmaha / brāhmaṇī kṣatriyā vaiśyā śūdrā ca ratim icchataḥ

vulgate_text: rājñāṃ tu kṣatriyā vaiśyā śūdrā ca bharatarṣabha / vaiśyasya vaiśyā vihitā śūdrā ca bharatarṣabha
ce_text: catasro vihitā bhāryā brāhmaṇasya pitāmaha / brāhmaṇī kṣatriyā vaiśyā śūdrā ca ratim icchataḥ

vulgate_text: vaiśyāyāstu naraśreṣṭha vihitāḥ patayastrayaḥ / savarṇaḥ kṣatriyaścaiva brāhmaṇaśca viśāmpate
ce_text: brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyas trayo varṇā dvijātayaḥ / eteṣu vihito dharmo brāhmaṇasya yudhiṣṭhira

vulgate_text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam / nāradena purā gītaṃ mārkaṇḍeyāya pṛcchate
ce_text: atrāpy udāharantīmam itihāsaṃ purātanam / ṛṣer uddālaker vākyaṃ nāciketasya cobhayoḥ

vulgate_text: brāhmaṇānbharataśreṣṭha satataṃ brahmavādinaḥ mārkaṇḍeyaḥ purā prāha iti lokeṣu buddhimān / brāhmaṇāḥ pātrabhūtāśca śuddhā naivaṃ pitṛṣviha
ce_text: brāhmaṇā bharataśreṣṭha satataṃ brahmavādinaḥ / mārkaṇḍeyaḥ purā prāha iha lokeṣu buddhimān

vulgate_text: yathā mahārṇave kṣiptaḥ kṣipraṃ neṣṭurvinaśyati / tathā duścaritaṃ sarvaṃ trayīnitye nimajjati
ce_text: yathā mahārṇave kṣiptaḥ kṣipraṃ loṣṭo vinaśyati / tathā duścaritaṃ sarvaṃ trayy āvṛttyā vinaśyati

vulgate_text: adhikāre yadanṛtaṃ yacca rājasu paiśunam / guroścālīkanirbandhaḥ samāni brahmahatyayā
ce_text: adhikāre yad anṛtaṃ rājagāmi ca paiśunam / guroś cālīkakaraṇaṃ samaṃ tad brahmahatyayā

vulgate_text: avratī kitavaḥ stenaḥ prāṇivikrayiko vaṇik / saniṣkṛtiḥ punaḥ somaṃ pītavānketanakṣamaḥ
ce_text: avratī kitavaḥ stenaḥ prāṇivikrayy atho vaṇik / paścāc ca pītavān somaṃ sa rājan ketanakṣamaḥ

vulgate_text: śrāddhāpavarge viprasya dātāro vostvitīrayet / kṣatriyasyāpi yo brūyātprīyantāṃ pitarastviti
ce_text: śrāddhāpavarge viprasya svadhā vai svaditā bhavet / kṣatriyasyāpy atho brūyāt prīyantāṃ pitaras tv iti

vulgate_text: vaiśyasya daive vaktavyaṃ prīyantāṃ devatā iti / gorhisāyāṃ caturbhāgaṃ pūrvaṃ viprātiketinaḥ
ce_text: puṇyāhavācanaṃ daive brāhmaṇasya vidhīyate / etad eva niroṃkāraṃ kṣatriyasya vidhīyate / vaiśyasya caiva vaktavyaṃ prīyantāṃ devatā iti

vulgate_text: varṇāvareṣu bhuñjānaṃ kramācchūdre caturguṇam / nānyatra brāhmaṇo brūyātpūrvaṃ vipreṇa ketitaḥ
ce_text: nānyatra brāhmaṇo 'śnīyāt pūrvaṃ vipreṇa ketitaḥ / yavīyān paśuhiṃsāyāṃ tulyadharmo bhavet sa hi

vulgate_text: pālāśo dvijadaṇḍaḥ syādaśvatthaḥ kṣatriyasya tu audumbaraśca vaiśyasya dharma eṣa yudhiṣṭhira
ce_text: viprasya raśanā mauñjī maurvī rājanyagāminī / bālvajīty eva vaiśyasya dharma eṣa yudhiṣṭhira

vulgate_text: viṣamavyavahārāśca viṣamāścaiva vṛddhiṣu / lābheṣu viṣamāścaiva te vai nirayagāminaḥ
ce_text: pāṣaṇḍā dūṣakāś caiva samayānāṃ ca dūṣakāḥ / ye pratyavasitāś caiva te vai nirayagāminaḥ

vulgate_text: muṇḍe brahmagavā caiva niriciṃ devaparvatam devahradamupaspṛśya brahmabhūto virājate / kumārapadamāsthāya māsenaikena śudhyati
ce_text: vindhye saṃtāpya cātmānaṃ satyasaṃdhas tv ahiṃsakaḥ / ṣaṇmāsaṃ padam āsthāya māsenaikena śudhyati

vulgate_text: adhruvaṃ jīvitaṃ jñātvā yo vai vedāntago dvijaḥ abhyarcya devatāstatra namaskṛtya munīṃstathā
ce_text: śarīram utsṛjet tatra vidhipūrvam anāśake / adhruvaṃ jīvitaṃ jñātvā yo vai vedāntago dvijaḥ

vulgate_text: idaṃ medhyamidaṃ puṇyamidaṃ svargyamanuttamam / idaṃ rahasyaṃ vedānāmāplāvyaṃ pāvanaṃ tathā
ce_text: idaṃ medhyam idaṃ dhanyam idaṃ svargyam idaṃ sukham / idaṃ rahasyaṃ devānām āplāvyānāṃ ca pāvanam

vulgate_text: śilavṛttergṛhaṃ prāptaḥ sa tena vidhinā'rcitaḥ / uvāsa rajanīṃ tatra sumukhaḥ sukhabhāgṛṣiḥ
ce_text: śilavṛtter gṛhaṃ prāptaḥ sa tena vidhinārcitaḥ / kṛtakṛtya upātiṣṭhat siddhaṃ tam atithiṃ tadā

vulgate_text: śilavṛttistu yatkṛtyaṃ prātastatkṛtavāñśuciḥ / kṛtakṛtyamupātiṣṭhatsiddhaṃ tamatithiṃ tadā
ce_text: śilavṛtter gṛhaṃ prāptaḥ sa tena vidhinārcitaḥ / kṛtakṛtya upātiṣṭhat siddhaṃ tam atithiṃ tadā

vulgate_text: viśvalokeṣu puṇyatvādgaṅgāyāḥ prathitaṃ yaśaḥ durmṛtānanapatyāṃśca sā mṛtānanayaddivam / yatputrānsagarasyeto bhasmākhyānanayaddivam
ce_text: triṣu lokeṣu puṇyatvād gaṅgāyāḥ prathitaṃ yaśaḥ / yat putrān sagarasyaiṣā bhasmākhyān anayad divam

vulgate_text: ke pūjyā vai triloke'sminmānavā bharatarpabha / vistareṇa tadācakṣva na hi tṛpyāmi kathyataḥ
ce_text: ke pūjyāḥ ke namaskāryā mānavair bharatarṣabha / vistareṇa tad ācakṣva na hi tṛpyāmi kathyatām

vulgate_text: devatātithibhṛtyānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ cārcane ratāḥ / śiṣṭānnabhojino ye ca durgāṇyatitaranti te
ce_text: nityaṃ śamaparā ye ca tathā ye cānasūyakāḥ / nityaṃ svādhyāyino ye ca durgāṇy atitaranti te

vulgate_text: pitāmaha mahāprājña sarvaśāstraviśārada / tvatto'haṃ śrotumicchāmi dharmaṃ bharatasattama
ce_text: bhagavan sarvadharmajña sarvaśāstraviśārada / martyasya kaḥ sahāyo vai pitā mātā suto guruḥ

vulgate_text: etadrājñaḥ kṛtyatamamabhiṣiktasya bhārata / brāhmaṇānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ ca pūjā ca sukhamicchataḥ
ce_text: etad rājñaḥ kṛtyatamam abhiṣiktasya bhārata / brāhmaṇānām anuṣṭhānam atyantaṃ sukham icchatā / śrotriyān brāhmaṇān vṛddhān nityam evābhipūjayet

vulgate_text: kartavyaṃ pārthivendreṇa tathaiva bharatarṣabha / śrotriyānbrāhmaṇānvṛddhānnityamevābhipūjayet
ce_text: etad rājñaḥ kṛtyatamam abhiṣiktasya bhārata / brāhmaṇānām anuṣṭhānam atyantaṃ sukham icchatā / śrotriyān brāhmaṇān vṛddhān nityam evābhipūjayet

vulgate_text: parivādaṃ ca ye kuryurbrāhmaṇānāmacetasaḥ / satyaṃ bravīmi te rājanvinaśyeyurna saṃśayaḥ
ce_text: parivādaṃ ca ye kuryur brāhmaṇānām acetasaḥ / nindāpraśaṃsākuśalāḥ kīrtyakīrtiparāvarāḥ / parikupyanti te rājan satataṃ dviṣatāṃ dvijāḥ

vulgate_text: ādityaścandramā viṣṇuḥ saṅkaro'gniḥ prajāpatiḥ / sarve brāhmaṇamāviśya sadā'nnamupabhuñjate
ce_text: ādityaś candramā vāyur bhūmir āpo 'mbaraṃ diśaḥ / sarve brāhmaṇam āviśya sadānnam upabhuñjate

vulgate_text: mahārathaśca rājanya eṣṭavyaḥ śatrutāpanaḥ / iti māṃ nāradaḥ prāha satataṃ sarvabhūtaye
ce_text: jāyatāṃ brahmavarcasvī rāṣṭre vai brāhmaṇaḥ śuciḥ / mahārathaś ca rājanya eṣṭavyaḥ śatrutāpanaḥ

vulgate_text: mekalā drāviḍā lāṭāḥ pauṇḍrāḥ kānvaśirāstathā / śauṇḍikā daradā dārvāścorāḥ śabarabarbarāḥ
ce_text: mekalā dramiḍāḥ kāśāḥ pauṇḍrāḥ kollagirās tathā / śauṇḍikā daradā darvāś caurāḥ śabarabarbarāḥ

ce_text: anṛtaṃ satyam ity āhuḥ satyaṃ cāpi tathānṛtam / iti yās tāḥ kathaṃ vīra saṃrakṣyāḥ puruṣair iha

vulgate_text: taṃ vai saṃyujya śāpena maṇḍūkaṃ tvarito yayau / anyatra vāsāya vibhurna cātmānamadarśayat
ce_text: taṃ sa saṃyujya śāpena maṇḍūkaṃ pāvako yayau / anyatra vāsāya vibhur na ca devān adarśayat

ce_text: vimūḍhāsmi kṛtānena tathāsvāsthyaṃ kṛtaṃ param / vihvalā cāsmi bhagavaṃs tejo naṣṭaṃ ca me 'nagha

vulgate_text: evamuktā tu sā devī tatraivāntaradhīyata pāvakaścāpi tejasvī kṛtvā kāryaṃ divaukasām / jagāmeṣṭaṃ tadā deśaṃ tato bhārgavanandana
ce_text: pāvakaś cāpi tejasvī kṛtvā kāryaṃ divaukasām / jagāmeṣṭaṃ tato deśaṃ tadā bhārgavanandana

vulgate_text: saṃjuhāvātmanā''tmānaṃ svayameva tadā prabho / yajñaṃ ca śobhayāmāsa bahurūpaṃ pinākadhṛt

ce_text: śeṣāḥ prajānāṃ patayaḥ srotobhyas tasya jajñire / ṛṣayo lomakūpebhyaḥ svedāc chando malātmakam

vulgate_text: devapakṣacarāḥ saumyāḥ prājāpatyā maharṣayaḥ / anantaṃ brahma satyaṃ ca tapaśca paramaṃ bhuvi

ce_text: kuśastambe juhoty agniṃ suvarṇaṃ tatra saṃsthitam / hute prītikarīm ṛddhiṃ bhagavāṃs tatra manyate

vulgate_text: uktaṃ sa daivatānāṃ hi avadhya iti pārthiva / kathaṃ tasyābhavanmṛtyurvistareṇa prakīrtaya

vulgate_text: sarveṣvahaḥsu prīyante kṛte śrāddhe pitāmahāḥ piṇḍānvāhāryakaṃ śrāddhaṃ kuryānmāsānumāsikam / pitṛyajñaṃ tu nirvartya vipraścandrakṣaye'gnimān
ce_text: sarveṣv ahaḥsu prīyante kṛtaiḥ śrāddhaiḥ pitāmahāḥ / pravakṣyāmi tu te sarvāṃs tithyāṃ tithyāṃ guṇāguṇān

vulgate_text: kuśīlavo devalako nakṣatrairyaśca jīvatī īdṛśairbrāhmaṇairbhuktamapāṅkteyairyudhiṣṭhira

vulgate_text: tilairvirahitaṃ śrāddhaṃ kṛtaṃ krodhavaśena ca / yātudhānāḥ piśācāśca vipralumpanti taddhaviḥ
ce_text: tilādāne ca kravyādā ye ca krodhavaśā gaṇāḥ / yātudhānāḥ piśācāś ca vipralumpanti tad dhaviḥ

vulgate_text: vidyāvedavratasnātā brāhmaṇāḥ sarva eva hi / sadācāraparāścaiva vijñeyāḥ sarvapāvanāḥ
ce_text: vedavidyāvratasnātā brāhmaṇāḥ sarva eva hi / pāṅkteyān yāṃs tu vakṣyāmi jñeyās te paṅktipāvanāḥ

vulgate_text: yatayo mokṣadharmajñā yoginaścaritavratāḥ / pañcarātravido mukhyāstathā bhāgavatāḥ pare
ce_text: ime pare mahārāja vijñeyāḥ paṅktipāvanāḥ / yatayo mokṣadharmajñā yogāḥ sucaritavratāḥ

vulgate_text: vaikhānasāḥ kulaśreṣṭhā vaidikācāracāriṇaḥ ye cetihāsaṃ prayatāḥ śrāvayanti dvijottamān
ce_text: ye cetihāsaṃ prayatāḥ śrāvayanti dvijottamān / ye ca bhāṣyavidaḥ ke cid ye ca vyākaraṇe ratāḥ

vulgate_text: srajo vajrīvarī caiva viśvedevāḥ sanātanāḥ / vidyudvarcāḥ somavarcāḥ sūryaśrīśceti nāmataḥ
ce_text: srajī vajrī varī caiva viśvedevāḥ sanātanāḥ / kīrtitās te mahābhāgāḥ kālasya gatigocarāḥ

vulgate_text: rakṣāṃsi nābhivardhante sthite deve hutāśane / pūrvaṃ piṇḍaṃ piturdadyāttato dadyātpitāmahe
ce_text: pūrvaṃ piṇḍaṃ pitur dadyāt tato dadyāt pitāmahe / prapitāmahāya ca tata eṣa śrāddhavidhiḥ smṛtaḥ

vulgate_text: ete kurukulaśreṣṭha mahāyogeśvarāḥ smṛtāḥ ete ca pitaro rājanneṣa śrāddhavidhiḥ paraḥ
ce_text: pitāmahaḥ pulastyaś ca vasiṣṭhaḥ pulahas tathā / aṅgirāś ca kratuś caiva kaśyapaś ca mahān ṛṣiḥ / ete kurukulaśreṣṭha mahāyogeśvarāḥ smṛtāḥ

vulgate_text: pretāstu piṇḍasambandhānmucyante tena karmaṇā ityeṣā puruṣaśreṣṭha śrāddhotpattiryathāgamam
ce_text: ete ca pitaro rājann eṣa śrāddhavidhiḥ paraḥ / pretās tu piṇḍasaṃbandhān mucyante tena karmaṇā

vulgate_text: devebhyaśca pitṛbhyaśca saṃśritebhyastathaiva ca / avaśiṣṭāni yo bhuṅkte tamāhurvighasāśinam
ce_text: devebhyaś ca pitṛbhyaś ca bhṛtyebhyo 'tithibhiḥ saha / avaśiṣṭāni yo bhuṅkte tam āhur vighasāśinam

vulgate_text: pratigraho brāhmaṇānāṃ sṛṣṭā vṛttiraninditā tasmāddadāmi vo vittaṃ tadvṛṇudhvaṃ tapodhanāḥ
ce_text: pratigrahas tārayati puṣṭir vai pratigṛhṇatām / mayi yad vidyate vittaṃ tac chṛṇudhvaṃ tapodhanāḥ

vulgate_text: aśvāṃstathā śīghragāñśvetarūpāṃnmanojavānpradadāmyarbudāni / kulambharānanaḍuhaḥ śataṃ śatāndhuryāñśvetānsarvaśo'haṃ dadāmi praṣṭhauhīnāṃ pīvarāṇāṃ ca tāvadagryā gṛṣṭīrdhenavaḥ suvratāśca
ce_text: kulaṃbharān anaḍuhaḥ śataṃśatān dhuryāñ śubhān sarvaśo 'haṃ dadāni / pṛthvīvāhān pīvarāṃś caiva tāvad agryā gṛṣṭyo dhenavaḥ suvratāś ca

vulgate_text: gurūṇīti viditvā'tha na grāhyāṇyatrirabravīt / nāsmeha mandavijñānā nāsma mānuṣabuddhayaḥ
ce_text: gurūṇīti viditvātha na grāhyāṇy atrir abravīt / na sma he mūḍhavijñānā na sma he mandabuddhayaḥ / haimānīmāni jānīmaḥ pratibuddhāḥ sma jāgṛmaḥ

vulgate_text: haimānīmāni jānīmaḥ pratibuddhāḥ sma jāgṛma iha hyetadupāvṛttaṃ pretya syātkaṭukodayam / apratigrāhyamevaitatpretyeha ca sukhepsunā
ce_text: iha hy etad upādattaṃ pretya syāt kaṭukodayam / apratigrāhyam evaitat pretya ceha sukhepsunā

vulgate_text: yadvai dharmātparaṃ nāsti tādṛśaṃ brāhmaṇā viduḥ / vinayātsādhu vidvāṃsamupāseyaṃ yathātatham
ce_text: yad vai dharme paraṃ nāsti brāhmaṇās tad dhanaṃ viduḥ / vinayārthaṃ suvidvāṃsam upāseyaṃ yathātatham

vulgate_text: atha te mantriṇaḥ sarve rājānamidamabruvan upadhiṃ śaṅkamānāste hitvā tāni phalāni vai / tato'nyatraiva gacchanti viditaṃ te'stu pārthiva
ce_text: upadhiṃ śaṅkamānās te hitvemāni phalāni vai / tato 'nyenaiva gacchanti viditaṃ te 'stu pārthiva

vulgate_text: godamo damato'dhūmo'damaste samadarśanāt viddhi māṃ gotamaṃ kṛtye yātudhāni nibodha māṃ
ce_text: godamo damago 'dhūmo damo durdarśanaś ca te / viddhi māṃ gautamaṃ kṛtye yātudhāni nibodha me

vulgate_text: vaktraikadeśe gaṇḍeti dhātumetaṃ pracakṣate / tenonnatena gaṇḍeti viddhi mā'nalasambhave
ce_text: gaṇḍaṃ gaṇḍaṃ gatavatī gaṇḍagaṇḍeti saṃjñitā / gaṇḍagaṇḍeva gaṇḍeti viddhi mānalasaṃbhave

vulgate_text: bahuṣvapi nimitteṣu puṇyamāśritya dīyate / etadvistarato brahmañśrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ

vulgate_text: upānahau ca yo dadyācchlakṣṇau snehasamanvitau / snātakāya mahābāho saṃśitāya dvijātaye

vulgate_text: sadā yajñena devāṃśca sadā''tithyena mānuṣān / chandatastarpaṇenāpi pitṝnyuñjanti nityaśaḥ

vulgate_text: manuṣyebhya iti prāhurbaliṃ dvāri gṛhasya vai / marudbhyo daivatebhyaśca balimantargṛhe haret

vulgate_text: tatastau satyasaṃkalpau merau kāñcanaparvate / devarṣibhiḥ sadā juṣṭe sahitau saṃnyaṣīdatām

ce_text: tasmāt somo 'py avikreyaḥ puruṣeṇa vipaścitā / vikrayaṃ hīha somasya garhayanti manīṣiṇaḥ

ce_text: so 'haṃ tena ca vṛttena bhojanena ca tena vai / imām avasthāṃ saṃprāptaḥ paśya kālasya paryayam

vulgate_text: sahasraṃ niṣkakaṇṭhānāmadadaṃ dakṣiṇāmaham vijitya bhūpatīnsarvānarthairiṣṭvā pitāmaha / aṣṭabhyo rājasūyebhyo na ca tenāhamāgataḥ
ce_text: vijitya nṛpatīn sarvān makhair iṣṭvā pitāmaha / aṣṭabhyo rājasūyebhyo na ca tenāham āgataḥ

vulgate_text: tapasvī niyatāhāraḥ śamamāsthāya vāgyataḥ / dīrghakālaṃ himavati gaṅgārthamacaraṃ tapaḥ

vulgate_text: mūrdhnā haraṃ mahādevaṃ praṇamyābhyarcayannṛpaḥ / na tenāpyahamāgacchaṃ phaleneha pitāmaha
ce_text: dīrghakālaṃ himavati gaṅgāyāś ca durutsahām / mūrdhnā dhārāṃ mahādevaḥ śirasā yām adhārayat / na tenāpy aham āgacchaṃ phaleneha pitāmaha

ce_text: evam evāparāṃ saṃdhyāṃ samupāsīta vāgyataḥ / nekṣetādityam udyantaṃ nāstaṃ yāntaṃ kadā cana

ce_text: ṛṣayo dīrghasaṃdhyatvād dīrgham āyur avāpnuvan / tasmāt tiṣṭhet sadā pūrvāṃ paścimāṃ caiva vāgyataḥ

ce_text: nātikalpaṃ nātisāyaṃ na ca madhyaṃdine sthite / nājñātaiḥ saha gaccheta naiko na vṛṣalaiḥ saha

ce_text: pradakṣiṇaṃ ca kurvīta parijñātān vanaspatīn / catuṣpathān prakurvīta sarvān eva pradakṣiṇān

vulgate_text: nityamagniṃ paricaredbhikṣāṃ dadyācca nityadā / dantakāṣṭhe ca sandhyāyāṃ malotsarge ca maunagaḥ
ce_text: nityam agniṃ paricared bhikṣāṃ dadyāc ca nityadā / vāgyato dantakāṣṭhaṃ ca nityam eva samācaret / na cābhyuditaśāyī syāt prāyaścittī tathā bhavet

vulgate_text: na cābhyuditasāyī syātprāyaścittī tathā bhavet mātāpitaramutthāya pūrvamevābhivādayet / ācāryamathavā'pyantaṃ tathā''yurvidante mahat
ce_text: mātāpitaram utthāya pūrvam evābhivādayet / ācāryam atha vāpy enaṃ tathāyur vindate mahat

vulgate_text: keśagrahaṃ prahārāṃśca sirasyetānvivarjayet na saṃhātābhyāṃ pāṇibhyāṃ kaṇḍūyedātmanaḥ śiraḥ / na cābhīkṣṇaṃ śiraḥsnāyāttathā syāyurna riṣyate
ce_text: na pāṇibhyām ubhābhyāṃ ca kaṇḍūyej jātu vai śiraḥ / na cābhīkṣṇaṃ śiraḥ snāyāt tathāsyāyur na riṣyate

vulgate_text: śiraḥsnātastu tailaiśca nāṅgaṃ kiñcidapi spṛśet / tilapiṣṭaṃ na cāśnīyādgatasarvarasaṃ tathā

vulgate_text: apūpānvividhākārāñśākāni vividhāni ca / pādapānrasasaṃyuktānna cecchanti yathā''miṣam
ce_text: nāpūpān vividhākārāñ śākāni vividhāni ca / ṣāḍavān rasayogāṃś ca tathecchanti yathāmiṣam

vulgate_text: sadyo vardhayati prāṇānpuṣṭimagryāṃ dadhāti ca / nāśo bhakṣaṇadoṣaḥ syāddānameva sadā matam
ce_text: sadyo vardhayati prāṇān puṣṭim agryāṃ dadāti ca / na bhakṣo 'bhyadhikaḥ kaś cin māṃsād asti paraṃtapa

vulgate_text: rakṣaṇārthāya bhūtānāṃ hiṃsrānhanyānmṛgānpunaḥ nātmānamaparityajya mṛgayā nāma vidyate
ce_text: nātmānam aparityajya mṛgayā nāma vidyate / samatām upasaṃgamya rūpaṃ hanyān na vā nṛpa

vulgate_text: samatāmupasaṅgamya rūpaṃ hanyānna vā nṛpa ato rājarṣayaḥ sarve mṛgayāṃ yānti bhārata / na hi lipyanti pāpena na caitatpātakaṃ bhuvi
ce_text: ato rājarṣayaḥ sarve mṛgayāṃ yānti bhārata / lipyante na hi doṣeṇa na caitat pātakaṃ viduḥ

vulgate_text: sarvadānaphalaṃ vā'pi naitattulyamahiṃsayā ahiṃsasya tapo'kṣayyamahiṃsro jayate sadā
ce_text: sarvayajñeṣu vā dānaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu cāplutam / sarvadānaphalaṃ vāpi naitat tulyam ahiṃsayā

vulgate_text: ahiṃsraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ yathā mātā yathā pitā etatphalamahiṃsāyāṃ bhūyaśca kurupuṅgava
ce_text: ahiṃsrasya tapo 'kṣayyam ahiṃsro yajate sadā / ahiṃsraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ yathā mātā yathā pitā

vulgate_text: vākślakṣṇo hyakṛtaprajño dveṣṭā viśvasya karmaṇaḥ / mithoguptanidhirnityaṃ parasvaharaṇe rataḥ
ce_text: vāktīkṣṇo nikṛtiprajño moṣṭā viśvasya sarvaśaḥ / mithaḥkṛto 'panidhanaḥ parasvaharaṇe rataḥ

vulgate_text: devārthaṃ pitṛyajñārthaṃ na ca śrāddhaṃ kṛtaṃ mayā / na dattamannakāmeṣu dattamannaṃ lunāmi ca
ce_text: devārthaṃ pitṛyajñārtham annaṃ śraddhākṛtaṃ mayā / na dattam arthakāmena deyam annaṃ punāti ha

vulgate_text: guptaṃ śaraṇamāśritya bhayeṣu śaraṇāgatān / tyaktvā'kasmānniśāyāṃ ca na dattamabhayaṃ mayā
ce_text: guptaṃ śaraṇam āśritya bhayeṣu śaraṇāgatāḥ / akasmān no bhayāt tyaktā na ca trātābhayaiṣiṇaḥ

vulgate_text: vāgbuddhipāṇipādaiśca samupetā vipaścitaḥ / kimāyāti manuṣyasya mandasyārthasya jīvataḥ
ce_text: vāgbuddhipāṇipādaiś cāpy upetasya vipaścitaḥ / kiṃ hīyate manuṣyasya mandasyāpi hi jīvataḥ

vulgate_text: śūdreṇārthapradhānena nṛśaṃsenātatāyinā mamaitaddarśanaṃ prāptaṃ tacca vai sukṛtaṃ purā / tiryagyonau sma jātena mama cābhyarcanāttathā
ce_text: mama te darśanaṃ prāptaṃ tac caiva sukṛtaṃ purā / tiryagyonau sma jātena mama cāpy arcanāt tathā

vulgate_text: rājaputraḥ sukhaṃ prāpya īje caivāptadakṣiṇaiḥ / atha coddīpyata svarge prabhūtopyavyayaḥ sukhī
ce_text: rājaputrasukhaṃ prāpya ṛtūṃś caivāptadakṣiṇān / atha modiṣyase svarge brahmabhūto 'vyayaḥ sukhī

vulgate_text: upapadyati dharmajña yathādharmaṃ yathāvratam tasmānmṛtyubhayātkīṭa mā vyathiṣṭhāḥ kathañcana / dharmalābhātparaṃ na syāttasmāddharmaṃ carottamam
ce_text: tasmān mṛtyubhayāt kīṭa mā vyathiṣṭhāḥ kathaṃ cana / dharmalopād bhayaṃ te syāt tasmād dharmaṃ carottamam

vulgate_text: kurukṣetre yuddhahatāḥ puṇye kṣatriyapuṅgavāḥ / samprāptāste gatiṃ puṇyāṃ tanmā tvaṃ śoca putraka
ce_text: te 'pi yasmāt svabhāvena hatāḥ kṣatriyapuṃgavāḥ / saṃprāptās te gatiṃ puṇyāṃ tasmān mā śoca putraka

vulgate_text: tapobhāgyānmahābhāga sukhabhāgyāttathaiva ca pṛthagācaritaṃ tāta pṛthagācaritātmanaḥ / alpāntaramahaṃ manye viśiṣṭamapi cānvayāt
ce_text: pṛthag ācaratas tāta pṛthag ātmani cātmanoḥ / alpāntaram ahaṃ manye viśiṣṭam api vā tvayā

vulgate_text: iti vedoktamṛṣibhiḥ purastātparikalpitam / idānīṃ caiva naḥ kṛtyaṃ purastācca pariśrutam
ce_text: trīṇy eva tu padāny āhuḥ puruṣasyottamaṃ vratam / na druhyec caiva dadyāc ca satyaṃ caiva paraṃ vadet / idānīṃ caiva naḥ kṛtyaṃ purastāc ca paraṃ smṛtam

vulgate_text: toṣitāstridaśā yatte dattvaitaddarśanaṃ mama / ajaiṣīrmahato lokānmahāyajñairiva prabho
ce_text: tṛṣitas tṛṣitāya tvaṃ dattvaitad aśanaṃ mama / ajaiṣīr mahato lokān mahāyajñair ivābhibho / ato dānapavitreṇa prīto 'smi tapasaiva ca

vulgate_text: puṇyaśca vātigandhaste manye karma vidhānajam / atha karmārjitastāta yathācaivānulepanāt
ce_text: puṇyasyaiva hi te gandhaḥ puṇyasyaiva ca darśanam / puṇyaś ca vāti gandhas te manye karmavidhānataḥ

vulgate_text: annaṃ hyavidvānhantyevamavidvāṃsaṃ ca hanti tat / taccānyaṃ hanti yaccānyatsa bhuktvā hanyate'budhaḥ
ce_text: adan hy avidvān hanty annam adyamānaṃ ca hanti tam / taṃ ca hanyati yasyānnaṃ sa hatvā hanyate 'budhaḥ

vulgate_text: loko hyayaṃ guṇāneva bhūyiṣṭhaṃ sampraśaṃsati / rūpamāno vayomāno dhanavidyāmadastathā
ce_text: evam uktaḥ sa bhagavān maitreyaṃ pratyabhāṣata / diṣṭyaivaṃ tvaṃ vijānāsi diṣṭyā te buddhir īdṛśī / loko hy ayaṃ guṇān eva bhūyiṣṭhaṃ sma praśaṃsati

vulgate_text: diṣṭyā nābhibhavanti tvāṃ daivaste'yamanugrahaḥ / tatte bahuguṇaṃ dānaṃ vartayiṣyāmi tacchṛṇu
ce_text: rūpamānavayomānaśrīmānāś cāpy asaṃśayam / diṣṭyā nābhibhavanti tvāṃ daivas te 'yam anugrahaḥ / yat te bhṛśataraṃ dānād vartayiṣyāmi tac chṛṇu

vulgate_text: akartā caiva kartā ca labhate yasya yādṛśam / yadi cordhvaṃ yadyadho vā svānlokānabhiyāsyati
ce_text: akartā caiva kartā ca labhate yasya yādṛśam / yady evordhvaṃ yady avāk ca tvaṃ lokam abhiyāsyasi

vulgate_text: adbhirgātrānmalamiva tamo'gniprabhayā yathā ] dānena tapasā caiva viṣṇorabhyarcanena ca / brāhmaṇaḥ sa mahābhāga taretsaṃsārasāgarāt
ce_text: adbhir gātrān malam iva tamo 'gniprabhayā yathā / dānena tapasā caiva sarvapāpam apohyate

vulgate_text: subuddhiḥ śrutisampanno dṛṣṭvā tamatibhīṣaṇam / sāmaivāsmai prayuñjāno na mumoha na vivyadhe
ce_text: sa buddhiśrutasaṃpannas taṃ dṛṣṭvātīva bhīṣaṇam / sāmaivāsmin prayuyuje na mumoha na vivyathe

vulgate_text: prājñairapujito nūnaṃ prājñairapyabhininditaḥ / hrīmānamarṣī durvṛttastenāsi hariṇaḥ kṛśaḥ
ce_text: prājñaiḥ saṃbhāvito nūnaṃ naprājñair upasaṃhitaḥ / hrīmān amarṣī durvṛttais tenāsi hariṇaḥ kṛśaḥ

vulgate_text: parokṣavādibhirmithyādoṣaste sampradarśitaḥ / tajjñairna pūjyase vyaktaṃ tenāsi hariṇaḥ kṛśaḥ
ce_text: prakāśārthagatir nūnaṃ rahasyakuśalaḥ kṛtī / tajjñair na pūjyase nūnaṃ tenāsi hariṇaḥ kṛśaḥ

vulgate_text: asatsu viniviṣṭeṣu na guṇānvadataḥ svayam / guṇāste na virājante tenāsi hariṇaḥ kṛśaḥ
ce_text: asatsv abhiniviṣṭeṣu bruvato muktasaṃśayam / guṇās te na virājante tenāsi hariṇaḥ kṛśaḥ

vulgate_text: dharmavṛttaḥ śrutairhīnaḥ padaṃ tvaṃ rajasānvitaḥ / mahatprārthayase nūnaṃ tenāsi hariṇaḥ kṛśaḥ
ce_text: dhanabuddhiśrutair hīnaḥ kevalaṃ tejasānvitaḥ / mahat prārthayase nūnaṃ tenāsi hariṇaḥ kṛśaḥ

vulgate_text: pitāmaha mahāprājña sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ / śrūyatāṃ me hi vacanamarthitvātprabravīmyaham
ce_text: pitāmaha mahāprājña sarvaśāstraviśārada / āgamair bahubhiḥ sphīto bhavān naḥ prathitaḥ kule

vulgate_text: parāvarajño bhūtānāṃ dayāvānsarvajantuṣu / āgamairbahubhiḥ prīto bhavānnaḥ paramaṃ kule
ce_text: pitāmaha mahāprājña sarvaśāstraviśārada / āgamair bahubhiḥ sphīto bhavān naḥ prathitaḥ kule

vulgate_text: ayaṃ sa kālaḥ samprāpto durlabhairjñātibāndhavaiḥ / śāstā tu nāsti naḥ kaścittvadṛte puruṣarṣabha
ce_text: ayaṃ ca kālaḥ saṃprāpto durlabhajñātibāndhavaḥ / śāstā ca na hi naḥ kaś cit tvām ṛte bharatarṣabha

vulgate_text: tasmāddharmārthasahitamāyatyāṃ ca hitodayam / āścaryaṃ paramaṃ vākyaṃ śrotumicchāmi bhārata
ce_text: tvatto dharmārthasaṃyuktam āyatyāṃ ca sukhodayam / āścaryabhūtaṃ lokasya śrotum icchāmy ariṃdama

vulgate_text: yadi te'hamanugrāhyo bhrātṛbhiḥ sahito'nagha / matpriyārthaṃ hi kauravya snehādbhāṣitumarhasi
ce_text: yadi te 'ham anugrāhyo bhrātṛbhiḥ sahito 'nagha / vaktum arhasi naḥ praśnaṃ yat tvāṃ pṛcchāmi pārthiva

vulgate_text: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā snehādāgataviklavaḥ / pravibanniva taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhīṣmo vacanamabravīt
ce_text: tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā snehād āgatasaṃbhramaḥ / bhīṣmo bhāgīrathīputra idaṃ vacanam abravīt

vulgate_text: nāradaḥ parvataścaiva kṛṣṇadvaipāyanastathā devalaḥ kāśyapaścaiva hastikāśyapa eva ca / jamadagniśca rājendra dhaumyo vālmīkireva ca
ce_text: kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaś caiva dhaumyaś ca japatāṃ varaḥ / devalaḥ kāśyapaś caiva hastikāśyapa eva ca

vulgate_text: keśavastānabhigatānprītyā samparigṛhya ca teṣāmatithisatkāraṃ pūjanārthaṃ kulocitam / devakītanayo hṛṣṭo devatulyamakalpayat
ce_text: teṣām atithisatkāram arcanīyaṃ kulocitam / devakītanayaḥ prīto devakalpam akalpayat

vulgate_text: tato nārāyaṇo devaḥ saṃkliṣṭo vratacaryayā / vahnirviniḥsṛto vaktrātkṛṣṇasyādbhutadarśanaḥ
ce_text: tato nārāyaṇaṃ tejo vratacaryendhanotthitam / vaktrān niḥsṛtya kṛṣṇasya vahnir adbhutakarmaṇaḥ

vulgate_text: keśavasya vacaḥ śrutvā tuṣṭuvurmunipuṅgavāḥ bhavānsṛjati vai lokānbhavānsaṃharati prajāḥ / bhavāñśītaṃ bhavānuṣṇaṃ bhavānsatyaṃ bhavānkratuḥ
ce_text: bhavān visṛjate lokān bhavān saṃharate punaḥ / bhavāñ śītaṃ bhavān uṣṇaṃ bhavān eva pravarṣati

vulgate_text: tvattaḥ sarvamidaṃ tāta lokacakraṃ pravartate / tvamevārhasi tadvaktuṃ mukhādagnivinirgamam
ce_text: etan no vismayakaraṃ praśaṃsa madhusūdana / tvam evārhasi kalyāṇa vaktuṃ vahner vinirgamam

vulgate_text: evaṃ me vaiṣṇavaṃ tejo mama vaktrādviniḥsṛtam / tattejasā nirmathitaḥ purato'yaṃ giriḥ sthitaḥ
ce_text: etat tad vaiṣṇavaṃ tejo mama vaktrād viniḥsṛtam / kṛṣṇavartmā yugāntābho yenāyaṃ mathito giriḥ

vulgate_text: tasmādbhavadbhiryatkiṃcidṛṣṭaṃ vā'pyathavā śrutam / āścaryabhūtaṃ lokeṣu tadbhavanto bruvantu me
ce_text: yac chrutaṃ yac ca vo dṛṣṭaṃ divi vā yadi vā bhuvi / āścaryaṃ paramaṃ kiṃ cit tad bhavanto bruvantu me

vulgate_text: yuṣmābhiḥ kathitaṃ yatsyāttapasā bhāvitātmabhiḥ tasyādamṛtasaṃkāśaṃ vāṅmadhuśravaṇe spṛhā
ce_text: tasyāmṛtanikāśasya vāṅmadhor asti me spṛhā / bhavadbhiḥ kathitasyeha tapovananivāsibhiḥ

vulgate_text: tatastvṛṣigaṇāḥ sarve nāradaṃ devadarśanam / amanyanta budhā buddhyā samarthaṃ tannibodhane
ce_text: tato munigaṇāḥ sarve nāradaṃ devadarśanam / tadā niyojayām āsur vacane vākyakovidam

vulgate_text: bhavatā tīrthayātrārthaṃ caratā himavadgirau / dṛṣṭaṃ vai yattadāścaryaṃ śrotṝṇāṃ paramaṃ priyam
ce_text: yad āścaryam acintyaṃ ca girau himavati prabho / anubhūtaṃ munigaṇais tīrthayātrāparāyaṇaiḥ

vulgate_text: atastvamaviśeṣeṇa hitārthaṃ sarvamāditaḥ / priyārthaṃ keśavasyāsya sa bhavānvaktumarhati
ce_text: tad bhavān ṛṣisaṃghasya hitārthaṃ sarvacoditaḥ / yathādṛṣṭaṃ hṛṣīkeśe sarvam ākhyātum arhati

vulgate_text: mṛdaṅgamurajoddhuṣṭaṃ śaṅkhavīṇābhināditam / nṛtyadbhirbhūtasaṅghaiśca sarvatastvabhiśobhitam
ce_text: mṛdaṅgapaṇavodghuṣṭaṃ śaṅkhabherīnināditam / nṛtyadbhir bhūtasaṃghaiś ca barhiṇaiś ca samantataḥ

vulgate_text: pranṛttāpsarasaṃ divyaṃ devagandharvanāditam / prathame varṣarātre tu meghasaṅghanināditam
ce_text: pranṛttāpsarasaṃ divyaṃ divyastrīgaṇasevitam / dṛṣṭikāntam anirdeśyaṃ divyam adbhutadarśanam

vulgate_text: ye codhvaretasaḥ siddhāstatratatra samāgatāḥ / mārtāṇḍaraśmisañcārā viśvedevagaṇāstathā
ce_text: munayaś ca mahābhāgāḥ siddhāś caivordhvaretasaḥ / maruto vasavaḥ sādhyā viśvedevāḥ sanātanāḥ

vulgate_text: tathā nāgāstathā divyā lokapālā hutāśanāḥ / vātāśca sarve cāyānti divyapuṣpasamākulāḥ
ce_text: yakṣā nāgāḥ piśācāś ca lokapālā hutāśanāḥ / bhāvāś ca sarve nyagbhūtās tatraivāsan samāgatāḥ

vulgate_text: kirantaḥ sarvapuṣpāṇi kiranto'dbhutadarśanāḥ / oṣadhyaḥ prajvalantyaśca dyotayantyo diśo daśa
ce_text: ṛtavaḥ sarvapuṣpaiś ca vyakiranta mahādbhutaiḥ / oṣadhyo jvalamānāś ca dyotayanti sma tad vanam

vulgate_text: vihagāśca mudā yuktā nṛtyanti ca nadanti ca / tataḥ samantatastatra divyā divyajanapriyāḥ
ce_text: vihagāś ca mudā yuktāḥ prānṛtyan vyanadaṃś ca ha / giripṛṣṭheṣu ramyeṣu vyāharanto janapriyāḥ

vulgate_text: vyāghracarmaparīdhāno gajacarmottaracchadaḥ / vyālayajñopavītaśca lohitāntravibhūṣitaḥ
ce_text: vyāghracarmāmbaradharaḥ siṃhacarmottaracchadaḥ / vyālayajñopavītī ca lohitāṅgadabhūṣaṇaḥ

vulgate_text: hariśmaśrujaṭo bhīmo bhayakartā'maradviṣām / bhayaheturabhaktānāṃ bhaktānāmabhayaṅkaraḥ
ce_text: hariśmaśrur jaṭī bhīmo bhayakartā suradviṣām / abhayaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ bhaktānāṃ vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ

vulgate_text: kinnarairdevagandharvaiḥ stūyamānastatastataḥ / ṛṣibhiścāpsarobhiśca sarvataścaiva śobhitaḥ
ce_text: ulūkavadanair bhīmaiḥ śyenabhāsamukhais tathā / nānāvarṇamṛgaprakhyaiḥ sarvajātisamanvayaiḥ / kiṃnarair devagandharvair yakṣabhūtagaṇais tathā

vulgate_text: mahoragasamākīrṇaṃ sarveṣāṃ romaharṣaṇam / bhīmarūpamanirdeśyamapradhṛṣyatamaṃ vibhoḥ
ce_text: tasya bhūtapateḥ sthānaṃ bhīmarūpadharaṃ babhau / apradhṛṣyataraṃ caiva mahoragasamākulam

vulgate_text: kāñcanaṃ kalaśaṃ gṛhya sarvatīrthāmbupūritam / puṣpavṛṣṭyā'bhivarṣantī divyagandhasamāvṛtā
ce_text: puṣpavṛṣṭyābhivarṣantī gandhair bahuvidhais tathā / sevantī himavatpārśvaṃ harapārśvam upāgamat

vulgate_text: devyā cāndhīkṛte deve kaśmalaṃ samapadyata / nimīlite bhūtapatau naṣṭacandrārkatārakam
ce_text: janaś ca vimanāḥ sarvo bhayatrāsasamanvitaḥ / nimīlite bhūtapatau naṣṭasūrya ivābhavat

vulgate_text: tṛtīyaṃ cāsya sambhūtaṃ lalāṭe netramāyatam / dvādaśādityasaṅkāśaṃ lokānbhāsā'vabhāsayat
ce_text: tṛtīyaṃ cāsya saṃbhūtaṃ netram ādityasaṃnibham / yugāntasadṛśaṃ dīptaṃ yenāsau mathito giriḥ

vulgate_text: dahyamāne girau tasminmṛgapakṣisamākule / savidyādharagandharve divyauṣadhasamākule
ce_text: dahyamāne vane tasmin saśālasaraladrume / sacandanavane ramye divyauṣadhividīpite

vulgate_text: hṛṣṭapuṣṭavihaṅgaiśca praphulladrumakānanaḥ / siddhacāraṇasaṅghaiśca prītiyuktaiḥ samākulaḥ
ce_text: tato 'bhavat punaḥ sarvaḥ prakṛtisthaḥ sudarśanaḥ / prahṛṣṭavihagaś caiva prapuṣpitavanadrumaḥ

vulgate_text: bhagavandevadeveśa śūlapāṇe mahādyute / vismayo me mahāñjātastasminnetrāgnisambhave
ce_text: bhagavan sarvabhūteśa śūlapāṇe mahāvrata / saṃśayo me mahāñ jātas taṃ me vyākhyātum arhasi

vulgate_text: kimarthaṃ devadeveśa lalāṭe'sminprakāśate / atisūryāgnisaṅkāśaṃ tṛtīyaṃ netramāyatam
ce_text: kimarthaṃ te lalāṭe vai tṛtīyaṃ netram utthitam / kimarthaṃ ca girir dagdhaḥ sapakṣigaṇakānanaḥ

vulgate_text: etadguhyamajānantyā tvayā bālyādanindite / mannetre pihite devi krīḍanārthaṃ dṛḍhavrate
ce_text: netre me saṃvṛte devi tvayā bālyād anindite / naṣṭālokas tato lokaḥ kṣaṇena samapadyata

vulgate_text: tṛtīyaṃ locanaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ lokaṃ saṃrakṣituṃ mayā / kathitaṃ saṃśayasthānaṃ nirviśaṅkā bhava priye
ce_text: naṣṭāditye tathā loke tamobhūte nagātmaje / tṛtīyaṃ locanaṃ dīptaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ te rakṣatā prajāḥ

vulgate_text: tapa eva sadā dharmo brāhmaṇasya na saṃśayaḥ / sa tu dharmārthamutpannaḥ pūrvaṃ dhātrā tapobalāt
ce_text: upavāsaḥ sadā dharmo brāhmaṇasya na saṃśayaḥ / sa hi dharmārtham utpanno brahmabhūyāya kalpate

vulgate_text: tasyopanayanaṃ dharmo nityaṃ codakadhāraṇam / śāstrasya śravaṇaṃ dharmo devavrataniṣevaṇam
ce_text: rahasyaśravaṇaṃ dharmo vedavrataniṣevaṇam / vratacaryāparo dharmo gurupādaprasādanam

vulgate_text: atithipriyatā dharmo dharmastretāgnidhāraṇam / iṣṭirvā paśubandhāśca vidhipūrvaṃ paraṃtapa
ce_text: atithivratatā dharmo dharmas tretāgnidhāraṇam / iṣṭīś ca paśubandhāṃś ca vidhipūrvaṃ samācaret

vulgate_text: dampatyoḥ samaśīlatvaṃ dharmo vai gṛhamedhinām / evaṃ dvijanmano dharmo gārhasthye dharmadhāraṇam
ce_text: daṃpatyoḥ samaśīlatvaṃ dharmaś ca gṛhamedhinām / gṛhyāṇāṃ caiva devānāṃ nityaṃ puṣpabalikriyā

vulgate_text: utsāhaḥ śastrajīvitvaṃ tasya dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ / bhṛtyānāṃ bharaṇaṃ dharmaḥ kṛte karmaṇyamoghatā
ce_text: yajñopavītadhāraṇaṃ yajño dharmakriyās tathā / bhṛtyānāṃ bharaṇaṃ dharmaḥ kṛte karmaṇy amoghatā

vulgate_text: yadi na syustathā vaiśyā na bhaveyustathā pare / teṣāmadhyayanaṃ dānaṃ gajanaṃ dharma ucyate
ce_text: teṣām agnipariṣyandaḥ pitṛdevārcanaṃ tathā / yajñānāṃ cāpi pañcānāṃ yajanaṃ dharma ucyate

vulgate_text: vāṇijyaṃ satpathe sthānamātitheyatvameva ca / viprāṇāṃ svāgatanyāyo vaiśyadharmaḥ sanātanaḥ
ce_text: vāṇijyaṃ satpathasthānam ātithyaṃ praśamo damaḥ / viprāṇāṃ svāgataṃ tyāgo vaiśyadharmaḥ sanātanaḥ

vulgate_text: tilagandharasāścaiva na vikreyāḥ kathañcana / vaṇikpathamupāsadbhirvaiśyairvaiśyapathi sthitaiḥ
ce_text: tilān gandhān rasāṃś caiva na vikrīṇīta vai kva cit / vaṇikpatham upāsīno vaiśyaḥ satpatham āśritaḥ

vulgate_text: sarvātithyaṃ trivargasya yathāśakti divāniśam / evaṃ te vihitā devi lokayātrā svayaṃbhuvā
ce_text: sarvātithyaṃ trivargasya yathāśakti divāniśam / śūdradharmaḥ samākhyātas trivarṇaparicāraṇam

vulgate_text: vārtā ca kārukarmāṇi śilyaṃ nāṭyaṃ tathaiva ca / ahiṃsakaḥ śubhācāro devatadvijavandakaḥ
ce_text: tyaktahiṃsaḥ śubhācāro devatādvijapūjakaḥ / śūdro dharmaphalair iṣṭaiḥ saṃprayujyeta buddhimān

vulgate_text: tathaiva vānaprasthasya dharmāḥ proktāḥ sanātanāḥ
ce_text: vedoktaḥ paramo dharmaḥ smṛtiśāstragato 'paraḥ / śiṣṭācīrṇaḥ paraḥ proktas trayo dharmāḥ sanātanāḥ

vulgate_text: teṣu tāvatpravakṣyāmi dharmaṃ śubhaphalodayam / brāhmaṇeṣvabhayo dharmaḥ paramaḥ śubhalakṣaṇaḥ
ce_text: teṣām imaṃ pravakṣyāmi dharmakarmaphalodayam / brāhmaṇeṣu hi yo dharmaḥ sa dharmaḥ paramo mataḥ

vulgate_text: svadāraniratirdharmo nityaṃ japyaṃ tathaiva ca / sarvātithyaṃ trivargasya yathāśakti divāniśam
ce_text: sarvātithyaṃ trivargasya yathāśakti divāniśam / śūdradharmaḥ samākhyātas trivarṇaparicāraṇam

vulgate_text: traividyo brāhmaṇo vṛddho na cādhyayanajīvakaḥ / trivargasya vyatikrāntaṃ tasya dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ
ce_text: traividyo brāhmaṇo vidvān na cādhyayanajīvanaḥ / trikarmā triparikrānto maitra eṣa smṛto dvijaḥ

vulgate_text: ṣaṭ karmāṇi ca proktāni sṛṣṭāni brahmaṇā purā / dharmiṣṭhāni variṣṭhāni tānitāni śṛṇūttame
ce_text: ṣaḍ imāni tu karmāṇi provāca bhuvaneśvaraḥ / vṛttyarthaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ vai śṛṇu tāni samāhitā

vulgate_text: yajanaṃ yājanaṃ caiva dānaṃ pātre pratigrahaḥ / adhyāpanamadhyayanaṃ ṣaṭkarmā dharmabhāgṛjuḥ
ce_text: yajanaṃ yājanaṃ caiva tathā dānapratigrahau / adhyāpanam adhītaṃ ca ṣaṭkarmā dharmabhāg dvijaḥ

vulgate_text: nityaḥ svādhyāyato dharmaḥ nityayajñaḥ sanātanaḥ / dānaṃ praśaṃsate nityaṃ brāhmaṇeṣu trikarmasu
ce_text: nityasvādhyāyatā dharmo dharmo yajñaḥ sanātanaḥ / dānaṃ praśasyate cāsya yathāśakti yathāvidhi

vulgate_text: cakṣuḥśrotramanojihvāsnigdhavarṇapradaḥ sadā / atithyabhyāgatarataḥ śeṣānnakṛtabhojanaḥ
ce_text: amānī ca sadājihmaḥ snigdhavāṇīpradas tathā / atithyabhyāgataratiḥ śeṣānnakṛtabhojanaḥ

vulgate_text: prātarutthāya vai paścādbhojane tu nimantrayet / satkṛtyā'nuvrajedyaśca tasya dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ
ce_text: prātar utthāya cācamya bhojanenopamantrya ca / satkṛtyānuvrajed yaś ca tasya dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ

vulgate_text: pravṛttilakṣaṇo dharmo gṛhastheṣu vidhīyate / tadahaṃ kīrtayiṣyāmi trivargeṣu ca yadyathā
ce_text: pravṛttilakṣaṇo dharmo gṛhastheṣu vidhīyate / tam ahaṃ kīrtayiṣyāmi sarvabhūtahitaṃ śubham

vulgate_text: nivṛttilakṣaṇaḥ puṇyo dharmo mokṣo vidhīyate / tasya vṛttiṃ pravakṣyāmi tāṃ śṛṇuṣva samāhitā
ce_text: nivṛttilakṣaṇas tv anyo dharmo mokṣa iti smṛtaḥ / tasya vṛttiṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu me devi tattvataḥ

vulgate_text: āśāpāśavimokṣaṃ ca vidhidharmamanuttamam / vṛkṣamūlacaro nityaṃ śūnyāgāriniveśanamam
ce_text: vṛkṣamūlaśayo nityaṃ śūnyāgāraniveśanaḥ / nadīpulinaśāyī ca nadītīraratiś ca yaḥ

vulgate_text: nadīpulinaśāyī ca nadītīramanuvrajan vimuktaḥ sarvasaṅgebhyaḥ snehabandhena vai dvijaḥ
ce_text: vimuktaḥ sarvasaṅgeṣu snehabandheṣu ca dvijaḥ / ātmany evātmano bhāvaṃ samāsajyāṭati dvijaḥ

vulgate_text: ātmanyevātmanā bhāvaṃ samāyojyeha tena vai / ātmabhūto yatāhāro mokṣadṛṣṭena karmaṇā
ce_text: sthāṇubhūto nirāhāro mokṣadṛṣṭena karmaṇā / parivrajati yo yuktas tasya dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ

vulgate_text: pavitranityo yuktaśca tasya dharmaḥka sanātanaḥ naikatra ramate sakto na caikagrāmagocaraḥ / yukto'pyaṭati yo yukto na caikapulināśrayaḥ
ce_text: na caikatra cirāsakto na caikagrāmagocaraḥ / yukto hy aṭati nirmukto na caikapulineśayaḥ

vulgate_text: vartamānāḥ kathaṃ sarve prāpnuvantyuttamāṃ gatim / etatsarvaṃ samāsena vaktumarhasi mānadaḥ
ce_text: kena vṛttena rājendra vartamānā narā yudhi / prāpnuvanty uttamaṃ svargaṃ kathaṃ ca narakaṃ nṛpa

vulgate_text: bhagavanmānuṣāḥ keciddṛśyante śoṣiṇaḥ kṛśāḥ / kena karmavipākena tanme śaṃsitumarhasi
ce_text: alpābādhās tathā ke cin mahābādhās tathāpare / dṛśyante puruṣā deva tan me śaṃsitum arhasi

vulgate_text: śeṣavyādhiyutāstatra narā dhamanisaṃtatāḥ / bhavantyeva narā devi pāpakarmopabhoginaḥ
ce_text: alpabhogakule jātā alpabhogaratā narāḥ / anena karmaṇā devi bhavanty adhanino narāḥ

vulgate_text: bhagavanmānuṣāḥ kecitpādarogasamanvitāḥ / dṛśyante satataṃ deva tanme śaṃsitumarhasi
ce_text: alpābādhās tathā ke cin mahābādhās tathāpare / dṛśyante puruṣā deva tan me śaṃsitum arhasi

vulgate_text: bhagavanmānuṣāḥ kecidaiśvaryajñānasaṃyutāḥ mlecchabhūmiṣu dṛśyante mlecchaiśvaryasamanvitāḥ / kena karmavipākena tanme śaṃsitumarhasi
ce_text: alpābādhās tathā ke cin mahābādhās tathāpare / dṛśyante puruṣā deva tan me śaṃsitum arhasi

vulgate_text: māṃsasya bhakṣaṇe doṣo yaścāsyābhakṣaṇe guṇaḥ / tadahaṃ kīrtayiṣyāmi tannibodha yathātatham
ce_text: jāto naḥ saṃśayo dharme māṃsasya parivarjane / doṣo bhakṣayataḥ kaḥ syāt kaś cābhakṣayato guṇaḥ

vulgate_text: yastu sarvāṇi māṃsāni yāvajjīvaṃ na bhakṣayet / sa svarge vipulaṃ sthānaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ
ce_text: sarvamāṃsāni yo rājan yāvajjīvaṃ na bhakṣayet / svarge sa vipulaṃ sthānaṃ prāpnuyān nātra saṃśayaḥ

vulgate_text: yattu varṣaśataṃ pūrṇaṃ tapyate paramaṃ tapaḥ / yaccāpi varjayenmāṃsaṃ samametanna vā samam
ce_text: yas tu varṣaśataṃ pūrṇaṃ tapas tapyet sudāruṇam / yaś caikaṃ varjayen māṃsaṃ samam etan mataṃ mama

vulgate_text: labhante vipulaṃ dharmaṃ tathā''hāraparikṣayāt / bahūnāmuparodhaṃ tu na kuryādātmakāraṇāt
ce_text: ahiṃsā paramo dharmas tathāhiṃsā paro damaḥ / ahiṃsā paramaṃ dānam ahiṃsā paramaṃ tapaḥ

vulgate_text: annaṃ prāṇo manuṣyāṇāmannadaḥ prāṇado bhavet / tasmākadannaṃ viśeṣeṇa dātumicchati mānavaḥ
ce_text: annena sadṛśaṃ dānaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati / tasmād annaṃ viśeṣeṇa dātum icchanti mānavāḥ

vulgate_text: śrāntamadhvapariśrāntamatithiṃ gṛhamāgatam / arcayīta prayatnena sa hi yajño varapradaḥ
ce_text: śrāntam adhvani vartantaṃ vṛddham arham upasthitam / arcayed bhūtim anvicchan gṛhastho gṛham āgatam

vulgate_text: kṛtvā tu pātakaṃ karma yo dadyādannamarthinām / brāhmaṇānāṃ viśeṣeṇa sopahanti svakaṃ tamaḥ
ce_text: kṛtvāpi pāpakaṃ karma yo dadyād annam arthine / brāhmaṇāya viśeṣeṇa na sa pāpena yujyate

vulgate_text: pitarastasya nandanti suvṛṣṭyā karṣakā iva / putro yasya tu pautro vā śrotriyaṃ bhojayiṣyati
ce_text: āśaṃsante hi pitaraḥ suvṛṣṭim iva karṣakāḥ / asmākam api putro vā pautro vānnaṃ pradāsyati

vulgate_text: annadānācca lokāṃstānsampravakṣyāmyanindite / bhavanāni prakāśante divi teṣāṃ mahātmanām
ce_text: annadānāṃ hi ye lokās tāṃs tvaṃ śṛṇu narādhipa / bhavanāni prakāśante divi teṣāṃ mahātmanām / nānāsaṃsthānarūpāṇi nānāstambhānvitāni ca

vulgate_text: anekaśatabhaumāni sāntarjalavanāni ca / vaiḍūryārciḥprakāśapani hemarūpyamayāni ca
ce_text: anekaśatabhaumāni sāntarjalavanāni ca / vaiḍūryārkaprakāśāni raupyarukmamayāni ca

vulgate_text: nānārūpāṇi saṃsthānāṃ nānāratnamayāni ca / candramaṇḍalaśubhrāṇi kiṅkiṇījālavanti ca
ce_text: candramaṇḍalaśubhrāṇi kiṅkiṇījālavanti ca / taruṇādityavarṇāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca

vulgate_text: taruṇādityavarṇāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca / yatheṣṭabhakṣyabhojyāni śayanāsanavanti ca
ce_text: candramaṇḍalaśubhrāṇi kiṅkiṇījālavanti ca / taruṇādityavarṇāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca

vulgate_text: sarvakāmaphalāścātra vṛkṣā bhavanasaṃsthitāḥ / vāpyo bahvyaśca kūpāśca dīrghikāśca sahasraśaḥ
ce_text: sarvakāmaphalāś cāpi vṛkṣā bhavanasaṃsthitāḥ / vāpyo vīthyaḥ sabhāḥ kūpā dīrghikāś caiva sarvaśaḥ

vulgate_text: tasmādannaṃ viśeṣeṇa dātavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā / sarvakālaṃ ca sarvasya sarvatra ca sadaiva ca
ce_text: ete lokāḥ puṇyakṛtām annadānāṃ mahātmanām / tasmād annaṃ viśeṣeṇa dātavyaṃ mānavair bhuvi

vulgate_text: yatkiñcitkurute pāpaṃ puruṣo vṛttikarśitaḥ / api gokarṇamātreṇa bhūmidānana mucyate
ce_text: yat kiṃ cit puruṣaḥ pāpaṃ kurute vṛttikarśitaḥ / api gocarmamātreṇa bhūmidānena pūyate

vulgate_text: suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ vastraṃ maṇimuktāvasūni ca / sarvametanmahābhāge bhūmidāne pratiṣṭhitam
ce_text: suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ vastraṃ maṇimuktāvasūni ca / sarvam etan mahāprājña dadāti vasudhāṃ dadat

vulgate_text: brāhmaṇaṃ vṛttasampannamāhitāgniṃ śucivratam / grāhayitvā nijāṃ bhūmiṃ na yānti yamasādanam
ce_text: brāhmaṇaṃ vṛttasaṃpannam āhitāgniṃ śucivratam / naraḥ pratigrāhya mahīṃ na yāti yamasādanam

vulgate_text: māṃsaiḥ prīṇanti pitaro mudgamāṣayavairiha / śaśarauravamāṃsena ṣaṇmāsaṃ tṛptiriṣyate
ce_text: māsān aṣṭau pārṣatena rauraveṇa navaiva tu / gavayasya tu māṃsena tṛptiḥ syād daśamāsikī

vulgate_text: saṃvatsaraṃ ca gavyena haviṣā pāyasena ca / vārdhrīṇasasya māṃsena tṛptirdvādaśavārṣikī
ce_text: yathā gavyaṃ tathā yuktaṃ pāyasaṃ sarpiṣā saha / vādhrīṇasasya māṃsena tṛptir dvādaśavārṣikī

vulgate_text: ānantyāya bhaveddattaṃ khaṅgamāṃsaṃ pitṛkṣaye / pāyasaṃ satilaṃ kṣaudraṃ khaṅgamāṃsena sammitam
ce_text: ānantyāya bhaved dattaṃ khaḍgamāṃsaṃ pitṛkṣaye / kālaśākaṃ ca lauhaṃ cāpy ānantyaṃ chāga ucyate

vulgate_text: parāvarajñe dharmāṇāṃ tapovananivāsinām dīkṣāvidhidamopete satataṃ vratacāriṇi / pṛcchāmi tvāṃ varārohe pṛṣṭā vada mamepsitam
ce_text: dakṣe śamadamopete nirmame dharmacāriṇi / pṛcchāmi tvāṃ varārohe pṛṣṭā vada mamepsitam

vulgate_text: sāvitrī brahmaṇaḥ patnī kauśikasya śacī śubhā / lakṣmīrviṣṇoḥ priyā bhāryā dhṛtirbhāryā yamasya tu
ce_text: sāvitrī brahmaṇaḥ sādhvī kauśikasya śacī satī / mārtaṇḍajasya dhūmorṇā ṛddhir vaiśravaṇasya ca

vulgate_text: mārkaṇḍeyasya dhūmorṇā ṛddhirvaiśravaṇasya tu / varuṇasya priyā gaurī savituśca suvarcalā
ce_text: sāvitrī brahmaṇaḥ sādhvī kauśikasya śacī satī / mārtaṇḍajasya dhūmorṇā ṛddhir vaiśravaṇasya ca

vulgate_text: rohiṇī śaśino bhāryā svāhā cāgneraninditā / kāśyapasyāditiścaiva vasiṣṭhasyāpyarundhatī
ce_text: varuṇasya tato gaurī sūryasya ca suvarcalā / rohiṇī śaśinaḥ sādhvī svāhā caiva vibhāvasoḥ

vulgate_text: strīdharmaṃ śrotumicchāmi tvayaiva samudāhṛtam / sadhramacāriṇī me tvaṃ lokasandhāriṇī tathā
ce_text: tena tvāṃ paripṛcchāmi dharmajñe dharmavādini / strīdharmaṃ śrotum icchāmi tvayodāhṛtam āditaḥ

vulgate_text: tvayā coktaṃ viśeṣeṇa guṇabhūtaṃ hi tiṣṭhati / striya eva sadā loke strīgaṇasya gatiḥ priye
ce_text: striyaś caiva viśeṣeṇa strījanasya gatiḥ sadā / gaur gāṃ gacchati suśroṇi lokeṣv eṣā sthitiḥ sadā

vulgate_text: imā nadyo mahādeva sarvatīrthodakānvitāḥ / upasparśanahetostvāṃ na tyajanti samīpataḥ
ce_text: imās tu nadyo deveśa sarvatīrthodakair yutāḥ / upasparśanahetos tvā samīpasthā upāsate

vulgate_text: etābhiḥ saha sammantrya pravakṣyāmi tavepsitam / ayuktaṃ satsu tantreṣu tānatikramya bhāṣitum
ce_text: etābhiḥ saha saṃmantrya pravakṣyāmy anupūrvaśaḥ / prabhavan yo 'nahaṃvādī sa vai puruṣa ucyate

vulgate_text: iti matvā mahādevī nadīrdevīḥ samāhvayat / vipāśāṃ ca vitastyāṃ ca candrabhāgāṃ sarasvatīm
ce_text: vipāśā ca vitastā ca candrabhāgā irāvatī / śatadrur devikā sindhuḥ kauśikī gomatī tathā

vulgate_text: ayaṃ bhagavatā praśna uktaḥ strīdharmamāśritaḥ / na caikayā mayā sādyaṃ tasmādvastvānayāmyaham
ce_text: ayaṃ bhagavatā dattaḥ praśnaḥ strīdharmasaṃśritaḥ / taṃ tu saṃmantrya yuṣmābhir vaktum icchāmi śaṃkare

vulgate_text: yuṣmābhistadvicāryaivaṃ vaktumicchāmi śobhanāḥ / tatkathaṃ devadevāya vācyaḥ strīdharma uttamaḥ
ce_text: ayaṃ bhagavatā dattaḥ praśnaḥ strīdharmasaṃśritaḥ / taṃ tu saṃmantrya yuṣmābhir vaktum icchāmi śaṃkare

vulgate_text: dhanyāścānugṛhītāḥ sma anena vacanena te / yā tvaṃ surāsurairmānyā nadīrādriyase'naghe
ce_text: dhanyāḥ smo 'nugṛhītāḥ smo devi dharmaparāyaṇā / yā tvaṃ sarvajaganmānyā nadīr mānayase 'naghe

vulgate_text: evaṃ prasāditā devī gaṅgayā lokapūjyayā / prāha dharmamaśeṣeṇa strīdharmaṃ surasundarī
ce_text: tataḥ sārādhitā devī gaṅgayā bahubhir guṇaiḥ / prāha sarvam aśeṣeṇa strīdharmaṃ surasundarī

vulgate_text: na ca bhoge na caiśvarye na sukhe na dhane tathā / spṛhā yasyāstathā bhartuḥ sā nārīṇāṃ pativratā
ce_text: na kāmeṣu na bhogeṣu naiśvarye na sukhe tathā / spṛhā yasyā yathā patyau sā nārī dharmabhāginī

vulgate_text: patirhi daivataṃ strīṇāṃ patirbandhuḥ patirgatiḥ / nānyaṃ gatimahaṃ paśye pramadāyā yathā patiḥ
ce_text: patir hi devo nārīṇāṃ patir bandhuḥ patir gatiḥ / patyā samā gatir nāsti daivataṃ vā yathā patiḥ

vulgate_text: sa varaiśchanditastena nṛpo vacanamabravīt / sahasrabāhutā me'stu yūpamadhye graho yathā
ce_text: sa varaiś chanditas tena nṛpo vacanam abravīt / sahasrabāhur bhūyāṃ vai camūmadhye gṛhe 'nyathā

ce_text: draṣṭavyaṃ naitad evaṃ hi kathaṃ jyāyastamo hi saḥ / smṛtam ākāśam aṇḍaṃ tu tasmāj jātaḥ pitāmahaḥ

vulgate_text: abhivādya tu taṃ devāḥ pṛṣṭvā kuśalameva ca / idamūcurmahātmānaṃ vākyaṃ kāle janādhipa
ce_text: abhivādya ca taṃ devā dṛṣṭvā ca yaśasā vṛtam / idam ūcur mahātmānaṃ vākyaṃ kāle janādhipa

vulgate_text: evamuktastadātrirvai tamonudabhavacchaśī / apaśyatsaumyabhāvācca somavatpriyadarśanaḥ
ce_text: evam uktas tadātris tu tamonud abhavac chaśī / apaśyat saumyabhāvaṃ ca sūryasya pratidarśanam

vulgate_text: atriṇā tvatha somatvaṃ kṛtamuttamatejasā / dvijenāgnidvitīyeni japatā carmavāsasā
ce_text: udbhāsitaś ca savitā devās trātā hatāsurāḥ / atriṇā tv atha somatvaṃ kṛtam uttamatejasā

vulgate_text: aśvibhyāṃ saha necchāmaḥ somaṃ pātuṃ mahāvrata / yadanyadvakṣyase vipra tatkariṣyāma te vacaḥ

vulgate_text: aśvibhyāṃ saha somaṃ vai na pāsyāmi dvijottama / pibantvanye yathākāmaṃ nāhaṃ pātumihotsahe
ce_text: aśvibhyāṃ saha necchāmaḥ pātuṃ somaṃ mahāvrata / pibantv anye yathākāmaṃ nāhaṃ pātum ihotsahe

vulgate_text: sarve ca niyatātmāno bālānāṃ saṃvibhāginaḥ upetya śanakairyānti na sevanti rajasvalām / svargātiṃ caiva gacchanti tathaiva śubhakarmiṇaḥ
ce_text: dīptam agniṃ juhvati ca gurūṇāṃ vacane sthitāḥ / sarve ca niyatātmāno bālānāṃ saṃvibhāginaḥ

vulgate_text: abhuktavatsu nāśnanti garbhiṇīvṛddhakādiṣu / pūrvāhṇeṣu na dīvyanti divā caiva na śerate
ce_text: upetya śakaṭair yānti na sevanti rajasvalām / abhuktavatsu nāśnanti divā caiva na śerate

vulgate_text: nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā prītāḥ sarve divaukasaḥ / praśaśaṃsurdvijāṃścāpi brāhmaṇāṃśca yaśasvinaḥ
ce_text: brahmasṛṣṭā havyabhujaḥ kapān bhuktvā sanātanāḥ / nabhasīva yathābhrāṇi vyarājanta narādhipa / praśaśaṃsur dvijāṃś caiva brahmāṇaṃ ca yaśasvinam

vulgate_text: uktā dharmā ye purāṇe mahānto rājanviprāṇāṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ viśāṃ ca / yeye śūdrāṇāṃ dharmamupāsate te tāneva kṛṣṇadupaśikṣasva pārthaḥ
ce_text: uktā dharmā ye purāṇe mahānto brāhmaṇānāṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ viśāṃ ca / paurāṇaṃ ye daṇḍam upāsate ca śeṣaṃ kṛṣṇād upaśikṣasva pārtha

vulgate_text: asmādvāyuścāntarikṣaṃ divaṃ ca diśaścatasro vidiśaścatasraḥ / sṛṣṭistathaiveyamanuprasūtā sa nirmame viśvamidaṃ purāṇaḥ
ce_text: kṛṣṇaḥ pṛthvīm asṛjat khaṃ divaṃ ca varāho 'yaṃ bhīmabalaḥ purāṇaḥ / asya cādho 'thāntarikṣaṃ divaṃ ca diśaś catasraḥ pradiśaś catasraḥ / sṛṣṭis tathaiveyam anuprasūtā sa nirmame viśvam idaṃ purāṇam

vulgate_text: taṃ ghoṣārthe gīrbhirindrāḥ stuvanti sa cāpīśo bhārataikaḥ paśūnām / tasya bhakṣānvividhānvedayanti tamevājau vāhanaṃ vedayanti
ce_text: tasya bhakṣān vividhān vedayanti tam evājau vāhanaṃ vedayanti / tasyāntarikṣaṃ pṛthivī divaṃ ca sarvaṃ vaśe tiṣṭhati śāśvatasya

vulgate_text: hiraṇmayaḥ saptagūḍhaḥ sasaṃviccaturbāhuḥ pannagaḥ padmanābhaḥ / mahātejāḥ sarvagaḥ sarvasiṃhaḥ kṛṣṇo lokāndhārayate yathaikaḥ haṃsaṃ tamoghnaṃ ca tameva vīra kṛṣṇaṃ sadā pārtha kartāramehi
ce_text: sa ekayuk cakram idaṃ trinābhi saptāśvayuktaṃ vahate vai tridhāmā / mahātejāḥ sarvagaḥ sarvasiṃhaḥ kṛṣṇo lokān dhārayate tathaikaḥ / aśnann anaśnaṃś ca tathaiva dhīraḥ kṛṣṇaṃ sadā pārtha kartāram ehi

vulgate_text: dvāravatyāṃ samāsīnaṃ purā māṃ kurunandana / pradyumnaḥ paripapraccha brāhmaṇaiḥ parikopitaḥ
ce_text: pradyumnaḥ paripapraccha brāhmaṇaiḥ parikopitaḥ / kiṃ phalaṃ brāhmaṇeṣv asti pūjāyāṃ madhusūdana / īśvarasya satas tasya iha caiva paratra ca

vulgate_text: kiṃ phalaṃ brāhmaṇeṣvasti pūjāyāṃ madhusūdana / īśvaratvaṃ kutasteṣāmihaiva ca paratra ca
ce_text: pradyumnaḥ paripapraccha brāhmaṇaiḥ parikopitaḥ / kiṃ phalaṃ brāhmaṇeṣv asti pūjāyāṃ madhusūdana / īśvarasya satas tasya iha caiva paratra ca

vulgate_text: roṣaṇaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ sūkṣme'pyapakṛte kṛte / paribhāṣāṃ ca me śrutvā ko nu dadyātpratiśrayam
ce_text: durvāsasaṃ vāsayet ko brāhmaṇaṃ satkṛtaṃ gṛhe / paribhāṣāṃ ca me śrutvā ko nu dadyāt pratiśrayam / yo māṃ kaś cid vāsayeta na sa māṃ kopayed iha

vulgate_text: atha svāvasathaṃ gatvā saśayyāstaraṇāni ca / adahatsa mahātejāstataścābhyapatatsvayam

vulgate_text: avimṛśyaiva ca tataḥ kṛtavānasmi tattathā / tenocchiṣṭena gātrāṇi śarīraṃ ca samālipam

vulgate_text: na tu pādatale lipte tasmātte mṛtyuratra vai / naitanme priyamityevaṃ sa māṃ prīto'bravīttadā

vulgate_text: prayataḥ prātarutthāya yastvadhīyedviśāmpate / prāñjaliḥ śatarudrīyaṃ nāsya kiñcani durlabham
ce_text: prayataḥ prātar utthāya yad adhīye viśāṃ pate / prāñjaliḥ śatarudrīyaṃ tan me nigadataḥ śṛṇu

vulgate_text: śivaḥ sarvakato rudraḥ sraṣṭā yastvaṃ śṛṇuṣva me prajāpatistamasṛjattamaso'nte mahātapāḥ / śaṅkarastvasṛjattāta prajāḥ sthāvarajaṅgamāḥ
ce_text: prajāpatis tat sasṛje tapaso 'nte mahātapāḥ / śaṃkaras tv asṛjat tāta prajāḥ sthāvarajaṅgamāḥ

vulgate_text: tena caiva hi tuṣṭena sa yajñaḥ sandhito'bhavat / yadyaccāpahṛtaṃ tatra tattathaivānvajīvayat
ce_text: tena caivātikopena sa yajñaḥ saṃdhito 'bhavat / yad yac cāpi hataṃ tatra tat tathaiva pradīyate

vulgate_text: sa vai rudraḥ sa ca śivaḥ sogniḥ sarvaḥ sa sarvajit / sa caivendraśca vāyuśca so'svinau sa ca vidyutaḥ
ce_text: sa devendraś ca vāyuś ca so 'śvinau sa ca vidyutaḥ / sa candramāḥ sa ceśānaḥ sa sūryo varuṇaś ca saḥ

vulgate_text: ātmano'rdhaṃ tu tasyāgniḥ somo'rdhaṃ punarucyate / brahmacaryaṃ caratyekā śivā cāsya tanustathā

vulgate_text: viśvedevāśca yattasminviśvarūpastataḥ smṛtaḥ sahasrākṣo'yutākṣo vā sarvatokṣimayopi vā / cakṣuṣaḥ prabhavaṃ tejaḥ sarvataścakṣureva tat

vulgate_text: nityena brahmacaryeṇa liṅgamasya yadā sthitam bhaktānugrahaṇārthāya gūḍhaliṅgastataḥ smṛtaḥ / mahayatyasya lokaśca priyaṃ hyetanmahātmanaḥ
ce_text: nityena brahmacaryeṇa liṅgam asya yadā sthitam / mahayanty asya lokāś ca maheśvara iti smṛtaḥ

vulgate_text: tadayuktaṃ vyavasyanti bālāḥ paṇḍitamāninaḥ / atha sañcintyamevaikaṃ kāraṇaṃ kiṃ bhavediti

vulgate_text: jyotiḥ sarvasya lokasya vipulaṃ pratipadyate na tveva gamanaṃ rājanhetuto gamanaṃ tathā / agrāhyamanibaddhaṃ ca vācā samparivarjayet
ce_text: tattvenāgamanaṃ rājan hetvantagamanaṃ tathā / agrāhyam anibaddhaṃ ca vācaḥ saṃparivarjanam

vulgate_text: asādhoḥ kīdṛśaṃ śīlaṃ sādhoścaiva tu kīdṛśam / bravītu me bhavānetatsanto'santaśca kīdṛśāḥ
ce_text: asatāṃ kīdṛśaṃ rūpaṃ sādhavaḥ kiṃ ca kurvate / bravītu me bhavān etat santo 'santaś ca kīdṛśāḥ

vulgate_text: atithīnāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ preṣyāṇāṃ svajanasya ca / sāmānyaṃ bhojanaṃ kuryātsvayaṃ nāgryaśanaṃ vrajet
ce_text: atithīnāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ preṣyāṇāṃ svajanasya ca / tathā śaraṇakāmānāṃ goptā syāt svāgatapradaḥ

vulgate_text: tathā śaraṇakāmānāṃ goptā syātsvāgatapradaḥ sāyaṃ prātarmanuṣyāṇāmaśanaṃ devanirmitam
ce_text: atithīnāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ preṣyāṇāṃ svajanasya ca / tathā śaraṇakāmānāṃ goptā syāt svāgatapradaḥ

vulgate_text: nāntarā bhojanaṃ dṛṣṭamupavāsavidhirhi saḥ homakāle yathā vahniḥ kāle homaṃ pratīkṣate

ce_text: mahodayo hy alarkaś ca ailaś caiva narādhipaḥ / karaṃdhamo naraśreṣṭhaḥ kadhmoraś ca narādhipaḥ

vulgate_text: ādirājaḥ pṛthurvainyo mitrabhānuḥ priyaṅkaraḥ / trasaddasyustathā rājā śveto rājarṣisattamaḥ
ce_text: trasadasyus tathā rājā śveto rājarṣisattamaḥ / mahābhiṣaś ca vikhyāto nimirājas tathāṣṭakaḥ

vulgate_text: havidhraśca pṛṣadhraśca pratīpaḥ śāntanustathā / ajaḥ prācīnabarhiśca tathaikṣvākurmahāyaśāḥ
ce_text: havidhraś ca pṛṣadhraś ca pratīpaḥ śaṃtanus tathā / kakṣasenaś ca rājarṣir ye cānye nānukīrtitāḥ

vulgate_text: anaraṇyo narapatirjānujaṅghastathaiva ca / kakṣasenaśca rājarṣirye cānye cānukīrtitāḥ
ce_text: havidhraś ca pṛṣadhraś ca pratīpaḥ śaṃtanus tathā / kakṣasenaś ca rājarṣir ye cānye nānukīrtitāḥ

vulgate_text: abhūnmuhūrtaṃ stimitaṃ sarvaṃ tadrājamaṇḍalam / tūṣṇīṃbhūte tatastasminpaṭe citramivārpitam
ce_text: tūṣṇīṃbhūte tadā bhīṣme paṭe citram ivārpitam / muhūrtam iva ca dhyātvā vyāsaḥ satyavatīsutaḥ / nṛpaṃ śayānaṃ gāṅgeyam idam āha vacas tadā

vulgate_text: uvāca cainaṃ madhuraṃ nṛpaṃ śāntanavo nṛpaḥ / praviśasva purīṃ rājandharme ca dhriyatāṃ manaḥ
ce_text: uvāca cainaṃ madhuraṃ tataḥ śāṃtanavo nṛpaḥ / praviśasva puraṃ rājan vyetu te mānaso jvaraḥ

vulgate_text: veda śāstrāṇi sūkṣmāṇi dharmāṃśca manujeśvara / vedāṃśca caturaḥ sarvānṣaḍaṅgairupabṛṃhitān
ce_text: vedaśāstrāṇi sarvāṇi dharmāṃś ca manujeśvara / vedāṃś ca caturaḥ sāṅgān nikhilenāvabudhyase

vulgate_text: tvadbhaktaṃ tvadgatiṃ śāntamudāramaparigraham trāyasva puṇḍarīkākṣa puruṣottama nityaśaḥ / anujānīhi māṃ kṛṣṇa vaikuṇṭha puruṣottama
ce_text: anujānīhi māṃ kṛṣṇa vaikuṇṭha puruṣottama / rakṣyāś ca te pāṇḍaveyā bhavān hy eṣāṃ parāyaṇam

vulgate_text: anujānāmi bhīṣma tvāṃ vasūnprāpnuhi pārthiva / na te'sti vṛjinaṃ kiñcicchuddhātmaiśvaryasaṃyutaḥ
ce_text: anujānāmi bhīṣma tvāṃ vasūn āpnuhi pārthiva / na te 'sti vṛjinaṃ kiṃ cin mayā dṛṣṭaṃ mahādyute

vulgate_text: ityuktvā suhṛdaḥ sarvāṃstathā sampūjya caiva ha dhanaṃ bahuvidhaṃ rājandattvā nityaṃ dvijātiṣu / punarevābravīddhīmānyudhiṣṭhiramidaṃ vacaḥ
ce_text: ity uktvā suhṛdaḥ sarvān saṃpariṣvajya caiva ha / punar evābravīd dhīmān yudhiṣṭhiram idaṃ vacaḥ

ce_text: yudhiṣṭhiras tu gāṅgeyaṃ viduraś ca mahāmatiḥ / chādayām āsatur ubhau kṣaumair mālyaiś ca kauravam

ce_text: striyaḥ kauravanāthasya bhīṣmaṃ kurukulodbhavam / tālavṛntāny upādāya paryavījan samantataḥ

vulgate_text: rājā tu dhṛtarāṣṭrastaṃ tathā dīno mahābhujam / vākyamāha mahābuddhiḥ prajñācakṣurnareśvaram

vulgate_text: śocitavyaṃ mayā caiva gāndhāryā ca mahīpate / yayoḥ putraśataṃ naṣṭaṃ svapnalabdhaṃ yathā dhanam
ce_text: śocitavyaṃ mayā caiva gāndhāryā ca viśāṃ pate / putrair vihīno rājyena svapnalabdhadhano yathā

vulgate_text: yadi māmanujānīyādbhavāngantuṃ tapovanam / kṛtakṛtyo bhaviṣyāmi iti me niścitā matiḥ
ce_text: yadi mām anujānīyād bhavān gantuṃ tapovanam / na hi śāntiṃ prapaśyāmi ghātayitvā pitāmaham / karṇaṃ ca puruṣavyāghraṃ saṃgrāmeṣv apalāyinam

ce_text: dvāv etau pakṣiṇau nityau sakhāyau cāpy acetanau / etābhyāṃ tu paro yasya cetanāvān iti smṛtaḥ

vulgate_text: anityaṃ nityamityeke nāstyastītyapi cāpare / tridhetyeke dvidhetyeke vyākīrṇamiti cāpare

vulgate_text: kecinmokṣaṃ praśaṃsanti kecidbhogānpṛthagvidhān dhanāni kecidicchanti nirdhanatvamathāpare / upāsya sādhanaṃ tveke naitadastīti cāpare

vulgate_text: evaṃ vyutthāpite dharme bahudhā viprabodhite / niścayaṃ nādhigacchāmaḥ śreyaḥ kimiti sattama

vulgate_text: etatpadamanudvignaṃ variṣṭhaṃ dharmalakṣaṇam jñānaṃ niḥśreya ityāhurvṛddhā niścitadarśinaḥ / tasmājjñānena śuddhena mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ

vulgate_text: samaḥ saṃjñānugaścaiva sa sarvatra vyavasthitaḥ / na sajjate sadā satvamāpaḥ puṣkaraparṇavat

vulgate_text: yathā dravyaṃ ca kartā ca saṃyogo'pyanayostathā yathā pradīpamādāya kaścittamasi gacchati / tathā sattvapradīpena gacchanti paramarṣayaḥ

ce_text: evaṃ gacchati medhāvī tattvayogavidhānavit / samājñāya mahābuddhir uttarād uttarottaram

vulgate_text: tatastvaṃ samyagācīrṇo dharme'sminnarikarśana / sarvapāpavinirmukto mokṣaṃ prāpsyasi kevalam

vulgate_text: ityuktavacanaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ pratyuvāca dhanaṃjayaḥ / yadiṣṭaṃ kuru sarveṣāmīśvaro'smānprapālaya

ce_text: ity uktavacanaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ pratyuvāca dhanaṃjayaḥ / gacchāvo nagaraṃ kṛṣṇa gajasāhvayam adya vai

vulgate_text: praṇavātmā ca śabdādīṃstriguṇātmā carācaram tathā rudrānvasūnvā'pi viddhi matprabhavāndvija
ce_text: tamo rajaś ca sattvaṃ ca viddhi bhāvān madāśrayān / tathā rudrān vasūṃś cāpi viddhi matprabhavān dvija

vulgate_text: yuvā ṣoḍaśavarṣo hi yadyadya bhavitā bhavān dadāni patnīṃ kanyāṃ ca svāṃ te duhitaraṃ dvija / etāmṛte'ṅganā nānyā tvattejo'rhati sevitum

vulgate_text: chidreṣveteṣvime nityaṃ hriyate dvijasattama / devarākṣasanāgānāmapramatteni dhāryate

vulgate_text: śākhāsvāsajya tasyaiva kṛṣṇājinamariṃdama / pātayāmāsa bilvāni tadā sa dvijapuṅgavaḥ

vulgate_text: yasmiṃste kuṇḍale baddhe tadā dvijavareṇa vai / bilvaprahāraistasyātha vyaśīryadbandhanaṃ tataḥ
ce_text: śākhāsv āsajya tasyaiva kṛṣṇājinam ariṃdama / yasmiṃs te kuṇḍale baddhe tadā dvijavareṇa vai

vulgate_text: iti stute mānuṣaiśca pūjite devakīsute śakrasadmapratīkāśo babhūva sa hi śailarāṭ

ce_text: dīkṣayasva tvam ātmānaṃ tvaṃ naḥ paramako guruḥ / tvayīṣṭavati dharmajña vipāpmā syām ahaṃ vibho / tvaṃ hi yajño 'kṣaraḥ sarvas tvaṃ dharmas tvaṃ prajāpatiḥ

ce_text: tvaṃ cādya kuruvīrāṇāṃ dharmeṇābhivirājase / guṇabhūtāḥ sma te rājaṃs tvaṃ no rājan mato guruḥ

vulgate_text: dhanuṣaḥ patatastasya savyasācikarādvibho / babhūva sadṛśaṃ rūpaṃ śakracāpasya bhārata

vulgate_text: aniśaṃ dīyate ca sma tatra bhojyaṃ pṛthagvidham brāhmaṇānāṃ viśāṃ caiva bahumṛṣṭānnamṛddhimat
ce_text: evaṃ pramuditaṃ sarvaṃ paśugodhanadhānyataḥ / yajñavāṭaṃ nṛpā dṛṣṭvā paraṃ vismayam āgaman / brāhmaṇānāṃ viśāṃ caiva bahumṛṣṭānnam ṛddhimat

vulgate_text: evaṃ sa vavṛte yajño dharmarājasya dhīmataḥ annasya subahūnrājannutsargānparvatopamān / dadhikulyāśaaca dadṛśuḥ sarpiṣaśca hradāñjanāḥ
ce_text: annasya bahavo rājann utsargāḥ parvatopamāḥ / dadhikulyāś ca dadṛśuḥ sarpiṣaś ca hradāñjanāḥ

vulgate_text: āgamiṣyanti rājānaḥ sarve vai kauravarṣabha / prāptānāṃ mahatāṃ pūjā kāryā hyetatkṣamaṃ hi naḥ
ce_text: āgamiṣyanti rājānaḥ sarvataḥ kauravān prati / teṣām ekaikaśaḥ pūjā kāryety etat kṣamaṃ hi naḥ

vulgate_text: saṃcintayāmi kaunteyaṃ raho jiṣṇuṃ janārdana / atīva duḥkhabhāgī sa satataṃ pāṇḍunandanaḥ
ce_text: atīva duḥkhabhāgī sa satataṃ kuntinandanaḥ / na ca paśyāmi bībhatsor nindyaṃ gātreṣu kiṃ cana / śrotavyaṃ cen mayaitad vai tan me vyākhyātum arhasi

vulgate_text: tatra bhīmādayaste tu karavo yājakāśca ye / remuḥ śrutvā vicitrāṃ tāṃ dhanaṃjayakathāṃ śubhām
ce_text: tatra bhīmādayas te tu kuravo yādavās tathā / remuḥ śrutvā vicitrārthā dhanaṃjayakathā vibho

vulgate_text: tatra vṛddhānyathāvatsa kurūnanyāṃśca pārthivān abhivādya mahābāhustaiścāpi pratinanditaḥ / praviveśa pitāmahyāḥ kuntyā bhavanamuttamam
ce_text: sa sametya kurūn sarvān sarvais tair abhinanditaḥ / praviveśa pitāmahyāḥ kuntyā bhavanam uttamam

vulgate_text: dharmarājaśca bhīmaśca phalgunaśca yamau tathā / pṛthakpṛthak ca te cainaṃ mānārthābhyāmayojayan
ce_text: dharmarājaś ca bhīmaś ca yamajau phalgunas tathā / pṛthak pṛthag atīvainaṃ mānārhaṃ samapūjayan

vulgate_text: evamatra mahārāja dakṣiṇābhirguṇīkura / śrīstvāṃ vrajatu te rājanbrāhmaṇā hyatra kāraṇam
ce_text: evam eva mahārāja dakṣiṇāṃ triguṇāṃ kuru / tritvaṃ vrajatu te rājan brāhmaṇā hy atra kāraṇam

vulgate_text: tatra vedavido rājaṃścakruḥ karmāṇi yājakāḥ / parikrāmanti śāstrajñā yatāvaddvijasattamāḥ
ce_text: tatra vedavido rājaṃś cakruḥ karmāṇi yājakāḥ / parikramantaḥ śāstrajñā vidhivat sādhuśikṣitāḥ

vulgate_text: te vyarājanta rājarṣe vāsobhirupaśobhitāḥ / mahendrānugatā devā yathā saptarṣibhirdivi
ce_text: te vyarājanta rājarṣe vāsobhir upaśobhitāḥ / narendrābhigatā devān yathā saptarṣayo divi

vulgate_text: nāhamādātumicchāmi brahmasvaṃ dvijasattamāḥ / idaṃ nityaṃ mano viprā bhrātṝṇāṃ caiva me sadā
ce_text: nāham ādātum icchāmi brahmasvaṃ munisattamāḥ / idaṃ hi me mataṃ nityaṃ bhrātṝṇāṃ ca mamānaghāḥ

vulgate_text: duḥśalāyāśca taṃ pautraṃ bālakaṃ bharatarṣabha / svarājye'tha piturdhāmānsvasuḥ prītyā nvayeśayat
ce_text: duḥśalāyāś ca taṃ pautraṃ bālakaṃ pārthivarṣabha / svarājye pitṛbhir gupte prītyā samabhiṣecayat

vulgate_text: bhakṣyakhāṇḍavarāgāṇāṃ kriyatāṃ bhujyatāṃ tathā / paśūnāṃ vadhyatāṃ caiva nāntaṃ dadṛśire janāḥ
ce_text: bhakṣyaṣāṇḍavarāgāṇāṃ kriyatāṃ bhujyatām iti / paśūnāṃ vadhyatāṃ cāpi nāntas tatra sma dṛśyate

vulgate_text: dīyatāṃ bhujyatāṃ cāpi tatra śabdo mahānabhūt / dīyatāṃ dīyatāṃ ceti divārātramavāritam
ce_text: dīyatāṃ bhujyatāṃ ceti divārātram avāritam / taṃ mahotsavasaṃkāśam atihṛṣṭajanākulam / kathayanti sma puruṣā nānādeśanivāsinaḥ

vulgate_text: uṣṇārtaśca kṣudhārtaśca viprastapasi saṃsthitaḥ / uñchamaprāptavāneva brāhmaṇaḥ kṣucchramānvitaḥ
ce_text: uñchaṃs tadā śuklapakṣe madhyaṃ tapati bhāskare / uṣṇārtaś ca kṣudhārtaś ca sa vipras tapasi sthitaḥ / uñcham aprāptavān eva sārdhaṃ parijanena ha

vulgate_text: iti bruvantīṃ tāṃ sādhvīṃ bhāryāṃ sa dvijasattamaḥ / kṣaudhāparigatāṃ jñātvā tānsaktūnnābhyanandata
ce_text: iti bruvantīṃ tāṃ sādhvīṃ dharmātmā sa dvijarṣabhaḥ / kṣudhāparigatāṃ jñātvā saktūṃs tān nābhyanandata

vulgate_text: bhavānhi paripālyo me sarvadaiva prayatnataḥ / sādhūnāṃ kāṅkṣitaṃ yasmātpiturvṛddhasya pālanam
ce_text: bhavān hi paripālyo me sarvayatnair dvijottama / sādhūnāṃ kāṅkṣitaṃ hy etat pitur vṛddhasya poṣaṇam

vulgate_text: bhuktvā tānapi saktūnsa naiva tuṣṭo babhūva ha / ucchavṛttistu dharmātmā vrīḍāmanujagāma ha
ce_text: bhuktvā tān api saktūn sa naiva tuṣṭo babhūva ha / uñchavṛttis tu savrīḍo babhūva dvijasattamaḥ

vulgate_text: sarvametaddhi yasmātte dattaṃ śuddhena cetasā / kṛcchrakāle tataḥ svargo vijitaḥ karmaṇā tvayā
ce_text: sarvasvam etad yasmāt te tyaktaṃ śuddhena cetasā / kṛcchrakāle tataḥ svargo jito 'yaṃ tava karmaṇā

vulgate_text: ityuktavākye dharme tu yānamārudya sa dvijaḥ / sadāraḥ sasutaścaiva sasnuṣaśca divaṃ gataḥ
ce_text: ity uktavākyo dharmeṇa yānam āruhya sa dvijaḥ / sabhāryaḥ sasutaś cāpi sasnuṣaś ca divaṃ yayau

vulgate_text: dharmasaṃśayamāpannānsatyaṃ brūhi mahāmate mahābhāga kathaṃ yajñeṣvāgamo nṛpasattama / yaṣṭavyaṃ paśubhirmedhyairatho bījairajairiti
ce_text: mahābhāga kathaṃ yajñeṣv āgamo nṛpate smṛtaḥ / yaṣṭavyaṃ paśubhir medhyair atho bījair ajair api

vulgate_text: api saṃcayabuddhirhi lobhamohavaśaṃ gataḥ / yajñaṃ karoti bhūtāni pāpenāśuddhabuddhinā
ce_text: api saṃcayabuddhir hi lobhamohavaśaṃgataḥ / udvejayati bhūtāni hiṃsayā pāpacetanaḥ

vulgate_text: yathāśaktyā bhagavatā tadannaṃ samupārjitam / tasminsatre tu yadvṛttaṃ yadyogyaṃ ca tadā'bhavat
ce_text: yathāśaktyā bhagavatā tad annaṃ samupārjitam / tasmin satre tu yat kiṃ cid ayogyaṃ tatra nābhavat / tathā hy anekair munibhir mahāntaḥ kratavaḥ kṛtāḥ

vulgate_text: tathā hyanekairmunibhirmahāntaḥ kratavaḥ kṛtāḥ evaṃvidhe tvagastyasya vartamāne tathā'dhvare / na vavarṣa sahasrākṣastadā bharatasattama
ce_text: evaṃvidhes tv agastyasya vartamāne mahādhvare / na vavarṣa sahasrākṣas tadā bharatasattama

vulgate_text: tataste munayo hṛṣṭā dadṛśustapaso balam / vismitā vacanaṃ prāhuridaṃ sarve mahārthavat
ce_text: ity ukte sarvam evaitad abhavat tasya dhīmataḥ / tatas te munayo dṛṣṭvā munes tasya tapobalam / vismitā vacanaṃ prāhur idaṃ sarve mahārthavat

vulgate_text: tatpayaḥ sthapayāmāsa nave bhāṇḍe dṛḍhe śucau / krodho nakularūpeṇa piṭharaṃ paryakarṣayat
ce_text: tat kṣīraṃ sthāpayām āsa nave bhāṇḍe dṛḍhe śucau / tac ca krodhaḥ svarūpeṇa piṭharaṃ paryavartayat

vulgate_text: tamājñāya muniḥ krodhaṃ naivāsya sa cukopa ha / sa tu krodhastato rājanbrāhmaṇīṃ mūrtimāsthitaḥ
ce_text: tam ājñāya muniḥ krodhaṃ naivāsya cukupe tataḥ / sa tu krodhas tam āhedaṃ prāñjalir mūrtimān sthitaḥ

vulgate_text: sākṣāddṛṣṭosi me kradha gaccha tvaṃ vigatajvaraḥ / na tvayāpakṛtaṃ me'dya na ca me manyurasti vai
ce_text: sākṣād dṛṣṭo 'si me krodha gaccha tvaṃ vigatajvaraḥ / na mamāpakṛtaṃ te 'dya na manyur vidyate mama

vulgate_text: sa tānprasādayāmāsa śāpasyānto bhavediti / taiścāpyuktaḥ kṣipandharmaṃ sāpasyāntamavāpsyati
ce_text: sa tān prasādayām āsa śāpasyānto bhaved iti / taiś cāpy ukto yadā dharmaṃ kṣepsyase mokṣyase tadā

vulgate_text: nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam / devīṃ sarasvatīṃ vyāsaṃ tato jayamudīrayet / prāpya paitāmahaṃ rājyaṃ mama pūrvapitāmahāḥ / kathamāsanmahārāje dhṛtarāṣṭre mahātmani
ce_text: prāpya rājyaṃ mahābhāgāḥ pāṇḍavā me pitāmahāḥ / katham āsan mahārāje dhṛtarāṣṭre mahātmani

vulgate_text: vihārayātrāsu punaḥ kururājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / sarvānkāmānupasthāpya dhṛtarāṣṭre nyavedayat
ce_text: vihārayātrāsu punaḥ kururājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / sarvān kāmān mahātejāḥ pradadāv ambikāsute

vulgate_text: dhṛṣṭaketośca bhaginī jarāsandhasutā tathā etāścānyāśca bahvyo vai yoṣitaḥ puruṣarṣabha / kiṃkarāḥ paryupātiṣṭhansarvāḥ subalajāṃ tathā
ce_text: dhṛṣṭaketoś ca bhaginī jarāsaṃdhasya cātmajā / kiṃkarāḥ smopatiṣṭhanti sarvāḥ subalajāṃ tathā

vulgate_text: parivṛtteṣu cāhaḥsu putrāṇāṃ śrāddhakarmaṇi / dadau ca rājā vittāni yāvadasya cikīrṣitam
ce_text: paridṛṣṭeṣu cāhaḥsu putrāṇāṃ śrāddhakarmaṇi / dadātu rājā sarveṣāṃ yāvad asya cikīrṣitam

vulgate_text: yāvaddhi kuruvīrasya jīvatputrasya vai sukham / tāvatsukhamavāpnoti bhogāṃścaiva vyavasthitān
ce_text: yāvad dhi kurumukhyasya jīvatputrasya vai sukham / babhūva tad avāpnotu bhogāṃś ceti vyavasthitāḥ

vulgate_text: dhṛtarāṣṭraśca tānsarvānvinītānniyame sthitān / śiṣyavṛttiṃ samāpannānguruvatpratyapadyata
ce_text: dhṛtarāṣṭraś ca tān vīrān vinītān vinaye sthitān / śiṣyavṛttau sthitān nityaṃ guruvat paryapaśyata

vulgate_text: brāhmaṇānsvastivācyātha hutvā caiva hutāśanam / āyūṃṣi pāṇḍuputrāṇāmāśaṃsata narādhipaḥ
ce_text: brāhmaṇān vācayitvā ca hutvā caiva hutāśanam / āyuṣyaṃ pāṇḍuputrāṇām āśāste sa narādhipaḥ

vulgate_text: saṃjayaṃ ca mahātmānaṃ kṛpaṃ cāpi mahāratham / anunetumihecchāmi bhavadbhirvasudhādhipam
ce_text: saṃjayaṃ ca mahāmātraṃ kṛpaṃ cāpi mahāratham / anunetum ihecchāmi bhavadbhiḥ pṛthivīpatim

vulgate_text: taṃ tu dṛṣṭvā samāsīnaṃ visaṃjñamiva kauravam / ārtiṃ rājā'gamattīvrāṃ kaunteyaḥ paravīrahā
ce_text: taṃ tu dṛṣṭvā tathāsīnaṃ niśceṣṭaṃ kurupārthivam / ārtiṃ rājā yayau tūrṇaṃ kaunteyaḥ paravīrahā

vulgate_text: spṛśantaṃ pāṇinā bhūyaḥ pariṣyajya ca pāṇḍavam uvāca rājā dharmajño dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ śubhaṃ vacaḥ
ce_text: spṛśa māṃ pāṇinā bhūyaḥ pariṣvaja ca pāṇḍava / jīvāmīva hi saṃsparśāt tava rājīvalocana

vulgate_text: jīvāmīvātisaṃsparśāttava rājīvalocana mūrdhānaṃ ca tavāghrātumicchāmi manujādhipa / pāṇibhyāṃ hi parispraṣṭuṃ prāṇānāṃ hitamātmani
ce_text: mūrdhānaṃ ca tavāghrātum icchāmi manujādhipa / pāṇibhyāṃ ca parispraṣṭuṃ prāṇā hi na jahur mama

vulgate_text: tato'bravīnmahātejā dhṛtarāṣṭro yudhiṣṭhiram / anujñātastvayā putra bhuñjīyāmiti kāmaye
ce_text: tato 'bravīn mahātejā dharmaputraṃ sa pārthivaḥ / anujñātas tvayā putra bhuñjīyām iti kāmaye

vulgate_text: cakravattāta kāryāṇāṃ paryāyo dṛśyate sadā kośasya nicaye yatnaṃ kurvīthā nyāyataḥ sadā / vividhasya mahārāja viparītaṃ vivarjayeḥ
ce_text: kośasya saṃcaye yatnaṃ kurvīthā nyāyataḥ sadā / dvividhasya mahārāja viparītaṃ vivarjayeḥ

vulgate_text: deśajāścaiva puruṣā vikrāntāḥ sveṣu karmasu / yātrābhiranurūpābhiranugrāhyā hitāstvayā
ce_text: deśāntarasthāś ca narā vikrāntāḥ sarvakarmasu / mātrābhir anurūpābhir anugrāhyā hitās tvayā

vulgate_text: guṇārthināṃ guṇaḥ kāryo viduṣā vai janādhipa / avicāryāśca te te syuracalā iva nityaśaḥ
ce_text: guṇārthināṃ guṇaḥ kāryo viduṣāṃ te janādhipa / avicālyāś ca te te syur yathā merur mahāgiriḥ

vulgate_text: yadā pare ca balinaḥ svapakṣaścaiva durbalaḥ / sārdhaṃ vidvāṃstadā kṣīṇaḥ paraiḥ sandhiṃ masāśrayet
ce_text: yadā svapakṣo balavān parapakṣas tathābalaḥ / vigṛhya śatrūn kaunteya yāyāt kṣitipatis tadā / yadā svapakṣo 'balavāṃs tadā saṃdhiṃ samāśrayet

vulgate_text: kaunteya taddhitaṃ te syātpṛthivīṃ vijigīṣataḥ / guṇānāṃ bhedane yogamīpsethāḥ saha mantribhiḥ
ce_text: gaṇānāṃ bhedane yogaṃ gacchethāḥ saha mantribhiḥ / sādhusaṃgrahaṇāc caiva pāpanigrahaṇāt tathā

vulgate_text: sādhusaṅgrahaṇāccaiva pāpanigrahaṇāttathā ātmasātkaraṇe nityaṃ pālanāni gṛhe tathā / durbalāścaiva satataṃ nānveṣṭavyā balīyasā
ce_text: gaṇānāṃ bhedane yogaṃ gacchethāḥ saha mantribhiḥ / sādhusaṃgrahaṇāc caiva pāpanigrahaṇāt tathā

vulgate_text: tiṣṭhethā rājaśārdūla vaitasīṃ vṛttimāsthitaḥ yadyenamabhiyāyācca balavāndurbala nṛpaḥ
ce_text: durbalāś cāpi satataṃ nāvaṣṭabhyā balīyasā / tiṣṭhethā rājaśārdūla vaitasīṃ vṛttim āsthitaḥ

vulgate_text: kośena paurairdaṇḍena ye cāsya priyakāriṇaḥ asambhave tu sarvasya yathā mukhyena niṣpatet / krameṇānena mokṣaḥ syāccharīraṃ prati kevalam
ce_text: asaṃbhave tu sarvasya yathāmukhyena niṣpatet / krameṇānena mokṣaḥ syāc charīram api kevalam

vulgate_text: samavetāṃśca tānsarvānpaurāñjānapadāṃstathā / tānāgatānabhiprekṣya samastaṃ ca suhṛñjanam
ce_text: tato niṣkramya nṛpatis tasmād antaḥpurāt tadā / sarvaṃ suhṛjjanaṃ caiva sarvāś ca prakṛtīs tathā / samavetāṃś ca tān sarvān paurajānapadān atha

vulgate_text: brāhmaṇāṃśca mahīpāla nānādeśasamāgatān / uvāca matimānrājā dhṛtarāṣṭro'mbikāsutaḥ
ce_text: brāhmaṇāṃś ca mahīpālān nānādeśasamāgatān / tataḥ prāha mahātejā dhṛtarāṣṭro mahīpatiḥ

vulgate_text: evameva mahābāhurbhīmārjunayamairvṛtaḥ yudhiṣṭhiro mahātejā bhavataḥ pālayiṣyati
ce_text: brahmeva bhagavān eṣa sarvabhūtajagatpatiḥ / yudhiṣṭhiro mahātejā bhavataḥ pālayiṣyati

vulgate_text: priyāṇi kurvansarveṣāmanuvṛttyarthamudyataḥ yathā bravīti dharmātmā muniḥ satyavatīsutaḥ / tathā kuru mahārāja sa hi naḥ paramo guruḥ
ce_text: yathā bravīti dharmajño muniḥ satyavatīsutaḥ / tathā kuru mahārāja sa hi naḥ paramo guruḥ

vulgate_text: na sa rājñāṃ vadhe sūnuḥ kāraṇaṃ te mahātmanām / na bhavānna ca te bhṛtyā na karṇo na ca saubalaḥ
ce_text: na sa rājāparādhnoti putras tava mahāmanāḥ / na bhavān na ca te bhṛtyā na karṇo na ca saubalaḥ

vulgate_text: prāpsyate ca bhavānpuṇyaṃ dharme ca satataṃ sthitaḥ / veda dharmaṃ mahābāho laukyaṃ vaidikameva ca
ce_text: prāpsyate ca bhavān puṇyaṃ dharme ca paramāṃ sthitim / veda puṇyaṃ ca kārtsnyena samyag bharatasattama

vulgate_text: tato viveśa bhavanaṃ gāndhāryā sahito nijam / āgatāyāṃ ca śarvaryāṃ sukhaṃ śete narādhipaḥ
ce_text: tato viveśa bhuvanaṃ gāndhāryā sahito nṛpaḥ / vyuṣṭāyāṃ caiva śarvaryāṃ yac cakāra nibodha tat

vulgate_text: kva tadā droṇabhiṣmau tau somadattopi vā'bhavat yatra dvādaśa varṣāṇi vane vanyena jīvatha / na tadā tvāṃ pitā jyeṣṭhaḥ pitṛtvenābhivīkṣate
ce_text: yatra trayodaśa samā vane vanyena jīvasi / na tadā tvā pitā jyeṣṭhaḥ pitṛtvenābhivīkṣate

vulgate_text: vyacodayaḥ purā'smākamutsāhaṃ śubhadarśane / vidulāyā vacobhistvaṃ nāsmānsaṃtyaktumarhasi
ce_text: vyarocayaḥ purā hy asmān utsāhya priyadarśane / vidurāyā vacobhis tvam asmān na tyaktum arhasi

vulgate_text: kva sā buddhiriyaṃ cādya bhavatyā yā śrutā mayā / kṣatradharme sthitaṃ tyaktvā na prayātumihārhasi
ce_text: kva sā buddhir iyaṃ cādya bhavatyā yā śrutā mayā / kṣatradharme sthitiṃ hy uktvā tasyāś calitum icchasi

vulgate_text: apekṣatāmeva vo bhīma vepantīṃ kadalīmiva / strīdharmiṇīmariṣṭāṅgīṃ tathā dyūtaparājitām
ce_text: prekṣantyā me tadā hīmāṃ vepantīṃ kadalīm iva / strīdharmiṇīm anindyāṅgīṃ tathā dyūtaparājitām

vulgate_text: rājyasthayā tapastaptuṃ kartuṃ dānavrataṃ mahat / anayā śakyamevādya śrūyatāṃ ca vaco mama
ce_text: rājyasthayā tapas taptaṃ dānaṃ dattaṃ vrataṃ kṛtam / anayā śakyam adyeha śrūyatāṃ ca vaco mama

vulgate_text: sthānamapyasya nṛpateḥ śrotumicchāmyahaṃ vibho / tvattaḥ kīdṛkkadā ceti tanmamākhyāhi tattvataḥ
